nodes.body_text: async function load(seasonId: string, copyId: string) { const parsed = parseCopyId(copyId); const season = await getSeason(seasonId); if (!parsed || !season || season.status === 'draft') return null; const copy = await getCopy(season.collectionName, copyId); if (!copy) return null; const packs = await getPacksForSeason(season); for (const pack of packs) { const card = (await getPackCards(pack.id)).find(c => c.number === copy.card); if (card) return { season, copy, pack, card }; } return null; }

function ScoreChart({ samples }: { samples: ScoreSample[] }) { if (samples.length < 2) return null; const min = Math.min(...samples.map(s => s.score)); const max = Math.max(...samples.map(s => s.score)); const span = Math.max(1, max - min); const t0 = samples[0].at, t1 = samples[samples.length - 1].at; const tspan = Math.max(1, t1 - t0); const pts = samples.map(s => [((s.at - t0) / tspan) * 100, 36 - ((s.score - min) / span) * 32] as const); const line = pts.map(([x, y]) => `${x.toFixed(2)},${y.toFixed(2)}`).join(' '); const gained = samples[samples.length - 1].score - samples[0].score; const fmt = (t: number) => new Date(t).toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short', timeZone: 'UTC' }); return (
{fmt(t0)}= 0 ? 'text-emerald-400' : 'text-rose-400'}>{gained >= 0 ? '+' : '−'}{Math.abs(gained).toLocaleString()} pts since then{fmt(t1)}
); }

A collectible card game played live on {CHANNEL_NAME}’s Twitch channel. Packs are opened on stream, the cards you pull go into your collection, and you can hunt for rare versions, upgrade your duplicates and climb the leaderboard. It’s a fan-made community game and isn’t affiliated with Twitch. No. The cards are virtual trading cards for fun: entries in this game’s own database, not NFTs, tokens, crypto or anything on a blockchain. They aren’t assets or property, have no cash value, and can’t be bought, sold or cashed out, here or anywhere else. Edition numbers and rarities are just part of the game. If anyone offers to sell you our cards, or to “mint” them, it isn’t us. See the{' '} Terms. Only on {CHANNEL_NAME}’s Twitch channel. It doesn’t run anywhere else. Packs are opened live there, and the Twitch extension is only available on that channel. This website just lets you look at your collection and, when you’re logged in, upgrade your cards. There’s no app store version, but you can add the website to your home screen on iPhone, Android or a computer so it opens full screen from its own icon. Step-by-step instructions are on the{' '} Get the app page. On iPhone you’ll need to log in with Twitch once inside the home-screen app.

  • Use the !pack command in chat to get a pack opened on stream for you.

nodes.name: bulkCards

nodes.body_text: async function bulkCards(packId: string, op: BulkCardOp): Promise<{ changed: number }> { await requireAdmin(); const cards = await getPackCards(packId); let changed = 0; const next = cards.map(c => { let updated = c; if (op === 'upgrades-on' && c.upgradesEnabled === false) updated = { ...c, upgradesEnabled: true }; else if (op === 'upgrades-off' && c.upgradesEnabled !== false) updated = { ...c, upgradesEnabled: false }; else if (op === 'all-variants-on' && c.disabledVariants?.length) updated = { ...c, disabledVariants: undefined }; else if (op === 'fullart-off-without-art' && !c.fullArtImageUrl) { // A card with no full-art image would show its normal art as Full Art / Shiny: switch those off for it. const off = [...new Set([...(c.disabledVariants ?? []), 'full', 'shiny'])] as OptionalVariant[]; if (off.length !== (c.disabledVariants ?? []).length) updated = { ...c, disabledVariants: off }; } if (updated !== c) changed++; return updated; }); if (changed > 0) await savePackCards(packId, next); revalidatePath(`/admin/packs/${packId}`); return { changed }; }

'{}')); } catch { /* ignore: saves nothing */ } const autoReload = formData.get('autoReload') === 'on'; const before = await getOverlaySettings(); // Keep a restore point of what is being replaced the first time (so even the very first save can be undone), then of every save. if ((await listVersions()).length === 0) await recordVersion('Before versions were kept'); await saveOverlaySettings({ ...before, layout: payload.layout !== undefined ? sanitizeLayout(payload.layout) : before.layout, props: payload.global !== undefined ? sanitizePropValues(payload.global) : before.props, autoReload, }); // Per-pack overrides only for packs that exist (a crafted payload must not leave stray keys behind). const knownPacks = new Set(await listAllPackIds()); for (const [packId, values] of Object.entries(payload.packs ?? {})) { if (!knownPacks.has(packId)) continue; await savePackOverrides(packId, sanitizePropValues(values, { keepDefaults: true })); } // Scenes (presets with their own overlay URL): each carries its own values and/or layout. for (const [id, scene] of Object.entries(payload.scenes ?? {})) { await updateScene(id, { ...(scene.props !== undefined ? { props: sanitizePropValues(scene.props, { keepDefaults: true }) } : {}), ...(scene.layout !== undefined ? { layout: sanitizeLayout(scene.layout) } : {}), }); } await recordVersion(String(formData.get('note') ?? '')); if (autoReload) await bumpReloadToken(); revalidatePath('/admin/overlay'); const scope = String(formData.get('scope') ?? 'global'); redirect(`/admin/overlay?scope=${encodeURIComponent(scope)}&saved=${autoReload ? 'saved-reload' : 'saved'}`); }

nodes.body_text: async function queueForOverlay(kind: 'pull' | 'collection', formData: FormData, count: number): Promise<ActionResult> { const username = cleanUsername(formData.get('username')); if (!username) return BAD_USERNAME; const status = await getOverlayStatus(); const force = formData.get('force') === 'on'; if (status.connected === 0 && !force) { return { ok: false, needsForce: true, message: 'No overlay is connected, so nothing would play on stream. Open the overlay in OBS first, or queue it anyway to play when one connects.', }; } for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) { const id = crypto.randomUUID(); // A pull is rolled here (lib/draw.ts) so the overlay can only save what was rolled. Gifts are never charged. const draw = kind === 'pull' ? await issueDraw(id, username) : undefined; if (kind === 'pull' && !draw) return { ok: false, message: 'The active season has no packs with cards to open.' }; await enqueueEvent({ id, type: kind, username, queuedAt: Date.now(), ...(draw ? { draw } : {}) }); } await recordActivity({ type: 'trigger', kind, username, source: 'admin', count }); revalidatePath('/admin'); revalidatePath('/admin/activity'); const waiting = status.connected === 0 ? ' It will play when an overlay connects.' : ''; return kind === 'pull' ? { ok: true, message: `Queued ${count} pack${count !== 1 ? 's' : ''} for ${username}.${waiting}` } : { ok: true, message: `Showing ${username}'s collection on stream.${waiting}` }; }

''), 10); const active = await getActiveSeasonWithPacks(); if (!active) return { ok: false, message: 'There is no active season to grant a card in.' }; const card = active.packs.flatMap(p => p.cards).find(c => c.number === cardNumber); if (!card) return { ok: false, message: 'Pick a card from the list.' }; const collectionName = active.season.collectionName; const variant = parseVariant(formData.get('variant')); const made = await addCollectionEntryWithSerial(collectionName, username, encodeEntry(card.number, variant), 'grant'); await ensureUserProfile(username); await recordActivity({ type: 'grant', source: 'admin', username, cardNumber: card.number, variant, collectionName, ...(made.copyId ? { copyId: made.copyId } : {}), ...(made.uid ? { uid: made.uid } : {}) }); revalidatePath('/admin'); revalidatePath('/admin/users'); return { ok: true, message: `Granted ${variant === 'regular' ? '' : VARIANT_LABELS[variant] + ' '}${card.name} (#${card.number}) to ${username}.` }; }

nodes.body_text: async function discordAction(_prev: ActionResult | null, formData: FormData): Promise<ActionResult> { await requireAdmin(); const intent = String(formData.get('intent') ?? 'save'); let raw: unknown; try { raw = JSON.parse(String(formData.get('settings') ?? '')); } catch { raw = null; } const cleaned = cleanDiscordInput(raw); if (!cleaned.ok) return { ok: false, message: cleaned.message }; const { settings } = cleaned; if (intent === 'save') { await saveDiscordSettings(settings); revalidatePath('/admin/settings'); const live = settings.enabled && settings.channels.some(c => c.enabled && c.url); return { ok: true, message: live ? 'Saved. Activity will be posted to Discord.' : 'Saved. Posting to Discord is off.' }; } const [kind, id] = intent.split(':'); const channel = settings.channels.find(c => c.id === id); if (!channel || (kind !== 'test' && kind !== 'last' && kind !== 'recap' && kind !== 'digest')) return { ok: false, message: 'That channel is not in the form any more.' }; if (!channel.url) return { ok: false, message: `${channel.name}: paste a webhook URL first.` }; let result; if (kind === 'test') { result = await deliver(channel, buildTestMessage(), 'test'); } else if (kind === 'digest') { result = await deliver(channel, buildDigestMessage(sampleDigest(), { footer: 'Test digest, made-up numbers' }), 'digest'); } else { const { events } = await getActivity({ limit: 200 }); if (!events[0]) return { ok: false, message: 'There is no activity to send yet.' }; const event = newestMatchingEvent(events, channel); if (!event) return { ok: false, message: 'No recent activity matches this channel’s filters.' }; result = await deliver(channel, await buildMessage(event, { footer: 'Resent from admin' }), 'last'); } if (!result.ok) { return { ok: false, message: `${channel.name}: Discord didn’t accept it: ${result.error}${result.status ? ` (HTTP ${result.status})` : ''}` }; } return { ok: true, message: kind === 'digest' ? `Test digest sent to ${channel.name}.` : kind === 'recap' ? `Test recap sent to ${channel.name}.` : kind === 'test' ? `Test message sent to ${channel.name}. Check your Discord channel.` : `Sent the most recent matching activity to ${channel.name}.` }; }

nodes.name: chime
nodes.body_text: function chime() { try { const Ctx = window.AudioContext || (window as unknown as { webkitAudioContext: typeof AudioContext }).webkitAudioContext; const ctx = new Ctx(); [660, 880].forEach((freq, i) => { const osc = ctx.createOscillator(); const gain = ctx.createGain(); osc.frequency.value = freq; gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, ctx.currentTime + i * 0.14); gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.18, ctx.currentTime + i * 0.14 + 0.02); gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, ctx.currentTime + i * 0.14 + 0.3); osc.connect(gain).connect(ctx.destination); osc.start(ctx.currentTime + i * 0.14); osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + i * 0.14 + 0.32); }); setTimeout(() => ctx.close(), 900); } catch { /* audio unavailable */ } }

nodes.body_text: 'use server'; import { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache'; import { requireAdmin } from '@/lib/admin-guard'; import { activateWithWrapUp } from '@/lib/season-wrap'; import { getPack, savePack, deletePack, getPackCards, savePackCards, getSeason, saveSeason, deleteSeason, listSeasons, setActiveSeason, } from '@/lib/kv'; import type { Card, OptionalVariant, Pack, Season, UpgradeCosts, VariantWeights } from '@/lib/types'; import { cleanDisabled } from '@/lib/variants'; import { notifyAdminLog } from '@/lib/discord'; import { currentStaffLogin } from '@/lib/staff-actor'; import { validatePack, validateSeason, type Issue } from '@/lib/draft-validation'; import { cleanPackInput, int, num, str, type PackInput } from '@/lib/pack-clean'; // Server actions behind the pack / season wizards. Unlike actions.ts they return data instead of // redirecting, because the wizards are client components that autosave as you go. // Every action checks the caller itself (requireAdmin): a server action is a public POST endpoint, so the middleware on the page is not enough. scripts/check-staff-guards.mts fails if one is missing. // ── Packs ───────────────────────────────────────────────── export type { PackInput }; /** Creates the draft record the first time the wizard has something worth keeping. */ /** Autosave target. Only touches drafts, so a stale wizard tab can't overwrite a live pack. */ /** * Replaces a pack's cards with the editor's list. Card numbers are what viewers' collections point at, so * existing cards always keep theirs; new cards get the next free number. Returns the saved cards so the * editor can show the assigned numbers. */ /** Publishes a draft once it passes validation. `active` = include in draws straight away. */ /** Turns a published pack back into a draft (it stops being drawn). */ // ── Seasons ─────────────────────────────────────────────── /** Publishes a draft season; `activate` also makes it the active one (deactivating the rest). */ /** * Takes a published season back to a draft. It stops being the active season (the overlay and Twitch panel see "no * active season" until another is activated) and disappears from the public site. Nothing is deleted: viewers' * collections, the season's packs and its settings are all kept, and it can be edited and published again from * /admin/seasons/new?draft=<id>. */

nodes.name: createDraftPack
nodes.signature: async function createDraftPack(input: PackInput): Promise<{ id: string }>
nodes.body_text: async function createDraftPack(input: PackInput): Promise<{ id: string }> { await requireAdmin(); const id = crypto.randomUUID(); await savePack({ id, createdAt: Date.now(), status: 'draft', ...cleanPackInput(input) }); // No revalidatePath here or in the autosave actions below: it would re-render the wizard page under the // user mid-edit. The list pages are force-dynamic, so they're fresh on every visit anyway. return { id }; }

nodes.body_text: async function saveDraftPack(id: string, input: PackInput): Promise<void> { await requireAdmin(); const existing = await getPack(id); if (!existing) throw new Error('This draft no longer exists.'); if (existing.status !== 'draft') throw new Error('This pack has already been published.'); await savePack({ ...existing, ...cleanPackInput(input) }); }

nodes.body_text: async function saveCards(packId: string, rows: CardInput[]): Promise<Card[]> { await requireAdmin(); const pack = await getPack(packId); if (!pack) throw new Error('Pack not found.'); const existing = await getPackCards(packId); const byId = new Map(existing.map(c => [c.id, c])); let next = existing.reduce((m, c) => Math.max(m, c.number), 0); const seen = new Set<string>(); const cards: Card[] = []; for (const r of rows) { if (typeof r.id !== 'string' || !r.id || seen.has(r.id)) continue; seen.add(r.id); const prev = byId.get(r.id); const full = str(r.fullArtImageUrl) || undefined; const still = str(r.stillUrl) || undefined; const fullStill = full ? str(r.fullArtStillUrl) || undefined : undefined; const sound = str(r.soundUrl) || undefined; const off = cleanDisabled(r.disabledVariants); cards.push({ id: r.id, number: prev?.number ?? ++next, name: str(r.name, 80).trim(), imageUrl: str(r.imageUrl), ...(sound && { soundUrl: sound }), ...(full && { fullArtImageUrl: full }), ...(still && { stillUrl: still }), ...(fullStill && { fullArtStillUrl: fullStill }), ...(off.length > 0 && { disabledVariants: off }), upgradesEnabled: r.upgradesEnabled !== false, probability: num(r.probability, 1, 0), stars: int(r.stars, 1), }); } // Keep ordering by number so the table is stable across reloads. cards.sort((a, b) => a.number - b.number); await savePackCards(packId, cards); return cards; }

function MixItUpConfig({ settings: s }: { settings: MixItUpSettings }) { return (

Pay to pull with Mix It Up

When this is on, a pull from the bot checks the viewer’s balance first and takes {s.currency} when the card is revealed. When it is off, pulls work exactly as before. Gifting packs from the dashboard never charges.

A Mix It Up webhook command that answers with the viewer’s balance. We send {'{ action: "balance", username, currency, secret }'}.

The command that takes the currency. We send {'{ action: "deduct", username, amount, currency, message, pullId, secret }'}. With one address, the command tells them apart by action.

Sent as secret in every request, so the command can check it came from here.

The key in the reply that holds the number, for example {'{ "balance": 250 }'}.

0 = no limit. Each viewer can have their own limit and temporary bonuses on their user page (Admin tab). “Per stream” follows the live Twitch stream; when the channel is offline it is per day (UTC).

Placeholders: {MESSAGE_VARS.map(v => {`{${v}}`})}

How a pull goes

  1. The bot asks for a pack for a viewer. We check their pulls this stream and ask Mix It Up for their balance.
  2. Not enough, or over the limit: no pack, and the answer carries a message the command can post to chat.
  3. Enough: the pack opens. When the card is revealed we tell Mix It Up to take {s.cost.toLocaleString()} {s.currency} and send your message.
  4. If Mix It Up does not confirm the payment, the print is taken back and the System Discord channel is told.

Mix It Up must answer in the reply to each request (a Webhook Response action). A reply counts as paid when it is a 2xx and does not say ok, success or applied is false.

Save Mix It Up

Try it

Uses the saved settings. Neither button takes any currency.

Each one re-checks the admin cookie (see lib/admin-guard.ts) and works on the sandbox // it is given, wherever the admin currently is. Results go back in the redirect URL (?msg=...) so the page is plain server HTML. /** Admin check, and sandboxes are switched off on preview deployments (one level of isolation is enough there). */ const COOKIE_OPTS = { httpOnly: true, secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production', sameSite: 'lax' as const, path: '/', maxAge: 60 * 60 * 24 * 30 }; /** * Runs one tool action: admin check, the sandbox must exist (a missing id would otherwise write into a dead namespace), * then report the outcome on the right tab. `fn` returns the message to show. */ /** Clears (keeps the profile) or deletes the viewers ticked on the Users tab. */ /** Logs the browser in as a test user, valid only inside this sandbox. No Twitch involved. */ /** Form version of loginAsAction (the Users table posts the viewer in a hidden field). */

nodes.name: guarded

nodes.body_text: async function guarded(id: string, tab: string, fn: () => Promise<string>): Promise<never> { await admin(); if (!(await getSandbox(id))) redirect('/admin/sandbox'); let msg: string; try { msg = await fn(); } catch (e) { if (isRedirect(e)) throw e; return back(id, e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Something went wrong.', 'error', tab); } await touchSandbox(id); return back(id, msg, 'ok', tab); }

String(formData.get('source')) : 'config') as SandboxSource; let sandbox; try { sandbox = await createSandbox({ name: String(formData.get('name') ?? ''), source, expiresInDays: Number(formData.get('expiresInDays')) || 0 }); } catch (e) { redirect(`/admin/sandbox?err=${encodeURIComponent(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Could not create the sandbox.')}`); } await logEvent(sandbox.id, 'Sandbox created', `From: ${source}`); await runInSandbox(null, () => notifySystem({ title: '🧪 Sandbox created', text: `**${escapeMd(sandbox.name)}**, from ${source}`, tone: 'info' })); (await cookies()).set(SANDBOX_COOKIE, sandbox.id, COOKIE_OPTS); // creating one drops you straight into it revalidatePath('/admin', 'layout'); redirect(`/admin/sandbox/${sandbox.id}?msg=${encodeURIComponent('Sandbox created. You are now in it: nothing you do here reaches production.')}`); }

nodes.name: enterSandboxAction
nodes.body_text: async function enterSandboxAction(id: string) { await admin(); if (!(await getSandbox(id))) return redirect('/admin/sandbox'); (await cookies()).set(SANDBOX_COOKIE, id, COOKIE_OPTS); await touchSandbox(id); revalidatePath('/admin', 'layout'); redirect(`/admin/sandbox/${id}`); }

nodes.name: exitSandboxAction
nodes.body_text: async function exitSandboxAction() { await admin(); const jar = await cookies(); jar.delete(SANDBOX_COOKIE); // A sandbox test login is meaningless outside its sandbox: drop it too so the public site doesn't look half-logged-in. jar.delete(SESSION_COOKIE); revalidatePath('/admin', 'layout'); redirect('/admin/sandbox'); }

nodes.body_text: async function resetSandboxAction(id: string) { await guarded(id, 'reset', async () => { await resetSandbox(id); await logEvent(id, 'Sandbox reset', 'Wiped and copied from its source again'); revalidatePath('/admin', 'layout'); return 'Sandbox reset to a fresh copy of its source.'; }); }

nodes.body_text: async function deleteSandboxAction(id: string) { await admin(); const gone = await getSandbox(id); await deleteSandbox(id); if (gone) await runInSandbox(null, () => notifySystem({ title: '🧪 Sandbox deleted', text: `**${escapeMd(gone.name)}**`, tone: 'info' })); const jar = await cookies(); if (jar.get(SANDBOX_COOKIE)?.value === id) { jar.delete(SANDBOX_COOKIE); jar.delete(SESSION_COOKIE); } revalidatePath('/admin', 'layout'); redirect('/admin/sandbox'); }

nodes.body_text: async function transferCopyAction(seasonId: string, copyId: string, formData: FormData): Promise<void> { await requireAdmin(); const ret = safeSerialsReturn(formData.get('ret')); const go = (msg: string, ok = true) => back(seasonId, copyId, msg, ok, ret); const ctx = await load(seasonId, copyId); if (!ctx) return go('That print or season does not exist.', false); const to = String(formData.get('to') ?? '').trim().replace(/^@/, '').toLowerCase(); if (!/^[a-z0-9_]{1,25}$/.test(to)) return go('Enter a valid Twitch username to give it to.', false); const c = ctx.season.collectionName; const result = await withCollectionLock(c, async (): Promise<string | null> => { const copy = await getCopy(c, copyId); if (!copy || !copy.owner) return 'That print no longer exists.'; if (isEscrow(copy.owner)) return 'It is held by an open trade offer. Cancel the offer first.'; if (copy.owner === to) return 'They already have it.'; const data = await getCollection(c); const entry = entryOf(copy); const i = data[copy.owner]?.indexOf(entry) ?? -1; if (i < 0) return 'The collection does not match the ledger for this print; nothing was changed.'; data[copy.owner] = [...data[copy.owner].slice(0, i), ...data[copy.owner].slice(i + 1)]; if (data[copy.owner].length === 0) delete data[copy.owner]; data[to] = [...(data[to] ?? []), entry]; await saveCollection(c, data, { moves: [{ from: copy.owner, to, entry, count: 1, ids: [copy.id], note: 'admin transfer' }] }); return null; }); if (result) return go(result, false); await ensureUserProfile(to).catch(() => { /* a profile is a convenience */ }); const label = `${ctx.parsed.variant === 'regular' ? '' : `${VARIANT_LABELS[ctx.parsed.variant]} `}#${ctx.parsed.card} edition ${ctx.parsed.n}`; await recordAudit(to, 'Print received from an admin', label); revalidatePath('/admin/serials'); return go(`Given to @${to}.`); }

'broadcaster' : 'viewer'; // Twitch opaque IDs: "U…" for a viewer logged in to Twitch, "A…" for an anonymous one. nodes.body_text: async function POST(req: NextRequest) { const { data, pull } = await req.json().catch(() => ({})); // Writing is not open to the world. A pull is saved only against a ticket the server issued when it queued the pull // (lib/draw.ts), and what is saved is what the TICKET says: the caller cannot pick the card, the viewer or the collection. // Replacing a whole collection (`data`) is an admin tool. if (!pull) { if (!(await isAuthenticated())) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 }); const target = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get('name'); if (!target || !data || typeof data !== 'object') return NextResponse.json({ error: 'missing name or data' }, { status: 400 }); await saveCollection(target, data); return NextResponse.json({ ok: true }); } const username = String(pull.username ?? '').toLowerCase(); const ticket = typeof pull.ticket === 'string' && username ? await claimDraw(pull.ticket, username) : null; if (!ticket) return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: 'This pull is not recognised, or it was already saved.' }, { status: 401 }); const name = ticket.collectionName; const entry = ticket.entry; // The overlay's in-memory copy of the collection goes stale whenever something else changes it (an upgrade, a grant, an admin // edit), so the pull is appended server-side and the new array is returned for the overlay to resync. let owned: number[] = []; let serial: number | null = null; let copyId: string | null = null; let uid: number | null = null; let before: Record<string, number[]> | null = null; let paid: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof claimPaidPull>> = null; { // A paid pull (Mix It Up) is claimed first, once, so a repeated save cannot add a second print on one payment. if (ticket.paid) { paid = await claimPaidPull(String(pull.ticket), username); if (!paid) return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: 'This paid pull was already used or has expired.' }, { status: 409 }); } before = await getCollection(name); ({ owned, serial, copyId, uid } = await addCollectionEntryWithSerial(name, username, entry, 'pull')); if (paid) { const mix = await getMixItUpSettings(); const card = decodeEntry(entry); const charge = await chargePaidPull(mix, paid, { cardName: ticket.cardName, variant: VARIANT_LABELS[card.variant], stars: ticket.stars, packName: ticket.packName, cardNumber: card.cardNumber, serial, }); if (!charge.applied) { // Mix It Up did not confirm the payment: take the print back and record nothing. const left = await revokePrint(name, username, entry, copyId); await releaseCount(paid); await noticeRevoked(username, ticket.cardName, charge.error ?? 'not applied'); return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, revoked: true, owned: left ?? owned }); } } } // The serial the new copy got and what it is worth (the overlay shows it on the reveal). const mult = serial ? serialMultiplier(serial, await getScoringSettings()) : 1; const { cardNumber, variant } = decodeEntry(entry); // What this pull meant for the viewer (the overlay's special moments use these). const isNew = !before?.[username]?.some(e => decodeEntry(e).cardNumber === cardNumber); const firstForViewer = !before?.[username]?.length; await recordActivity({ type: 'pull', username, collectionName: name, cardNumber, cardName: ticket.cardName, stars: ticket.stars, packName: ticket.packName, variant, isNew, copies: owned.filter(e => decodeEntry(e).cardNumber === cardNumber).length, uniqueOwned: new Set(owned.map(e => decodeEntry(e).cardNumber)).size, ...(serial ? { serial, ...(mult > 1 ? { bonus: Math.round(mult * 100) / 100 } : {}) } : {}), ...(copyId ? { copyId } : {}), ...(uid ? { uid } : {}), }); getWebhookSettings().then(settings => fireOutgoing(settings.outgoing.cardPulled, { username, cardName: ticket.cardName, cardNumber: String(cardNumber), stars: String(ticket.stars), variant, packName: ticket.packName, }) ).catch(() => {}); return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, owned, serial, uid, serialMult: Math.round(mult * 100) / 100, isNew, firstForViewer }); }

'regular').toLowerCase() as Variant; if (!VARIANTS.includes(variant)) { return NextResponse.json({ error: `variant must be one of: ${VARIANTS.join(', ')}` }, { status: 400 }); } const season = await getActiveSeason(); if (!season) { return NextResponse.json({ error: 'No active season' }, { status: 404 }); } const made = await addCollectionEntryWithSerial(season.collectionName, username, encodeEntry(num, variant), 'grant'); // Recorded with the same facts as a pull (name, stars, pack, new or not, how many, edition) so the live feed and Discord show it like one. const card = (await getActiveSeasonWithPacks().catch(() => null))?.packs.flatMap(p => p.cards.map(c => ({ ...c, packName: p.pack.name }))).find(c => c.number === num); const copies = made.owned.filter(e => decodeEntry(e).cardNumber === num).length; const mult = made.serial ? serialMultiplier(made.serial, await getScoringSettings()) : 1; await recordActivity({ type: 'grant', source: 'webhook', username, cardNumber: num, variant, collectionName: season.collectionName, ...(card ? { cardName: card.name, stars: card.stars, packName: card.packName } : {}), isNew: copies <= 1, copies, uniqueOwned: new Set(made.owned.map(e => decodeEntry(e).cardNumber)).size, ...(made.serial ? { serial: made.serial, ...(mult > 1 ? { bonus: Math.round(mult * 100) / 100 } : {}) } : {}), ...(made.copyId ? { copyId: made.copyId } : {}), ...(made.uid ? { uid: made.uid } : {}), }); return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, username, cardNumber: num, variant }); }

nodes.body_text: async function POST(req: NextRequest) { const parsed = await parseIncomingWebhook(req); if (!parsed.ok) return parsed.response; // Admin can restrict this to when the stream is live (Settings → OBS Overlay). const blocked = await liveGate('pull'); if (blocked) return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, ignored: true, reason: blocked }); // Paid pulls (Settings → Mix It Up): the viewer's limit and balance are checked first; a refusal queues nothing and says why. const id = crypto.randomUUID(); const mix = await getMixItUpSettings(); const paid = mix.enabled && !(await inSandbox()); if (paid) { const r = await reservePaidPull(mix, parsed.username, id); if (!r.ok) return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, ignored: true, reason: r.reason, message: r.message, ...(r.balance !== undefined ? { balance: r.balance } : {}) }); } const draw = await issueDraw(id, parsed.username, paid); if (!draw) { if (paid) await releasePaidPull(id); return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, ignored: true, reason: 'no_packs', message: 'There is no active season with packs to open.' }); } try { await enqueueEvent({ id, type: 'pull', username: parsed.username, queuedAt: Date.now(), draw, ...(paid ? { paid: true } : {}) }); } catch (e) { await dropDraw(id); if (paid) await releasePaidPull(id); throw e; } await recordActivity({ type: 'trigger', kind: 'pull', username: parsed.username }); return NextResponse.json({ ok: true }); }

nodes.body_text: async function GET(req: NextRequest) { const returnTo = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get('returnTo'); // ?silent=1 is for the activity feed: the same renewal from the viewer session, but a small JSON answer instead of redirects. const silent = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get('silent') === '1'; const deny = (error: string) => NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error }, { status: 401, headers: { 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' } }); const session = await getSession(); if (silent && (!session || session.sandbox)) return deny('no-session'); if (!session) { if (!loginConfigured()) return NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/login?error=unavailable', req.url)); const here = staffReturnTo(returnTo, 'admin'); // only ever an /admin or /mod path return NextResponse.redirect(new URL(`/auth/twitch?returnTo=${encodeURIComponent(here)}`, req.url)); } if (session.sandbox) return NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/login?error=not-staff', req.url)); // a sandbox test login is never staff const role = resolveRole({ login: session.username, twitchId: session.twitchId }, await getStaffRecord(session.username)); if (!role) { if (silent) { const r = deny('not-staff'); r.cookies.set({ name: STAFF_COOKIE, value: '', maxAge: 0, path: '/' }); return r; } const res = NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/login?error=not-staff', req.url)); res.cookies.set({ name: STAFF_COOKIE, value: '', maxAge: 0, path: '/' }); return res; } const token = await signStaffToken({ u: session.username, id: session.twitchId, dn: session.displayName, role }); if (!token) return silent ? deny('unavailable') : NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/login?error=unavailable', req.url)); if (role !== 'super') await touchStaffLogin(session.username, session.twitchId, session.displayName); if (silent) { const done = NextResponse.json({ ok: true, role }, { headers: { 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' } }); done.cookies.set(STAFF_COOKIE, token, staffCookieOptions()); return done; } const res = NextResponse.redirect(new URL(staffReturnTo(returnTo, role), req.url)); res.cookies.set(STAFF_COOKIE, token, staffCookieOptions()); return res; }

'denied' : 'failed'); const code = params.get('code'); const state = params.get('state'); const cookie = req.cookies.get(OAUTH_COOKIE)?.value; if (!code || !state || !cookie) return fail(req, 'expired'); let expected: { state?: string; returnTo?: string }; try { expected = JSON.parse(cookie); } catch { return fail(req, 'expired'); } if (typeof expected.state !== 'string' || !sameString(expected.state, state)) return fail(req, 'expired'); let profile; try { profile = await profileFromCode(code); } catch (e) { console.error('[auth] Twitch login failed:', e instanceof Error ? e.message : e); return fail(req, 'failed'); } // Same record the Twitch Extension creates, so the website and the panel share one identity. await ensureUserProfile(profile.login, profile.id); const existing = await getUserProfile(profile.login); if (existing && existing.displayName === existing.username && profile.displayName !== profile.login) { await saveUserProfile({ ...existing, displayName: profile.displayName }); // nicer capitalisation, only if never customised } const token = signSession({ username: profile.login, twitchId: profile.id, displayName: profile.displayName }); if (!token) return fail(req, 'unavailable'); const res = NextResponse.redirect(new URL(safeReturnTo(expected.returnTo), req.url)); res.cookies.delete(OAUTH_COOKIE); res.cookies.set(SESSION_COOKIE, token, sessionCookieOptions()); // A staff cookie belongs to whoever was signed in before; a fresh Twitch sign-in must earn its own (via /auth/staff). res.cookies.delete(STAFF_COOKIE); return res; }

nodes.body_text: async function GET(req: NextRequest) { if (!loginConfigured()) return NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/auth/error?reason=unavailable', req.url)); const state = randomBytes(24).toString('base64url'); const returnTo = safeReturnTo(req.nextUrl.searchParams.get('returnTo')); const res = NextResponse.redirect(authorizeUrl(state)); res.cookies.set(OAUTH_COOKIE, JSON.stringify({ state, returnTo }), sessionCookieOptions(60 * 10)); return res; }

0; const below = r.bottom + 6; const top = below + h > window.innerHeight - MARGIN && r.top - 6 - h >= MARGIN ? r.top - 6 - h : below; setPos({ left, top, width }); }, [open]); useEffect(() => { if (!open) return; const close = () => setOpen(false); // Capture phase, and the key is swallowed, so Esc closes only the tip and not a dialog it sits in. const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); setOpen(false); } }; const onDown = (e: PointerEvent) => { if (!wrap.current?.contains(e.target as Node)) setOpen(false); }; document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey, true); document.addEventListener('pointerdown', onDown); window.addEventListener('scroll', close, true); window.addEventListener('resize', close); return () => { document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey, true); document.removeEventListener('pointerdown', onDown); window.removeEventListener('scroll', close, true); window.removeEventListener('resize', close); }; }, [open]); useEffect(() => () => clearTimeout(closeTimer.current), []); return ( { pointer.current = e.pointerType; if (e.pointerType === 'mouse') show(); }} onPointerLeave={e => { if (e.pointerType === 'mouse') hideSoon(); }} onBlur={e => { if (!wrap.current?.contains(e.relatedTarget as Node | null)) setOpen(false); }} > {open && ( {entry.title} {entry.body} {entry.faq && ( More in the FAQ )} )} ); }

nodes.body_text: 'use client'; import { useState } from 'react'; import { Icon } from './Icon'; import { SHARE_W, HEADER_H, BIG_STATS_H, cardArea, cardAreaWithPlate, cardAreaWithStats, plateRect, layoutCards, formatHeight, getShareTheme, binderLayout, statsLayout, type BinderShare, type BinderShareSlot, type Rect, type ShareSpec, type ShareTheme, } from '@/lib/share-image'; import { qrModules } from '@/lib/qr'; const imageCache = new Map<string, Promise<HTMLImageElement | null>>(); /** Loads (and remembers) an image, so changing a theme doesn't fetch and decode the same art again. */ /** Letter-spacing where the browser supports it (the property is newer than the rest of the canvas API). */ const NUMBER_FONT = 'ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace'; /** The engraved metal plate under a single copy's card: a slim bevelled plate, small spaced lettering cut into it, rivets and a QR code. */ /** A rounded rectangle with a separate radius for each corner [top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left]. */ /** The binder's cover: its colour and material, a dashed stitch line and a soft shadow, like the website's. */ /** One pocket: the card in its rarity border (or the binder's look for a card they don't have yet). */ /** The stats card: rank and score, six figure tiles and a strip of their most valuable prints (spec.cards). */ /** Draws the binder pages (cover frame, page paper, headings and every pocket) where the card grid would normally go. */ /** Draws the image on a canvas. A card whose art can't be loaded (blocked or offline) is drawn as a plain tile, never skipped. */ /** Builds the image, then hands it to the phone's share sheet (with the link and a line of text) or downloads it. */ /** A button that builds the image in the browser, then shares it (phones) or downloads it. */

nodes.name: loadImage
nodes.body_text: function loadImage(src: string): Promise<HTMLImageElement | null> { const hit = imageCache.get(src); if (hit) return hit; const p = new Promise<HTMLImageElement | null>(resolve => { const img = new Image(); img.crossOrigin = 'anonymous'; img.onload = () => resolve(img); img.onerror = () => { imageCache.delete(src); resolve(null); }; img.src = src; }); imageCache.set(src, p); return p; }

nodes.body_text: function roundRect(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number, r: number) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x + r, y); ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r); ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r); ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r); ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r); ctx.closePath(); }

nodes.name: drawPlate
nodes.signature: function drawPlate(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, p: NonNullable<ShareSpec['plate']>, rarityEdge: string, font: string, t: ShareTheme, h: number)
nodes.body_text: function drawPlate(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, p: NonNullable<ShareSpec['plate']>, rarityEdge: string, font: string, t: ShareTheme, h: number) { const r = plateRect(h); const look = p.look; const pl = look ? { ...t.plate, ...(look.stops ? { stops: look.stops, dark: !!look.dark } : {}), ...(look.ink ? { ink: look.ink } : {}) } : t.plate; const edge = look?.edge ?? rarityEdge; ctx.save(); ctx.shadowColor = edge; ctx.shadowBlur = 24; const metal = ctx.createLinearGradient(r.x, r.y, r.x + r.w, r.y + r.h); metal.addColorStop(0, pl.stops[0]); metal.addColorStop(0.36, pl.stops[1]); metal.addColorStop(0.62, pl.stops[2]); metal.addColorStop(1, pl.stops[3]); ctx.fillStyle = metal; roundRect(ctx, r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h, 20); ctx.fill(); ctx.restore(); ctx.save(); roundRect(ctx, r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h, 20); ctx.clip(); // Brushed lines. ctx.fillStyle = pl.dark ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)'; for (let x = r.x; x < r.x + r.w; x += 4) ctx.fillRect(x, r.y, 1, r.h); // A soft sheen across the top half, like light on a bevel. const sheen = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, r.y, 0, r.y + r.h); sheen.addColorStop(0, pl.dark ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.10)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.28)'); sheen.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)'); sheen.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.12)'); ctx.fillStyle = sheen; ctx.fillRect(r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h); ctx.restore(); ctx.strokeStyle = edge; ctx.lineWidth = 4; roundRect(ctx, r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h, 20); ctx.stroke(); // An inset bevel: a dark hairline with a light one under it. ctx.lineWidth = 1.5; ctx.strokeStyle = pl.lo; roundRect(ctx, r.x + 10, r.y + 10, r.w - 20, r.h - 20, 12); ctx.stroke(); ctx.strokeStyle = pl.hi; roundRect(ctx, r.x + 11.5, r.y + 11.5, r.w - 20, r.h - 20, 12); ctx.stroke(); // Rivets. for (const [rx, ry] of [[r.x + 28, r.y + 28], [r.x + r.w - 28, r.y + 28], [r.x + 28, r.y + r.h - 28], [r.x + r.w - 28, r.y + r.h - 28]]) { const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(rx - 2, ry - 2, 1, rx, ry, 7); g.addColorStop(0, pl.hi); g.addColorStop(1, pl.rivet); ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(rx, ry, 6.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); ctx.strokeStyle = pl.lo; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.stroke(); } const padL = 62; const show = look?.show; const qr = p.qrUrl && (!show || show.qr) ? qrModules(p.qrUrl) : null; const qrSize = 132; const textW = r.w - padL - 40 - (qr ? qrSize + 70 : 0); const left = r.x + padL; // Engraved lettering: a light edge below and a dark edge above, so it looks cut into the metal. const engrave = (text: string, x: number, y: number, size: number, weight: number, fill: string, maxW: number, family = font, spacing = 0) => { ctx.font = `${weight} ${size}px ${family}`; ctx.textAlign = 'left'; spaced(ctx, spacing); ctx.fillStyle = pl.hi; ctx.fillText(text, x, y + 1.5, maxW); ctx.fillStyle = pl.lo; ctx.fillText(text, x, y - 1, maxW); ctx.fillStyle = fill; ctx.fillText(text, x, y, maxW); spaced(ctx, 0); }; engrave('THE CHEESY TCG · PRINT', left, r.y + 46, 16, 800, pl.ink, textW, font, 3); // A fine rule under the label. ctx.fillStyle = pl.lo; ctx.fillRect(left, r.y + 58, textW, 1); ctx.fillStyle = pl.hi; ctx.fillRect(left, r.y + 59, textW, 1); // The number: small "No." and the digits in a tabular face, much quieter than before. const digits = p.number.replace(/^#/, ''); const nx = left + 50; if (!show || show.number) engrave('No.', left, r.y + 110, 20, 800, pl.ink, 60, font, 2); if (show && !show.number) { /* number left off this pack's back */ } else { ctx.font = `700 52px ${NUMBER_FONT}`; spaced(ctx, 3); if (p.gold) { const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, r.y + 66, 0, r.y + 114); g.addColorStop(0, '#f7d56b'); g.addColorStop(0.5, '#e0a81c'); g.addColorStop(1, '#8a5a00'); ctx.fillStyle = pl.hi; ctx.fillText(digits, nx, r.y + 111.5, textW - 50); ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(60,35,0,0.55)'; ctx.fillText(digits, nx, r.y + 109, textW - 50); ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillText(digits, nx, r.y + 110, textW - 50); spaced(ctx, 0); } else { spaced(ctx, 0); engrave(digits, nx, r.y + 110, 52, 700, pl.ink, textW - 50, NUMBER_FONT, 3); } } if (!show || show.edition) engrave(p.edition, left, r.y + 146, 23, 700, pl.ink, textW); const bits = [(!show || show.date) ? p.date : undefined, ...((!show || show.origin) ? p.lines ?? [] : [])].filter(Boolean) as string[]; if (bits.length) engrave(bits.slice(0, 2).join(' · '), left, r.y + 176, 17, 700, pl.ink, textW, font, 1); if (qr) { const q = r.x + r.w - 62 - qrSize, qy = r.y + (r.h - qrSize) / 2; ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.94)'; roundRect(ctx, q - 8, qy - 8, qrSize + 16, qrSize + 16, 10); ctx.fill(); const cell = qrSize / (qr.size + 2); ctx.fillStyle = '#1f1f24'; for (let row = 0; row < qr.size; row++) for (let col = 0; col < qr.size; col++) if (qr.dark(row, col)) ctx.fillRect(q + (col + 1) * cell, qy + (row + 1) * cell, Math.ceil(cell), Math.ceil(cell)); } }

nodes.body_text: function drawLeather(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, r: Rect, b: BinderShare) { const c = b.cover; ctx.save(); ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)'; ctx.shadowBlur = 40; ctx.shadowOffsetY = 18; ctx.fillStyle = c.b; roundRect(ctx, r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h, 18); ctx.fill(); ctx.restore(); ctx.save(); roundRect(ctx, r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h, 18); ctx.clip(); if (b.material === 'metal') { const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(r.x, r.y, r.x + r.w, r.y + r.h * 0.45); [[0, c.c], [0.22, c.a], [0.38, c.b], [0.56, c.a], [0.78, c.c], [1, c.b]].forEach(([o, col]) => g.addColorStop(o as number, col as string)); ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h); ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)'; for (let x = r.x; x < r.x + r.w; x += 3) ctx.fillRect(x, r.y, 1, r.h); } else if (b.material === 'holo') { const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(r.x, r.y, r.x + r.w, r.y + r.h * 0.3); [[0, c.c], [0.17, c.a], [0.34, '#ff7ab8'], [0.5, '#7ad7ff'], [0.66, '#a6ff9a'], [0.83, c.a], [1, c.c]].forEach(([o, col]) => g.addColorStop(o as number, col as string)); ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h); } else { const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(r.x + r.w * 0.2, r.y, 10, r.x + r.w * 0.2, r.y, Math.max(r.w, r.h) * 1.15); g.addColorStop(0, c.a); g.addColorStop(0.55, c.b); g.addColorStop(1, c.c); ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h); if (b.material === 'cloth') { // A woven look: fine crossing diagonals. ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)'; for (let d = -r.h; d < r.w; d += 5) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(r.x + d, r.y + r.h); ctx.lineTo(r.x + d + r.h, r.y); ctx.stroke(); } ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.12)'; for (let d = 0; d < r.w + r.h; d += 5) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(r.x + d, r.y + r.h); ctx.lineTo(r.x + d - r.h, r.y); ctx.stroke(); } } } ctx.restore(); ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5; roundRect(ctx, r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h, 18); ctx.stroke(); ctx.save(); ctx.setLineDash([7, 6]); ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,214,150,0.35)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5; roundRect(ctx, r.x + 6, r.y + 6, r.w - 12, r.h - 12, 13); ctx.stroke(); ctx.restore(); }

nodes.name: drawPocket
nodes.signature: function drawPocket(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, r: Rect, slot: BinderShareSlot | null, img: HTMLImageElement | null, b: BinderShare, k: number, font: string)
nodes.body_text: function drawPocket(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, r: Rect, slot: BinderShareSlot | null, img: HTMLImageElement | null, b: BinderShare, k: number, font: string) { const dark = !b.page.light; const emptyFill = dark ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.02)' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.03)'; const emptyLine = dark ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.07)' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.1)'; const radius = 8 * k; if (!slot || (!slot.owned && b.missing === 'blank')) { ctx.fillStyle = emptyFill; roundRect(ctx, r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h, radius); ctx.fill(); ctx.save(); ctx.setLineDash([5 * k, 4 * k]); ctx.strokeStyle = emptyLine; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, k); roundRect(ctx, r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h, radius); ctx.stroke(); ctx.restore(); return; } if (!slot.owned) { ctx.fillStyle = dark ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.03)' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.03)'; roundRect(ctx, r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h, radius); ctx.fill(); if (b.missing === 'ghost' && img) { ctx.save(); roundRect(ctx, r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h, radius); ctx.clip(); ctx.globalAlpha = 0.14; if ('filter' in ctx) (ctx as CanvasRenderingContext2D & { filter: string }).filter = 'grayscale(1)'; ctx.drawImage(img, r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h); ctx.restore(); } ctx.save(); ctx.setLineDash([5 * k, 4 * k]); ctx.strokeStyle = dark ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.14)' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.18)'; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.2, 1.5 * k); roundRect(ctx, r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h, radius); ctx.stroke(); ctx.restore(); ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.fillStyle = b.page.muted; const mid = r.y + r.h / 2; ctx.font = `800 ${18 * k}px ${font}`; ctx.fillText(`#${slot.number}`, r.x + r.w / 2, mid + (b.missing === 'name' ? 0 : 6 * k), r.w - 8 * k); if (b.missing === 'name') { ctx.font = `600 ${10 * k}px ${font}`; ctx.fillText(slot.name, r.x + r.w / 2, mid + 16 * k, r.w - 8 * k); } if (slot.label) { ctx.font = `600 ${10 * k}px ${font}`; ctx.fillText(slot.label, r.x + r.w / 2, mid + (b.missing === 'name' ? 29 : 18) * k, r.w - 8 * k); } ctx.textAlign = 'left'; return; } const hex = slot.hex ?? '#facc15'; const frame = b.pocket === 'frame'; const rad = frame ? 10 * k : radius; // The card, with a soft shadow that follows its own (transparent cornered) outline. ctx.save(); ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)'; ctx.shadowBlur = 12 * k; ctx.shadowOffsetY = 5 * k; if (img) ctx.drawImage(img, r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h); else { ctx.fillStyle = '#1f2937'; roundRect(ctx, r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h, rad); ctx.fill(); } ctx.restore(); if (!img) { ctx.fillStyle = '#9ca3af'; ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.font = `700 ${12 * k}px ${font}`; ctx.fillText(slot.name, r.x + r.w / 2, r.y + r.h / 2, r.w - 8 * k); ctx.textAlign = 'left'; } if (b.pocket !== 'flat') { ctx.strokeStyle = hex; ctx.lineWidth = (frame ? 4 : 2) * k; const inset = ctx.lineWidth / 2; roundRect(ctx, r.x + inset, r.y + inset, r.w - 2 * inset, r.h - 2 * inset, rad); ctx.stroke(); } if (b.pocket === 'sleeve') { ctx.save(); roundRect(ctx, r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h, rad); ctx.clip(); const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(r.x, r.y, r.x + r.w, r.y + r.h); g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.22)'); g.addColorStop(0.38, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)'); g.addColorStop(0.7, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)'); g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)'); ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h); ctx.restore(); ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.18)'; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, k); roundRect(ctx, r.x + 0.5, r.y + 0.5, r.w - 1, r.h - 1, rad); ctx.stroke(); } if (b.badges) { const pill = (text: string, x: number, y: number, size: number, fill: string, line: string, ink: string, rightAlign = false) => { ctx.font = `800 ${size}px ${font}`; const w = ctx.measureText(text).width + size * 1.1, h = size * 1.45; const px = rightAlign ? x - w : x; ctx.fillStyle = fill; roundRect(ctx, px, y, w, h, h / 2); ctx.fill(); ctx.strokeStyle = line; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, k * 0.9); ctx.stroke(); ctx.fillStyle = ink; ctx.fillText(text, px + size * 0.55, y + size * 1.1); }; if (slot.count > 1) pill(`×${slot.count}`, r.x + 4 * k, r.y + 4 * k, 10 * k, 'rgba(7,11,29,0.88)', 'rgba(234,179,8,0.5)', '#fde047'); if (slot.tag) pill(slot.tag, r.x + r.w - 4 * k, r.y + r.h - 4 * k - 9 * k * 1.45, 9 * k, 'rgba(7,11,29,0.88)', 'rgba(232,121,249,0.5)', '#f5d0fe', true); } }

nodes.name: pill
nodes.signature: pill = (text: string, x: number, y: number, size: number, fill: string, line: string, ink: string, rightAlign = false)
nodes.body_text: pill = (text: string, x: number, y: number, size: number, fill: string, line: string, ink: string, rightAlign = false) => { ctx.font = `800 ${size}px ${font}`; const w = ctx.measureText(text).width + size * 1.1, h = size * 1.45; const px = rightAlign ? x - w : x; ctx.fillStyle = fill; roundRect(ctx, px, y, w, h, h / 2); ctx.fill(); ctx.strokeStyle = line; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, k * 0.9); ctx.stroke(); ctx.fillStyle = ink; ctx.fillText(text, px + size * 0.55, y + size * 1.1); }

nodes.name: drawStatsCard
nodes.signature: async function drawStatsCard(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, spec: ShareSpec, H: number, font: string, t: ShareTheme, preview: boolean)
nodes.body_text: async function drawStatsCard(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, spec: ShareSpec, H: number, font: string, t: ShareTheme, preview: boolean) { const sc = spec.statsCard!; const L = statsLayout(H, Math.min(3, spec.cards.length)); const accent = sc.accent ?? t.chipText; const imgs = await Promise.all(spec.cards.slice(0, L.thumbs.length).map(c => loadImage(preview ? c.thumb ?? c.src : c.src))); // Rank and score, big. const hero = L.hero, half = (hero.w - 24) / 2; const heroes: [string, string, string][] = [['RANK', sc.rank, accent], ['POINTS', sc.score, t.title]]; heroes.forEach(([label, value, colour], i) => { const x = hero.x + i * (half + 24); ctx.fillStyle = t.tile; roundRect(ctx, x, hero.y, half, hero.h, 26); ctx.fill(); ctx.strokeStyle = i === 0 ? accent : t.chipBorder; ctx.lineWidth = i === 0 ? 4 : 2; ctx.stroke(); ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.fillStyle = colour; ctx.font = `800 110px ${font}`; ctx.fillText(value, x + half / 2, hero.y + hero.h / 2 + 30, half - 40); ctx.fillStyle = t.subtitle; ctx.font = `700 24px ${font}`; spaced(ctx, 3); ctx.fillText(label, x + half / 2, hero.y + hero.h - 28); spaced(ctx, 0); ctx.textAlign = 'left'; }); // Six figures, two columns of three. sc.figures.slice(0, 6).forEach((f, i) => { const r = L.tiles[i]; ctx.fillStyle = t.tile; roundRect(ctx, r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h, 20); ctx.fill(); ctx.strokeStyle = t.chipBorder; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.stroke(); ctx.textAlign = 'left'; ctx.fillStyle = t.subtitle; ctx.font = `700 21px ${font}`; spaced(ctx, 2); ctx.fillText(f.label.toUpperCase(), r.x + 26, r.y + 40, r.w - 52); spaced(ctx, 0); ctx.fillStyle = t.chipText; ctx.font = `800 48px ${font}`; ctx.fillText(f.value, r.x + 26, r.y + 92, r.w - 52); if (f.progress !== undefined) { const bw = r.w - 52, by = r.y + r.h - 24; ctx.fillStyle = t.chipBg; roundRect(ctx, r.x + 26, by, bw, 10, 5); ctx.fill(); if (f.progress > 0) { ctx.fillStyle = accent; roundRect(ctx, r.x + 26, by, Math.max(10, bw * Math.min(1, f.progress)), 10, 5); ctx.fill(); } } else if (f.sub) { ctx.fillStyle = t.subtitle; ctx.font = `600 22px ${font}`; ctx.fillText(f.sub, r.x + 26, r.y + r.h - 18, r.w - 52); } }); // Their most valuable prints, small. if (L.thumbs.length > 0 && L.thumbs[0].h > 60) { ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.fillStyle = t.subtitle; ctx.font = `700 22px ${font}`; spaced(ctx, 3); ctx.fillText('MOST VALUABLE PRINTS', L.strip.x + L.strip.w / 2, L.stripLabelY); spaced(ctx, 0); ctx.textAlign = 'left'; L.thumbs.forEach((r, i) => { const card = spec.cards[i], img = imgs[i], hex = card?.hex ?? '#facc15'; ctx.save(); ctx.shadowColor = hex; ctx.shadowBlur = 22; if (img) ctx.drawImage(img, r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h); else { ctx.fillStyle = t.tile; roundRect(ctx, r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h, 12); ctx.fill(); } ctx.restore(); if (card?.tag) { ctx.font = `800 20px ${font}`; const tw = ctx.measureText(card.tag).width + 18; ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(7,11,29,0.9)'; roundRect(ctx, r.x + r.w - tw - 8, r.y + 10, tw, 32, 16); ctx.fill(); ctx.fillStyle = '#fde047'; ctx.fillText(card.tag, r.x + r.w - tw + 1, r.y + 33); } }); } }

nodes.name: drawBinder
nodes.signature: async function drawBinder(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, b: BinderShare, H: number, font: string, preview: boolean)
nodes.body_text: async function drawBinder(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, b: BinderShare, H: number, font: string, preview: boolean) { const L = binderLayout(b, H); drawLeather(ctx, L.leather, b); const two = L.pages.length === 2; // Load every image the pages need (full art for the saved image, thumbnails for the live preview). const jobs = L.pages.map((_, pi) => Promise.all(b.pages[pi].slots.map(s => { if (!s || (!s.owned && b.missing !== 'ghost')) return Promise.resolve(null); return loadImage(preview ? s.thumb ?? s.src : s.src); }))); const imgs = await Promise.all(jobs); L.pages.forEach((pg, pi) => { const r = pg.rect; const radii: [number, number, number, number] = two ? (pi === 0 ? [10, 0, 0, 10] : [0, 10, 10, 0]) : [10, 10, 10, 10]; ctx.save(); roundRectR(ctx, r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h, radii); ctx.clip(); const paper = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, r.y, 0, r.y + r.h); paper.addColorStop(0, b.page.a); paper.addColorStop(1, b.page.b); ctx.fillStyle = paper; ctx.fillRect(r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h); if (two) { // Shade towards the spine, so the two pages read as an open book. const spineX = pi === 0 ? r.x + r.w : r.x; const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(spineX, 0, spineX + (pi === 0 ? -26 : 26), 0); g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.45)'); g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)'); ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h); } ctx.restore(); ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.06)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1; roundRectR(ctx, r.x + 0.5, r.y + 0.5, r.w - 1, r.h - 1, radii); ctx.stroke(); const title = b.pages[pi].title; if (title) { const fs = Math.min(16, Math.max(11, 12 * L.k)); ctx.font = `800 ${fs}px ${font}`; ctx.fillStyle = b.page.ink; ctx.textAlign = 'left'; spaced(ctx, 1.6); ctx.fillText(title.toUpperCase(), pg.head.x, pg.head.y + fs, pg.head.w); spaced(ctx, 0); } pg.pockets.forEach((pr, si) => drawPocket(ctx, pr, b.pages[pi].slots[si] ?? null, imgs[pi][si] ?? null, b, L.k, font)); }); if (two) { // The three binder rings down the middle. const L0 = L.leather; const cx = L.pages[1].rect.x; [0.22, 0.5, 0.78].forEach(f => { const cy = L0.y + L0.h * f; const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx - 3, cy - 3, 1, cx, cy, 12); g.addColorStop(0, '#f1f1f5'); g.addColorStop(0.6, '#8a8a96'); g.addColorStop(1, '#4b4b55'); ctx.save(); ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)'; ctx.shadowBlur = 5; ctx.shadowOffsetY = 2; ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, 11, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); ctx.restore(); }); } }

nodes.name: renderShare
nodes.signature: async function renderShare(spec: ShareSpec, opts?: { preview?: boolean }): Promise<HTMLCanvasElement>
nodes.body_text: async function renderShare(spec: ShareSpec, opts?: { preview?: boolean }): Promise<HTMLCanvasElement> { const H = formatHeight(spec.format); const t = getShareTheme(spec.theme); const canvas = document.createElement('canvas'); canvas.width = SHARE_W; canvas.height = H; const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d')!; const font = getComputedStyle(document.body).fontFamily || 'sans-serif'; const bg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H); bg.addColorStop(0, t.bg[0]); bg.addColorStop(1, t.bg[1]); ctx.fillStyle = bg; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, SHARE_W, H); const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(SHARE_W / 2, HEADER_H, 40, SHARE_W / 2, HEADER_H, 760); glow.addColorStop(0, t.glow); glow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)'); ctx.fillStyle = glow; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, SHARE_W, H); const bar = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, SHARE_W, 0); t.bar.forEach((c, i, a) => bar.addColorStop(a.length === 1 ? 0 : i / (a.length - 1), c)); ctx.fillStyle = bar; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, SHARE_W, 10); ctx.textAlign = 'left'; ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic'; ctx.fillStyle = t.title; ctx.font = `800 64px ${font}`; ctx.fillText(spec.title.length > 26 ? `${spec.title.slice(0, 25)}…` : spec.title, 70, 108, SHARE_W - 140); if (spec.subtitle) { ctx.fillStyle = t.subtitle; ctx.font = `600 30px ${font}`; ctx.fillText(spec.subtitle, 70, 158, SHARE_W - 140); } if (spec.stats?.length) { ctx.font = `700 30px ${font}`; let x = 70; for (const s of spec.stats) { const w = ctx.measureText(s).width + 36; ctx.fillStyle = t.chipBg; roundRect(ctx, x, 182, w, 46, 23); ctx.fill(); ctx.strokeStyle = t.chipBorder; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.stroke(); ctx.fillStyle = t.chipText; ctx.fillText(s, x + 18, 215); x += w + 14; } } if (spec.bigStats?.length) { const gap = 24, n = spec.bigStats.length; const w = (SHARE_W - 140 - gap * (n - 1)) / n; spec.bigStats.forEach((s, i) => { const x = 70 + i * (w + gap), y = HEADER_H; ctx.fillStyle = t.tile; roundRect(ctx, x, y, w, BIG_STATS_H, 22); ctx.fill(); ctx.strokeStyle = t.chipBorder; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.stroke(); ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.fillStyle = t.chipText; ctx.font = `800 58px ${font}`; ctx.fillText(s.value, x + w / 2, y + 84, w - 24); ctx.fillStyle = t.subtitle; ctx.font = `700 21px ${font}`; spaced(ctx, 2); ctx.fillText(s.label.toUpperCase(), x + w / 2, y + 122, w - 24); spaced(ctx, 0); ctx.textAlign = 'left'; }); } if (spec.binder) await drawBinder(ctx, spec.binder, H, font, !!opts?.preview); if (spec.statsCard) await drawStatsCard(ctx, spec, H, font, t, !!opts?.preview); const n = spec.binder || spec.statsCard ? 0 : spec.cards.length; const area = spec.plate ? cardAreaWithPlate(H) : spec.bigStats?.length ? cardAreaWithStats(H) : cardArea(H); // A tall story fits two columns of 5-6 cards bigger than three thin ones. const cols = H > 1500 && n >= 5 && n <= 6 ? 2 : undefined; const rects = layoutCards(n, area, 28, cols); const imgs = await Promise.all(spec.cards.slice(0, rects.length).map(c => loadImage(opts?.preview ? c.thumb ?? c.src : c.src))); rects.forEach((r, i) => { const card = spec.cards[i]; const img = imgs[i]; const hex = card.hex ?? '#facc15'; if (img) { // The art has transparent rounded corners: draw it as it is (no box behind or border around it) and let the glow follow // its silhouette, since a canvas shadow is cast by the opaque pixels only. ctx.save(); ctx.shadowColor = hex; ctx.shadowBlur = 30; ctx.drawImage(img, r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h); ctx.restore(); } else { ctx.save(); ctx.shadowColor = hex; ctx.shadowBlur = 30; ctx.fillStyle = t.tile; roundRect(ctx, r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h, 18); ctx.fill(); ctx.restore(); ctx.save(); roundRect(ctx, r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h, 18); ctx.clip(); ctx.fillStyle = '#1f2937'; ctx.fillRect(r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h); ctx.fillStyle = '#9ca3af'; ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.font = `700 ${Math.max(18, r.w / 9)}px ${font}`; ctx.fillText(card.name, r.x + r.w / 2, r.y + r.h / 2, r.w - 20); ctx.textAlign = 'left'; ctx.restore(); ctx.strokeStyle = hex; ctx.lineWidth = 4; roundRect(ctx, r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h, 18); ctx.stroke(); } if (card.tag) { const fs = Math.max(20, Math.min(34, r.w / 7)); ctx.font = `800 ${fs}px ${font}`; const tw = ctx.measureText(card.tag).width + 24; // Top right, inset a little so it sits on the card rather than the rounded corner. const tx = r.x + r.w - tw - 18, ty = r.y + 20; ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(7,11,29,0.9)'; roundRect(ctx, tx, ty, tw, fs + 18, (fs + 18) / 2); ctx.fill(); ctx.fillStyle = '#fde047'; ctx.fillText(card.tag, tx + 12, ty + fs + 3); } }); if (spec.plate) drawPlate(ctx, spec.plate, spec.cards[0]?.hex ?? '#facc15', font, t, H); ctx.fillStyle = t.footer; ctx.font = `600 28px ${font}`; ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.fillText(spec.footer, SHARE_W / 2, H - 40, SHARE_W - 140); return canvas; }

nodes.name: ExportResult
nodes.body_text: type ExportResult = 'shared' | 'downloaded' | 'cancelled';

nodes.name: exportShare
nodes.signature: async function exportShare(spec: ShareSpec, filename: string, extra?: { text?: string; url?: string; download?: boolean }): Promise<ExportResult>
nodes.body_text: async function exportShare(spec: ShareSpec, filename: string, extra?: { text?: string; url?: string; download?: boolean }): Promise<ExportResult> { const canvas = await renderShare(spec); const blob: Blob | null = await new Promise(res => canvas.toBlob(res, 'image/png')); if (!blob) throw new Error('no image'); const file = new File([blob], filename, { type: 'image/png' }); if (!extra?.download && navigator.canShare?.({ files: [file] })) { try { await navigator.share({ files: [file], title: spec.title, ...(extra?.text ? { text: extra.text } : {}), ...(extra?.url && navigator.canShare?.({ files: [file], url: extra.url }) ? { url: extra.url } : {}) }); return 'shared'; } catch (e) { if ((e as Error).name === 'AbortError') return 'cancelled'; } } const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob); const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = url; a.download = filename; a.click(); setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 5000); return 'downloaded'; }

nodes.name: ShareImageButton
nodes.signature: function ShareImageButton({ spec, filename, label = 'Share image', className }: { spec: ShareSpec; filename: string; label?: string; className?: string })
nodes.body_text: function ShareImageButton({ spec, filename, label = 'Share image', className }: { spec: ShareSpec; filename: string; label?: string; className?: string }) { const [state, setState] = useState<'idle' | 'working' | 'error'>('idle'); async function go() { setState('working'); try { await exportShare(spec, filename); setState('idle'); } catch { setState('error'); } } return ( <button type="button" onClick={go} disabled={state === 'working'} className={className ?? 'inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-gray-200 bg-white/[0.06] border border-white/10 hover:bg-white/10 rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 transition-colors disabled:opacity-60'}> <Icon name="image" />{state === 'working' ? 'Making image…' : state === 'error' ? 'Could not make the image, retry' : label} </button> ); }

nodes.body_text: async function go() { setState('working'); try { await exportShare(spec, filename); setState('idle'); } catch { setState('error'); } }

nodes.body_text: async function postJsonOnce(url: string, body: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<Response> { const send = (extra?: Record<string, unknown>) => fetch(url, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ ...body, ...extra }) }); let res = await send(); for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 2; attempt++) { if (res.status !== 403) return res; const data = await res.clone().json().catch(() => null) as { captcha?: boolean; siteKey?: unknown } | null; if (!data?.captcha || typeof data.siteKey !== 'string') return res; const token = await requestToken(data.siteKey, attempt > 0); if (!token) return res; // closed: the caller shows the "please complete the quick check" message res = await send({ captchaToken: token }); } return res; }

(window as unknown as { webkitAudioContext?: typeof AudioContext }).webkitAudioContext; if (!Ctx) return; const ctx = new Ctx(); const t = ctx.currentTime; [660, 880].forEach((hz, i) => { const o = ctx.createOscillator(); const g = ctx.createGain(); o.type = 'sine'; o.frequency.value = hz; g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t + i * 0.12); g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.12, t + i * 0.12 + 0.02); g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + i * 0.12 + 0.3); o.connect(g); g.connect(ctx.destination); o.start(t + i * 0.12); o.stop(t + i * 0.12 + 0.32); }); setTimeout(() => ctx.close().catch(() => {}), 800); } catch { /* no audio */ } }

'' : `?since=${version.current}`; const res = await fetch(`/api/notifications${q}`, { cache: 'no-store' }); if (!res.ok || res.status === 204) return; const body = (await res.json()) as { notices: Notice[]; seen: number; v?: number; sound?: boolean }; if (typeof body.v === 'number') version.current = body.v; setNotices(body.notices); setSeen(s => Math.max(s, body.seen)); const known = announced.current; if (known === null) { announced.current = new Set(body.notices.map(n => n.id)); } else { const fresh = freshNotices(body.notices, body.seen, known); fresh.forEach(n => known.add(n.id)); if (fresh.length > 0) { setAlertN(a => a + 1); }); } if (body.sound) chime(); } } // A trade of yours was accepted while you were away or on another page: play it once. if (!showing.current) { const played = readPlayed(); const fresh = body.notices.find(n => n.kind === 'accepted' && n.swap && n.at > body.seen && Date.now() - n.at < FRESH_MS && !played.includes(n.id)); function PrivacyPage() { return (

This policy explains what information {APP_NAME} (the “Extension” and its companion website) collects, why, who it is shared with, and the choices you have. It is operated by {OPERATOR} (“we”, “us”).

{APP_NAME} is a collectible card game played only on the {CHANNEL_NAME} Twitch channel: viewers get cards when packs are opened on stream, and can see their collection in a Twitch Extension and on this website. It is a hobby project made for the {CHANNEL_NAME} community; we do not sell your information and we do not run advertising.

} >

From Twitch, when you use the Extension:

  • Your Twitch opaque user ID. Twitch gives every Extension an anonymous ID for each viewer. We store it so the Extension can recognise you when you come back.
  • Your Twitch user ID and username (login name). Only if you choose to share your identity.{' '} The Extension shows the Twitch “share your identity” prompt when you press Login with Twitch. If you allow it, we use your Twitch user ID to look up your username through the Twitch API, and we store both so your cards can be tied to you. If you decline, the Extension still works for browsing but cannot show your collection. (If you are the channel owner, Twitch signs your role into the token instead, and we use your channel ID.)
  • When you use “Log in with Twitch” on the website, Twitch asks for your permission to share your basic public profile with us: your Twitch user ID, login name, display name and profile picture. We request no extra permissions: we cannot see your email address, chat, follows or subscriptions, and we cannot act on your Twitch account. We use the Twitch access token only once, to read that profile, and then revoke it; we never store it.
  • Your public Twitch profile picture, fetched from Twitch’s public API to show next to your collection and on the leaderboard. Profile pictures are cached for up to 7 days.

    • From playing:

  • Your collection: which cards you have pulled, granted, or upgraded, and in which season; and the resulting leaderboard score, which is calculated from your collection.
  • An activity log of recent game events (pulls, grants, upgrades, trades, resets), each with your username and a timestamp. Only the most recent 500 events are kept.
  • Trade offers you make or receive (who, which cards, any note you write, and when), kept in a log of the latest 400 finished trades. Open offers on the Trade page, including the board, are visible to logged-in viewers.
  • A history for every print. Each print of a card has a print number, an edition number and a record of when it was created and who held, traded or spent it (kept with the usernames involved). It is shown on the card’s public page.
  • Alert devices if you turn on alerts (push notifications): for each device up to five, the push address your browser gives us (a web address that lets us send that browser an alert, together with its encryption keys), a short device label such as “Chrome on Android”, and when it was added and last used. We delete it when you turn alerts off, remove the device in Settings, or the browser tells us the address no longer exists. It is included in your data download. If you report another collector from their profile, we keep your username, the person you reported, the reason, your details and any trade or print link you added, so staff can look into it. Only staff see it: the person you reported is never told who reported them, and reports about you are not part of your data download.
  • Your email address only if you choose to get notifications by email: the address you typed, which kinds of notice you picked, when you added and confirmed it, and why email was switched off if it was (you unsubscribed, or the address bounced or was reported as spam). Until you confirm it with the link we send, nothing else is emailed to it. It is never shown to other collectors, it is included in your data download, and you can remove it in Settings at any time or with the unsubscribe link in any email. Notices waiting to be sent are kept only until they go out.
  • Your settings and profi

A custom colour is clamped in lightness so the header glow stays readable on the dark theme. export const HEX_RE = /^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/; /** Lightness limits (0 to 1) of a custom accent: dark enough colours vanish into the page, pale ones wash the header out. */ export const ACCENT_MIN_L = 0.35; export const ACCENT_MAX_L = 0.7; /** "#rrggbb" in any case → the same colour with its lightness held between ACCENT_MIN_L and ACCENT_MAX_L, lower-case. Null when it is not a 7-character hex colour. */

nodes.name: toHsl
nodes.signature: function toHsl(r: number, g: number, b: number): [number, number, number]
nodes.body_text: function toHsl(r: number, g: number, b: number): [number, number, number] { const max = Math.max(r, g, b), min = Math.min(r, g, b), l = (max + min) / 2, d = max - min; if (d === 0) return [0, 0, l]; const s = d / (1 - Math.abs(2 * l - 1)); const h = max === r ? ((g - b) / d) % 6 : max === g ? (b - r) / d + 2 : (r - g) / d + 4; return [(h * 60 + 360) % 360, s, l]; }

nodes.name: fromHsl
nodes.signature: function fromHsl(h: number, s: number, l: number): [number, number, number]
nodes.body_text: function fromHsl(h: number, s: number, l: number): [number, number, number] { const c = (1 - Math.abs(2 * l - 1)) * s, x = c * (1 - Math.abs(((h / 60) % 2) - 1)), m = l - c / 2; const [r, g, b] = h < 60 ? [c, x, 0] : h < 120 ? [x, c, 0] : h < 180 ? [0, c, x] : h < 240 ? [0, x, c] : h < 300 ? [x, 0, c] : [c, 0, x]; return [r + m, g + m, b + m]; }

nodes.name: clampAccent
nodes.body_text: function clampAccent(hex: string): string | null { if (!HEX_RE.test(hex)) return null; const n = parseInt(hex.slice(1), 16); const [h, s, l] = toHsl(((n >> 16) & 255) / 255, ((n >> 8) & 255) / 255, (n & 255) / 255); const [r, g, b] = fromHsl(h, s, Math.min(ACCENT_MAX_L, Math.max(ACCENT_MIN_L, l))); const byte = (v: number) => Math.round(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, v)) * 255).toString(16).padStart(2, '0'); return `#${byte(r)}${byte(g)}${byte(b)}`; }

nodes.body_text: // Closed alpha / beta: who may use the public site while it is locked (pure and edge-safe: the middleware uses it too). // // Three modes, set by an admin: Open (today), Beta (alpha and beta testers plus staff) and Alpha (alpha testers plus staff). `label` is // separate, so a public beta can show the banner without locking anything. The testers list is the KV hash `access:testers` // (login -> record); the settings are `access:settings`. lib/access.ts has the KV side, lib/access-token.ts the signed cookie. /** What the signed access cookie says the holder is. */ export const ACCESS_MODES: AccessMode[] = ['open', 'beta', 'alpha']; export const ACCESS_LABELS: AccessLabel[] = ['none', 'alpha', 'beta']; export const MODE_LABELS: Record<AccessMode, string> = { open: 'Open', beta: 'Closed beta', alpha: 'Closed alpha' }; export const MODE_HINTS: Record<AccessMode, string> = { open: 'Everyone can use the site.', beta: 'Alpha and beta testers, and staff.', alpha: 'Alpha testers and staff only.', }; export const MAX_TESTERS = 500; export const MESSAGE_MAX = 300; export const DEFAULT_ACCESS: AccessSettings = { mode: 'open', label: 'none', v: 0 }; /** May this visitor in? Staff always; testers when the mode includes their tier; everyone when the site is open. */ /** The cookie's tier, split back into the two inputs of canEnter. */ /** The best tier a person has: staff first, then the tester tier. */ // ── Which paths the gate leaves alone ── // Exempt in every mode: the Twitch panel and its API, the OBS overlay and every webhook / cron / overlay / collection API, the login and // access routes, the staff panels (they have their own gate), the legal pages (not the FAQ: it is for testers too), the closed page itself and static files. const EXEMPT_PAGES = ['/closed', '/login', '/privacy', '/terms', '/admin', '/mod', '/offline', '/email-status']; const EXEMPT_PREFIXES = ['/auth/', '/_next/', '/assets/', '/brand/', '/icons/', '/twitch-panel/']; const EXEMPT_API = ['/api/twitch', '/api/version', '/api/webhooks', '/api/cron', '/api/overlay', '/api/collection', '/api/auth', '/api/admin', '/api/seasons', '/api/sandbox', '/api/upload', '/api/seed', '/api/account/deletion', '/api/account/export']; /** The public site's own APIs, which need a tester or staff sign-in when the site is closed. Every other API is left alone. */ const GATED_API = ['/api/account', '/api/trades', '/api/notifications', '/api/feedback', '/api/search', '/api/live', '/api/recent-pulls']; /** True when the gate never applies to this path. Anything with a file extension counts (static files, the overlay, robots.txt, the service worker). */ /** The default banner text, replaced by the admin's message when one is set. */ export const DEFAULT_BANNER: Record<'alpha' | 'beta', string> = { alpha: 'Alpha: things may change, and progress may be reset before launch.', beta: 'Beta: things may change, and progress may be reset before launch.', }; /** The achievements a tester earns for good (fixed pseudo-season `special`, so they sit outside every season). */ export const SPECIAL_SEASON_ID = 'special'; export const SPECIAL_SEASON_NAME = 'Special'; export const TESTER_ACHIEVEMENTS: Record<TesterTier, { id: string; title: string; detail: string; icon: 'flask' | 'bug' }> = { alpha: { id: `${SPECIAL_SEASON_ID}:alpha-tester`, title: 'Alpha tester', detail: 'Helped test the Cheesy TCG in its closed alpha.', icon: 'flask' }, beta: { id: `${SPECIAL_SEASON_ID}:beta-tester`, title: 'Beta tester', detail: 'Helped test the Cheesy TCG in its closed beta.', icon: 'bug' }, };
