nodes.body_text: function canEnter(mode: AccessMode, tier: TesterTier | null | undefined, isStaff: boolean): boolean { if (mode === 'open' || isStaff) return true; if (mode === 'beta') return tier === 'alpha' || tier === 'beta'; return tier === 'alpha'; }

nodes.name: canEnterTier
nodes.body_text: canEnterTier = (mode: AccessMode, tier: AccessTier): boolean => canEnter(mode, tier === 'staff' ? null : tier, tier === 'staff')

nodes.name: bestTier
nodes.signature: function bestTier(isStaff: boolean, tester: TesterTier | null | undefined): AccessTier | null
nodes.body_text: function bestTier(isStaff: boolean, tester: TesterTier | null | undefined): AccessTier | null { return isStaff ? 'staff' : tester ?? null; }

nodes.name: within
nodes.body_text: within = (path: string, base: string) => path === base || path.startsWith(`${base}/`)

nodes.name: isExemptPath
nodes.body_text: function isExemptPath(pathname: string): boolean { if (/\.[a-z0-9]+$/i.test(pathname)) return true; if (EXEMPT_PAGES.some(p => within(pathname, p))) return true; if (EXEMPT_PREFIXES.some(p => pathname.startsWith(p))) return true; if (pathname.startsWith('/api/')) return EXEMPT_API.some(p => within(pathname, p)) || !GATED_API.some(p => within(pathname, p)); return false; }

nodes.name: isApiPath
nodes.body_text: isApiPath = (pathname: string) => pathname.startsWith('/api/')

nodes.name: access-edge.ts
nodes.body_text: // The middleware's view of the access settings (edge-safe, no @vercel/kv): one GET of `access:settings` over the Upstash REST API, // remembered for 30 seconds per instance. Returns null when the database cannot be reached, which the middleware treats as "open". import { normalizeAccess, type AccessSettings } from './access-core'; const TTL_MS = 30_000; let cache: { at: number; settings: AccessSettings | null } | null = null; /** Forget the remembered settings (tests, and when a cookie proves they are out of date). */ /** The settings, at most 30 seconds old (`fresh` skips the wait). Null on a database error: the caller fails open. */

nodes.name: resetAccessCache
nodes.body_text: function resetAccessCache() { cache = null; }

nodes.name: fetchSettings
nodes.body_text: async function fetchSettings(): Promise<AccessSettings | null> { const url = process.env.KV_REST_API_URL; const token = process.env.KV_REST_API_TOKEN; if (!url || !token) return null; try { const res = await fetch(url.replace(/\/$/, ''), { method: 'POST', headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(['GET', 'access:settings']), cache: 'no-store', signal: AbortSignal.timeout(1500) }); if (!res.ok) return null; const body = (await res.json()) as { result?: unknown }; return normalizeAccess(body.result ?? null); } catch { return null; } }

nodes.name: readAccessSettings
nodes.signature: async function readAccessSettings(fresh = false, now = Date.now()): Promise<AccessSettings | null>
nodes.body_text: async function readAccessSettings(fresh = false, now = Date.now()): Promise<AccessSettings | null> { if (!fresh && cache && now - cache.at < TTL_MS && cache.settings) return cache.settings; const settings = await fetchSettings(); // A failed read is not remembered, so the next request tries again; the last good copy is not used past its time. cache = settings ? { at: now, settings } : null; return settings; }

nodes.name: access-gate.ts
nodes.body_text: // The middleware's gate decision for the closed alpha / beta (pure, so scripts/check-access.mts can run the whole table). import { canEnterTier, isApiPath, isExemptPath, type AccessSettings } from './access-core'; import type { AccessToken } from './access-token'; /** * `settings` is null when the database could not be read, which fails open. A staff cookie passes in every mode (the layouts re-check the * live staff list). An access cookie passes when it was issued at or after the current settings version and its tier is still allowed. */

nodes.name: GateOutcome
nodes.signature: type GateOutcome = | 'pass' // let the request through | 'refresh' // signed in but no usable access cookie: /auth/access checks the lists and issues one | 'closed' // nobody signed in: the /closed page | 'forbidden';
nodes.body_text: type GateOutcome = | 'pass' // let the request through | 'refresh' // signed in but no usable access cookie: /auth/access checks the lists and issues one | 'closed' // nobody signed in: the /closed page | 'forbidden';

nodes.name: gateDecision
nodes.signature: function gateDecision(input: { pathname: string; settings: AccessSettings | null; access: AccessToken | null; staffCookie: boolean; hasSession: boolean }): GateOutcome
nodes.body_text: function gateDecision(input: { pathname: string; settings: AccessSettings | null; access: AccessToken | null; staffCookie: boolean; hasSession: boolean }): GateOutcome { const { pathname, settings, access, staffCookie, hasSession } = input; if (isExemptPath(pathname)) return 'pass'; if (!settings || settings.mode === 'open') return 'pass'; if (staffCookie) return 'pass'; if (access && access.v >= settings.v && canEnterTier(settings.mode, access.tier)) return 'pass'; if (isApiPath(pathname)) return 'forbidden'; return hasSession ? 'refresh' : 'closed'; }

nodes.name: access-token.ts
nodes.body_text: // The signed access cookie `tcg_access` (edge-safe: Web Crypto only, so the middleware can verify it without a database). // // It says "this Twitch account was on the tester list (or staff) when it was issued", with the settings version `v` it was // checked against, and lasts one hour. The middleware uses it for the coarse gate; the layouts and signed-in APIs re-check the live list // (lib/access.ts), so a forged or stale cookie still gets nothing. Signed with SESSION_SECRET, like the staff cookie. import type { AccessTier } from './access-core'; export const ACCESS_COOKIE = 'tcg_access'; export const ACCESS_TTL_S = 60 * 60; const enc = new TextEncoder(); // The signed text is prefixed, so a staff cookie (same secret) can never be passed off as an access cookie. /** The token's contents if it is genuine and not expired, else null. */

nodes.name: AccessToken
nodes.body_text: interface AccessToken { login: string; tier: AccessTier; v: number; exp: number }

nodes.name: b64url
nodes.body_text: b64url = (bytes: Uint8Array) => btoa(String.fromCharCode(...bytes)).replace(/\+/g, '-').replace(/\//g, '_').replace(/=+$/, '')

nodes.name: fromB64url
nodes.body_text: fromB64url = (s: string) => Uint8Array.from(atob(s.replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/')), c => c.charCodeAt(0))

nodes.name: secret
nodes.signature: function secret(env: Record<string, string | undefined> = process.env): string | null
nodes.body_text: function secret(env: Record<string, string | undefined> = process.env): string | null { const s = env.SESSION_SECRET; return s && s.length >= 16 ? s : null; }

nodes.name: hmac
nodes.signature: async function hmac(payload: string, key: string): Promise<Uint8Array>
nodes.body_text: async function hmac(payload: string, key: string): Promise<Uint8Array> { const k = await crypto.subtle.importKey('raw', enc.encode(key), { name: 'HMAC', hash: 'SHA-256' }, false, ['sign']); return new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.sign('HMAC', k, enc.encode(`access:${payload}`))); }

nodes.name: same
nodes.body_text: same = (a: Uint8Array, b: Uint8Array) => { if (a.length !== b.length) return false; let d = 0; for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) d |= a[i] ^ b[i]; return d === 0; }

nodes.name: signAccessToken
nodes.signature: async function signAccessToken(data: { login: string; tier: AccessTier; v: number }, now = Date.now(), env?: Record<string, string | undefined>): Promise<string | null>
nodes.body_text: async function signAccessToken(data: { login: string; tier: AccessTier; v: number }, now = Date.now(), env?: Record<string, string | undefined>): Promise<string | null> { const key = secret(env); if (!key) return null; const token: AccessToken = { ...data, exp: Math.floor(now / 1000) + ACCESS_TTL_S }; const payload = b64url(enc.encode(JSON.stringify(token))); return `${payload}.${b64url(await hmac(payload, key))}`; }

nodes.name: verifyAccessToken
nodes.signature: async function verifyAccessToken(raw: string | undefined, now = Date.now(), env?: Record<string, string | undefined>): Promise<AccessToken | null>
nodes.body_text: async function verifyAccessToken(raw: string | undefined, now = Date.now(), env?: Record<string, string | undefined>): Promise<AccessToken | null> { const key = secret(env); if (!key || !raw) return null; const parts = raw.split('.'); if (parts.length !== 2 || !parts[0] || !parts[1]) return null; try { if (!same(await hmac(parts[0], key), fromB64url(parts[1]))) return null; const t = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(fromB64url(parts[0]))) as AccessToken; if (typeof t.login !== 'string' || typeof t.v !== 'number' || typeof t.exp !== 'number' || t.exp < now / 1000) return null; if (t.tier !== 'alpha' && t.tier !== 'beta' && t.tier !== 'staff') return null; return t; } catch { return null; } }

nodes.name: accessCookieOptions
nodes.body_text: function accessCookieOptions(maxAge = ACCESS_TTL_S) { return { httpOnly: true, secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production', sameSite: 'lax' as const, path: '/', maxAge }; }

nodes.name: access.ts
nodes.body_text: // Closed alpha / beta, the server side (pure parts in access-core.ts, the cookie in access-token.ts). Settings are the KV key // `access:settings`, testers the hash `access:testers` (login -> record), changes are logged in `access:log`. // // Like the staff list, this is real account data, so it lives in the PRODUCTION namespace (`prodKv`) even inside a sandbox, and a // preview deployment (fenced from writing it) cannot change it. import { redirect } from 'next/navigation'; import { headers } from 'next/headers'; import { NextResponse } from 'next/server'; import { isPreview, kv, prodKv, runInSandbox } from './db'; import { notifyAdminLog } from './discord'; import { recordAudit } from './audit'; import { getSession, type Session } from './session'; import { getStaffRecord } from './staff'; import { getStaff } from './staff-guard'; import { resolveRole, cleanLogin } from './staff-core'; import { MAX_TESTERS, MODE_LABELS, SPECIAL_SEASON_ID, SPECIAL_SEASON_NAME, TESTER_ACHIEVEMENTS, bestTier, canEnterTier, isApiPath, isExemptPath, normalizeAccess, sanitizeTester, type AccessMode, type AccessLabel, type AccessSettings, type AccessTier, type TesterRecord, type TesterTier, } from './access-core'; const SETTINGS = 'access:settings'; const TESTERS = 'access:testers'; const LOG = 'access:log'; const LOG_CAP = 100; const PREVIEW_REFUSAL: AccessResult = { ok: false, message: 'Access cannot be changed on a preview deployment. Do it on the live site.' }; /** Saves the mode, label and closed-page message. `v` goes up on every change, which sends every signed cookie back for a re-check. */ // ── Testers ── /** The achievement is written straight into the viewer's earned list and never taken back (even if they are removed, or move up a tier). */ /** Adds someone to the list (or moves them to another tier) and awards the tester achievement. */ /** Removes the tester record on account deletion (the achievement goes with the rest of their data). */ // ── Who may enter ── /** The access tier for a signed-in viewer, from the live staff and tester lists. */ /** True when this request may use the site now: the site is open, or the signed-in viewer is a tester the mode includes, or staff. */ /** * The authoritative check for the public layouts: redirects to /closed. The paths the gate leaves alone (privacy, terms) still render, * and the answer says whether this viewer may see the rest of the site: false means show those pages without the site's nav and links. */ /** For the signed-in public APIs: a 403 answer when the site is closed to this caller, else null. */

nodes.name: AccessResult
nodes.body_text: interface AccessResult { ok: boolean; message: string }

nodes.name: AccessLogEntry
nodes.body_text: interface AccessLogEntry { at: number; by: string; what: string }

nodes.name: getAccessSettings
nodes.body_text: async function getAccessSettings(): Promise<AccessSettings> { try { return normalizeAccess(await prodKv.get(SETTINGS)); } catch { return normalizeAccess(null); } }

nodes.name: logChange
nodes.signature: async function logChange(by: string, what: string)
nodes.body_text: async function logChange(by: string, what: string) { try { await prodKv.lpush(LOG, { at: Date.now(), by, what }); await prodKv.ltrim(LOG, 0, LOG_CAP - 1); } catch { /* best effort */ } }

nodes.name: getAccessLog
nodes.body_text: async function getAccessLog(limit = 20): Promise<AccessLogEntry[]> { try { return (await prodKv.lrange<AccessLogEntry>(LOG, 0, limit - 1)) ?? []; } catch { return []; } }

nodes.name: saveAccessSettings
nodes.signature: async function saveAccessSettings(by: string, input: { mode: AccessMode; label: AccessLabel; message?: string }): Promise<AccessResult>
nodes.body_text: async function saveAccessSettings(by: string, input: { mode: AccessMode; label: AccessLabel; message?: string }): Promise<AccessResult> { if (isPreview()) return PREVIEW_REFUSAL; const before = await getAccessSettings(); const next = normalizeAccess({ mode: input.mode, label: input.label, message: input.message, v: before.v + 1 }); await prodKv.set(SETTINGS, next); const parts: string[] = []; if (before.mode !== next.mode) parts.push(`mode ${MODE_LABELS[before.mode]} to ${MODE_LABELS[next.mode]}`); if (before.label !== next.label) parts.push(`banner ${before.label} to ${next.label}`); if ((before.message ?? '') !== (next.message ?? '')) parts.push('message changed'); const what = parts.join(', ') || 'saved, nothing changed'; await logChange(by, what); void notifyAdminLog({ action: 'Site access changed', subject: MODE_LABELS[next.mode], detail: what, by }); return { ok: true, message: next.mode === 'open' ? 'Saved. The site is open to everyone.' : `Saved. The site is now ${MODE_LABELS[next.mode].toLowerCase()}.` }; }

nodes.name: getTester
nodes.signature: async function getTester(login: string): Promise<TesterRecord | null>
nodes.body_text: async function getTester(login: string): Promise<TesterRecord | null> { const l = cleanLogin(login); if (!l) return null; try { return sanitizeTester(await prodKv.hget(TESTERS, l)); } catch { return null; } }

nodes.name: listTesters
nodes.body_text: async function listTesters(): Promise<TesterRecord[]> { try { const all = (await prodKv.hgetall(TESTERS)) ?? {}; return Object.values(all).map(sanitizeTester).filter((r): r is TesterRecord => !!r) .sort((a, b) => (a.tier === b.tier ? a.login.localeCompare(b.login) : a.tier === 'alpha' ? -1 : 1)); } catch { return []; } }

nodes.name: awardTesterAchievement
nodes.signature: async function awardTesterAchievement(login: string, tier: TesterTier): Promise<void>
nodes.body_text: async function awardTesterAchievement(login: string, tier: TesterTier): Promise<void> { const a = TESTER_ACHIEVEMENTS[tier]; try { await runInSandbox(null, async () => { const key = `user:${login}:ach`; const have = await kv.hget(key, a.id); if (have) return; await kv.hset(key, { [a.id]: { id: a.id, seasonId: SPECIAL_SEASON_ID, seasonName: SPECIAL_SEASON_NAME, title: a.title, detail: a.detail, icon: a.icon, have: 1, need: 1, earned: true, earnedAt: Date.now() } }); }); } catch { /* best effort: setting the tier again awards it */ } }

nodes.name: setTester
nodes.signature: async function setTester(by: string, loginInput: unknown, tier: unknown, noteInput?: unknown): Promise<AccessResult>
nodes.body_text: async function setTester(by: string, loginInput: unknown, tier: unknown, noteInput?: unknown): Promise<AccessResult> { if (isPreview()) return PREVIEW_REFUSAL; const login = cleanLogin(loginInput); if (!login) return { ok: false, message: 'Enter a Twitch username (3 to 25 letters, numbers or underscores).' }; if (tier !== 'alpha' && tier !== 'beta') return { ok: false, message: 'Pick alpha or beta.' }; const existing = await getTester(login); if (!existing && Object.keys((await prodKv.hgetall(TESTERS)) ?? {}).length >= MAX_TESTERS) return { ok: false, message: `The list is full (${MAX_TESTERS} testers).` }; const note = typeof noteInput === 'string' ? noteInput.trim().slice(0, 120) : existing?.note; const record: TesterRecord = { login, tier, addedBy: existing?.addedBy || by, addedAt: existing?.addedAt || Date.now(), ...(note ? { note } : {}) }; await prodKv.hset(TESTERS, { [login]: record }); await awardTesterAchievement(login, tier); await recordAudit(login, existing ? 'Tester tier changed' : 'Tester added', `${existing ? `${existing.tier} to ` : 'as '}${tier}`); await logChange(by, `${login} ${existing ? `${existing.tier} to ${tier}` : `added as ${tier}`}`); return { ok: true, message: existing ? `${login} is now a${tier === 'alpha' ? 'n alpha' : ' beta'} tester.` : `${login} added as a${tier === 'alpha' ? 'n alpha' : ' beta'} tester.` }; }

nodes.name: removeTester
nodes.signature: async function removeTester(by: string, loginInput: unknown): Promise<AccessResult>
nodes.body_text: async function removeTester(by: string, loginInput: unknown): Promise<AccessResult> { if (isPreview()) return PREVIEW_REFUSAL; const login = cleanLogin(loginInput); const rec = login ? await getTester(login) : null; if (!login || !rec) return { ok: false, message: 'That person isn\'t on the tester list.' }; await prodKv.hdel(TESTERS, login); await recordAudit(login, 'Tester removed', `was ${rec.tier}`); await logChange(by, `${login} removed (was ${rec.tier})`); return { ok: true, message: `${login} is no longer a tester. They keep the achievement, and lose access within the hour.` }; }

nodes.name: deleteTesterRecord
nodes.body_text: async function deleteTesterRecord(login: string): Promise<void> { try { await prodKv.hdel(TESTERS, login.toLowerCase()); } catch { /* best effort */ } }

nodes.name: tierFor
nodes.signature: async function tierFor(session: Pick<Session, 'username' | 'twitchId' | 'sandbox'> | null): Promise<AccessTier | null>
nodes.body_text: async function tierFor(session: Pick<Session, 'username' | 'twitchId' | 'sandbox'> | null): Promise<AccessTier | null> { if (!session || session.sandbox) return null; const staff = resolveRole({ login: session.username, twitchId: session.twitchId }, await getStaffRecord(session.username)); const tester = staff ? null : (await getTester(session.username))?.tier ?? null; return bestTier(!!staff, tester); }

nodes.name: hasSiteAccess
nodes.body_text: async function hasSiteAccess(): Promise<boolean> { const settings = await getAccessSettings(); if (settings.mode === 'open') return true; const tier = await tierFor(await getSession()); if (tier && canEnterTier(settings.mode, tier)) return true; return !!(await getStaff()); // the owner's emergency password login and any staff cookie }

nodes.name: requireSiteAccess
nodes.body_text: async function requireSiteAccess(): Promise<boolean> { let exempt = false; try { const path = (await headers()).get('x-tcg-path'); exempt = !!path && isExemptPath(path); } catch { /* no request headers: check anyway */ } let allowed = true; try { allowed = await hasSiteAccess(); } catch { allowed = true; } // a KV blip must not lock the site while live if (!allowed && !exempt) redirect('/closed'); return allowed; }

nodes.name: siteClosedResponse
nodes.body_text: async function siteClosedResponse(): Promise<NextResponse | null> { try { if (await hasSiteAccess()) return null; } catch { return null; } return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: 'closed' }, { status: 403, headers: { 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' } }); }

nodes.name: account-deletion.ts
nodes.body_text: import { deleteTesterRecord } from './access'; import { deleteUserPullLimit } from './pull-limit'; import { kv } from './db'; import { listSeasons, getUserProfile, deleteUserProfile, removeUserFromCollection } from './kv'; import { takeUserSnapshot } from './user-admin'; import { cancelOpenTrades } from './trades'; import { deleteUserSettings } from './user-settings-store'; import { deleteAllDevices } from './push'; import { deleteEmail } from './email'; import { recordAudit } from './audit'; import { recordActivity } from './activity'; import { deleteFeedbackOf } from './feedback'; // Deleting a viewer completely (admin "Delete this viewer", and the Users page delete). Order matters: open offers are cancelled first so // escrowed prints go back to the viewer, then every collection is emptied (the print ledger retires what they held), then the rest. /** Removes the Twitch extension's opaque-ID links that point at this viewer. Needs a key scan, so it is skipped where one is not possible (a sandbox). */

nodes.name: DeletionReport
nodes.body_text: interface DeletionReport { snapshot: boolean; tradesCancelled: number; feedbackDeleted: number; opaqueRemoved: number }

nodes.name: removeOpaqueLinks
nodes.body_text: async function removeOpaqueLinks(user: string): Promise<number> { let removed = 0; try { let cursor: string | number = 0; for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) { const [next, keys] = (await kv.scan(cursor, { match: 'twitch_opaque:*', count: 500 })) as [string | number, string[]]; for (const k of keys) if (String(await kv.get(k)).toLowerCase() === user) { await kv.del(k); removed++; } cursor = next; if (String(cursor) === '0') break; } } catch { /* best effort */ } return removed; }

nodes.name: deleteViewerAccount
nodes.body_text: async function deleteViewerAccount(username: string): Promise<DeletionReport> { const user = username.toLowerCase(); // Open offers first, so escrowed prints are back in the collection before the restore point is taken and before anything is retired. const tradesCancelled = await cancelOpenTrades({ username: user }, 'The account was deleted'); const snapshot = !!(await takeUserSnapshot(user, 'Before deleting the account')); const seasons = await listSeasons(); for (const s of seasons) await removeUserFromCollection(s.collectionName, user); const profile = await getUserProfile(user); await deleteUserProfile(user); await deleteUserPullLimit(user); await deleteUserSettings(user); // settings, pinned / favourites, watches and the watch index await deleteTesterRecord(user); await deleteAllDevices(user); await deleteEmail(user); await kv.del(`notif:${user}`, `notif:${user}:seen`, `notif:${user}:v`, `user:${user}:ach`, ...seasons.map(s => `user:${user}:scorehist:${s.id}`)); const hidden = (await kv.get<string[]>('users:hidden').catch(() => null)) ?? []; if (hidden.includes(user)) await kv.set('users:hidden', hidden.filter(u => u !== user)); const feedbackDeleted = await deleteFeedbackOf(user); const opaqueRemoved = await removeOpaqueLinks(user); await recordAudit(user, 'Account deleted', `cards, profile, settings, notices, alert devices and email address removed${profile ? '' : ' (there was no profile)'}; a restore point is kept for 14 days`); await recordActivity({ type: 'delete', username: user }); return { snapshot, tradesCancelled, feedbackDeleted, opaqueRemoved }; }

nodes.name: achievements-store.ts
nodes.body_text: import { kv } from './db'; import { getCollection, getPackCards, getPacksForSeason, listSeasons } from './kv'; import { countVariants, allowedVariants } from './variants'; import { evaluateSeason, sortAchievements, type AchCard, type Achievement } from './achievements'; import { loadSerialIndex } from './serials'; import { getScoringSettings } from './scoring'; // The server side of achievements: works out every goal across the published seasons and remembers what has been earned // (KV hash `user:<u>:ach`, id -> the achievement as it was, plus when it was first seen earned) so a goal is never taken back. /** Computes (and stores anything newly earned for) one viewer. Best effort: a failure returns what is already stored. */

nodes.name: EarnedAchievement
nodes.body_text: interface EarnedAchievement extends Achievement { earnedAt: number }

nodes.name: key
nodes.body_text: key = (u: string) => `user:${u.toLowerCase()}:ach`

nodes.name: AchievementsView
nodes.body_text: interface AchievementsView { earned: EarnedAchievement[]; /** Goals not yet earned, closest first (only for seasons that are still running). */ next: Achievement[]; }

nodes.name: syncAchievements
nodes.signature: async function syncAchievements(username: string, now = Date.now()): Promise<AchievementsView>
nodes.body_text: async function syncAchievements(username: string, now = Date.now()): Promise<AchievementsView> { const u = username.toLowerCase(); let stored: Record<string, EarnedAchievement> = {}; try { const raw = (await kv.hgetall(key(u))) as Record<string, unknown> | null; for (const [id, v] of Object.entries(raw ?? {})) { const parsed = typeof v === 'string' ? JSON.parse(v) : v; if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object') stored[id] = parsed as EarnedAchievement; } } catch { stored = {}; } const live: Achievement[] = []; try { const seasons = (await listSeasons()).filter(s => s.status !== 'draft'); const cutoff = (await getScoringSettings().catch(() => null))?.serialBonusCutoff ?? 0; await Promise.all(seasons.map(async season => { const [collection, packs] = await Promise.all([getCollection(season.collectionName), getPacksForSeason(season)]); const owned = collection[u]; if (!owned || owned.length === 0) return; const cards: AchCard[] = []; for (const pack of packs.filter(p => p.status !== 'draft')) { for (const c of await getPackCards(pack.id)) { cards.push({ number: c.number, stars: c.stars, variants: pack.upgradesEnabled && c.upgradesEnabled !== false ? allowedVariants(pack, c) : ['regular'] }); } } // Edition numbers need the season's copies to be numbered; until then there are no serial milestones. const idx = await loadSerialIndex(season.collectionName).catch(() => null); const held = idx ? idx.held.get(u) ?? new Map<number, number[]>() : undefined; live.push(...evaluateSeason({ seasonId: season.id, seasonName: season.name, cards, counts: countVariants(owned), held, bonusCutoff: cutoff })); })); } catch { /* keep what we have */ } const fresh = live.filter(a => a.earned && !stored[a.id]); if (fresh.length > 0) { const add = Object.fromEntries(fresh.map(a => [a.id, { ...a, earnedAt: now } satisfies EarnedAchievement])); try { await kv.hset(key(u), add); } catch { /* try again next view */ } Object.assign(stored, add); } // Tester achievements (pseudo-season `special`, written by lib/access.ts) are kept as they are and listed first. const sorted = sortAchievements(Object.values(stored).map(a => ({ ...a, earned: true }))); const earned = [...sorted.filter(a => a.seasonId === 'special'), ...sorted.filter(a => a.seasonId !== 'special')]; const earnedIds = new Set(earned.map(a => a.id)); const activeSeasons = new Set((await listSeasons().catch(() => [])).filter(s => s.active && !s.endedAt).map(s => s.id)); const next = sortAchievements(live.filter(a => !earnedIds.has(a.id) && activeSeasons.has(a.seasonId) && a.have > 0)); return { earned, next }; }

nodes.name: achievements.ts
nodes.body_text: import type { IconName } from '@/app/components/Icon'; import type { Variant } from './types'; import { VARIANTS, VARIANT_LABELS, decodeEntry, type VariantCounts } from './variants'; import { RARITIES } from './rarity'; // Profile achievements (pure, client-safe): collection goals per season, such as completing the season, owning every card of a // rarity, or every card in a version. `evaluateSeason` says what is earned and how far along each goal is; lib/achievements-store.ts // remembers what was earned so a goal is never taken back when copies are traded away. /** Every goal for one season. Goals that make no sense for the season (no cards of a rarity, no upgrades) are left out. */ /** One-off goals about the numbers on the copies you hold: first editions and early numbers. Needs the season's copies to be numbered. */ /** Earned first (newest first when dates are known), then the closest to done. */

nodes.name: AchCard
nodes.body_text: interface AchCard { number: number; stars: number; /** The versions this card can be pulled in (Regular only where upgrades are off). */ variants: Variant[] }

nodes.name: AchSeason
nodes.body_text: interface AchSeason { seasonId: string; seasonName: string; cards: AchCard[]; /** The viewer's copies per card number, by version. */ counts: Map<number, VariantCounts>; /** The edition numbers they hold, by entry (card + version), when the season's copies are numbered. Switches on the serial milestones. */ held?: Map<number, number[]>; /** The serial bonus cutoff (editions up to this number earn extra points; 0 = none). */ bonusCutoff?: number; }

nodes.name: Achievement
nodes.body_text: interface Achievement { /** `<seasonId>:<kind>`, stable, so it can be stored. */ id: string; seasonId: string; seasonName: string; title: string; detail: string; icon: IconName; have: number; need: number; earned: boolean; }

nodes.name: owns
nodes.signature: owns = (s: AchSeason, number: number, v?: Variant): boolean
nodes.body_text: owns = (s: AchSeason, number: number, v?: Variant): boolean => { const c = s.counts.get(number); if (!c) return false; return v ? c[v] > 0 : VARIANTS.some(x => c[x] > 0); }

nodes.name: goal
nodes.signature: function goal(s: AchSeason, kind: string, title: string, detail: string, icon: IconName, cards: AchCard[], has: (c: AchCard) => boolean): Achievement | null
nodes.body_text: function goal(s: AchSeason, kind: string, title: string, detail: string, icon: IconName, cards: AchCard[], has: (c: AchCard) => boolean): Achievement | null { if (cards.length === 0) return null; const have = cards.filter(has).length; return { id: `${s.seasonId}:${kind}`, seasonId: s.seasonId, seasonName: s.seasonName, title, detail, icon, have, need: cards.length, earned: have === cards.length }; }

nodes.name: evaluateSeason
nodes.body_text: function evaluateSeason(s: AchSeason): Achievement[] { const out: (Achievement | null)[] = []; out.push(goal(s, 'complete', `Completed ${s.seasonName}`, `Own at least one of every card in ${s.seasonName}.`, 'cheese', s.cards, c => owns(s, c.number))); for (const tier of [...RARITIES].sort((a, b) => a.stars - b.stars)) { const cards = s.cards.filter(c => c.stars === tier.stars); out.push(goal(s, `tier-${tier.stars}`, `All ${tier.label}`, `Own every ${tier.label} card in ${s.seasonName}.`, 'award', cards, c => owns(s, c.number))); } for (const v of VARIANTS.filter(x => x !== 'regular')) { const cards = s.cards.filter(c => c.variants.includes(v)); out.push(goal(s, `all-${v}`, `All ${VARIANT_LABELS[v]}`, `Own the ${VARIANT_LABELS[v]} version of every card that has one in ${s.seasonName}.`, v === 'shiny' ? 'sparkles' : 'gem', cards, c => owns(s, c.number, v))); } // The master set: every card in every version it can be pulled in. Only meaningful when some card has more than one version. if (s.cards.some(c => c.variants.length > 1)) { const wanted = s.cards.flatMap(c => c.variants.map(v => ({ number: c.number, stars: c.stars, variants: [v] as Variant[] }))); out.push(goal(s, 'master', `Master set: ${s.seasonName}`, `Own every card in every version in ${s.seasonName}.`, 'trophy', wanted, c => owns(s, c.number, c.variants[0]))); } if (s.held) out.push(...serialGoals(s)); return out.filter((a): a is Achievement => a !== null); }

nodes.name: serialGoals
nodes.body_text: function serialGoals(s: AchSeason): Achievement[] { if (!s.held) return []; const goals: Achievement[] = []; const mk = (kind: string, title: string, detail: string, icon: IconName, have: number, need: number): Achievement => ({ id: `${s.seasonId}:${kind}`, seasonId: s.seasonId, seasonName: s.seasonName, title, detail, icon, have: Math.min(have, need), need, earned: have >= need }); const firsts = new Map<number, Set<Variant>>(); // card -> versions whose edition #1 they hold let early = 0; for (const [entry, list] of s.held) { const { cardNumber, variant } = decodeEntry(entry); if (list.includes(1)) firsts.set(cardNumber, (firsts.get(cardNumber) ?? new Set()).add(variant)); if ((s.bonusCutoff ?? 0) > 0 && list.some(n => n <= (s.bonusCutoff ?? 0))) early++; } goals.push(mk('first-edition', 'First edition', `Hold edition #1 of any card in ${s.seasonName}: the very first print ever made.`, 'gem', firsts.size > 0 ? 1 : 0, 1)); if (s.cards.some(c => c.variants.includes('shiny'))) { const shinyFirst = [...firsts.values()].some(v => v.has('shiny')); goals.push(mk('first-shiny', 'First shiny edition', `Hold edition #1 of a Shiny Full Art card in ${s.seasonName}.`, 'sparkles', shinyFirst ? 1 : 0, 1)); } goals.push(mk('five-firsts', 'Five firsts', `Hold edition #1 of five different cards in ${s.seasonName}.`, 'award', firsts.size, Math.min(5, Math.max(1, s.cards.length)))); if ((s.bonusCutoff ?? 0) > 0) goals.push(mk('early-bird', 'Early bird', `Hold a print with a low enough edition number (#${s.bonusCutoff} or lower) to earn the edition points bonus in ${s.seasonName}.`, 'zap', early > 0 ? 1 : 0, 1)); return goals; }

nodes.name: mk
nodes.signature: mk = (kind: string, title: string, detail: string, icon: IconName, have: number, need: number): Achievement
nodes.body_text: mk = (kind: string, title: string, detail: string, icon: IconName, have: number, need: number): Achievement => ({ id: `${s.seasonId}:${kind}`, seasonId: s.seasonId, seasonName: s.seasonName, title, detail, icon, have: Math.min(have, need), need, earned: have >= need })

nodes.name: sortAchievements
nodes.signature: function sortAchievements<T extends { earned: boolean; have: number; need: number; earnedAt?: number }>(list: T[]): T[]
nodes.body_text: function sortAchievements<T extends { earned: boolean; have: number; need: number; earnedAt?: number }>(list: T[]): T[] { return [...list].sort((a, b) => Number(b.earned) - Number(a.earned) || (b.earnedAt ?? 0) - (a.earnedAt ?? 0) || b.have / b.need - a.have / a.need); }

nodes.name: activity-view.ts
nodes.body_text: import type { ActivityEvent } from './activity'; import { VARIANT_LABELS } from './variants'; // Client-safe helpers for the Live Activity page: categories, search text, "notable" moments, burst grouping, rates and export. export const CATEGORIES: { id: Category; label: string }[] = [ { id: 'pulls', label: 'Pulls' }, { id: 'upgrades', label: 'Upgrades' }, { id: 'grants', label: 'Grants & removals' }, { id: 'trades', label: 'Trades' }, { id: 'stream', label: 'Stream' }, { id: 'resets', label: 'Resets' }, ]; /** Looks a card name up by number (and pack, where known); supplied by the page. */ /** One event as a plain sentence (used for search, the detail panel title and CSV export). */ /** A pull as a pull event: a pull itself, or a webhook grant (a reward) dressed as one with defaults for facts older events lack. Null for anything else. */ /** The facts of a pull, from a pull or from a webhook grant (a reward reads as a pull everywhere in the feed). Null for anything else. */ /** Why an event is worth a second look, or null. Used for highlighting, pinning and alerts. */ /** * Collapses quick bursts: pulls by the same viewer within 8 seconds of each other (a multi-pack opening), and admin gift triggers * for the same viewer. Events are newest first, so a group's first event is its latest. Singletons stay as one-event groups. */ /** CSV of events (newest first as given): time, type, viewer, description, collection. */ /** The card an event is about, if any. */

nodes.name: Category
nodes.body_text: type Category = 'pulls' | 'upgrades' | 'grants' | 'trades' | 'stream' | 'resets';

nodes.name: categoryOf
nodes.body_text: function categoryOf(e: ActivityEvent): Category { switch (e.type) { case 'pull': return 'pulls'; case 'upgrade': return 'upgrades'; case 'grant': return e.source === 'webhook' ? 'pulls' : 'grants'; // a webhook reward reads as a pull case 'remove': return 'grants'; case 'trade': return 'trades'; case 'trigger': case 'collection_shown': return 'stream'; default: return 'resets'; } }

nodes.name: CardNamer
nodes.signature: type CardNamer = (number: number, packName?: string) => string | undefined;
nodes.body_text: type CardNamer = (number: number, packName?: string) => string | undefined;

nodes.name: plainText
nodes.signature: function plainText(e: ActivityEvent, cardName: CardNamer): string
nodes.body_text: function plainText(e: ActivityEvent, cardName: CardNamer): string { const text = plainBase(e, cardName); return e.staff ? `${text} (by ${e.staff})` : text; }

nodes.name: plainBase
nodes.signature: function plainBase(e: ActivityEvent, cardName: CardNamer): string
nodes.body_text: function plainBase(e: ActivityEvent, cardName: CardNamer): string { const name = (n: number, pack?: string) => cardName(n, pack) ?? `Card #${n}`; const v = (x?: string) => (x && x !== 'regular' ? ` (${VARIANT_LABELS[x as keyof typeof VARIANT_LABELS] ?? x})` : ''); switch (e.type) { case 'pull': return `${e.username} pulled ${e.cardName || name(e.cardNumber, e.packName)}${v(e.variant)}${e.serial ? ` #${e.serial}` : ''}${e.isNew ? ' (new)' : ` (x${e.copies})`}`; case 'grant': return e.source === 'webhook' ? `${e.username} pulled ${e.cardName || name(e.cardNumber)}${v(e.variant)}${e.serial ? ` #${e.serial}` : ''} (granted by webhook)` : `${name(e.cardNumber)}${v(e.variant)} granted to ${e.username} (${e.source})`; case 'remove': return `${name(e.cardNumber)}${v(e.variant)} removed from ${e.username}`; case 'upgrade': return `${e.username} upgraded ${e.cardName || name(e.cardNumber)} to ${VARIANT_LABELS[e.to]} (${e.cost}x ${VARIANT_LABELS[e.from]})`; case 'trade': { const what = { offered: e.kind === 'listing' ? 'posted a listing' : `offered ${e.partner ?? '?'} a trade`, countered: `countered ${e.partner ?? '?'}'s offer`, accepted: `traded with ${e.partner ?? '?'}`, declined: 'had an offer declined', cancelled: e.by === 'admin' ? 'had an offer cancelled by an admin' : 'cancelled an offer', expired: 'had an offer expire', reversed: `had a trade with ${e.partner ?? '?'} reversed by staff` }[e.action]; return `${e.username} ${what}: ${e.give.join(', ')} for ${e.get.join(', ')}`; } case 'reset': return e.scope === 'everyone' ? 'All collections reset' : `${e.username}'s collection reset${e.scope === 'all' ? ' (all seasons)' : ''}`; case 'delete': return `${e.username} deleted`; case 'trigger': return e.source === 'admin' && e.kind === 'pull' ? `${(e.count ?? 1) > 1 ? `${e.count} packs` : 'A pack'} gifted to ${e.username}` : e.kind === 'card' ? `${e.username} showed off ${e.cardName ?? 'a card'}` : `${e.username} triggered a ${e.kind === 'pull' ? 'pack draw' : 'collection view'} (${e.source ?? 'webhook'})`; default: return `${e.username}'s collection shown on stream`; } }

nodes.name: name
nodes.body_text: name = (n: number, pack?: string) => cardName(n, pack) ?? `Card #${n}`

nodes.name: v
nodes.body_text: v = (x?: string) => (x && x !== 'regular' ? ` (${VARIANT_LABELS[x as keyof typeof VARIANT_LABELS] ?? x})` : '')

nodes.name: PullEvent
nodes.body_text: type PullEvent = Extract<ActivityEvent, { type: 'pull' }>;

nodes.name: asPullEvent
nodes.body_text: function asPullEvent(e: ActivityEvent): PullEvent | null { if (e.type === 'pull') return e; if (e.type !== 'grant' || e.source !== 'webhook') return null; const { source: _source, ...rest } = e; return { ...rest, type: 'pull', cardName: e.cardName ?? `Card #${e.cardNumber}`, stars: e.stars ?? 1, packName: e.packName ?? '', isNew: e.isNew === true, copies: e.copies ?? 1, uniqueOwned: e.uniqueOwned ?? 0 }; }

nodes.name: PullFacts
nodes.body_text: interface PullFacts { username: string; at: number; variant: string; stars: number; isNew: boolean; serial?: number; uniqueOwned?: number; packName?: string }

nodes.name: pullFacts
nodes.body_text: function pullFacts(e: ActivityEvent): PullFacts | null { if (e.type === 'pull') return { username: e.username, at: e.at, variant: e.variant ?? 'regular', stars: e.stars, isNew: e.isNew, serial: e.serial, uniqueOwned: e.uniqueOwned, packName: e.packName }; if (e.type === 'grant' && e.source === 'webhook') return { username: e.username, at: e.at, variant: e.variant ?? 'regular', stars: e.stars ?? 1, isNew: e.isNew === true, serial: e.serial, uniqueOwned: e.uniqueOwned, packName: e.packName }; return null; }

nodes.name: notableReason
nodes.signature: function notableReason(e: ActivityEvent, totalCards: number): string | null
nodes.body_text: function notableReason(e: ActivityEvent, totalCards: number): string | null { const p = pullFacts(e); if (p) { if (p.serial === 1) return 'First ever pull'; if (p.variant === 'shiny') return 'Shiny pull'; if (p.variant === 'full') return 'Full Art pull'; if (p.stars >= 5) return '5-star pull'; if (totalCards > 0 && p.isNew && (p.uniqueOwned ?? 0) >= totalCards) return 'Collection completed'; } if (e.type === 'upgrade' && (e.to === 'shiny' || e.to === 'full')) return `Upgraded to ${VARIANT_LABELS[e.to]}`; if (e.type === 'trade' && e.action === 'cancelled' && e.by === 'admin') return 'Trade cancelled by an admin'; if (e.type === 'reset' && e.scope === 'everyone') return 'Everyone reset'; return null; }

nodes.name: Group
nodes.body_text: interface Group { key: string; events: ActivityEvent[] }

nodes.name: groupEvents
nodes.body_text: function groupEvents(events: ActivityEvent[]): Group[] { const groups: Group[] = []; for (const e of events) { const last = groups[groups.length - 1]; const prev = last?.events[last.events.length - 1]; const burst = (e.type === 'pull' || (e.type === 'trigger' && e.source === 'admin')) && prev && prev.type === e.type && prev.username === e.username && prev.at - e.at <= 8000; if (burst && last) last.events.push(e); else groups.push({ key: String(e.seq), events: [e] }); } return groups; }

nodes.name: Rates
nodes.body_text: interface Rates { perMinute: number; lastHour: number; viewersLastHour: number; rareLastHour: number; newCardsLastHour: number; /** Pulls per minute for the last 30 minutes, oldest first. */ spark: number[]; /** Set when the last 2 minutes are far busier than the 30 minutes before them. */ spike: { recent: number; usual: number } | null; }

nodes.name: rateStats
nodes.signature: function rateStats(events: ActivityEvent[], now: number): Rates
nodes.body_text: function rateStats(events: ActivityEvent[], now: number): Rates { const pulls = events.map(pullFacts).filter((p): p is PullFacts => p !== null); // pulls and webhook grants const hour = pulls.filter(p => now - p.at <= 3_600_000); const spark = Array.from({ length: 30 }, (_, i) => { const from = now - (30 - i) * 60_000; return pulls.filter(p => p.at > from && p.at <= from + 60_000).length; }); const recent = pulls.filter(p => now - p.at <= 120_000).length; const before = pulls.filter(p => now - p.at > 120_000 && now - p.at <= 30 * 60_000 + 120_000).length; const usual = (before / 30) * 2; // expected pulls in a 2 minute window return { perMinute: pulls.filter(p => now - p.at <= 300_000).length / 5, lastHour: hour.length, viewersLastHour: new Set(hour.map(p => p.username)).size, rareLastHour: hour.filter(p => p.variant === 'shiny' || p.variant === 'full' || p.stars >= 5).length, newCardsLastHour: hour.filter(p => p.isNew).length, spark, spike: recent >= 8 && recent >= usual * 3 ? { recent, usual: Math.round(usual) } : null, }; }

nodes.name: csvCell
nodes.body_text: csvCell = (v: string | number) => `"${String(v).replace(/"/g, '""')}"`

nodes.name: toCsv
nodes.signature: function toCsv(events: ActivityEvent[], cardName: CardNamer): string
nodes.body_text: function toCsv(events: ActivityEvent[], cardName: CardNamer): string { const rows = [['time', 'type', 'viewer', 'description', 'collection'].join(',')]; for (const e of events) rows.push([new Date(e.at).toISOString(), e.type, e.username, plainText(e, cardName), e.collectionName ?? ''].map(csvCell).join(',')); return rows.join('\n'); }

nodes.name: cardNumberOf
nodes.body_text: function cardNumberOf(e: ActivityEvent): number | undefined { return 'cardNumber' in e && typeof e.cardNumber === 'number' ? e.cardNumber : undefined; }

nodes.name: activity.ts
nodes.body_text: import { kv, inSandbox } from './db'; import { after } from 'next/server'; import { notifyDiscord } from './discord'; import { recordStats } from './stats'; import { currentStaffLogin } from './staff-actor'; import type { Variant } from './types'; // Append-only activity log powering /admin/activity. Newest first in the KV list `activity:log` // (capped at LOG_CAP); `activity:seq` is a monotonic counter so pollers can ask "anything after N?" // with a single cheap GET. const LOG_KEY = 'activity:log'; const SEQ_KEY = 'activity:seq'; const LOG_CAP = 500; /** * Is this the kind of event a staff member causes (so it should name them)? A viewer's own pull, upgrade or trade is not, even when * the viewer happens to be staff: only the actions taken from the admin and mod panels. */ /** Records an event. Never throws, activity logging must not break the action it describes. */ // Posts to Discord after the response has been sent (so it never slows the request that caused the // event). Outside a request (scripts/tests) `after` isn't available, so just run it. /** * Newest-first events. With `after`, returns only events newer than that seq (at most `limit`); * when nothing is new it costs a single GET. */ /** * Trade events logged before offers could be answered were { partner, gave: number, got: number } (a completed trade, with copy * counts). Everything that reads the log expects the current shape, so old entries are upgraded as they are read. */

Older events lack them. */ cardName?: string; stars?: number; packName?: string; isNew?: boolean; copies?: number; uniqueOwned?: number; serial?: number; bonus?: number } | { type: 'remove'; cardNumber: number; variant?: Variant } | { type: 'upgrade'; cardNumber: number; cardName: string; from: Variant; to: Variant; cost: number; /** The print the upgrade made. */ copyId?: string; uid?: number } // something that happened to a trade offer. `username` is the viewer who made the offer, `partner` the other side (who it was // offered to / who accepted), `by` who did it ('admin' for an admin cancel). give/get are readable lines ("2× Card (Shiny Full Art)") | { type: 'trade'; action: 'offered' | 'countered' | 'accepted' | 'declined' | 'cancelled' | 'expired' | 'reversed'; partner?: string; by?: string; kind: 'direct' | 'listing'; give: string[]; get: string[]; givePts: number; getPts: number; note?: string; cardNumber?: number } | { type: 'reset'; scope: 'season' | 'all' | 'everyone' } | { type: 'delete' } // something asked the overlay to draw / show a collection: an incoming webhook, or an admin quick action | { type: 'trigger'; kind: 'pull' | 'collection' | 'card'; source?: 'webhook' | 'admin'; count?: number; cardName?: string } | { type: 'collection_shown' };

nodes.name: ActivityEvent
nodes.signature: type ActivityEvent = ActivityDetail & { seq: number; at: number; username: string; // lowercase Twitch login; '' for events not about one user collectionName?: string; /** The staff member (Twitch login) who did it, on events that staff cause: gifts, grants, removals, resets, deletes and admin cancels of offers. */ staff?: string; };
nodes.body_text: type ActivityEvent = ActivityDetail & { seq: number; at: number; username: string; // lowercase Twitch login; '' for events not about one user collectionName?: string; /** The staff member (Twitch login) who did it, on events that staff cause: gifts, grants, removals, resets, deletes and admin cancels of offers. */ staff?: string; };

nodes.name: NewActivity
nodes.signature: type NewActivity = ActivityDetail & { username: string; collectionName?: string };
nodes.body_text: type NewActivity = ActivityDetail & { username: string; collectionName?: string };

nodes.name: isStaffAction
nodes.body_text: function isStaffAction(e: NewActivity): boolean { switch (e.type) { case 'remove': case 'reset': case 'delete': return true; case 'grant': return e.source === 'admin'; case 'trigger': return e.source === 'admin'; case 'trade': return e.by === 'admin'; default: return false; } }

nodes.name: recordActivity
nodes.body_text: async function recordActivity(event: NewActivity): Promise<void> { try { const seq = await kv.incr(SEQ_KEY); const staff = isStaffAction(event) ? await currentStaffLogin() : null; const full: ActivityEvent = { ...event, username: event.username.toLowerCase(), seq, at: Date.now(), ...(staff ? { staff } : {}) }; await kv.lpush(LOG_KEY, full); await kv.ltrim(LOG_KEY, 0, LOG_CAP - 1); await recordStats(full as unknown as Parameters<typeof recordStats>[0], full.at); // A sandbox never posts to Discord (the post runs in after(), where the request's sandbox isn't visible, so decide here). if (!(await inSandbox())) forwardToDiscord(full); } catch { // swallow } }

nodes.name: forwardToDiscord
nodes.body_text: function forwardToDiscord(event: ActivityEvent): void { const run = () => notifyDiscord(event); try { after(run); } catch { void run(); } }

nodes.name: run
nodes.body_text: run = () => notifyDiscord(event)

nodes.name: getActivity
nodes.signature: async function getActivity({ after, limit = 100 }: { after?: number; limit?: number } = {}): Promise<{ events: ActivityEvent[]; seq: number }>
nodes.body_text: async function getActivity({ after, limit = 100 }: { after?: number; limit?: number } = {}): Promise<{ events: ActivityEvent[]; seq: number }> { const seq = (await kv.get<number>(SEQ_KEY)) ?? 0; if (after !== undefined && seq <= after) return { events: [], seq }; const count = Math.min(after !== undefined ? seq - after : limit, limit); const events = ((await kv.lrange<ActivityEvent>(LOG_KEY, 0, count - 1)) ?? []).map(normalizeEvent); return { events: after !== undefined ? events.filter(e => e.seq > after) : events, seq }; }

nodes.name: normalizeEvent
nodes.body_text: function normalizeEvent(e: ActivityEvent): ActivityEvent { if (e.type !== 'trade' || Array.isArray(e.give)) return e; const legacy = e as unknown as { gave?: number; got?: number }; const lines = (n?: number) => [`${n ?? '?'} card${n === 1 ? '' : 's'}`]; return { ...e, action: e.action ?? 'accepted', kind: e.kind ?? 'direct', give: lines(legacy.gave), get: lines(legacy.got), givePts: 0, getPts: 0 }; }

nodes.name: admin-guard.ts
nodes.body_text: import { requireStaff, type StaffContext } from './staff-guard'; /** * Throws unless the caller is an admin (or the super admin, or signed in with the emergency password). Server actions are public * POST endpoints: Next.js lets one be invoked by id from outside its page, so anything powerful checks this itself. * Returns who the caller is. Actions mods may also use call `requireStaff('mod')` instead. */

nodes.name: requireAdmin

nodes.name: asset-fix.ts
nodes.body_text: import { put } from '@vercel/blob'; import { getPack, getPackCards, savePack, savePackCards } from './kv'; import { storeOptimizedCard } from './card-upload'; import { toCover, toThumb } from './card-image'; import { cardThumbUrl, isBlobUrl } from './card-art'; import { HEAVY_BYTES, deleteUnusedBlobs, formatOf, type AssetKey } from './assets'; // Server-side repairs and swaps for the Assets page. Everything here works from an AssetKey (which card / pack), // re-reads the current URL from the database and decides what is wrong for itself, so a stale or crafted request // can't point it at an arbitrary file. const IMAGE_EXT = ['webp', 'gif', 'png', 'jpg', 'jpeg', 'svg']; const SOUND_EXT = ['mp3', 'wav', 'ogg', 'm4a', 'webm']; /** A URL a card / pack may point at: our own Blob store or a bundled /assets file, of the right media type. */ /** Points a card / pack at a new file (already uploaded). The old file is left alone: it shows up under Unused. */ /** * Repairs one reference: a GIF becomes an optimized WebP, an oversized card image is re-encoded, and a missing * thumbnail is regenerated. Returns what it did (or why it could not). */ /** A cover must come out at least this much smaller to be worth replacing (re-encoding a WebP again just loses quality). */ const COVER_MIN_SAVING = 0.1; /** * Shrinks a pack cover: re-encodes it as a WebP at the standard width (see COVER_WIDTH) and points the pack at it. Works for covers * in Blob and for bundled /assets files (the optimised copy goes to Blob). Leaves the cover alone when it is already small, so it * is safe to run on everything. The old file is removed only if nothing else points at it. */

nodes.name: FixResult
nodes.body_text: interface FixResult { ok: boolean; message: string; newUrl?: string; /** Bytes before / after, when a file was re-encoded. */ before?: number; after?: number }

nodes.name: Ref

nodes.name: resolveRef
nodes.signature: async function resolveRef(key: AssetKey): Promise<Ref | null>
nodes.body_text: async function resolveRef(key: AssetKey): Promise<Ref | null> { if (key.kind === 'pack-cover') { const pack = await getPack(key.packId); if (!pack) return null; return { url: pack.coverImageUrl, set: url => savePack({ ...pack, coverImageUrl: url }) }; } const cards = await getPackCards(key.packId); const card = cards.find(c => c.id === key.cardId); if (!card) return null; const field = key.kind === 'sound' ? 'soundUrl' : 'imageUrl'; return { url: card[field], set: url => savePackCards(key.packId, cards.map(c => (c.id === card.id ? { ...c, [field]: url } : c))), }; }

nodes.name: absolute
nodes.body_text: absolute = (url: string, origin: string) => (url.startsWith('/') ? origin + url : url)

nodes.name: fail
nodes.body_text: fail = (message: string): FixResult => ({ ok: false, message })

nodes.name: acceptableAssetUrl
nodes.signature: function acceptableAssetUrl(kind: AssetKey['kind'], url: string): boolean
nodes.body_text: function acceptableAssetUrl(kind: AssetKey['kind'], url: string): boolean { if (!isBlobUrl(url) && !url.startsWith('/assets/')) return false; const ext = url.split('?')[0].split('.').pop()?.toLowerCase() ?? ''; return (kind === 'sound' ? SOUND_EXT : IMAGE_EXT).includes(ext); }

nodes.name: replaceAsset
nodes.signature: async function replaceAsset(key: AssetKey, newUrl: string): Promise<FixResult>
nodes.body_text: async function replaceAsset(key: AssetKey, newUrl: string): Promise<FixResult> { if (!acceptableAssetUrl(key.kind, newUrl)) return fail(key.kind === 'sound' ? 'That is not a sound file we can use.' : 'That is not an image file we can use.'); const ref = await resolveRef(key); if (!ref) return fail('That card or pack no longer exists.'); await ref.set(newUrl); return { ok: true, message: 'Replaced.', newUrl }; }

nodes.name: fixAsset
nodes.signature: async function fixAsset(key: AssetKey, origin: string): Promise<FixResult>
nodes.body_text: async function fixAsset(key: AssetKey, origin: string): Promise<FixResult> { if (key.kind === 'sound') return fail('Sounds are not fixed automatically. Replace the file instead.'); const ref = await resolveRef(key); if (!ref?.url) return fail('Nothing to fix: no file is set.'); const url = ref.url; const format = formatOf(url); if (!process.env.BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN && !process.env.VERCEL_BLOB_RW_TOKEN) return fail('Blob storage is not connected here, so fixed files cannot be saved.'); let res: Response; try { res = await fetch(absolute(url, origin)); } catch { return fail('Could not reach the file.'); } if (!res.ok) return fail('The file is missing. Replace it instead.'); const buf = Buffer.from(await res.arrayBuffer()); // Re-encode: any GIF, or a card image far heavier than it should be. if (format === 'GIF' || (key.kind === 'card-art' && buf.length > HEAVY_BYTES)) { try { const result = await storeOptimizedCard(buf); await ref.set(result.url); // The old file (and its thumbnail) is only removed if nothing else points at it; deleteUnusedBlobs re-checks. await deleteUnusedBlobs([url, cardThumbUrl(url)]); const pct = Math.round((1 - result.bytes / buf.length) * 100); return { ok: true, newUrl: result.url, message: `Optimized: ${fmt(buf.length)} → ${fmt(result.bytes)} (${pct}% smaller).` }; } catch { return fail('Could not process the image. Is it a valid file?'); } } // Thumbnail: only for card art that follows the <uuid>.webp naming, where the thumbnail URL can be derived. if (key.kind === 'card-art') { const thumb = cardThumbUrl(url); if (thumb === url) return fail('Nothing to fix.'); if (!isBlobUrl(thumb)) return fail('This is a bundled file. Regenerate its thumbnail with node scripts/optimize-cards.mjs.'); const head = await fetch(thumb, { method: 'HEAD' }).catch(() => null); if (head?.ok) return fail('Nothing to fix: the thumbnail exists.'); try { const small = await toThumb(buf); await put(new URL(thumb).pathname.slice(1), small, { access: 'public', addRandomSuffix: false, contentType: 'image/webp', cacheControlMaxAge: 31536000 }); return { ok: true, newUrl: url, message: 'Thumbnail regenerated.' }; } catch { return fail('Could not create the thumbnail.'); } } return fail('Nothing to fix.'); }

nodes.name: optimizeCover
nodes.signature: async function optimizeCover(key: AssetKey, origin: string): Promise<FixResult>
nodes.body_text: async function optimizeCover(key: AssetKey, origin: string): Promise<FixResult> { if (key.kind !== 'pack-cover') return fail('Only pack covers can be optimised here.'); const ref = await resolveRef(key); if (!ref?.url) return fail('This pack has no cover.'); if (!process.env.BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN && !process.env.VERCEL_BLOB_RW_TOKEN) return fail('Blob storage is not connected here, so optimised files cannot be saved.'); const url = ref.url; if (!isBlobUrl(url) && !url.startsWith('/')) return fail('This cover is hosted elsewhere, so it cannot be optimised.'); let res: Response; try { res = await fetch(absolute(url, origin)); } catch { return fail('Could not reach the file.'); } if (!res.ok) return fail('The file is missing. Replace it instead.'); const buf = Buffer.from(await res.arrayBuffer()); let out: Buffer; try { out = await toCover(buf); } catch { return fail('Could not process the image. Is it a valid file?'); } if (out.length > buf.length * (1 - COVER_MIN_SAVING)) { return { ok: true, message: `Already small (${fmt(buf.length)}); left as it is.`, before: buf.length, after: buf.length }; } const saved = await put(`covers/${crypto.randomUUID()}.webp`, out, { access: 'public', addRandomSuffix: false, contentType: 'image/webp', cacheControlMaxAge: 31536000 }); await ref.set(saved.url); await deleteUnusedBlobs([url]); const pct = Math.round((1 - out.length / buf.length) * 100); return { ok: true, newUrl: saved.url, before: buf.length, after: out.length, message: `Optimised: ${fmt(buf.length)} → ${fmt(out.length)} (${pct}% smaller).` }; }

nodes.name: fmt
nodes.body_text: function fmt(b: number) { return b < 1048576 ? `${Math.round(b / 1024)} KB` : `${(b / 1048576).toFixed(1)} MB`; }

nodes.body_text: import type { AssetKind, LibraryAsset } from './assets'; // Pure number-crunching for the Assets page's Insights tab (client-safe; no server imports). /** Rough size reduction when a GIF is converted to the animated WebP (a 20 MB card GIF becomes 1–4 MB). */ export const GIF_SAVINGS = 0.9; /** Unused files older than `days` days (by upload time). */

nodes.name: PackWeight
nodes.body_text: interface PackWeight { packId: string; packName: string; files: number; bytes: number; flagged: number }

nodes.name: Insights
nodes.body_text: interface Insights { totalBytes: number; byKind: Record<AssetKind, { files: number; bytes: number }>; perPack: PackWeight[]; heaviest: LibraryAsset[]; gifs: { files: number; bytes: number; estimatedSaved: number }; averageCardArt: number | null; shared: number; // files used from more than one place unknownSize: number; // files whose size couldn't be read (external URLs) }

nodes.name: computeInsights
nodes.body_text: function computeInsights(assets: LibraryAsset[], top = 10): Insights { const byKind: Insights['byKind'] = { 'card-art': { files: 0, bytes: 0 }, 'pack-cover': { files: 0, bytes: 0 }, sound: { files: 0, bytes: 0 } }; const packs = new Map<string, PackWeight>(); let totalBytes = 0, unknownSize = 0, shared = 0; const gifs = { files: 0, bytes: 0, estimatedSaved: 0 }; for (const a of assets) { const b = a.bytes ?? 0; totalBytes += b; if (a.bytes === null) unknownSize++; byKind[a.kind].files++; byKind[a.kind].bytes += b; const p = packs.get(a.origin.packId) ?? { packId: a.origin.packId, packName: a.origin.packName, files: 0, bytes: 0, flagged: 0 }; p.files++; p.bytes += b; if (a.issues.length > 0) p.flagged++; packs.set(a.origin.packId, p); if (a.sharedWith.length > 0) shared++; if (a.format === 'GIF' && !a.issues.includes('missing')) { gifs.files++; gifs.bytes += b; } } gifs.estimatedSaved = Math.round(gifs.bytes * GIF_SAVINGS); const art = byKind['card-art']; return { totalBytes, byKind, unknownSize, shared, gifs, perPack: [...packs.values()].sort((x, y) => y.bytes - x.bytes), heaviest: [...assets].filter(a => a.bytes !== null).sort((x, y) => (y.bytes ?? 0) - (x.bytes ?? 0)).slice(0, top), averageCardArt: art.files > 0 ? Math.round(art.bytes / art.files) : null, }; }

nodes.name: olderThan
nodes.signature: function olderThan<T extends { uploadedAt: string }>(items: T[], days: number, now = Date.now()): T[]
nodes.body_text: function olderThan<T extends { uploadedAt: string }>(items: T[], days: number, now = Date.now()): T[] { const cutoff = now - days * 86_400_000; return items.filter(i => new Date(i.uploadedAt).getTime() < cutoff); }

Never carries a URL: the server re-reads the current one. */ /** Why the Blob inventory couldn't be read (so the UI can say the real reason). */ export const HEAVY_BYTES = 8 * 1024 * 1024; const RECENT_MS = 10 * 60 * 1000; // don't call a just-uploaded file "unused" (it may be mid-optimize) /** Every URL referenced by a pack or card, plus the thumbnails that ride along with card art. */ /** Size + existence of a same-origin file (bundled /assets/…) via HEAD. */ /** Of the requested URLs, the ones that exist in the store and that nothing (including a card's companion thumbnail) references. */ /** * Deletes Blob files that nothing references. Re-checks on the server. Never trusts the form, * so a stale page can't delete something that has since been put back into use. * Returns how many files were deleted. */

nodes.body_text: async function collectReferenced() { const packs = await listAllPacks(); const cardLists = await Promise.all(packs.map(p => getPackCards(p.id))); const refs: { url: string; kind: AssetKind; origin: AssetOrigin }[] = []; packs.forEach((pack, i) => { if (pack.coverImageUrl) refs.push({ url: pack.coverImageUrl, kind: 'pack-cover', origin: { kind: 'pack-cover', packId: pack.id, packName: pack.name } }); for (const card of cardLists[i]) { const base = { packId: pack.id, packName: pack.name, cardId: card.id, cardName: card.name, cardNumber: card.number }; if (card.imageUrl) refs.push({ url: card.imageUrl, kind: 'card-art', origin: { kind: 'card-art', ...base } }); if (card.soundUrl) refs.push({ url: card.soundUrl, kind: 'sound', origin: { kind: 'sound', ...base } }); } }); const referenced = new Set<string>(); for (const r of refs) { referenced.add(r.url); if (r.kind === 'card-art') referenced.add(cardThumbUrl(r.url)); // companion thumbnail } for (const list of cardLists) for (const c of list) { if (c.stillUrl) referenced.add(c.stillUrl); // chosen still frames are separate files if (c.fullArtStillUrl) referenced.add(c.fullArtStillUrl); } return { refs, referenced }; }

nodes.name: withTimeout
nodes.signature: function withTimeout<T>(promise: Promise<T>, ms: number, message: string): Promise<T>
nodes.body_text: function withTimeout<T>(promise: Promise<T>, ms: number, message: string): Promise<T> { return new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => { const timer = setTimeout(() => reject(new Error(message)), ms); promise.then( v => { clearTimeout(timer); resolve(v); }, e => { clearTimeout(timer); reject(e); }, ); }); }

nodes.name: listAllBlobs
nodes.signature: async function listAllBlobs(): Promise<{ connected: boolean; problem?: BlobProblem; blobs: { url: string; pathname: string; size: number; uploadedAt: Date }[]; }>
nodes.body_text: async function listAllBlobs(): Promise<{ connected: boolean; problem?: BlobProblem; blobs: { url: string; pathname: string; size: number; uploadedAt: Date }[]; }> { // Say which it is: no token in this environment (e.g. a Vercel preview whose env vars are scoped to // Production only) vs. a token that exists but Vercel rejected or couldn't be reached. if (!process.env.BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN && !process.env.VERCEL_BLOB_RW_TOKEN) { return { connected: false, problem: { kind: 'no-token' }, blobs: [] }; } try { const blobs: { url: string; pathname: string; size: number; uploadedAt: Date }[] = []; let cursor: string | undefined; for (let page = 0; page < 10; page++) { // up to 10,000 files // The SDK retries network failures with backoff and doesn't reliably honour an abort signal while // doing so, so race it against a timer. A broken store must not hang the whole page. const res = await withTimeout(list({ cursor, limit: 1000 }), 8000, 'Timed out reaching Vercel Blob'); blobs.push(...res.blobs); if (!res.hasMore) break; cursor = res.cursor; } return { connected: true, blobs }; } catch (err) { const message = (err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)).replace(/vercel_blob_rw_\w+/gi, '[token]').slice(0, 300); return { connected: false, problem: { kind: 'error', message }, blobs: [] }; } }

nodes.body_text: async function headLocal(origin: string, path: string): Promise<{ bytes: number | null; exists: boolean | null }> { try { const res = await fetch(origin + path, { method: 'HEAD', next: { revalidate: 300 } }); if (res.status === 404) return { bytes: null, exists: false }; if (!res.ok) return { bytes: null, exists: null }; const len = res.headers.get('content-length'); return { bytes: len ? Number(len) : null, exists: true }; } catch { return { bytes: null, exists: null }; } }

nodes.name: loadAssetLibrary
nodes.body_text: async function loadAssetLibrary(origin: string): Promise<AssetLibrary> { const [{ refs, referenced }, inventory] = await Promise.all([collectReferenced(), listAllBlobs()]); const blobBySize = new Map(inventory.blobs.map(b => [b.url, b])); const assets = await Promise.all( refs.map(async ({ url, kind, origin: o }): Promise<LibraryAsset> => { const format = formatOf(url); let bytes: number | null = null; let exists: boolean | null = null; if (isBlobUrl(url)) { const blob = blobBySize.get(url); if (blob) { bytes = blob.size; exists = true; } else if (inventory.connected) exists = false; // we can see the store, and it isn't there } else if (url.startsWith('/')) { ({ bytes, exists } = await headLocal(origin, url)); } // Card art should ship with a static thumbnail next to the animated file. let thumbOk: boolean | null = true; const thumb = kind === 'card-art' ? cardThumbUrl(url) : url; if (kind === 'card-art' && thumb !== url) { if (isBlobUrl(thumb)) thumbOk = inventory.connected ? blobBySize.has(thumb) : null; else if (thumb.startsWith('/')) thumbOk = (await headLocal(origin, thumb)).exists; } const issues: AssetIssue[] = []; if (exists === false) issues.push('missing'); if (format === 'GIF') issues.push('legacy-gif'); if (thumbOk === false && exists !== false) issues.push('no-thumbnail'); if (bytes !== null && bytes > HEAVY_BYTES && format !== 'GIF') issues.push('heavy'); const sharedWith = refs.filter(r => r.url === url && r.origin !== o).map(r => r.origin); return { id: assetId(keyOf(o, kind)), url, kind, origin: o, format, bytes, issues, sharedWith, optimized: kind === 'card-art' && format === 'WebP' && thumb !== url && thumbOk !== false, }; }), ); const now = Date.now(); const unused: UnusedBlob[] = inventory.blobs .filter(b => !referenced.has(b.url) && now - new Date(b.uploadedAt).getTime() > RECENT_MS) .map(b => ({ url: b.url, pathname: b.pathname, bytes: b.size, uploadedAt: new Date(b.uploadedAt).toISOString(), format: formatOf(b.pathname) })) .sort((a, b) => b.bytes - a.bytes); return { assets, unused, blobConnected: inventory.connected, blobProblem: inventory.problem }; }

nodes.name: pickDeletable
nodes.signature: function pickDeletable(requested: string[], inStore: Set<string>, referenced: Set<string>): string[]
nodes.body_text: function pickDeletable(requested: string[], inStore: Set<string>, referenced: Set<string>): string[] { return [...new Set(requested)].filter(u => isBlobUrl(u) && inStore.has(u) && !referenced.has(u)); }

nodes.name: deleteUnusedBlobs
nodes.body_text: async function deleteUnusedBlobs(urls: string[]): Promise<number> { const requested = [...new Set(urls)].filter(isBlobUrl); if (requested.length === 0) return 0; // The Blob store is shared with production and a sandbox's data can lag behind it, so a sandbox must never delete files. if (await inSandbox()) return 0; const [{ referenced }, inventory] = await Promise.all([collectReferenced(), listAllBlobs()]); if (!inventory.connected) return 0; const safe = pickDeletable(requested, new Set(inventory.blobs.map(b => b.url)), referenced); if (safe.length === 0) return 0; await del(safe); return safe.length; }

nodes.name: audio-encode.ts
nodes.body_text: // Browser-side sound optimiser: decodes any audio the browser can play and re-encodes it as a smaller MP3. Client only (Web Audio). // Done in the browser because the serverless functions have no audio encoder, and sounds are short: it takes a moment. // The encoder library is loaded on demand so it never weighs down the rest of the admin. export const DEFAULT_MP3: Mp3Options = { kbps: 96, mono: true }; export const BITRATES = [64, 96, 128, 160] as const; /** The sample rate every sound is brought to (MP3 supports it and every browser decodes straight to it). */ const RATE = 44100; const CHUNK = 1152; /** A new file must be at least this much smaller (as a share of the original) to be worth swapping in. */ export const WORTH_IT = 0.15; /** Decodes `data` and encodes it as MP3. Throws a readable Error if the browser can't decode the file. */

nodes.name: Mp3Options
nodes.body_text: interface Mp3Options { /** Constant bitrate in kbit/s. */ kbps: number; /** Mix down to one channel (half the size; fine for effects). */ mono: boolean; }

nodes.name: Mp3Result
nodes.body_text: interface Mp3Result { blob: Blob; bytes: number; seconds: number; channels: 1 | 2 }

nodes.name: toInt16
nodes.body_text: toInt16 = (f: Float32Array): Int16Array => { const out = new Int16Array(f.length); for (let i = 0; i < f.length; i++) { const s = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, f[i])); out[i] = s < 0 ? s * 0x8000 : s * 0x7fff; } return out; }

nodes.name: encodeMp3
nodes.signature: async function encodeMp3(data: ArrayBuffer, opts: Mp3Options = DEFAULT_MP3): Promise<Mp3Result>
nodes.body_text: async function encodeMp3(data: ArrayBuffer, opts: Mp3Options = DEFAULT_MP3): Promise<Mp3Result> { const { Mp3Encoder } = await import('@breezystack/lamejs'); const Ctx: typeof AudioContext = window.AudioContext ?? (window as unknown as { webkitAudioContext: typeof AudioContext }).webkitAudioContext; const ctx = new Ctx({ sampleRate: RATE }); let audio: AudioBuffer; try { audio = await ctx.decodeAudioData(data.slice(0)); // slice: decoding detaches the buffer, and the caller may want its size } catch { throw new Error('This browser could not read that audio file.'); } finally { ctx.close().catch(() => { /* already closed */ }); } const channels: 1 | 2 = opts.mono || audio.numberOfChannels < 2 ? 1 : 2; const left = audio.getChannelData(0); const right = audio.numberOfChannels > 1 ? audio.getChannelData(1) : left; const mixed = channels === 1 && audio.numberOfChannels > 1 ? left.map((v, i) => (v + right[i]) / 2) : left; const enc = new Mp3Encoder(channels, audio.sampleRate, opts.kbps); const l = toInt16(mixed); const r = channels === 2 ? toInt16(right) : null; const parts: Uint8Array[] = []; for (let i = 0; i < l.length; i += CHUNK) { const chunk = channels === 2 && r ? enc.encodeBuffer(l.subarray(i, i + CHUNK), r.subarray(i, i + CHUNK)) : enc.encodeBuffer(l.subarray(i, i + CHUNK)); if (chunk.length) parts.push(chunk); } const tail = enc.flush(); if (tail.length) parts.push(tail); const blob = new Blob(parts as BlobPart[], { type: 'audio/mpeg' }); return { blob, bytes: blob.size, seconds: audio.duration, channels }; }

nodes.name: audit.ts
nodes.body_text: import { kv } from './db'; import { currentStaffLogin } from './staff-actor'; import { notifyAdminLog } from './discord'; // A small audit trail of what an admin did to a viewer's account (grants, removals, resets, edits, restores, merges, flags). It is // best-effort (never throws), capped, and shown on the user's page. `audit:user:<name>` holds that viewer's newest entries and // `audit:all` the newest across everyone. const USER_CAP = 100; const ALL_CAP = 500;

nodes.name: AuditEntry
nodes.body_text: interface AuditEntry { at: number; username: string; action: string; detail?: string; /** Who did it: the staff member's Twitch login (or "password" for the emergency login). Absent on older entries. */ by?: string; }

nodes.name: recordAudit
nodes.signature: async function recordAudit(username: string, action: string, detail?: string): Promise<void>
nodes.body_text: async function recordAudit(username: string, action: string, detail?: string): Promise<void> { try { const by = await currentStaffLogin(); const entry: AuditEntry = { at: Date.now(), username: username.toLowerCase(), action, ...(detail ? { detail: detail.slice(0, 300) } : {}), ...(by ? { by } : {}) }; await kv.lpush(`audit:user:${entry.username}`, entry); await kv.ltrim(`audit:user:${entry.username}`, 0, USER_CAP - 1); await kv.lpush('audit:all', entry); await kv.ltrim('audit:all', 0, ALL_CAP - 1); void notifyAdminLog({ action, subject: entry.username, detail: entry.detail, by }); } catch { /* best effort */ } }
