nodes.name: avatars.ts
nodes.body_text: import { kv } from './db'; import { fetchTwitchAvatars, twitchCredentials } from './twitch-helix'; // Twitch profile pictures, cached in one KV hash so pages don't hit Twitch on every render. // Entries: login → { url, at }. url '' means "looked up, no avatar" (cached shorter so new accounts appear). const KEY = 'twitch:avatars'; const TTL_FOUND = 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000; const TTL_MISSING = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000; const VALID_LOGIN = /^[a-z0-9_]{1,25}$/; // anything else (e.g. "mrbeast#") can't be a Twitch login /** * Twitch serves avatars at fixed sizes (28, 50, 70, 150, 300, 600) selected by filename suffix. * Pass roughly 2x the displayed size for crisp retina rendering. */ /** * Returns login → avatar URL for the given usernames. Missing/stale entries are fetched from * Twitch in one batch and cached. Never throws: if Twitch or KV is unavailable, users simply * come back without an avatar and the UI falls back to initials. */

nodes.name: Entry
nodes.signature: type Entry = { url: string; at: number };
nodes.body_text: type Entry = { url: string; at: number };

nodes.name: sizeTwitchAvatar
nodes.body_text: function sizeTwitchAvatar(url: string, px: 28 | 50 | 70 | 150 | 300): string { return url.replace(/-\d+x\d+(\.\w+)$/, `-${px}x${px}$1`); }

nodes.name: getAvatars
nodes.signature: async function getAvatars(usernames: string[]): Promise<Record<string, string>>
nodes.body_text: async function getAvatars(usernames: string[]): Promise<Record<string, string>> { const names = [...new Set(usernames.map(u => u.toLowerCase()).filter(u => VALID_LOGIN.test(u)))]; if (names.length === 0) return {}; try { const cache = (await kv.hgetall<Record<string, Entry>>(KEY)) ?? {}; const now = Date.now(); const stale = names.filter(n => { const e = cache[n]; return !e || now - e.at > (e.url ? TTL_FOUND : TTL_MISSING); }); if (stale.length > 0 && twitchCredentials()) { try { const found = await fetchTwitchAvatars(stale); const updates: Record<string, Entry> = {}; for (const n of stale) updates[n] = { url: found[n] ?? '', at: now }; await kv.hset(KEY, updates); Object.assign(cache, updates); } catch { // Keep serving whatever is cached (even stale) rather than failing the page. } } return Object.fromEntries(names.filter(n => cache[n]?.url).map(n => [n, cache[n].url])); } catch { return {}; } }

nodes.name: backup-core.ts
nodes.body_text: // Pure parts of the nightly backup (no KV, no Blob): which keys are worth keeping, the file name and retention rules, and the // encrypted file format. The server side is lib/backup.ts. // // A backup is a gzipped JSON snapshot of the production keyspace, ENCRYPTED before it leaves the server. Vercel Blob (the // version this project uses) only stores public files, and a backup holds Twitch IDs, usernames and the webhook secrets, so a // plaintext file at a guessable address would be a leak. The key is BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_KEY; without it no backup is written. import { createCipheriv, createDecipheriv, randomBytes, scryptSync } from 'node:crypto'; import { gunzipSync, gzipSync } from 'node:zlib'; /** * Keys that are NOT backed up: sandboxes (test data), counters and caches that rebuild themselves, locks, cooldowns, queues, * per-viewer restore points (they are backups already, 14-day TTL) and the sandbox bookkeeping. This is a deny-list on purpose: * a key nobody thought about is backed up by default. */ export const DENY_PREFIXES = [ 'sbx:', // sandboxes and the preview namespace 'sandbox:', // sandbox registry / activity / undo points 'stats:', // time-series counters (rebuild from now on, not from history) 'twitch:', // Helix caches: live status, avatars 'activity:', // the live activity log and its sequence counter 'lock:', // short-lived locks 'potw:week:', // the print of the week's once-a-week lock 'captcha:', // short-lived pass tokens 'showoff:cd:', // cooldowns 'trade:cd:', 'webhooks:queue', // pending overlay events 'overlay:clients', 'overlay:reload', 'watch:idx:', // rebuilt on first use from the viewers who have played ] as const; /** Per-viewer restore points: `user:<name>:snap:<id>` and the `user:<name>:snaps` index. */ const SNAPSHOT_KEY = /^user:[^:]+:snaps?(:|$)/; // ---- file names and retention ---- export const BACKUP_PREFIX = 'backups/'; export const BACKUP_KEEP = 14; export const BACKUP_STALE_HOURS = 36; const NAME_RE = /^backups\/(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})\.json\.gz\.enc$/; /** Which stored file names to delete so only the newest `keep` backups remain. Anything not named like a backup is never returned. */ /** True when the newest backup is missing or older than the allowed gap. */ // ---- format ---- const MAGIC = Buffer.from('TCGBK1'); const SALT = 16, IV = 12, TAG = 16; /** AES-256-GCM, key derived from the secret with a fresh salt: MAGIC | salt | iv | ciphertext | tag. */ /** A readable one-line summary of what a backup holds. */

nodes.name: BackupType
nodes.body_text: type BackupType = 'string' | 'hash' | 'list' | 'set';

nodes.name: BackupEntry
nodes.body_text: interface BackupEntry { key: string; type: BackupType; value: unknown }

nodes.name: BackupFile
nodes.body_text: interface BackupFile { version: 1; createdAt: number; entries: BackupEntry[]; skipped: { key: string; type: string }[] }

nodes.name: isBackedUp
nodes.body_text: function isBackedUp(key: string): boolean { if (DENY_PREFIXES.some(p => key.startsWith(p))) return false; return !SNAPSHOT_KEY.test(key); }

nodes.name: dayStamp
nodes.body_text: dayStamp = (at: number) => new Date(at).toISOString().slice(0, 10)

nodes.name: backupName
nodes.body_text: backupName = (at: number) => `${BACKUP_PREFIX}${dayStamp(at)}.json.gz.enc`

nodes.name: pickBackupsToDelete
nodes.signature: function pickBackupsToDelete(pathnames: string[], keep = BACKUP_KEEP): string[]
nodes.body_text: function pickBackupsToDelete(pathnames: string[], keep = BACKUP_KEEP): string[] { const dated = pathnames.map(p => ({ p, m: NAME_RE.exec(p) })).filter((x): x is { p: string; m: RegExpExecArray } => !!x.m); dated.sort((a, b) => (a.m[1] < b.m[1] ? 1 : a.m[1] > b.m[1] ? -1 : 0)); // newest first return dated.slice(keep).map(x => x.p); }

nodes.name: backupIsStale
nodes.signature: function backupIsStale(lastAt: number | null, now: number, hours = BACKUP_STALE_HOURS): boolean
nodes.body_text: function backupIsStale(lastAt: number | null, now: number, hours = BACKUP_STALE_HOURS): boolean { return lastAt === null || now - lastAt > hours * 3_600_000; }

nodes.name: serializeBackup
nodes.body_text: function serializeBackup(file: BackupFile): Buffer { return gzipSync(Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(file), 'utf8')); }

nodes.name: parseBackup
nodes.body_text: function parseBackup(gz: Buffer): BackupFile { const f = JSON.parse(gunzipSync(gz).toString('utf8')) as BackupFile; if (f?.version !== 1 || !Array.isArray(f.entries)) throw new Error('Not a backup file this version understands.'); return f; }

nodes.name: deriveKey
nodes.body_text: deriveKey = (secret: string, salt: Buffer) => scryptSync(secret, salt, 32)

nodes.name: encryptBackup
nodes.signature: function encryptBackup(plain: Buffer, secret: string): Buffer
nodes.body_text: function encryptBackup(plain: Buffer, secret: string): Buffer { if (!secret || secret.length < 16) throw new Error('BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_KEY must be at least 16 characters.'); const salt = randomBytes(SALT), iv = randomBytes(IV); const cipher = createCipheriv('aes-256-gcm', deriveKey(secret, salt), iv); const body = Buffer.concat([cipher.update(plain), cipher.final()]); return Buffer.concat([MAGIC, salt, iv, body, cipher.getAuthTag()]); }

nodes.name: decryptBackup
nodes.signature: function decryptBackup(blob: Buffer, secret: string): Buffer
nodes.body_text: function decryptBackup(blob: Buffer, secret: string): Buffer { if (blob.length < MAGIC.length + SALT + IV + TAG || !blob.subarray(0, MAGIC.length).equals(MAGIC)) throw new Error('Not an encrypted backup file.'); let o = MAGIC.length; const salt = blob.subarray(o, (o += SALT)), iv = blob.subarray(o, (o += IV)); const tag = blob.subarray(blob.length - TAG), body = blob.subarray(o, blob.length - TAG); const decipher = createDecipheriv('aes-256-gcm', deriveKey(secret, salt), iv); decipher.setAuthTag(tag); try { return Buffer.concat([decipher.update(body), decipher.final()]); } catch { throw new Error('Could not decrypt: wrong BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_KEY, or the file is damaged.'); } }

nodes.name: describeBackup
nodes.body_text: function describeBackup(f: BackupFile): string { const by: Record<string, number> = {}; for (const e of f.entries) by[e.type] = (by[e.type] ?? 0) + 1; const parts = Object.entries(by).map(([t, n]) => `${n} ${t}`).join(', '); return `${f.entries.length} keys (${parts || 'none'})${f.skipped.length ? `, ${f.skipped.length} skipped` : ''}`; }

nodes.name: backup.ts
nodes.body_text: // Nightly backup of the production keyspace (server side). Pure rules live in lib/backup-core.ts. // // Uses the raw `prodKv` on purpose: a backup is of PRODUCTION (never a sandbox's namespace), and refuses to run anywhere else. // `collectEntries` / `restoreEntries` take a minimal client so they can run against the mock KV in scripts/check-backup.mts. import { list, put, del } from '@vercel/blob'; import { inSandbox, prodKv } from './db'; import { BACKUP_KEEP, BACKUP_PREFIX, backupIsStale, backupName, encryptBackup, isBackedUp, pickBackupsToDelete, serializeBackup, type BackupEntry, type BackupFile, type BackupType, } from './backup-core'; /** The few KV commands a backup needs. `prodKv` and the mock both satisfy it. */ /** The few KV commands a restore needs. */ const SUPPORTED = new Set<string>(['string', 'hash', 'list', 'set']); const CONCURRENCY = 25; /** Every key that is worth keeping, with its type and value. Unsupported types are listed in `skipped`, never dropped silently. */ /** * Writes entries into a target. `mapKey` renames each key (a sandbox restore prefixes `sbx:<id>:`); each key is deleted first so a * restore replaces rather than merges. Returns how many keys were written. */ // ---- Blob ---- /** The stored backups, newest first. Throws when Blob is not connected. */ /** For the Settings page: when the newest backup was made, how big it is, and whether that is too long ago. Never throws. */ /** * Takes a backup now: snapshot the production keyspace, encrypt it, store it as `backups/<date>.json.gz.enc` and delete anything * older than the newest 14. Refuses outside production and inside a sandbox, and refuses without an encryption key (a backup is * never stored in the clear: Blob files are public). */

nodes.name: BackupClient
nodes.body_text: interface BackupClient { scan(cursor: string | number, opts: { match?: string; count?: number }): Promise<[string | number, string[]]>; type(key: string): Promise<string>; get(key: string): Promise<unknown>; hgetall(key: string): Promise<Record<string, unknown> | null>; lrange(key: string, start: number, end: number): Promise<unknown[]>; smembers(key: string): Promise<unknown[]>; }

nodes.name: RestoreClient
nodes.body_text: interface RestoreClient { set(key: string, value: unknown): Promise<unknown>; hset(key: string, fields: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<unknown>; rpush(key: string, ...items: unknown[]): Promise<unknown>; sadd(key: string, ...members: unknown[]): Promise<unknown>; del(...keys: string[]): Promise<unknown>; }

nodes.name: collectEntries
nodes.signature: async function collectEntries(client: BackupClient, now = Date.now()): Promise<BackupFile>
nodes.body_text: async function collectEntries(client: BackupClient, now = Date.now()): Promise<BackupFile> { const found = new Set<string>(); // SCAN may repeat a key let cursor: string | number = 0; do { const [next, batch] = await client.scan(cursor, { match: '*', count: 500 }); for (const k of batch) if (isBackedUp(k)) found.add(k); cursor = next; } while (String(cursor) !== '0'); const keys = [...found].sort(); const entries: BackupEntry[] = []; const skipped: { key: string; type: string }[] = []; for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i += CONCURRENCY) { const part = await Promise.all(keys.slice(i, i + CONCURRENCY).map(async key => { const type = await client.type(key); if (type === 'none') return null; // expired between SCAN and now if (!SUPPORTED.has(type)) return { skip: { key, type } }; const value = type === 'hash' ? await client.hgetall(key) : type === 'list' ? await client.lrange(key, 0, -1) : type === 'set' ? await client.smembers(key) : await client.get(key); return { entry: { key, type: type as BackupType, value } as BackupEntry }; })); for (const p of part) { if (p?.entry) entries.push(p.entry); else if (p?.skip) skipped.push(p.skip); } } return { version: 1, createdAt: now, entries, skipped }; }

nodes.name: restoreEntries
nodes.signature: async function restoreEntries(client: RestoreClient, entries: BackupEntry[], mapKey: (key: string) => string = k => k): Promise<number>
nodes.body_text: async function restoreEntries(client: RestoreClient, entries: BackupEntry[], mapKey: (key: string) => string = k => k): Promise<number> { let n = 0; for (const e of entries) { const key = mapKey(e.key); await client.del(key); if (e.type === 'string') await client.set(key, e.value); else if (e.type === 'hash') { const h = (e.value ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>; if (Object.keys(h).length) await client.hset(key, h); } else if (e.type === 'list') { const l = (e.value ?? []) as unknown[]; if (l.length) await client.rpush(key, ...l); } else if (e.type === 'set') { const s = (e.value ?? []) as unknown[]; if (s.length) await client.sadd(key, ...s); } else continue; n++; } return n; }

nodes.name: StoredBackup
nodes.body_text: interface StoredBackup { pathname: string; url: string; size: number; uploadedAt: number }

nodes.name: listBackups
nodes.body_text: async function listBackups(): Promise<StoredBackup[]> { const out: StoredBackup[] = []; let cursor: string | undefined; do { const page = await list({ prefix: BACKUP_PREFIX, cursor }); for (const b of page.blobs) out.push({ pathname: b.pathname, url: b.url, size: b.size, uploadedAt: new Date(b.uploadedAt).getTime() }); cursor = page.hasMore ? page.cursor : undefined; } while (cursor); return out.sort((a, b) => b.uploadedAt - a.uploadedAt); }

nodes.name: BackupStatus
nodes.body_text: interface BackupStatus { ok: boolean; lastAt: number | null; size: number | null; url: string | null; count: number; stale: boolean; problem?: string }

nodes.name: backupStatus
nodes.body_text: async function backupStatus(now = Date.now()): Promise<BackupStatus> { const none = { lastAt: null, size: null, url: null, count: 0, stale: true }; if (!process.env.BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN) return { ok: false, ...none, problem: 'Blob storage is not connected, so backups cannot be stored.' }; try { const all = await listBackups(); const last = all[0] ?? null; const stale = backupIsStale(last?.uploadedAt ?? null, now); return { ok: !stale, lastAt: last?.uploadedAt ?? null, size: last?.size ?? null, url: last?.url ?? null, count: all.length, stale, ...(last ? {} : { problem: 'No backup has been made yet.' }) }; } catch (e) { return { ok: false, ...none, problem: e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Could not list backups.' }; } }

nodes.name: BackupRun
nodes.body_text: interface BackupRun { name: string; keys: number; skipped: number; bytes: number; deleted: number }

nodes.name: runBackup
nodes.body_text: async function runBackup(now = Date.now()): Promise<BackupRun> { if (process.env.VERCEL_ENV !== 'production') throw new Error('Backups only run on the production deployment.'); if (await inSandbox()) throw new Error('Backups never run inside a sandbox.'); const secret = process.env.BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_KEY ?? ''; if (secret.length < 16) throw new Error('BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_KEY is not set (at least 16 characters), so no backup was written.'); if (!process.env.BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN) throw new Error('Blob storage is not connected (BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN).'); const file = await collectEntries(prodKv as unknown as BackupClient, now); const body = encryptBackup(serializeBackup(file), secret); const name = backupName(now); // One file per day: a second run the same day replaces the first. const existing = (await listBackups()).filter(b => b.pathname === name); if (existing.length) await del(existing.map(b => b.url)); await put(name, body, { access: 'public', addRandomSuffix: false, contentType: 'application/octet-stream' }); const all = await listBackups(); const old = new Set(pickBackupsToDelete(all.map(b => b.pathname), BACKUP_KEEP)); const doomed = all.filter(b => old.has(b.pathname)).map(b => b.url); if (doomed.length) await del(doomed); return { name, keys: file.entries.length, skipped: file.skipped.length, bytes: body.length, deleted: doomed.length }; }

nodes.name: binder-config.ts
nodes.body_text: // A collector's binder settings (pure, client-safe): how it looks and, optionally, exactly which card sits in which pocket. // Stored in `UserSettings.binder` (null = the default look and the automatic layout). Everything is validated on the way in, // so a crafted request can never store an unknown option or an out-of-range value. import { VARIANTS } from './variants'; import type { Variant } from './types'; export const BINDER_LIMITS = { title: 40, subtitle: 60, pageTitle: 40, pages: 40, cols: [2, 4], rows: [1, 4] } as const; export const MAX_POCKETS = BINDER_LIMITS.cols[1] * BINDER_LIMITS.rows[1]; export const COVER_COLOURS: CoverColour[] = [ { id: 'saddle', label: 'Saddle', a: '#7a3b24', b: '#4a2417', c: '#2f170f', ink: '#f8dc8a', shareTheme: 'classic' }, { id: 'navy', label: 'Navy', a: '#27458f', b: '#16295c', c: '#0b1636', ink: '#cfe0ff', shareTheme: 'classic' }, { id: 'crimson', label: 'Crimson', a: '#a3202f', b: '#6b1220', c: '#3d0912', ink: '#ffd9a8', shareTheme: 'classic' }, { id: 'forest', label: 'Forest', a: '#2f7a4d', b: '#1b4d31', c: '#0e2c1c', ink: '#d7f5c8', shareTheme: 'classic' }, { id: 'violet', label: 'Violet', a: '#6d3fc0', b: '#432680', c: '#241347', ink: '#ead9ff', shareTheme: 'midnight' }, { id: 'charcoal', label: 'Charcoal', a: '#3f4452', b: '#272a34', c: '#13151b', ink: '#e5e7eb', shareTheme: 'ink' }, { id: 'cheddar', label: 'Cheddar', a: '#d6a017', b: '#a8760a', c: '#6b4806', ink: '#fff3c4', shareTheme: 'cheese' }, { id: 'rose', label: 'Rose', a: '#c2477a', b: '#8a2a56', c: '#521533', ink: '#ffdceb', shareTheme: 'holo' }, ]; export const MATERIALS = [ { id: 'leather', label: 'Leather' }, { id: 'cloth', label: 'Cloth' }, { id: 'metal', label: 'Brushed metal' }, { id: 'holo', label: 'Holo foil' }, ] as const; /** Icons for the cover (names from app/components/Icon.tsx), or none. */ export const EMBLEMS = ['cheese', 'crown', 'gem', 'trophy', 'sparkles', 'zap', 'gift', 'target', 'cards', 'party', 'none'] as const; export const PAGE_COLOURS: PageColour[] = [ { id: 'midnight', label: 'Midnight', a: '#121a3a', b: '#0c1230', ink: '#8b93b5', muted: 'rgba(255,255,255,.28)' }, { id: 'charcoal', label: 'Charcoal', a: '#22252d', b: '#15171c', ink: '#9ca3af', muted: 'rgba(255,255,255,.28)' }, { id: 'forest', label: 'Forest', a: '#14301f', b: '#0b1d12', ink: '#8fb59a', muted: 'rgba(255,255,255,.28)' }, { id: 'wine', label: 'Wine', a: '#3a1220', b: '#240a14', ink: '#c99aab', muted: 'rgba(255,255,255,.28)' }, { id: 'parchment', label: 'Parchment', a: '#efe3c3', b: '#e0d0a6', ink: '#7a6638', muted: 'rgba(60,40,10,.4)' }, { id: 'snow', label: 'Snow', a: '#f4f6fb', b: '#e3e8f3', ink: '#5b6482', muted: 'rgba(30,40,70,.4)' }, ]; export const POCKET_STYLES = [ { id: 'plain', label: 'Plain' }, { id: 'sleeve', label: 'Glossy sleeve' }, { id: 'frame', label: 'Thick frame' }, { id: 'flat', label: 'Borderless' }, ] as const; /** What a pocket shows for a card the collector doesn't have yet. */ export const MISSING_STYLES = [ { id: 'name', label: 'Number and name' }, { id: 'number', label: 'Number only' }, { id: 'ghost', label: 'Faded card' }, { id: 'blank', label: 'Empty' }, ] as const; export const SORTS = [ { id: 'number', label: 'Card number' }, { id: 'rarity', label: 'Rarest first' }, { id: 'name', label: 'Name' }, { id: 'collected', label: 'Collected first' }, ] as const; /** One pocket's card, and optionally the version to show (null = the best one they own). */ export const DEFAULT_BINDER: BinderConfig = { title: '', subtitle: '', cover: 'saddle', material: 'leather', emblem: 'cheese', pageColour: 'midnight', pocketStyle: 'plain', missing: 'name', cols: 3, rows: 3, badges: true, holo: true, mode: 'auto', sort: 'number', groupByPack: true, hideUncollected: false, pagesSeason: null, pages: [], }; /** True for a pale colour ('#rrggbb'), by perceived brightness. */ /** Anything → a valid, complete config, or null when it is just the defaults (so nothing needs storing). */ // ── page editing (all pure, so the editor and the checks share one set of rules) ── /** * Makes every page fit `cap` pockets. Cards that no longer fit (the grid got smaller) move to a new page right after, so * shrinking the grid never throws a card out of the binder. */ /** The next empty pocket after (page, slot), or null when the binder is full from there on. */ /** Moves a card from one pocket to another (swapping if the target is taken). */

nodes.body_text: interface CoverColour { id: string; label: string; /** Highlight, base and deep tones of the cover, and the colour of its lettering. */ a: string; b: string; c: string; ink: string; /** A matching look for share images. */ shareTheme: string }

nodes.name: Emblem
nodes.body_text: type Emblem = (typeof EMBLEMS)[number];

nodes.name: PageColour
nodes.body_text: interface PageColour { id: string; label: string; a: string; b: string; ink: string; muted: string }

nodes.name: PocketStyle
nodes.body_text: type PocketStyle = (typeof POCKET_STYLES)[number]['id'];

nodes.name: MissingStyle
nodes.body_text: type MissingStyle = (typeof MISSING_STYLES)[number]['id'];
