nodes.name: BinderConfig
nodes.body_text: interface BinderConfig { /** Cover lettering; empty = "<name>'s binder". */ title: string; /** Under the title; empty = "N of M cards collected". */ subtitle: string; cover: string; material: Material; emblem: Emblem; pageColour: string; pocketStyle: PocketStyle; missing: MissingStyle; cols: number; rows: number; /** ×N and version badges on the pockets. */ badges: boolean; /** The holographic shimmer on pockets. */ holo: boolean; /** auto: pages built from the collection; custom: the pages below, placed by hand. */ mode: 'auto' | 'custom'; sort: BinderSort; groupByPack: boolean; /** Auto mode: leave out cards they don't have. */ hideUncollected: boolean; /** The season the custom pages were made for (card numbers mean different cards in another season). */ pagesSeason: string | null; pages: BinderPageCfg[]; }

nodes.name: coverColour
nodes.body_text: coverColour = (id: string) => COVER_COLOURS.find(c => c.id === id) ?? COVER_COLOURS[0]

nodes.name: pageColour
nodes.body_text: pageColour = (id: string) => PAGE_COLOURS.find(c => c.id === id) ?? PAGE_COLOURS[0]

nodes.name: isLightColour
nodes.body_text: function isLightColour(hex: string): boolean { const m = /^#?([0-9a-f]{6})$/i.exec(hex.trim()); if (!m) return false; const n = parseInt(m[1], 16); const r = (n >> 16) & 255, g = (n >> 8) & 255, b = n & 255; return (0.299 * r + 0.587 * g + 0.114 * b) / 255 > 0.6; }

nodes.name: capacity
nodes.body_text: capacity = (c: Pick<BinderConfig, 'cols' | 'rows'>) => c.cols * c.rows

nodes.name: clean
nodes.body_text: clean = (v: unknown, max: number) => (typeof v === 'string' ? v.replace(/[\u0000-\u001f\u007f]+/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, max) : '')

nodes.name: pick
nodes.signature: pick = <T extends string>(v: unknown, ok: readonly T[], fallback: T): T
nodes.body_text: pick = <T extends string>(v: unknown, ok: readonly T[], fallback: T): T => (typeof v === 'string' && (ok as readonly string[]).includes(v) ? (v as T) : fallback)

nodes.name: int
nodes.signature: int = (v: unknown, [lo, hi]: readonly [number, number] | readonly number[], fallback: number)
nodes.body_text: int = (v: unknown, [lo, hi]: readonly [number, number] | readonly number[], fallback: number) => (typeof v === 'number' && Number.isInteger(v) ? Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, v)) : fallback)

nodes.name: sanitizeSlot
nodes.body_text: function sanitizeSlot(s: unknown): BinderSlot | null { if (!s || typeof s !== 'object') return null; const card = Number((s as { card?: unknown }).card); if (!Number.isInteger(card) || card < 1 || card >= 1_000_000) return null; const v = (s as { variant?: unknown }).variant; return { card, variant: typeof v === 'string' && (VARIANTS as readonly string[]).includes(v) ? (v as Variant) : null }; }

nodes.name: sanitizeBinder
nodes.body_text: function sanitizeBinder(input: unknown): BinderConfig | null { if (!input || typeof input !== 'object') return null; const o = input as Record<string, unknown>; const cfg: BinderConfig = { title: clean(o.title, BINDER_LIMITS.title), subtitle: clean(o.subtitle, BINDER_LIMITS.subtitle), cover: pick(o.cover, COVER_COLOURS.map(c => c.id), DEFAULT_BINDER.cover), material: pick(o.material, MATERIALS.map(m => m.id), DEFAULT_BINDER.material), emblem: pick(o.emblem, EMBLEMS, DEFAULT_BINDER.emblem), pageColour: pick(o.pageColour, PAGE_COLOURS.map(c => c.id), DEFAULT_BINDER.pageColour), pocketStyle: pick(o.pocketStyle, POCKET_STYLES.map(p => p.id), DEFAULT_BINDER.pocketStyle), missing: pick(o.missing, MISSING_STYLES.map(m => m.id), DEFAULT_BINDER.missing), cols: int(o.cols, BINDER_LIMITS.cols, DEFAULT_BINDER.cols), rows: int(o.rows, BINDER_LIMITS.rows, DEFAULT_BINDER.rows), badges: typeof o.badges === 'boolean' ? o.badges : DEFAULT_BINDER.badges, holo: typeof o.holo === 'boolean' ? o.holo : DEFAULT_BINDER.holo, mode: o.mode === 'custom' ? 'custom' : 'auto', sort: pick(o.sort, SORTS.map(s => s.id), DEFAULT_BINDER.sort), groupByPack: typeof o.groupByPack === 'boolean' ? o.groupByPack : DEFAULT_BINDER.groupByPack, hideUncollected: typeof o.hideUncollected === 'boolean' ? o.hideUncollected : DEFAULT_BINDER.hideUncollected, pagesSeason: typeof o.pagesSeason === 'string' && o.pagesSeason.length > 0 && o.pagesSeason.length <= 80 ? o.pagesSeason : null, pages: [], }; const cap = capacity(cfg); if (Array.isArray(o.pages)) { for (const p of o.pages.slice(0, BINDER_LIMITS.pages)) { if (!p || typeof p !== 'object') continue; const raw = Array.isArray((p as { slots?: unknown }).slots) ? ((p as { slots: unknown[] }).slots).slice(0, MAX_POCKETS) : []; cfg.pages.push({ title: clean((p as { title?: unknown }).title, BINDER_LIMITS.pageTitle), slots: raw.map(sanitizeSlot) }); } cfg.pages = reflowPages(cfg.pages, cap); // pads every page to the grid and moves any overflow to a page of its own } if (cfg.pages.length === 0) { cfg.pagesSeason = null; if (cfg.mode === 'custom') cfg.mode = 'auto'; } return JSON.stringify(cfg) === JSON.stringify(DEFAULT_BINDER) ? null : cfg; }

nodes.name: emptySlots
nodes.body_text: emptySlots = (n: number): (BinderSlot | null)[] => Array.from({ length: n }, () => null)

nodes.name: blankPage
nodes.body_text: blankPage = (cap: number, title = ''): BinderPageCfg => ({ title, slots: emptySlots(cap) })

nodes.name: reflowPages
nodes.signature: function reflowPages(pages: BinderPageCfg[], cap: number): BinderPageCfg[]
nodes.body_text: function reflowPages(pages: BinderPageCfg[], cap: number): BinderPageCfg[] { const out: BinderPageCfg[] = []; for (const p of pages) { const kept = p.slots.slice(0, cap); while (kept.length < cap) kept.push(null); out.push({ title: p.title, slots: kept }); const spill = p.slots.slice(cap).filter((s): s is BinderSlot => !!s); for (let i = 0; i < spill.length; i += cap) { const chunk: (BinderSlot | null)[] = spill.slice(i, i + cap); while (chunk.length < cap) chunk.push(null); out.push({ title: p.title ? `${p.title} (more)` : '', slots: chunk }); } } return out.slice(0, BINDER_LIMITS.pages); }

nodes.name: addPage
nodes.signature: function addPage(pages: BinderPageCfg[], cap: number, at = pages.length): BinderPageCfg[]
nodes.body_text: function addPage(pages: BinderPageCfg[], cap: number, at = pages.length): BinderPageCfg[] { if (pages.length >= BINDER_LIMITS.pages) return pages; const i = Math.max(0, Math.min(pages.length, at)); return [...pages.slice(0, i), blankPage(cap), ...pages.slice(i)]; }

nodes.name: removePage
nodes.body_text: removePage = (pages: BinderPageCfg[], i: number): BinderPageCfg[] => pages.filter((_, k) => k !== i)

nodes.name: movePage
nodes.signature: function movePage(pages: BinderPageCfg[], from: number, to: number): BinderPageCfg[]
nodes.body_text: function movePage(pages: BinderPageCfg[], from: number, to: number): BinderPageCfg[] { if (from < 0 || from >= pages.length) return pages; const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(pages.length - 1, to)); const next = pages.slice(); const [p] = next.splice(from, 1); next.splice(t, 0, p); return next; }

nodes.name: renamePage
nodes.signature: renamePage = (pages: BinderPageCfg[], i: number, title: string): BinderPageCfg[]
nodes.body_text: renamePage = (pages: BinderPageCfg[], i: number, title: string): BinderPageCfg[] => pages.map((p, k) => (k === i ? { ...p, title: clean(title, BINDER_LIMITS.pageTitle) } : p))

nodes.name: clearPage
nodes.body_text: clearPage = (pages: BinderPageCfg[], i: number): BinderPageCfg[] => pages.map((p, k) => (k === i ? { ...p, slots: emptySlots(p.slots.length) } : p))

nodes.name: setSlot
nodes.signature: function setSlot(pages: BinderPageCfg[], page: number, slot: number, value: BinderSlot | null): BinderPageCfg[]
nodes.body_text: function setSlot(pages: BinderPageCfg[], page: number, slot: number, value: BinderSlot | null): BinderPageCfg[] { return pages.map((p, k) => (k === page && slot >= 0 && slot < p.slots.length ? { ...p, slots: p.slots.map((s, j) => (j === slot ? value : s)) } : p)); }

nodes.name: nextEmpty
nodes.signature: function nextEmpty(pages: BinderPageCfg[], page: number, slot: number): { page: number; slot: number } | null
nodes.body_text: function nextEmpty(pages: BinderPageCfg[], page: number, slot: number): { page: number; slot: number } | null { for (let p = page; p < pages.length; p++) for (let s = p === page ? slot + 1 : 0; s < pages[p].slots.length; s++) if (!pages[p].slots[s]) return { page: p, slot: s }; return null; }

nodes.name: swapSlots
nodes.signature: function swapSlots(pages: BinderPageCfg[], a: { page: number; slot: number }, b: { page: number; slot: number }): BinderPageCfg[]
nodes.body_text: function swapSlots(pages: BinderPageCfg[], a: { page: number; slot: number }, b: { page: number; slot: number }): BinderPageCfg[] { const va = pages[a.page]?.slots[a.slot] ?? null, vb = pages[b.page]?.slots[b.slot] ?? null; return setSlot(setSlot(pages, a.page, a.slot, vb), b.page, b.slot, va); }

nodes.name: binder.ts
nodes.body_text: // The collection binder's page layout (pure, client-safe). A binder is a cover followed by pages of pockets (3x3 by default, // up to 4x4), either built automatically (a pack at a time, in set order) or placed by hand (see lib/binder-config.ts), shown two // pages at a time on wide screens and one on phones. import { capacity, reflowPages, type BinderConfig, type BinderPageCfg, type BinderSort } from './binder-config'; import type { Variant } from './types'; export const POCKETS = 9; /** Packs in the order they first appear, each pack's cards sorted (by card number unless asked otherwise), `cap` to a page, after a cover. */ /** The automatic layout as editable pages (what "Start from my collection" fills the hand-made binder with). */ /** The hand-made pages: each pocket's card number becomes an index into the card list (a number that isn't in the season is an empty pocket). */ /** * What is on view at each position. Two-page mode opens on the cover alone (its right side), then pairs of pages like a real book. * One-page mode shows a page at a time. */ /** Which spread a page index lives in (so a pack's name can jump to it). */ /** Keeps a spread number on the book. */

nodes.name: BinderPage
nodes.body_text: interface BinderPage { kind: 'cover' | 'cards'; pack?: string; /** Page number within its pack (1-based) and how many pages the pack has. */ part?: number; parts?: number; /** Indexes into the card list, null for an empty pocket. */ slots: (number | null)[]; /** Custom pages: the version pinned in each pocket (null = best owned). */ pins?: (Variant | null)[]; /** Custom pages: this page's index in the saved config, so the editor knows which page a pocket belongs to. */ cfgIndex?: number; /** Custom pages: the page's own title. */ title?: string; }

nodes.name: BinderCardInfo
nodes.body_text: interface BinderCardInfo { packName: string; number: number; stars?: number; name?: string; owned?: boolean }

nodes.name: AutoOptions
nodes.body_text: interface AutoOptions { cap?: number; sort?: BinderSort; group?: boolean; hideUncollected?: boolean }

nodes.name: ordered
nodes.signature: function ordered(idx: number[], cards: BinderCardInfo[], sort: BinderSort): number[]
nodes.body_text: function ordered(idx: number[], cards: BinderCardInfo[], sort: BinderSort): number[] { const byNumber = (a: number, b: number) => cards[a].number - cards[b].number; const cmp: Record<BinderSort, (a: number, b: number) => number> = { number: byNumber, rarity: (a, b) => (cards[b].stars ?? 0) - (cards[a].stars ?? 0) || byNumber(a, b), name: (a, b) => (cards[a].name ?? '').localeCompare(cards[b].name ?? '') || byNumber(a, b), collected: (a, b) => Number(!!cards[b].owned) - Number(!!cards[a].owned) || byNumber(a, b), }; return idx.slice().sort(cmp[sort]); }

nodes.name: byNumber
nodes.body_text: byNumber = (a: number, b: number) => cards[a].number - cards[b].number

nodes.name: buildBinderPages
nodes.signature: function buildBinderPages(cards: BinderCardInfo[], opts: AutoOptions = {}): BinderPage[]
nodes.body_text: function buildBinderPages(cards: BinderCardInfo[], opts: AutoOptions = {}): BinderPage[] { const cap = Math.max(1, opts.cap ?? POCKETS); const sort = opts.sort ?? 'number'; const group = opts.group ?? true; const keep = cards.map((c, i) => i).filter(i => !opts.hideUncollected || cards[i].owned !== false); const groups: { name: string; idx: number[] }[] = []; if (group) { for (const i of keep) { let g = groups.find(x => x.name === cards[i].packName); if (!g) groups.push(g = { name: cards[i].packName, idx: [] }); g.idx.push(i); } } else if (keep.length) groups.push({ name: 'All cards', idx: keep }); const pages: BinderPage[] = [{ kind: 'cover', slots: [] }]; for (const g of groups) { const idx = ordered(g.idx, cards, sort); const parts = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(idx.length / cap)); for (let p = 0; p < parts; p++) { const slice: (number | null)[] = idx.slice(p * cap, (p + 1) * cap); while (slice.length < cap) slice.push(null); pages.push({ kind: 'cards', pack: g.name, part: p + 1, parts, slots: slice }); } } return pages; }

nodes.name: autoFillPages
nodes.signature: function autoFillPages(cards: BinderCardInfo[], cfg: Pick<BinderConfig, 'cols' | 'rows' | 'sort' | 'groupByPack' | 'hideUncollected'>): BinderPageCfg[]
nodes.body_text: function autoFillPages(cards: BinderCardInfo[], cfg: Pick<BinderConfig, 'cols' | 'rows' | 'sort' | 'groupByPack' | 'hideUncollected'>): BinderPageCfg[] { const pages = buildBinderPages(cards, { cap: capacity(cfg), sort: cfg.sort, group: cfg.groupByPack, hideUncollected: cfg.hideUncollected }); return pages.filter(p => p.kind === 'cards').map(p => ({ title: (p.parts ?? 1) > 1 ? `${p.pack} ${p.part}/${p.parts}` : p.pack ?? '', slots: p.slots.map(i => (i === null ? null : { card: cards[i].number, variant: null })), })); }

nodes.name: buildCustomPages
nodes.signature: function buildCustomPages(cards: { number: number }[], pages: BinderPageCfg[], cap: number): BinderPage[]
nodes.body_text: function buildCustomPages(cards: { number: number }[], pages: BinderPageCfg[], cap: number): BinderPage[] { const byNumber = new Map<number, number>(); cards.forEach((c, i) => { if (!byNumber.has(c.number)) byNumber.set(c.number, i); }); const out: BinderPage[] = [{ kind: 'cover', slots: [] }]; reflowPages(pages, cap).forEach((p, k) => { const slots = p.slots.map(s => (s ? byNumber.get(s.card) ?? null : null)); out.push({ kind: 'cards', pack: p.title, title: p.title, cfgIndex: k, slots, pins: p.slots.map(s => (s && byNumber.has(s.card) ? s.variant : null)) }); }); return out; }

nodes.name: Spread
nodes.body_text: interface Spread { left?: BinderPage; right?: BinderPage; /** Page numbers shown (1-based, cover = 1) for the label. */ label: string }

nodes.name: buildSpreads
nodes.signature: function buildSpreads(pages: BinderPage[], double: boolean): Spread[]
nodes.body_text: function buildSpreads(pages: BinderPage[], double: boolean): Spread[] { if (!double) return pages.map((p, i) => ({ right: p, label: `Page ${i + 1} of ${pages.length}` })); const out: Spread[] = [{ right: pages[0], label: `Cover` }]; for (let i = 1; i < pages.length; i += 2) { const a = pages[i], b = pages[i + 1]; out.push({ left: a, right: b, label: b ? `Pages ${i + 1}-${i + 2} of ${pages.length}` : `Page ${i + 1} of ${pages.length}` }); } return out; }

nodes.name: spreadOfPage
nodes.signature: function spreadOfPage(pageIndex: number, double: boolean): number
nodes.body_text: function spreadOfPage(pageIndex: number, double: boolean): number { return double ? (pageIndex === 0 ? 0 : Math.ceil(pageIndex / 2)) : pageIndex; }

nodes.name: clampSpread
nodes.body_text: clampSpread = (n: number, count: number) => Math.max(0, Math.min(Math.max(0, count - 1), Math.floor(n)))

nodes.name: board-view.ts
nodes.body_text: // Sorting, filtering and rank movement for the public leaderboard (pure, client-safe). export const METRIC_LABELS: Record<BoardMetric, string> = { points: 'Points', cards: 'Different cards', copies: 'Prints', shiny: 'Shinies' }; /** The saved standings of an ended season as board rows. Collectors who have since been hidden or gone private are left out. */ /** Every row ranked by the chosen metric (ties share a rank, the points score breaks ties in the ordering). */ /** Narrow a ranked board without changing anyone's rank (so searching for someone still shows their true place). */ /** Places gained (+) or lost (−) since an earlier set of ranks. New names (not in `before`) get no entry. */

nodes.name: BoardMetric
nodes.body_text: type BoardMetric = 'points' | 'cards' | 'copies' | 'shiny';

nodes.name: BoardRow
nodes.body_text: interface BoardRow { username: string; score: number; cardPoints: number; completionBonus: number; setBonus: number; complete: boolean; uniqueCards: number; copies: number; /** Copies per version, Regular first (see VARIANTS). */ variants: { regular: number; reverse: number; full: number; shiny: number }; /** The bonuses are one lump (completionBonus holds the total): an old final standing that did not record the split. */ bonusesTogether?: boolean; }

nodes.name: standingsToBoardRows
nodes.signature: function standingsToBoardRows( standings: { username: string; score: number; cardPoints: number; uniqueCards: number; copies: number; complete: boolean; completionBonus?: number; setBonus?: number; variants?: BoardRow['variants'] }[], hidden: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(), ): { rows: BoardRow[]; hasVariants: boolean }
nodes.body_text: function standingsToBoardRows( standings: { username: string; score: number; cardPoints: number; uniqueCards: number; copies: number; complete: boolean; completionBonus?: number; setBonus?: number; variants?: BoardRow['variants'] }[], hidden: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(), ): { rows: BoardRow[]; hasVariants: boolean } { const kept = standings.filter(s => !hidden.has(s.username)); return { hasVariants: kept.length > 0 && kept.every(s => !!s.variants), rows: kept.map(s => { const split = s.completionBonus !== undefined && s.setBonus !== undefined; return { username: s.username, score: s.score, cardPoints: s.cardPoints, complete: s.complete, uniqueCards: s.uniqueCards, copies: s.copies, completionBonus: split ? s.completionBonus! : Math.max(0, s.score - s.cardPoints), setBonus: split ? s.setBonus! : 0, variants: s.variants ?? { regular: 0, reverse: 0, full: 0, shiny: 0 }, ...(split ? {} : { bonusesTogether: true }), }; }), }; }

nodes.name: metricValue
nodes.body_text: metricValue = (r: BoardRow, m: BoardMetric): number => m === 'points' ? r.score : m === 'cards' ? r.uniqueCards : m === 'copies' ? r.copies : r.variants.shiny

nodes.name: RankedRow
nodes.body_text: interface RankedRow { row: BoardRow; rank: number }

nodes.name: rankBoard
nodes.signature: function rankBoard(rows: BoardRow[], metric: BoardMetric): RankedRow[]
nodes.body_text: function rankBoard(rows: BoardRow[], metric: BoardMetric): RankedRow[] { const sorted = [...rows].sort((a, b) => metricValue(b, metric) - metricValue(a, metric) || b.score - a.score || a.username.localeCompare(b.username)); const out: RankedRow[] = []; sorted.forEach((row, i) => { const prev = out[i - 1]; out.push({ row, rank: prev && metricValue(prev.row, metric) === metricValue(row, metric) ? prev.rank : i + 1 }); }); return out; }

nodes.name: filterBoard
nodes.signature: function filterBoard(ranked: RankedRow[], opts: { q?: string; completeOnly?: boolean }): RankedRow[]
nodes.body_text: function filterBoard(ranked: RankedRow[], opts: { q?: string; completeOnly?: boolean }): RankedRow[] { const q = (opts.q ?? '').trim().toLowerCase().replace(/^@/, ''); return ranked.filter(r => (!opts.completeOnly || r.row.complete) && (!q || r.row.username.includes(q))); }

nodes.name: rankMovement
nodes.signature: function rankMovement(before: Record<string, number>, now: RankedRow[]): Record<string, number>
nodes.body_text: function rankMovement(before: Record<string, number>, now: RankedRow[]): Record<string, number> { const out: Record<string, number> = {}; for (const { row, rank } of now) { const was = before[row.username]; if (was !== undefined && was !== rank) out[row.username] = was - rank; } return out; }

nodes.name: rankSnapshot
nodes.body_text: rankSnapshot = (ranked: RankedRow[]): Record<string, number> => Object.fromEntries(ranked.map(r => [r.row.username, r.rank]))

nodes.name: captcha-server.ts
nodes.body_text: import { NextResponse } from 'next/server'; import { currentSandboxId, kv } from './db'; import { PASS_SECONDS, captchaBody, captchaKeys, checkCaptcha, verifyTurnstile } from './captcha'; /** * Gate for a trade or upgrade request: returns the error response to send when the viewer still has to pass the check, or * null to carry on. The token (if the page has one) is read from the request body's `captchaToken`. */

nodes.name: passKey
nodes.body_text: passKey = (username: string) => `captcha:pass:${username.toLowerCase()}`

nodes.name: clientIp
nodes.body_text: function clientIp(req: Request): string | undefined { const fwd = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-for')?.split(',')[0]?.trim(); return fwd || req.headers.get('x-real-ip') || undefined; }

nodes.name: captchaGate
nodes.signature: async function captchaGate(req: Request, username: string, body: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<NextResponse | null>
nodes.body_text: async function captchaGate(req: Request, username: string, body: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<NextResponse | null> { const outcome = await checkCaptcha({ username, token: body.captchaToken, ip: clientIp(req) }, { keys: captchaKeys(), sandbox: !!(await currentSandboxId()), hasPass: async u => !!(await kv.get(passKey(u))), grantPass: async u => { await kv.set(passKey(u), 1, { ex: PASS_SECONDS }); }, verify: (token, secret, ip) => verifyTurnstile(token, secret, ip), }); return outcome.ok ? null : NextResponse.json(captchaBody(outcome), { status: 403 }); }

nodes.name: captcha.ts
nodes.body_text: // Cloudflare Turnstile on the website's trade and upgrade actions. // // The check is only asked for when needed: the first time a viewer trades or upgrades (and again after PASS_SECONDS of not // doing so) the server answers "captcha required" and the page shows the widget, then retries with the token. A passed check // is remembered for the viewer for a while so a run of upgrades is not interrupted. It switches itself off (fails open) when // the keys are not set, inside sandboxes, and if Cloudflare cannot be reached, so it can never lock the game. // // TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY (public) and TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY (private) come from the Cloudflare dashboard. The Twitch panel's // trades and upgrades are signed by Twitch and do not use this. export const PASS_SECONDS = 15 * 60; const VERIFY_URL = 'https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/siteverify'; const MAX_TOKEN = 2048; /** Decides whether a viewer may go ahead. Pure apart from the injected `deps`. */ /** Asks Cloudflare whether a token is genuine (each token works once). A network problem is "unreachable", not a failure. */ /** The message and shape the page looks for: `captcha: true` plus the public site key makes it show the check and retry. */

nodes.name: CaptchaKeys
nodes.body_text: interface CaptchaKeys { site: string; secret: string }

nodes.name: captchaKeys
nodes.signature: function captchaKeys(env: Record<string, string | undefined> = process.env): CaptchaKeys | null
nodes.body_text: function captchaKeys(env: Record<string, string | undefined> = process.env): CaptchaKeys | null { const site = env.TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY?.trim(); const secret = env.TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY?.trim(); return site && secret ? { site, secret } : null; }

nodes.name: VerifyResult
nodes.body_text: type VerifyResult = 'valid' | 'invalid' | 'unreachable';

nodes.name: CaptchaDeps
nodes.body_text: interface CaptchaDeps { keys: CaptchaKeys | null; sandbox: boolean; hasPass(username: string): Promise<boolean>; grantPass(username: string): Promise<void>; verify(token: string, secret: string, ip?: string): Promise<VerifyResult>; }

nodes.name: CaptchaOutcome
nodes.signature: type CaptchaOutcome = | { ok: true; via: 'off' | 'pass' | 'token' | 'unreachable' } | { ok: false; reason: 'required' | 'failed'; siteKey: string };
nodes.body_text: type CaptchaOutcome = | { ok: true; via: 'off' | 'pass' | 'token' | 'unreachable' } | { ok: false; reason: 'required' | 'failed'; siteKey: string };

nodes.name: checkCaptcha
nodes.signature: async function checkCaptcha(input: { username: string; token?: unknown; ip?: string }, deps: CaptchaDeps): Promise<CaptchaOutcome>
nodes.body_text: async function checkCaptcha(input: { username: string; token?: unknown; ip?: string }, deps: CaptchaDeps): Promise<CaptchaOutcome> { if (!deps.keys || deps.sandbox) return { ok: true, via: 'off' }; if (await deps.hasPass(input.username)) return { ok: true, via: 'pass' }; const token = typeof input.token === 'string' ? input.token.trim() : ''; if (!token || token.length > MAX_TOKEN) return { ok: false, reason: 'required', siteKey: deps.keys.site }; const verdict = await deps.verify(token, deps.keys.secret, input.ip); if (verdict === 'invalid') return { ok: false, reason: 'failed', siteKey: deps.keys.site }; if (verdict === 'valid') await deps.grantPass(input.username); return { ok: true, via: verdict === 'valid' ? 'token' : 'unreachable' }; }

nodes.name: verifyTurnstile
nodes.signature: async function verifyTurnstile(token: string, secret: string, ip?: string, fetchImpl: typeof fetch = fetch): Promise<VerifyResult>
nodes.body_text: async function verifyTurnstile(token: string, secret: string, ip?: string, fetchImpl: typeof fetch = fetch): Promise<VerifyResult> { try { const form = new URLSearchParams({ secret, response: token }); if (ip) form.set('remoteip', ip); const res = await fetchImpl(VERIFY_URL, { method: 'POST', body: form, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(5000) }); if (!res.ok) return 'unreachable'; const data = (await res.json()) as { success?: boolean }; return data.success ? 'valid' : 'invalid'; } catch { return 'unreachable'; } }

nodes.name: captchaBody
nodes.body_text: function captchaBody(outcome: Extract<CaptchaOutcome, { ok: false }>) { return { error: outcome.reason === 'failed' ? 'The check did not pass. Please try again.' : 'Please complete the quick check to continue.', captcha: true as const, siteKey: outcome.siteKey, }; }

nodes.name: card-art.ts
nodes.body_text: /** * Static thumbnail for a card image, or the original URL when none exists. * - Bundled cards: /assets/cards/X.webp → /assets/cards/thumb/X.webp * - Admin uploads: …/cards/<uuid>.webp (Blob) → …/cards/<uuid>.thumb.webp * Everything else (external URLs, non-optimized uploads) has no thumbnail. * Browser-safe: no sharp or server imports here. */ /** The fields cardStill() reads; any card shape that carries them works. */ /** The static image to show for a card's art: the chosen still frame if there is one, else the thumbnail (the first frame). `which` picks the normal or the full-art image. */ /** The same for a given art URL of a card (the full-art image, or the normal one): the chosen still for that image, else its thumbnail. */ /** * True for art the frame picker may read: a bundled card (/assets/cards/<name>.webp) or a card file in this project's Blob store * (cards/<name>.webp). Anything else (other hosts, other folders, path tricks) is refused, since the server fetches the URL. */ /** Blob path for a chosen still; the frame number and a fresh id keep it a new URL every time, so a CDN never serves an older still. */ /** Blob paths for an optimized upload and its thumbnail; keep in sync with cardThumbUrl. */ /** True for files in this project's Vercel Blob store. */ const BLOB_HOST = /^https:\/\/[^/]+\.public\.blob\.vercel-storage\.com\//i;

nodes.name: cardThumbUrl
nodes.body_text: function cardThumbUrl(imageUrl: string): string { return imageUrl .replace(/^\/assets\/cards\/([^/]+\.webp)$/i, '/assets/cards/thumb/$1') .replace(/^(https:\/\/[^/]+\.public\.blob\.vercel-storage\.com\/cards\/[0-9a-f-]{36})\.webp$/i, '$1.thumb.webp'); }

nodes.name: StillFields
nodes.body_text: interface StillFields { imageUrl: string; fullArtImageUrl?: string; stillUrl?: string; fullArtStillUrl?: string }

nodes.name: cardStill
nodes.body_text: function cardStill(card: StillFields, which: 'art' | 'fullArt' = 'art'): string { if (which === 'fullArt') return card.fullArtStillUrl || cardThumbUrl(card.fullArtImageUrl ?? card.imageUrl); return card.stillUrl || cardThumbUrl(card.imageUrl); }

nodes.name: stillFor
nodes.signature: function stillFor(card: Partial<StillFields>, url: string): string
nodes.body_text: function stillFor(card: Partial<StillFields>, url: string): string { if (card.stillUrl && url === card.imageUrl) return card.stillUrl; if (card.fullArtStillUrl && url === card.fullArtImageUrl) return card.fullArtStillUrl; return cardThumbUrl(url); }

nodes.name: isFrameSourceUrl
nodes.body_text: function isFrameSourceUrl(url: string): boolean { if (/^\/assets\/cards\/[A-Za-z0-9 _.()-]+\.webp$/i.test(url) && !url.includes('..')) return true; return /^https:\/\/[a-z0-9-]+\.public\.blob\.vercel-storage\.com\/cards\/[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\.webp$/i.test(url) && !url.includes('..'); }

nodes.name: stillBlobPath
nodes.signature: function stillBlobPath(id: string, frame: number): string
nodes.body_text: function stillBlobPath(id: string, frame: number): string { return `cards/${id}.still-${frame}.webp`; }

nodes.name: optimizedCardPaths
nodes.signature: function optimizedCardPaths(id: string): { full: string; thumb: string }
nodes.body_text: function optimizedCardPaths(id: string): { full: string; thumb: string } { return { full: `cards/${id}.webp`, thumb: `cards/${id}.thumb.webp` }; }

nodes.name: isBlobUrl
nodes.body_text: function isBlobUrl(url: string): boolean { return BLOB_HOST.test(url); }

nodes.name: card-back-edit.ts
nodes.body_text: // The card back editor's pure operations (ROADMAP 20.3b): changing, adding, ordering, aligning and snapping elements of a v2 design. // Client-safe and free of React so a script can test them. Boxes are in PERCENT of the card (left / top / width / height of what is drawn). import { DEFAULT_CARD_BACK, MAX_ELEMENTS, MAX_TEXT_BOXES, PRESETS, sanitizeCardBack, type BackEl, type CardBackStyle, type ElementKind, } from './card-back'; /** A design with `fn` applied to the elements whose ids are in `ids`; always passes through the sanitiser so it stays valid. */ /** The design with `patch` applied to its background fields (background, colours, pattern, pattern settings, edge, stack position). */ /** Adds a text box (free, centred) on top; null when the limits are reached. */ /** Duplicates a text box just above itself, nudged so the copy is visible; null for other kinds or at the limits. */ /** Removes a text box (the other kinds can only be hidden). */ /** Moves the element `from` to the place of `to` in the list (layers order, and the stack order for stack elements). */ /** One step up (`-1`) or down (`1`) in the layers list. */ // Type an element takes when it leaves the stack, so it looks as it did (the stack's own CSS sizes and weights). const LOOK: Partial<Record<ElementKind, Partial<BackEl>>> = { brand: { weight: 800, uppercase: true, letterSpacing: 2.8 }, number: { weight: 800, lineHeight: 1 }, edition: { weight: 400 }, name: { weight: 800 }, date: { weight: 800, letterSpacing: 1.6 }, origin: { weight: 400 }, text: { weight: 400, italic: true }, }; /** Takes an element out of the stack and places it where it was drawn (`box` in percent, `fontPx` its font size, `cardW` the card width in px). */ /** Puts a free element back in the stack (at its place in the list). */ /** An element back to what the default design (or, for a text box, a fresh one) has. */ // ── Align and distribute (free elements; `boxes` are their measured boxes, in percent) ── /** Spaces three or more free elements evenly between the outermost two, by their centres. */ // ── Snapping ───────────────────────────────────────────── export const GRID = 2; export const SNAP_THRESHOLD = 1.2; /** * Snaps a dragged box along one axis. `edges` are the box's [start, centre, end] in percent; `targets` the lines to snap to (the card's * edges and centre, other elements' edges and centres). The 2 % grid applies to the centre. Returns how far to shift and the guide line. */ /** The snap lines of the card itself and of the other boxes, per axis. */ // ── Presets (v2 layouts) and warnings ──────────────────── /** The presets of the editor: the 20.1 four (as stack layouts) and two that place elements freely. */ export const EDITOR_PRESETS: { id: string; label: string; style: CardBackStyle }[] = [ ...PRESETS, { id: 'poster', label: 'Poster', style: sanitizeCardBack({ v: 2, background: 'solid', bg1: '#14121f', pattern: 'rays', patternColor: '#fbbf24', patternOpacity: 0.12, edge: 'rarity', align: 'middle', elements: [ { id: 'number', kind: 'number', place: 'free', x: 50, y: 50, w: 90, size: 20, font: 'bebas', weight: 400, color: '#fde68a', fx: { glow: { color: '#f59e0b', blur: 14, strength: 1 } } }, freeText('text-1', { x: 50, y: 22, w: 84, size: 9, font: 'bangers', weight: 400, text: '{card}', color: 'rarity', rotate: -4, fx: { outline: { color: '#000000', width: 3 } } }), { id: 'edition', kind: 'edition', place: 'free', x: 50, y: 66, w: 80, size: 5, font: 'orbitron', weight: 700, uppercase: true, letterSpacing: 2, color: '#f9fafb' }, { id: 'brand', kind: 'brand', place: 'free', x: 50, y: 92, w: 80, size: 3.4, font: 'body', weight: 800, uppercase: true, letterSpacing: 4, color: '#fde68a' }, { id: 'qr', kind: 'qr', place: 'free', x: 86, y: 86, w: 14, dark: '#14121f', light: '#fde68a' }, { id: 'date', kind: 'date', show: false }, { id: 'name', kind: 'name', show: false }, { id: 'origin', kind: 'origin', show: false }, { id: 'history', kind: 'history', show: false }, { id: 'link', kind: 'link' }, ] }), }, { id: 'minimal', label: 'Minimal', style: sanitizeCardBack({ v: 2, background: 'solid', bg1: '#f4f1ea', pattern: 'grain', patternOpacity: 0.5, edge: 'rarity', align: 'middle', elements: [ { id: 'number', kind: 'number', place: 'free', x: 50, y: 46, w: 90, size: 14, font: 'playfair', weight: 700, color: '#1c1c24' }, freeText('text-1', { x: 50, y: 58, w: 80, size: 4.4, font: 'playfair', weight: 400, italic: true, text: '{card}, edition {edition}', color: '#1c1c24' }), freeText('text-2', { x: 50, y: 92, w: 80, size: 3.4, font: 'spacemono', weight: 400, text: '{pack} / {season}', color: '#6b6b76', letterSpacing: 2 }), { id: 'qr', kind: 'qr', place: 'free', x: 50, y: 78, w: 16 }, { id: 'brand', kind: 'brand', show: false }, { id: 'edition', kind: 'edition', show: false }, { id: 'name', kind: 'name', show: false }, { id: 'date', kind: 'date', show: false }, { id: 'origin', kind: 'origin', show: false }, { id: 'history', kind: 'history', show: false }, { id: 'link', kind: 'link' }, ] }), }, ]; /** Text that would be drawn smaller than `minPx` when the card is `tileW` px wide (the size of a tile), for the editor's warning. */

nodes.name: Box
nodes.body_text: interface Box { l: number; t: number; w: number; h: number }

nodes.name: r2
nodes.body_text: r2 = (n: number) => Math.round(n * 100) / 100

nodes.name: clamp
nodes.signature: clamp = (n: number, lo: number, hi: number)
nodes.body_text: clamp = (n: number, lo: number, hi: number) => Math.min(hi, Math.max(lo, n))

nodes.name: patchElements
nodes.signature: function patchElements(style: CardBackStyle, ids: Iterable<string>, patch: Partial<BackEl> | ((e: BackEl) => Partial<BackEl>)): CardBackStyle
nodes.body_text: function patchElements(style: CardBackStyle, ids: Iterable<string>, patch: Partial<BackEl> | ((e: BackEl) => Partial<BackEl>)): CardBackStyle { const set = new Set(ids); return sanitizeCardBack({ ...style, elements: style.elements.map(e => (set.has(e.id) ? { ...e, ...(typeof patch === 'function' ? patch(e) : patch) } : e)) }); }

nodes.name: patchBackground
nodes.signature: function patchBackground(style: CardBackStyle, patch: Partial<Omit<CardBackStyle, 'elements' | 'v'>>): CardBackStyle
nodes.body_text: function patchBackground(style: CardBackStyle, patch: Partial<Omit<CardBackStyle, 'elements' | 'v'>>): CardBackStyle { return sanitizeCardBack({ ...style, ...patch }); }

nodes.name: nextId
nodes.body_text: nextId = (style: CardBackStyle, base: string) => { let i = 1; while (style.elements.some(e => e.id === `${base}-${i}`)) i++; return `${base}-${i}`; }

nodes.name: addText
nodes.signature: function addText(style: CardBackStyle, text = 'New text'): { style: CardBackStyle; id: string } | null
nodes.body_text: function addText(style: CardBackStyle, text = 'New text'): { style: CardBackStyle; id: string } | null { if (style.elements.length >= MAX_ELEMENTS || style.elements.filter(e => e.kind === 'text').length >= MAX_TEXT_BOXES) return null; const id = nextId(style, 'text'); const top = Math.max(0, ...style.elements.filter(e => e.place === 'free').map(e => e.z)); const el: Partial<BackEl> & { id: string; kind: ElementKind } = { id, kind: 'text', place: 'free', x: 50, y: 50, w: 70, size: 8, weight: 700, font: 'display', text, z: Math.min(50, top + 1) }; return { style: sanitizeCardBack({ ...style, elements: [...style.elements, el] }), id }; }

nodes.name: duplicateElement
nodes.signature: function duplicateElement(style: CardBackStyle, id: string): { style: CardBackStyle; id: string } | null
nodes.body_text: function duplicateElement(style: CardBackStyle, id: string): { style: CardBackStyle; id: string } | null { const src = style.elements.find(e => e.id === id); if (!src || src.kind !== 'text' || style.elements.length >= MAX_ELEMENTS || style.elements.filter(e => e.kind === 'text').length >= MAX_TEXT_BOXES) return null; const copy = { ...src, id: nextId(style, 'text'), x: clamp(src.x + 3, 0, 100), y: clamp(src.y + 3, 0, 100), z: Math.min(50, src.z + 1), locked: false }; const i = style.elements.indexOf(src); return { style: sanitizeCardBack({ ...style, elements: [...style.elements.slice(0, i + 1), copy, ...style.elements.slice(i + 1)] }), id: copy.id }; }

nodes.name: removeElement
nodes.signature: function removeElement(style: CardBackStyle, id: string): CardBackStyle
nodes.body_text: function removeElement(style: CardBackStyle, id: string): CardBackStyle { return sanitizeCardBack({ ...style, elements: style.elements.filter(e => !(e.id === id && e.kind === 'text')) }); }

nodes.name: moveElement
nodes.signature: function moveElement(style: CardBackStyle, from: string, to: string): CardBackStyle
nodes.body_text: function moveElement(style: CardBackStyle, from: string, to: string): CardBackStyle { const a = style.elements.findIndex(e => e.id === from), b = style.elements.findIndex(e => e.id === to); if (a < 0 || b < 0 || a === b) return style; const els = [...style.elements]; const [m] = els.splice(a, 1); els.splice(b, 0, m); return sanitizeCardBack({ ...style, elements: els }); }

nodes.name: stepElement
nodes.signature: function stepElement(style: CardBackStyle, id: string, dir: -1 | 1): CardBackStyle
nodes.body_text: function stepElement(style: CardBackStyle, id: string, dir: -1 | 1): CardBackStyle { const i = style.elements.findIndex(e => e.id === id), j = i + dir; return i < 0 || j < 0 || j >= style.elements.length ? style : moveElement(style, id, style.elements[j].id); }

nodes.name: makeFree
nodes.signature: function makeFree(style: CardBackStyle, id: string, box: Box, fontPx: number, cardW: number): CardBackStyle
nodes.body_text: function makeFree(style: CardBackStyle, id: string, box: Box, fontPx: number, cardW: number): CardBackStyle { return patchElements(style, [id], e => ({ place: 'free', x: r2(box.l + box.w / 2), y: r2(box.t + box.h / 2), w: r2(clamp(box.w + (e.kind === 'qr' || e.kind === 'logo' ? 0 : 4), 10, 100)), size: r2(clamp((fontPx / cardW) * 100, 2, 30)), font: e.kind === 'number' ? e.font : e.font === 'body' ? 'body' : e.font, ...(LOOK[e.kind] ?? {}), z: 0, })); }

nodes.name: returnToStack
nodes.body_text: returnToStack = (style: CardBackStyle, id: string) => patchElements(style, [id], { place: 'stack' })

nodes.name: resetElement
nodes.signature: function resetElement(style: CardBackStyle, id: string): CardBackStyle
nodes.body_text: function resetElement(style: CardBackStyle, id: string): CardBackStyle { const base = DEFAULT_CARD_BACK.elements.find(e => e.kind === style.elements.find(x => x.id === id)?.kind); return base ? patchElements(style, [id], () => ({ ...base, id })) : patchElements(style, [id], { place: 'free', x: 50, y: 50, w: 70, size: 8, rotate: 0, weight: 700, font: 'display', italic: false, underline: false, uppercase: false, letterSpacing: 0, lineHeight: 1.25, align: 'center', color: 'auto', opacity: 1, fx: {} }); }

nodes.name: AlignMode
nodes.body_text: type AlignMode = 'left' | 'center' | 'right' | 'top' | 'middle' | 'bottom';

nodes.name: alignElements
nodes.signature: function alignElements(style: CardBackStyle, ids: string[], mode: AlignMode, boxes: Record<string, Box>): CardBackStyle
nodes.body_text: function alignElements(style: CardBackStyle, ids: string[], mode: AlignMode, boxes: Record<string, Box>): CardBackStyle { const free = ids.filter(id => style.elements.find(e => e.id === id)?.place === 'free' && boxes[id]); if (free.length < 2) return style; const bs = free.map(id => boxes[id]); const left = Math.min(...bs.map(b => b.l)), right = Math.max(...bs.map(b => b.l + b.w)), top = Math.min(...bs.map(b => b.t)), bottom = Math.max(...bs.map(b => b.t + b.h)); return patchElements(style, free, e => { const b = boxes[e.id]; switch (mode) { case 'left': return { x: r2(left + b.w / 2) }; case 'right': return { x: r2(right - b.w / 2) }; case 'center': return { x: r2((left + right) / 2) }; case 'top': return { y: r2(top + b.h / 2) }; case 'bottom': return { y: r2(bottom - b.h / 2) }; case 'middle': return { y: r2((top + bottom) / 2) }; } }); }

nodes.name: distributeElements
nodes.signature: function distributeElements(style: CardBackStyle, ids: string[], axis: 'x' | 'y', boxes: Record<string, Box>): CardBackStyle
nodes.body_text: function distributeElements(style: CardBackStyle, ids: string[], axis: 'x' | 'y', boxes: Record<string, Box>): CardBackStyle { const free = ids.filter(id => style.elements.find(e => e.id === id)?.place === 'free' && boxes[id]); if (free.length < 3) return style; const c = (id: string) => (axis === 'x' ? boxes[id].l + boxes[id].w / 2 : boxes[id].t + boxes[id].h / 2); const sorted = [...free].sort((a, b) => c(a) - c(b)); const first = c(sorted[0]), last = c(sorted[sorted.length - 1]); const at = new Map(sorted.map((id, i) => [id, first + ((last - first) * i) / (sorted.length - 1)])); return patchElements(style, free, e => (axis === 'x' ? { x: r2(at.get(e.id)!) } : { y: r2(at.get(e.id)!) })); }

nodes.name: c
nodes.body_text: c = (id: string) => (axis === 'x' ? boxes[id].l + boxes[id].w / 2 : boxes[id].t + boxes[id].h / 2)

nodes.name: snapAxis
nodes.signature: function snapAxis(edges: [number, number, number], targets: number[], opts: { grid?: boolean; threshold?: number } = {}): { delta: number; guide: number | null }
nodes.body_text: function snapAxis(edges: [number, number, number], targets: number[], opts: { grid?: boolean; threshold?: number } = {}): { delta: number; guide: number | null } { const thr = opts.threshold ?? SNAP_THRESHOLD; let best: { delta: number; guide: number | null } = { delta: 0, guide: null }; let bestDist = thr; for (const e of edges) for (const t of targets) { const d = t - e; if (Math.abs(d) < bestDist) { bestDist = Math.abs(d); best = { delta: d, guide: t }; } } if (best.guide === null && opts.grid !== false) { const g = Math.round(edges[1] / GRID) * GRID - edges[1]; if (Math.abs(g) < thr) best = { delta: g, guide: null }; } return best; }

nodes.name: snapTargets
nodes.signature: function snapTargets(others: Box[]): { x: number[]; y: number[] }
nodes.body_text: function snapTargets(others: Box[]): { x: number[]; y: number[] } { const x = [0, 50, 100], y = [0, 50, 100]; for (const b of others) { x.push(b.l, b.l + b.w / 2, b.l + b.w); y.push(b.t, b.t + b.h / 2, b.t + b.h); } return { x, y }; }

nodes.name: freeText
nodes.signature: freeText = (id: string, over: Partial<BackEl>): Partial<BackEl> & { id: string; kind: ElementKind }
nodes.body_text: freeText = (id: string, over: Partial<BackEl>): Partial<BackEl> & { id: string; kind: ElementKind } => ({ id, kind: 'text', place: 'free', ...over })

nodes.name: tinyText
nodes.signature: function tinyText(style: CardBackStyle, tileW = 120, minPx = 9): string[]
nodes.body_text: function tinyText(style: CardBackStyle, tileW = 120, minPx = 9): string[] { return style.elements.filter(e => e.show && e.place === 'free' && e.kind !== 'qr' && e.kind !== 'logo' && (e.size / 100) * tileW < minPx).map(e => e.id); }

nodes.name: card-back-fonts.ts
nodes.body_text: // Loading the back's curated fonts in the browser (ROADMAP 20.3a). A font is fetched only when a back on the page uses it; the files are // self-hosted in /public/fonts/back (OFL, licences beside them), so nothing calls a font service at runtime. Client-only (needs `document`). import { BACK_FONTS } from './card-back'; const requested = new Set<string>(); /** Starts loading one weight of a curated font (a no-op for the site's own fonts, outside a browser, or when already requested). */ /** Resolves when every font the design needs has loaded (for the canvas renderer, which must not draw before they have). */

nodes.name: loadBackFont
nodes.signature: function loadBackFont(id: string, weight: number): Promise<void>
nodes.body_text: function loadBackFont(id: string, weight: number): Promise<void> { if (typeof document === 'undefined' || !('fonts' in document)) return Promise.resolve(); const f = BACK_FONTS.find(x => x.id === id); if (!f?.files) return Promise.resolve(); const have = Object.keys(f.files).map(Number); const w = have.reduce((best, n) => (Math.abs(n - weight) < Math.abs(best - weight) ? n : best), have[0]); const key = `${id}:${w}`; const family = /'([^']+)'/.exec(f.css)?.[1]; if (!family || requested.has(key)) return Promise.resolve(); requested.add(key); const face = new FontFace(family, `url(/fonts/back/${f.files[w]}) format('woff2')`, { weight: String(w), display: 'swap' }); document.fonts.add(face); return face.load().then(() => undefined, () => { requested.delete(key); }); }

nodes.name: loadBackFonts
nodes.signature: async function loadBackFonts(fonts: { id: string; weight: number }[]): Promise<void>
nodes.body_text: async function loadBackFonts(fonts: { id: string; weight: number }[]): Promise<void> { await Promise.all(fonts.map(f => loadBackFont(f.id, f.weight))); }

nodes.name: card-back-layout.ts
nodes.body_text: // The back's layout engine (ROADMAP 20.3a): a design and a print in, positioned nodes with their final styles out. Pure and client-safe. // The DOM renderer (FlipCard) draws these nodes; the canvas and overlay renderers of 20.3c draw the same list, so every place shows the // same design. STACK nodes are laid out by the plate's own CSS (today's centred column), FREE nodes carry final pixel positions. import { BACK_FONTS, fontCss, type BackEl, type CardBackStyle, type Effects } from './card-back'; import { editionLine, madeLine, type FlipBack } from './flip-back'; const AUTO_INK = '#1c1c24'; /** Template placeholders; unknown ones are dropped. */ /** The CSS for an element's effects (outline, glow, shadow, engrave, gradient text) at a card width in px. */ /** What a stack or free element prints for this print; null = nothing to draw (the element is skipped). */ /** The back's nodes for one print at one card size (`size` is the card's width and height in px; stack nodes ignore it). */ /** The curated font files the nodes need, as `{ id, weight }` (deduplicated). */

nodes.name: BackNode
nodes.body_text: interface BackNode { id: string; kind: BackEl['kind']; mode: 'stack' | 'free'; /** `foot` = a stack QR code or link that shows nothing for this print (the footer row is still kept, as it always was). */ tag: 'p' | 'ul' | 'img' | 'qr' | 'a' | 'empty'; /** The stylesheet classes of a stack node (`flip-serial gold` ...). Free nodes have none. */ cls: string; text?: string; items?: { text: string; date: string }[]; src?: string; qrUrl?: string; href?: string; /** CSS custom properties (stack nodes read them from the stylesheet). */ vars: Record<string, string>; /** Final CSS declarations (free nodes: position, type and effects; stack nodes: extra effects only). */ css: Record<string, string | number>; /** QR code colours, when set. */ dark?: string; light?: string; /** Fonts this node needs loaded (curated ids with files). */ font?: { id: string; weight: number }; }

nodes.name: LayoutOptions
nodes.body_text: interface LayoutOptions { compact?: boolean }

nodes.name: hexOr
nodes.signature: hexOr = (c: string, rarity: string, auto: string)
nodes.body_text: hexOr = (c: string, rarity: string, auto: string) => (c === 'rarity' ? rarity : c === 'auto' ? auto : c)

nodes.name: resolveTemplate
nodes.signature: function resolveTemplate(t: string, back: FlipBack, style: CardBackStyle): string
nodes.body_text: function resolveTemplate(t: string, back: FlipBack, style: CardBackStyle): string { const vars: Record<string, string> = { pack: style.packName ?? '', season: style.seasonName ?? '', card: back.name, version: back.variantLabel, edition: String(back.n), printNumber: String(back.uid ?? back.n), holder: back.holder ?? '', date: back.date ?? '', }; return t.replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (_, k: string) => vars[k] ?? '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); }

nodes.name: effectsCss
nodes.signature: function effectsCss(fx: Effects, hex: string, cardW: number): Record<string, string | number>
nodes.body_text: function effectsCss(fx: Effects, hex: string, cardW: number): Record<string, string | number> { const css: Record<string, string | number> = {}; const shadows: string[] = []; const unit = cardW / 100; if (fx.outline && fx.outline.width > 0) { css.WebkitTextStroke = `${Math.round(fx.outline.width * unit * 0.1 * 100) / 100}px ${fx.outline.color}`; css.paintOrder = 'stroke fill'; } if (fx.glow) for (let i = 0; i < Math.ceil(fx.glow.strength); i++) shadows.push(`0 0 ${Math.round(fx.glow.blur * unit * 0.25 * 100) / 100}px ${fx.glow.color}`); if (fx.shadow) shadows.push(`${Math.round(fx.shadow.x * unit * 0.25 * 100) / 100}px ${Math.round(fx.shadow.y * unit * 0.25 * 100) / 100}px ${Math.round(fx.shadow.blur * unit * 0.25 * 100) / 100}px ${fx.shadow.color}`); if (fx.engrave) shadows.push('0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.55)', '0 -1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,.4)'); if (shadows.length) css.textShadow = shadows.join(', '); if (fx.gradientText) { css.backgroundImage = `linear-gradient(${fx.gradientText.angle}deg, ${fx.gradientText.from}, ${fx.gradientText.to})`; css.WebkitBackgroundClip = 'text'; css.backgroundClip = 'text'; css.color = 'transparent'; css.WebkitTextFillColor = 'transparent'; } void hex; return css; }

nodes.name: content
nodes.signature: function content(e: BackEl, back: FlipBack, style: CardBackStyle, compact: boolean): Partial<BackNode> | null
nodes.body_text: function content(e: BackEl, back: FlipBack, style: CardBackStyle, compact: boolean): Partial<BackNode> | null { switch (e.kind) { case 'logo': { const src = e.src === 'cover' ? style.cover : e.url; return src ? { tag: 'img', cls: 'flip-logo', src } : null; } case 'brand': return { tag: 'p', cls: 'flip-brand', text: 'The Cheesy TCG' }; case 'number': return { tag: 'p', cls: `flip-serial ${!!back.bonus && back.bonus > 1 ? 'gold' : ''} ${back.uid ? 'long' : ''}`, text: `#${back.uid ?? back.n}` }; case 'edition': { const t = back.uid ? editionLine(back.n, back.total) : madeLine(back.n, back.total); return t ? { tag: 'p', cls: 'flip-line', text: t } : null; } case 'name': return { tag: 'p', cls: 'flip-line strong', text: `${back.variantLabel} · ${back.name}` }; case 'text': { const t = resolveTemplate(e.text, back, style); return t ? { tag: 'p', cls: 'flip-custom', text: t } : null; } case 'date': return back.date ? { tag: 'p', cls: 'flip-date', text: `${back.est ? 'NUMBERED' : 'PULLED'} ${back.date}` } : null; case 'origin': { const t = [back.origin, back.holder ? `Held by ${back.holder}` : null].filter(Boolean).join(' · '); return !compact && t ? { tag: 'p', cls: 'flip-line small', text: t } : null; } case 'history': return !compact && back.history && back.history.length > 0 ? { tag: 'ul', cls: 'flip-hist', items: back.history } : null; case 'qr': return !compact && back.qrUrl ? { tag: 'qr', cls: 'flip-qr', qrUrl: back.qrUrl } : null; case 'link': return back.href ? { tag: 'a', cls: 'flip-link', text: 'Full history ›', href: back.href } : null; } }

nodes.name: layoutBack
nodes.signature: function layoutBack(style: CardBackStyle, back: FlipBack, size: { w: number; h: number }, opts: LayoutOptions = {}): BackNode[]
nodes.body_text: function layoutBack(style: CardBackStyle, back: FlipBack, size: { w: number; h: number }, opts: LayoutOptions = {}): BackNode[] { const compact = !!opts.compact; const rarity = back.hex ?? '#9ca3af'; const stack: BackNode[] = []; const free: (BackNode & { z: number; order: number })[] = []; style.elements.forEach((e, order) => { const isFoot = e.kind === 'qr' || e.kind === 'link'; if (e.place === 'stack') { const c = e.show ? content(e, back, style, compact) : null; if (!c && !isFoot) return; const vars: Record<string, string> = {}; let css: Record<string, string | number> = {}; if (c) { const textual = e.kind !== 'qr' && e.kind !== 'logo'; const ink = e.color === 'auto' ? null : hexOr(e.color, rarity, AUTO_INK); if (textual && ink && !(e.kind === 'number' && c.cls?.includes('gold'))) vars[e.kind === 'brand' || e.kind === 'link' ? '--accent-ink' : '--ink'] = ink; if (textual && !e.fx.engrave) vars['--ink-shadow'] = 'none'; const { engrave: _g, ...extra } = e.fx; void _g; if (Object.keys(extra).length) css = effectsCss(extra, rarity, size.w); if (e.scale !== 1 && ['number', 'edition', 'name', 'date', 'origin', 'history', 'qr', 'brand'].includes(e.kind)) vars[`--k-${e.kind}`] = String(e.scale); if (e.kind === 'number' && e.font !== 'display') vars['--num-font'] = fontCss(e.font); if (e.kind === 'logo') vars['--logo-px'] = `${e.px}px`; } stack.push({ id: e.id, kind: e.kind, mode: 'stack', tag: c?.tag ?? 'empty', cls: c?.cls ?? '', ...c, vars, css, ...(e.kind === 'qr' && e.dark !== 'auto' ? { dark: e.dark } : {}), ...(e.kind === 'qr' && e.light !== 'auto' ? { light: e.light } : {}) }); return; } // Free: a box placed in percent of the card. const c = e.show ? content(e, back, style, compact) : null; if (!c) return; const w = (e.w / 100) * size.w; const css: Record<string, string | number> = { position: 'absolute', left: Math.round(((e.x / 100) * size.w - w / 2) * 100) / 100, top: Math.round((e.y / 100) * size.h * 100) / 100, width: Math.round(w * 100) / 100, transform: `translateY(-50%)${e.rotate ? ` rotate(${e.rotate}deg)` : ''}`, zIndex: 10 + e.z, opacity: e.opacity, margin: 0, }; let font: BackNode['font']; if (e.kind !== 'qr' && e.kind !== 'logo') { const f = BACK_FONTS.find(x => x.id === e.font) ?? BACK_FONTS[0]; Object.assign(css, { fontFamily: f.css, fontSize: Math.round((e.size / 100) * size.w * 100) / 100, fontWeight: e.weight, fontStyle: e.italic ? 'italic' : 'normal', textDecoration: e.underline ? 'underline' : 'none', textTransform: e.uppercase ? 'uppercase' : 'none', letterSpacing: `${e.letterSpacing / 10}em`, lineHeight: e.lineHeight, textAlign: e.align, color: hexOr(e.color, rarity, AUTO_INK), overflowWrap: 'anywhere', }); if (f.files) font = { id: f.id, weight: e.weight }; } else { css.height = e.kind === 'qr' ? Math.round(w * 100) / 100 : 'auto'; } const fxCss = effectsCss(e.fx, rarity, size.w); if (e.kind === 'qr' || e.kind === 'logo') { delete fxCss.WebkitTextStroke; delete fxCss.paintOrder; delete fxCss.textShadow; if (e.fx.glow || e.fx.shadow || e.fx.outline) css.filter = [e.fx.outline ? `drop-shadow(0 0 1px ${e.fx.outline.color})` : '', e.fx.glow ? `drop-shadow(0 0 ${e.fx.glow.blur / 4}px ${e.fx.glow.color})` : '', e.fx.shadow ? `drop-shadow(${e.fx.shadow.x / 4}px ${e.fx.shadow.y / 4}px ${e.fx.shadow.blur / 4}px ${e.fx.shadow.color})` : ''].filter(Boolean).join(' '); } Object.assign(css, fxCss); free.push({ id: e.id, kind: e.kind, mode: 'free', tag: c.tag ?? 'p', cls: '', ...c, vars: {}, css, ...(font ? { font } : {}), ...(e.kind === 'qr' && e.dark !== 'auto' ? { dark: e.dark } : {}), ...(e.kind === 'qr' && e.light !== 'auto' ? { light: e.light } : {}), z: e.z, order }); }); free.sort((a, b) => a.z - b.z || a.order - b.order); return [...stack, ...free.map(({ z: _z, order: _o, ...n }) => { void _z; void _o; return n; })]; }

nodes.name: fontsNeeded
nodes.signature: function fontsNeeded(nodes: BackNode[]): { id: string; weight: number }[]
nodes.body_text: function fontsNeeded(nodes: BackNode[]): { id: string; weight: number }[] { const seen = new Map<string, { id: string; weight: number }>(); for (const n of nodes) if (n.font) seen.set(`${n.font.id}:${n.font.weight}`, n.font); return [...seen.values()]; }

nodes.name: card-back-patterns.ts
nodes.body_text: // The back's background patterns (ROADMAP 20.3a). Pure and client-safe: each pattern is a function from its settings to ONE small SVG covering // the whole card (viewBox 300 x 450, stretched to the plate), so the DOM uses it as a background-image data URI and the canvas and overlay // renderers (20.3c) draw the very same SVG. Nothing here is random: `grain` uses an SVG noise filter with a fixed seed and `confetti` a // seeded generator, so the server and every browser agree. `none` and `cover` draw no SVG; `lines` and `holes` at their default // settings are the classic CSS layers (see plateBackground in lib/card-back-v1.ts), so the default design is unchanged. export const PATTERN_IDS = [ 'none', 'lines', 'holes', 'cover', 'dots', 'grid', 'diagonal', 'chevron', 'waves', 'honeycomb', 'diamonds', 'crosshatch', 'stars', 'rays', 'circuit', 'confetti', 'cheese', 'grain', ] as const; export const PATTERN_LABELS: Record<PatternId, string> = { none: 'None', lines: 'Brushed lines', holes: 'Cheese holes', cover: 'Pack cover, faded', dots: 'Dots', grid: 'Grid', diagonal: 'Diagonal stripes', chevron: 'Chevrons', waves: 'Waves', honeycomb: 'Honeycomb', diamonds: 'Diamonds', crosshatch: 'Crosshatch', stars: 'Stars', rays: 'Sunburst', circuit: 'Circuit', confetti: 'Confetti', cheese: 'Cheese wedges', grain: 'Fine grain', }; export const BLENDS = ['normal', 'overlay', 'multiply', 'screen'] as const; export const DEFAULT_PATTERN: PatternSettings = { color: 'auto', opacity: 1, scale: 1, angle: 0, blend: 'normal' }; export const MAX_TILE_BYTES = 4096; /** True when any setting differs from the defaults (the classic `lines` and `holes` are only used while none does). */ // "auto" tints: [colour, alpha] const AUTO: Partial<Record<PatternId, [string, number]>> = { lines: ['#ffffff', 0.28], holes: ['#000000', 0.28], stars: ['#ffffff', 0.4], rays: ['#ffffff', 0.18], grain: ['#000000', 0.32], cheese: ['#000000', 0.2] }; const DEFAULT_AUTO: [string, number] = ['#000000', 0.18]; /** A tiny deterministic generator (mulberry32), so a pattern is the same everywhere. */ // Each pattern draws one cell of `w` x `h` units (times the scale `k`); `ink` is the fill or stroke colour. const CELLS: Partial<Record<PatternId, Draw>> = { lines: (c, k) => ({ cell: [3 * k, 3 * k], body: `<rect width="${n(k)}" height="${n(3 * k)}" fill="${c}"/>` }), holes: (c, k) => ({ cell: [28 * k, 28 * k], body: `<circle cx="${n(7 * k)}" cy="${n(7 * k)}" r="${n(5 * k)}" fill="${c}"/><circle cx="${n(21 * k)}" cy="${n(21 * k)}" r="${n(4 * k)}" fill="${c}"/>` }), dots: (c, k) => ({ cell: [16 * k, 16 * k], body: `<circle cx="${n(8 * k)}" cy="${n(8 * k)}" r="${n(2 * k)}" fill="${c}"/>` }), grid: (c, k) => ({ cell: [24 * k, 24 * k], body: `<path d="M${n(24 * k)} 0V${n(24 * k)}M0 ${n(24 * k)}H${n(24 * k)}" stroke="${c}" stroke-width="${n(k)}" fill="none"/>` }), diagonal: (c, k) => ({ cell: [14 * k, 14 * k], body: `<rect width="${n(14 * k)}" height="${n(5 * k)}" fill="${c}"/>`, }), chevron: (c, k) => ({ cell: [40 * k, 20 * k], body: `<path d="M0 ${n(14 * k)}L${n(20 * k)} ${n(4 * k)}L${n(40 * k)} ${n(14 * k)}" stroke="${c}" stroke-width="${n(3 * k)}" fill="none"/>` }), waves: (c, k) => ({ cell: [40 * k, 16 * k], body: `<path d="M0 ${n(8 * k)}Q${n(10 * k)} ${n(0)} ${n(20 * k)} ${n(8 * k)}T${n(40 * k)} ${n(8 * k)}" stroke="${c}" stroke-width="${n(2 * k)}" fill="none"/>` }), honeycomb: (c, k) => { const w = 34.64 * k, h = 60 * k, r = 20 * k; // hexagon of radius r, pointy top return { cell: [w, h], body: `<path d="${hex(w / 2, 0)}${hex(w / 2, h)}${hex(0, h / 2)}${hex(w, h / 2)}" stroke="${c}" stroke-width="${n(1.5 * k)}" fill="none"/>` }; }, diamonds: (c, k) => ({ cell: [30 * k, 30 * k], body: `<path d="M${n(15 * k)} 0L${n(30 * k)} ${n(15 * k)}L${n(15 * k)} ${n(30 * k)}L0 ${n(15 * k)}Z" stroke="${c}" stroke-width="${n(1.5 * k)}" fill="none"/><path d="M${n(15 * k)} ${n(10 * k)}L${n(20 * k)} ${n(15 * k)}L${n(15 * k)} ${n(20 * k)}L${n(10 * k)} ${n(15 * k)}Z" fill="${c}"/>` }), crosshatch: (c, k) => ({ cell: [12 * k, 12 * k], body: `<path d="M0 0L${n(12 * k)} ${n(12 * k)}M${n(12 * k)} 0L0 ${n(12 * k)}" stroke="${c}" stroke-width="${n(k)}" fill="none"/>` }), stars: (c, k) => { return { cell: [50 * k, 50 * k], body: star(12 * k, 12 * k, 6 * k) + star(37 * k, 37 * k, 4 * k) }; }, circuit: (c, k) => ({ cell: [60 * k, 60 * k], body: `<path d="M0 ${n(15 * k)}H${n(20 * k)}V${n(35 * k)}H${n(45 * k)}V${n(60 * k)}M${n(60 * k)} ${n(10 * k)}H${n(40 * k)}V${n(25 * k)}M${n(10 * k)} ${n(60 * k)}V${n(45 * k)}H${n(25 * k)}" stroke="${c}" stroke-width="${n(1.5 * k)}" fill="none"/><circle cx="${n(20 * k)}" cy="${n(15 * k)}" r="${n(2.5 * k)}" fill="${c}"/><circle cx="${n(45 * k)}" cy="${n(35 * k)}" r="${n(2.5 * k)}" fill="${c}"/><circle cx="${n(40 * k)}" cy="${n(25 * k)}" r="${n(2.5 * k)}" fill="${c}"/><circle cx="${n(10 * k)}" cy="${n(45 * k)}" r="${n(2.5 * k)}" fill="${c}"/>` }), confetti: (c, k) => { const rnd = seeded(20260617); const size = 120 * k; let body = ''; for (let i = 0; i < 18; i++) { const x = rnd() * size, y = rnd() * size, a = Math.round(rnd() * 180), s = (2 + rnd() * 3) * k; body += rnd() < 0.4 ? `<circle cx="${n(x)}" cy="${n(y)}" r="${n(s / 1.6)}" fill="${c}"/>` : `<rect x="${n(x)}" y="${n(y)}" width="${n(s * 2)}" height="${n(s * 0.7)}" fill="${c}" transform="rotate(${a} ${n(x)} ${n(y)})"/>`; } return { cell: [size, size], body }; }, cheese: (c, k) => ({ cell: [60 * k, 60 * k], body: `<path d="M${n(4 * k)} ${n(56 * k)}L${n(52 * k)} ${n(40 * k)}L${n(52 * k)} ${n(56 * k)}Z" fill="${c}"/><circle cx="${n(30 * k)}" cy="${n(50 * k)}" r="${n(2.2 * k)}" fill="#fff" fill-opacity=".5"/><circle cx="${n(42 * k)}" cy="${n(48 * k)}" r="${n(1.6 * k)}" fill="#fff" fill-opacity=".5"/><circle cx="${n(14 * k)}" cy="${n(14 * k)}" r="${n(6 * k)}" fill="${c}"/><circle cx="${n(40 * k)}" cy="${n(12 * k)}" r="${n(4 * k)}" fill="${c}"/><circle cx="${n(24 * k)}" cy="${n(30 * k)}" r="${n(3 * k)}" fill="${c}"/>` }), }; /** * The SVG for a pattern (null for `none`, `cover` and an unknown id). One SVG covers the whole card (300 x 450 units); `scale` sizes the * cells, `angle` turns the tiling. Always under MAX_TILE_BYTES. */ /** The SVG as a CSS `url(...)` value (a data URI; no quotes inside, so it is safe in a style attribute). */

nodes.name: PatternId
nodes.body_text: type PatternId = (typeof PATTERN_IDS)[number];

nodes.name: Blend
nodes.body_text: type Blend = (typeof BLENDS)[number];

nodes.name: PatternSettings
nodes.body_text: interface PatternSettings { /** A hex colour, or `auto` = today's tint for that pattern. */ color: string; opacity: number; scale: number; angle: number; blend: Blend; }

nodes.name: isCustomPattern
nodes.body_text: isCustomPattern = (s: Partial<PatternSettings>) => (s.color ?? 'auto') !== 'auto' || (s.opacity ?? 1) !== 1 || (s.scale ?? 1) !== 1 || (s.angle ?? 0) !== 0

nodes.name: n
nodes.body_text: n = (v: number) => String(Math.round(v * 100) / 100)

nodes.name: seeded
nodes.body_text: function seeded(seed: number): () => number { let a = seed >>> 0; return () => { a = (a + 0x6d2b79f5) >>> 0; let t = a; t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1); t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61); return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296; }; }

nodes.name: Draw
nodes.signature: type Draw = (ink: string, k: number) => { cell: [number, number]; body: string; stroke?: boolean; width?: number };

nodes.signature: function patternSvg(id: string, s: Partial<PatternSettings> = {}): string | null
nodes.body_text: function patternSvg(id: string, s: Partial<PatternSettings> = {}): string | null { const set = { ...DEFAULT_PATTERN, ...s }; const [autoC, autoA] = AUTO[id as PatternId] ?? DEFAULT_AUTO; const ink = set.color === 'auto' ? autoC : set.color; const alpha = Math.round((set.color === 'auto' ? autoA : 1) * Math.max(0, Math.min(1, set.opacity)) * 1000) / 1000; const k = Math.max(0.5, Math.min(3, set.scale)); const head = '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 300 450" preserveAspectRatio="none">'; const angle = ((Math.round(set.angle) % 360) + 360) % 360; if (id === 'grain') { const f = n(0.8 / k); return `${head}<filter id="g" x="0" y="0" width="100%" height="100%"><feTurbulence type="fractalNoise" baseFrequency="${f}" numOctaves="2" seed="7" stitchTiles="stitch"/><feColorMatrix values="0 0 0 0 ${n(parseInt(ink.slice(1, 3), 16) / 255)} 0 0 0 0 ${n(parseInt(ink.slice(3, 5), 16) / 255)} 0 0 0 0 ${n(parseInt(ink.slice(5, 7), 16) / 255)} 0 0 0 1.2 -0.1"/></filter><rect width="300" height="450" filter="url(#g)" opacity="${alpha}"/></svg>`; } if (id === 'rays') { const count = Math.max(8, Math.round(24 / k / 2) * 2); const R = 400, step = 360 / count; let wedges = ''; for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 2) { const a0 = (i * step * Math.PI) / 180, a1 = ((i + 1) * step * Math.PI) / 180; wedges += `M150 225L${n(150 + Math.cos(a0) * R)} ${n(225 + Math.sin(a0) * R)}L${n(150 + Math.cos(a1) * R)} ${n(225 + Math.sin(a1) * R)}Z`; } return `${head}<path d="${wedges}" fill="${ink}" fill-opacity="${alpha}" transform="rotate(${angle} 150 225)"/></svg>`; } const draw = CELLS[id as PatternId]; if (!draw) return null; const rot = id === 'diagonal' ? (angle + 45) % 360 : angle; const { cell, body } = draw(ink, k); return `${head}<defs><pattern id="p" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse" width="${n(cell[0])}" height="${n(cell[1])}"${rot ? ` patternTransform="rotate(${rot} 150 225)"` : ''}>${body}</pattern></defs><rect x="-300" y="-300" width="900" height="1050" fill="url(#p)" opacity="${alpha}"/></svg>`; }
