nodes.name: card-back-store.ts
nodes.body_text: import { kv } from './db'; import { isDefaultCardBack, resolveCardBack, sanitizeCardBack, type CardBackStyle } from './card-back'; import type { Pack } from './types'; // A pack's designed back, in its own key so the pack forms that rewrite the whole Pack never touch it. No key = the classic look. /** The stored design, or null when the pack has none (the classic plate). Never throws: a read failure falls back to the classic look. */ /** Stores a design (a design equal to the default removes the key). Returns what was stored. */ /** The design for prints of `pack` in `seasonName`, ready for `FlipBack.style` (undefined = classic). */

nodes.name: key
nodes.body_text: key = (packId: string) => `pack:${packId}:cardback`

nodes.name: getCardBack
nodes.signature: async function getCardBack(packId: string): Promise<CardBackStyle | null>
nodes.body_text: async function getCardBack(packId: string): Promise<CardBackStyle | null> { try { const raw = await kv.get<unknown>(key(packId)); return raw ? sanitizeCardBack(raw) : null; } catch { return null; } }

nodes.name: saveCardBack
nodes.signature: async function saveCardBack(packId: string, input: unknown): Promise<CardBackStyle>
nodes.body_text: async function saveCardBack(packId: string, input: unknown): Promise<CardBackStyle> { const style = sanitizeCardBack(input); if (isDefaultCardBack(style)) await kv.del(key(packId)); else await kv.set(key(packId), style); return style; }

nodes.name: deleteCardBack
nodes.body_text: async function deleteCardBack(packId: string): Promise<void> { await kv.del(key(packId)); }

nodes.name: cardBackFor
nodes.signature: async function cardBackFor(pack: Pick<Pack, 'id' | 'name' | 'coverImageUrl'>, seasonName?: string): Promise<CardBackStyle | undefined>
nodes.body_text: async function cardBackFor(pack: Pick<Pack, 'id' | 'name' | 'coverImageUrl'>, seasonName?: string): Promise<CardBackStyle | undefined> { return resolveCardBack(await getCardBack(pack.id), { packName: pack.name, seasonName, cover: pack.coverImageUrl }); }

nodes.name: card-back-v1.ts
nodes.body_text: // The 20.1 (v1) design of a print's back: one design for the whole back, controlled by a few switches. Kept as the model the 20.1 editor // edits; stored designs are v2 (lib/card-back.ts) and `upgradeCardBack` turns a v1 design into elements that render the same. // (ROADMAP 20.1 / 20.3a) Pure and client-safe: the shape, the sanitiser, the presets and the CSS the // FlipCard turns a design into. `DEFAULT_V1` is today's engraved steel plate exactly; a pack with no stored design uses it. // Stored apart from the Pack object in `pack:<id>:cardback` (see lib/card-back-store.ts), because pack forms rewrite the whole pack. export const SIZES = ['S', 'M', 'L'] as const; export const ELEMENTS = ['number', 'edition', 'name', 'date', 'origin', 'history', 'qr'] as const; export const ELEMENT_LABELS: Record<BackElement, string> = { number: 'Print number', edition: 'Edition line', name: 'Name line', date: 'Date', origin: 'Origin and holder', history: 'History', qr: 'QR code', }; export const BACKGROUNDS = ['steel', 'solid', 'gradient'] as const; import { BLENDS, DEFAULT_PATTERN, PATTERN_IDS, isCustomPattern, patternSvg, patternUrl, type Blend } from './card-back-patterns'; export const PATTERNS = PATTERN_IDS; export const FONTS = ['display', 'body', 'mono'] as const; export const ALIGNS = ['top', 'middle', 'bottom'] as const; export const LOGOS = ['none', 'cover', 'url'] as const; export const DEFAULT_V1: CardBackV1 = { background: 'steel', bg1: '#a9a9b3', bg2: '#dcdce3', angle: 135, pattern: 'lines', patternColor: 'auto', patternOpacity: 1, patternScale: 1, patternAngle: 0, patternBlend: 'normal', edge: 'rarity', text: 'auto', accent: 'auto', font: 'display', align: 'middle', logo: 'none', logoUrl: '', logoSize: 'M', line: '', show: { number: true, edition: true, name: true, date: true, origin: true, history: true, qr: true }, size: { number: 'M', edition: 'M', name: 'M', date: 'M', origin: 'M', history: 'M', qr: 'M' }, }; export const MAX_LINE = 60; const HEX = /^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/; const SHORT_HEX = /^#[0-9a-fA-F]{3}$/; /** Only http(s) and site-relative image addresses; anything else (javascript:, data:, quotes that could end a CSS url()) is dropped. */ /** Turns anything (a stored value, a form post) into a valid design: unknown keys dropped, colours and choices validated, the line capped. */ /** True when the design is today's look (nothing worth storing). */ export const PRESETS_V1: { id: string; label: string; style: CardBackV1 }[] = [ { id: 'classic', label: 'Classic', style: DEFAULT_V1 }, { id: 'clean', label: 'Clean', style: sanitizeV1({ background: 'solid', bg1: '#15151c', pattern: 'none', text: '#f3f4f6', accent: '#fbbf24', font: 'body', size: { number: 'L' }, show: { history: false } }) }, { id: 'gold', label: 'Gold foil', style: sanitizeV1({ background: 'gradient', bg1: '#b8892b', bg2: '#f1d37a', angle: 135, pattern: 'lines', edge: '#a87a1e', text: '#3c2604', accent: '#5a3a06' }) }, { id: 'art', label: 'Pack art', style: sanitizeV1({ background: 'solid', bg1: '#111118', pattern: 'cover', text: '#f9fafb', accent: '#fde68a', logo: 'cover', logoSize: 'M' }) }, ]; export const SCALE: Record<BackSize, number> = { S: 0.8, M: 1, L: 1.25 }; export const FONT_VAR: Record<CardBackV1['font'], string> = { display: 'var(--font-display, inherit)', body: 'inherit', mono: 'ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace' }; export const JUSTIFY: Record<CardBackV1['align'], string> = { top: 'flex-start', middle: 'center', bottom: 'flex-end' }; export const LOGO_PX: Record<BackSize, number> = { S: 26, M: 38, L: 54 }; /** The pattern's layers (top first): the classic CSS for `lines`, `holes` and `cover` at their default settings, otherwise the pattern's SVG. */ /** The plate's background layers (top first). For the default design this is today's brushed steel, character for character. */ /** `background-blend-mode` for the plate: the pattern layers blend with what is under them; undefined for the normal blend. */ /** The CSS custom properties a styled back sets on its plate. The default design sets none that differ from the stylesheet. */

nodes.name: BackSize
nodes.body_text: type BackSize = (typeof SIZES)[number];

nodes.name: BackElement
nodes.body_text: type BackElement = (typeof ELEMENTS)[number];

nodes.name: CardBackV1
nodes.body_text: interface CardBackV1 { /** `steel` is today's brushed metal; `solid` uses `bg1`; `gradient` runs `bg1` to `bg2` at `angle` degrees. */ background: (typeof BACKGROUNDS)[number]; bg1: string; bg2: string; angle: number; pattern: (typeof PATTERNS)[number]; /** How the pattern is drawn: a hex colour or `auto` (the pattern's own tint), opacity 0 to 1, cell scale 0.5 to 3, turn 0 to 359 degrees, blend with the background. */ patternColor: string; patternOpacity: number; patternScale: number; patternAngle: number; patternBlend: Blend; /** `rarity` = the card's rarity colour (today); otherwise a fixed #rrggbb. */ edge: string; /** `auto` = today's dark engraved ink; otherwise a fixed colour. */ text: string; /** `auto` = today's ink for the brand label and the link; otherwise a fixed colour. */ accent: string; /** The face of the big number. */ font: (typeof FONTS)[number]; align: (typeof ALIGNS)[number]; logo: (typeof LOGOS)[number]; logoUrl: string; logoSize: BackSize; /** A line of text under the name; `{pack}` and `{season}` are filled in. Empty = none. */ line: string; show: Record<BackElement, boolean>; size: Record<BackElement, BackSize>; /** Filled in when a back is built for a print, never stored: the pack's cover and the finished custom line. */ cover?: string; lineText?: string; }

nodes.name: colour
nodes.signature: function colour(v: unknown, fallback: string, allow?: string): string
nodes.body_text: function colour(v: unknown, fallback: string, allow?: string): string { if (typeof v !== 'string') return fallback; const s = v.trim(); if (allow && s === allow) return s; if (HEX.test(s)) return s.toLowerCase(); if (SHORT_HEX.test(s)) return `#${s[1]}${s[1]}${s[2]}${s[2]}${s[3]}${s[3]}`.toLowerCase(); return fallback; }

nodes.name: num
nodes.signature: num = (v: unknown, lo: number, hi: number, fb: number, mul: number)
nodes.body_text: num = (v: unknown, lo: number, hi: number, fb: number, mul: number) => { const x = typeof v === 'number' ? v : Number(v); return typeof v !== 'undefined' && v !== null && v !== '' && Number.isFinite(x) ? Math.round(Math.min(hi, Math.max(lo, x)) * mul) / mul : fb; }

nodes.name: pick
nodes.signature: pick = <T extends string>(v: unknown, all: readonly T[], fallback: T): T
nodes.body_text: pick = <T extends string>(v: unknown, all: readonly T[], fallback: T): T => (typeof v === 'string' && (all as readonly string[]).includes(v) ? (v as T) : fallback)

nodes.name: safeUrl
nodes.body_text: function safeUrl(v: unknown): string { if (typeof v !== 'string') return ''; const s = v.trim(); if (s.length > 500 || /[\s"'()\\<>]/.test(s)) return ''; return /^https:\/\//i.test(s) || /^\/(?!\/)/.test(s) ? s : ''; }

nodes.name: sanitizeV1
nodes.body_text: function sanitizeV1(input: unknown): CardBackV1 { const d = DEFAULT_V1; const o = (input && typeof input === 'object' ? input : {}) as Record<string, unknown>; const show = (o.show && typeof o.show === 'object' ? o.show : {}) as Record<string, unknown>; const size = (o.size && typeof o.size === 'object' ? o.size : {}) as Record<string, unknown>; const angle = typeof o.angle === 'number' && Number.isFinite(o.angle) ? Math.round(((o.angle % 360) + 360) % 360) : d.angle; const line = typeof o.line === 'string' ? o.line.replace(/[\r\n\t]+/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, MAX_LINE) : ''; const logo = pick(o.logo, LOGOS, d.logo); const logoUrl = safeUrl(o.logoUrl); return { background: pick(o.background, BACKGROUNDS, d.background), bg1: colour(o.bg1, d.bg1), bg2: colour(o.bg2, d.bg2), angle, pattern: o.pattern === undefined ? d.pattern : pick(o.pattern, PATTERNS, 'none'), patternColor: colour(o.patternColor, d.patternColor, 'auto'), patternOpacity: num(o.patternOpacity, 0, 1, d.patternOpacity, 100), patternScale: num(o.patternScale, 0.5, 3, d.patternScale, 100), patternAngle: Math.round(((num(o.patternAngle, -100000, 100000, d.patternAngle, 1) % 360) + 360) % 360), patternBlend: pick(o.patternBlend, BLENDS, d.patternBlend), edge: colour(o.edge, d.edge, 'rarity'), text: colour(o.text, d.text, 'auto'), accent: colour(o.accent, d.accent, 'auto'), font: pick(o.font, FONTS, d.font), align: pick(o.align, ALIGNS, d.align), logo: logo === 'url' && !logoUrl ? 'none' : logo, logoUrl, logoSize: pick(o.logoSize, SIZES, d.logoSize), line, show: Object.fromEntries(ELEMENTS.map(e => [e, typeof show[e] === 'boolean' ? show[e] : d.show[e]])) as Record<BackElement, boolean>, size: Object.fromEntries(ELEMENTS.map(e => [e, pick(size[e], SIZES, d.size[e])])) as Record<BackElement, BackSize>, }; }

nodes.name: isDefaultV1
nodes.body_text: function isDefaultV1(s: CardBackV1): boolean { const { cover: _c, lineText: _l, ...rest } = s; void _c; void _l; return JSON.stringify(rest) === JSON.stringify(sanitizeV1(DEFAULT_V1)); }

nodes.name: PatternFields
nodes.body_text: type PatternFields = Pick<CardBackV1, 'background' | 'bg1' | 'bg2' | 'angle' | 'pattern' | 'cover'> & Partial<Pick<CardBackV1, 'patternColor' | 'patternOpacity' | 'patternScale' | 'patternAngle' | 'patternBlend'>>;

nodes.name: patternLayers
nodes.body_text: function patternLayers(s: PatternFields): string[] { const set = { ...DEFAULT_PATTERN, color: s.patternColor ?? 'auto', opacity: s.patternOpacity ?? 1, scale: s.patternScale ?? 1, angle: s.patternAngle ?? 0 }; if (s.pattern === 'none') return []; if (s.pattern === 'cover') return s.cover ? ['linear-gradient(rgba(0,0,0,.55), rgba(0,0,0,.55))', `url("${s.cover}") center / cover`] : []; if (!isCustomPattern(set)) { if (s.pattern === 'lines') return ['repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,.28) 0 1px, transparent 1px 3px)']; if (s.pattern === 'holes') return ['radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, rgba(0,0,0,.28) 0 5px, transparent 6px) 0 0 / 28px 28px', 'radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, rgba(0,0,0,.2) 0 4px, transparent 5px) 14px 14px / 28px 28px']; } const svg = patternSvg(s.pattern, set); return svg ? [`${patternUrl(svg)} center / 100% 100%`] : []; }

nodes.name: plateBackground
nodes.body_text: function plateBackground(s: PatternFields): string { const layers = patternLayers(s); if (s.background === 'steel') layers.push('linear-gradient(135deg, #a9a9b3 0%, #dcdce3 36%, #9a9aa5 62%, #c4c4cd 100%)'); else if (s.background === 'solid') layers.push(`linear-gradient(${s.bg1}, ${s.bg1})`); else layers.push(`linear-gradient(${s.angle}deg, ${s.bg1}, ${s.bg2})`); return layers.join(', '); }

nodes.name: plateBlend
nodes.body_text: function plateBlend(s: PatternFields): string | undefined { const blend = s.patternBlend ?? 'normal'; const count = patternLayers(s).length; return blend === 'normal' || count === 0 ? undefined : [...Array(count).fill(blend), 'normal'].join(', '); }

nodes.name: cardBackVars
nodes.signature: function cardBackVars(s: CardBackV1, rarityHex: string): Record<string, string>
nodes.body_text: function cardBackVars(s: CardBackV1, rarityHex: string): Record<string, string> { const v: Record<string, string> = { '--edge': s.edge === 'rarity' ? rarityHex : s.edge, '--plate-bg': plateBackground(s), '--plate-justify': JUSTIFY[s.align], '--num-font': FONT_VAR[s.font], }; if (s.text !== 'auto') { v['--ink'] = s.text; v['--ink-soft'] = s.text; v['--ink-shadow'] = 'none'; } if (s.accent !== 'auto') v['--accent-ink'] = s.accent; for (const e of ELEMENTS) v[`--k-${e}`] = String(SCALE[s.size[e]]); v['--logo-px'] = `${LOGO_PX[s.logoSize]}px`; return v; }

nodes.name: card-back.ts
nodes.body_text: // The design of a print's back, per pack: the v2 model (ROADMAP 20.3a). Pure and client-safe. // // A design is a background (steel, one colour or a gradient, with a pattern and an edge) plus a list of ELEMENTS: the print number, edition, // name, date, origin and holder, history, QR code, logo, brand, the "Full history" link and up to 8 text boxes. Each element is shown or // hidden and is placed either in the STACK (today's centred column, in list order) or FREE (a box placed in percent of the card). Stored in // its own KV key `pack:<id>:cardback` (lib/card-back-store.ts) as `v: 2`. `sanitizeCardBack` accepts v1 (20.1) and v2 and always returns v2; // `upgradeCardBack` turns a v1 design into elements that render exactly as the v1 design did, and `DEFAULT_CARD_BACK` is today's steel plate. import { ALIGNS, BACKGROUNDS, DEFAULT_V1, LOGO_PX, PATTERNS, PRESETS_V1, SCALE, SIZES, JUSTIFY, plateBackground, plateBlend, sanitizeV1, type BackSize, type CardBackV1, } from './card-back-v1'; export { ALIGNS, BACKGROUNDS, PATTERNS, SIZES, type BackSize }; import type { Blend } from './card-back-patterns'; export const ELEMENT_KINDS = ['number', 'edition', 'name', 'date', 'origin', 'history', 'qr', 'logo', 'brand', 'link', 'text'] as const; export const KIND_LABELS: Record<ElementKind, string> = { number: 'Print number', edition: 'Edition line', name: 'Name line', date: 'Date', origin: 'Origin and holder', history: 'History', qr: 'QR code', logo: 'Logo', brand: 'Site name', link: 'Full history link', text: 'Text', }; export const MAX_ELEMENTS = 24; export const MAX_TEXT_BOXES = 8; export const MAX_TEXT = 80; export const MAX_BYTES = 16 * 1024; /** The curated fonts (self-hosted in /public/fonts/back, OFL). `display`, `body` and `mono` are the site's own and the system monospace. */ export const BACK_FONTS: BackFont[] = [ { id: 'display', label: 'Site display', css: 'var(--font-display, inherit)' }, { id: 'body', label: 'Site body', css: 'inherit' }, { id: 'mono', label: 'System mono', css: 'ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace' }, { id: 'fredoka', label: 'Fredoka', css: "'BackFredoka', sans-serif", files: { 400: 'fredoka-400.woff2', 700: 'fredoka-700.woff2' } }, { id: 'nunito', label: 'Nunito', css: "'BackNunito', sans-serif", files: { 400: 'nunito-400.woff2', 700: 'nunito-700.woff2' } }, { id: 'bebas', label: 'Bebas Neue', css: "'BackBebas', sans-serif", files: { 400: 'bebas-neue-400.woff2' } }, { id: 'oswald', label: 'Oswald', css: "'BackOswald', sans-serif", files: { 400: 'oswald-400.woff2', 700: 'oswald-700.woff2' } }, { id: 'orbitron', label: 'Orbitron', css: "'BackOrbitron', sans-serif", files: { 400: 'orbitron-400.woff2', 700: 'orbitron-700.woff2' } }, { id: 'playfair', label: 'Playfair Display', css: "'BackPlayfair', serif", files: { 400: 'playfair-display-400.woff2', 700: 'playfair-display-700.woff2' } }, { id: 'cinzel', label: 'Cinzel', css: "'BackCinzel', serif", files: { 400: 'cinzel-400.woff2', 700: 'cinzel-700.woff2' } }, { id: 'bangers', label: 'Bangers', css: "'BackBangers', cursive", files: { 400: 'bangers-400.woff2' } }, { id: 'pixel', label: 'Press Start 2P', css: "'BackPixel', monospace", files: { 400: 'press-start-2p-400.woff2' } }, { id: 'spacemono', label: 'Space Mono', css: "'BackSpaceMono', monospace", files: { 400: 'space-mono-400.woff2', 700: 'space-mono-700.woff2' } }, { id: 'zillaslab', label: 'Zilla Slab', css: "'BackZillaSlab', serif", files: { 400: 'zilla-slab-400.woff2', 700: 'zilla-slab-700.woff2' } }, { id: 'pacifico', label: 'Pacifico', css: "'BackPacifico', cursive", files: { 400: 'pacifico-400.woff2' } }, ]; export const FONT_IDS = BACK_FONTS.map(f => f.id); export const WEIGHTS = [400, 500, 600, 700, 800, 900] as const; export const TEXT_ALIGNS = ['left', 'center', 'right'] as const; // ── Sanitising ─────────────────────────────────────────── const HEX = /^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/; const SHORT_HEX = /^#[0-9a-fA-F]{3}$/; /** Only http(s) and site-relative image addresses; anything else (javascript:, data:, quotes that could end a CSS url()) is dropped. */ const BASE_EL: Omit<BackEl, 'id' | 'kind'> = { show: true, place: 'stack', x: 50, y: 50, w: 80, rotate: 0, z: 0, locked: false, scale: 1, size: 8, font: 'body', weight: 400, italic: false, underline: false, uppercase: false, letterSpacing: 0, lineHeight: 1.25, align: 'center', color: 'auto', opacity: 1, fx: {}, text: '', src: 'cover', url: '', px: 38, dark: 'auto', light: 'auto', }; /** Turns anything (a stored v1 or v2 value, a form post) into a valid v2 design: unknown keys, fonts and kinds dropped, every number clamped, colours hex only, at most 24 elements and 16 KB. */ // ── v1 to v2 ───────────────────────────────────────────── /** * A 20.1 design as v2 elements that render exactly as it did: all in the stack, in today's order (logo, site name, number, edition, name, * the custom line, date, origin, history, QR code, link), with the v1 switches as `show`, sizes as `scale`, the text and accent colours as * each element's colour (a custom text colour also turns the engraved shadow off, as it did), and the number's font. */ /** The 20.1 controls' view of a v2 design (what the current editor shows and edits until 20.3b replaces it). */ export const DEFAULT_CARD_BACK: CardBackStyle = upgradeCardBack(DEFAULT_V1); /** True when the design is today's look (nothing worth storing). */ export const PRESETS: { id: string; label: string; style: CardBackStyle }[] = PRESETS_V1.map(p => ({ id: p.id, label: p.label, style: upgradeCardBack(p.style) })); /** A stored design ready for prints of `packName` in `seasonName`: the cover and the names attached so text boxes can use them. */ // ── Plate-level CSS (the rest is per element, see lib/card-back-layout.ts) ── /** The CSS custom properties a styled back sets on its plate: edge colour, background and where the stack sits. */ // ── The share image's plate (a canvas drawing, so it takes values rather than CSS) ── /** What a share image's engraved plate takes from a pack's design: its metal, ink, edge and which parts are printed. */

nodes.name: ElementKind
nodes.body_text: type ElementKind = (typeof ELEMENT_KINDS)[number];

nodes.name: BackFont
nodes.body_text: interface BackFont { id: string; label: string; css: string; /** Files in /public/fonts/back by weight; absent for the site's own. */ files?: Record<number, string> }

nodes.name: fontCss
nodes.body_text: fontCss = (id: string) => (BACK_FONTS.find(f => f.id === id) ?? BACK_FONTS[0]).css

nodes.name: Effects
nodes.body_text: interface Effects { outline?: { color: string; width: number }; glow?: { color: string; blur: number; strength: number }; shadow?: { color: string; x: number; y: number; blur: number }; /** Today's pressed-into-metal look (light and dark edges). */ engrave?: boolean; gradientText?: { from: string; to: string; angle: number }; }

nodes.name: BackEl

nodes.name: isRec
nodes.signature: isRec = (v: unknown): v is Record<string, unknown>
nodes.body_text: isRec = (v: unknown): v is Record<string, unknown> => !!v && typeof v === 'object' && !Array.isArray(v)

nodes.name: clamp
nodes.signature: clamp = (v: unknown, lo: number, hi: number, fb: number)
nodes.body_text: clamp = (v: unknown, lo: number, hi: number, fb: number) => { const n = typeof v === 'number' ? v : Number(v); return Number.isFinite(n) && v !== '' && v !== null ? Math.min(hi, Math.max(lo, n)) : fb; }

nodes.name: r2
nodes.body_text: r2 = (n: number) => Math.round(n * 100) / 100

nodes.name: hex
nodes.signature: function hex(v: unknown, fb: string, ...allow: string[]): string
nodes.body_text: function hex(v: unknown, fb: string, ...allow: string[]): string { if (typeof v !== 'string') return fb; const s = v.trim(); if (allow.includes(s)) return s; if (HEX.test(s)) return s.toLowerCase(); if (SHORT_HEX.test(s)) return `#${s[1]}${s[1]}${s[2]}${s[2]}${s[3]}${s[3]}`.toLowerCase(); return fb; }

nodes.name: pick
nodes.signature: pick = <T extends string | number>(v: unknown, all: readonly T[], fb: T): T
nodes.body_text: pick = <T extends string | number>(v: unknown, all: readonly T[], fb: T): T => (all as readonly unknown[]).includes(v) ? (v as T) : fb

nodes.name: safeUrl
nodes.body_text: function safeUrl(v: unknown): string { if (typeof v !== 'string') return ''; const s = v.trim(); if (s.length > 500 || /[\s"'()\\<>]/.test(s)) return ''; return /^https:\/\//i.test(s) || /^\/(?!\/)/.test(s) ? s : ''; }

nodes.name: cleanText
nodes.body_text: cleanText = (v: unknown, max: number) => (typeof v === 'string' ? v.replace(/[\u0000-\u001f\u007f<>]/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, max) : '')

nodes.name: sanitizeFx
nodes.body_text: function sanitizeFx(v: unknown): Effects { const o = isRec(v) ? v : {}; const fx: Effects = {}; if (isRec(o.outline)) fx.outline = { color: hex(o.outline.color, '#000000'), width: r2(clamp(o.outline.width, 0, 10, 1)) }; if (isRec(o.glow)) fx.glow = { color: hex(o.glow.color, '#ffffff'), blur: r2(clamp(o.glow.blur, 0, 40, 8)), strength: r2(clamp(o.glow.strength, 0, 3, 1)) }; if (isRec(o.shadow)) fx.shadow = { color: hex(o.shadow.color, '#000000'), x: r2(clamp(o.shadow.x, -20, 20, 0)), y: r2(clamp(o.shadow.y, -20, 20, 2)), blur: r2(clamp(o.shadow.blur, 0, 30, 4)) }; if (o.engrave === true) fx.engrave = true; if (isRec(o.gradientText)) fx.gradientText = { from: hex(o.gradientText.from, '#fde68a'), to: hex(o.gradientText.to, '#f59e0b'), angle: Math.round(((clamp(o.gradientText.angle, -100000, 100000, 180) % 360) + 360) % 360) }; return fx; }

nodes.name: sanitizeEl
nodes.signature: function sanitizeEl(raw: unknown, i: number, taken: Set<string>): BackEl | null
nodes.body_text: function sanitizeEl(raw: unknown, i: number, taken: Set<string>): BackEl | null { if (!isRec(raw) || !ELEMENT_KINDS.includes(raw.kind as ElementKind)) return null; const kind = raw.kind as ElementKind; let id = typeof raw.id === 'string' && /^[a-z0-9_-]{1,24}$/i.test(raw.id) ? raw.id : `${kind}-${i}`; while (taken.has(id)) id = `${kind}-${i}-${taken.size}`; taken.add(id); const url = safeUrl(raw.url); const src = pick(raw.src, ['cover', 'url'] as const, 'cover'); return { id, kind, show: raw.show !== false, place: raw.place === 'free' ? 'cover' : src, url, px: Math.round(clamp(raw.px, 10, 120, 38)), dark: hex(raw.dark, 'auto', 'auto'), light: hex(raw.light, 'auto', 'auto'), }; }

nodes.name: patternFields
nodes.body_text: function patternFields(o: Record<string, unknown>) { const p = sanitizeV1({ pattern: 'none', patternColor: o.patternColor, patternOpacity: o.patternOpacity, patternScale: o.patternScale, patternAngle: o.patternAngle, patternBlend: o.patternBlend }); return { patternColor: p.patternColor, patternOpacity: p.patternOpacity, patternScale: p.patternScale, patternAngle: p.patternAngle, patternBlend: p.patternBlend }; }

nodes.name: sanitizeV2
nodes.body_text: function sanitizeV2(o: Record<string, unknown>): CardBackStyle { const d = DEFAULT_V1; const taken = new Set<string>(); const seenKinds = new Set<string>(); let texts = 0; const elements: BackEl[] = []; for (const [i, raw] of (Array.isArray(o.elements) ? o.elements : []).entries()) { if (elements.length >= MAX_ELEMENTS) break; const el = sanitizeEl(raw, i, taken); if (!el) continue; if (el.kind === 'text') { if (texts >= MAX_TEXT_BOXES) continue; texts++; } else if (seenKinds.has(el.kind)) continue; else seenKinds.add(el.kind); elements.push(el); } return { v: 2, background: pick(o.background, BACKGROUNDS, d.background), bg1: hex(o.bg1, d.bg1), bg2: hex(o.bg2, d.bg2), angle: Math.round(((clamp(o.angle, -100000, 100000, d.angle) % 360) + 360) % 360), pattern: o.pattern === undefined ? d.pattern : pick(o.pattern, PATTERNS, 'none'), ...patternFields(o), edge: hex(o.edge, 'rarity', 'rarity'), align: pick(o.align, ALIGNS, d.align), elements, }; }

nodes.name: sanitizeCardBack

nodes.name: nearest
nodes.body_text: nearest = (n: number): BackSize => (SIZES as readonly BackSize[]).reduce((best, s) => (Math.abs(SCALE[s] - n) < Math.abs(SCALE[best] - n) ? s : best), 'M' as BackSize)

nodes.name: toV1
nodes.body_text: function toV1(s: CardBackStyle): CardBackV1 { const find = (k: ElementKind) => s.elements.find(e => e.kind === k); const num = find('number'), brand = find('brand'), logo = find('logo'), text1 = s.elements.find(e => e.kind === 'text'); const text = num && num.color !== 'rarity' ? num.color : 'auto'; const accent = brand && brand.color !== 'rarity' && brand.color !== text ? brand.color : 'auto'; const d = DEFAULT_V1; const show = { ...d.show }, size = { ...d.size }; for (const k of ['number', 'edition', 'name', 'date', 'origin', 'history', 'qr'] as const) { const e = find(k); show[k] = e ? e.show : false; size[k] = e ? nearest(e.scale) : 'M'; } const px = logo?.px ?? 38; const logoSize = (['S', 'M', 'L'] as BackSize[]).reduce((best, k) => (Math.abs(LOGO_PX[k] - px) < Math.abs(LOGO_PX[best] - px) ? k : best), 'M' as BackSize); return sanitizeV1({ background: s.background, bg1: s.bg1, bg2: s.bg2, angle: s.angle, pattern: s.pattern, patternColor: s.patternColor, patternOpacity: s.patternOpacity, patternScale: s.patternScale, patternAngle: s.patternAngle, patternBlend: s.patternBlend, edge: s.edge, align: s.align, text, accent, font: num && ['display', 'body', 'mono'].includes(num.font) ? num.font : 'display', logo: logo && logo.show ? nodes.name: isDefaultCardBack
nodes.body_text: function isDefaultCardBack(s: CardBackStyle): boolean { const { cover: _c, packName: _p, seasonName: _s, ...rest } = s; void _c; void _p; void _s; return JSON.stringify(rest) === JSON.stringify(DEFAULT_CARD_BACK); }

nodes.name: resolveCardBack
nodes.signature: function resolveCardBack(style: CardBackStyle | null | undefined, ctx: { packName: string; seasonName?: string; cover?: string }): CardBackStyle | undefined
nodes.body_text: function resolveCardBack(style: CardBackStyle | null | undefined, ctx: { packName: string; seasonName?: string; cover?: string }): CardBackStyle | undefined { if (!style) return undefined; return { ...style, cover: safeUrl(ctx.cover) || undefined, packName: ctx.packName, seasonName: ctx.seasonName }; }

nodes.name: plateVars

nodes.body_text: function plateVars(s: CardBackStyle, rarityHex: string): Record<string, string> { const blend = plateBlend(s); return { '--edge': s.edge === 'rarity' ? rarityHex : s.edge, '--plate-bg': plateBackground(s), '--plate-justify': JUSTIFY[s.align], ...(blend ? { '--plate-blend': blend } : {}) }; }

nodes.name: rgb
nodes.body_text: rgb = (h: string): [number, number, number] => [parseInt(h.slice(1, 3), 16), parseInt(h.slice(3, 5), 16), parseInt(h.slice(5, 7), 16)]

nodes.name: hexOf
nodes.body_text: hexOf = (c: number[]) => `#${c.map(x => Math.round(x).toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('')}`

nodes.name: mix
nodes.signature: mix = (a: string, b: string, t: number)
nodes.body_text: mix = (a: string, b: string, t: number) => { const x = rgb(a), y = rgb(b); return hexOf(x.map((v, i) => v + (y[i] - v) * t)); }

nodes.name: luma
nodes.body_text: luma = (h: string) => { const [r, g, b] = rgb(h); return (0.299 * r + 0.587 * g + 0.114 * b) / 255; }

nodes.name: plateLook

nodes.body_text: function plateLook(s: CardBackStyle | undefined | null): PlateLook | undefined { if (!s) return undefined; const v1 = toV1(s); const a = v1.bg1, b = v1.background === 'gradient' ? v1.bg2 : v1.bg1; const custom = v1.background !== 'steel'; const dark = custom ? (luma(a) + luma(b)) / 2 < 0.5 : false; return { ...(custom ? { stops: [a, mix(a, b, 0.4), mix(a, b, 0.7), b] as [string, string, string, string], dark } : {}), ...(v1.text !== 'auto' ? { ink: v1.text } : {}), ...(v1.edge !== 'rarity' ? { edge: v1.edge } : {}), show: { number: v1.show.number, edition: v1.show.edition, date: v1.show.date, origin: v1.show.origin, qr: v1.show.qr }, }; }

nodes.body_text: import { readFile } from 'fs/promises'; import path from 'path'; import { isFrameSourceUrl } from './card-art'; // Server side of the still-frame picker: reads a card's art (bundled file or Blob) so sharp can cut a frame from it. const MAX_BYTES = 40 * 1024 * 1024; /** The art's bytes, or null for a URL the picker may not read or a file that can't be fetched. */

nodes.name: loadFrameSource
nodes.signature: async function loadFrameSource(url: string): Promise<Buffer | null>
nodes.body_text: async function loadFrameSource(url: string): Promise<Buffer | null> { if (!isFrameSourceUrl(url)) return null; try { if (url.startsWith('/')) { const root = path.join(process.cwd(), 'public', 'assets', 'cards'); const file = path.join(root, decodeURIComponent(url.slice('/assets/cards/'.length))); if (path.dirname(file) !== root) return null; return await readFile(file); } const res = await fetch(url, { cache: 'no-store' }); if (!res.ok) return null; const buf = Buffer.from(await res.arrayBuffer()); return buf.length <= MAX_BYTES ? buf : null; } catch { return null; } }

nodes.name: card-held.ts
nodes.body_text: // Which of a pack's card numbers some viewer already holds. Viewers' collections point at card numbers, so a number that is held // must not change: renumbering would hand every viewer's copies to whichever card carries the new number. import { getCollection, listSeasons } from './kv'; import { decodeEntry } from './variants'; /** * The card numbers of `packId` that appear in a viewer's collection, in any version, across every season that uses the pack. * (Copies sitting in an open trade offer are out of the collection while it is open, so a card held only there counts as not held.) */

nodes.name: heldCardNumbers
nodes.body_text: async function heldCardNumbers(packId: string): Promise<Set<number>> { const seasons = (await listSeasons()).filter(s => s.packIds.includes(packId)); const held = new Set<number>(); for (const s of seasons) { const collection = await getCollection(s.collectionName); for (const entries of Object.values(collection)) for (const entry of entries) held.add(decodeEntry(entry).cardNumber); } return held; }

nodes.name: card-image.ts
nodes.body_text: // Card art processing, shared by scripts/optimize-cards.mjs and the upload routes. // Server/Node only (sharp). Browser-safe URL helpers live in ./card-art.ts. import sharp from 'sharp'; export const CARD_WIDTH = 600; // animated card width; cards render well below this even on 1440p streams export const CARD_QUALITY = 75; export const THUMB_WIDTH = 260; // ~2x the largest grid tile export const THUMB_QUALITY = 80; /** Animated GIF → animated WebP (≈20 MB → ≈1–4 MB), keeping timing, looping and transparency. */ /** Static first-frame thumbnail (≈15 KB) for grids; the animated file loads on hover. */ export const COVER_WIDTH = 640; // a pack cover is drawn ~290px wide (up to 3x per pack on the overlay); 640 covers retina export const COVER_QUALITY = 82; /** Pack cover → WebP at the standard width (animated covers stay animated; transparency is kept). */ /** How many frames an image has and the average delay between them (a still image: one frame). */ /** One frame as a small static WebP, at thumbnail size by default (the size cardThumbUrl() serves). */

nodes.name: Input
nodes.body_text: type Input = Buffer | string;

nodes.name: toAnimatedCard
nodes.body_text: function toAnimatedCard(input: Input): Promise<Buffer> { return sharp(input, { animated: true }) .resize({ width: CARD_WIDTH, withoutEnlargement: true }) .webp({ quality: CARD_QUALITY, effort: 4, smartSubsample: true }) .toBuffer(); }

nodes.name: toThumb
nodes.body_text: function toThumb(input: Input): Promise<Buffer> { return sharp(input, { page: 0 }) .resize({ width: THUMB_WIDTH, withoutEnlargement: true }) .webp({ quality: THUMB_QUALITY, effort: 4 }) .toBuffer(); }

nodes.name: toCover
nodes.body_text: function toCover(input: Input): Promise<Buffer> { return sharp(input, { animated: true }) .resize({ width: COVER_WIDTH, withoutEnlargement: true }) .webp({ quality: COVER_QUALITY, effort: 5, smartSubsample: true }) .toBuffer(); }

nodes.name: frameInfo
nodes.signature: async function frameInfo(input: Input): Promise<{ frames: number; delayMs: number }>
nodes.body_text: async function frameInfo(input: Input): Promise<{ frames: number; delayMs: number }> { const m = await sharp(input, { animated: true }).metadata(); const delays = (m.delay ?? []).filter(d => d > 0); return { frames: Math.max(1, m.pages ?? 1), delayMs: delays.length > 0 ? Math.round(delays.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / delays.length) : 100 }; }

nodes.name: renderFrame
nodes.signature: function renderFrame(input: Input, frame: number, width = THUMB_WIDTH): Promise<Buffer>
nodes.body_text: function renderFrame(input: Input, frame: number, width = THUMB_WIDTH): Promise<Buffer> { return sharp(input, { page: Math.max(0, Math.floor(frame)) }) .resize({ width, withoutEnlargement: true }) .webp({ quality: THUMB_QUALITY, effort: 4 }) .toBuffer(); }

nodes.body_text: import type { Variant } from './types'; import type { VariantCounts } from './variants'; /** * Every input and intermediate number behind one card's points, so the "Advanced information" panel can show the working. * Built in computeSeasonValues (lib/leaderboard.ts) from the SAME numbers the values use, so it can't drift from them. * Plain data (no database access), so client components can import it. */ // ── A card's chance within its pack, from the weights typed (saved or not) ── // One place for the arithmetic, so the pack workspace's list, grid, card panel and Odds view always agree. /** The sum of the weights that can be drawn (negative and non-numbers count as 0). */ /** A weight's share of the pack (0 to 1; 0 when it cannot be drawn). */ /** "1 in 40", or "-" when the card can never be drawn. */

nodes.name: CardMaths
nodes.body_text: interface CardMaths { /** The scoring settings that applied. */ baseScore: number; rarityExponent: number; serialBonusMax: number; serialBonusCutoff: number; upgradeMargin: number; completionBonusPct: number; completeSetBonusPct: number; /** Pull chance = (packWeight / totalPackWeight) × (cardProbability / totalProbability). */ packWeight: number; totalPackWeight: number; cardProbability: number; totalProbability: number; pullRate: number; /** Cards in the season. */ totalCards: number; /** 1 / (pullRate × totalCards): how many times rarer than an average card, before the exponent. */ rarityBase: number; /** rarityBase ^ rarityExponent. */ rarity: number; /** Whether this card's pack has variants at all (otherwise every multiplier is 1). */ upgradesEnabled: boolean; /** Effective variant roll weights (switched-off variants are 0). */ weights: Record<Variant, number>; /** Copies needed for each upgrade step in a row (Regular→Reverse, Reverse→Full, Full→Shiny). */ costs: { reverse: number; full: number; shiny: number }; /** Variant multiplier workings: byOdds = regular weight ÷ this weight, byCost = previous multiplier × cost × margin. */ byOdds: Record<Variant, number>; byCost: Record<Variant, number>; multiplier: Record<Variant, number>; /** Season-wide: how many copies of this card exist in each version. */ copies: VariantCounts; /** base × rarity × multiplier before rounding (a copy's serial bonus comes on top), and the points after (rounded, at least 1). */ raw: Record<Variant, number>; values: Record<Variant, number>; /** What one Regular copy of every card is worth right now: the yardstick for the collection bonuses. */ setValue: number; totalCopies: number; }

nodes.name: totalWeight
nodes.body_text: totalWeight = (weights: number[]) => weights.reduce((s, w) => s + (w > 0 ? w : 0), 0)

nodes.name: shareOf
nodes.body_text: shareOf = (weight: number, total: number) => (weight > 0 && total > 0 ? weight / total : 0)

nodes.name: oneInLabel
nodes.signature: function oneInLabel(weight: number, total: number): string
nodes.body_text: function oneInLabel(weight: number, total: number): string { const s = shareOf(weight, total); return s > 0 ? `1 in ${Math.round(1 / s).toLocaleString('en-GB')}` : '-'; }

nodes.name: storeOptimizedCard
nodes.signature: async function storeOptimizedCard(gif: Buffer): Promise<{ url: string; thumbUrl: string; bytes: number }>
nodes.body_text: async function storeOptimizedCard(gif: Buffer): Promise<{ url: string; thumbUrl: string; bytes: number }> { const [full, thumb] = await Promise.all([toAnimatedCard(gif), toThumb(gif)]); const paths = optimizedCardPaths(crypto.randomUUID()); const opts = { access: 'public', addRandomSuffix: false, contentType: 'image/webp', cacheControlMaxAge: 31536000 } as const; const [fullBlob, thumbBlob] = await Promise.all([put(paths.full, full, opts), put(paths.thumb, thumb, opts)]); return { url: fullBlob.url, thumbUrl: thumbBlob.url, bytes: full.length }; }

nodes.name: deleteBlobQuietly
nodes.body_text: async function deleteBlobQuietly(url: string): Promise<void> { try { await del(url); } catch { /* an orphaned temp blob is harmless */ } }

nodes.name: storeStill

nodes.body_text: async function storeStill(webp: Buffer, frame: number): Promise<string> { const blob = await put(stillBlobPath(crypto.randomUUID(), frame), webp, { access: 'public', addRandomSuffix: false, contentType: 'image/webp', cacheControlMaxAge: 31536000 }); return blob.url; }

nodes.body_text: // "What's new" for players. Entries come from two places: the `## Changelog` section of every merged PR, collected at build time by // scripts/build-changelog.mjs into .next-changelog.json (ROADMAP 21.1), and the hand-written history below, from before that shipped. // New changes are NOT added here: fill the PR's Changelog section instead. Write for players, not developers: say what they can now do, // say "print" for a card copy, no em dashes, and never name a tool or author. import generated from '../.next-changelog.json'; const HAND_WRITTEN: ChangelogEntry[] = [ { date: '2026-10-17', title: 'Chat commands', tags: ['new'], items: [ 'Type !stats and a card name in chat to see how rare it is, how many prints were made and how many collectors have it.', 'Type !showoff to put one of your cards on stream, as before. The FAQ lists every chat command that is switched on.', ], }, { date: '2026-10-17', title: 'Card backs with their own look', tags: ['new'], items: [ 'Each pack can now have its own design for the back of a print: its own colours, pattern, logo and a custom line of text, with the print number and the rest in the size and place the pack wants.', 'You see it when you flip a print on its page, in your collection and binder, on the home page and in the share picture of a print. Packs without a new design look the same as before.', ], }, { date: '2026-10-17', title: 'Report a collector', tags: ['new'], items: [ 'You can now report another collector from their profile: press Share, then Report. Choose a reason, add details and an optional link to a trade or print.', 'Only staff see reports, and the person you report is never told it was you. You get a notice when staff have looked at it.', ], }, { date: '2026-10-16', title: 'Staff badges', tags: ['new'], items: [ 'The streamer, admins and mods now have a purple Streamer, Admin or Mod badge next to their name on their profile, on the leaderboard and on trades, so you know who you are dealing with.', 'Staff who also play as a normal collector can hide their badge in Settings.', ], }, { date: '2026-10-16', title: 'Alpha and beta notice', tags: ['new'], items: [ 'While the Cheesy TCG is in alpha or beta, a thin notice sits at the top of every page and the logo shows an ALPHA or BETA tag. The notice has a Report a problem link and can be closed for the rest of your visit.', ], }, { date: '2026-10-16', title: 'Closed alpha and beta testing', tags: ['new'], items: [ 'While the Cheesy TCG is being tested, the website can be limited to invited testers. If you are not on the list yet you will see a "closed" page; log in with Twitch and ask in the Discord to be added. Privacy and Terms stay open, and the Twitch panel keeps working.', 'Testers earn a permanent Alpha tester or Beta tester achievement, shown first on their profile.', ], }, { date: '2026-10-16', title: 'Open your most valuable prints', tags: ['improved'], items: ['Each row in Most valuable prints, on My Stats and on profiles, now opens that print. A row that groups several prints of a card opens the card in the card dex.'], }, { date: '2026-10-16', title: 'A wider "live now" banner on the home page', tags: ['improved'], items: ['When Cheesygidds is streaming, the live banner now spans the top of the home page with the stream title, viewer count and a Watch on Twitch button.'], }, { date: '2026-10-16', title: 'The app icon only shows where it helps', tags: ['improved'], items: ['The install icon in the top bar now only appears on phones and tablets. On a computer you can still find the install guide in the footer and the site menu.'], }, { date: '2026-10-16', title: 'The cheese is back in your browser tab', tags: ['fixed'], items: ['The site icon shows in the browser tab and in bookmarks again.'], }, { date: '2026-10-16', title: 'Little "i" buttons explain the terms', tags: ['new'], items: [ 'Tap or hover the new "i" next to a term such as Progress bonus, Edition, Print number, Pull chance or the trade fairness label to see a short explanation.', 'You will find them on your stats, profiles, the leaderboard, the card dex, print pages and the trade screen. Each one links to the full answer in the FAQ.', ], }, { date: '2026-10-16', title: 'Send feedback, and delete your account yourself', tags: ['new'], items: [ 'The new Feedback page lets you suggest something or report a problem. If we answer, you get a notice in the bell.', 'Find it in the footer, the bell menu and the FAQ, and on the error page as Report this.', 'At the bottom of Settings, Request deletion asks the team to delete your account and data. You can cancel the request until it is handled.', ], }, { date: '2026-10-16', title: 'Print of the week, wanted counts and a weekly digest', tags: ['new'], items: [ 'The home page now features a Print of the week: one standout print, picked each week.', 'Trade listings show how many collectors want that card, so you can spot the popular ones.', 'When you make an offer you can choose exactly which print of a card to trade.', 'The Discord server gets a weekly digest of the best of the week.', ], }, { date: '2026-10-16', title: 'Alerts you will not miss', tags: ['new', 'improved'], items: [ 'Notices arrive within seconds and the bell is hard to miss.', 'There is a full Notifications page with everything you have been sent.', 'Turn on phone and desktop alerts in Settings to hear about trades even when the site is closed.', ], }, { date: '2026-10-16', title: 'Every card copy is a print', tags: ['improved'], items: [ 'A single card you own is now called a print, with its own print number.', 'Recent pulls and the activity feeds open the exact print that was pulled.', 'Your profile’s Recent pulls lists your latest pulls with the edition and print number.', 'The card dialog shows the prints first, then the details of one print.', 'Every offer now has its own trade page you can share.', ], }, { date: '2026-10-16', title: 'Stream and Discord extras', tags: ['new'], items: [ 'A recap of the stream is posted to Discord when it ends.', 'New trade listings are posted to a Discord channel with a link to the trade.', 'The overlay can show the print number on a reveal.', ], }, { date: '2026-10-15', title: 'A polish pass across the site', tags: ['improved', 'fixed'], items: [ 'Accepting, taking, declining and cancelling a trade now needs a second tap, so a stray tap cannot do it.', 'Upgrading a print on My stats also asks for a second tap.', 'Private profiles hide their page, and unknown cards and prints show a proper not-found page.', 'Fixes for phone layouts, keyboard use and screen readers on most pages.', 'The home screen icon on iPhone is fixed, and your rarest cards animate when you hover over them.', ], }, ]; const GENERATED = generated as ChangelogEntry[]; /** The public What's new: generated player entries first (newest first), then the hand-written history. Staff-only entries never appear. */ export const CHANGELOG: ChangelogEntry[] = [...GENERATED.filter(e => e.audience !== 'staff'), ...HAND_WRITTEN]; /** The staff What's new (admin and mod panels): entries for staff, and those marked for both. */ export const STAFF_CHANGELOG: ChangelogEntry[] = GENERATED.filter(e => e.audience === 'staff' || e.audience === 'both'); /** The date of the newest entry (empty when there are none). */ /** Whether the viewer has something new to read: their last seen date is missing or older than the newest entry. */ export const CHANGELOG_SEEN_KEY = 'tcg_changelog_seen';

nodes.name: ChangeTag
nodes.body_text: type ChangeTag = 'new' | 'improved' | 'fixed';

nodes.name: ChangelogEntry
nodes.body_text: interface ChangelogEntry { /** YYYY-MM-DD. */ date: string; title: string; items: string[]; tags?: ChangeTag[]; /** The pull request the entry was built from (generated entries only). */ pr?: number; /** Who it is for, from the PR's "Audience:" line: absent = players, `staff` = the staff What's new page only, `both` = both pages. */ audience?: 'staff' | 'both'; }

nodes.name: newestChangelogDate
nodes.body_text: function newestChangelogDate(entries: ChangelogEntry[] = CHANGELOG): string { return entries.reduce((max, e) => (e.date > max ? e.date : max), ''); }

nodes.name: hasUnseenChanges
nodes.signature: function hasUnseenChanges(seen: string | null | undefined, newest: string = newestChangelogDate()): boolean
nodes.body_text: function hasUnseenChanges(seen: string | null | undefined, newest: string = newestChangelogDate()): boolean { return !!newest && (!seen || seen < newest); }

nodes.name: collection-view.ts
nodes.body_text: import { VARIANTS, type VariantCounts } from './variants'; import type { Variant } from './types'; // Filtering, sorting and per-pack progress for the profile's Collection tab (pure, client-safe). export const DEFAULT_VIEW: ViewState = { show: 'default', q: '', stars: 0, pack: '', sort: 'number', dir: 1 }; export const SHOW_LABELS: Record<ShowFilter, string> = { default: 'Collected', all: 'Everything', owned: 'Collected', missing: 'Still missing', dupes: 'Duplicates (2+ prints)', versions: 'Special versions', theyHave: 'They have, I lack', iHave: 'I have, they lack', shared: 'We both have', }; export const SORT_LABELS: Record<SortKey, string> = { number: 'Card number', rarity: 'Rarity', value: 'Points', copies: 'Prints', name: 'Name' }; /** Which cards show, in which order: indexes into `cards`. `mine` = the signed-in viewer's copies per card number (only when comparing). */ /** Owned / total per pack, in order of first appearance. */ /** How two collections relate, by card (variants ignored). */ /** How the card dialog lays out a card's prints: grouped by version, edition ascending, capped at `limit` tiles (pass Infinity for "Show all"). Pure. */ /** The holder's best print of one card in one version: the lowest edition number (the biggest edition bonus). */ /** The rarest prints a collector holds: one per card and version (their lowest edition of it), rarest first by `chance` (the odds of pulling * that card in that version), ties to the lower edition number, then the lower card number. Prints with no known chance are left out. */

nodes.name: ShowFilter
nodes.body_text: type ShowFilter = 'default' | 'all' | 'owned' | 'missing' | 'dupes' | 'versions' | 'theyHave' | 'iHave' | 'shared';

nodes.name: SortKey
nodes.body_text: type SortKey = 'number' | 'rarity' | 'value' | 'copies' | 'name';

nodes.name: ViewCard
nodes.body_text: interface ViewCard { number: number; name: string; stars: number; packName: string; counts: VariantCounts; values: Record<Variant, number>; /** Points the viewer's low serial numbers add to this card (see lib/leaderboard.ts). */ serial?: { points: number }; }

nodes.name: ViewState
nodes.body_text: interface ViewState { show: ShowFilter; q: string; stars: number; pack: string; sort: SortKey; dir: 1 | -1 }

nodes.name: copiesOf
nodes.body_text: copiesOf = (c: VariantCounts) => VARIANTS.reduce((s, v) => s + c[v], 0)

nodes.name: pointsOf
nodes.body_text: pointsOf = (c: ViewCard) => VARIANTS.reduce((s, v) => s + c.counts[v] * c.values[v], 0) + (c.serial?.points ?? 0)

nodes.name: applyView
nodes.signature: function applyView(cards: ViewCard[], view: ViewState, opts: { hideUncollected: boolean; mine?: Record<number, number> }): number[]
nodes.body_text: function applyView(cards: ViewCard[], view: ViewState, opts: { hideUncollected: boolean; mine?: Record<number, number> }): number[] { const q = view.q.trim().toLowerCase(); const mine = opts.mine ?? {}; const keep = (c: ViewCard): boolean => { const n = copiesOf(c.counts); if (view.stars && c.stars !== view.stars) return false; if (view.pack && c.packName !== view.pack) return false; if (q && !(c.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) || String(c.number) === q.replace('#', ''))) return false; const m = mine[c.number] ?? 0; switch (view.show) { case 'default': return opts.hideUncollected ? n > 0 : true; case 'all': return true; case 'owned': return n > 0; case 'missing': return n === 0; case 'dupes': return n > 1; case 'versions': return VARIANTS.some(v => v !== 'regular' && c.counts[v] > 0); case 'theyHave': return n > 0 && m === 0; case 'iHave': return m > 0 && n === 0; case 'shared': return n > 0 && m > 0; } }; const idx = cards.map((_, i) => i).filter(i => keep(cards[i])); const key = (c: ViewCard): number | string => { switch (view.sort) { case 'rarity': return c.stars; case 'value': return pointsOf(c); case 'copies': return copiesOf(c.counts); case 'name': return c.name.toLowerCase(); default: return c.number; } }; // Descending is the natural direction for rarity / points / copies. const nat: 1 | -1 = view.sort === 'rarity' || view.sort === 'value' || view.sort === 'copies' ? -1 : 1; const sign = nat * view.dir; return idx.sort((a, b) => { const ka = key(cards[a]), kb = key(cards[b]); const cmp = ka < kb ? -1 : ka > kb ? 1 : 0; return cmp !== 0 ? cmp * sign : cards[a].number - cards[b].number; }); }

nodes.name: keep
nodes.body_text: keep = (c: ViewCard): boolean => { const n = copiesOf(c.counts); if (view.stars && c.stars !== view.stars) return false; if (view.pack && c.packName !== view.pack) return false; if (q && !(c.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) || String(c.number) === q.replace('#', ''))) return false; const m = mine[c.number] ?? 0; switch (view.show) { case 'default': return opts.hideUncollected ? n > 0 : true; case 'all': return true; case 'owned': return n > 0; case 'missing': return n === 0; case 'dupes': return n > 1; case 'versions': return VARIANTS.some(v => v !== 'regular' && c.counts[v] > 0); case 'theyHave': return n > 0 && m === 0; case 'iHave': return m > 0 && n === 0; case 'shared': return n > 0 && m > 0; } }

nodes.name: key
nodes.body_text: key = (c: ViewCard): number | string => { switch (view.sort) { case 'rarity': return c.stars; case 'value': return pointsOf(c); case 'copies': return copiesOf(c.counts); case 'name': return c.name.toLowerCase(); default: return c.number; } }

nodes.name: PackProgress
nodes.body_text: interface PackProgress { pack: string; owned: number; total: number; pct: number }

nodes.name: packProgress
nodes.body_text: function packProgress(cards: ViewCard[]): PackProgress[] { const map = new Map<string, { owned: number; total: number }>(); for (const c of cards) { const p = map.get(c.packName) ?? { owned: 0, total: 0 }; p.total++; if (copiesOf(c.counts) > 0) p.owned++; map.set(c.packName, p); } return [...map.entries()].map(([pack, p]) => ({ pack, ...p, pct: p.total ? Math.round((p.owned / p.total) * 100) : 0 })); }

nodes.name: Comparison
nodes.body_text: interface Comparison { shared: number; theyHave: number; iHave: number; both: number; total: number }

nodes.name: compareCollections
nodes.signature: function compareCollections(cards: ViewCard[], mine: Record<number, number>): Comparison
nodes.body_text: function compareCollections(cards: ViewCard[], mine: Record<number, number>): Comparison { let shared = 0, theyHave = 0, iHave = 0; for (const c of cards) { const t = copiesOf(c.counts) > 0, m = (mine[c.number] ?? 0) > 0; if (t && m) shared++; else if (t) theyHave++; else if (m) iHave++; } return { shared, theyHave, iHave, both: shared + theyHave + iHave, total: cards.length }; }

nodes.name: DialogGroup
nodes.body_text: interface DialogGroup<T> { variant: Variant; /** How many prints of this version are owned. */ count: number; /** The tiles to show: edition ascending (newest edition last). Empty when the season's prints are not tracked. */ copies: T[] }

nodes.name: DialogCopies
nodes.body_text: interface DialogCopies<T> { /** Whether the season tracks individual prints (otherwise one tile per version with its count). */ tracked: boolean; /** Versions in Regular, RH, FA, SH order; owned ones only. */ groups: DialogGroup<T>[]; /** Prints owned in all. */ total: number; /** Tiles shown after the cap, and how many were left out. */ shown: number; more: number; /** The one print when the card has exactly one tracked print: the dialog opens straight on it. */ only: T | null; }

nodes.name: copiesForDialog
nodes.signature: function copiesForDialog<T extends { variant: Variant; n: number }>(copies: T[] | undefined, counts: VariantCounts, limit = 60): DialogCopies<T>
nodes.body_text: function copiesForDialog<T extends { variant: Variant; n: number }>(copies: T[] | undefined, counts: VariantCounts, limit = 60): DialogCopies<T> { const list = copies ?? []; if (list.length === 0) { const groups = VARIANTS.filter(v => counts[v] > 0).map(v => ({ variant: v, count: counts[v], copies: [] as T[] })); const total = copiesOf(counts); return { tracked: false, groups, total, shown: groups.length, more: 0, only: null }; } let left = Math.max(0, limit); let shown = 0; const groups: DialogGroup<T>[] = []; for (const v of VARIANTS) { const all = list.filter(c => c.variant === v).sort((a, b) => a.n - b.n); if (all.length === 0) continue; const take = all.slice(0, left); if (take.length === 0) continue; // cut off by the cap: shown under "Show all" left -= take.length; shown += take.length; groups.push({ variant: v, count: all.length, copies: take }); } return { tracked: true, groups, total: list.length, shown, more: list.length - shown, only: list.length === 1 ? list[0] : null }; }

nodes.name: PrintLike
nodes.body_text: interface PrintLike { id: string; card: number; variant: Variant; n: number }

nodes.name: bestPrintOf
nodes.signature: function bestPrintOf<T extends PrintLike>(copies: T[], card: number, variant: Variant): T | undefined
nodes.body_text: function bestPrintOf<T extends PrintLike>(copies: T[], card: number, variant: Variant): T | undefined { let best: T | undefined; for (const c of copies) if (c.card === card && c.variant === variant && (!best || c.n < best.n)) best = c; return best; }

nodes.name: rarestPrints
nodes.signature: function rarestPrints<T extends PrintLike>(copies: T[], chance: (card: number, variant: Variant) => number, limit = 5): (T & { chance: number })[]
nodes.body_text: function rarestPrints<T extends PrintLike>(copies: T[], chance: (card: number, variant: Variant) => number, limit = 5): (T & { chance: number })[] { const best = new Map<string, T>(); for (const c of copies) { const k = `${c.card}.${c.variant}`; const cur = best.get(k); if (!cur || c.n < cur.n) best.set(k, c); } return [...best.values()] .map(c => ({ ...c, chance: chance(c.card, c.variant) })) .filter(c => c.chance > 0) .sort((a, b) => a.chance - b.chance || a.n - b.n || a.card - b.card) .slice(0, limit); }

nodes.name: collection.ts
nodes.body_text: import { decodeEntry } from './variants'; /** * Pull count per card number, across all variants. The stored collection array keeps duplicates (one entry * per pull); variant entries are decoded back to their card number so a card is one card regardless of variant. */ /** Number of distinct cards owned, what completion % should be based on (duplicates and variants don't count). */

nodes.name: countPulls
nodes.body_text: function countPulls(owned: number[]): Map<number, number> { const counts = new Map<number, number>(); for (const entry of owned) { const { cardNumber } = decodeEntry(entry); counts.set(cardNumber, (counts.get(cardNumber) ?? 0) + 1); } return counts; }

nodes.name: uniqueCount
nodes.body_text: function uniqueCount(owned: number[]): number { return new Set(owned.map(e => decodeEntry(e).cardNumber)).size; }

nodes.name: commands-core.ts
nodes.body_text: // Chat commands for Mix It Up (ROADMAP 19.2), the pure part (client-safe, no database): the command shape, the action registry with // each action's variables and sample values, matching a typed command to a configured one, and building the reply text. export const MAX_COMMANDS = 30; export const REPLY_MAX = 400; export const COOLDOWN_MAX_S = 3600; export const COMMAND_ACTIONS: Record<CommandActionId, ActionInfo> = { showoff: { label: 'Show off a card', description: "Puts one of the viewer's own cards on stream (the overlay show-off). Args: a card name or number, optionally with a version.", vars: [v('username', 'cheesefan'), v('cardName', 'Gouda Goat'), v('variant', 'Shiny'), v('edition', '#12', 'Edition number, empty when the copy has none'), v('printNumber', '#1023381', 'Unique print number'), v('points', '480'), v('stars', '4')], errors: ['notFound', 'notOwned', 'cooldown', 'offline'], }, 'card-stats': { label: 'Card stats', description: 'Public facts about one card of the running season. Args: a card name or number.', vars: [v('cardName', 'Gouda Goat'), v('number', '12'), v('stars', '4'), v('rarity', 'Epic'), v('pullChance', '1 in 40'), v('printsMade', '57'), v('collectors', '31'), v('topHolder', 'cheesefan', 'Private collectors show as "a private collector"'), v('firstPulledBy', 'brielover'), v('points', '120', 'One Regular print'), v('yourPrints', '2'), v('url', 'https://cheesytcg.app/cards?card=12', 'The card dex link')], errors: ['notFound', 'cooldown', 'offline'], }, 'my-stats': { label: 'My stats', description: "The viewer's own standing, or @someone's when given in the args. Private collectors keep their stats private.", vars: [v('rank', '7'), v('score', '5230'), v('cards', '18'), v('totalCards', '25'), v('prints', '41'), v('progressBonus', '310'), v('bestEdition', 'Gouda Goat #3'), v('rarestPrint', 'Gouda Goat'), v('profileUrl', 'https://cheesytcg.app/u/cheesefan')], errors: ['notFound', 'cooldown', 'offline'], }, collection: { label: 'Show collection', description: "Shows the viewer's collection on the overlay.", vars: [v('cards', '18'), v('prints', '41')], errors: ['cooldown', 'offline'], }, leaderboard: { label: 'Leaderboard', description: 'The top three collectors.', vars: [v('first', 'cheesefan (5230)'), v('second', 'brielover (4100)'), v('third', 'goatgirl (3900)')], errors: ['notFound', 'cooldown', 'offline'], }, 'pulls-left': { label: 'Pulls left', description: 'With paid pulls on: what is left this stream and the price.', vars: [v('left', '2'), v('limit', '3'), v('price', '100'), v('currency', 'Brie Bucks')], errors: ['notFound', 'cooldown', 'offline'], }, text: { label: 'Fixed text', description: 'Just answers with the reply text.', vars: [v('username', 'cheesefan'), v('args', 'hello')], errors: ['cooldown', 'offline'], }, }; /** What a viewer reads in the FAQ about each action (the FAQ lists the enabled commands, so it cannot drift). */ export const FAQ_LINES: Record<CommandActionId, string> = { showoff: 'shows one of your cards on stream. Add a card name or number, and a version if you like.', 'card-stats': 'tells you about a card: how rare it is, how many prints were made and how many collectors have it. Add a card name or number.', 'my-stats': 'tells you your rank, score and progress. Add @someone to look at another collector.', collection: 'shows your collection on stream.', leaderboard: 'names the top three collectors.', 'pulls-left': 'tells you how many paid pulls you have left this stream.', text: 'answers with a short message.', }; export const ACTION_IDS = Object.keys(COMMAND_ACTIONS) as CommandActionId[]; export const ERROR_LABELS: Record<ErrorKind, string> = { notFound: 'Not found', notOwned: 'Not theirs', cooldown: 'On cooldown', offline: 'Stream offline', }; export const ERROR_DEFAULTS: Record<ErrorKind, string> = { notFound: 'I could not find that.', notOwned: 'You do not have that yet.', cooldown: 'Easy there, try again in a few seconds.', offline: 'That only works while the stream is live.', }; export const DEFAULT_COMMANDS: ChatCommand[] = [ { id: 'showoff', name: 'showoff', aliases: [], enabled: true, action: 'showoff', reply: 'Showing off your {variant} {cardName} {edition}!', errors: {}, cooldownS: 0, userCooldownS: 0, liveOnly: false }, { id: 'stats', name: 'stats', aliases: [], enabled: true, action: 'card-stats', reply: '{cardName}: {stars} stars, {pullChance}, {printsMade} prints made, {collectors} collectors. {url}', errors: {}, cooldownS: 5, userCooldownS: 0, liveOnly: false }, ]; /** Replaces {name} with its value; unknown placeholders are dropped. */ /** Chat-ready: no Markdown marks, spaces tidied, at most REPLY_MAX characters. */ /** The word a viewer typed, without "!" and in lower case. */ /** The enabled command whose name or an alias is this word. */ /** Cleans whatever came from the builder form or KV. Names and aliases stay unique across commands. */ /** Flattens the variables next to ok/message, so Mix It Up's "JSON to special identifiers" can read each one. */ /** The args typed after the command, from whichever field the bot used. */

nodes.name: CommandActionId
nodes.body_text: type CommandActionId = 'showoff' | 'card-stats' | 'my-stats' | 'collection' | 'leaderboard' | 'pulls-left' | 'text';

nodes.name: ErrorKind
nodes.body_text: type ErrorKind = 'notFound' | 'notOwned' | 'cooldown' | 'offline';

nodes.name: ChatCommand
nodes.body_text: interface ChatCommand { id: string; /** Without the "!". */ name: string; aliases: string[]; enabled: boolean; action: CommandActionId; /** The reply template: {variables} of the action. */ reply: string; errors: Partial<Record<ErrorKind, string>>; /** One run per this many seconds for everyone (0 = none). */ cooldownS: number; /** One run per viewer per this many seconds (0 = none). */ userCooldownS: number; liveOnly: boolean; }

nodes.name: ActionInfo
nodes.body_text: interface ActionInfo { label: string; description: string; /** The variables the reply can use, with a sample value for the preview. */ vars: { name: string; sample: string; help: string }[]; /** Which error texts the command can show. */ errors: ErrorKind[]; }

nodes.name: v
nodes.body_text: v = (name: string, sample: string, help = '') => ({ name, sample, help })

nodes.name: interpolate
nodes.signature: function interpolate(template: string, vars: Record<string, string>): string
nodes.body_text: function interpolate(template: string, vars: Record<string, string>): string { return template.replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (_, k) => vars[k] ?? ''); }

nodes.name: tidyReply
nodes.body_text: function tidyReply(text: string): string { const t = text.replace(/[*`~]/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').replace(/\s+([.,!?])/g, '$1').trim(); return t.length > REPLY_MAX ? `${t.slice(0, REPLY_MAX - 1).trimEnd()}…` : t; }

nodes.name: renderReply
nodes.body_text: renderReply = (template: string, vars: Record<string, string>) => tidyReply(interpolate(template, vars))

nodes.name: sampleVars
nodes.body_text: function sampleVars(action: CommandActionId): Record<string, string> { return Object.fromEntries(COMMAND_ACTIONS[action].vars.map(x => [x.name, x.sample])); }

nodes.name: commandWord
nodes.body_text: commandWord = (raw: unknown): string => (typeof raw === 'string' ? raw.trim().replace(/^!+/, '').split(/\s+/)[0]?.toLowerCase() ?? '' : '')

nodes.name: matchCommand
nodes.signature: function matchCommand(commands: ChatCommand[], raw: unknown): ChatCommand | null
nodes.body_text: function matchCommand(commands: ChatCommand[], raw: unknown): ChatCommand | null { const w = commandWord(raw); if (!w) return null; return commands.find(c => c.enabled && (c.name === w || c.aliases.includes(w))) ?? null; }

nodes.name: clampInt
nodes.body_text: clampInt = (x: unknown, max: number): number => { const n = Math.floor(Number(x)); return Number.isFinite(n) ? Math.min(max, Math.max(0, n)) : 0; }

nodes.name: word
nodes.body_text: word = (x: unknown): string => String(x ?? '').trim().replace(/^!+/, '').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9_-]/g, '').slice(0, 24)

nodes.name: cleanCommands
nodes.signature: function cleanCommands(raw: unknown): { ok: true; commands: ChatCommand[] } | { ok: false; message: string }
nodes.body_text: function cleanCommands(raw: unknown): { ok: true; commands: ChatCommand[] } | { ok: false; message: string } { const list = Array.isArray(raw) ? raw : []; if (list.length > MAX_COMMANDS) return { ok: false, message: `At most ${MAX_COMMANDS} commands.` }; const used = new Set<string>(); const ids = new Set<string>(); const out: ChatCommand[] = []; for (const r of list as Record<string, unknown>[]) { const name = word(r?.name); if (!name) return { ok: false, message: 'Every command needs a name (letters, numbers, - and _).' }; const aliases = (Array.isArray(r.aliases) ? r.aliases : String(r.aliases ?? '').split(/[,\s]+/)).map(word).filter(Boolean); const words = [name, ...new Set(aliases.filter(a => a !== name))]; const clash = words.find(w => used.has(w)); if (clash) return { ok: false, message: `"!${clash}" is used by two commands.` }; words.forEach(w => used.add(w)); const action = ACTION_IDS.includes(r.action as CommandActionId) ? (r.action as CommandActionId) : 'text'; const errs = (r.errors ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>; const errors: ChatCommand['errors'] = {}; for (const k of COMMAND_ACTIONS[action].errors) { const t = tidyReply(String(errs[k] ?? '')); if (t) errors[k] = t; } let id = typeof r.id === 'string' && /^[a-z0-9-]{1,40}$/.test(r.id) ? r.id : name; while (ids.has(id)) id = `${id}-2`; ids.add(id); out.push({ id, name, aliases: words.slice(1), enabled: r.enabled !== false, action, reply: String(r.reply ?? '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, REPLY_MAX * 2), errors, cooldownS: clampInt(r.cooldownS, COOLDOWN_MAX_S), userCooldownS: clampInt(r.userCooldownS, COOLDOWN_MAX_S), liveOnly: r.liveOnly === true, }); } return { ok: true, commands: out }; }

nodes.name: flatReply
nodes.signature: function flatReply(ok: boolean, message: string, vars: Record<string, string>): Record<string, unknown>
nodes.body_text: function flatReply(ok: boolean, message: string, vars: Record<string, string>): Record<string, unknown> { const reserved = new Set(['ok', 'message', 'vars']); return { ...Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(vars).filter(([k]) => !reserved.has(k))), ok, message, vars }; }

nodes.name: argsFrom
nodes.body_text: function argsFrom(body: Record<string, unknown>): string { for (const k of ['args', 'allargs', 'arguments']) if (typeof body[k] === 'string') return (body[k] as string).trim().slice(0, 120); return ''; }

nodes.body_text: import { kv, inSandbox } from './db'; import { getActiveSeasonWithPacks, getCollection } from './kv'; import { getHiddenUsers } from './user-admin'; import { getSeasonOverview } from './site-data'; import { ownersByCard } from './site-data'; import { collectionBonuses, copyPoints, pointsFor } from './leaderboard'; import { countVariants, decodeEntry, VARIANTS, VARIANT_LABELS } from './variants'; import { resolveCard, type ShowCard } from './showoff'; import { prepareShowOff } from './showoff-prepare'; import { getOwnerCopies, mintedCounts, pageCopies } from './serials'; import { getRarity } from './rarity'; import { enqueueEvent } from './webhooks'; import { recordActivity } from './activity'; import { liveGate } from './overlay-settings'; import { getLiveStatus } from './twitch-live'; import { getMixItUpSettings, pullsUsedThisStream, type MixItUpLogEntry } from './mixitup'; import { getUserPullLimit } from './pull-limit'; import { effectiveLimit } from './pull-limit-core'; import { SITE_URL } from './site'; import { profileHref } from './profile-url'; import { DEFAULT_COMMANDS, ERROR_DEFAULTS, cleanCommands, interpolate, matchCommand, renderReply, tidyReply, type ChatCommand, type ErrorKind, } from './commands-core'; // Chat commands (ROADMAP 19.2): the configured commands in KV and the code that runs one. The webhook (`/api/webhooks/command`) and the // builder's Try it box both call runCommand; Try it passes `dry`, which checks everything but queues no overlay event and spends no cooldown. const KEY = 'mixitup:commands'; const STATS_KEY = 'mixitup:cmdstats'; const LOG_KEY = 'mixitup:cmdlog'; /** The saved commands; the two defaults (!showoff and !stats) are created the first time anything asks. */ /** The last 20 command runs, as Log rows. */ const NO_SEASON = 'There is no season running right now.'; const KIND_OF: Record<string, ErrorKind | undefined> = { none: 'notFound', ambiguous: 'notFound', 'nothing-to-show': 'notFound', 'not-owned': 'notOwned', cooldown: 'cooldown' }; const PRIVATE = 'a private collector'; /** * Runs one chat command. Unknown or switched-off commands are `known: false` (the webhook answers with an empty message). * `dry` (the builder's Try it): the same checks and reply, but no overlay event, no cooldown spent, no log line. */

nodes.name: getCommands
nodes.body_text: async function getCommands(): Promise<ChatCommand[]> { const stored = await kv.get<unknown>(KEY).catch(() => null); if (Array.isArray(stored)) { const r = cleanCommands(stored); return r.ok ? r.commands : []; } const seeded = cleanCommands(DEFAULT_COMMANDS); const commands = seeded.ok ? seeded.commands : []; await kv.set(KEY, commands).catch(() => {}); return commands; }

nodes.body_text: async function saveCommands(commands: ChatCommand[]): Promise<void> { await kv.set(KEY, commands); }

nodes.name: noteRun

nodes.body_text: async function noteRun(c: ChatCommand, username: string, ok: boolean, detail: string): Promise<void> { try { await kv.lpush(LOG_KEY, { at: Date.now(), username, what: 'command', ok, detail: `!${c.name} ${detail}`.trim() }); await kv.ltrim(LOG_KEY, 0, 19); const stats = await getCommandStats(); stats[c.id] = { count: (stats[c.id]?.count ?? 0) + 1, last: Date.now() }; await kv.set(STATS_KEY, stats); } catch { /* the log never breaks a command */ } }

nodes.name: doShowOff
nodes.signature: async function doShowOff(c: Ctx): Promise<Done | Fail>
nodes.body_text: async function doShowOff(c: Ctx): Promise<Done | Fail> { if (await liveGate('collection')) return fail(ERROR_DEFAULTS.offline, 'offline'); const r = await prepareShowOff(c.user, c.args, { dry: c.dry }); if (!r.ok) return fail(r.message, KIND_OF[r.error]); const { plan } = r; const s = await season(); const card = s?.overview.cards.find(x => x.number === plan.cardNumber); const cv = s?.overview.values.cards.get(plan.cardNumber); const points = cv && s ? Math.round(copyPoints(cv, plan.variant, plan.serial, s.overview.values.settings)) : 0; if (!c.dry && !c.sandbox) { await enqueueEvent({ id: crypto.randomUUID(), type: 'card', username: plan.username, queuedAt: Date.now(), cardNumber: plan.cardNumber, variant: plan.variant, serial: plan.serial, serialMult: plan.serialMult, uid: plan.uid, }); await recordActivity({ type: 'trigger', kind: 'card', username: plan.username, cardName: plan.cardName }); } return { vars: { username: plan.username, cardName: plan.cardName, variant: plan.variant === 'regular' ? '' : VARIANT_LABELS[plan.variant], edition: plan.serial ? `#${plan.serial}` : '', printNumber: plan.uid ? `#${plan.uid}` : '', points: String(points), stars: String(card?.stars ?? ''), } }; }

nodes.name: doCardStats
nodes.signature: async function doCardStats(c: Ctx): Promise<Done | Fail>
nodes.body_text: async function doCardStats(c: Ctx): Promise<Done | Fail> { const s = await season(); if (!s) return fail(NO_SEASON); const text = c.args.trim(); if (!text) return fail('Which card? Try the name or the number.', 'notFound'); const num = /^#?(\d{1,6})$/.exec(text); const all = asCards(s.overview.cards); const r = resolveCard({ number: num ? Number(num[1]) : null, name: num ? '' : text, variant: null }, all, new Set(all.map(x => x.number)), () => null); if (!r.ok) return fail(r.reason === 'ambiguous' ? r.message : `I could not find a card called "${text}".`, 'notFound'); const n = r.card.number; const card = s.overview.cards.find(x => x.number === n)!; const cv = s.overview.values.cards.get(n); const hidden = await getHiddenUsers(); const minted = await mintedCounts(s.season.collectionName).catch(() => new Map<number, number>()); let made = 0; for (const [entry, count] of minted) if (decodeEntry(entry).cardNumber === n) made += count; if (made === 0) made = cv?.copies ?? 0; const top = ownersByCard(s.collection, s.overview.values, 1).get(n)?.top[0]; const collectors = ownersByCard(s.collection, s.overview.values, 1, hidden).get(n)?.collectors ?? 0; let first = 'nobody yet'; try { const firsts = (await Promise.all(VARIANTS.map(v => pageCopies(s.season.collectionName, n, v, 0, 1, true)))).flatMap(p => p.copies); const oldest = firsts.sort((a, b) => a.at - b.at)[0]; if (oldest) { const who = (oldest.ev.find(e => e.type === 'minted')?.who ?? oldest.owner ?? '').toLowerCase(); if (who) first = hidden.has(who) ? PRIVATE : who; } } catch { /* the ledger is not tracking this season */ } const mine = (s.collection[c.user] ?? []).filter(e => decodeEntry(e).cardNumber === n).length; return { vars: { cardName: card.name, number: String(n), stars: String(card.stars), rarity: getRarity(card.stars)?.label ?? '', pullChance: cv && cv.pullRate > 0 ? `1 in ${Math.max(1, Math.round(1 / cv.pullRate)).toLocaleString('en-US')}` : 'never', printsMade: String(made), collectors: String(collectors), topHolder: top ? (hidden.has(top.username) ? PRIVATE : top.username) : 'nobody yet', firstPulledBy: first, points: String(Math.round(cv?.values.regular ?? 0)), yourPrints: String(mine), url: `${SITE_URL}/cards?card=${n}&season=${encodeURIComponent(s.season.id)}`, } }; }

nodes.name: doMyStats
nodes.signature: async function doMyStats(c: Ctx): Promise<Done | Fail>
nodes.body_text: async function doMyStats(c: Ctx): Promise<Done | Fail> { const s = await season(); if (!s) return fail(NO_SEASON); const asked = c.args.trim().split(/\s+/)[0]?.replace(/^@/, '').toLowerCase() ?? ''; const target = asked || c.user; const hidden = await getHiddenUsers(); if (target !== c.user && hidden.has(target)) return fail('This collector keeps their stats private.'); const entries = s.collection[target] ?? []; if (entries.length === 0) return fail(target === c.user ? 'You have no cards yet.' : `${target} has no cards yet.`, 'notFound'); const values = s.overview.values; const held = pointsFor(values, entries, target); const b = collectionBonuses(values, held.unique.size); const score = Math.round(held.points + b.completion + b.set); const rank = s.overview.rows.filter(r => r.score > held.points + b.completion + b.set).length + 1; let best = 'none yet'; try { const copies = (await getOwnerCopies(s.season.collectionName, target)).sort((a, z) => a.n - z.n); if (copies[0]) best = `${s.overview.cards.find(x => x.number === copies[0].card)?.name ?? 'a card'} #${copies[0].n}`; } catch { /* not tracked */ } let rarest = ''; let rarestRate = Infinity; for (const cardNumber of held.unique) { const rate = values.cards.get(cardNumber)?.pullRate ?? Infinity; if (rate < rarestRate) { rarestRate = rate; rarest = s.overview.cards.find(x => x.number === cardNumber)?.name ?? ''; } } return { vars: { rank: String(rank), score: String(score), cards: String(held.unique.size), totalCards: String(values.totalCards), prints: String(held.copies), progressBonus: String(Math.round(b.completion + b.set)), bestEdition: best, rarestPrint: rarest || 'none yet', profileUrl: `${SITE_URL}${profileHref(target)}`, } }; }

nodes.name: doCollection
nodes.signature: async function doCollection(c: Ctx): Promise<Done | Fail>
nodes.body_text: async function doCollection(c: Ctx): Promise<Done | Fail> { if (await liveGate('collection')) return fail(ERROR_DEFAULTS.offline, 'offline'); const s = await season(); const entries = s?.collection[c.user] ?? []; if (!c.dry && !c.sandbox) { await enqueueEvent({ id: crypto.randomUUID(), type: 'collection', username: c.user, queuedAt: Date.now() }); await recordActivity({ type: 'trigger', kind: 'collection', username: c.user }); } return { vars: { cards: String(countVariants(entries).size), prints: String(entries.length) } }; }

nodes.name: doLeaderboard
nodes.body_text: async function doLeaderboard(): Promise<Done | Fail> { const s = await season(); if (!s) return fail(NO_SEASON); const rows = s.overview.rows; if (rows.length === 0) return fail('Nobody is on the leaderboard yet.', 'notFound'); const at = (i: number) => (rows[i] ? `${rows[i].username} (${Math.round(rows[i].score).toLocaleString('en-US')})` : '-'); return { vars: { first: at(0), second: at(1), third: at(2) } }; }

nodes.body_text: async function doPullsLeft(c: Ctx): Promise<Done | Fail> { const m = await getMixItUpSettings(); if (!m.enabled) return fail('Paid pulls are off right now.', 'notFound'); const eff = effectiveLimit(m.limit, await getUserPullLimit(c.user)); const used = await pullsUsedThisStream(c.user); return { vars: { left: eff.limit > 0 ? String(Math.max(0, eff.limit - used)) : 'unlimited', limit: eff.limit > 0 ? String(eff.limit) : 'unlimited', price: String(m.cost), currency: m.currency, } }; }
