nodes.name: runCommand
nodes.signature: async function runCommand(input: RunInput, commands?: ChatCommand[]): Promise<RunOutput>
nodes.body_text: async function runCommand(input: RunInput, commands?: ChatCommand[]): Promise<RunOutput> { const list = commands ?? await getCommands(); const cmd = matchCommand(list, input.command); if (!cmd) return { known: false, ok: false, message: '', vars: {} }; const user = input.username.toLowerCase().replace(/^@/, '').trim(); const ctx: Ctx = { user, args: input.args, dry: !!input.dry, sandbox: await inSandbox() }; const base = { username: user, args: input.args }; const refuse = async (kind: ErrorKind | undefined, message: string): Promise<RunOutput> => { const text = tidyReply(interpolate((kind && cmd.errors[kind]) || message, base)); if (!ctx.dry) await noteRun(cmd, user, false, `refused: ${kind ?? 'error'}`); return { known: true, ok: false, message: text, vars: {} }; }; if (cmd.liveOnly) { const live = await getLiveStatus().catch(() => null); if (live && !live.live) return refuse('offline', ERROR_DEFAULTS.offline); } const cdKey = `cmd:cd:${cmd.id}`; const ucdKey = `cmd:ucd:${cmd.id}:${user}`; const cooling = (cmd.cooldownS > 0 && (await kv.get(cdKey).catch(() => null)) !== null) || (cmd.userCooldownS > 0 && (await kv.get(ucdKey).catch(() => null)) !== null); if (cooling && !ctx.dry) return refuse('cooldown', ERROR_DEFAULTS.cooldown); let r: Done | Fail; try { r = cmd.action === 'showoff' ? await doShowOff(ctx) : cmd.action === 'card-stats' ? await doCardStats(ctx) : cmd.action === 'my-stats' ? await doMyStats(ctx) : cmd.action === 'collection' ? await doCollection(ctx) : cmd.action === 'leaderboard' ? await doLeaderboard() : cmd.action === 'pulls-left' ? await doPullsLeft(ctx) : await doText(ctx); } catch { r = fail('Something went wrong, try again in a moment.'); } if (r.fail) return refuse(r.kind, r.message); if (!ctx.dry) { if (cmd.cooldownS > 0) await kv.set(cdKey, 1, { ex: cmd.cooldownS }).catch(() => {}); if (cmd.userCooldownS > 0) await kv.set(ucdKey, 1, { ex: cmd.userCooldownS }).catch(() => {}); await noteRun(cmd, user, true, input.args ? `"${input.args.slice(0, 40)}"` : ''); } return { known: true, ok: true, message: renderReply(cmd.reply, r.vars), vars: r.vars }; }

'error'}`); return { known: true, ok: false, message: text, vars: {} }; }

nodes.name: copy-link.ts
nodes.body_text: import { VARIANTS } from './variants'; import type { Variant } from './types'; // Where a pull / grant / upgrade event's print lives. Client-safe (no server imports), so feeds on the server and in the browser share it. /** * The page of the print an activity event made: `/c/<print number>` when the event carries one; for older pull events that only have * an edition (`serial`) the print's id is derived (`<card>.<version index>.<n>`) and opened as `/copy/<season>/<id>`; otherwise null * (the caller falls back to the card dex link). The season id is the one the event's collection belongs to. */ /** The admin page of the same print. Uses the event's copy id, or derives it for older pull events. */ /** * Where a "Most valuable prints" row goes (15.4): one numbered print opens its print page (`/c/<uid>`, or the derived `/copy/...` link * when the print has no unique number yet); a row that groups several prints of a card and version opens the card dex dialog. */

'regular'); if (v >= 0) return `/copy/${encodeURIComponent(seasonId)}/${e.cardNumber}.${v}.${e.serial}`; } return null; }

'regular'))}.${e.serial}` : null); return id && seasonId ? `/admin/serials/${encodeURIComponent(seasonId)}/${id}` : null; }

nodes.name: topPrintHref
nodes.signature: function topPrintHref(row: { card: { number: number }; variant: Variant; serial?: number }, seasonId: string, uid?: number | null): string
nodes.body_text: function topPrintHref(row: { card: { number: number }; variant: Variant; serial?: number }, seasonId: string, uid?: number | null): string { if (row.serial) { if (uid) return `/c/${uid}`; const v = VARIANTS.indexOf(row.variant); if (v >= 0 && seasonId) return `/copy/${encodeURIComponent(seasonId)}/${row.card.number}.${v}.${row.serial}`; } return `/cards?card=${row.card.number}`; }

nodes.body_text: function copyShareSpec(i: CopyShareInput): ShareSpec { const { copy } = i; const label = `${copy.variant === 'regular' ? '' : `${VARIANT_LABELS[copy.variant]} `}${i.cardName}`; const host = i.siteUrl.replace(/^https?:\/\//, ''); const gone = !copy.owner; return { title: label, subtitle: `${i.seasonName} · ${i.packName}`, stats: [VARIANT_LABELS[copy.variant], ...(i.mult > 1 ? [`Edition bonus ×${Math.round(i.mult * 100) / 100}`] : [])], cards: [{ src: i.art, thumb: cardThumbUrl(i.art), name: i.cardName, hex: i.hex }], plate: { number: `#${copy.uid ?? copy.n}`, edition: copy.uid ? editionLine(copy.n, i.total) : madeLine(copy.n, i.total) || `Edition #${copy.n}`, date: `${copy.est ? 'NUMBERED' : 'PULLED'} ${engravedDate(copy.at)}`, lines: [gone ? 'No longer exists' : isEscrow(copy.owner) ? 'In a trade offer' : i.privateHolder ? 'Held by a private collector' : `Held by @${copy.owner}`], gold: i.mult > 1, qrUrl: `${i.siteUrl}/copy/${encodeURIComponent(i.seasonId)}/${copy.id}`, look: plateLook(i.back), }, footer: copy.uid ? `${host}/c/${copy.uid}` : host, }; }

nodes.name: copy-view.ts
nodes.body_text: import { getPackCards, getPacksForSeason, listSeasons } from './kv'; import { findByUid, getCopy } from './serials'; import type { Copy } from './serials-core'; import type { Card, Pack, Season } from './types'; /** A copy found by its unique number, with the season, pack and card it belongs to. Null when it, or its season, is gone or a draft. */

nodes.name: loadCopyByUid
nodes.signature: async function loadCopyByUid(uid: number): Promise<{ season: Season; copy: Copy; pack: Pack; card: Card } | null>
nodes.body_text: async function loadCopyByUid(uid: number): Promise<{ season: Season; copy: Copy; pack: Pack; card: Card } | null> { const hit = await findByUid(uid); if (!hit) return null; const season = (await listSeasons()).find(s => s.collectionName === hit.collection && s.status !== 'draft'); if (!season) return null; const copy = await getCopy(hit.collection, hit.copyId); if (!copy) return null; for (const pack of await getPacksForSeason(season)) { const card = (await getPackCards(pack.id)).find(c => c.number === copy.card); if (card) return { season, copy, pack, card }; } return null; }

import { uniqueCount } from './collection'; import { rarityStats } from './rarity'; import { getAvatars } from './avatars'; import { getActivity, type ActivityEvent } from './activity'; import { getSeasonLeaderboard, type LeaderboardRow, type SeasonValues } from './leaderboard'; import { listOpenTrades, tradeHistory } from './trades'; import type { Trade } from './trade-core'; import { getLiveStatus, getLatestRecap, type LiveStatus } from './twitch-live'; import type { StreamRecap } from './stream-recap'; import { getLatestDigest } from './weekly-digest-store'; import type { WeeklyDigest } from './weekly-digest'; import { allowedVariants, decodeEntry, emptyCounts, type VariantCounts } from './variants'; import { getOverlayStatus, type OverlayStatus } from './overlay'; import { getTradeSettings } from './trades'; import { bucketsFor, getSeries, type Range, type Series } from './stats'; import { twitchCredentials } from './twitch-helix'; import { getOverlaySettings } from './overlay-settings'; import { jsonBytes, sizeAttention } from './data-health'; import { countNewFeedback, listFeedback } from './feedback'; import { DELETION_OVERDUE_DAYS } from './feedback-core'; import { autoDisabledChannels } from './discord'; // Server side of the admin dashboard: where the layout and notes are stored, and the numbers the widgets show. // Only what the widgets in the saved layout need is computed (the leaderboard, activity log, trades and live status cost // extra reads), so a trimmed-down dashboard is a cheaper one. const LAYOUT_KEY = 'admin:dashboard'; // the shared layout: what everyone had before layouts were per person, and the emergency password login's const NOTES_KEY = 'admin:dashboard:notes'; /** * Where one person's layout lives. `login` is a staff member's Twitch login; null (the emergency password login) uses the shared key. * The "user" segment keeps a login called "notes" or "presets" from landing on those keys. */ /** This person's layout, else the shared one (so nobody loses what they had), else the default. */ /** Things worth a look, most urgent first: each is a plain check against data we already keep. */ // ── Presets: named layouts the admin can switch between ── const PRESETS_KEY = 'admin:dashboard:presets'; const PRESET_CAP = 12;

nodes.name: layoutKeyFor
nodes.body_text: function layoutKeyFor(login: string | null): string { const clean = (login ?? '').trim().toLowerCase(); return clean ? `${LAYOUT_KEY}:user:${clean}` : LAYOUT_KEY; }

nodes.name: getDashboardLayout
nodes.signature: async function getDashboardLayout(login: string | null = null): Promise<DashboardLayout>
nodes.body_text: async function getDashboardLayout(login: string | null = null): Promise<DashboardLayout> { try { const stored = (login ? await kv.get<DashboardLayout>(layoutKeyFor(login)) : null) ?? await kv.get<DashboardLayout>(LAYOUT_KEY); return stored ? sanitizeLayout(stored) : DEFAULT_LAYOUT; } catch { return DEFAULT_LAYOUT; } }

nodes.name: saveDashboardLayout

nodes.body_text: async function saveDashboardLayout(layout: DashboardLayout, login: string | null = null): Promise<void> { await kv.set(layoutKeyFor(login), sanitizeLayout(layout)); }

nodes.name: resetDashboardLayout
nodes.signature: async function resetDashboardLayout(login: string | null = null): Promise<void>
nodes.body_text: async function resetDashboardLayout(login: string | null = null): Promise<void> { await kv.del(layoutKeyFor(login)); }

nodes.name: getDashboardNotes
nodes.body_text: async function getDashboardNotes(): Promise<string> { try { return (await kv.get<string>(NOTES_KEY)) ?? ''; } catch { return ''; } }

nodes.name: saveDashboardNotes

nodes.name: AttentionItem
nodes.body_text: interface AttentionItem { id: string; level: 'warn' | 'info'; text: string; href?: string; cta?: string; }

nodes.name: computeAttention
nodes.signature: async function computeAttention(season: Season, packs: { pack: Pack; cards: Card[] }[], live: LiveStatus | null, overlay: OverlayStatus | null, collectionBytes: number): Promise<AttentionItem[]>
nodes.body_text: async function computeAttention(season: Season, packs: { pack: Pack; cards: Card[] }[], live: LiveStatus | null, overlay: OverlayStatus | null, collectionBytes: number): Promise<AttentionItem[]> { const items: AttentionItem[] = []; const size = sizeAttention(season.name, collectionBytes); if (size) items.push({ id: 'data-size', level: 'warn', text: size.text, href: '/admin/settings?tab=environment', cta: 'Data health' }); const [allPacks, seasons, tradeSettings, open] = await Promise.all([ listAllPacks().catch(() => [] as Pack[]), listSeasons().catch(() => [] as Season[]), getTradeSettings().catch(() => null), listOpenTrades().catch(() => [] as Trade[]), ]); if (live?.live && overlay && overlay.connected === 0) items.push({ id: 'overlay-live', level: 'warn', text: 'The channel is live but no overlay is connected, so gifts and pulls will not play.', href: '/admin/settings?tab=overlay', cta: 'Overlay settings' }); if (overlay && overlay.queued > 20) items.push({ id: 'queue', level: 'warn', text: `${overlay.queued} events are waiting in the overlay queue.`, href: '/admin#quick-actions', cta: 'Clear queue' }); if (packs.length === 0) items.push({ id: 'no-packs', level: 'warn', text: 'This season has no active pack with cards, so nothing can be drawn.', href: `/admin/seasons/${season.id}`, cta: 'Season settings' }); const inSeason = new Set(seasons.flatMap(s => s.packIds)); const orphans = allPacks.filter(p => p.status === 'published' && !inSeason.has(p.id)); if (orphans.length > 0) items.push({ id: 'orphans', level: 'warn', text: `${orphans.length} published pack${orphans.length === 1 ? ' is' : 's are'} not in any season, so can never be drawn: ${orphans.slice(0, 3).map(p => p.name).join(', ')}${orphans.length > 3 ? '…' : ''}`, href: '/admin/packs', cta: 'Packs' }); const noFullArt = packs.flatMap(({ pack, cards }) => (pack.upgradesEnabled ? cards.filter(c => !c.fullArtImageUrl && allowedVariants(pack, c).includes('full')) : [])); if (noFullArt.length > 0) items.push({ id: 'full-art', level: 'warn', text: `${noFullArt.length} card${noFullArt.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} can be pulled as Full Art / Shiny but ${noFullArt.length === 1 ? 'has' : 'have'} no full-art image (they reuse the normal art).`, href: '/admin/packs', cta: 'Fix in packs' }); if (tradeSettings && !tradeSettings.enabled) items.push({ id: 'trading-paused', level: 'info', text: 'Trading is paused: nothing new can be offered or accepted.', href: '/admin/trades', cta: 'Trades' }); const soon = open.filter(t => t.expiresAt - Date.now() < 6 * 3_600_000).length; if (soon > 0) items.push({ id: 'expiring', level: 'info', text: `${soon} trade offer${soon === 1 ? '' : 's'} expire${soon === 1 ? 's' : ''} within 6 hours (the cards return to their owners).`, href: '/admin/trades', cta: 'Trades' }); for (const c of await autoDisabledChannels()) items.push({ id: `discord-off-${c.id}`, level: 'warn', text: `The Discord channel "${c.name}": ${c.reason}.`, href: '/admin/settings?tab=webhooks', cta: 'Webhooks' }); const drafts = allPacks.filter(p => p.status === 'draft').length + seasons.filter(s => s.status === 'draft').length; if (drafts > 0) items.push({ id: 'drafts', level: 'info', text: `${drafts} draft pack${drafts === 1 ? '' : 's'} or season${drafts === 1 ? '' : 's'} waiting to be published.`, href: '/admin/packs', cta: 'Review drafts' }); const deletions = (await listFeedback({ kind: 'deletion', status: 'new' }).catch(() => [])).sort((a, b) => a.at - b.at); if (deletions.length > 0) { const overdue = Date.now() - deletions[0].at > DELETION_OVERDUE_DAYS * 86_400_000; items.push({ id: 'deletions', level: overdue ? 'warn' : 'info', text: `${deletions.length} account deletion request${deletions.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} waiting${overdue ? ', the oldest for more than a month (people expect it done within about a month)' : ''}.`, href: '/admin/feedback?kind=deletion', cta: 'Deletion requests' }); } const reports = await listFeedback({ kind: 'report', status: 'new' }).catch(() => []); if (reports.length > 0) items.push({ id: 'reports', level: 'warn', text: `${reports.length} user report${reports.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} waiting for a look.`, href: '/admin/feedback?kind=report', cta: 'User reports' }); const waiting = Math.max(0, (await countNewFeedback().catch(() => 0)) - reports.length); if (waiting > 0) items.push({ id: 'feedback', level: 'info', text: `${waiting} new suggestion${waiting === 1 ? '' : 's'} or problem report${waiting === 1 ? '' : 's'} from viewers waiting for a look.`, href: '/admin/feedback', cta: 'Feedback' }); if (!twitchCredentials()) items.push({ id: 'twitch', level: 'info', text: 'Twitch credentials are not set, so avatars and the live indicator are switched off.', href: '/admin/settings?tab=viewers', cta: 'Viewer settings' }); return items; }

nodes.name: DashboardData
nodes.body_text: interface DashboardData { season: Season; packs: { pack: Pack; cards: Card[] }[]; allCards: Card[]; users: [string, number[]][]; totalUsers: number; totalOwned: number; totalUnique: number; avgCompletion: number; topCollectors: { username: string; owned: number; pct: number }[]; cardStats: (Card & { ownedBy: number })[]; avatars: Record<string, string | undefined>; rarityDist: ReturnType<typeof rarityStats>; variantCounts: VariantCounts; activity: ActivityEvent[]; trades: { open: Trade[]; recent: Trade[]; escrowedCopies: number; completed24h: number } | null; board: { rows: LeaderboardRow[]; values: SeasonValues } | null; live: LiveStatus | null; recap: StreamRecap | null; digest: WeeklyDigest | null; notes: string; /** The dashboard's chosen time range, with this period's and the previous period's counters. */ range: Range['id']; series: Series | null; prevSeries: Series | null; attention: AttentionItem[]; overlay: OverlayStatus | null; /** Events an admin caused (grants, removals, resets, gifts, cancellations), newest first. */ adminActions: ActivityEvent[]; /** Distinct viewers per day for the last 7 days (oldest first), whatever the chosen range. */ dailyViewers: number[]; overlaySettings: { livePacksOnly: boolean; liveCollectionsOnly: boolean }; }

nodes.name: loadDashboardData
nodes.signature: async function loadDashboardData(season: Season, packs: { pack: Pack; cards: Card[] }[], needs: Set<WidgetType>, range: Range['id'] = '7d'): Promise<DashboardData>
nodes.body_text: async function loadDashboardData(season: Season, packs: { pack: Pack; cards: Card[] }[], needs: Set<WidgetType>, range: Range['id'] = '7d'): Promise<DashboardData> { const allCards = packs.flatMap(p => p.cards); const collection = await getCollection(season.collectionName); const users = Object.entries(collection); const totalUsers = users.length; const totalOwned = users.reduce((s, [, c]) => s + c.length, 0); const totalUnique = users.reduce((s, [, c]) => s + uniqueCount(c), 0); const avgCompletion = totalUsers > 0 && allCards.length > 0 ? Math.round((totalUnique / totalUsers / allCards.length) * 100) : 0; const freq: Record<number, number> = {}; const variantCounts = emptyCounts(); for (const [, owned] of users) { const seen = new Set<number>(); for (const entry of owned) { const { cardNumber, variant } = decodeEntry(entry); seen.add(cardNumber); variantCounts[variant]++; } seen.forEach(n => { freq[n] = (freq[n] ?? 0) + 1; }); } const topCollectors = users .map(([username, owned]) => ({ username, owned: uniqueCount(owned), pct: allCards.length > 0 ? Math.round((uniqueCount(owned) / allCards.length) * 100) : 0, })) .sort((a, b) => b.owned - a.owned) .slice(0, 8); const cardStats = allCards.map(c => ({ ...c, ownedBy: freq[c.number] ?? 0 })).sort((a, b) => b.stars - a.stars || b.ownedBy - a.ownedBy); const wantsActivity = needs.has('activity') || needs.has('pulse') || needs.has('changes'); const wantsSeries = needs.has('pulls-chart') || needs.has('pulse') || needs.has('viewers') || needs.has('progress') || needs.has('economy'); const wantsLive = needs.has('live') || needs.has('attention') || needs.has('recap'); const wantsOverlay = needs.has('attention') || needs.has('overlay-controls'); const { starts, step } = bucketsFor(range, season.createdAt); const span = step === 'hour' ? 3_600_000 : 86_400_000; const [avatars, activity, openTrades, history, board, live, notes, recap, digest, series, prevSeries, overlay] = await Promise.all([ needs.has('top-collectors') || needs.has('leaderboard') ? getAvatars(topCollectors.map(c => c.username)) : Promise.resolve({}), wantsActivity ? getActivity({ limit: 500 }).then(r => r.events).catch(() => []) : Promise.resolve([] as ActivityEvent[]), needs.has('trades') ? listOpenTrades().catch(() => [] as Trade[]) : Promise.resolve(null), needs.has('trades') ? tradeHistory().catch(() => [] as Trade[]) : Promise.resolve(null), needs.has('leaderboard') || needs.has('valuable') ? getSeasonLeaderboard(season).catch(() => null) : Promise.resolve(null), wantsLive ? getLiveStatus().catch(() => null) : Promise.resolve(null), needs.has('notes') ? getDashboardNotes() : Promise.resolve(''), needs.has('recap') ? getLatestRecap() : Promise.resolve(null), needs.has('digest') ? getLatestDigest() : Promise.resolve(null), wantsSeries ? getSeries(season.collectionName, starts, step) : Promise.resolve(null), wantsSeries ? getSeries(season.collectionName, starts.map(s => s - starts.length * span), step) : Promise.resolve(null), wantsOverlay ? getOverlayStatus().catch(() => null) : Promise.resolve(null), ]); const [dailySeries, overlaySettings] = await Promise.all([ needs.has('viewers') ? getSeries(season.collectionName, bucketsFor('7d', season.createdAt).starts, 'day') : Promise.resolve(null), needs.has('overlay-controls') ? getOverlaySettings().catch(() => null) : Promise.resolve(null), ]); const attention = needs.has('attention') ? await computeAttention(season, packs, live, overlay, needs.has('attention') ? jsonBytes(collection) : 0) : []; const adminActions = activity.filter(e => (e.type === 'grant' && e.source === 'admin') || e.type === 'remove' || e.type === 'reset' || e.type === 'delete' || (e.type === 'trigger' && e.source === 'admin') || (e.type === 'trade' && e.by === 'admin')).slice(0, 12); const trades = openTrades && history ? { open: openTrades, recent: history.slice(0, 6), escrowedCopies: openTrades.filter(t => t.escrowed).reduce((n, t) => n + t.give.reduce((m, i) => m + i.count, 0), 0), completed24h: history.filter(t => t.status === 'accepted' && (t.resolvedAt ?? 0) > Date.now() - 86_400_000).length, } : null; return { season, packs, allCards, users, totalUsers, totalOwned, totalUnique, avgCompletion, topCollectors, cardStats, avatars: avatars as Record<string, string | undefined>, rarityDist: rarityStats(allCards), variantCounts, activity, trades, board: board ? { rows: board.rows, values: board.values } : null, live, recap, digest, notes, range, series, prevSeries, attention, overlay, adminActions, dailyViewers: dailySeries?.viewers ?? [], overlaySettings: { livePacksOnly: !!overlaySettings?.livePacksOnly, liveCollectionsOnly: !!overlaySettings?.liveCollectionsOnly }, }; }

nodes.name: DashboardPreset
nodes.body_text: interface DashboardPreset { name: string; layout: DashboardLayout; /** Who saved it (a staff login), when known. */ by?: string }

nodes.name: getDashboardPresets
nodes.body_text: async function getDashboardPresets(): Promise<DashboardPreset[]> { try { const stored = await kv.get<DashboardPreset[]>(PRESETS_KEY); return (stored ?? []).filter(p => p && typeof p.name === 'string').map(p => ({ name: p.name, layout: sanitizeLayout(p.layout), ...(typeof p.by === 'string' ? { by: p.by } : {}) })); } catch { return []; } }

nodes.name: saveDashboardPreset
nodes.signature: async function saveDashboardPreset(name: string, layout: DashboardLayout, by?: string): Promise<void>
nodes.body_text: async function saveDashboardPreset(name: string, layout: DashboardLayout, by?: string): Promise<void> { const rest = (await getDashboardPresets()).filter(p => p.name !== name); await kv.set(PRESETS_KEY, [{ name, layout, ...(by ? { by } : {}) }, ...rest].slice(0, PRESET_CAP)); }

nodes.name: deleteDashboardPreset
nodes.body_text: async function deleteDashboardPreset(name: string): Promise<void> { await kv.set(PRESETS_KEY, (await getDashboardPresets()).filter(p => p.name !== name)); }

nodes.body_text: import type { IconName } from '@/app/components/Icon'; // The admin dashboard is a grid of widgets the admin can add, remove, reorder (drag and drop) and resize. This file is the // client-safe model: the registry of widget types and the layout shape + its sanitizer. The server side (data + persistence) // is in lib/dashboard-data.ts, the widgets themselves in app/admin/dashboard/. export const WIDGET_TYPES = [ 'overview', 'quick-actions', 'top-collectors', 'leaderboard', 'rarity', 'packs', 'card-ownership', 'activity', 'trades', 'overlay', 'pulse', 'variants', 'valuable', 'unowned', 'live', 'shortcuts', 'notes', 'attention', 'pulls-chart', 'economy', 'viewers', 'progress', 'changes', 'overlay-controls', 'recap', 'digest', ] as const; /** Column spans on the 12-column grid (everything stacks on phones, and spans of 6 or less pair up on tablets). */ export const SPANS = [3, 4, 6, 8, 12] as const; export const WIDGETS: Record<WidgetType, WidgetDef> = { overview: { type: 'overview', title: 'Season overview', icon: 'chart', description: 'Players, cards pulled, card pool and average completion at a glance.', defaultSpan: 12, spans: [6, 8, 12] }, 'quick-actions': { type: 'quick-actions', title: 'Quick actions', icon: 'zap', description: 'Gift packs, show a collection or grant a card to a viewer.', defaultSpan: 12, spans: [8, 12] }, 'top-collectors': { type: 'top-collectors', title: 'Top collectors', icon: 'award', description: 'Who owns the most different cards this season.', defaultSpan: 8, spans: [6, 8, 12] }, leaderboard: { type: 'leaderboard', title: 'Leaderboard', icon: 'trophy', description: 'The top scorers (points, not card count), with their completion.', defaultSpan: 4, spans: [4, 6, 8] }, rarity: { type: 'rarity', title: 'Rarity mix', icon: 'gem', description: 'How the season\'s cards split across rarities.', defaultSpan: 4, spans: [3, 4, 6] }, packs: { type: 'packs', title: 'Active packs', icon: 'cards', description: 'The packs being drawn this season, with a link to each.', defaultSpan: 4, spans: [3, 4, 6] }, 'card-ownership': { type: 'card-ownership', title: 'Card ownership', icon: 'cards', description: 'Every card with how many collectors own it.', defaultSpan: 12, spans: [6, 8, 12] }, activity: { type: 'activity', title: 'Recent activity', icon: 'radio', description: 'The latest pulls, grants, upgrades and trades.', defaultSpan: 6, spans: [4, 6, 8, 12] }, trades: { type: 'trades', title: 'Trading', icon: 'trade', description: 'Open offers, cards held in escrow and recent completed trades.', defaultSpan: 6, spans: [4, 6, 8] }, overlay: { type: 'overlay', title: 'Overlay status', icon: 'monitor', description: 'Whether OBS has the overlay open, and shortcuts to edit it.', defaultSpan: 4, spans: [3, 4, 6] }, pulse: { type: 'pulse', title: 'Activity pulse', icon: 'trend', description: 'Pulls and active viewers over the last hour, day and week.', defaultSpan: 4, spans: [3, 4, 6] }, variants: { type: 'variants', title: 'Variant mix', icon: 'sparkles', description: 'How many Regular, Reverse Holo, Full Art and Shiny prints exist.', defaultSpan: 4, spans: [3, 4, 6] }, valuable: { type: 'valuable', title: 'Most valuable cards', icon: 'coins', description: 'The cards worth the most points per print right now.', defaultSpan: 4, spans: [4, 6, 8] }, unowned: { type: 'unowned', title: 'Cards nobody owns', icon: 'hole', description: 'Cards no viewer has pulled yet.', defaultSpan: 4, spans: [3, 4, 6] }, live: { type: 'live', title: 'Stream status', icon: 'radio', description: 'Whether the channel is live on Twitch, with the title and viewer count.', defaultSpan: 4, spans: [3, 4, 6] }, recap: { type: 'recap', title: 'Last stream recap', icon: 'radio', description: 'The summary posted to Discord when the last stream ended: packs opened, new collectors, the rarest pull and the top puller.', defaultSpan: 4, spans: [4, 6, 8] }, digest: { type: 'digest', title: 'Weekly digest', icon: 'calendar', description: 'The last Sunday summary posted to Discord: pulls, trades, top 3, movers and the print of the week.', defaultSpan: 4, spans: [4, 6, 8] }, shortcuts: { type: 'shortcuts', title: 'Shortcuts', icon: 'compass', description: 'Jump to creating a pack or season, the overlay editor, trades and the sandbox.', defaultSpan: 4, spans: [3, 4, 6, 8] }, attention: { type: 'attention', title: 'Needs attention', icon: 'alert', description: 'A to-do list: overlay offline while live, packs in no season, missing full art, expiring trades and more.', defaultSpan: 6, spans: [4, 6, 8, 12] }, 'pulls-chart': { type: 'pulls-chart', title: 'Pulls over time', icon: 'chart', description: 'Pulls per hour or day for the chosen range, split by variant, with the change from the previous period.', defaultSpan: 8, spans: [6, 8, 12] }, economy: { type: 'economy', title: 'Economy health', icon: 'coins', description: 'Points in circulation, how evenly they are spread, and the scarcest and most common cards.', defaultSpan: 4, spans: [4, 6, 8] }, viewers: { type: 'viewers', title: 'Viewers', icon: 'users', description: 'Active, new and returning viewers over the chosen range.', defaultSpan: 4, spans: [3, 4, 6] }, progress: { type: 'progress', title: 'Season progress', icon: 'calendar', description: 'How long the season has run, pulls per day and how much of the card pool has been found.', defaultSpan: 4, spans: [3, 4, 6] }, changes: { type: 'changes', title: 'Admin actions', icon: 'shield', description: 'Recent grants, removals, resets, gifts and cancellations made by an admin.', defaultSpan: 4, spans: [4, 6, 8] }, 'overlay-controls': { type: 'overlay-controls', title: 'Overlay controls', icon: 'monitor', description: 'Queue size, the "only when live" switches and clearing the queue, without leaving the dashboard.', defaultSpan: 4, spans: [3, 4, 6] }, notes: { type: 'notes', title: 'Notes', icon: 'note', description: 'A scratchpad for reminders. Saved with the dashboard.', defaultSpan: 4, spans: [3, 4, 6, 8] }, }; /** What a fresh install shows: the original dashboard (header stats, quick actions, collectors + rarity + packs, card table), plus a couple of extras. */ export const DEFAULT_LAYOUT: DashboardLayout = { widgets: [ { type: 'overview', span: 12 }, { type: 'attention', span: 4 }, { type: 'pulls-chart', span: 8 }, { type: 'quick-actions', span: 12 }, { type: 'top-collectors', span: 8 }, { type: 'rarity', span: 4 }, { type: 'activity', span: 6 }, { type: 'trades', span: 6 }, { type: 'packs', span: 4 }, { type: 'leaderboard', span: 4 }, { type: 'overlay', span: 4 }, { type: 'card-ownership', span: 12 }, ], }; /** Cleans a layout from the client: known widgets only, each at most once, spans snapped to what the widget allows. */ /** Tailwind needs whole class names, so the spans are spelled out. */ export const SPAN_CLASS: Record<Span, string> = { 3: 'md:col-span-6 xl:col-span-3', 4: 'md:col-span-6 xl:col-span-4', 6: 'md:col-span-6 xl:col-span-6', 8: 'md:col-span-12 xl:col-span-8', 12: 'md:col-span-12 xl:col-span-12', }; /** Whose layout key to use: a Twitch staff member's own login, or null (the shared layout) for the emergency password login. */ /** Ready-made layouts every staff member can switch to (shown above the team layouts). Applying one replaces the person's own layout. */ export const BUILTIN_PRESETS: { name: string; layout: DashboardLayout }[] = [ { name: 'Stream night', layout: { widgets: [ { type: 'live', span: 4 }, { type: 'overlay-controls', span: 4 }, { type: 'recap', span: 4 }, { type: 'quick-actions', span: 12 }, { type: 'activity', span: 6 }, { type: 'pulls-chart', span: 6 }, ] } }, { name: 'Season overview', layout: { widgets: [ { type: 'overview', span: 12 }, { type: 'pulls-chart', span: 8 }, { type: 'rarity', span: 4 }, { type: 'top-collectors', span: 6 }, { type: 'packs', span: 6 }, { type: 'card-ownership', span: 12 }, { type: 'digest', span: 6 }, ] } }, { name: 'Trading desk', layout: { widgets: [ { type: 'trades', span: 8 }, { type: 'attention', span: 4 }, { type: 'activity', span: 6 }, { type: 'leaderboard', span: 6 }, ] } }, { name: 'Minimal', layout: { widgets: [ { type: 'overview', span: 12 }, { type: 'attention', span: 4 }, { type: 'quick-actions', span: 8 }, ] } }, ];

nodes.name: WidgetType
nodes.body_text: type WidgetType = (typeof WIDGET_TYPES)[number];

nodes.name: Span
nodes.body_text: type Span = (typeof SPANS)[number];

nodes.name: WidgetDef
nodes.body_text: interface WidgetDef { type: WidgetType; title: string; icon: IconName; description: string; defaultSpan: Span; /** Spans this widget makes sense at (a table is useless at 3 columns). */ spans: readonly Span[]; }

nodes.name: WidgetPlacement
nodes.body_text: interface WidgetPlacement { type: WidgetType; span: Span; }

nodes.name: DashboardLayout
nodes.body_text: interface DashboardLayout { widgets: WidgetPlacement[]; }

nodes.name: isType
nodes.body_text: isType = (t: unknown): t is WidgetType => typeof t === 'string' && (WIDGET_TYPES as readonly string[]).includes(t)

nodes.name: sanitizeLayout
nodes.body_text: function sanitizeLayout(input: unknown): DashboardLayout { const raw = (input && typeof input === 'object' ? (input as { widgets?: unknown }).widgets : null); if (!Array.isArray(raw)) return DEFAULT_LAYOUT; const seen = new Set<WidgetType>(); const widgets: WidgetPlacement[] = []; for (const w of raw) { const type = (w as { type?: unknown })?.type; if (!isType(type) || seen.has(type)) continue; seen.add(type); const def = WIDGETS[type]; const span = Number((w as { span?: unknown }).span); widgets.push({ type, span: (def.spans as readonly number[]).includes(span) ? (span as Span) : def.defaultSpan }); } return { widgets }; }

nodes.name: loginForLayout
nodes.signature: function loginForLayout(who: { login: string; via: 'twitch' | 'password' } | null): string | null
nodes.body_text: function loginForLayout(who: { login: string; via: 'twitch' | 'password' } | null): string | null { return who && who.via === 'twitch' ? who.login : null; }

nodes.name: data-health.ts
nodes.body_text: // Data health: how big the stored game data is, so a storage redesign (roadmap 3.2) is decided by numbers, not a hunch. // // Each season's collection is ONE JSON value (`tcg_<name>`: { viewer: number[] }) that is read and rewritten whole, under a lock, // on every pull, trade and upgrade. Trades (`trades:open`, `trades:history`) work the same way. So the size of those values, and how // long the writers wait for each other, is what decides when this stops being fine. Nothing here changes behaviour. import { kv } from './db'; import { getCollection, listSeasons } from './kv'; /** A collection value at this size gets a "needs attention" line on the dashboard. */ export const BLOB_WARN_BYTES = 512 * 1024; /** From here a pull rewrites a couple of MB every time; the storage layout should be revisited (3.2). */ export const BLOB_HIGH_BYTES = 2 * 1024 * 1024; /** Bytes of a value as it is stored (the JSON text, UTF-8). */ /** Pure: size and shape of one season's collection value. */ /** The dashboard's check text for a collection value (null while it is small). */ // ---- server side ---- const OWNER_SAMPLE = 500; const BATCH = 25; /** Measures everything for the Settings page. Reads each published season's collection once; never throws for a missing key. */

nodes.name: HealthLevel
nodes.body_text: type HealthLevel = 'ok' | 'warn' | 'high';

nodes.name: healthLevel
nodes.body_text: healthLevel = (bytes: number): HealthLevel => (bytes >= BLOB_HIGH_BYTES ? 'high' : bytes >= BLOB_WARN_BYTES ? 'warn' : 'ok')

nodes.name: jsonBytes
nodes.body_text: jsonBytes = (value: unknown): number => (value === null || value === undefined ? 0 : Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(value), 'utf8'))

nodes.name: formatBytes
nodes.body_text: function formatBytes(bytes: number): string { if (bytes >= 1_048_576) return `${(bytes / 1_048_576).toFixed(2)} MB`; if (bytes >= 1024) return `${(bytes / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`; return `${bytes} B`; }

nodes.name: CollectionSummary
nodes.body_text: interface CollectionSummary { bytes: number; viewers: number; /** Every entry in every viewer's list (one per copy, duplicates included). */ entries: number; largest: { username: string; entries: number } | null; }

nodes.name: summarizeCollection
nodes.body_text: function summarizeCollection(collection: Record<string, number[]>): CollectionSummary { let entries = 0; let largest: CollectionSummary['largest'] = null; const names = Object.keys(collection); for (const name of names) { const n = Array.isArray(collection[name]) ? collection[name].length : 0; entries += n; if (!largest || n > largest.entries) largest = { username: name, entries: n }; } return { bytes: jsonBytes(collection), viewers: names.length, entries, largest }; }

nodes.name: sizeAttention
nodes.signature: function sizeAttention(seasonName: string, bytes: number): { level: HealthLevel; text: string } | null
nodes.body_text: function sizeAttention(seasonName: string, bytes: number): { level: HealthLevel; text: string } | null { const level = healthLevel(bytes); if (level === 'ok') return null; return { level, text: `${seasonName}'s collection data is ${formatBytes(bytes)}, and every pull, trade and upgrade rewrites all of it. ${level === 'high' ? 'It is large enough that the storage layout should be revisited.' : 'Keep an eye on it as the season grows.'}`, }; }

nodes.name: LedgerHealth
nodes.body_text: interface LedgerHealth { tracking: boolean; /** Copies alive right now (the id index). */ live: number; /** Copies that ended (upgraded, removed) and are kept with their history. */ retired: number; /** Distinct card + version editions that have a serial counter. */ editions: number; /** Total entries across the per-viewer ledger hashes read (a sample of at most OWNER_SAMPLE viewers). */ ownerEntries: number; largestOwner: { username: string; entries: number } | null; /** True when there were more viewers than the sample. */ sampled: boolean; }

nodes.name: SeasonHealth
nodes.body_text: interface SeasonHealth { id: string; name: string; active: boolean; collection: CollectionSummary; level: HealthLevel; ledger: LedgerHealth; }

nodes.name: TradesHealth
nodes.body_text: interface TradesHealth { openCount: number; openBytes: number; historyCount: number; historyBytes: number }

nodes.name: DataHealth
nodes.body_text: interface DataHealth { at: number; seasons: SeasonHealth[]; trades: TradesHealth; activityEvents: number; }

nodes.name: ledgerHealth
nodes.signature: async function ledgerHealth(collectionName: string, viewers: string[]): Promise<LedgerHealth>
nodes.body_text: async function ledgerHealth(collectionName: string, viewers: string[]): Promise<LedgerHealth> { const c = collectionName; const [init, live, retired, editions] = await Promise.all([ kv.get(`copies:${c}:init`).catch(() => null), kv.hlen(`copies:${c}:idx`).catch(() => 0), kv.hlen(`copies:${c}:ret`).catch(() => 0), kv.hlen(`copies:${c}:n`).catch(() => 0), ]); const tracking = !!init; const sample = tracking ? viewers.slice(0, OWNER_SAMPLE) : []; let ownerEntries = 0; let largestOwner: LedgerHealth['largestOwner'] = null; for (let i = 0; i < sample.length; i += BATCH) { const lens = await Promise.all(sample.slice(i, i + BATCH).map(u => kv.hlen(`copies:${c}:o:${u}`).catch(() => 0))); lens.forEach((len, j) => { const n = Number(len) || 0; ownerEntries += n; if (!largestOwner || n > largestOwner.entries) largestOwner = { username: sample[i + j], entries: n }; }); } return { tracking, live: Number(live) || 0, retired: Number(retired) || 0, editions: Number(editions) || 0, ownerEntries, largestOwner, sampled: tracking && viewers.length > OWNER_SAMPLE }; }

nodes.name: loadDataHealth
nodes.signature: async function loadDataHealth(activeSeasonId?: string | null): Promise<DataHealth>
nodes.body_text: async function loadDataHealth(activeSeasonId?: string | null): Promise<DataHealth> { const seasons = (await listSeasons()).filter(s => s.status !== 'draft'); const rows = await Promise.all(seasons.map(async (s): Promise<SeasonHealth> => { const raw = await getCollection(s.collectionName); const collection = summarizeCollection(raw); return { id: s.id, name: s.name, active: s.id === activeSeasonId, collection, level: healthLevel(collection.bytes), ledger: await ledgerHealth(s.collectionName, Object.keys(raw)) }; })); const [open, history, activityEvents] = await Promise.all([ kv.get<unknown[]>('trades:open').catch(() => null), kv.get<unknown[]>('trades:history').catch(() => null), kv.llen('activity:log').catch(() => 0), ]); return { at: Date.now(), seasons: rows, trades: { openCount: open?.length ?? 0, openBytes: jsonBytes(open), historyCount: history?.length ?? 0, historyBytes: jsonBytes(history) }, activityEvents: Number(activityEvents) || 0, }; }

nodes.name: db.ts
nodes.body_text: import { kv as prodKv } from '@vercel/kv'; import { AsyncLocalStorage } from 'node:async_hooks'; import { cookies, headers } from 'next/headers'; // The ONLY place that talks to Vercel KV. Everything else imports `kv` from here (scripts/check-kv-imports.mts fails if a // file imports '@vercel/kv' directly). // // Sandboxes: a request can be pinned to a sandbox, and then every key it touches is transparently prefixed with // `sbx:<id>:`, so nothing a sandbox does can reach production data. The sandbox comes from (first match wins): // 1. an explicit override (`runInSandbox`, used to carry the choice into `after()` callbacks and scripts), // 2. the `x-tcg-sandbox` request header (the overlay sends it when its URL has ?sandbox=<id>), // 3. the `tcg_sandbox` cookie (set when an admin enters a sandbox in the browser). // A sandbox id that doesn't exist (deleted, or junk) maps to a dead namespace. Never to production, so a stale cookie // can't make a "sandbox" request quietly hit real data. // // Preview deployments (VERCEL_ENV=preview) share the production store, so they are forced into one reserved namespace, // `sbx:preview:*`: the sandbox choice from cookie / header / override is ignored, and so is "outside a request" (which // would otherwise mean production). The raw `prodKv` is fenced there too: it can still read production (the staff list, // the sandbox seeding), but any write to a key outside `sbx:preview:` throws. export const SANDBOX_COOKIE = 'tcg_sandbox'; export const SANDBOX_HEADER = 'x-tcg-sandbox'; export const SANDBOX_REGISTRY_KEY = 'sandbox:registry'; // lives in the production namespace, never prefixed const ID_RE = /^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,22}[a-z0-9]$/; export const PREVIEW_ID = 'preview'; // reserved: the namespace every preview deployment is pinned to export const RESERVED_IDS: readonly string[] = [PREVIEW_ID]; const DEAD = '__missing__'; // not matchable by ID_RE, so no real sandbox can collide with it /** True on a Vercel preview deployment. Read per call (not at load) so scripts can switch it. */ const override = new AsyncLocalStorage<{ id: string | null }>(); /** Runs `fn` pinned to a sandbox (or to production with `null`), whatever the current request says. */ let known: { at: number; ids: Set<string> } | null = null; /** Forget the cached list of sandboxes (after creating or deleting one). */ /** The sandbox this request is in, or null for production. Never throws. */ /** True when the request is in a sandbox (including a dead one). Use it to switch off anything that reaches the outside world. */ /** Commands whose first argument is a key. Anything else is refused rather than risk an un-prefixed key. */ const KEY_FIRST = new Set([ 'get', 'set', 'getset', 'getdel', 'incr', 'incrby', 'decr', 'exists', 'expire', 'ttl', 'hget', 'hset', 'hgetall', 'hdel', 'hincrby', 'hexists', 'hlen', 'lpush', 'rpush', 'lpop', 'rpop', 'lrange', 'ltrim', 'llen', 'sadd', 'srem', 'smembers', 'sismember', 'scard', ]); /** Commands that only read. On a preview any other command is treated as a write and must stay inside `sbx:preview:`. */ const READ_ONLY = new Set(['get', 'mget', 'exists', 'ttl', 'type', 'strlen', 'hget', 'hgetall', 'hlen', 'hexists', 'hkeys', 'hvals', 'hmget', 'lrange', 'llen', 'lindex', 'smembers', 'sismember', 'scard', 'scan', 'zrange', 'zscore', 'zcard', 'dbsize']); const PREVIEW_PREFIX = `sbx:${PREVIEW_ID}:`; /** * The raw client with the preview fence: on a preview deployment, writes outside `sbx:preview:` throw and pipelines are * refused; everywhere else it is the plain client. Reads always pass through. */ const fenced: Kv = new Proxy(prodKv, { }) as Kv; /** The KV client every module uses. Same API as @vercel/kv; keys are namespaced when the request is in a sandbox. */ export const kv: Kv = new Proxy(fenced, { }) as Kv; /** The raw production client. Only the sandbox manager (lib/sandbox.ts) and the staff list (lib/staff.ts, real account data that must not change with the sandbox) should use this. */ export { fenced as prodKv };

nodes.name: isPreview
nodes.body_text: isPreview = () => process.env.VERCEL_ENV === 'preview'

nodes.name: runInSandbox
nodes.signature: function runInSandbox<T>(id: string | null, fn: () => T): T
nodes.body_text: function runInSandbox<T>(id: string | null, fn: () => T): T { return override.run({ id }, fn); }

nodes.name: sandboxExists
nodes.body_text: async function sandboxExists(id: string): Promise<boolean> { if (!known || Date.now() - known.at > 15_000) { const list = (await prodKv.get<{ id: string }[]>(SANDBOX_REGISTRY_KEY).catch(() => null)) ?? []; known = { at: Date.now(), ids: new Set(list.map(s => s.id)) }; } return known.ids.has(id); }

nodes.name: forgetSandboxCache
nodes.body_text: function forgetSandboxCache() { known = null; }

nodes.name: currentSandboxId
nodes.body_text: async function currentSandboxId(): Promise<string | null> { if (isPreview()) return PREVIEW_ID; const pinned = override.getStore(); if (pinned) return pinned.id; let raw: string | undefined; try { raw = (await headers()).get(SANDBOX_HEADER) || (await cookies()).get(SANDBOX_COOKIE)?.value || undefined; } catch { return null; // outside a request (a script): production } if (!raw) return null; if (!ID_RE.test(raw)) return DEAD; return (await sandboxExists(raw)) ? raw : DEAD; }

nodes.name: inSandbox
nodes.body_text: async function inSandbox(): Promise<boolean> { return (await currentSandboxId()) !== null; }

nodes.name: prefixed
nodes.body_text: prefixed = (id: string, key: unknown) => `sbx:${id}:${String(key)}`

nodes.name: Kv
nodes.body_text: type Kv = typeof prodKv;

nodes.name: get
nodes.body_text: get(target, prop) { const orig = (target as unknown as Record<string | symbol, unknown>)[prop]; if (typeof orig !== 'function' || typeof prop !== 'string') return orig; const name = prop.toLowerCase(); return (...args: unknown[]) => { if (isPreview() && !READ_ONLY.has(name)) { if (name === 'pipeline' || name === 'multi') return Promise.reject(new Error(`kv.${prop} is not available on a preview deployment`)); const keys = name === 'del' || name === 'unlink' ? args : [args[0]]; if (!keys.every(k => typeof k === 'string' && k.startsWith(PREVIEW_PREFIX))) return Promise.reject(new Error(`Blocked: a preview deployment may not write outside ${PREVIEW_PREFIX}* (kv.${prop})`)); } return (orig as (...a: unknown[]) => unknown).apply(target, args); }; }

nodes.name: get
nodes.body_text: get(target, prop) { const orig = (target as unknown as Record<string | symbol, unknown>)[prop]; if (typeof orig !== 'function' || typeof prop !== 'string') return orig; return async (...args: unknown[]) => { const id = await currentSandboxId(); if (id === null) return (orig as (...a: unknown[]) => unknown).apply(target, args); if (prop === 'del') return (orig as (...a: unknown[]) => unknown).apply(target, args.map(k => prefixed(id, k))); if (!KEY_FIRST.has(prop.toLowerCase())) throw new Error(`kv.${prop} is not supported by the namespaced client`); return (orig as (...a: unknown[]) => unknown).apply(target, [prefixed(id, args[0]), ...args.slice(1)]); }; }

nodes.name: dex-view.ts
nodes.body_text: // Filtering and sorting for the Card Dex (pure, client-safe). export const SORT_LABELS: Record<DexSort, string> = { number: 'Card number', rarity: 'Rarest first', value: 'Most valuable', copies: 'Most pulled', collectors: 'Most collectors', name: 'Name', missing: 'Missing first', }; export const DEFAULT_DEX: DexFilter = { q: '', stars: null, pack: '', show: 'all', sort: 'number', dir: 1 }; /** The natural direction of each sort (rarest, most valuable, most pulled and most collectors lead with the biggest). */ const NATURAL: Record<DexSort, 1 | -1> = { number: 1, rarity: 1, value: -1, copies: -1, collectors: -1, name: 1, missing: 1 }; /** Owned of total, for the viewer's progress bar. */

nodes.name: DexShow
nodes.body_text: type DexShow = 'all' | 'collected' | 'missing' | 'wanted' | 'undiscovered';

nodes.name: DexSort
nodes.body_text: type DexSort = 'number' | 'rarity' | 'value' | 'copies' | 'collectors' | 'name' | 'missing';

nodes.name: DexRow
nodes.body_text: interface DexRow { number: number; name: string; stars: number; packName: string; pullRate: number; copies: number; collectors: number; /** Points of one Regular copy. */ value: number; owned?: boolean; wanted?: boolean; }

nodes.name: DexFilter
nodes.body_text: interface DexFilter { q: string; stars: number | null; pack: string; show: DexShow; sort: DexSort; dir: 1 | -1 }

nodes.name: applyDex
nodes.signature: function applyDex<T extends DexRow>(cards: T[], f: DexFilter): T[]
nodes.body_text: function applyDex<T extends DexRow>(cards: T[], f: DexFilter): T[] { const q = f.q.trim().toLowerCase(); const keep = (c: T): boolean => { if (f.stars !== null && c.stars !== f.stars) return false; if (f.pack && c.packName !== f.pack) return false; if (q && !(c.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) || String(c.number) === q.replace('#', ''))) return false; switch (f.show) { case 'collected': return !!c.owned; case 'missing': return !c.owned; case 'wanted': return !!c.wanted; case 'undiscovered': return c.copies === 0; default: return true; } }; const key = (c: T): number | string => { switch (f.sort) { case 'rarity': return c.pullRate; // a smaller pull rate = rarer case 'value': return c.value; case 'copies': return c.copies; case 'collectors': return c.collectors; case 'name': return c.name.toLowerCase(); case 'missing': return c.owned ? 1 : 0; default: return c.number; } }; const sign = NATURAL[f.sort] * f.dir; return cards.filter(keep).sort((a, b) => { const ka = key(a), kb = key(b); const cmp = ka < kb ? -1 : ka > kb ? 1 : 0; return cmp * sign || a.number - b.number; }); }

nodes.name: keep
nodes.body_text: keep = (c: T): boolean => { if (f.stars !== null && c.stars !== f.stars) return false; if (f.pack && c.packName !== f.pack) return false; if (q && !(c.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) || String(c.number) === q.replace('#', ''))) return false; switch (f.show) { case 'collected': return !!c.owned; case 'missing': return !c.owned; case 'wanted': return !!c.wanted; case 'undiscovered': return c.copies === 0; default: return true; } }

nodes.name: key
nodes.body_text: key = (c: T): number | string => { switch (f.sort) { case 'rarity': return c.pullRate; // a smaller pull rate = rarer case 'value': return c.value; case 'copies': return c.copies; case 'collectors': return c.collectors; case 'name': return c.name.toLowerCase(); case 'missing': return c.owned ? 1 : 0; default: return c.number; } }

nodes.name: dexProgress
nodes.signature: function dexProgress(cards: DexRow[]): { owned: number; total: number; pct: number }
nodes.body_text: function dexProgress(cards: DexRow[]): { owned: number; total: number; pct: number } { const owned = cards.filter(c => c.owned).length; return { owned, total: cards.length, pct: cards.length ? Math.round((owned / cards.length) * 100) : 0 }; }

nodes.name: discord-config.ts
nodes.body_text: // Discord feed settings types + constants. Browser-safe (no server imports) so the admin UI can use // them; the server-side logic lives in ./discord.ts. /** The kinds of feedback post a channel can pick from. 'report' is the profile report of ROADMAP 17.2 (the profile menu files it). */ export const FEEDBACK_FILTER_KINDS: FeedbackFilterKind[] = ['idea', 'bug', 'deletion', 'report']; /** What the channel card offers as ticks. */ export const FEEDBACK_FILTER_OPTIONS: { key: FeedbackFilterKind; label: string }[] = [ { key: 'idea', label: 'Suggestions' }, { key: 'bug', label: 'Problems' }, { key: 'deletion', label: 'Deletion requests' }, { key: 'report', label: 'Reports' }, ]; /** One webhook (one Discord channel) with its own switch and its own choice of what to post. */ /** One send attempt, newest first in the channel's delivery log. */ export const DISCORD_LOG_CAP = 20; export const MAX_DISCORD_CHANNELS = 25; export const DEFAULT_CATEGORIES: Record<DiscordCategory, boolean> = { pulls: true, cards: true, upgrades: true, trades: true, listings: false, recap: false, digest: false, feedback: false, stream: false, resets: true, admin: false, system: false }; export const DEFAULT_DISCORD: DiscordSettings = { enabled: false, channels: [] }; export const DISCORD_CATEGORIES: { key: DiscordCategory; label: string; hint: string }[] = [ { key: 'pulls', label: 'Card pulls', hint: 'Every pack opened on stream' }, { key: 'cards', label: 'Grants & removals', hint: 'Cards given or taken away by an admin or webhook' }, { key: 'upgrades', label: 'Upgrades', hint: 'Cards upgraded to a better version, with a link to the new print' }, { key: 'trades', label: 'Trades', hint: 'Completed trades, counter-offers and admin cancels' }, { key: 'listings', label: 'Trade listings', hint: 'New listings on the trade board, each with a link to its trade page' }, { key: 'recap', label: 'Stream recap', hint: 'One summary after each stream: packs opened, new collectors, the rarest pull, the top puller and trades' }, { key: 'digest', label: 'Weekly digest', hint: 'One post each Sunday evening: pulls, new collectors and trades, the top 3, movers, the most traded and most wanted cards and the print of the week' }, { key: 'feedback', label: 'Feedback', hint: 'Each new suggestion and problem report, with the sender’s login (the text is cut and Markdown-escaped)' }, { key: 'stream', label: 'Stream triggers', hint: 'Pack draws / collection views requested, and collections shown' }, { key: 'resets', label: 'Resets & deletions', hint: 'Collections reset or users deleted' }, { key: 'admin', label: 'Admin log', hint: 'What staff did, with their names (grants, removals, resets, staff changes, seasons, packs, scoring, trading paused). Keep this channel private' }, { key: 'system', label: 'System', hint: 'Backup results, data-health warnings, sandboxes, the stream going live or offline' }, ]; const NONE: Record<DiscordCategory, boolean> = { pulls: false, cards: false, upgrades: false, trades: false, listings: false, recap: false, digest: false, feedback: false, stream: false, resets: false, admin: false, system: false }; /** "Add channel" presets: a name and the boxes ticked for it. */ export const DISCORD_PRESETS: { key: string; name: string; hint: string; categories: Partial<Record<DiscordCategory, boolean>>; feedbackKinds?: FeedbackFilterKind[] }[] = [ { key: 'activity', name: 'Activity', hint: 'Pulls, grants, upgrades, trades and resets', categories: { pulls: true, cards: true, upgrades: true, trades: true, resets: true } }, { key: 'pulls', name: 'Pulls', hint: 'Every card pulled on stream', categories: { pulls: true } }, { key: 'upgrades', name: 'Upgrades', hint: 'Cards upgraded to a better version', categories: { upgrades: true } }, { key: 'trades', name: 'Trades', hint: 'Completed trades and counter-offers', categories: { trades: true } }, { key: 'listings', name: 'Trade listings', hint: 'New board listings, linked to the trade', categories: { listings: true } }, { key: 'recap', name: 'Stream recap', hint: 'One summary when the stream ends', categories: { recap: true } }, { key: 'digest', name: 'Weekly digest', hint: 'One summary every Sunday evening', categories: { digest: true } }, { key: 'feedback', name: 'Feedback', hint: 'New suggestions and problem reports', categories: { feedback: true }, feedbackKinds: ['idea', 'bug'] }, { key: 'requests', name: 'Requests and reports', hint: 'Deletion requests and user reports. Keep this channel private', categories: { feedback: true }, feedbackKinds: ['deletion', 'report'] }, { key: 'admin', name: 'Admin log', hint: 'What staff did, by name (keep it private)', categories: { admin: true } }, { key: 'system', name: 'System', hint: 'Backups, data health, sandboxes, live status', categories: { system: true } }, { key: 'stream', name: 'Stream', hint: 'Draws requested and collections shown', categories: { stream: true } }, ]; /** Steps for the "Deploys & code" card: GitHub (and so Vercel) changes posted straight to Discord, no server code involved. */ export const DEPLOY_STEPS: string[] = [ 'In Discord, make a webhook for the channel you want (Channel settings, Integrations, Webhooks, New Webhook, Copy Webhook URL).', 'In the GitHub repository open Settings, Webhooks, Add webhook.', 'Payload URL: the Discord webhook URL with /github added on the end. Content type: application/json.', 'Choose individual events: Pushes, Pull requests, Releases and Deployment statuses.', 'Vercel reports every deployment to GitHub as a deployment status, so "deployed to Production / Preview" shows up in the same channel with its link.', ];

nodes.body_text: interface DiscordChannel { id: string; name: string; url: string; enabled: boolean; categories: Record<DiscordCategory, boolean>; minStars: number; // pulls below this rarity are skipped newOnly: boolean; // pulls: only announce cards the viewer didn't have yet /** Feedback: which kinds of post this channel gets. Absent = all of them (so existing channels are unchanged). */ feedbackKinds?: FeedbackFilterKind[]; /** Set when the channel was switched off automatically after repeated failed sends (cleared when it is switched on again). */ offReason?: string; }

nodes.body_text: interface DiscordLogEntry { at: number; kind: string; ok: boolean; status: number; error?: string }

nodes.name: newChannelId
nodes.body_text: function newChannelId(): string { return Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10); }

nodes.name: presetChannel
nodes.body_text: function presetChannel(key: string): DiscordChannel { const p = DISCORD_PRESETS.find(x => x.key === key) ?? DISCORD_PRESETS[0]; return { id: newChannelId(), name: p.name, url: '', enabled: false, categories: { ...NONE, ...p.categories }, minStars: 1, newOnly: false, ...(p.feedbackKinds ? { feedbackKinds: [...p.feedbackKinds] } : {}) }; }

nodes.body_text: import { kv, inSandbox } from './db'; import { after } from 'next/server'; import type { ActivityEvent } from './activity'; import { getActiveSeasonWithPacks } from './kv'; import { cardThumbUrl, stillFor, type StillFields } from './card-art'; import { getRarity } from './rarity'; import { getAvatars, sizeTwitchAvatar } from './avatars'; import { VARIANT_LABELS } from './variants'; import type { Variant } from './types'; import type { StreamRecap } from './stream-recap'; import type { WeeklyDigest } from './weekly-digest'; import { REPORT_REASON_LABELS, discordText, type FeedbackItem } from './feedback-core'; import { SITE_URL } from './site'; import { copyHrefFor } from './copy-link'; import { FEEDBACK_FILTER_KINDS, type FeedbackFilterKind, DEFAULT_CATEGORIES, DEFAULT_DISCORD, MAX_DISCORD_CHANNELS, type DiscordCategory, type DiscordChannel, type DiscordLogEntry, type DiscordSettings, DISCORD_LOG_CAP } from './discord-config'; export { DISCORD_CATEGORIES, DEFAULT_DISCORD } from './discord-config'; export type { DiscordCategory, DiscordChannel, DiscordSettings } from './discord-config'; // Posts the live activity feed to a Discord channel through an incoming webhook. // Settings live in KV (`discord:settings`); events arrive from recordActivity() in lib/activity.ts. const KEY = 'discord:settings'; /** Channels saved before upgrades and trades had boxes of their own keep posting them wherever `cards` was ticked. */ /** A channel's feedback filter: only known kinds, once each; all four (or no list) means "everything", which is stored as no list. An empty list is kept (the channel gets no feedback). */ /** Does this channel want a feedback post of this kind? (Whether it has Feedback ticked is checked by the caller.) */ /** * Reads whatever is stored. The first version kept one webhook at the top level ({ url, enabled, categories, minStars, newOnly }); * that becomes one channel called "Activity" with the same settings, so nothing changes until an admin edits it. */ /** * Only real Discord webhook URLs are accepted. The server POSTs to whatever is stored here, so an * arbitrary URL would let a typo (or a compromised session) aim requests at any host. * Outside production a plain http://localhost URL is also allowed so the feature can be tested * against a local stand-in. */ /** Does this channel want this event? (Whether the channel is switched on is checked by the caller.) */ /** The newest event (the list is newest first) that this channel's filters would let through, or undefined. nodes.body_text: function normalize(s: (Partial<DiscordSettings> & Partial<DiscordChannel>) | null | undefined): DiscordSettings { if (!s) return { ...DEFAULT_DISCORD, channels: [] }; if (!Array.isArray(s.channels)) { const url = typeof s.url === 'string' ? s.url.trim() : ''; if (!url) return { enabled: !!s.enabled, channels: [] }; return { enabled: !!s.enabled, channels: [normalizeChannel({ ...s, id: 'activity', name: 'Activity', enabled: true }, 'activity')] }; } const seen = new Set<string>(); const channels = s.channels.slice(0, MAX_DISCORD_CHANNELS).map((c, i) => { let ch = normalizeChannel(c, `channel${i + 1}`); while (seen.has(ch.id)) ch = { ...ch, id: ch.id + 'x' }; seen.add(ch.id); return ch; }); return { enabled: !!s.enabled, channels }; }

nodes.name: categoryOf
nodes.body_text: function categoryOf(e: ActivityEvent): DiscordCategory { switch (e.type) { case 'pull': return 'pulls'; case 'grant': return e.source === 'webhook' ? 'pulls' : 'cards'; // a webhook reward posts like a pull case 'remove': return 'cards'; case 'upgrade': return 'upgrades'; case 'trade': return 'trades'; case 'trigger': case 'collection_shown': return 'stream'; default: return 'resets'; // reset, delete } }

nodes.name: shouldSend
nodes.signature: function shouldSend(e: ActivityEvent, c: Pick<DiscordChannel, 'categories' | 'minStars' | 'newOnly'>): boolean
nodes.body_text: function shouldSend(e: ActivityEvent, c: Pick<DiscordChannel, 'categories' | 'minStars' | 'newOnly'>): boolean { // A staff action also goes to channels with the admin log on (which is where the staff member's name shows). if (!c.categories[categoryOf(e)] && !(e.staff && c.categories.admin)) return false; // Offers, counters, completed trades and admin cancels are worth a post; a viewer declining, withdrawing or letting one expire is noise. if (e.type === 'trade' && !(e.action === 'offered' || e.action === 'countered' || e.action === 'accepted' || e.by === 'admin')) return false; // A webhook grant counts as a pull for the star and new-only filters (when it carries the facts; older ones pass). if (e.type === 'pull' || (e.type === 'grant' && e.source === 'webhook')) { if (e.stars !== undefined && e.stars < c.minStars) return false; if (c.newOnly && e.isNew === false) return false; } return true; }

nodes.signature: function newestMatchingEvent(events: ActivityEvent[], c: Pick<DiscordChannel, 'categories' | 'minStars' | 'newOnly'>): ActivityEvent | undefined
nodes.body_text: function newestMatchingEvent(events: ActivityEvent[], c: Pick<DiscordChannel, 'categories' | 'minStars' | 'newOnly'>): ActivityEvent | undefined { return events.find(e => shouldSend(e, c)); }

nodes.body_text: function cleanDiscordInput(raw: unknown): { ok: true; settings: DiscordSettings } | { ok: false; message: string } { const r = raw as Partial<DiscordSettings> | null; if (!r || typeof r !== 'object' || !Array.isArray(r.channels)) return { ok: false, message: 'The settings could not be read. Reload the page and try again.' }; if (r.channels.length > MAX_DISCORD_CHANNELS) return { ok: false, message: `At most ${MAX_DISCORD_CHANNELS} channels.` }; const settings = normalize({ enabled: !!r.enabled, channels: r.channels }); for (const c of settings.channels) { if (c.url && !isValidDiscordWebhookUrl(c.url)) return { ok: false, message: `${c.name}: that doesn’t look like a Discord webhook URL. nodes.body_text: async function postToDiscord(url: string, body: DiscordPayload): Promise<SendResult> { if (!isValidDiscordWebhookUrl(url)) return { ok: false, status: 0, error: 'That is not a Discord webhook URL.' }; for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 2; attempt++) { try { const res = await fetch(url, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body), signal: AbortSignal.timeout(5000), }); if (res.ok) return { ok: true, status: res.status }; const text = await res.text().catch(() => ''); if (res.status === 429 && attempt === 0) { const retry = Number(JSON.parse(text || '{}').retry_after); if (retry > 0 && retry <= 5) { await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, retry * 1000)); continue; } } let message = text.slice(0, 200); try { message = JSON.parse(text).message ?? message; } catch { /* not JSON */ } return { ok: false, status: res.status, error: message || `HTTP ${res.status}` }; } catch (err) { return { ok: false, status: 0, error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Request failed' }; } } return { ok: false, status: 429, error: 'Rate limited by Discord' }; }

nodes.name: recordDelivery
nodes.signature: async function recordDelivery(channel: DiscordChannel, kind: string, r: SendResult): Promise<void>
nodes.body_text: async function recordDelivery(channel: DiscordChannel, kind: string, r: SendResult): Promise<void> { try { const entry: DiscordLogEntry = { at: Date.now(), kind, ok: r.ok, status: r.status, ...(r.error ? { error: r.error.slice(0, 200) } : {}) }; await kv.lpush(logKey(channel.id), entry); await kv.ltrim(logKey(channel.id), 0, DISCORD_LOG_CAP - 1); if (r.ok) return; const log = await getDiscordLog(channel.id); if (log.length < DISCORD_LOG_CAP || !log.every(e => !e.ok)) return; const settings = await getDiscordSettings(); const stored = settings.channels.find(x => x.id === channel.id); if (!stored?.enabled) return; stored.enabled = false; stored.offReason = `Switched off after ${DISCORD_LOG_CAP} failed sends in a row (last: ${r.error ?? `HTTP ${r.status}`})`.slice(0, 300); await saveDiscordSettings(settings); void notifyAdminLog({ action: 'Discord channel switched off', subject: stored.name, detail: stored.offReason }); } catch { /* the log is best effort */ } }

nodes.name: validatePack
nodes.signature: function validatePack(pack: PackFields, cards: CardFields[]): Issue[]
nodes.body_text: function validatePack(pack: PackFields, cards: CardFields[]): Issue[] { const issues: Issue[] = []; if (!pack.name.trim()) issues.push({ step: 'details', message: 'Give the pack a name.' }); if (cards.length === 0) { issues.push({ step: 'cards', message: 'Add at least one card.' }); } else { const unnamed = cards.filter(c => !c.name.trim()).length; const noImage = cards.filter(c => !c.imageUrl).length; const noOdds = cards.filter(c => !(c.probability > 0)).length; const badStars = cards.filter(c => !(c.stars >= 1 && c.stars <= 5)).length; const plural = (n: number) => `${n} card${n === 1 ? '' : 's'}`; if (unnamed) issues.push({ step: 'cards', message: `${plural(unnamed)} ${unnamed === 1 ? 'has' : 'have'} no name.` }); if (noImage) issues.push({ step: 'cards', message: `${plural(noImage)} ${noImage === 1 ? 'has' : 'have'} no image.` }); if (noOdds) issues.push({ step: 'cards', message: `${plural(noOdds)} ${noOdds === 1 ? 'has' : 'have'} a probability of 0 and could never be pulled.` }); if (badStars) issues.push({ step: 'cards', message: `${plural(badStars)} ${badStars === 1 ? 'has' : 'have'} a star rating outside 1–5.` }); } if (pack.upgradesEnabled && !(pack.variantWeights.regular > 0)) { issues.push({ step: 'upgrades', message: 'The Regular weight must be above 0, or every pull would be a rare variant.' }); } return issues; }

nodes.name: validateSeason
nodes.signature: function validateSeason( season: Pick<Season, 'name' | 'collectionName' | 'packIds'> & Partial<Pick<Season, 'startsAt' | 'endsAt'>>, /** Collection names used by *other* seasons, sharing one would merge two seasons' collections. */ otherCollectionNames: string[], ): Issue[]
nodes.body_text: function validateSeason( season: Pick<Season, 'name' | 'collectionName' | 'packIds'> & Partial<Pick<Season, 'startsAt' | 'endsAt'>>, /** Collection names used by *other* seasons, sharing one would merge two seasons' collections. */ otherCollectionNames: string[], ): Issue[] { const issues: Issue[] = []; if (!season.name.trim()) issues.push({ step: 'details', message: 'Give the season a name.' }); const key = season.collectionName.trim(); if (!key) { issues.push({ step: 'details', message: 'Choose a collection name.' }); } else { if (/\s/.test(key)) issues.push({ step: 'details', message: 'The collection name can\'t contain spaces.' }); if (otherCollectionNames.some(n => n.toLowerCase() === key.toLowerCase())) { issues.push({ step: 'details', message: `Another season already uses "${key}", viewers' cards would be shared between them.` }); } } if (season.startsAt !== undefined && season.endsAt !== undefined && season.endsAt <= season.startsAt) issues.push({ step: 'details', message: 'The end date must be after the start date.' }); if (season.packIds.length === 0) issues.push({ step: 'packs', message: 'Attach at least one pack.' }); return issues; }

nodes.name: draw.ts
nodes.body_text: // Server-side pulls (ROADMAP Track 13). The server rolls what a queued pull will be, stores it as a one-use ticket, and the overlay // only plays it and reports back with the ticket id. `/api/collection` then saves what the TICKET says, never what the caller says, // so nobody who finds that URL can write cards. The odds are the ones the overlay always used: a pack by its weight, a card by its // probability, then (where the pack and card have variants on) a version by the pack's weights. import { kv } from './db'; import { getActiveSeasonWithPacks } from './kv'; import { DEFAULT_VARIANT_WEIGHTS, VARIANTS, encodeEntry } from './variants'; import type { Card, Pack, Variant } from './types'; const TICKET_TTL_S = 12 * 3600; // an overlay that is offline plays queued pulls when it comes back, so be generous /** Rolls one pull from the given packs. Pure apart from `rng` (so a script can test the odds). Null when there is nothing to draw. */ /** What the overlay needs to play the pull. */ /** Rolls a pull for a viewer and stores its ticket under `id`. Null when the active season has nothing to draw. */ /** Takes a ticket, once. Null = unknown, expired, already used or for another viewer (nothing is saved then). */ /** Throws a ticket away (a pull that was never queued). */

nodes.name: ticketKey
nodes.body_text: ticketKey = (id: string) => `draw:${id}`

nodes.name: DrawResult
nodes.body_text: interface DrawResult { pack: Pack; card: Card; variant: Variant }

nodes.name: rollDraw
nodes.signature: function rollDraw(packs: { pack: Pack; cards: Card[] }[], rng: () => number = Math.random): DrawResult | null
nodes.body_text: function rollDraw(packs: { pack: Pack; cards: Card[] }[], rng: () => number = Math.random): DrawResult | null { const usable = packs.filter(p => p.cards.length > 0); if (usable.length === 0) return null; const totalWeight = usable.reduce((s, { pack }) => s + (pack.weight || 1), 0); let rw = rng() * totalWeight; let chosen = usable[usable.length - 1]; for (const p of usable) { rw -= p.pack.weight || 1; if (rw <= 0) { chosen = p; break; } } const totalProb = chosen.cards.reduce((s, c) => s + c.probability, 0); let rp = rng() * totalProb; let card = chosen.cards[chosen.cards.length - 1]; for (const c of chosen.cards) { rp -= c.probability; if (rp <= 0) { card = c; break; } } let variant: Variant = 'regular'; if (chosen.pack.upgradesEnabled && card.upgradesEnabled !== false) { const w = { ...DEFAULT_VARIANT_WEIGHTS, ...chosen.pack.variantWeights }; const off = [...(chosen.pack.disabledVariants ?? []), ...(card.disabledVariants ?? [])] as Variant[]; const weight = (v: Variant) => (v !== 'regular' && off.includes(v) ? 0 : Math.max(0, w[v])); const total = VARIANTS.reduce((s, v) => s + weight(v), 0); if (total > 0) { let r = rng() * total; for (const v of VARIANTS) { r -= weight(v); if (r < 0) { variant = v; break; } } } } return { pack: chosen.pack, card, variant }; }

nodes.name: weight
nodes.body_text: weight = (v: Variant) => (v !== 'regular' && off.includes(v) ? 0 : Math.max(0, w[v]))

nodes.name: DrawTicket
nodes.body_text: interface DrawTicket { username: string; collectionName: string; packId: string; packName: string; cardNumber: number; cardName: string; stars: number; variant: Variant; /** The collection entry to add (card + version, see lib/variants.ts). */ entry: number; /** A Mix It Up payment was reserved under the same id (lib/mixitup.ts). */ paid: boolean; }

nodes.name: QueuedDraw
nodes.body_text: interface QueuedDraw { packId: string; cardNumber: number; variant: Variant }

nodes.name: issueDraw
nodes.signature: async function issueDraw(id: string, username: string, paid = false): Promise<QueuedDraw | null>
nodes.body_text: async function issueDraw(id: string, username: string, paid = false): Promise<QueuedDraw | null> { const active = await getActiveSeasonWithPacks(); const rolled = active ? rollDraw(active.packs) : null; if (!active || !rolled) return null; const { pack, card, variant } = rolled; const ticket: DrawTicket = { username: username.toLowerCase(), collectionName: active.season.collectionName, packId: pack.id, packName: pack.name, cardNumber: card.number, cardName: card.name, stars: card.stars, variant, entry: encodeEntry(card.number, variant), paid, }; await kv.set(ticketKey(id), ticket, { ex: TICKET_TTL_S }); return { packId: pack.id, cardNumber: card.number, variant }; }

nodes.name: claimDraw
nodes.signature: async function claimDraw(id: string, username: string): Promise<DrawTicket | null>
nodes.body_text: async function claimDraw(id: string, username: string): Promise<DrawTicket | null> { const t = await kv.get<DrawTicket>(ticketKey(id)); if (!t || t.username !== username.toLowerCase()) return null; return (await kv.del(ticketKey(id))) === 1 ? t : null; }

nodes.body_text: async function dropDraw(id: string): Promise<void> { await kv.del(ticketKey(id)).catch(() => {}); }

nodes.name: email-core.ts
nodes.body_text: // Email notifications, the client-safe half: the stored record, address checks and how a batch of notices becomes one email. // Sending, tokens and storage live in lib/email.ts (Node only). Kinds are the same four groups as Web Push (offers, results, // listing alerts, admin), but email starts with offers and results only. import { PUSH_KINDS, pushGroup, payloadFor, type PushKind } from './push-core'; import type { Notice } from './trade-notice-core'; export const EMAIL_KINDS = PUSH_KINDS; export const EMAIL_DEFAULT_KINDS: EmailKind[] = ['offers', 'results']; /** At most one email per viewer in this window; notices that arrive inside it wait and go out together. */ export const EMAIL_WINDOW_S = 15 * 60; /** The confirmation link works this long. */ export const EMAIL_CONFIRM_TTL_S = 24 * 60 * 60; /** A batch never lists more than this many notices (the rest are counted). */ export const EMAIL_BATCH_MAX = 20; /** Notices waiting for the window to pass are capped, so a flood cannot grow the queue without end. */ export const EMAIL_QUEUE_MAX = 60; /** A lower-cased address, or null when it does not look like one. Deliberately simple: the confirmation email is the real test. */ /** "a***@example.com": enough to recognise it, not enough to read it over a shoulder. */ /** Does this record want an email for this kind of notice right now? */ const NOUN: Record<string, [string, string]> = { offer: ['new trade offer', 'new trade offers'], countered: ['counter offer', 'counter offers'], accepted: ['accepted trade', 'accepted trades'], declined: ['declined offer', 'declined offers'], cancelled: ['cancelled offer', 'cancelled offers'], expired: ['expired offer', 'expired offers'], watch: ['new listing for a card you watch', 'new listings for cards you watch'], admin: ['message from the admins', 'messages from the admins'], feedback: ['answer to your feedback', 'answers to your feedback'], }; /** One email for one or more notices. `base` is the site address; the two links are absolute and already signed. */

nodes.name: EmailKind
nodes.body_text: type EmailKind = PushKind;

nodes.name: EmailOff
nodes.body_text: type EmailOff = 'unsubscribed' | 'bounced' | 'complained';

nodes.name: EmailRecord
nodes.body_text: interface EmailRecord { address: string; addedAt: number; verifiedAt?: number; kinds: EmailKind[]; off?: EmailOff }

nodes.name: EmailStatus
nodes.body_text: type EmailStatus = 'pending' | 'on' | 'off';

nodes.name: emailStatus
nodes.body_text: emailStatus = (r: EmailRecord): EmailStatus => (r.off ? 'off' : r.verifiedAt ? 'on' : 'pending')

nodes.name: normalizeAddress
nodes.body_text: function normalizeAddress(v: unknown): string | null { if (typeof v !== 'string') return null; const a = v.trim().toLowerCase(); if (a.length < 6 || a.length > 254 || /[\s<>,;"()\\[\]]/.test(a)) return null; return /^[a-z0-9.!#$%&'*+/=?^_`{|}~-]{1,64}@[a-z0-9-]+(\.[a-z0-9-]+)+$/.test(a) && !a.includes('..') ? a : null; }

nodes.name: maskAddress
nodes.body_text: function maskAddress(a: string): string { const [name, domain] = a.split('@'); return `${name.slice(0, 1)}***@${domain}`; }

nodes.name: sanitizeEmailKinds
nodes.body_text: function sanitizeEmailKinds(v: unknown): EmailKind[] { return Array.isArray(v) ? EMAIL_KINDS.filter(k => v.includes(k)) : [...EMAIL_DEFAULT_KINDS]; }

nodes.name: sanitizeEmailRecord
nodes.body_text: function sanitizeEmailRecord(raw: unknown): EmailRecord | null { const o = (raw && typeof raw === 'object' ? raw : null) as Record<string, unknown> | null; const address = o ? normalizeAddress(o.address) : null; if (!o || !address) return null; const off = o.off === 'unsubscribed' || o.off === 'bounced' || o.off === 'complained' ? o.off : undefined; return { address, addedAt: typeof o.addedAt === 'number' ? o.addedAt : 0, kinds: sanitizeEmailKinds(o.kinds), ...(typeof o.verifiedAt === 'number' ? { verifiedAt: o.verifiedAt } : {}), ...(off ? { off } : {}), }; }

nodes.signature: emailWants = (r: EmailRecord | null, kind: string): boolean
nodes.body_text: emailWants = (r: EmailRecord | null, kind: string): boolean => !!r && emailStatus(r) === 'on' && r.kinds.includes(pushGroup(kind))

nodes.body_text: esc = (s: string) => s.replace(/&/g, '&').replace(/</g, '<').replace(/>/g, '>').replace(/"/g, '"')

nodes.name: BuiltEmail
nodes.body_text: interface BuiltEmail { subject: string; text: string; html: string }

nodes.name: buildEmail
nodes.signature: function buildEmail(items: Notice[], links: { base: string; unsubscribe: string; manage: string }, appName: string): BuiltEmail
nodes.body_text:
function buildEmail(items: Notice[], links: { base: string; unsubscribe: string; manage: string }, appName: string): BuiltEmail { const total = items.length; const shown = items.slice(0, EMAIL_BATCH_MAX); const kinds = new Set(items.map(n => n.kind)); let subject: string; if (total === 1) subject = payloadFor(items[0]).title; else if (kinds.size === 1) subject = `${total} ${NOUN[items[0].kind]?.[1] ?? 'new notices'}`; else subject = `${total} new notices on ${appName}`; const url = (n: Notice) => links.base + payloadFor(n).url; const more = total > shown.length ? `And ${total - shown.length} more. Open your notifications to see them all.` : ''; const text = [ ...shown.map(n => `- ${n.text}\n ${url(n)}`), ...(more ? ['', more] : []), '', `Open the site: ${links.base}/notifications`, '', `You get this because you asked for email notifications on ${appName}.`, `Choose what you get: ${links.manage}`, `Stop these emails: ${links.unsubscribe}`, ].join('\n'); const li = shown.map(n => `
  • ${esc(n.text)}
    Open it
    • `).join(''); const html = `

    ${esc(subject)}

      ${li}
    ${more ? `

    ${esc(more)}

    ` : ''}

    Open your notifications

    You get this because you asked for email notifications on ${esc(appName)}. Choose what you get or stop these emails.

    `; return { subject, text, html }; }

nodes.body_text: url = (n: Notice) => links.base + payloadFor(n).url
