nodes.body_text: import { after } from 'next/server'; import { createHash, createHmac, timingSafeEqual } from 'node:crypto'; import { kv, inSandbox } from './db'; import { withLock } from './kv'; import { getUserSettings } from './user-settings-store'; import { wantsNotice } from './user-settings'; import { SITE_URL } from './site'; import { APP_NAME } from './legal'; import { EMAIL_CONFIRM_TTL_S, EMAIL_DEFAULT_KINDS, EMAIL_QUEUE_MAX, EMAIL_WINDOW_S, buildConfirmEmail, buildEmail, emailStatus, emailWants, normalizeAddress, sanitizeEmailKinds, sanitizeEmailRecord, type BuiltEmail, type EmailOff, type EmailRecord, } from './email-core'; import type { Notice } from './trade-notice-core'; // Email notifications through Resend's REST API (ROADMAP 22.1): the only file that talks to it. Node runtime only; never import it from // client code or the edge middleware. Without RESEND_API_KEY (and a SESSION_SECRET to sign links with) the whole feature is hidden and // every function here is a quiet no-op. Nothing is sent from a sandbox or preview. The record lives at user:<u>:email. // // Batching has no background job: a notice joins the viewer's queue (email:q:<u>); one email goes out per EMAIL_WINDOW_S (the window is a // SET NX EX key, email:last:<u>) and takes the whole queue. Notices that arrive inside the window wait for the next notice or for the // daily cron (flushDueEmails). const PENDING_SET = 'email:pending'; /** RESEND_API_URL points the sender at a fake, outside production only. */ // ── signed links ── /** The viewer and address hash a confirmation token vouches for, or null (forged, edited or expired). */ /** No expiry: an unsubscribe link in an old email must keep working. It only ever switches email off. */ // ── storage ── /** Account deletion: the record, the queue and the window. */ // ── sending ── /** One message through Resend. Returns false on any failure (logged without the address). */ /** Settings -> Email: store the (unconfirmed) address and send the confirmation link. Changing the address starts again. */ /** The link in the confirmation email. False when the token is bad or the address was changed since. */ /** Switches email off (the unsubscribe link, a bounce, a complaint). The address stays so the viewer can see why; they must confirm again to turn it back on. */ // ── notices ── /** Sends the viewer's queue as one email when the window allows it. Returns how many notices went out. */ /** Waits this long for more notices before the first email of a window goes out (so a burst is one email). Zero outside production if asked. */ /** * Called by notify() once the notice is written. Queues it for the viewer when their email wants this kind, then sends through after() * (the sandbox is decided now: it is not visible inside after()). Outside a request (scripts, checks) it just runs. */ /** Daily cron: send what the 15 minute window held back. */ // ── Resend webhook ── /** Verifies a Svix-signed webhook (Resend signs with Svix): HMAC-SHA256 of "id.timestamp.body" with the base64 part of the whsec_ secret. */ /** A bounce or complaint event: switch email off for the viewer it was sent to (the `viewer` tag), if the address still matches. */

nodes.body_text: emailApiKey = () => (process.env.RESEND_API_KEY ?? '').trim()

nodes.name: signingKey
nodes.body_text: signingKey = () => { const s = process.env.SESSION_SECRET ?? ''; return s.length >= 16 ? s : ''; }

nodes.name: emailConfigured
nodes.body_text: emailConfigured = () => !!(emailApiKey() && signingKey())

nodes.name: fromAddress
nodes.body_text: fromAddress = () => (process.env.EMAIL_FROM ?? '').trim() || `${APP_NAME} <alerts@cheesytcg.app>`

nodes.name: apiBase
nodes.body_text: apiBase = () => ((process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production' && process.env.RESEND_API_URL) || 'https://api.resend.com').replace(/\/$/, '')

nodes.name: b64
nodes.body_text: b64 = (s: string) => Buffer.from(s).toString('base64url')

nodes.name: mac
nodes.body_text: mac = (data: string) => createHmac('sha256', signingKey()).update(data).digest('base64url')

nodes.name: addrHash
nodes.body_text: addrHash = (address: string) => createHash('sha256').update(address).digest('hex').slice(0, 16)

nodes.name: same
nodes.body_text: same = (a: string, b: string) => { const x = Buffer.from(a), y = Buffer.from(b); return x.length === y.length && timingSafeEqual(x, y); }

nodes.name: confirmToken
nodes.signature: function confirmToken(user: string, address: string, now = Date.now()): string
nodes.body_text: function confirmToken(user: string, address: string, now = Date.now()): string { const payload = b64(JSON.stringify({ u: user.toLowerCase(), a: addrHash(address), exp: Math.floor(now / 1000) + EMAIL_CONFIRM_TTL_S })); return `${payload}.${mac(`confirm.${payload}`)}`; }

nodes.name: readConfirmToken
nodes.signature: function readConfirmToken(token: string, now = Date.now()): { user: string; hash: string } | null
nodes.body_text: function readConfirmToken(token: string, now = Date.now()): { user: string; hash: string } | null { if (!signingKey()) return null; const [payload, sig, extra] = token.split('.'); if (!payload || !sig || extra !== undefined || !same(sig, mac(`confirm.${payload}`))) return null; try { const o = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(payload, 'base64url').toString('utf8')) as { u?: unknown; a?: unknown; exp?: unknown }; if (typeof o.u !== 'string' || typeof o.a !== 'string' || typeof o.exp !== 'number' || o.exp < now / 1000) return null; return { user: o.u, hash: o.a }; } catch { return null; } }

nodes.name: unsubscribeToken
nodes.body_text: unsubscribeToken = (user: string) => { const u = b64(user.toLowerCase()); return `${u}.${mac(`unsub.${u}`)}`; }

nodes.name: readUnsubscribeToken
nodes.body_text: function readUnsubscribeToken(token: string): string | null { if (!signingKey()) return null; const [u, sig, extra] = token.split('.'); if (!u || !sig || extra !== undefined || !same(sig, mac(`unsub.${u}`))) return null; return Buffer.from(u, 'base64url').toString('utf8') || null; }

nodes.name: links
nodes.body_text: links = (user: string) => ({ base: SITE_URL, unsubscribe: `${SITE_URL}/api/email/unsubscribe?t=${unsubscribeToken(user)}`, manage: `${SITE_URL}/settings#email`, })

nodes.name: getEmail
nodes.signature: async function getEmail(user: string): Promise<EmailRecord | null>
nodes.body_text: async function getEmail(user: string): Promise<EmailRecord | null> { return sanitizeEmailRecord(await kv.get(recordKey(user)).catch(() => null)); }

nodes.name: putEmail
nodes.body_text: putEmail = (user: string, r: EmailRecord) => kv.set(recordKey(user), r)

nodes.name: deleteEmail
nodes.body_text: async function deleteEmail(user: string): Promise<void> { await kv.del(recordKey(user), queueKey(user), lastKey(user)).catch(() => 0); await kv.srem(PENDING_SET, user.toLowerCase()).catch(() => 0); }

nodes.name: Outgoing
nodes.body_text: interface Outgoing { to: string; mail: BuiltEmail; user: string; unsubscribe: boolean }

nodes.name: deliver
nodes.body_text: async function deliver(o: Outgoing): Promise<boolean> { try { const headers = o.unsubscribe ? { 'List-Unsubscribe': `<${links(o.user).unsubscribe}>`, 'List-Unsubscribe-Post': 'List-Unsubscribe=One-Click' } : undefined; const r = await fetch(`${apiBase()}/emails`, { method: 'POST', headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${emailApiKey()}`, 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ from: fromAddress(), to: [o.to], subject: o.mail.subject, html: o.mail.html, text: o.mail.text, ...(headers ? { headers } : {}), tags: [{ name: 'viewer', value: o.user.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9_-]/g, '_') }], }), signal: AbortSignal.timeout(10000), }); if (!r.ok) console.warn(`email for ${o.user}: Resend answered ${r.status}`); return r.ok; } catch (e) { console.warn('email failed:', e instanceof Error ? e.message : e); return false; } }

nodes.name: StartResult
nodes.signature: type StartResult = { ok: true; record: EmailRecord } | { ok: false; error: string };
nodes.body_text: type StartResult = { ok: true; record: EmailRecord } | { ok: false; error: string };

nodes.name: startEmail
nodes.signature: async function startEmail(user: string, input: unknown): Promise<StartResult>
nodes.body_text: async function startEmail(user: string, input: unknown): Promise<StartResult> { if (!emailConfigured()) return { ok: false, error: 'Email is not set up on this site yet.' }; const address = normalizeAddress(input); if (!address) return { ok: false, error: 'That does not look like an email address.' }; const u = user.toLowerCase(); if (!(await kv.set(`email:cfm:${u}`, 1, { nx: true, ex: 60 }))) return { ok: false, error: 'Wait a minute before asking for another confirmation email.' }; const n = Number(await kv.incr(`email:cfm:${u}:day`)); if (n === 1) await kv.expire(`email:cfm:${u}:day`, 86400).catch(() => 0); if (n > 5) return { ok: false, error: 'That is enough confirmation emails for today. Try again tomorrow.' }; const prev = await getEmail(u); const record: EmailRecord = { address, addedAt: Date.now(), kinds: prev ? prev.kinds : [...EMAIL_DEFAULT_KINDS] }; await putEmail(u, record); await kv.del(queueKey(u)).catch(() => 0); if (!(await inSandbox())) { const url = `${SITE_URL}/api/email/confirm?t=${confirmToken(u, address)}`; const sent = await deliver({ to: address, user: u, unsubscribe: false, mail: buildConfirmEmail(url, APP_NAME, EMAIL_CONFIRM_TTL_S / 3600) }); if (!sent) return { ok: false, error: 'Could not send the confirmation email right now. Try again in a little while.' }; } return { ok: true, record }; }

nodes.name: confirmEmail
nodes.body_text: async function confirmEmail(token: string): Promise<boolean> { const t = readConfirmToken(token); if (!t) return false; const rec = await getEmail(t.user); if (!rec || addrHash(rec.address) !== t.hash) return false; if (rec.verifiedAt && !rec.off) return true; const { off: _off, ...rest } = rec; await putEmail(t.user, { ...rest, verifiedAt: Date.now() }); return true; }

nodes.name: setEmailKinds
nodes.signature: async function setEmailKinds(user: string, kinds: unknown): Promise<EmailRecord | null>
nodes.body_text: async function setEmailKinds(user: string, kinds: unknown): Promise<EmailRecord | null> { const rec = await getEmail(user); if (!rec) return null; const next = { ...rec, kinds: sanitizeEmailKinds(kinds) }; await putEmail(user, next); return next; }

nodes.name: switchEmailOff
nodes.signature: async function switchEmailOff(user: string, why: EmailOff): Promise<boolean>
nodes.body_text: async function switchEmailOff(user: string, why: EmailOff): Promise<boolean> { const rec = await getEmail(user); if (!rec) return false; await putEmail(user, { ...rec, off: why }); await kv.del(queueKey(user)).catch(() => 0); return true; }

nodes.name: readQueue
nodes.body_text: async function readQueue(user: string): Promise<Notice[]> { const q = await kv.get<Notice[]>(queueKey(user)).catch(() => null); return Array.isArray(q) ? q : []; }

nodes.name: flushEmail
nodes.body_text: async function flushEmail(user: string): Promise<number> { const u = user.toLowerCase(); try { if (!emailConfigured() || (await inSandbox())) return 0; const rec = await getEmail(u); if (!rec || emailStatus(rec) !== 'on') { await kv.del(queueKey(u)).catch(() => 0); await kv.srem(PENDING_SET, u).catch(() => 0); return 0; } if ((await readQueue(u)).length === 0) { await kv.srem(PENDING_SET, u).catch(() => 0); return 0; } if (!(await kv.set(lastKey(u), Date.now(), { nx: true, ex: EMAIL_WINDOW_S }))) return 0; // sent one within the window: wait const items = await withLock(`email:${u}`, async () => { const q = await readQueue(u); await kv.del(queueKey(u)); return q; }); if (items.length === 0) return 0; const sent = await deliver({ to: rec.address, user: u, unsubscribe: true, mail: buildEmail(items.sort((a, b) => a.at - b.at), links(u), APP_NAME) }); if (!sent) { // keep them for the next try await withLock(`email:${u}`, async () => { await kv.set(queueKey(u), [...items, ...(await readQueue(u))].slice(-EMAIL_QUEUE_MAX)); }); await kv.del(lastKey(u)).catch(() => 0); return 0; } if ((await readQueue(u)).length === 0) await kv.srem(PENDING_SET, u).catch(() => 0); return items.length; } catch (e) { console.warn('email flush failed:', e instanceof Error ? e.message : e); return 0; } }

nodes.name: coalesceMs
nodes.body_text: coalesceMs = () => (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production' && process.env.EMAIL_COALESCE_MS ? Number(process.env.EMAIL_COALESCE_MS) || 0 : 20000)

nodes.name: emailNotice
nodes.signature: async function emailNotice(user: string, notice: Notice): Promise<void>
nodes.body_text: async function emailNotice(user: string, notice: Notice): Promise<void> { try { if (!emailConfigured() || (await inSandbox())) return; const u = user.toLowerCase(); const rec = await getEmail(u); if (!emailWants(rec, notice.kind) || !wantsNotice(await getUserSettings(u), notice.kind)) return; await withLock(`email:${u}`, async () => { await kv.set(queueKey(u), [...(await readQueue(u)), notice].slice(-EMAIL_QUEUE_MAX)); }); await kv.sadd(PENDING_SET, u); const run = async () => { const ms = coalesceMs(); if (ms > 0) await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); await flushEmail(u); }; try { after(run); } catch { await run(); } } catch { /* best effort */ } }

nodes.name: run
nodes.body_text: run = async () => { const ms = coalesceMs(); if (ms > 0) await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); await flushEmail(u); }

nodes.name: flushDueEmails
nodes.body_text: async function flushDueEmails(): Promise<number> { if (!emailConfigured()) return 0; let sent = 0; const waiting = ((await kv.smembers(PENDING_SET).catch(() => [])) as string[]).slice(0, 500); for (const u of waiting) sent += await flushEmail(u); return sent; }

nodes.name: verifyWebhook
nodes.signature: function verifyWebhook(body: string, h: { id: string | null; timestamp: string | null; signature: string | null }, secret = (process.env.RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET ?? '').trim(), now = Date.now()): boolean
nodes.body_text: function verifyWebhook(body: string, h: { id: string | null; timestamp: string | null; signature: string | null }, secret = (process.env.RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET ?? '').trim(), now = Date.now()): boolean { if (!secret || !h.id || !h.timestamp || !h.signature) return false; const ts = Number(h.timestamp); if (!Number.isFinite(ts) || Math.abs(now / 1000 - ts) > 5 * 60) return false; const key = Buffer.from(secret.replace(/^whsec_/, ''), 'base64'); const expected = createHmac('sha256', key).update(`${h.id}.${h.timestamp}.${body}`).digest('base64'); return h.signature.split(' ').some(part => { const [v, sig] = part.split(','); return v === 'v1' && !!sig && same(sig, expected); }); }

nodes.name: handleWebhookEvent
nodes.body_text: async function handleWebhookEvent(event: unknown): Promise<'off' | 'ignored'> { const e = (event && typeof event === 'object' ? event : {}) as { type?: unknown; data?: { to?: unknown; tags?: unknown } }; const why: EmailOff | null = e.type === 'email.bounced' ? 'bounced' : e.type === 'email.complained' ? 'complained' : null; if (!why || !e.data) return 'ignored'; const tags = e.data.tags; const viewer = Array.isArray(tags) ? (tags as { name?: unknown; value?: unknown }[]).find(t => t?.name === 'viewer')?.value : tags && typeof tags === 'object' ? (tags as Record<string, unknown>).viewer : undefined; const to = Array.isArray(e.data.to) ? e.data.to.map(normalizeAddress) : []; if (typeof viewer !== 'string' || !viewer) return 'ignored'; const rec = await getEmail(viewer); if (!rec || !to.includes(rec.address)) return 'ignored'; return (await switchEmailOff(viewer, why)) ? 'off' : 'ignored'; }

Left unset, the password still works as a break-glass full-admin login.' }, { name: 'SUPER_ADMIN_TWITCH_IDS', group: 'Admin', level: 'optional', unlocks: 'Extra super admins, as comma-separated numeric Twitch account IDs. joshmiles is always a super admin (fixed in the code).' }, { name: 'ADMIN_PASSWORD', group: 'Admin', level: 'required', unlocks: 'The password you type on the admin login page.', minLength: 8 }, { name: 'KV_REST_API_URL', group: 'Database', level: 'required', unlocks: 'All game data: seasons, packs, cards, collections.' }, { name: 'KV_REST_API_TOKEN', group: 'Database', level: 'required', unlocks: 'Read and write access to that database.' }, { name: 'BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN', group: 'Storage', level: 'recommended', unlocks: 'Uploading card art, covers and sounds, and the Assets cleanup tools.' }, { name: 'BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_KEY', group: 'Storage', level: 'recommended', unlocks: 'Nightly backups: the password the backup file is encrypted with (backups are public files in Blob, so none is written without it). Needs SESSION_SECRET too. Without it the email option stays hidden.' }, { name: 'EMAIL_FROM', group: 'Notifications', level: 'recommended', unlocks: 'Who the emails come from, on a domain verified in Resend, e.g. The Cheesy TCG <alerts@cheesytcg.app>.' }, { name: 'RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET', group: 'Notifications', level: 'optional', unlocks: 'Signing secret (whsec_...) of the Resend webhook to /api/webhooks/email, which switches email off for an address that bounced or reported spam. Without it the webhook refuses every call.' }, { name: 'TWITCH_CLIENT_ID', group: 'Twitch API', level: 'recommended', unlocks: 'Avatars, the LIVE indicator, and finding a viewer from their Twitch ID.' }, { name: 'TWITCH_CLIENT_SECRET', group: 'Twitch API', level: 'recommended', unlocks: 'The same, and website login (it signs the code exchange).' }, { name: 'SESSION_SECRET', group: 'Website login', level: 'recommended', unlocks: '"Log in with Twitch" on the website: My Stats, upgrading and trading.', minLength: 16 }, { name: 'SITE_URL', group: 'Website login', level: 'optional', unlocks: 'The public address used in login redirects and links. Defaults to the production domain.' }, { name: 'TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY', group: 'Bot protection', level: 'recommended', unlocks: 'The Cloudflare Turnstile check shown before trades and upgrades on the website (the public site key).' }, { name: 'TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY', group: 'Bot protection', level: 'recommended', unlocks: 'Verifying that check on the server (needs the site key too). Without both, trades and upgrades skip the check.' }, { name: 'GITHUB_CHANGELOG_TOKEN', group: 'Storage', level: 'recommended', unlocks: "The What's new page: at each build it reads the merged pull requests (fine-grained token for this repo only, Pull requests: read-only) and turns their Changelog sections into entries. Without it only the hand-written history shows." }, { name: 'LEGAL_OPERATOR_NAME', group: 'Legal pages', level: 'recommended', unlocks: 'Names who runs the extension on the Privacy Policy and Terms. Set before submitting the extension for review.' }, { name: 'LEGAL_CONTACT_EMAIL', group: 'Legal pages', level: 'recommended', unlocks: 'The privacy contact address on the Privacy Policy. Set before submitting the extension for review.' }, { name: 'LEGAL_GOVERNING_LAW', group: 'Legal pages', level: 'optional', unlocks: 'The governing-law line in the Terms.' }, ]; export const ENV_GROUPS: EnvGroup[] = ['Admin', 'Database', 'Storage', 'Twitch Extension', 'Twitch API', 'Website login', 'Bot protection', 'Legal pages', 'Notifications']; /** Presence of each variable; a value that is set but shorter than its minimum is flagged weak (its length is the only thing inspected). */ /** The Blob token can arrive under either of two names (see lib/assets.ts). */

nodes.body_text: import { getUserSettings } from './user-settings-store'; import { getOwnerCopies, isTracking, printLabel } from './serials'; import { entryOf, newestFirst } from './serials-core'; import type { TradeItem } from './trade-core'; import { encodeEntry } from './variants'; // Favourite prints (ROADMAP 9.1): a viewer marks prints by unique number (Copy.uid) and they can't be traded or spent in an // upgrade. Checked against the live owner whenever it is used, so a favourite that has left them simply stops counting. /** Ids of the prints `owner` holds right now that they have marked as favourites. */ /** * Which prints of one stack may be spent. `picked` are exact picks: a favourite among them is refused. With no picks the newest * non-favourite prints are chosen; `ids: null` means the owner has no favourite of this card, so the ledger's own newest-first * choice is already safe and nothing needs pinning. */ /** `items` with the unpicked stacks pinned to non-favourite prints where the owner has favourites; the first refusal otherwise. */

nodes.name: favouriteIdsOf
nodes.signature: async function favouriteIdsOf(collection: string, owner: string): Promise<Set<string>>
nodes.body_text: async function favouriteIdsOf(collection: string, owner: string): Promise<Set<string>> { const s = await getUserSettings(owner); if (s.favourites.length === 0) return new Set(); const favs = new Set(s.favourites); return new Set((await getOwnerCopies(collection, owner)).filter(c => c.uid && favs.has(c.uid)).map(c => c.id)); }

nodes.signature: type Spend = { ok: true; ids: string[] | null } | { ok: false; text: string };

nodes.name: spendablePrints
nodes.signature: async function spendablePrints(collection: string, owner: string, entry: number, count: number, picked: string[] | undefined, favs: Set<string>, verb: 'trade' | 'spend' = 'trade'): Promise<Spend>
nodes.body_text: async function spendablePrints(collection: string, owner: string, entry: number, count: number, picked: string[] | undefined, favs: Set<string>, verb: 'trade' | 'spend' = 'trade'): Promise<Spend> { if (favs.size === 0) return { ok: true, ids: null }; if (picked) { const hit = picked.find(id => favs.has(id)); if (hit) return { ok: false, text: `${await printLabel(collection, hit)} is one of your favourites. Unfavourite it first to ${verb} it.` }; return { ok: true, ids: picked }; } const mine = (await getOwnerCopies(collection, owner)).filter(c => entryOf(c) === entry); if (!mine.some(c => favs.has(c.id))) return { ok: true, ids: null }; const free = mine.filter(c => !favs.has(c.id)); if (free.length < count) { return { ok: false, text: free.length === 0 ? `You only have favourites of that card left. Unfavourite one to ${verb} it.` : `Some of your prints of that card are favourites, so only ${free.length} can be ${verb === 'trade' ? 'traded' : 'spent'}. Unfavourite one to use more.` }; } return { ok: true, ids: newestFirst(free, count).map(c => c.id) }; }

nodes.name: protectFavourites
nodes.signature: async function protectFavourites(collection: string, owner: string, items: TradeItem[]): Promise<{ ok: true; items: TradeItem[] } | { ok: false; text: string }>
nodes.body_text: async function protectFavourites(collection: string, owner: string, items: TradeItem[]): Promise<{ ok: true; items: TradeItem[] } | { ok: false; text: string }> { if (!(await isTracking(collection))) return { ok: true, items }; const favs = await favouriteIdsOf(collection, owner); if (favs.size === 0) return { ok: true, items }; const out: TradeItem[] = []; for (const i of items) { const r = await spendablePrints(collection, owner, encodeEntry(i.cardNumber, i.variant), i.count, i.ids, favs); if (!r.ok) return r; out.push(r.ids && !i.ids ? { ...i, ids: r.ids } : i); } return { ok: true, items: out }; }

nodes.name: feedback-core.ts
nodes.body_text: // Suggestions and problem reports, the client-safe half (pure): shapes, limits, validation, the Discord text and the retention rule. // The store lives in lib/feedback.ts. scripts/check-feedback.mts covers this file. /** 'deletion' is an account deletion request (ROADMAP 11.3): it shares the inbox but has its own flow and is never sent from the feedback form. */ export const FEEDBACK_KINDS: FeedbackKind[] = ['idea', 'bug', 'deletion', 'report']; export const FEEDBACK_STATUSES: FeedbackStatus[] = ['new', 'planned', 'done', 'wontfix', 'duplicate']; export const KIND_LABELS: Record<FeedbackKind, string> = { idea: 'Suggestion', bug: 'Problem report', deletion: 'Deletion request', report: 'User report' }; export const STATUS_LABELS: Record<FeedbackStatus, string> = { new: 'New', planned: 'Planned', done: 'Done', wontfix: "Won't do", duplicate: 'Duplicate' }; /** A deletion request still waiting after this many days is overdue (people expect about a month). */ export const DELETION_OVERDUE_DAYS = 30; export const FEEDBACK_LIMITS = { title: 100, body: 2000, expected: 1000, from: 200, reply: 1000, ua: 300, perDay: 5, /** Reports one viewer may file per UTC day (counted apart from the feedback sends). */ reportsPerDay: 5, reportDetails: 1000, reportDetailsMin: 10, /** Newest items kept in the list. */ listCap: 1000, /** Days a finished item is kept after it was resolved (answered, planned, done...). */ keepDaysAfterResolved: 90, discordText: 500, } as const; /** Device details the sender agreed to include. The build stamp is added on the server, never taken from the request. */ const CONTROL = /[\u0000-\u0008\u000b\u000c\u000e-\u001f\u007f]/g; /** Single line: control characters and runs of spaces collapsed. */ /** Several lines allowed, control characters other than newline and tab removed, trailing space trimmed. */ /** A page on this site: a path that starts with a single slash. Anything else (another site, a script) is dropped. */ /** What the form sent → a clean submission or a message for the sender. */ /** The device details to keep, trimmed and bounded (only when the sender ticked the box). */ /** The UTC day, for the per-viewer daily counter. */ /** Whether a sweep may delete an item now: it was resolved long enough ago. Open ('new') items are never deleted. */ /** What the sender hears when staff change an item. Null when there is nothing to say (nothing changed). */ /** Text for Discord: Markdown neutralised and cut, so a post cannot format itself, link or ping. */ // ── User reports (ROADMAP 17.2) ── export const REPORT_REASONS: ReportReason[] = ['offensive', 'cheating', 'scam', 'other']; export const REPORT_REASON_LABELS: Record<ReportReason, string> = { offensive: 'Offensive name, bio or picture', cheating: 'Cheating or abuse', scam: 'Scam or unfair trade', other: 'Something else', }; /** A trade or print page on this site (`/trade/<id>`, `/copy/<season>/<copy>`), or ''. */ /** What the report dialog sent → a clean report or a message for the reporter. */

For a user report: the trade or print page they linked. */ from?: string; /** User reports only: the reported viewer's login, and why. Staff-only: never shown to the reported person. */ target?: string; reason?: ReportReason; meta?: FeedbackMeta; at: number; status: FeedbackStatus; reply?: string; /** The staff login that last changed the status or wrote the reply (staff-only; never shown to the sender or in Discord). */ repliedBy?: string; /** When the status first left 'new', for the retention sweep. */ resolvedAt?: number; }

nodes.name: oneLine
nodes.signature: function oneLine(s: unknown, max: number): string
nodes.body_text: function oneLine(s: unknown, max: number): string { return typeof s === 'string' ? s.replace(/[\u0000-\u001f\u007f]+/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, max) : ''; }

nodes.body_text:
function multiLine(s: unknown, max: number): string { return typeof s === 'string' ? s.replace(/
?/g, '
').replace(CONTROL, '').replace(/
{3,}/g, '

').trim().slice(0, max) : ''; }

nodes.name: cleanFrom
nodes.body_text: function cleanFrom(v: unknown): string { if (typeof v !== 'string') return ''; const s = v.trim().slice(0, FEEDBACK_LIMITS.from); return /^\/(?!\/)[^\s\\]*$/.test(s) ? s : ''; }

nodes.name: FeedbackInput
nodes.signature: type FeedbackInput = | { ok: true; value: { kind: FeedbackKind; title: string; body: string; expected?: string; from?: string; includeDevice: boolean } } | { ok: false; error: string };
nodes.body_text: type FeedbackInput = | { ok: true; value: { kind: FeedbackKind; title: string; body: string; expected?: string; from?: string; includeDevice: boolean } } | { ok: false; error: string };

nodes.name: parseFeedbackInput
nodes.body_text: function parseFeedbackInput(raw: unknown): FeedbackInput { const o = (raw && typeof raw === 'object' ? raw : {}) as Record<string, unknown>; const kind = o.kind === 'bug' ? 'bug' : o.kind === 'idea' ? 'idea' : null; if (!kind) return { ok: false, error: 'Choose whether this is a suggestion or a problem.' }; const body = multiLine(o.body, FEEDBACK_LIMITS.body); if (body.length < 5) return { ok: false, error: kind === 'bug' ? 'Tell us what happened (at least a few words).' : 'Add a few details (at least a few words).' }; let title = oneLine(o.title, FEEDBACK_LIMITS.title); if (kind === 'idea' && title.length < 3) return { ok: false, error: 'Give your suggestion a short title.' }; if (kind === 'bug' && !title) title = oneLine(body, 60); // a problem report has no title field: the first words stand in const expected = kind === 'bug' ? multiLine(o.expected, FEEDBACK_LIMITS.expected) : ''; const from = kind === 'bug' ? cleanFrom(o.from) : ''; return { ok: true, value: { kind, title, body, ...(expected ? { expected } : {}), ...(from ? { from } : {}), includeDevice: o.includeDevice === true } }; }

nodes.name: cleanMeta
nodes.signature: function cleanMeta(raw: unknown, build: string): FeedbackMeta
nodes.body_text: function cleanMeta(raw: unknown, build: string): FeedbackMeta { const o = (raw && typeof raw === 'object' ? raw : {}) as Record<string, unknown>; const ua = oneLine(o.ua, FEEDBACK_LIMITS.ua); const screen = /^\d{2,5}x\d{2,5}$/.test(typeof o.screen === 'string' ? o.screen : '') ? (o.screen as string) : ''; return { ...(ua ? { ua } : {}), ...(screen ? { screen } : {}), ...(build ? { build: oneLine(build, 40) } : {}) }; }

nodes.name: dayKey
nodes.body_text: dayKey = (at: number) => new Date(at).toISOString().slice(0, 10)

nodes.name: isStatus
nodes.signature: function isStatus(v: unknown): v is FeedbackStatus
nodes.body_text: function isStatus(v: unknown): v is FeedbackStatus { return typeof v === 'string' && (FEEDBACK_STATUSES as string[]).includes(v); }

nodes.name: expired
nodes.signature: function expired(item: Pick<FeedbackItem, 'status' | 'resolvedAt'>, now: number): boolean
nodes.body_text: function expired(item: Pick<FeedbackItem, 'status' | 'resolvedAt'>, now: number): boolean { if (item.status === 'new') return false; const since = item.resolvedAt ?? 0; return since > 0 && now - since > FEEDBACK_LIMITS.keepDaysAfterResolved * 86_400_000; }

nodes.name: noticeText
nodes.signature: function noticeText(item: Pick<FeedbackItem, 'title' | 'status' | 'reply'> & { kind?: FeedbackKind }, changed: { status: boolean; reply: boolean }): string | null
nodes.body_text: function noticeText(item: Pick<FeedbackItem, 'title' | 'status' | 'reply'> & { kind?: FeedbackKind }, changed: { status: boolean; reply: boolean }): string | null { if (!changed.status && !changed.reply) return null; if (item.kind === 'report') return changed.status ? (item.status === 'done' ? 'Thanks for your report. Staff have looked at it and dealt with it.' : item.status === 'wontfix' || item.status === 'duplicate' ? 'Thanks for your report. Staff have looked at it and no further action was needed.' : null) : null; // outcome only: never what was done to the other person, never the staff reply if (item.kind === 'deletion') return item.status === 'wontfix' ? `We could not delete your account yet.${item.reply ? ` Reason: ${item.reply.slice(0, 200)}` : ''}` : null; // a finished deletion has no one left to tell const what = `"${item.title.slice(0, 60)}"`; const status = item.status === 'new' ? '' : item.status === 'wontfix' ? `We won't be doing ${what}.` : item.status === 'done' ? `${what} is done.` : item.status === 'planned' ? `${what} is planned.` : `${what} was marked as a duplicate of something we already track.`; if (changed.reply && item.reply) return `${changed.status && status ? status + ' ' : ''}A reply on ${what}: ${item.reply.slice(0, 200)}`.trim(); return status || null; }

nodes.name: discordText
nodes.signature: function discordText(s: string, max: number = FEEDBACK_LIMITS.discordText): string
nodes.body_text: function discordText(s: string, max: number = FEEDBACK_LIMITS.discordText): string { return s.replace(/([\\*_~`|>[\]()#:<])/g, '\\$1').replace(/@/g, '@\u200b').slice(0, max); }

nodes.body_text: type ReportReason = 'offensive' | 'cheating' | 'scam' | 'other';

nodes.name: cleanReportLink
nodes.body_text: function cleanReportLink(v: unknown): string { const s = cleanFrom(v); return /^\/(trade|copy)\/[A-Za-z0-9_.:\-/]+$/.test(s) ? s : ''; }

nodes.name: ReportInput
nodes.signature: type ReportInput = | { ok: true; value: { target: string; reason: ReportReason; details: string; link?: string } } | { ok: false; error: string };
nodes.body_text: type ReportInput = | { ok: true; value: { target: string; reason: ReportReason; details: string; link?: string } } | { ok: false; error: string };

nodes.name: parseReportInput
nodes.body_text: function parseReportInput(raw: unknown): ReportInput { const o = (raw && typeof raw === 'object' ? raw : {}) as Record<string, unknown>; const t = typeof o.target === 'string' ? o.target.trim().replace(/^@/, '').toLowerCase() : ''; if (!/^[a-z0-9_]{3,25}$/.test(t)) return { ok: false, error: 'Who are you reporting? Open the report from their profile.' }; const reason = (REPORT_REASONS as string[]).includes(o.reason as string) ? (o.reason as ReportReason) : null; if (!reason) return { ok: false, error: 'Choose a reason.' }; const details = multiLine(o.details, FEEDBACK_LIMITS.reportDetails); if (reason === 'other' && details.length < FEEDBACK_LIMITS.reportDetailsMin) return { ok: false, error: `Tell us a little more (at least ${FEEDBACK_LIMITS.reportDetailsMin} characters).` }; const link = cleanReportLink(o.link); return { ok: true, value: { target: t, reason, details, ...(link ? { link } : {}) } }; }

nodes.name: feedback.ts
nodes.body_text: import { kv } from './db'; import { notify } from './trade-notify'; import { notifyFeedback } from './discord'; import { getActiveSeasonWithPacks, getCollection, getUserProfile } from './kv'; import { getBuildInfo, formatVersion } from './version'; import { FEEDBACK_LIMITS, REPORT_REASON_LABELS, cleanMeta, dayKey, expired, isStatus, noticeText, multiLine, oneLine, type FeedbackInput, type FeedbackItem, type ReportInput, type FeedbackKind, type FeedbackStatus, } from './feedback-core'; // Suggestions and problem reports: one inbox. `feedback:<id>` holds an item, `feedback:list` the ids newest first (capped), and // `feedback:new` the ids still waiting for staff (so the "new" counts are one SCARD). Best-effort side effects (Discord, bell). const LIST = 'feedback:list'; const NEW_SET = 'feedback:new'; /** Sends used today by this viewer (UTC day). */ /** Newest first. The sweep runs here, so the admin page keeps the store tidy without a cron. */ // ── User reports (ROADMAP 17.2) ── // A report is an inbox item of kind 'report' with `target` and `reason`. Own daily counter, one open report per reporter per target. /** One viewer's own items, newest first. */ /** How many items still wait for staff (a set size, so cheap enough for every admin page). */ /** * Staff set a status and/or write a reply. The sender hears about it in the bell (and by push if they use it): their own Settings * switch for this kind of notice applies. `by` is the staff login, kept on the item but never shown to the sender or in Discord. */ /** * Deletes items resolved more than keepDaysAfterResolved days ago and forgets ids whose item is gone. Returns how many items it deleted. */ // ── Account deletion requests (ROADMAP 11.3) ── // A request is an inbox item of kind 'deletion', so it shares the list, the new count and the sweep. It is not counted against the // daily send limit. Handling it (deleting the viewer, or declining) is in app/admin/feedback-actions.ts and lib/account-deletion.ts. /** The viewer's latest deletion request (any status), newest first, or null. */ /** Removes one item entirely (the list entry is dropped by the next sweep). */ /** The sender takes their request back while it is still waiting. Returns whether one was cancelled. */ /** Marks a request done without telling the sender (the account no longer exists to be told). */ /** Deletes every inbox item of a viewer except the deletion request(s), which stay as the record of what was asked. */

nodes.name: sentToday

nodes.name: submitFeedback
nodes.signature: async function submitFeedback(user: string, input: ParsedInput, device: unknown, now = Date.now()): Promise<SubmitResult>
nodes.body_text: async function submitFeedback(user: string, input: ParsedInput, device: unknown, now = Date.now()): Promise<SubmitResult> { const u = user.toLowerCase(); const used = await sentToday(u, now); if (used >= FEEDBACK_LIMITS.perDay) return { ok: false, status: 429, error: `You can send ${FEEDBACK_LIMITS.perDay} messages a day. Try again tomorrow.` }; await kv.set(rateKey(u, now), used + 1, { ex: 2 * 86_400 }); const build = formatVersion(getBuildInfo()); const item: FeedbackItem = { id: Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10) + now.toString(36).slice(-4), kind: input.kind, user: u, title: input.title, body: input.body, ...(input.expected ? { expected: input.expected } : {}), ...(input.from ? { from: input.from } : {}), ...(input.includeDevice ? { meta: cleanMeta(device, build) } : {}), at: now, status: 'new', }; await kv.set(itemKey(item.id), item); await kv.lpush(LIST, item.id); await kv.ltrim(LIST, 0, FEEDBACK_LIMITS.listCap - 1); await kv.sadd(NEW_SET, item.id); await notifyFeedback(item); return { ok: true, item }; }

nodes.name: loadMany
nodes.body_text: async function loadMany(ids: string[]): Promise<FeedbackItem[]> { const items = await Promise.all(ids.map(getFeedback)); return items.filter((i): i is FeedbackItem => !!i); }

nodes.name: listFeedback
nodes.body_text: async function listFeedback(filter: FeedbackFilter = {}): Promise<FeedbackItem[]> { await sweepFeedback().catch(() => 0); const ids = (await kv.lrange<string>(LIST, 0, FEEDBACK_LIMITS.listCap - 1).catch(() => [] as string[])) ?? []; return (await loadMany(ids)).filter(i => (!filter.kind || i.kind === filter.kind) && (!filter.status || i.status === filter.status) && (!filter.user || i.user === filter.user.toLowerCase())); }

nodes.name: knownViewer
nodes.body_text: async function knownViewer(login: string): Promise<boolean> { if (await getUserProfile(login).catch(() => null)) return true; const active = await getActiveSeasonWithPacks().catch(() => null); if (!active) return false; return Object.keys(await getCollection(active.season.collectionName).catch(() => ({}))).some(u => u.toLowerCase() === login); }

nodes.name: submitReport
nodes.signature: async function submitReport(reporter: string, input: ParsedReport, now = Date.now()): Promise<SubmitResult>
nodes.body_text: async function submitReport(reporter: string, input: ParsedReport, now = Date.now()): Promise<SubmitResult> { const me = reporter.toLowerCase(); if (input.target === me) return { ok: false, status: 400, error: "You can't report yourself." }; if (!(await knownViewer(input.target))) return { ok: false, status: 404, error: "We don't know that collector." }; if ((await feedbackOf(me)).some(i => i.kind === 'report' && i.target === input.target && i.status === 'new')) { return { ok: false, status: 409, error: 'You already reported this person. Staff will look at it.' }; } const used = await reportsToday(me, now); if (used >= FEEDBACK_LIMITS.reportsPerDay) return { ok: false, status: 429, error: `You can send ${FEEDBACK_LIMITS.reportsPerDay} reports a day. Try again tomorrow.` }; await kv.set(reportRateKey(me, now), used + 1, { ex: 2 * 86_400 }); const item: FeedbackItem = { id: Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10) + now.toString(36).slice(-4), kind: 'report', user: me, title: `Report: @${input.target} (${REPORT_REASON_LABELS[input.reason]})`, body: input.details, target: input.target, reason: input.reason, ...(input.link ? { from: input.link } : {}), at: now, status: 'new', }; await kv.set(itemKey(item.id), item); await kv.lpush(LIST, item.id); await kv.ltrim(LIST, 0, FEEDBACK_LIMITS.listCap - 1); await kv.sadd(NEW_SET, item.id); await notifyFeedback(item); return { ok: true, item }; }

nodes.name: feedbackOf
nodes.body_text: async function feedbackOf(user: string): Promise<FeedbackItem[]> { const ids = (await kv.lrange<string>(LIST, 0, FEEDBACK_LIMITS.listCap - 1).catch(() => [] as string[])) ?? []; return (await loadMany(ids)).filter(i => i.user === user.toLowerCase()); }

nodes.name: countNewFeedback
nodes.body_text: async function countNewFeedback(): Promise<number> { return Number(await kv.scard(NEW_SET).catch(() => 0)) || 0; }

nodes.name: UpdateResult
nodes.signature: type UpdateResult = { ok: true; item: FeedbackItem } | { ok: false; error: string };
nodes.body_text: type UpdateResult = { ok: true; item: FeedbackItem } | { ok: false; error: string };

nodes.name: updateFeedback
nodes.signature: async function updateFeedback(id: string, patch: { status?: unknown; reply?: unknown }, by: string | null, now = Date.now()): Promise<UpdateResult>
nodes.body_text: async function updateFeedback(id: string, patch: { status?: unknown; reply?: unknown }, by: string | null, now = Date.now()): Promise<UpdateResult> { const item = await getFeedback(id); if (!item) return { ok: false, error: 'That item no longer exists.' }; const status = isStatus(patch.status) ? patch.status : item.status; const reply = patch.reply === undefined ? item.reply ?? '' : multiLine(patch.reply, FEEDBACK_LIMITS.reply); const changed = { status: status !== item.status, reply: reply !== (item.reply ?? '') }; if (!changed.status && !changed.reply) return { ok: true, item }; const next: FeedbackItem = { ...item, status, ...(reply ? { reply } : {}), ...(by ? { repliedBy: oneLine(by, 40) } : {}) }; if (!reply) delete next.reply; if (status !== 'new' && !next.resolvedAt) next.resolvedAt = now; if (status === 'new') delete next.resolvedAt; await kv.set(itemKey(id), next); if (status === 'new') await kv.sadd(NEW_SET, id); else await kv.srem(NEW_SET, id); const text = noticeText(next, changed); if (text) await notify(item.user, { kind: 'feedback', text, feedbackId: id }); return { ok: true, item: next }; }

nodes.name: sweepFeedback
nodes.body_text: async function sweepFeedback(now = Date.now()): Promise<number> { const ids = (await kv.lrange<string>(LIST, 0, FEEDBACK_LIMITS.listCap - 1).catch(() => [] as string[])) ?? []; if (ids.length === 0) return 0; const items = await Promise.all(ids.map(async id => [id, await getFeedback(id)] as const)); const gone = items.filter(([, i]) => !i || expired(i, now)); if (gone.length === 0) return 0; const goneIds = new Set(gone.map(([id]) => id)); let deleted = 0; for (const [id, i] of gone) { if (i) { await kv.del(itemKey(id)); deleted++; } await kv.srem(NEW_SET, id); } const keep = ids.filter(id => !goneIds.has(id)); await kv.del(LIST); if (keep.length) await kv.rpush(LIST, ...keep); // pushed in the same newest-first order, so the list keeps its order return deleted; }

nodes.name: deletionOf
nodes.signature: async function deletionOf(user: string): Promise<FeedbackItem | null>
nodes.body_text: async function deletionOf(user: string): Promise<FeedbackItem | null> { return (await feedbackOf(user)).find(i => i.kind === 'deletion') ?? null; }

nodes.name: DeletionRequestResult
nodes.signature: type DeletionRequestResult = { ok: true; item: FeedbackItem } | { ok: false; error: string };

nodes.name: requestDeletion

nodes.body_text: async function requestDeletion(user: string, now = Date.now()): Promise<DeletionRequestResult> { const u = user.toLowerCase(); const existing = await deletionOf(u); if (existing && existing.status === 'new') return { ok: false, error: 'You already asked for this. It is waiting for the team.' }; const item: FeedbackItem = { id: Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10) + now.toString(36).slice(-4), kind: 'deletion', user: u, title: 'Delete my account', body: `@${u} asked for their account and data to be deleted.`, at: now, status: 'new', }; await kv.set(itemKey(item.id), item); await kv.lpush(LIST, item.id); await kv.ltrim(LIST, 0, FEEDBACK_LIMITS.listCap - 1); await kv.sadd(NEW_SET, item.id); await notifyFeedback(item); return { ok: true, item }; }

nodes.name: removeFeedbackItem
nodes.body_text: async function removeFeedbackItem(id: string): Promise<void> { await kv.del(itemKey(id)); await kv.srem(NEW_SET, id); }

nodes.name: cancelDeletion
nodes.body_text: async function cancelDeletion(user: string): Promise<boolean> { const item = await deletionOf(user); if (!item || item.status !== 'new') return false; await removeFeedbackItem(item.id); await sweepFeedback().catch(() => 0); return true; }

nodes.name: closeDeletion
nodes.signature: async function closeDeletion(id: string, by: string | null, now = Date.now()): Promise<void>
nodes.body_text: async function closeDeletion(id: string, by: string | null, now = Date.now()): Promise<void> { const item = await getFeedback(id); if (!item) return; await kv.set(itemKey(id), { ...item, status: 'done' as const, resolvedAt: now, ...(by ? { repliedBy: oneLine(by, 40) } : {}) }); await kv.srem(NEW_SET, id); }

nodes.name: deleteFeedbackOf
nodes.body_text: async function deleteFeedbackOf(user: string): Promise<number> { const mine = (await feedbackOf(user)).filter(i => i.kind !== 'deletion'); for (const i of mine) await removeFeedbackItem(i.id); if (mine.length) await sweepFeedback().catch(() => 0); return mine.length; }

nodes.name: flip-back.ts
nodes.body_text: import type { CardBackStyle } from './card-back'; import { ORIGIN_BY, ORIGIN_VERB, isEscrow, type Origin } from './serials-core'; // The engraved back of a flip card (client-safe, pure): what is printed on it and how dates and history lines are worded. const MONTHS = ['JAN', 'FEB', 'MAR', 'APR', 'MAY', 'JUN', 'JUL', 'AUG', 'SEP', 'OCT', 'NOV', 'DEC']; /** "12 OCT 2026", always in UTC so the server and the browser print the same text. */ /** "of 12 made", or '' when the total is unknown. */ /** The edition line under the engraved number: "Edition #7 of 12 made" (just "Edition #7" when the total is unknown). */ /** One short line of a print's history ("Traded to @bob"), for the engraved back and the card dialog. Private collectors stay private. */

nodes.name: glossary.ts
nodes.body_text: // One place for the short explanations behind the little "i" buttons (<InfoTip term="..." />). Plain strings only, so the // FAQ and the tooltips cannot drift apart: each term can point at its FAQ anchor, and scripts/check-words.mts checks the // anchors exist and the wording follows the house rules. No numbers that the streamer can change in Scoring settings. export const GLOSSARY: Record<TermId, GlossaryEntry> = { progressBonus: { title: 'Progress bonus', body: 'Extra points that grow with the share of the set you own. Every different card you find adds its own points and also raises this bonus. Duplicates do not count towards it.', faq: 'bonuses', }, fullSetBonus: { title: 'Full set bonus', body: 'A one-off extra for owning at least one print of every card in the season. You also get a Complete badge on the leaderboard.', faq: 'bonuses', }, editionBonus: { title: 'Edition bonus', body: 'The first prints ever made of a card are worth extra. Edition #1 is worth the most, and the bonus fades away as the edition number goes up. It belongs to the print, so it moves with it if you trade it.', faq: 'points', }, edition: { title: 'Edition', body: 'The count of a print among all prints of the same card and version. Your Shiny Gouda Goat edition #3 is the third Shiny Gouda Goat ever drawn. Low editions earn the edition bonus.', faq: 'serials', }, printNumber: { title: 'Print number', body: 'A number that belongs to one print only, across the whole game. Use it to refer to a print: type it in the search box or open its page. It is not the same as the edition number.', faq: 'serials', }, points: { title: 'Points', body: 'What a print is worth. Rarer cards, shinier versions and low edition numbers are worth more. Card values shift a little as cards are pulled, so the numbers are a guide.', faq: 'points', }, pullChance: { title: 'Pull chance', body: 'How often this card turns up. "1 in 12" means about one pull in twelve gives you this card. The rarer a card, the more it is worth.', faq: 'cards', }, score: { title: 'Score', body: 'The total of what every print you own is worth, plus the collection bonuses. It is what the leaderboard ranks by.', faq: 'points', }, rank: { title: 'Rank', body: 'Your place on the leaderboard. It follows whichever measure the board is showing, and it does not change when you search for someone.', faq: 'points', }, fairness: { title: 'Fairness label', body: 'A rough guide comparing the points on each side of the offer. It only looks at points, so a low edition number or a card you simply want can matter more to you. You are never stopped from making a lopsided offer, only asked to confirm it.', faq: 'fair-trade', }, escrow: { title: 'Held for this offer', body: 'Cards in an offer leave your collection while it is open, so nobody can accept something you no longer have. They come back if the offer is declined, cancelled, countered or runs out, and go to the other person if it is accepted. Held cards do not count towards your points.', faq: 'escrow', }, reverseHolo: { title: 'Reverse Holo', body: 'The regular art with a holographic shimmer. Worth more than a Regular.', faq: 'cards', }, fullArt: { title: 'Full Art', body: 'A bolder, full-art version of the card. Worth more than a Reverse Holo.', faq: 'cards', }, shiny: { title: 'Shiny Full Art', body: 'The full art with the holographic shimmer, and it gently rocks on screen. The rarest version, and worth the most.', faq: 'cards', }, upgrade: { title: 'Upgrade', body: 'Spend several prints of a card to make one print of the next version up. The spent prints are retired and the new print remembers what it was made from.', faq: 'upgrades', }, };

nodes.name: holo-core.ts
nodes.body_text: import type { Variant } from './types'; import { VARIANTS } from './variants'; import { effectiveProps, type PropValue, type PropValues } from './overlay-props'; // The holographic shimmer shown on cards on the website and in the Twitch panel, driven by the SAME per-variant settings the // admin sets in the Overlay Editor (Variants -> a variant -> Holographic shimmer): on / off / auto, colours, strength, // sweep time, angle, blend and loop. The overlay builds its shimmer in public/widget.js (applyLook); this mirrors it so a // card looks the same wherever it is shown. Geometry (kept identical): an 8-slot gradient tile 5 card-widths wide and tall // that slides 8 card-widths in one sweep; a looping sweep slides exactly one tile. /** What a client needs to draw one variant's shimmer on one card. `style` holds CSS custom properties to set on the art. */ const NONE: HoloSpec = { on: false, style: {} }; export const NO_HOLO: HoloSpecs = { regular: NONE, reverse: NONE, full: NONE, shiny: NONE }; /** The overlay's gradient: 8 colour bands (cycling through the palette) separated by transparent gaps. */ /** Builds the shimmer for each variant of a card, from the effective overlay properties. */ /** The CSS custom properties for a variant's shimmer, as a React style object (client-safe). Empty when the shimmer is off. */ /** Class names to add to a card's art for its shimmer: always the base class, plus .holo-live where it should sweep by itself. */

nodes.name: HoloSpec
nodes.body_text: interface HoloSpec { on: boolean; style: Record<string, string>; }

nodes.name: HoloSpecs
nodes.body_text: type HoloSpecs = Record<Variant, HoloSpec>;

nodes.name: holoGradient
nodes.signature: function holoGradient(colors: string[], angle: number): string
nodes.body_text: function holoGradient(colors: string[], angle: number): string { const palette = colors.length ? colors : ['#fffee3']; const stops: string[] = []; for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) stops.push('#ffffff00', palette[i % palette.length]); stops.push('#ffffff00'); return `linear-gradient(${angle}deg, ${stops.join(', ')})`; }

nodes.name: buildHoloSpecs
nodes.signature: function buildHoloSpecs(props: PropValues, stars: number, holoMinStars: number): HoloSpecs
nodes.body_text: function buildHoloSpecs(props: PropValues, stars: number, holoMinStars: number): HoloSpecs { const out = { ...NO_HOLO } as HoloSpecs; for (const v of VARIANTS) { const g = (name: string): PropValue | undefined => props[`variant.${v}.${name}`]; const mode = String(g('holoMode')); const on = mode === 'on' || (mode === 'auto' && stars >= holoMinStars); if (!on) { out[v] = NONE; continue; } const loop = g('holoLoop') === true; out[v] = { on: true, style: { '--holo-gradient': holoGradient(Array.isArray(g('holoColors')) ? (g('holoColors') as string[]) : [], Number(g('holoAngle'))), '--holo-opacity': String(g('holoOpacity')), '--holo-time': `${Number(g('holoSpeed'))}s`, '--holo-blend': String(g('holoBlend')), '--holo-name': loop ? 'holoSiteLoop' : 'holoSite', '--holo-iter': loop ? 'infinite' : '1', '--holo-timing': loop ? 'linear' : 'ease', }, }; } return out; }

nodes.name: g
nodes.body_text: g = (name: string): PropValue | undefined => props[`variant.${v}.${name}`]

nodes.name: holoVars
nodes.body_text: function holoVars(spec: HoloSpec | undefined): React.CSSProperties { return (spec?.on ? spec.style : {}) as React.CSSProperties; }

nodes.name: holoClass
nodes.signature: function holoClass(spec: HoloSpec | undefined, live = false): string
nodes.body_text: function holoClass(spec: HoloSpec | undefined, live = false): string { return spec?.on ? (live ? 'holo-fx holo-live' : 'holo-fx') : ''; }

nodes.name: holo.ts
nodes.body_text: import type { Pack } from './types'; import { effectiveProps, type PropValues } from './overlay-props'; import { getOverlaySettings, getPackOverrides } from './overlay-settings'; import { buildHoloSpecs, type HoloSpecs } from './holo-core'; export * from './holo-core'; // Server side of the shimmer: reads the Overlay Editor's saved settings (global + per-pack overrides) and resolves them per card. // Client components import the types and helpers from './holo-core' (no database access). /** * One lookup of the overlay settings, then a function that gives any card's shimmer specs: the global values with that * pack's overrides on top. Call once per request and reuse. */

nodes.name: getHoloResolver
nodes.signature: async function getHoloResolver(): Promise<(pack: Pick<Pack, 'id' | 'holoMinStars'>, stars: number) => HoloSpecs>
nodes.body_text: async function getHoloResolver(): Promise<(pack: Pick<Pack, 'id' | 'holoMinStars'>, stars: number) => HoloSpecs> { const [settings, overrides] = await Promise.all([getOverlaySettings().catch(() => null), getPackOverrides().catch((): Record<string, PropValues> => ({}))]); const cache = new Map<string, PropValues>(); return (pack, stars) => { let props = cache.get(pack.id); if (!props) { props = effectiveProps(settings?.props, overrides[pack.id]); cache.set(pack.id, props); } return buildHoloSpecs(props, stars, pack.holoMinStars); }; }

nodes.name: home-data.ts
nodes.body_text: // Small pure helpers for the home page (client-safe, no database): where a viewer stands, and how long a season has left. /** The viewer's place on a board (rows are sorted best first). Null when they are not on it (no cards yet, or a private profile). */ /** "Ends in 3 days" / "Ends in 5 hours" / "Ended", or null when the season has no end date. */ // ── recent pulls (the home feed) ── /** Why a pull stands out (the chip text), or null for an ordinary one. */ /** "just now", "3m ago", "2h ago", "4d ago". */

nodes.name: StandingRow

nodes.name: Standing
nodes.body_text: interface Standing { rank: number; of: number; score: number; uniqueCards: number; totalCards: number; pct: number; /** The collector one place above and the points needed to pass them (null at #1). */ ahead: { username: string; gap: number } | null; }

nodes.name: viewerStanding
nodes.signature: function viewerStanding(rows: StandingRow[], username: string, totalCards: number): Standing | null
nodes.body_text: function viewerStanding(rows: StandingRow[], username: string, totalCards: number): Standing | null { const i = rows.findIndex(r => r.username === username); if (i < 0) return null; const me = rows[i]; const above = i > 0 ? rows[i - 1] : null; return { rank: i + 1, of: rows.length, score: Math.round(me.score), uniqueCards: me.uniqueCards, totalCards, pct: totalCards > 0 ? Math.round((me.uniqueCards / totalCards) * 100) : 0, ahead: above ? { username: above.username, gap: Math.max(1, Math.ceil(above.score - me.score)) } : null, }; }

nodes.name: seasonCountdown
nodes.signature: function seasonCountdown(endsAt: number | undefined, now = Date.now()): string | null
nodes.body_text: function seasonCountdown(endsAt: number | undefined, now = Date.now()): string | null { if (!endsAt) return null; const ms = endsAt - now; if (ms <= 0) return 'Ended'; const hours = Math.ceil(ms / 3_600_000); if (hours < 24) return `Ends in ${hours} hour${hours === 1 ? '' : 's'}`; const days = Math.ceil(hours / 24); return `Ends in ${days} day${days === 1 ? '' : 's'}`; }

nodes.name: PullItem
nodes.body_text: interface PullItem { seq: number; username: string; cardNumber: number; cardName: string; stars: number; variant?: 'regular' | 'reverse' | 'full' | 'shiny'; at: number; thumb?: string; hex?: string; /** How the card arrived: pulled in a pack (default) or granted (an admin gift or the grant webhook). */ kind?: 'pull' | 'grant'; /** A pull worth a second look: Shiny, Full Art or a 5-star card. */ notable: boolean; /** The serial number the copy got, and its points multiplier when above 1. */ serial?: number; bonus?: number; /** The print's unique number, and where its page is (the card's dex page when the event has no print to point at). */ uid?: number; href?: string; }

nodes.name: notableReason
nodes.signature: function notableReason(p: { variant?: string; stars: number; serial?: number }): string | null
nodes.body_text: function notableReason(p: { variant?: string; stars: number; serial?: number }): string | null { if (p.serial === 1) return 'First ever'; if (p.variant === 'shiny') return 'Shiny'; if (p.variant === 'full') return 'Full Art'; if (p.stars >= 5) return '5★'; return null; }

nodes.name: agoShort
nodes.signature: function agoShort(at: number, now = Date.now()): string
nodes.body_text: function agoShort(at: number, now = Date.now()): string { const s = Math.max(0, Math.round((now - at) / 1000)); if (s < 45) return 'just now'; const m = Math.round(s / 60); if (m < 60) return `${m}m ago`; const h = Math.round(m / 60); return h < 24 ? `${h}h ago` : `${Math.round(h / 24)}d ago`; }

nodes.name: home-pulls.ts
nodes.body_text: import { getRecentCardArrivals } from './site-data'; import { stillFor } from './card-art'; import { getRarity } from './rarity'; import { copyHrefFor } from './copy-link'; import { notableReason, type PullItem } from './home-data'; import type { Season } from './types'; /** * The home feed's items: the newest cards in a season, pulled or granted (collectors an admin hid are never included), each with * its art and rarity colour. A grant event carries only the card number, so its name and stars come from the season's cards; a * grant of a card that no longer exists is left out. */

nodes.name: recentPullItems
nodes.signature: async function recentPullItems(season: Season, cards: { number: number; name?: string; stars?: number; imageUrl?: string }[], limit = 8): Promise<PullItem[]>
nodes.body_text: async function recentPullItems(season: Season, cards: { number: number; name?: string; stars?: number; imageUrl?: string }[], limit = 8): Promise<PullItem[]> { const byNumber = new Map(cards.map(c => [c.number, c])); const arrivals = await getRecentCardArrivals(season.collectionName, limit * 2); const items: PullItem[] = []; for (const e of arrivals) { const card = byNumber.get(e.cardNumber); const grant = e.type === 'grant'; const cardName = e.type === 'pull' ? e.cardName : card?.name; const stars = e.type === 'pull' ? e.stars : card?.stars; if (!cardName || stars === undefined) continue; items.push({ seq: e.seq, username: e.username, cardNumber: e.cardNumber, cardName, stars, variant: e.variant, at: e.at, kind: grant ? 'grant' : 'pull', thumb: card?.imageUrl ? stillFor(card, card.imageUrl) : undefined, hex: getRarity(stars)?.hex, notable: notableReason({ variant: e.variant, stars, serial: e.type === 'pull' ? e.serial : undefined }) !== null, href: copyHrefFor(e, season.id) ?? `/cards?card=${e.cardNumber}`, ...(e.uid ? { uid: e.uid } : {}), ...(e.type === 'pull' && e.serial ? { serial: e.serial, ...(e.bonus ? { bonus: e.bonus } : {}) } : {}), }); if (items.length >= limit) break; } return items; }

nodes.name: install-detect.ts
nodes.body_text: // Works out how the visitor is browsing, so the install guide can open on the right instructions (pure, client-safe). const IN_APP = /FBAN|FBAV|Instagram|Line\/|Twitch|TikTok|musical_ly|Snapchat|Twitter|Discord|Pinterest|LinkedInApp|; wv\)/i; /** `touchPoints` is `navigator.maxTouchPoints`: iPadOS reports itself as a Mac, so touch is how it is told apart. */

nodes.name: InstallPlatform
nodes.body_text: type InstallPlatform = 'ios' | 'android' | 'desktop';

nodes.name: InstallBrowser
nodes.body_text: type InstallBrowser = 'safari' | 'chrome' | 'firefox' | 'samsung' | 'edge' | 'other';

nodes.name: InstallEnv
nodes.body_text: interface InstallEnv { platform: InstallPlatform; browser: InstallBrowser; /** Opened inside another app's built-in browser (Instagram, Facebook, Twitch...), which can't add to the home screen. */ inApp: boolean; }

nodes.name: detectInstallEnv
nodes.body_text: function detectInstallEnv(ua: string, touchPoints = 0): InstallEnv { const ios = /iPhone|iPad|iPod/.test(ua) || (/Macintosh/.test(ua) && touchPoints > 1); const android = /Android/i.test(ua); const platform: InstallPlatform = ios ? 'ios' : android ? 'android' : 'desktop'; let browser: InstallBrowser = 'other'; if (/SamsungBrowser/i.test(ua)) browser = 'samsung'; else if (/EdgA|EdgiOS|Edg\//.test(ua)) browser = 'edge'; else if (/FxiOS|Firefox/i.test(ua)) browser = 'firefox'; else if (/CriOS|Chrome\//.test(ua)) browser = 'chrome'; else if (/Safari\//.test(ua)) browser = 'safari'; return { platform, browser, inApp: IN_APP.test(ua) }; }

nodes.name: kv.ts
nodes.body_text: import { dropLedger, isTracking, lastCopy, syncAfterSave, type SyncContext } from './serials'; import type { Origin } from './serials-core'; import { kv } from './db'; import type { Season, Pack, Card, UserProfile, UpgradeCosts, VariantWeights } from './types'; import { DEFAULT_UPGRADE_COSTS, DEFAULT_VARIANT_WEIGHTS, cleanDisabled } from './variants'; import { SEED_SEASON, SEED_PACK, SEED_CARDS } from './seed'; // ── Normalizers (handle legacy KV shapes) ───────────────── // Card art used to ship as 20MB+ GIFs in /assets/GIF; it now lives as animated WebP in /assets/cards. // Rewrite stored legacy URLs on read so existing KV data keeps working without a migration. // ── Seasons ─────────────────────────────────────────────── /** True when a season's start or end time has passed and nothing has acted on it yet (see lib/season-wrap.ts applySeasonSchedule). */ /** Makes exactly one season active (or none, if `activeId` is omitted). */ // ── Packs (global) ──────────────────────────────────────── /** The pack's revision counter: raised by every write to the pack or its cards, so the workspace can tell that someone else saved first. */ // ── Cards ────────────────────────────────────────────────── // ── Composite ───────────────────────────────────────────── // ── User Profiles ───────────────────────────────────────── /** Creates a profile if missing; backfills twitchId on an existing one. */ // Aggregate all users across every season's legacy collection. // Returns one entry per unique username with per-season card arrays. // ── Twitch opaque user ID mapping ───────────────────────── // ── Legacy collection ───────────────────────────────────── /** * Writes a collection. When the collection's copies are being tracked (lib/serials.ts) the write is followed by a ledger sync, so * every route that changes a collection keeps card serials correct without knowing about them. `ctx` says where new copies came * from, or which copies a trade / upgrade moved, so their identity is kept. */ /** * Runs `fn` while holding a short per-collection lock. The whole collection is one JSON blob, so any * read-modify-write (pull, grant, remove, upgrade) must go through this or concurrent serverless * invocations overwrite each other's changes. */ /** * A short named lock (Redis SET NX EX), for any read-modify-write that must not interleave across serverless invocations. * Locks are never held across anything slow. If one code path takes two locks it must always take them in the same order * (trading takes 'trades' first, then a collection's lock; nothing takes them the other way round). */ /** Appends one entry (card + variant, see lib/variants.ts) to a user's collection. Returns their new array. */ /** Like addCollectionEntry, and also says which serial number, copy id and unique number the new copy got (nulls before the collection is numbered). */ /** Removes a user's entry from one collection. Returns true if there was anything to remove. */ // ── Seed ────────────────────────────────────────────────── /** Idempotently installs Season 1 / Cheesy Starter Pack and backfills missing card sounds. */

nodes.name: normalizeSeason
nodes.body_text: function normalizeSeason(raw: unknown): Season { const s = raw as Record<string, unknown>; return { id: s.id as string, name: s.name as string, collectionName: (s.collectionName as string) ?? '', active: ((s.active as boolean) ?? false) && s.status !== 'draft', status: s.status === 'draft' ? 'draft' : 'published', createdAt: (s.createdAt as number) ?? Date.now(), maxConcurrentPacks: (s.maxConcurrentPacks as number) ?? 1, packIds: (s.packIds as string[]) ?? [], ...(typeof s.startsAt === 'number' ? { startsAt: s.startsAt } : {}), ...(typeof s.endsAt === 'number' ? { endsAt: s.endsAt } : {}), ...(s.autoStart === true ? { autoStart: true } : {}), ...(typeof s.endedAt === 'number' ? { endedAt: s.endedAt } : {}), ...(s.tradingFrozen === true ? { tradingFrozen: true } : {}), }; }

nodes.name: normalizeCard
nodes.body_text: function normalizeCard(card: Card): Card { const imageUrl = card.imageUrl?.replace(/^\/assets\/GIF\/(.+)\.gif$/i, '/assets/cards/$1.webp'); const disabled = cleanDisabled(card.disabledVariants); const next = imageUrl === card.imageUrl ? card : { ...card, imageUrl }; // Only carry the field when something is switched off, so existing records are unchanged. return disabled.length ? { ...next, disabledVariants: disabled } : next.disabledVariants ? { ...next, disabledVariants: undefined } : next; }

nodes.name: normalizePack
nodes.body_text: function normalizePack(raw: unknown): Pack { const p = raw as Record<string, unknown>; return { id: p.id as string, name: p.name as string, coverImageUrl: (p.coverImageUrl as string) ?? '', active: (p.active as boolean) ?? true, status: p.status === 'draft' ? 'draft' : 'published', weight: (p.weight as number) ?? 1, accentColor: (p.accentColor as string) ?? 'rgb(241,187,6)', tearBorderColor: (p.tearBorderColor as string) ?? 'rgb(218,163,18)', holoMinStars: (p.holoMinStars as number) ?? 5, cardTime: (p.cardTime as number) ?? 3, cooldownTime: (p.cooldownTime as number) ?? 1, soundVolume: (p.soundVolume as number) ?? 1.0, createdAt: (p.createdAt as number) ?? Date.now(), upgradesEnabled: (p.upgradesEnabled as boolean) ?? false, variantWeights: { ...DEFAULT_VARIANT_WEIGHTS, ...(p.variantWeights as Partial<VariantWeights> | undefined) }, upgradeCosts: { ...DEFAULT_UPGRADE_COSTS, ...(p.upgradeCosts as Partial<UpgradeCosts> | undefined) }, disabledVariants: cleanDisabled(p.disabledVariants), ...(p.archived === true ? { archived: true, archivedAt: (p.archivedAt as number | undefined) ?? undefined } : {}), }; }

nodes.name: listSeasonIds
nodes.body_text: async function listSeasonIds(): Promise<string[]> { return (await kv.get<string[]>('seasons:list')) ?? []; }

nodes.name: listSeasons
nodes.body_text: async function listSeasons(): Promise<Season[]> { const ids = await listSeasonIds(); const raws = await Promise.all(ids.map(id => kv.get(`season:${id}`))); return raws.filter(Boolean).map(normalizeSeason); }

nodes.name: getSeason
nodes.signature: async function getSeason(id: string): Promise<Season | null>
nodes.body_text: async function getSeason(id: string): Promise<Season | null> { const raw = await kv.get(`season:${id}`); return raw ? normalizeSeason(raw) : null; }

nodes.name: scheduleDue
nodes.signature: function scheduleDue(seasons: Season[], now = Date.now()): boolean
nodes.body_text: function scheduleDue(seasons: Season[], now = Date.now()): boolean { return seasons.some(s => s.status === 'published' && ( (!s.active && s.autoStart && !s.endedAt && s.startsAt !== undefined && s.startsAt <= now && (s.endsAt === undefined || s.endsAt > now)) || (s.active && !s.endedAt && s.endsAt !== undefined && s.endsAt <= now) )); }

nodes.name: getActiveSeason
nodes.body_text: async function getActiveSeason(): Promise<Season | null> { let seasons = await listSeasons(); // There is no background job: a scheduled start / end is applied the first time anything asks for the active season after it is due. if (scheduleDue(seasons)) { try { const { applySeasonSchedule } = await import('./season-wrap'); await applySeasonSchedule(); seasons = await listSeasons(); } catch { /* scheduling must never break a read */ } } return seasons.find(s => s.active && s.status === 'published') ?? null; }

nodes.name: saveSeason
nodes.body_text: async function saveSeason(season: Season): Promise<void> { await kv.set(`season:${season.id}`, season); const ids = await listSeasonIds(); if (!ids.includes(season.id)) { await kv.set('seasons:list', [...ids, season.id]); } }

nodes.name: setActiveSeason
nodes.body_text: async function setActiveSeason(activeId?: string): Promise<void> { const all = await listSeasons(); if (activeId && all.find(s => s.id === activeId)?.status === 'draft') { throw new Error('A draft season cannot be activated. Publish it first.'); } await Promise.all( all .filter(s => s.active !== (s.id === activeId)) .map(s => saveSeason({ ...s, active: s.id === activeId })) ); }

nodes.name: deleteSeason
nodes.body_text: async function deleteSeason(id: string): Promise<void> { await kv.del(`season:${id}`); const ids = await listSeasonIds(); await kv.set('seasons:list', ids.filter(i => i !== id)); }

nodes.name: listAllPacks

nodes.name: savePack
nodes.body_text: async function savePack(pack: Pack): Promise<void> { await kv.set(`pack:${pack.id}`, pack); await bumpRev(pack.id); const ids = await listAllPackIds(); if (!ids.includes(pack.id)) { await kv.set('packs:list', [...ids, pack.id]); } }

nodes.name: deletePack
nodes.body_text: async function deletePack(id: string): Promise<void> { await Promise.all([kv.del(`pack:${id}`), kv.del(`pack:${id}:cards`), kv.del(`pack:${id}:cardback`), kv.del(`pack:${id}:rev`)]); const ids = await listAllPackIds(); await kv.set('packs:list', ids.filter(i => i !== id)); // remove from any seasons that reference this pack const seasons = await listSeasons(); await Promise.all( seasons .filter(s => s.packIds.includes(id)) .map(s => saveSeason({ ...s, packIds: s.packIds.filter(pid => pid !== id) })) ); }

nodes.name: getPacksForSeason
nodes.body_text: async function getPacksForSeason(season: Season): Promise<Pack[]> { const raws = await Promise.all(season.packIds.map(id => kv.get(`pack:${id}`))); return raws.filter(Boolean).map(normalizePack); }

nodes.name: getActivePacksForSeason
nodes.body_text: async function getActivePacksForSeason(season: Season): Promise<Pack[]> { const packs = await getPacksForSeason(season); return packs.filter(p => p.active && p.status === 'published'); }

nodes.name: getPackCards

nodes.name: getActiveSeasonWithPacks

nodes.body_text: async function getActiveSeasonWithPacks(): Promise<{ season: Season; packs: { pack: Pack; cards: Card[] }[]; } | null> { const season = await getActiveSeason(); if (!season) return null; const activePacks = await getActivePacksForSeason(season); const packsWithCards = await Promise.all( activePacks.map(async pack => ({ pack, cards: await getPackCards(pack.id) })) ); return { season, packs: packsWithCards }; }

nodes.body_text: async function getAllCollectionUsers(): Promise<{ username: string; seasons: { id: string; name: string; collectionName: string; cards: number[] }[]; }[]> { const seasons = await listSeasons(); const collections = await Promise.all(seasons.map(s => getCollection(s.collectionName))); const userMap = new Map<string, { id: string; name: string; collectionName: string; cards: number[] }[]>(); seasons.forEach((season, i) => { for (const [username, cards] of Object.entries(collections[i])) { const lower = username.toLowerCase(); if (!userMap.has(lower)) userMap.set(lower, []); userMap.get(lower)!.push({ id: season.id, name: season.name, collectionName: season.collectionName, cards, }); } }); return Array.from(userMap.entries()).map(([username, seasons]) => ({ username, seasons })); }

nodes.name: withLock
nodes.signature: async function withLock<T>(name: string, fn: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T>
nodes.body_text: async function withLock<T>(name: string, fn: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> { const key = `lock:${name}`; const token = crypto.randomUUID(); for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 30; attempt++) { const got = await kv.set(key, token, { nx: true, ex: 10 }); if (got) { try { return await fn(); } finally { if ((await kv.get(key)) === token) await kv.del(key); } } await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 80 + Math.random() * 120)); } throw new Error('That is busy, try again'); }

nodes.name: seedSeason1
nodes.body_text: async function seedSeason1(): Promise<void> { const [seasonIds, packIds] = await Promise.all([listSeasonIds(), listAllPackIds()]); if (!packIds.includes(SEED_PACK.id)) { await savePack(SEED_PACK); await savePackCards(SEED_PACK.id, SEED_CARDS); } else { const seedSound = new Map(SEED_CARDS.map(c => [c.id, c.soundUrl])); const existing = await getPackCards(SEED_PACK.id); if (existing.some(c => !c.soundUrl && seedSound.get(c.id))) { await savePackCards( SEED_PACK.id, existing.map(c => (c.soundUrl ? c : { ...c, soundUrl: seedSound.get(c.id) })) ); } } if (!seasonIds.includes(SEED_SEASON.id)) { await saveSeason(SEED_SEASON); } else { const existing = await getSeason(SEED_SEASON.id); if (existing && !existing.packIds.includes(SEED_PACK.id)) { await saveSeason({ ...existing, packIds: [...existing.packIds, SEED_PACK.id] }); } } }

nodes.name: leaderboard.ts
nodes.body_text: import type { Card, Pack, Season, Variant } from './types'; import { getCollection, getPackCards, getPacksForSeason } from './kv'; import { VARIANTS, decodeEntry, effectiveWeights, emptyCounts, encodeEntry, type VariantCounts } from './variants'; import { DEFAULT_SCORING, getScoringSettings, type ScoringSettings } from './scoring'; import { serialMultiplier } from './scoring-core'; import { loadSerialIndex } from './serials'; import type { SerialIndex } from './serials-core'; import { currentSandboxId, kv } from './db'; import { createTtlCache } from './ttl-cache'; /** The set of hidden viewers (KV `users:hidden`, kept by lib/user-admin.ts); read here directly to avoid a circular import. */ import type { CardMaths } from './card-maths'; // Every tunable number (base score, serial bonus, upgrade margin, bonus sizes, ...) lives in ScoringSettings // (lib/scoring.ts), edited in Admin -> Settings -> Scoring. Functions here take them as a parameter and default to the // built-in defaults, so they stay pure and testable. /** The two collection bonuses for someone who owns `uniqueCards` distinct cards of the season. */ /** One copy's points: the card's value for that version, times the bonus its serial number earns (no serial = no bonus). */ /** What a viewer's copies are worth: each entry takes its serial numbers (lowest first) when the ledger knows them. */ /** * How much a copy at each variant is worth relative to Regular. Starts from the variant odds (a 1-in-100 * shiny is worth ~100 regulars), but never less than the cost of crafting it plus a margin, otherwise * upgrading could lower a viewer's score. */ /** * Per-card values for a season: * value = SCORE_BASE × rarity × variantMultiplier * - rarity: how much rarer than an average card it is to roll (1 = average; from card probability and pack weight) * - variantMultiplier: see variantMultipliers * A copy's own points then get its serial bonus on top (copyPoints): the earliest copies ever made are worth more. */ /** One viewer's total score: the value of every copy they hold, plus the collection bonuses. */ /** * What an upgrade would really do to a viewer's score: `cost` copies of `from` go (the newest serials, as the ledger does) and one * `to` copy arrives with the next free serial of that version. Nobody else's copies matter to a value any more, so this is just the * viewer's own score before and after. Can be negative when the serial bonuses spent outweigh what the new version adds. */ /** Loads everything needed and returns the season's value table plus ranked rows. */ const boardCache = createTtlCache<Board>(20_000); /** * The same board, shared for ~20 seconds between everyone looking at the PUBLIC pages (home, leaderboard, stats, card dex), so a * burst of visitors costs one computation. Never use it where a viewer has just changed their own cards (their collection, My Stats, * upgrades, trades) or in the admin: those call getSeasonLeaderboard directly. The result is shared: treat it as read-only. */
