[]), ...(self as string[])]); } catch { return new Set(); } }

nodes.name: CardValue
nodes.body_text: interface CardValue { number: number; /** Chance that one pull of the season is this card, before the variant roll. */ pullRate: number; /** How many copies of this card exist across everyone's collections this season (all variants). */ copies: number; /** The same, split by variant. */ variantCopies: VariantCounts; /** Points per copy, by variant, before any serial bonus (a copy with a low serial is worth more: see copyPoints). */ values: Record<Variant, number>; /** The working behind `values`, for the card details' Advanced information panel. */ maths: CardMaths; }

nodes.name: LeaderboardRow
nodes.body_text: interface LeaderboardRow { username: string; /** Total: card points + progress bonus + full set bonus. */ score: number; /** Value of every copy owned, serial bonuses included. */ cardPoints: number; /** The part of `cardPoints` that came from low serial numbers. */ serialPoints: number; completionBonus: number; setBonus: number; /** Owns at least one of every card in the season. */ complete: boolean; uniqueCards: number; copies: number; variants: VariantCounts; }

nodes.name: SeasonValues
nodes.body_text: interface SeasonValues { cards: Map<number, CardValue>; totalCards: number; totalCopies: number; /** What one Regular copy of every card is worth right now: the yardstick for the collection bonuses. */ setValue: number; /** The scoring settings these values were computed with. */ settings: ScoringSettings; /** Who holds which serial numbers. Absent (or a viewer missing from it) = no serial bonus. */ serials?: SerialIndex | null; }

nodes.name: Bonuses
nodes.body_text: interface Bonuses { completion: number; set: number; /** Fraction of the season's cards owned (0-1). */ fraction: number; complete: boolean; }

nodes.name: collectionBonuses
nodes.signature: function collectionBonuses(values: Pick<SeasonValues, 'totalCards' | 'setValue' | 'settings'>, uniqueCards: number): Bonuses
nodes.body_text: function collectionBonuses(values: Pick<SeasonValues, 'totalCards' | 'setValue' | 'settings'>, uniqueCards: number): Bonuses { const total = values.totalCards; const fraction = total > 0 ? Math.min(1, uniqueCards / total) : 0; const complete = total > 0 && uniqueCards >= total; return { completion: Math.round(values.setValue * (values.settings.completionBonusPct / 100) * fraction), set: complete ? Math.round(values.setValue * (values.settings.completeSetBonusPct / 100)) : 0, fraction, complete, }; }

nodes.name: copyPoints
nodes.signature: function copyPoints(cv: CardValue, variant: Variant, serial: number | undefined, settings: ScoringSettings): number
nodes.body_text: function copyPoints(cv: CardValue, variant: Variant, serial: number | undefined, settings: ScoringSettings): number { const mult = serialMultiplier(serial, settings); return mult === 1 ? cv.values[variant] : Math.max(1, Math.round(cv.maths.raw[variant] * mult)); }

nodes.name: HeldPoints
nodes.body_text: interface HeldPoints { /** Points of every copy, serial bonuses included. */ points: number; /** The part of `points` that came from serial bonuses. */ serialPoints: number; unique: Set<number>; variants: VariantCounts; copies: number; }

nodes.name: pointsFor
nodes.signature: function pointsFor(values: Pick<SeasonValues, 'cards' | 'settings' | 'serials'>, entries: number[], username?: string): HeldPoints
nodes.body_text: function pointsFor(values: Pick<SeasonValues, 'cards' | 'settings' | 'serials'>, entries: number[], username?: string): HeldPoints { const held = username !== undefined ? values.serials?.held.get(username) : undefined; const seen = new Map<number, number>(); const out: HeldPoints = { points: 0, serialPoints: 0, unique: new Set(), variants: emptyCounts(), copies: 0 }; for (const entry of entries) { const { cardNumber, variant } = decodeEntry(entry); const cv = values.cards.get(cardNumber); if (!cv) continue; // card since deleted from the season const k = seen.get(entry) ?? 0; seen.set(entry, k + 1); const pts = copyPoints(cv, variant, held?.get(entry)?.[k], values.settings); out.points += pts; out.serialPoints += pts - cv.values[variant]; out.unique.add(cardNumber); out.variants[variant]++; out.copies++; } return out; }

nodes.name: variantMultiplierDetail
nodes.signature: function variantMultiplierDetail( pack: Pick<Pack, 'upgradesEnabled' | 'variantWeights' | 'upgradeCosts' | 'disabledVariants'>, settings: ScoringSettings = DEFAULT_SCORING, ): { multiplier: Record<Variant, number>; byOdds: Record<Variant, number>; byCost: Record<Variant, number> }
nodes.body_text: function variantMultiplierDetail( pack: Pick<Pack, 'upgradesEnabled' | 'variantWeights' | 'upgradeCosts' | 'disabledVariants'>, settings: ScoringSettings = DEFAULT_SCORING, ): { multiplier: Record<Variant, number>; byOdds: Record<Variant, number>; byCost: Record<Variant, number> } { const m: Record<Variant, number> = { regular: 1, reverse: 1, full: 1, shiny: 1 }; const byOddsAll: Record<Variant, number> = { regular: 1, reverse: 1, full: 1, shiny: 1 }; const byCostAll: Record<Variant, number> = { regular: 1, reverse: 1, full: 1, shiny: 1 }; if (!pack.upgradesEnabled) return { multiplier: m, byOdds: byOddsAll, byCost: byCostAll }; const w = effectiveWeights(pack); // switched-off variants have no odds, so only the crafting cost sets their value for (let i = 1; i < VARIANTS.length; i++) { const v = VARIANTS[i]; const byOdds = w[v] > 0 ? w.regular / w[v] : 0; const byCost = m[VARIANTS[i - 1]] * pack.upgradeCosts[v as Exclude<Variant, 'regular'>] * settings.upgradeMargin; byOddsAll[v] = byOdds; byCostAll[v] = byCost; m[v] = Math.max(byOdds, byCost); } return { multiplier: m, byOdds: byOddsAll, byCost: byCostAll }; }

nodes.name: variantMultipliers
nodes.signature: function variantMultipliers( pack: Pick<Pack, 'upgradesEnabled' | 'variantWeights' | 'upgradeCosts' | 'disabledVariants'>, settings: ScoringSettings = DEFAULT_SCORING, ): Record<Variant, number>
nodes.body_text: function variantMultipliers( pack: Pick<Pack, 'upgradesEnabled' | 'variantWeights' | 'upgradeCosts' | 'disabledVariants'>, settings: ScoringSettings = DEFAULT_SCORING, ): Record<Variant, number> { return variantMultiplierDetail(pack, settings).multiplier; }

nodes.name: computeSeasonValues
nodes.signature: function computeSeasonValues( packs: { pack: Pack; cards: Card[] }[], collection: Record<string, number[]>, settings: ScoringSettings = DEFAULT_SCORING, serials: SerialIndex | null = null, ): SeasonValues
nodes.body_text: function computeSeasonValues( packs: { pack: Pack; cards: Card[] }[], collection: Record<string, number[]>, settings: ScoringSettings = DEFAULT_SCORING, serials: SerialIndex | null = null, ): SeasonValues { const active = packs.filter(p => p.cards.length > 0); const totalPackWeight = active.reduce((s, p) => s + (p.pack.weight || 1), 0); const totalCards = active.reduce((s, p) => s + p.cards.length, 0); const copiesByCard = new Map<number, VariantCounts>(); let totalCopies = 0; for (const entries of Object.values(collection)) { for (const entry of entries) { const { cardNumber, variant } = decodeEntry(entry); const counts = copiesByCard.get(cardNumber) ?? emptyCounts(); counts[variant]++; copiesByCard.set(cardNumber, counts); totalCopies++; } } const cards = new Map<number, CardValue>(); for (const { pack, cards: packCards } of active) { const totalProb = packCards.reduce((s, c) => s + c.probability, 0); const detail = variantMultiplierDetail(pack, settings); const mult = detail.multiplier; const packWeights = effectiveWeights(pack); for (const card of packCards) { const pullRate = totalProb > 0 && totalPackWeight > 0 ? ((pack.weight || 1) / totalPackWeight) * (card.probability / totalProb) : 1 / Math.max(1, totalCards); const rarity = pullRate > 0 ? Math.pow(1 / (pullRate * totalCards), settings.rarityExponent) : 1; const variantCopies = copiesByCard.get(card.number) ?? emptyCounts(); const copies = VARIANTS.reduce((s, v) => s + variantCopies[v], 0); const values = {} as Record<Variant, number>; const raw = {} as Record<Variant, number>; for (const v of VARIANTS) { raw[v] = settings.baseScore * rarity * mult[v]; values[v] = Math.max(1, Math.round(raw[v])); } const maths: CardMaths = { baseScore: settings.baseScore, rarityExponent: settings.rarityExponent, serialBonusMax: settings.serialBonusMax, serialBonusCutoff: settings.serialBonusCutoff, upgradeMargin: settings.upgradeMargin, completionBonusPct: settings.completionBonusPct, completeSetBonusPct: settings.completeSetBonusPct, packWeight: pack.weight || 1, totalPackWeight, cardProbability: card.probability, totalProbability: totalProb, pullRate, totalCards, rarityBase: pullRate > 0 ? 1 / (pullRate * totalCards) : 1, rarity, upgradesEnabled: !!pack.upgradesEnabled, weights: packWeights, costs: pack.upgradeCosts, byOdds: detail.byOdds, byCost: detail.byCost, multiplier: mult, copies: variantCopies, raw, values, setValue: 0, totalCopies, }; cards.set(card.number, { number: card.number, pullRate, copies, variantCopies, values, maths }); } } let setValue = 0; for (const cv of cards.values()) setValue += cv.values.regular; for (const cv of cards.values()) cv.maths.setValue = setValue; return { cards, totalCards, totalCopies, setValue, settings, serials }; }

nodes.name: scoreFor
nodes.signature: function scoreFor(values: SeasonValues, entries: number[], username?: string): number
nodes.body_text: function scoreFor(values: SeasonValues, entries: number[], username?: string): number { const held = pointsFor(values, entries, username); const b = collectionBonuses(values, held.unique.size); return held.points + b.completion + b.set; }

nodes.name: projectUpgradeGain
nodes.signature: function projectUpgradeGain( values: SeasonValues, owned: number[], username: string, cardNumber: number, from: Variant, to: Variant, cost: number, ): number | null
nodes.body_text: function projectUpgradeGain( values: SeasonValues, owned: number[], username: string, cardNumber: number, from: Variant, to: Variant, cost: number, ): number | null { const fromEntry = encodeEntry(cardNumber, from); const toEntry = encodeEntry(cardNumber, to); const after: number[] = []; let toRemove = cost; for (let i = owned.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { if (owned[i] === fromEntry && toRemove > 0) toRemove--; else after.push(owned[i]); } if (toRemove > 0) return null; // doesn't have enough copies after.push(toEntry); const idx = values.serials; const held = idx?.held.get(username); let afterValues = values; if (idx && held) { // The same serials after the upgrade: the `cost` highest of the spent version go, the next free one of the new version arrives. const spent = held.get(fromEntry) ?? []; const next = new Map(held); next.set(fromEntry, spent.slice(0, Math.max(0, spent.length - cost))); next.set(toEntry, [...(held.get(toEntry) ?? []), (idx.minted.get(toEntry) ?? 0) + 1].sort((a, b) => a - b)); afterValues = { ...values, serials: { ...idx, held: new Map(idx.held).set(username, next) } }; } return scoreFor(afterValues, after, username) - scoreFor(values, owned, username); }

nodes.name: buildLeaderboard
nodes.signature: function buildLeaderboard(values: SeasonValues, collection: Record<string, number[]>): LeaderboardRow[]
nodes.body_text: function buildLeaderboard(values: SeasonValues, collection: Record<string, number[]>): LeaderboardRow[] { const rows: LeaderboardRow[] = []; for (const [username, entries] of Object.entries(collection)) { const held = pointsFor(values, entries, username); if (held.copies > 0) { const b = collectionBonuses(values, held.unique.size); rows.push({ username: username.toLowerCase(), score: held.points + b.completion + b.set, cardPoints: held.points, serialPoints: held.serialPoints, completionBonus: b.completion, setBonus: b.set, complete: b.complete, uniqueCards: held.unique.size, copies: held.copies, variants: held.variants, }); } } return rows.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score || b.uniqueCards - a.uniqueCards || a.username.localeCompare(b.username)); }

nodes.name: getSeasonLeaderboard
nodes.signature: async function getSeasonLeaderboard(season: Season): Promise<{ rows: LeaderboardRow[]; values: SeasonValues; packs: { pack: Pack; cards: Card[] }[]; }>
nodes.body_text: async function getSeasonLeaderboard(season: Season): Promise<{ rows: LeaderboardRow[]; values: SeasonValues; packs: { pack: Pack; cards: Card[] }[]; }> { const [packList, collection, settings, serials] = await Promise.all([ getPacksForSeason(season), getCollection(season.collectionName), getScoringSettings(), loadSerialIndex(season.collectionName), ]); // A draft pack attached to a published season is never drawn, so nobody can own its cards: counting them would dilute every // card's rarity and make a complete collection impossible. (An inactive published pack still counts: its cards can be held.) const packs = await Promise.all(packList.filter(p => p.status !== 'draft').map(async pack => ({ pack, cards: await getPackCards(pack.id) }))); const values = computeSeasonValues(packs, collection, settings, serials); // Viewers an admin has hidden from public rankings are left out of the rows (their cards still count in the season's copy totals). const hidden = await getHiddenUsersSafe(); const rows = buildLeaderboard(values, collection).filter(r => !hidden.has(r.username)); return { rows, values, packs }; }

Set these in the deployment's environment so the // published documents name a real operator and a real way to get in touch. Don't hard-code them here. // LEGAL_OPERATOR_NAME who runs the extension (a person or business name), e.g. "Jane Doe" // LEGAL_CONTACT_EMAIL where privacy / data requests go // LEGAL_GOVERNING_LAW e.g. "the laws of England and Wales" // Everything falls back to neutral wording when unset, so the pages always render. export const LEGAL_UPDATED = '18 October 2026'; export const APP_NAME = 'The Cheesy TCG'; export const OPERATOR = process.env.LEGAL_OPERATOR_NAME?.trim() || 'the streamer who operates this extension'; export const CONTACT_EMAIL = process.env.LEGAL_CONTACT_EMAIL?.trim() || ''; export const GOVERNING_LAW = process.env.LEGAL_GOVERNING_LAW?.trim() || ''; export const PRIVACY_URL = `${SITE_URL}/privacy`; export const TERMS_URL = `${SITE_URL}/terms`;

nodes.name: mixitup-core.ts
nodes.body_text: // Mix It Up paid pulls (ROADMAP Track 12): the settings, the message template, how replies are read and when a pull is allowed. // Pure (no database, no network), so the settings form, the server and scripts/check-mixitup.mts share it. import { checkWebhookUrl } from './webhook-clean'; export const MESSAGE_VARS = ['username', 'amount', 'currency', 'cardName', 'variant', 'stars', 'packName', 'cardNumber', 'serial'] as const; export const DEFAULT_MESSAGE = '{username} opened a pack and pulled {cardName} ({variant}, {stars} stars). {amount} {currency} spent.'; export const MESSAGE_MAX = 400; export const DEFAULT_MIXITUP: MixItUpSettings = { enabled: false, balanceUrl: '', deductUrl: '', secret: '', currency: 'Brie Bucks', cost: 100, limit: 0, message: DEFAULT_MESSAGE, balanceField: 'balance', }; /** Whatever is stored (or nothing), as complete, safe settings. */ /** Checks the settings form. Returns the cleaned settings, or the first problem in words. */ /** Fills {placeholders}; an unknown or missing one becomes empty. Capped so a long card name cannot make an oversized message. */ /** Sample values for the form's live preview. */ export const SAMPLE_VARS = { username: 'cheesyviewer', amount: 100, currency: 'Brie Bucks', cardName: 'Gouda Goat', variant: 'Shiny Full Art', stars: 4, packName: 'Base', cardNumber: 7, serial: 3 }; /** The balance in a reply body, or null when it is missing or not a whole, non-negative number. Numeric strings ("1,250" too) are accepted. */ /** Did Mix It Up say it applied the deduction? A 2xx answer counts unless the body sets ok / success / applied to false. */ /** The window "per stream" counts in: the Twitch stream's start, else the UTC day (off-stream or Twitch not configured). */ /** The sentence a refusal sends back for Mix It Up to post to chat. */ /** Can this balance cover every pull in flight, this one included (`pending` already counts it)? */

nodes.name: MixItUpSettings
nodes.body_text: interface MixItUpSettings { enabled: boolean; /** Mix It Up webhook command that answers `{ balance }`. */ balanceUrl: string; /** Command that takes the currency. Empty = the balance URL again (Mix It Up tells them apart by `action`). */ deductUrl: string; /** Sent as `secret` in every request so the command can check where it came from. */ secret: string; currency: string; /** What one pack costs, in the currency. */ cost: number; /** Paid pulls per viewer per stream; 0 = no limit. */ limit: number; /** The message sent with the deduction. See MESSAGE_VARS. */ message: string; /** Which key of the balance reply holds the number. */ balanceField: string; }

nodes.name: num
nodes.signature: num = (v: unknown, fallback: number, min: number, max: number): number
nodes.body_text: num = (v: unknown, fallback: number, min: number, max: number): number => { const n = typeof v === 'number' ? v : typeof v === 'string' && v.trim() !== '' ? Number(v) : NaN; return Number.isFinite(n) ? Math.min(max, Math.max(min, Math.floor(n))) : fallback; }

nodes.name: text
nodes.signature: text = (v: unknown, max: number, fallback = ''): string
nodes.body_text: text = (v: unknown, max: number, fallback = ''): string => (typeof v === 'string' ? v.trim().slice(0, max) : fallback)

nodes.name: normalizeMixItUp
nodes.body_text: function normalizeMixItUp(raw: unknown): MixItUpSettings { const r = (raw && typeof raw === 'object' ? raw : {}) as Record<string, unknown>; const d = DEFAULT_MIXITUP; return { enabled: r.enabled === true, balanceUrl: text(r.balanceUrl, 500), deductUrl: text(r.deductUrl, 500), secret: text(r.secret, 200), currency: text(r.currency, 40, d.currency) || d.currency, cost: num(r.cost, d.cost, 1, 1_000_000), limit: num(r.limit, d.limit, 0, 1000), message: text(r.message, MESSAGE_MAX, d.message) || d.message, balanceField: text(r.balanceField, 60, d.balanceField) || d.balanceField, }; }

nodes.name: cleanMixItUpInput
nodes.signature: function cleanMixItUpInput(raw: Record<string, unknown>): { ok: true; settings: MixItUpSettings } | { ok: false; message: string }
nodes.body_text: function cleanMixItUpInput(raw: Record<string, unknown>): { ok: true; settings: MixItUpSettings } | { ok: false; message: string } { const s = normalizeMixItUp(raw); for (const [key, label] of [['balanceUrl', 'balance address'], ['deductUrl', 'deduct address']] as const) { const t = checkWebhookUrl(s[key]); if (!t.ok) return { ok: false, message: `The ${label}: ${t.error}` }; s[key] = t.url; } const cost = Number(raw.cost); if (raw.cost !== undefined && (!Number.isFinite(cost) || cost < 1)) return { ok: false, message: 'The price per pack must be 1 or more.' }; s.enabled = raw.enabled === true || raw.enabled === 'true' || raw.enabled === 'on'; if (s.enabled && !s.balanceUrl) return { ok: false, message: 'Paste the balance address before switching Mix It Up on.' }; return { ok: true, settings: s }; }

nodes.name: renderMessage
nodes.signature: function renderMessage(template: string, vars: Record<string, string | number | undefined>): string
nodes.body_text: function renderMessage(template: string, vars: Record<string, string | number | undefined>): string { const out = template.replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (_, k: string) => String(vars[k] ?? '')).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); return out.length > MESSAGE_MAX ? out.slice(0, MESSAGE_MAX - 1) + '…' : out; }

nodes.name: parseBalance
nodes.signature: function parseBalance(body: unknown, field: string): number | null
nodes.body_text: function parseBalance(body: unknown, field: string): number | null { if (!body || typeof body !== 'object') return null; let v = (body as Record<string, unknown>)[field]; if (typeof v === 'string') v = Number(v.replace(/[,\s]/g, '')); return typeof v === 'number' && Number.isFinite(v) && v >= 0 ? Math.floor(v) : null; }

nodes.name: replyApplied
nodes.signature: function replyApplied(status: number, body: unknown): boolean
nodes.body_text: function replyApplied(status: number, body: unknown): boolean { if (status < 200 || status >= 300) return false; if (body && typeof body === 'object') { const b = body as Record<string, unknown>; for (const k of ['ok', 'success', 'applied']) if (b[k] === false || b[k] === 'false') return false; } return true; }

nodes.name: streamKey
nodes.signature: function streamKey(startedAtMs: number | null, now = Date.now()): string
nodes.body_text: function streamKey(startedAtMs: number | null, now = Date.now()): string { return startedAtMs ? `s${startedAtMs}` : `d${new Date(now).toISOString().slice(0, 10)}`; }

nodes.name: RefusalReason
nodes.body_text: type RefusalReason = 'insufficient_balance' | 'limit_reached' | 'mixitup_unavailable' | 'bad_balance';

nodes.name: refusalMessage
nodes.signature: function refusalMessage(reason: RefusalReason, s: Pick<MixItUpSettings, 'cost' | 'currency' | 'limit'>, username: string, balance?: number): string
nodes.body_text: function refusalMessage(reason: RefusalReason, s: Pick<MixItUpSettings, 'cost' | 'currency' | 'limit'>, username: string, balance?: number): string { switch (reason) { case 'insufficient_balance': return `${username}, a pack costs ${s.cost.toLocaleString()} ${s.currency}${balance !== undefined ? ` and you have ${balance.toLocaleString()}` : ''}.`; case 'limit_reached': return `${username}, you have used all ${s.limit} pulls for this stream.`; case 'bad_balance': return `${username}, the balance could not be read, so no pack was opened.`; default: return `${username}, the balance check did not answer, so no pack was opened. Try again in a moment.`; } }

nodes.name: decide
nodes.signature: function decide(o: { balance: number; cost: number; pending: number }): boolean
nodes.body_text: function decide(o: { balance: number; cost: number; pending: number }): boolean { return o.balance >= o.cost * o.pending; // pending already counts this pull }

nodes.name: mixitup.ts
nodes.body_text: // Mix It Up paid pulls, the server side (ROADMAP Track 12; the pure parts are in mixitup-core.ts). A pull is reserved when the // pull webhook arrives (limit and balance checked), claimed when the overlay saves the card, and charged then; if Mix It Up does // not confirm the charge, the print is revoked. import { kv, inSandbox } from './db'; import { checkWebhookUrl } from './webhook-clean'; import { getCollection, saveCollection, withCollectionLock } from './kv'; import { getCopy } from './serials'; import { entryOf, isEscrow } from './serials-core'; import { getLiveStatus } from './twitch-live'; import { notifySystem } from './discord'; import { getUserPullLimit } from './pull-limit'; import { effectiveLimit } from './pull-limit-core'; import { normalizeMixItUp, parseBalance, refusalMessage, renderMessage, replyApplied, streamKey, decide, type MixItUpSettings, type RefusalReason, } from './mixitup-core'; const KEY = 'mixitup:settings'; const LOG = 'mixitup:log'; const TIMEOUT_MS = 5000; const PAY_TTL_S = 12 * 3600; // as long as a draw ticket (lib/draw.ts) const COUNT_TTL_S = 3 * 86400; // ── The request log (last 20) ── // ── Talking to Mix It Up ── /** POSTs JSON to a Mix It Up webhook command and reads its answer. Only public http(s) addresses; never throws. */ /** Asks Mix It Up for one viewer's balance. */ /** Sends a message that deducts nothing, so the command can be tried without a real pull. */ // ── Reserve ── /** * Before a pull is queued: is the viewer under their limit and able to pay? On success the pull is reserved under `payId` (limit * and in-flight counts raised, until the pull is claimed or the reservation expires). A sandbox never calls out and never charges. */ /** How many paid pulls a viewer has used in the current stream window (for the admin's user page). */ // ── Claim, charge, revoke ── /** Takes a reservation (once). Null = unknown, expired, already used, or for another viewer: nothing is saved then. */ /** Tells Mix It Up to take the currency, with the message about the card. Applied = it said so. */ /** Cancels a reservation whose pull never got queued: the viewer's allowance and in-flight count come back. */ /** A claimed pull that was not charged: give the viewer's pull allowance back. */ /** * Takes the print back after a failed charge: removed from the viewer's collection and retired in the copy ledger, under the * collection lock. Returns their new collection, or null if the print was no longer theirs (nothing changed then). */

nodes.name: getMixItUpSettings
nodes.body_text: async function getMixItUpSettings(): Promise<MixItUpSettings> { return normalizeMixItUp(await kv.get(KEY).catch(() => null)); }

nodes.name: saveMixItUpSettings
nodes.body_text: async function saveMixItUpSettings(s: MixItUpSettings): Promise<void> { await kv.set(KEY, normalizeMixItUp(s)); }

nodes.name: MixItUpLogEntry
nodes.body_text: interface MixItUpLogEntry { at: number; username: string; what: 'balance' | 'deduct' | 'test' | 'revoked' | 'refused' | 'command'; ok: boolean; detail: string }

nodes.name: logMixItUp
nodes.body_text: async function logMixItUp(e: Omit<MixItUpLogEntry, 'at'>): Promise<void> { try { await kv.lpush(LOG, { ...e, at: Date.now() }); await kv.ltrim(LOG, 0, 19); } catch { /* the log never breaks a pull */ } }

nodes.name: getMixItUpLog
nodes.body_text: async function getMixItUpLog(): Promise<MixItUpLogEntry[]> { try { return (await kv.lrange<MixItUpLogEntry>(LOG, 0, 19)) ?? []; } catch { return []; } }

nodes.name: Fetch
nodes.body_text: type Fetch = typeof fetch;

nodes.name: Reply
nodes.body_text: interface Reply { ok: boolean; status: number; body: unknown; error?: string }

nodes.name: callMixItUp
nodes.signature: async function callMixItUp(url: string, payload: Record<string, unknown>, doFetch: Fetch = fetch): Promise<Reply>
nodes.body_text: async function callMixItUp(url: string, payload: Record<string, unknown>, doFetch: Fetch = fetch): Promise<Reply> { const t = checkWebhookUrl(url); if (!t.ok || !t.url) return { ok: false, status: 0, body: null, error: t.ok ? 'no address set' : t.error }; try { const res = await doFetch(t.url, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(payload), signal: AbortSignal.timeout(TIMEOUT_MS), cache: 'no-store', }); const raw = await res.text().catch(() => ''); let body: unknown = null; try { body = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null; } catch { /* a plain-text answer is fine */ } return { ok: res.ok, status: res.status, body }; } catch (e) { return { ok: false, status: 0, body: null, error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'no answer' }; } }

nodes.name: deductUrl
nodes.body_text: deductUrl = (s: MixItUpSettings) => s.deductUrl || s.balanceUrl

nodes.name: fetchBalance
nodes.signature: async function fetchBalance(s: MixItUpSettings, username: string, doFetch?: Fetch): Promise<{ balance: number | null; error?: string }>
nodes.body_text: async function fetchBalance(s: MixItUpSettings, username: string, doFetch?: Fetch): Promise<{ balance: number | null; error?: string }> { const r = await callMixItUp(s.balanceUrl, { action: 'balance', secret: s.secret, username, currency: s.currency }, doFetch); if (!r.ok) return { balance: null, error: r.error ?? `HTTP ${r.status}` }; const balance = parseBalance(r.body, s.balanceField); return balance === null ? { balance: null, error: `no number at "${s.balanceField}" in the reply` } : { balance }; }

nodes.name: sendTest
nodes.signature: async function sendTest(s: MixItUpSettings, doFetch?: Fetch): Promise<Reply>
nodes.body_text: async function sendTest(s: MixItUpSettings, doFetch?: Fetch): Promise<Reply> { return callMixItUp(deductUrl(s), { action: 'test', secret: s.secret, username: 'tcg-test', amount: 0, currency: s.currency, message: renderMessage(s.message, { username: 'tcg-test', amount: 0, currency: s.currency, cardName: 'Test Card', variant: 'Regular', stars: 1, packName: 'Test', cardNumber: 1, serial: 1 }) }, doFetch); }

nodes.name: pendKey
nodes.body_text: pendKey = (user: string) => `mixitup:pending:${user}`

nodes.body_text: payKey = (id: string) => `mixitup:pay:${id}`

nodes.name: PayRecord
nodes.body_text: interface PayRecord { username: string; amount: number; stream: string; at: number }

nodes.name: Reservation
nodes.signature: type Reservation = { ok: true } | { ok: false; reason: RefusalReason; message: string; balance?: number };
nodes.body_text: type Reservation = { ok: true } | { ok: false; reason: RefusalReason; message: string; balance?: number };

nodes.name: currentStream
nodes.body_text: async function currentStream(): Promise<string> { const live = await getLiveStatus().catch(() => null); const started = live?.live && live.startedAt ? Date.parse(live.startedAt) : NaN; return streamKey(Number.isFinite(started) ? started : null); }

nodes.name: reservePaidPull
nodes.signature: async function reservePaidPull(s: MixItUpSettings, username: string, payId: string, doFetch?: Fetch): Promise<Reservation>
nodes.body_text: async function reservePaidPull(s: MixItUpSettings, username: string, payId: string, doFetch?: Fetch): Promise<Reservation> { const user = username.toLowerCase(); const stream = await currentStream(); // The viewer's own limit (and any bonuses they hold) wins over the default in Settings; 0 = no limit. const limit = effectiveLimit(s.limit, await getUserPullLimit(user)).limit; const refuse = async (reason: RefusalReason, balance?: number, why?: string): Promise<Reservation> => { await logMixItUp({ username: user, what: 'refused', ok: false, detail: `${reason}${why ? `: ${why}` : ''}` }); return { ok: false, reason, message: refusalMessage(reason, { ...s, limit }, user, balance), ...(balance !== undefined ? { balance } : {}) }; }; let counted = false; if (limit > 0) { const used = await kv.incr(cntKey(stream, user)); await kv.expire(cntKey(stream, user), COUNT_TTL_S); counted = true; if (used > limit) { await kv.decr(cntKey(stream, user)); return refuse('limit_reached'); } } const undo = async () => { if (counted) await kv.decr(cntKey(stream, user)); }; const { balance, error } = await fetchBalance(s, user, doFetch); await logMixItUp({ username: user, what: 'balance', ok: balance !== null, detail: balance !== null ? `${balance} ${s.currency}` : error ?? 'no answer' }); if (balance === null) { await undo(); return refuse(error?.startsWith('no number') ? 'bad_balance' : 'mixitup_unavailable', undefined, error); } const pending = await kv.incr(pendKey(user)); await kv.expire(pendKey(user), 600); if (!decide({ balance, cost: s.cost, pending })) { await kv.decr(pendKey(user)); await undo(); return refuse('insufficient_balance', balance); } await kv.set(payKey(payId), { username: user, amount: s.cost, stream, at: Date.now() } satisfies PayRecord, { ex: PAY_TTL_S }); return { ok: true }; }

nodes.name: refuse
nodes.signature: refuse = async (reason: RefusalReason, balance?: number, why?: string): Promise<Reservation>
nodes.body_text: refuse = async (reason: RefusalReason, balance?: number, why?: string): Promise<Reservation> => { await logMixItUp({ username: user, what: 'refused', ok: false, detail: `${reason}${why ? `: ${why}` : ''}` }); return { ok: false, reason, message: refusalMessage(reason, { ...s, limit }, user, balance), ...(balance !== undefined ? { balance } : {}) }; }

nodes.name: undo
nodes.body_text: undo = async () => { if (counted) await kv.decr(cntKey(stream, user)); }

nodes.name: pullsUsedThisStream
nodes.body_text: async function pullsUsedThisStream(username: string): Promise<number> { const n = Number(await kv.get(cntKey(await currentStream(), username.toLowerCase())).catch(() => 0)); return Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0 ? n : 0; }

nodes.name: Claimed
nodes.body_text: interface Claimed { payId: string; username: string; amount: number; stream: string }

nodes.name: claimPaidPull
nodes.signature: async function claimPaidPull(payId: string, username: string): Promise<Claimed | null>
nodes.body_text: async function claimPaidPull(payId: string, username: string): Promise<Claimed | null> { const rec = await kv.get<PayRecord>(payKey(payId)); if (!rec || rec.username !== username.toLowerCase()) return null; if ((await kv.del(payKey(payId))) !== 1) return null; // someone else claimed it first await kv.decr(pendKey(rec.username)).catch(() => {}); return { payId, username: rec.username, amount: rec.amount, stream: rec.stream }; }

nodes.name: PullDetails
nodes.body_text: interface PullDetails { cardName: string; variant: string; stars: number; packName: string; cardNumber: number; serial?: number | null }

nodes.name: chargePaidPull
nodes.signature: async function chargePaidPull(s: MixItUpSettings, c: Claimed, d: PullDetails, doFetch?: Fetch): Promise<{ applied: boolean; error?: string }>
nodes.body_text: async function chargePaidPull(s: MixItUpSettings, c: Claimed, d: PullDetails, doFetch?: Fetch): Promise<{ applied: boolean; error?: string }> { if (await inSandbox()) return { applied: true }; const message = renderMessage(s.message, { username: c.username, amount: c.amount, currency: s.currency, cardName: d.cardName, variant: d.variant, stars: d.stars, packName: d.packName, cardNumber: d.cardNumber, serial: d.serial ?? '' }); const r = await callMixItUp(deductUrl(s), { action: 'deduct', secret: s.secret, username: c.username, amount: c.amount, currency: s.currency, message, pullId: c.payId }, doFetch); const applied = replyApplied(r.status, r.body); await logMixItUp({ username: c.username, what: 'deduct', ok: applied, detail: applied ? `${c.amount} ${s.currency}` : r.error ?? `HTTP ${r.status}, not applied` }); return applied ? { applied } : { applied, error: r.error ?? `HTTP ${r.status}` }; }

nodes.name: releasePaidPull
nodes.body_text: async function releasePaidPull(payId: string): Promise<void> { const rec = await kv.get<PayRecord>(payKey(payId)).catch(() => null); if (!rec || (await kv.del(payKey(payId))) !== 1) return; await kv.decr(pendKey(rec.username)).catch(() => {}); await releaseCount({ payId, username: rec.username, amount: rec.amount, stream: rec.stream }); }

nodes.name: releaseCount
nodes.body_text: async function releaseCount(c: Claimed): Promise<void> { await kv.decr(cntKey(c.stream, c.username)).catch(() => {}); }

nodes.name: revokePrint
nodes.signature: async function revokePrint(collectionName: string, username: string, entry: number, copyId: string | null): Promise<number[] | null>
nodes.body_text: async function revokePrint(collectionName: string, username: string, entry: number, copyId: string | null): Promise<number[] | null> { const user = username.toLowerCase(); const out = await withCollectionLock(collectionName, async () => { const data = await getCollection(collectionName); const owned = data[user] ?? []; const copy = copyId ? await getCopy(collectionName, copyId) : null; if (copy && (copy.owner !== user || isEscrow(copy.owner))) return null; const i = owned.lastIndexOf(copy ? entryOf(copy) : entry); if (i < 0) return null; data[user] = [...owned.slice(0, i), ...owned.slice(i + 1)]; if (data[user].length === 0) delete data[user]; await saveCollection(collectionName, data, copy ? { retire: { owner: user, ids: [copy.id], who: user, note: 'payment failed' } } : undefined); return data[user] ?? []; }); return out; }

nodes.name: noticeRevoked
nodes.signature: async function noticeRevoked(username: string, cardName: string, why: string): Promise<void>
nodes.body_text: async function noticeRevoked(username: string, cardName: string, why: string): Promise<void> { await logMixItUp({ username, what: 'revoked', ok: false, detail: `${cardName}: ${why}` }); await notifySystem({ title: 'A paid pull was revoked', text: `${username}'s ${cardName} was taken back because Mix It Up did not confirm the payment (${why}).`, tone: 'bad' }); }

nodes.name: notice-list-core.ts
nodes.body_text: import type { Notice } from './trade-notice-core'; // The /notifications page's grouping and filtering (client-safe, pure). export const NOTICE_FILTERS: { id: NoticeFilter; label: string }[] = [ { id: 'all', label: 'All' }, { id: 'unread', label: 'Unread' }, { id: 'offers', label: 'Offers' }, { id: 'results', label: 'Results' }, { id: 'alerts', label: 'Alerts' }, { id: 'admin', label: 'Admin' }, ]; /** "Today", "Yesterday" or a date, in the viewer's own time zone. */ /** Newest first, split into consecutive groups with the same day label. */ /** The time of day in the viewer's time zone (call only after the page has mounted, so server and browser output cannot differ). */

nodes.name: NoticeFilter
nodes.body_text: type NoticeFilter = 'all' | 'unread' | 'offers' | 'results' | 'alerts' | 'admin';

nodes.name: matchesFilter
nodes.signature: function matchesFilter(n: Notice, filter: NoticeFilter, seen: number): boolean
nodes.body_text: function matchesFilter(n: Notice, filter: NoticeFilter, seen: number): boolean { switch (filter) { case 'unread': return n.at > seen; case 'offers': return n.kind === 'offer' || n.kind === 'countered'; case 'results': return n.kind === 'accepted' || n.kind === 'declined' || n.kind === 'cancelled' || n.kind === 'expired'; case 'alerts': return n.kind === 'watch'; case 'admin': return n.kind === 'admin' || n.kind === 'feedback'; default: return true; } }

nodes.name: dayLabel
nodes.signature: function dayLabel(at: number, now = Date.now()): string
nodes.body_text: function dayLabel(at: number, now = Date.now()): string { const day = (t: number) => { const d = new Date(t); return new Date(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth(), d.getDate()).getTime(); }; const diff = Math.round((day(now) - day(at)) / 86_400_000); if (diff <= 0) return 'Today'; if (diff === 1) return 'Yesterday'; return new Date(at).toLocaleDateString(undefined, { weekday: 'long', day: 'numeric', month: 'long' }); }

Client-safe; the view feeds it the // UNSAVED weights from the workspace, so what is simulated is what a save would store. import type { Variant } from './types'; import { VARIANTS } from './variants'; export const TIER_DEFAULTS: Record<number, number> = { 5: 2, 4: 8, 3: 20, 2: 30, 1: 40 }; /** Every weight scaled so they add up to 100 (unchanged when the total is 0). */ /** Each rarity gets its target share of all pulls, split equally among its cards. `targets` is stars -> wanted share (any scale). */ /** Cumulative draw: returns a function that picks an index by weight (-1 when nothing can be drawn). */ /** Draws `runs` packs (one card and, with upgrades on, one variant roll each) and how many packs it takes to see every card once. */

nodes.body_text: type VariantWeights = Record<Variant, number>;

nodes.name: r4
nodes.body_text: r4 = (n: number) => Math.round(n * 10_000) / 10_000

nodes.name: normalizeWeights
nodes.body_text: function normalizeWeights(cards: OddsCard[]): Record<string, number> { const total = cards.reduce((s, c) => s + (c.probability > 0 ? c.probability : 0), 0); return Object.fromEntries(cards.map(c => [c.id, total > 0 ? r4((Math.max(0, c.probability) / total) * 100) : c.probability])); }

nodes.name: balanceByRarity
nodes.signature: function balanceByRarity(cards: OddsCard[], targets: Record<number, number>): Record<string, number>
nodes.body_text: function balanceByRarity(cards: OddsCard[], targets: Record<number, number>): Record<string, number> { const count = new Map<number, number>(); for (const c of cards) count.set(c.stars, (count.get(c.stars) ?? 0) + 1); const want = (s: number) => Math.max(0, Number(targets[s]) || 0); const sum = [...count.keys()].reduce((t, s) => t + want(s), 0) || 1; return Object.fromEntries(cards.map(c => [c.id, r4(((want(c.stars) / sum) * 100) / (count.get(c.stars) ?? 1))])); }

nodes.body_text: want = (s: number) => Math.max(0, Number(targets[s]) || 0)

nodes.name: makePicker
nodes.signature: function makePicker(weights: number[], random: () => number = Math.random): () => number
nodes.body_text: function makePicker(weights: number[], random: () => number = Math.random): () => number { const cum: number[] = []; let t = 0; for (const w of weights) { t += Math.max(0, w); cum.push(t); } return () => { if (t <= 0) return -1; const r = random() * t; let lo = 0, hi = cum.length - 1; while (lo < hi) { const mid = (lo + hi) >> 1; if (cum[mid] > r) hi = mid; else lo = mid + 1; } return lo; }; }

nodes.name: SimResult

nodes.name: simulate
nodes.signature: function simulate(cards: OddsCard[], variantWeights: (id: string) => VariantWeights | undefined, upgrades: boolean, runs: number, random: () => number = Math.random): SimResult | null
nodes.body_text: function simulate(cards: OddsCard[], variantWeights: (id: string) => VariantWeights | undefined, upgrades: boolean, runs: number, random: () => number = Math.random): SimResult | null { const pick = makePicker(cards.map(c => c.probability), random); if (pick() < 0) return null; const perCard: Record<string, number> = {}; const perStars: Record<number, number> = {}; const perVariant = Object.fromEntries(VARIANTS.map(v => [v, 0])) as Record<Variant, number>; const variantPickers = new Map<string, () => number>(); const pickVariant = (c: OddsCard): Variant => { if (!upgrades) return 'regular'; let p = variantPickers.get(c.id); if (!p) { const w = variantWeights(c.id); p = makePicker(VARIANTS.map(v => w?.[v] ?? 0), random); variantPickers.set(c.id, p); } const i = p(); return VARIANTS[i < 0 ? 0 : i]; }; for (let i = 0; i < runs; i++) { const c = cards[pick()]; perCard[c.id] = (perCard[c.id] ?? 0) + 1; perStars[c.stars] = (perStars[c.stars] ?? 0) + 1; perVariant[pickVariant(c)]++; } const reachable = cards.filter(c => c.probability > 0).length; const trials: number[] = []; for (let t = 0; t < 300; t++) { const seen = new Set<number>(); let n = 0; while (seen.size < reachable && n < 20_000) { seen.add(pick()); n++; } trials.push(n); } trials.sort((a, b) => a - b); return { draws: runs, perCard, perStars, perVariant, found: Object.keys(perCard).length, fullSet: reachable > 0 ? { median: trials[Math.floor(trials.length / 2)], p90: trials[Math.floor(trials.length * 0.9)] } : null }; }

nodes.name: pickVariant
nodes.body_text: pickVariant = (c: OddsCard): Variant => { if (!upgrades) return 'regular'; let p = variantPickers.get(c.id); if (!p) { const w = variantWeights(c.id); p = makePicker(VARIANTS.map(v => w?.[v] ?? 0), random); variantPickers.set(c.id, p); } const i = p(); return VARIANTS[i < 0 ? 0 : i]; }

nodes.body_text: // The overlay key (ROADMAP 13.2). The OBS overlay is a browser source with no login, so the endpoints it uses to take queued pulls, // report "collection shown" and check in need something that is not public. The OBS URL carries `?key=<key>`; widget.js sends it as // the `x-overlay-key` header on every request. A signed-in staff browser (the editor preview, a test tab) needs no key, and a // sandbox only ever touches its own fake data. import { timingSafeEqual, randomBytes } from 'node:crypto'; import { kv, inSandbox } from './db'; import { isAuthenticated } from './auth'; const KEY = 'overlay:key'; export const OVERLAY_KEY_HEADER = 'x-overlay-key'; /** The key, made on first use. */ /** Replaces the key; every OBS source needs the new URL after this. */ /** Pure part: does the header value match the key? */ /** May this request act as the overlay? Right key, a staff session, or a sandbox. Never throws: any doubt is a no. */ /** The OBS browser-source address, with the key. `params` are extra query parameters (preset, dev ...). */

nodes.name: getOverlayKey
nodes.body_text: async function getOverlayKey(): Promise<string> { const have = await kv.get<string>(KEY); if (typeof have === 'string' && have.length >= 16) return have; const fresh = randomBytes(18).toString('hex'); await kv.set(KEY, fresh, { nx: true }); return (await kv.get<string>(KEY)) ?? fresh; // a parallel request may have won the race: use its key }

nodes.name: regenerateOverlayKey
nodes.body_text: async function regenerateOverlayKey(): Promise<string> { const fresh = randomBytes(18).toString('hex'); await kv.set(KEY, fresh); return fresh; }

nodes.body_text: function same(a: string, b: string): boolean { const x = Buffer.from(a), y = Buffer.from(b); return x.length === y.length && timingSafeEqual(x, y); }

nodes.body_text: // How the OBS overlay is laid out. Browser-safe (no KV) so the settings editor can import it. // // The overlay is drawn on a fixed "design stage" of width × height and then scaled to fit whatever // size the OBS browser source really is, so nothing is cut off even if the source is a different size. // That size is shared (it is one browser source). Where things sit on the stage is set separately for the // pack opening and for the collection view, because they are different shapes: each has its own `scale` // and offsets, in design-stage pixels, applied on top of that fit. export const DEFAULT_PLACEMENT: Placement = { scale: 1, offsetX: 0, offsetY: 0 }; export const DEFAULT_LAYOUT: OverlayLayout = { width: 1280, height: 720, pack: { ...DEFAULT_PLACEMENT }, collection: { ...DEFAULT_PLACEMENT }, }; export const LAYOUT_PRESETS: { label: string; width: number; height: number }[] = [ { label: '1280 × 720', width: 1280, height: 720 }, { label: '1920 × 1080', width: 1920, height: 1080 }, { label: '1024 × 768', width: 1024, height: 768 }, { label: '1600 × 900', width: 1600, height: 900 }, ]; /** Portrait stages for vertical scenes (a phone-shaped OBS canvas, Shorts / TikTok style). */ export const VERTICAL_LAYOUT_PRESETS: { label: string; width: number; height: number }[] = [ { label: '1080 × 1920', width: 1080, height: 1920 }, { label: '720 × 1280', width: 720, height: 1280 }, { label: '1080 × 1350', width: 1080, height: 1350 }, ]; /** Taller than wide. */ /** * A starting layout for a new scene. A vertical stage gets the cards shown a little smaller than the landscape default and * centred in the taller frame (the admin fine-tunes with the Layout tools); landscape copies the layout it is based on. */ /** * Coerces anything (stored JSON, form data, a postMessage) into a valid layout. Also upgrades the original * single-placement shape ({ width, height, scale, offsetX, offsetY }): both views start from that old placement, * so an existing setup looks exactly the same until the admin separates them. */

A whole configuration is a flat map of key -> value. // - Only values that DIFFER from the default are stored ("sparse"), so new properties and changed defaults flow through. // - The same flat map is used for the global settings, per-pack overrides, named presets and JSON export/import, and // the editor UI is generated from this registry, so adding a property is one entry here plus using it in widget.js. // - The defaults reproduce the overlay's original look exactly, so an untouched install is unchanged. // ── Reveal animation styles ─────────────────────────────── export const REVEAL_STYLES: { value: string; label: string; experimental?: boolean; description: string }[] = [ { value: 'classic', label: 'Classic, pack tears, card rises', description: 'The original: the pack tilts in, the tear strip flies off and the card rises.' }, { value: 'simple', label: 'Simple, card zooms in', description: 'No pack. The card just zooms in. Quick, good for busy streams.' }, { value: 'slide', label: 'Slide up', description: 'The card slides up from below with its info following.' }, { value: 'flip', label: 'Flip reveal', description: 'A card back flips over to reveal the art.' }, { value: 'rip-shake', label: 'Rip, shake & burst', experimental: true, description: 'The pack shakes harder and harder, the tear strip flies off and the card bursts out.' }, { value: 'rip-peel', label: 'Rip, peel open', experimental: true, description: 'The tear strip peels back from one side like a wrapper, then the card rises.' }, { value: 'rip-slice', label: 'Rip, slice off', experimental: true, description: 'The tear strip slides straight off to the side like a clean cut, the pack drops away and the card rises.' }, { value: 'rip-explode', label: 'Rip, explode', experimental: true, description: 'The pack swells and flashes white, then bursts apart as the card slams out.' }, { value: 'drop', label: 'Drop in', description: 'No pack. nodes.body_text: interface PropDef { key: string; group: string; label: string; /** Sub-heading the property is listed under inside its group (set automatically by `sectionFor`). */ section?: string; /** Card versions: which version this property belongs to. */ variant?: VariantId; help?: string; type: PropType; default: PropValue; // number min?: number; max?: number; step?: number; unit?: string; // select options?: { value: string; label: string }[]; // colors: how many entries are allowed minItems?: number; maxItems?: number; // text maxLength?: number; /** Shown with an "experimental" badge: works, but is new or unusual and may change. */ experimental?: boolean; }

nodes.name: VariantId
nodes.body_text: type VariantId = (typeof VARIANT_IDS)[number];

nodes.name: variantProps
nodes.body_text: function variantProps(v: VariantId): PropDef[] { return variantPropsRaw(v).map(p => ({ ...p, group: 'variants', variant: v })); }

nodes.body_text: import { kv } from './db'; import { queueLength } from './webhooks'; // Which OBS overlays (overlay.html browser sources) are currently open, and. When OBS lets the // page read it, whether OBS is streaming/recording. Each overlay instance sends a heartbeat every // ~10s with a random id; we keep them in one KV hash and treat a client as connected while its // last heartbeat is recent. const KEY = 'overlay:clients'; export const HEARTBEAT_MS = 10_000; const CONNECTED_MS = 25_000; // tolerates one missed heartbeat const PRUNE_AFTER_MS = 10 * 60_000; // forget clients that vanished long ago const ID_RE = /^[A-Za-z0-9-]{8,64}$/;

nodes.name: OverlayClient
nodes.body_text: interface OverlayClient { id: string; at: number; // last heartbeat (ms) streaming: boolean | null; // null = OBS didn't tell us (no "read status" permission, or not OBS) recording: boolean | null; obs: boolean; // looks like an OBS browser source (vs. a normal browser tab) dev: boolean; // opened with ?dev }

nodes.body_text: interface OverlayStatus { connected: number; clients: OverlayClient[]; // connected only streaming: boolean | null; // any connected overlay reports streaming; null if none can tell recording: boolean | null; lastSeen: number | null; // most recent heartbeat from anyone, even if disconnected now queued: number; // events waiting for an overlay to pick up }

nodes.body_text: function isValidClientId(id: unknown): id is string { return typeof id === 'string' && ID_RE.test(id); }

nodes.name: recordHeartbeat
nodes.body_text: async function recordHeartbeat(c: Omit<OverlayClient, 'at'>): Promise<void> { await kv.hset(KEY, { [c.id]: { ...c, at: Date.now() } satisfies OverlayClient }); // Occasionally drop clients that stopped reporting (keeps the hash tiny without an extra read every time). if (Math.random() < 0.1) { const all = (await kv.hgetall<Record<string, OverlayClient>>(KEY)) ?? {}; const stale = Object.entries(all).filter(([, v]) => Date.now() - v.at > PRUNE_AFTER_MS).map(([k]) => k); if (stale.length) await kv.hdel(KEY, ...stale); } }

nodes.name: getOverlayStatus
nodes.body_text: async function getOverlayStatus(): Promise<OverlayStatus> { const [all, queued] = await Promise.all([ kv.hgetall<Record<string, OverlayClient>>(KEY), queueLength().catch(() => 0), ]); const clients = Object.values(all ?? {}); const now = Date.now(); const connected = clients.filter(c => now - c.at <= CONNECTED_MS).sort((a, b) => b.at - a.at); // A flag is true if any connected overlay says so, false if some say false, null if nobody can tell. const combine = (pick: (c: OverlayClient) => boolean | null): boolean | null => { const known = connected.map(pick).filter((v): v is boolean => v !== null); if (known.length === 0) return null; return known.some(Boolean); }; return { connected: connected.length, clients: connected, streaming: combine(c => c.streaming), recording: combine(c => c.recording), lastSeen: clients.length ? Math.max(...clients.map(c => c.at)) : null, queued, }; }

nodes.body_text: combine = (pick: (c: OverlayClient) => boolean | null): boolean | null => { const known = connected.map(pick).filter((v): v is boolean => v !== null); if (known.length === 0) return null; return known.some(Boolean); }

nodes.name: cardProblems
nodes.signature: function cardProblems(c: CardFields, otherNumbers: number[]): string[]
nodes.body_text: function cardProblems(c: CardFields, otherNumbers: number[]): string[] { const out: string[] = []; if (!str(c.name, 200).trim()) out.push('Give the card a name.'); if (!Number.isInteger(c.stars) || c.stars < 1 || c.stars > 5) out.push('Stars must be a whole number from 1 to 5.'); if (!Number.isFinite(c.probability) || c.probability < 0) out.push('Odds must be a number, 0 or more.'); if (!Number.isInteger(c.number) || c.number < 1 || c.number > MAX_CARD_NUMBER) out.push(`The card number must be a whole number from 1 to ${MAX_CARD_NUMBER.toLocaleString('en-GB')}.`); else if (otherNumbers.includes(c.number)) out.push(`Another card in this pack is already #${c.number}, and viewers' prints would be shared between the two.`); return out; }

nodes.name: pack-editor-core.ts
nodes.body_text: // The pack workspace's pure core (ROADMAP 20.2): the working state of a pack and its cards, the change set between two states, how the // server applies it, the "old -> new" lines of Review, and how a change set is re-applied on top of someone else's save. Client-safe (no // database): the workspace shows the result of `applyChanges` and the server saves the result of the SAME function, so they can't differ. import type { Card, OptionalVariant, Pack } from './types'; import { cardProblems, cleanPackInput, int, num, str, type PackInput } from './pack-clean'; import { cleanDisabled } from './variants'; /** A card as the workspace edits it: empty strings for "none" so inputs stay controlled. `number` is 0 for a card not saved yet. */ /** What changed against the saved state: the pack's changed fields, new cards, changed fields of existing cards, removed card ids. */ const CARD_KEYS: (keyof CardFields)[] = ['number', 'name', 'imageUrl', 'fullArtImageUrl', 'stillUrl', 'fullArtStillUrl', 'soundUrl', 'stars', 'probability', 'upgradesEnabled', 'disabledVariants']; /** The card the server stores for a working card (the same limits `saveCards` has always applied). */ /** The saved pack and cards after `changes`. Existing cards keep their numbers (unless the change renumbers one); new cards get the next free number above everything that ever existed here. */ /** The working state a saved result corresponds to. */ // ── Review ("old -> new" per field) ────────────────────── const FIELD_LABELS: Record<string, string> = { name: 'Name', coverImageUrl: 'Cover', active: 'In draws', weight: 'Draw weight', accentColor: 'Accent colour', tearBorderColor: 'Tear colour', holoMinStars: 'Holo from stars', cardTime: 'Card time', cooldownTime: 'Cooldown', soundVolume: 'Volume', upgradesEnabled: 'Variants and upgrades', variantWeights: 'Version weights', upgradeCosts: 'Upgrade costs', disabledVariants: 'Versions off', number: 'Number', imageUrl: 'Art', fullArtImageUrl: 'Full art', stillUrl: 'Still frame', fullArtStillUrl: 'Full art still', soundUrl: 'Sound', stars: 'Stars', probability: 'Odds', }; // ── Someone else saved first ───────────────────────────── /** * Re-applies `mine` (your unsaved changes, made against `oldBase`) on top of `newBase` (what is saved now). A field you changed that someone * else also changed to something different keeps THEIR value and is listed as a clash; everything else of yours is kept. */ // ── Bulk edits (20.2c) ─────────────────────────────────── /** The bundled sound of the first 25 cards, or '' when a card has none. */ /** `op` applied to the cards in `ids` (the others, and the order, are untouched). A card the op cannot change is returned as it was. */ /** Lines pasted from a spreadsheet column (one value per line; a trailing empty line is dropped). */

nodes.name: WorkCard
nodes.body_text: interface WorkCard { id: string; number: number; name: string; imageUrl: string; fullArtImageUrl: string; stillUrl: string; fullArtStillUrl: string; soundUrl: string; stars: number; probability: number; upgradesEnabled: boolean; disabledVariants: OptionalVariant[]; }

nodes.name: CardFields
nodes.body_text: type CardFields = Omit<WorkCard, 'id'>;

nodes.name: Work
nodes.body_text: interface Work { pack: PackInput; cards: WorkCard[] }

nodes.name: ChangeSet
nodes.body_text: interface ChangeSet { pack: Partial<PackInput>; add: WorkCard[]; update: Record<string, Partial<CardFields>>; remove: string[]; }

nodes.name: packToInput
nodes.body_text: packToInput = (p: Pack): PackInput => ({ name: p.name, coverImageUrl: p.coverImageUrl, active: p.active, weight: p.weight, accentColor: p.accentColor, tearBorderColor: p.tearBorderColor, holoMinStars: p.holoMinStars, cardTime: p.cardTime, cooldownTime: p.cooldownTime, soundVolume: p.soundVolume, upgradesEnabled: p.upgradesEnabled, variantWeights: { ...p.variantWeights }, upgradeCosts: { ...p.upgradeCosts }, disabledVariants: [...(p.disabledVariants ?? [])], })

nodes.name: cardToWork
nodes.body_text: cardToWork = (c: Card): WorkCard => ({ id: c.id, number: c.number, name: c.name, imageUrl: c.imageUrl, fullArtImageUrl: c.fullArtImageUrl ?? '', stillUrl: c.stillUrl ?? '', fullArtStillUrl: c.fullArtStillUrl ?? '', soundUrl: c.soundUrl ?? '', stars: c.stars, probability: c.probability, upgradesEnabled: c.upgradesEnabled !== false, disabledVariants: [...(c.disabledVariants ?? [])], })

nodes.name: newWorkCard
nodes.signature: function newWorkCard(id: string, over: Partial<CardFields> = {}): WorkCard
nodes.body_text: function newWorkCard(id: string, over: Partial<CardFields> = {}): WorkCard { return { id, number: 0, name: '', imageUrl: '', fullArtImageUrl: '', stillUrl: '', fullArtStillUrl: '', soundUrl: '', stars: 1, probability: 10, upgradesEnabled: true, disabledVariants: [], ...over }; }

nodes.name: same
nodes.body_text: same = (a: unknown, b: unknown) => JSON.stringify(a) === JSON.stringify(b)

nodes.name: diffChanges
nodes.signature: function diffChanges(base: Work, work: Work): ChangeSet
nodes.body_text: function diffChanges(base: Work, work: Work): ChangeSet { const pack: Partial<PackInput> = {}; for (const k of Object.keys(work.pack) as (keyof PackInput)[]) if (!same(base.pack[k], work.pack[k])) (pack as Record<string, unknown>)[k] = work.pack[k]; const baseById = new Map(base.cards.map(c => [c.id, c])); const workIds = new Set(work.cards.map(c => c.id)); const add: WorkCard[] = []; const update: Record<string, Partial<CardFields>> = {}; for (const c of work.cards) { const b = baseById.get(c.id); if (!b) { add.push(c); continue; } const d: Record<string, unknown> = {}; for (const k of CARD_KEYS) if (!same(b[k], c[k])) d[k] = c[k]; if (Object.keys(d).length > 0) update[c.id] = d as Partial<CardFields>; } return { pack, add, update, remove: base.cards.filter(c => !workIds.has(c.id)).map(c => c.id) }; }

nodes.name: isEmptyChange
nodes.body_text: isEmptyChange = (c: ChangeSet) => Object.keys(c.pack).length === 0 && c.add.length === 0 && Object.keys(c.update).length === 0 && c.remove.length === 0

nodes.name: cleanCard
nodes.signature: function cleanCard(w: WorkCard, number: number): Card
nodes.body_text: function cleanCard(w: WorkCard, number: number): Card { const full = str(w.fullArtImageUrl) || undefined; const still = str(w.stillUrl) || undefined; const fullStill = full ? str(w.fullArtStillUrl) || undefined : undefined; const sound = str(w.soundUrl) || undefined; const off = cleanDisabled(w.disabledVariants); return { id: w.id, number, name: str(w.name, 80).trim(), imageUrl: str(w.imageUrl), ...(sound && { soundUrl: sound }), ...(full && { fullArtImageUrl: full }), ...(still && { stillUrl: still }), ...(fullStill && { fullArtStillUrl: fullStill }), ...(off.length > 0 && { disabledVariants: off }), upgradesEnabled: w.upgradesEnabled !== false, probability: num(w.probability, 1, 0), stars: int(w.stars, 1), }; }

nodes.name: Applied
nodes.body_text: interface Applied { pack: Pack; cards: Card[]; /** The number the server gave each new card, by its id. */ assigned: Record<string, number>; /** Cards (and the pack) whose fields would not pass `cardProblems`. */ problems: { id: string; name: string; messages: string[] }[]; }

nodes.name: applyChanges
nodes.signature: function applyChanges(pack: Pack, cards: Card[], changes: ChangeSet): Applied
nodes.body_text: function applyChanges(pack: Pack, cards: Card[], changes: ChangeSet): Applied { const nextPack: Pack = Object.keys(changes.pack).length > 0 ? { ...pack, ...cleanPackInput({ ...packToInput(pack), ...changes.pack }) } : pack; const removed = new Set(changes.remove); let next = cards.reduce((m, c) => Math.max(m, c.number), 0); const out: Card[] = []; for (const c of cards) { if (removed.has(c.id)) continue; const u = changes.update[c.id]; out.push(u ? cleanCard({ ...cardToWork(c), ...u } as WorkCard, typeof u.number === 'number' ? u.number : c.number) : c); } const assigned: Record<string, number> = {}; const seen = new Set(out.map(c => c.id)); for (const a of changes.add) { if (typeof a.id !== 'string' || !a.id || seen.has(a.id)) continue; seen.add(a.id); assigned[a.id] = ++next; out.push(cleanCard(a, next)); } out.sort((a, b) => a.number - b.number); const problems: Applied['problems'] = []; const touched = new Set([...Object.keys(changes.update), ...changes.add.map(a => a.id)]); for (const c of out) { if (!touched.has(c.id)) continue; // an old card nobody edited does not block saving something else const messages = cardProblems({ name: c.name, stars: c.stars, probability: c.probability, number: c.number }, out.filter(o => o !== c).map(o => o.number)); if (messages.length > 0) problems.push({ id: c.id, name: c.name, messages }); } if (!nextPack.name.trim()) problems.unshift({ id: 'pack', name: 'Pack', messages: ['Give the pack a name.'] }); return { pack: nextPack, cards: out, assigned, problems }; }

nodes.name: workOf
nodes.body_text: workOf = (pack: Pack, cards: Card[]): Work => ({ pack: packToInput(pack), cards: cards.map(cardToWork) })

nodes.name: ReviewLine
nodes.body_text: interface ReviewLine { scope: string; field: string; from: string; to: string }

nodes.name: fieldLabel
nodes.body_text: fieldLabel = (k: string) => FIELD_LABELS[k] ?? k

nodes.name: show
nodes.signature: function show(k: string, v: unknown): string
nodes.body_text: function show(k: string, v: unknown): string { if (typeof v === 'boolean') return v ? 'on' : 'off'; if (v === '' || v === undefined || v === null) return 'none'; if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.length ? v.join(', ') : 'none'; if (typeof v === 'object') return Object.entries(v as Record<string, unknown>).map(([a, b]) => `${a} ${b}`).join(', '); if (typeof v === 'string' && /^https?:\/\/|^\//.test(v)) return v.split('/').pop()?.slice(0, 40) || 'set'; return String(v); }

nodes.name: reviewLines
nodes.signature: function reviewLines(base: Work, work: Work): ReviewLine[]
nodes.body_text: function reviewLines(base: Work, work: Work): ReviewLine[] { const cs = diffChanges(base, work); const out: ReviewLine[] = []; for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(cs.pack)) out.push({ scope: 'Pack', field: fieldLabel(k), from: show(k, (base.pack as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)[k]), to: show(k, v) }); const baseById = new Map(base.cards.map(c => [c.id, c])); for (const [id, d] of Object.entries(cs.update)) { const b = baseById.get(id)!; const label = `#${b.number} ${b.name || 'Untitled'}`; for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(d)) out.push({ scope: label, field: fieldLabel(k), from: show(k, (b as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)[k]), to: show(k, v) }); } for (const a of cs.add) out.push({ scope: a.name || 'New card', field: 'Card', from: 'none', to: 'added' }); for (const id of cs.remove) { const b = baseById.get(id)!; out.push({ scope: `#${b.number} ${b.name || 'Untitled'}`, field: 'Card', from: 'there', to: 'removed' }); } return out; }

nodes.name: rebase
nodes.signature: function rebase(oldBase: Work, newBase: Work, mine: ChangeSet): { work: Work; clashes: string[] }
nodes.body_text: function rebase(oldBase: Work, newBase: Work, mine: ChangeSet): { work: Work; clashes: string[] } { const clashes: string[] = []; const pack: PackInput = { ...newBase.pack }; for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(mine.pack)) { const key = k as keyof PackInput; if (!same(newBase.pack[key], oldBase.pack[key]) && !same(newBase.pack[key], v)) clashes.push(`Pack: ${fieldLabel(k)}`); else (pack as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)[k] = v; } const cards = newBase.cards.map(c => ({ ...c })); const byId = new Map(cards.map(c => [c.id, c])); const oldById = new Map(oldBase.cards.map(c => [c.id, c])); for (const [id, d] of Object.entries(mine.update)) { const cur = byId.get(id); const was = oldById.get(id); if (!cur || !was) { clashes.push(`${was ? `#${was.number} ${was.name}` : 'A card'}: removed by someone else`); continue; } for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(d)) { const key = k as keyof CardFields; if (!same(cur[key], was[key]) && !same(cur[key], v)) clashes.push(`#${cur.number} ${cur.name || 'Untitled'}: ${fieldLabel(k)}`); else (cur as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)[k] = v; } } for (const a of mine.add) if (!byId.has(a.id)) cards.push(a); const gone = new Set(mine.remove); return { work: { pack, cards: cards.filter(c => !gone.has(c.id)) }, clashes }; }

nodes.name: BulkOp
nodes.signature: type BulkOp = | { kind: 'stars'; value: number } | { kind: 'weight'; value: number } | { kind: 'multiply'; factor: number } | { kind: 'version'; variant: OptionalVariant; on: boolean } | { kind: 'sound'; mode: 'default' | 'clear' } | { kind: 'upgrades'; on: boolean };
nodes.body_text: type BulkOp = | { kind: 'stars'; value: number } | { kind: 'weight'; value: number } | { kind: 'multiply'; factor: number } | { kind: 'version'; variant: OptionalVariant; on: boolean } | { kind: 'sound'; mode: 'default' | 'clear' } | { kind: 'upgrades'; on: boolean };

nodes.name: defaultSoundFor
nodes.body_text: defaultSoundFor = (number: number) => (number >= 1 && number <= 25 ? `/assets/sounds/${number}.mp3` : '')

nodes.name: bulkApply
nodes.signature: function bulkApply(cards: WorkCard[], ids: Set<string>, op: BulkOp): WorkCard[]
nodes.body_text: function bulkApply(cards: WorkCard[], ids: Set<string>, op: BulkOp): WorkCard[] { return cards.map(c => { if (!ids.has(c.id)) return c; switch (op.kind) { case 'stars': return { ...c, stars: Math.min(5, Math.max(1, Math.round(op.value) || 1)) }; case 'weight': return Number.isFinite(op.value) && op.value >= 0 ? { ...c, probability: op.value } : c; case 'multiply': return Number.isFinite(op.factor) && op.factor >= 0 ? { ...c, probability: Math.round(c.probability * op.factor * 10_000) / 10_000 } : c; case 'version': { const off = new Set(c.disabledVariants); if (op.on) off.delete(op.variant); else off.add(op.variant); return { ...c, disabledVariants: [...off] as OptionalVariant[] }; } case 'sound': { const s = op.mode === 'clear' ? '' : defaultSoundFor(c.number); return op.mode === 'default' && !s ? c : { ...c, soundUrl: s }; } case 'upgrades': return { ...c, upgradesEnabled: op.on }; } }); }
