nodes.name: pack-health.ts
nodes.body_text: import type { Card, Pack } from './types'; import { allowedVariants } from './variants'; // Client-safe checks that say what is wrong or incomplete about a pack, shown as a badge on every pack tile and as a list on the // pack page. Each issue names what to do and where (a link into the right editor).

nodes.name: HealthIssue
nodes.body_text: interface HealthIssue { id: string; level: 'warn' | 'info'; text: string; /** Where to fix it. */ href?: string; }

nodes.name: packHealth
nodes.signature: function packHealth(pack: Pack, cards: Card[], opts: { inSeason: boolean }): HealthIssue[]
nodes.body_text: function packHealth(pack: Pack, cards: Card[], opts: { inSeason: boolean }): HealthIssue[] { const issues: HealthIssue[] = []; const base = `/admin/packs/${pack.id}`; const plural = (n: number, one: string, many: string) => (n === 1 ? one : many); if (cards.length === 0) { issues.push({ id: 'no-cards', level: 'warn', text: 'No cards yet, so nothing can be drawn.', href: `${base}/cards` }); return issues; } const noOdds = cards.filter(c => !(c.probability > 0)); if (noOdds.length > 0) issues.push({ id: 'no-odds', level: 'warn', text: `${noOdds.length} ${plural(noOdds.length, 'card has', 'cards have')} 0 odds and can never be pulled.`, href: base }); const noImage = cards.filter(c => !c.imageUrl); if (noImage.length > 0) issues.push({ id: 'no-image', level: 'warn', text: `${noImage.length} ${plural(noImage.length, 'card has', 'cards have')} no image.`, href: `${base}/cards` }); const unnamed = cards.filter(c => !c.name.trim()); if (unnamed.length > 0) issues.push({ id: 'unnamed', level: 'warn', text: `${unnamed.length} ${plural(unnamed.length, 'card has', 'cards have')} no name.`, href: `${base}/cards` }); const numbers = new Map<number, number>(); for (const c of cards) numbers.set(c.number, (numbers.get(c.number) ?? 0) + 1); const dupNumbers = [...numbers.entries()].filter(([, n]) => n > 1); if (dupNumbers.length > 0) issues.push({ id: 'dup-numbers', level: 'warn', text: `Card number${dupNumbers.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} used twice: ${dupNumbers.map(([n]) => `#${n}`).join(', ')}. Viewer collections point at numbers, so they must be unique.`, href: base }); if (pack.upgradesEnabled) { const noFullArt = cards.filter(c => !c.fullArtImageUrl && allowedVariants(pack, c).includes('full')); if (noFullArt.length > 0) issues.push({ id: 'no-full-art', level: 'warn', text: `${noFullArt.length} ${plural(noFullArt.length, 'card can', 'cards can')} be pulled as Full Art / Shiny but ${plural(noFullArt.length, 'has', 'have')} no full-art image.`, href: base }); if (!(pack.variantWeights.regular > 0)) issues.push({ id: 'regular-weight', level: 'warn', text: 'The Regular weight is 0, so every pull would be a rare variant.', href: base }); } const names = new Map<string, number>(); for (const c of cards) { const k = c.name.trim().toLowerCase(); if (k) names.set(k, (names.get(k) ?? 0) + 1); } const dupNames = [...names.entries()].filter(([, n]) => n > 1); if (dupNames.length > 0) issues.push({ id: 'dup-names', level: 'info', text: `${dupNames.length} card ${plural(dupNames.length, 'name is', 'names are')} used more than once.`, href: base }); if (!pack.coverImageUrl) issues.push({ id: 'no-cover', level: 'info', text: 'No cover image.', href: `${base}?tab=settings` }); if (pack.status === 'published' && !opts.inSeason) issues.push({ id: 'no-season', level: 'warn', text: 'Not in any season, so it is never drawn.', href: '/admin/seasons' }); return issues; }

nodes.name: plural
nodes.signature: plural = (n: number, one: string, many: string)
nodes.body_text: plural = (n: number, one: string, many: string) => (n === 1 ? one : many)

nodes.name: pack-save.ts
nodes.body_text: // Saving a change set from the pack workspace (ROADMAP 20.2a). No authentication here: app/admin/workspace-actions.ts checks the caller // first. Split out so a script can test the revision check, the held-number rules and the audit entry against the mock KV. import { recordAudit } from './audit'; import { heldCardNumbers } from './card-held'; import { getPack, getPackCards, getPackRev, savePack, savePackCards } from './kv'; import { applyChanges, reviewLines, workOf, type ChangeSet, type Work } from './pack-editor-core'; import type { Pack } from './types'; /** * Saves a change set against revision `rev`. Refuses when someone saved since (`conflict`), when a card viewers hold would be renumbered, or * (published packs only) when a touched card fails its checks. Removing a card viewers hold needs `confirmHeld`. */

nodes.name: WorkspaceState
nodes.body_text: interface WorkspaceState { work: Work; rev: number; held: number[]; status: Pack['status']; archived: boolean }

nodes.name: SaveResult
nodes.signature: type SaveResult = | { ok: true; state: WorkspaceState; assigned: Record<string, number>; changed: number } | { ok: false; kind: 'conflict' | 'invalid' | 'held' | 'missing'; message: string; problems?: { id: string; name: string; messages: string[] }[] };
nodes.body_text: type SaveResult = | { ok: true; state: WorkspaceState; assigned: Record<string, number>; changed: number } | { ok: false; kind: 'conflict' | 'invalid' | 'held' | 'missing'; message: string; problems?: { id: string; name: string; messages: string[] }[] };

nodes.name: loadWorkspaceState
nodes.signature: async function loadWorkspaceState(packId: string): Promise<WorkspaceState | null>
nodes.body_text: async function loadWorkspaceState(packId: string): Promise<WorkspaceState | null> { const pack = await getPack(packId); if (!pack) return null; const [cards, rev, held] = await Promise.all([getPackCards(packId), getPackRev(packId), heldCardNumbers(packId).catch(() => new Set<number>())]); return { work: workOf(pack, cards), rev, held: [...held], status: pack.status, archived: !!pack.archived }; }

nodes.name: savePackChangesCore
nodes.signature: async function savePackChangesCore(packId: string, rev: number, changes: ChangeSet, opts: { confirmHeld?: boolean } = {}): Promise<SaveResult>
nodes.body_text: async function savePackChangesCore(packId: string, rev: number, changes: ChangeSet, opts: { confirmHeld?: boolean } = {}): Promise<SaveResult> { const pack = await getPack(packId); if (!pack) return { ok: false, kind: 'missing', message: 'This pack no longer exists.' }; if (rev !== (await getPackRev(packId))) return { ok: false, kind: 'conflict', message: 'Someone else saved this pack since you opened it.' }; const cards = await getPackCards(packId); const renumbered = Object.entries(changes.update).filter(([id, u]) => u.number !== undefined && u.number !== cards.find(c => c.id === id)?.number); const removing = cards.filter(c => changes.remove.includes(c.id)); if (renumbered.length > 0 || removing.length > 0) { const held = await heldCardNumbers(packId); const stuck = renumbered.map(([id]) => cards.find(c => c.id === id)).filter(c => c && held.has(c.number)); if (stuck.length > 0) return { ok: false, kind: 'held', message: `${stuck.map(c => `#${c!.number}`).join(', ')} ${stuck.length === 1 ? 'has' : 'have'} been pulled by viewers, so the number can't change.` }; const heldGone = removing.filter(c => held.has(c.number)); if (heldGone.length > 0 && !opts.confirmHeld) return { ok: false, kind: 'held', message: `${heldGone.map(c => `#${c.number} ${c.name}`).join(', ')} ${heldGone.length === 1 ? 'is' : 'are'} held by viewers. Confirm to delete anyway.` }; } const applied = applyChanges(pack, cards, changes); // A draft may be unfinished (autosave keeps whatever is there); a published pack is live, so a touched card must pass its checks. if (pack.status !== 'draft' && applied.problems.length > 0) return { ok: false, kind: 'invalid', message: 'Fix these before saving.', problems: applied.problems }; if (Object.keys(changes.pack).length > 0) await savePack(applied.pack); if (changes.add.length > 0 || Object.keys(changes.update).length > 0 || changes.remove.length > 0) await savePackCards(packId, applied.cards); const lines = reviewLines(workOf(pack, cards), workOf(applied.pack, applied.cards)); if (pack.status !== 'draft' && lines.length > 0) { await recordAudit(`pack:${packId}`, 'Pack edited', `${pack.name}: ${lines.slice(0, 6).map(l => `${l.scope} ${l.field}`).join('; ')}${lines.length > 6 ? ` and ${lines.length - 6} more` : ''}`); } return { ok: true, state: (await loadWorkspaceState(packId))!, assigned: applied.assigned, changed: lines.length }; }

nodes.name: palette.ts
nodes.body_text: import { NAV_ITEMS } from './admin-nav'; import type { IconName } from '@/app/components/Icon'; // The command palette's items and ranking (pure, client-safe). Pages and actions are static; packs, seasons and viewers are // fetched when the palette opens (GET /api/admin/palette). export const GROUP_ORDER: PaletteGroup[] = ['Pages', 'Actions', 'Packs', 'Seasons', 'Users']; export const STATIC_ITEMS: PaletteItem[] = [ ...NAV_ITEMS.map(i => ({ id: `page:${i.href}`, label: i.label, group: 'Pages' as const, icon: i.icon, href: i.href, keywords: i.keywords, keys: ['g', i.key] })), { id: 'act:new-pack', label: 'New pack', group: 'Actions', icon: 'cards', href: '/admin/packs/new', hint: 'Start the pack wizard', keywords: ['create', 'add'] }, { id: 'act:new-season', label: 'New season', group: 'Actions', icon: 'trophy', href: '/admin/seasons/new', hint: 'Start the season wizard', keywords: ['create', 'add'] }, { id: 'act:gift', label: 'Gift packs to a viewer', group: 'Actions', icon: 'gift', href: '/admin', hint: 'Dashboard quick actions', keywords: ['quick', 'send'] }, { id: 'act:scoring', label: 'Scoring settings', group: 'Actions', icon: 'trophy', href: '/admin/settings?tab=scoring', keywords: ['points', 'leaderboard', 'values'] }, { id: 'act:env', label: 'Environment health', group: 'Actions', icon: 'shield', href: '/admin/settings?tab=environment', keywords: ['secrets', 'keys', 'variables'] }, { id: 'act:twitch', label: 'Twitch extension setup', group: 'Actions', icon: 'tv', href: '/admin/settings?tab=viewers', keywords: ['panel', 'urls'] }, { id: 'act:copy-overlay', label: 'Copy the overlay URL', group: 'Actions', icon: 'copy', action: 'copy-overlay', keywords: ['obs', 'browser source'] }, { id: 'act:preview', label: 'Preview the overlay', group: 'Actions', icon: 'external', action: 'open-preview', keywords: ['obs'] }, { id: 'act:exit-sandbox', label: 'Exit the sandbox', group: 'Actions', icon: 'flask', action: 'exit-sandbox', keywords: ['production'] }, { id: 'act:logout', label: 'Log out', group: 'Actions', icon: 'logout', action: 'logout', keywords: ['sign out'] }, ]; /** Every character of `q` appears in `s` in order (a loose "fuzzy" match). */ /** Higher is better; 0 means no match. */ /** Items that match, best first (ties keep group order, then alphabetical). With no query: pages and actions in their natural order. */

nodes.name: PaletteGroup
nodes.body_text: type PaletteGroup = 'Pages' | 'Actions' | 'Packs' | 'Seasons' | 'Users';

nodes.name: PaletteAction
nodes.body_text: type PaletteAction = 'copy-overlay' | 'open-preview' | 'exit-sandbox' | 'logout';

nodes.name: PaletteItem
nodes.body_text: interface PaletteItem { id: string; label: string; group: PaletteGroup; icon: IconName; hint?: string; href?: string; action?: PaletteAction; keywords?: string[]; /** The "g x" shortcut, shown at the right. */ keys?: string[]; }

nodes.name: norm
nodes.body_text: norm = (s: string) => s.toLowerCase().normalize('NFKD').replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}\s_#-]/gu, '').trim()

nodes.name: subsequence
nodes.signature: function subsequence(q: string, s: string): boolean
nodes.body_text: function subsequence(q: string, s: string): boolean { let i = 0; for (const c of s) if (c === q[i] && ++i === q.length) return true; return q.length === 0; }

nodes.name: scoreItem
nodes.signature: function scoreItem(item: Pick<PaletteItem, 'label' | 'hint' | 'keywords'>, query: string): number
nodes.body_text: function scoreItem(item: Pick<PaletteItem, 'label' | 'hint' | 'keywords'>, query: string): number { const q = norm(query); if (!q) return 1; const label = norm(item.label); if (label === q) return 100; if (label.startsWith(q)) return 85; if (label.split(/[\s_-]+/).some(w => w.startsWith(q))) return 70; if (label.includes(q)) return 55; if ((item.keywords ?? []).some(k => norm(k).startsWith(q))) return 45; if ((item.keywords ?? []).some(k => norm(k).includes(q))) return 35; if (item.hint && norm(item.hint).includes(q)) return 25; if (q.length >= 2 && subsequence(q, label)) return 15; return 0; }

nodes.name: rankItems
nodes.signature: function rankItems(items: PaletteItem[], query: string, limit = 30): PaletteItem[]
nodes.body_text: function rankItems(items: PaletteItem[], query: string, limit = 30): PaletteItem[] { const q = norm(query); const scored = items.map((it, i) => ({ it, i, s: scoreItem(it, q) })).filter(x => x.s > 0); scored.sort((a, b) => b.s - a.s || GROUP_ORDER.indexOf(a.it.group) - GROUP_ORDER.indexOf(b.it.group) || (q ? a.it.label.localeCompare(b.it.label) : a.i - b.i)); // With no query, keep the list short: pages and actions only (entities appear once you type). const filtered = q ? scored : scored.filter(x => x.it.group === 'Pages' || x.it.group === 'Actions'); return filtered.slice(0, limit).map(x => x.it); }

nodes.name: print-of-week-store.ts
nodes.body_text: import { kv } from './db'; import { getActiveSeason, getCollection, getPackCards, getPacksForSeason, getSeason } from './kv'; import { getCopy, getOwnerCopies, isTracking } from './serials'; import type { Copy } from './serials-core'; import { isoWeekKey, pickPrintOfWeek, pushHistory, recentUids, scorePrint, type Candidate, type PotwHistoryEntry, type PotwPick } from './print-of-week'; import type { Card, Pack, Season } from './types'; // Print of the week, server side. KV: `potw:current` (the pick), `potw:history` (newest 20 {uid, at}), `potw:week:<yyyy-Www>` (the // once-a-week lock). Sandboxes get their own copies of these keys like everything else (lib/db.ts). const CURRENT = 'potw:current'; const HISTORY = 'potw:history'; const WEEK_TTL_S = 21 * 24 * 3600; const BATCH = 10; /** Scores every live print of a season (everyone in the collection blob; a print in a trade offer is skipped by `scorePrint`). */ /** Scans the active season and stores the best print that was not picked in the last 8 weeks. `by` is 'auto' or a staff login. */ /** The weekly cron's step: picks once per ISO week (a second call in the same week does nothing). */ /** An admin features one specific print. Returns why not, or null when done. */ /** The pick with everything the home page draws, or null when there is none or it was spent / removed since (never a broken card). */

nodes.name: getPotw
nodes.body_text: async function getPotw(): Promise<PotwPick | null> { try { return (await kv.get<PotwPick>(CURRENT)) ?? null; } catch { return null; } }

nodes.name: getHistory
nodes.body_text: async function getHistory(): Promise<PotwHistoryEntry[]> { try { return (await kv.get<PotwHistoryEntry[]>(HISTORY)) ?? []; } catch { return []; } }

nodes.name: ScanResult
nodes.body_text: interface ScanResult { candidates: Candidate[]; owners: number; prints: number; ms: number }

nodes.name: ScanSummary
nodes.body_text: type ScanSummary = Omit<ScanResult, 'candidates'> & { candidates: number };

nodes.name: scanSeason
nodes.signature: async function scanSeason(season: Season, now = Date.now()): Promise<ScanResult>
nodes.body_text: async function scanSeason(season: Season, now = Date.now()): Promise<ScanResult> { const started = Date.now(); const c = season.collectionName; if (!(await isTracking(c))) return { candidates: [], owners: 0, prints: 0, ms: 0 }; const owners = Object.keys(await getCollection(c)); const candidates: Candidate[] = []; let prints = 0; for (let i = 0; i < owners.length; i += BATCH) { const lists = await Promise.all(owners.slice(i, i + BATCH).map(o => getOwnerCopies(c, o).catch(() => [] as Copy[]))); for (const copy of lists.flat()) { prints++; const s = scorePrint(copy, now); if (s && copy.uid) candidates.push({ ...s, uid: copy.uid, copyId: copy.id, at: copy.at }); } } return { candidates, owners: owners.length, prints, ms: Date.now() - started }; }

nodes.name: store
nodes.signature: async function store(pick: PotwPick, now: number): Promise<void>
nodes.body_text: async function store(pick: PotwPick, now: number): Promise<void> { await kv.set(CURRENT, pick); await kv.set(HISTORY, pushHistory(await getHistory(), pick.uid, now)); }

nodes.name: PickOutcome
nodes.signature: type PickOutcome = { ok: true; pick: PotwPick; scan: ScanSummary } | { ok: false; reason: string };
nodes.body_text: type PickOutcome = { ok: true; pick: PotwPick; scan: ScanSummary } | { ok: false; reason: string };

nodes.name: pickNow
nodes.signature: async function pickNow(by: string, now = Date.now()): Promise<PickOutcome>
nodes.body_text: async function pickNow(by: string, now = Date.now()): Promise<PickOutcome> { const season = await getActiveSeason(); if (!season) return { ok: false, reason: 'No season is active.' }; if (!(await isTracking(season.collectionName))) return { ok: false, reason: 'The active season has no numbered prints yet.' }; const scan = await scanSeason(season, now); const best = pickPrintOfWeek(scan.candidates, recentUids(await getHistory(), now)); if (!best) return { ok: false, reason: 'No print is eligible right now.' }; const pick: PotwPick = { uid: best.uid, seasonId: season.id, copyId: best.copyId, score: best.score, reason: best.reason, chosenAt: now, by }; await store(pick, now); return { ok: true, pick, scan: { ...scan, candidates: scan.candidates.length } }; }

nodes.name: WeeklyOutcome
nodes.signature: type WeeklyOutcome = | { status: 'picked'; pick: PotwPick; scan: ScanSummary } | { status: 'already'; week: string } | { status: 'none'; reason: string };
nodes.body_text: type WeeklyOutcome = | { status: 'picked'; pick: PotwPick; scan: ScanSummary } | { status: 'already'; week: string } | { status: 'none'; reason: string };

nodes.name: pickOncePerWeek
nodes.body_text: async function pickOncePerWeek(now = Date.now()): Promise<WeeklyOutcome> { const week = isoWeekKey(now); const lock = `potw:week:${week}`; const got = await kv.set(lock, now, { nx: true, ex: WEEK_TTL_S }); if (!got) return { status: 'already', week }; let out: PickOutcome; try { out = await pickNow('auto', now); } catch (e) { out = { ok: false, reason: e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Pick failed.' }; } if (!out.ok) { // Nothing was picked, so let a retry later in the week try again. await kv.del(lock).catch(() => { /* the TTL clears it */ }); return { status: 'none', reason: out.reason }; } return { status: 'picked', pick: out.pick, scan: out.scan }; }

nodes.name: featureCopy
nodes.signature: async function featureCopy(season: Season, copy: Copy, by: string, now = Date.now()): Promise<string | null>
nodes.body_text: async function featureCopy(season: Season, copy: Copy, by: string, now = Date.now()): Promise<string | null> { if (!copy.owner) return 'That print no longer exists.'; if (!copy.uid) return 'It has no print number yet.'; const s = scorePrint(copy, now); if (!s) return 'It is in a trade offer right now.'; await store({ uid: copy.uid, seasonId: season.id, copyId: copy.id, score: s.score, reason: s.reason, chosenAt: now, by }, now); return null; }

nodes.name: clearPotw
nodes.body_text: async function clearPotw(): Promise<void> { await kv.del(CURRENT); }

nodes.name: FeaturedPrint
nodes.body_text: interface FeaturedPrint { pick: PotwPick; season: Season; copy: Copy; card: Card; pack: Pack }

nodes.name: loadFeatured
nodes.body_text: async function loadFeatured(): Promise<FeaturedPrint | null> { const pick = await getPotw(); if (!pick) return null; const season = await getSeason(pick.seasonId); if (!season || season.status === 'draft') return null; const copy = await getCopy(season.collectionName, pick.copyId); if (!copy || !copy.owner || copy.uid !== pick.uid) return null; for (const pack of await getPacksForSeason(season)) { const card = (await getPackCards(pack.id)).find(x => x.number === copy.card); if (card) return { pick, season, copy, card, pack }; } return null; }

nodes.name: print-of-week.ts
nodes.body_text: import { buildProvenance } from './provenance'; import { isEscrow, type Copy } from './serials-core'; // Print of the week (pure, client-safe): how interesting a print's journey is, and which print to feature. The cron and the admin // buttons that store the pick live in lib/print-of-week-store.ts. const WEEK_MS = 7 * 24 * 3_600_000; /** Weeks of age that still count. */ export const AGE_CAP_WEEKS = 8; /** A print picked within this many weeks is not picked again (the history keeps the newest `HISTORY_KEEP`). */ export const SKIP_WEEKS = 8; export const HISTORY_KEEP = 20; /** The pick stored at `potw:current`. */ /** "Held by 5 collectors, traded 4 times, 9 weeks old" from the parts that earned points. */ /** * Points for a print's journey: distinct holders x3, completed trades x2, edition #1 +5, Shiny / Full Art +2, age in weeks (cap 8) x1, * forged from other prints +2. Null when it cannot be featured: spent, in a trade offer, or without a print number. */ /** The best candidate that was not picked recently: highest score, the older print on a tie (then the lower print number). */ /** Newest first, no repeats, capped. */ /** The uids picked within the last `SKIP_WEEKS` weeks, which are not picked again. */ /** ISO week key "2026-W42" (UTC), so the cron runs its pick once per week. */

nodes.name: PotwParts
nodes.body_text: interface PotwParts { holders: number; trades: number; first: boolean; /** Shiny or Full Art. */ rare: boolean; ageWeeks: number; forged: boolean; }

nodes.name: Scored
nodes.body_text: interface Scored { score: number; parts: PotwParts; reason: string }

nodes.name: PotwPick
nodes.body_text: interface PotwPick { uid: number; seasonId: string; copyId: string; score: number; reason: string; chosenAt: number; by: string }

nodes.name: plural
nodes.body_text: plural = (n: number, one: string, many = `${one}s`) => `${n} ${n === 1 ? one : many}`

nodes.name: reasonText
nodes.body_text: function reasonText(p: PotwParts): string { const out: string[] = [`Held by ${plural(p.holders, 'collector')}`]; if (p.trades > 0) out.push(`traded ${p.trades === 1 ? 'once' : `${p.trades} times`}`); if (p.first) out.push('the first edition ever made'); if (p.forged) out.push('forged from other prints'); if (p.ageWeeks > 0) out.push(`${plural(p.ageWeeks, 'week')} old`); return out.join(', '); }

nodes.name: scorePrint
nodes.signature: function scorePrint(copy: Pick<Copy, 'ev' | 'owner' | 'at' | 'n' | 'variant' | 'origin' | 'madeFrom' | 'uid'>, now = Date.now()): Scored | null
nodes.body_text: function scorePrint(copy: Pick<Copy, 'ev' | 'owner' | 'at' | 'n' | 'variant' | 'origin' | 'madeFrom' | 'uid'>, now = Date.now()): Scored | null { if (!copy.uid || !copy.owner || isEscrow(copy.owner)) return null; const prov = buildProvenance(copy, now); const parts: PotwParts = { holders: Math.max(1, prov.holders.length), trades: prov.trades, first: copy.n === 1, rare: copy.variant === 'shiny' || copy.variant === 'full', ageWeeks: Math.min(AGE_CAP_WEEKS, Math.floor(prov.ageMs / WEEK_MS)), forged: copy.origin === 'upgrade' || (copy.madeFrom?.length ?? 0) > 0, }; const score = parts.holders * 3 + parts.trades * 2 + (parts.first ? 5 : 0) + (parts.rare ? 2 : 0) + parts.ageWeeks + (parts.forged ? 2 : 0); return { score, parts, reason: reasonText(parts) }; }

nodes.name: Candidate
nodes.body_text: interface Candidate extends Scored { uid: number; copyId: string; at: number }

nodes.name: pickPrintOfWeek
nodes.signature: function pickPrintOfWeek(candidates: Candidate[], recentUids: number[]): Candidate | null
nodes.body_text: function pickPrintOfWeek(candidates: Candidate[], recentUids: number[]): Candidate | null { const skip = new Set(recentUids); const pool = candidates.filter(c => !skip.has(c.uid)); pool.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score || a.at - b.at || a.uid - b.uid); return pool[0] ?? null; }

nodes.name: PotwHistoryEntry
nodes.body_text: interface PotwHistoryEntry { uid: number; at: number }

nodes.name: pushHistory
nodes.signature: pushHistory = (history: PotwHistoryEntry[], uid: number, at: number): PotwHistoryEntry[]
nodes.body_text: pushHistory = (history: PotwHistoryEntry[], uid: number, at: number): PotwHistoryEntry[] => [{ uid, at }, ...history.filter(h => h.uid !== uid)].slice(0, HISTORY_KEEP)

nodes.name: recentUids
nodes.body_text: recentUids = (history: PotwHistoryEntry[], now = Date.now()): number[] => history.filter(h => now - h.at < SKIP_WEEKS * WEEK_MS).map(h => h.uid)

nodes.name: isoWeekKey
nodes.body_text: function isoWeekKey(ms: number): string { const d = new Date(Date.UTC(new Date(ms).getUTCFullYear(), new Date(ms).getUTCMonth(), new Date(ms).getUTCDate())); const day = d.getUTCDay() || 7; d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate() + 4 - day); const year = d.getUTCFullYear(); const week = Math.ceil(((d.getTime() - Date.UTC(year, 0, 1)) / 86_400_000 + 1) / 7); return `${year}-W${String(week).padStart(2, '0')}`; }

nodes.name: profile-data.ts
nodes.body_text: import { getActiveSeasonWithPacks, getCollection, getUserProfile } from './kv'; import { getSeasonLeaderboard, getSeasonLeaderboardCached, pointsFor } from './leaderboard'; import { getUserAwards } from './season-wrap'; import { getAvatars, sizeTwitchAvatar } from './avatars'; import { getHiddenUsers } from './user-admin'; import { getUserSettings } from './user-settings-store'; import { hasExperiment, type UserSettings } from './user-settings'; import { countPulls } from './collection'; import { RARITIES } from './rarity'; import { serialMultiplier } from './scoring-core'; import { VARIANTS, allowedVariants, countVariants, decodeEntry, effectiveWeights, encodeEntry, emptyCounts, upgradeStep } from './variants'; import { getHoloResolver } from './holo'; import type { GridCard } from '@/app/u/[username]/CollectionGrid'; import type { Card, Pack, Season, UserProfile, Variant } from './types'; import type { VariantCounts } from './variants'; import { ORIGIN_LABELS, entryOf, type Copy } from './serials-core'; import { mintedCounts } from './serials'; import { histText } from './flip-back'; import { cardBackFor } from './card-back-store'; import { cardThumbUrl } from './card-art'; import type { BigStat, ShareCard, ShareSpec } from './share-image'; import { copyPoints, type CardValue, type LeaderboardRow } from './leaderboard'; import type { ScoringSettings } from './scoring-core'; // Everything a profile page needs about one viewer in the active season, loaded once and shared by the tabs. /** The viewer's `n` most valuable single copies, one per card (a copy with a low serial number is worth its serial bonus too). */ /** Everything a collector could put in a share image, best first: their strongest copy of each card with its lowest serial. */ /** The header, stats and footer of a collector's share image (the cards are chosen separately). */ /** The big stat tiles of the stats poster. */ /** The quick "Share image" of a collector: their best six cards with serials, rank and progress. */ const SHORT_VARIANT: Record<Variant, string> = { regular: '', reverse: 'RH', full: 'FA', shiny: 'SH' }; /** * `fresh: true` (the owner looking at their own profile) skips the shared 20 s leaderboard so an upgrade they just made shows * immediately; everyone else gets the shared one. */ /** What this viewer's low serial numbers add to one card, and the best one they hold (for the card dialog). */ /** The per-card data the collection grid and its detail view need (values come from the season leaderboard maths). */

nodes.name: ShowcaseCard
nodes.body_text: interface ShowcaseCard { number: number; name: string; imageUrl: string; fullArtImageUrl?: string; stars: number; variant: Variant; points: number }

nodes.name: topCopies
nodes.signature: function topCopies(allCards: { number: number; name: string; imageUrl: string; fullArtImageUrl?: string; stars: number }[], variantMap: Map<number, VariantCounts>, values: Map<number, CardValue>, n: number, serial?: { held?: Map<number, number[]>; settings: ScoringSettings }): ShowcaseCard[]
nodes.body_text: function topCopies(allCards: { number: number; name: string; imageUrl: string; fullArtImageUrl?: string; stars: number }[], variantMap: Map<number, VariantCounts>, values: Map<number, CardValue>, n: number, serial?: { held?: Map<number, number[]>; settings: ScoringSettings }): ShowcaseCard[] { const out: ShowcaseCard[] = []; for (const c of allCards) { const counts = variantMap.get(c.number); if (!counts) continue; let best: { variant: Variant; points: number } | null = null; for (const v of VARIANTS) if (counts[v] > 0) { const cv = values.get(c.number); const pts = !cv ? 0 : serial ? copyPoints(cv, v, serial.held?.get(encodeEntry(c.number, v))?.[0], serial.settings) : cv.values[v]; if (!best || pts > best.points) best = { variant: v, points: pts }; } if (best) out.push({ number: c.number, name: c.name, imageUrl: c.imageUrl, fullArtImageUrl: c.fullArtImageUrl, stars: c.stars, ...best }); } return out.sort((a, b) => b.points - a.points || a.number - b.number).slice(0, n); }

nodes.name: buildShareCandidates
nodes.signature: function buildShareCandidates(b: ProfileBase, copies: Copy[], n = 18): ShareCard[]
nodes.body_text: function buildShareCandidates(b: ProfileBase, copies: Copy[], n = 18): ShareCard[] { const top = topCopies(b.allCards, b.variantMap, b.board.values.cards, n, { held: b.board.values.serials?.held.get(b.lower), settings: b.board.values.settings }); const art = (c: ShowcaseCard) => ((c.variant === 'full' || c.variant === 'shiny') && c.fullArtImageUrl ? c.fullArtImageUrl : c.imageUrl); return top.map(c => { const lowest = copies.filter(x => x.card === c.number && x.variant === c.variant).sort((a, z) => a.n - z.n)[0]; return { src: art(c), thumb: cardThumbUrl(art(c)), name: c.name, hex: RARITIES.find(r => r.stars === c.stars)?.hex, tag: [c.variant === 'regular' ? '' : SHORT_VARIANT[c.variant], lowest ? `#${lowest.n}` : ''].filter(Boolean).join(' ') || undefined }; }); }

nodes.name: art
nodes.body_text: art = (c: ShowcaseCard) => ((c.variant === 'full' || c.variant === 'shiny') && c.fullArtImageUrl ? c.fullArtImageUrl : c.imageUrl)

nodes.name: buildShareBase
nodes.signature: function buildShareBase(b: ProfileBase, siteHost: string): Omit<ShareSpec, 'cards'>
nodes.body_text: function buildShareBase(b: ProfileBase, siteHost: string): Omit<ShareSpec, 'cards'> { return { title: b.displayName, subtitle: `@${b.lower} · ${b.season.name}`, stats: [b.rank ? `#${b.rank} rank` : 'Unranked', `${b.row ? Math.round(b.row.score).toLocaleString() : 0} pts`, `${b.uniqueOwned}/${b.total} cards`], footer: siteHost, }; }

nodes.name: buildShareSpec
nodes.signature: function buildShareSpec(b: ProfileBase, copies: Copy[], siteHost: string): ShareSpec
nodes.body_text: function buildShareSpec(b: ProfileBase, copies: Copy[], siteHost: string): ShareSpec { return { ...buildShareBase(b, siteHost), cards: buildShareCandidates(b, copies, 6) }; }

nodes.name: ProfileBase
nodes.body_text: interface ProfileBase { lower: string; displayName: string; profile: UserProfile | null; avatarUrl?: string; season: Season; packs: { pack: Pack; cards: Card[] }[]; allCards: (Card & { packName: string; pack: Pack })[]; collection: Record<string, number[]>; owned: number[]; countMap: Map<number, number>; variantMap: ReturnType<typeof countVariants>; board: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof getSeasonLeaderboard>>; rank: number | null; // 1-based row: LeaderboardRow | null; awards: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof getUserAwards>>; settings: UserSettings; // their own Settings (accent, wanted cards, layout, experiments) bio: string; // the line they wrote in Settings hidden: boolean; // an admin hid them from public boards (their page still works, but no activity feed) uniqueOwned: number; total: number; pct: number; rarity: { stars: number; label: string; hex: string; total: number; owned: number }[]; }

nodes.name: loadProfileBase
nodes.signature: async function loadProfileBase(lower: string, fresh: boolean): Promise<ProfileBase | null>
nodes.body_text: async function loadProfileBase(lower: string, fresh: boolean): Promise<ProfileBase | null> { const [result, profile, hiddenSet, theirs] = await Promise.all([getActiveSeasonWithPacks(), getUserProfile(lower), getHiddenUsers().catch(() => new Set<string>()), getUserSettings(lower)]); if (!result) return null; const { season, packs } = result; const [avatars, collection, board, awards] = await Promise.all([ getAvatars([lower]), getCollection(season.collectionName), fresh ? getSeasonLeaderboard(season) : getSeasonLeaderboardCached(season), getUserAwards(lower).catch(() => []), ]); const allCards = packs.flatMap(({ pack, cards }) => cards.map(c => ({ ...c, packName: pack.name, pack }))).sort((a, b) => b.stars - a.stars || a.number - b.number); const owned = collection[lower] ?? []; const countMap = countPulls(owned); const idx = board.rows.findIndex(r => r.username === lower); const uniqueOwned = allCards.filter(c => countMap.has(c.number)).length; const total = allCards.length; return { lower, displayName: profile?.displayName || lower, profile, avatarUrl: avatars[lower] ? sizeTwitchAvatar(avatars[lower], 150) : undefined, season, packs, allCards, collection, owned, countMap, variantMap: countVariants(owned), board, rank: idx >= 0 ? idx + 1 : null, row: idx >= 0 ? board.rows[idx] : null, awards, settings: theirs, bio: theirs.bio, hidden: hiddenSet.has(lower), uniqueOwned, total, pct: total > 0 ? Math.round((uniqueOwned / total) * 100) : 0, rarity: RARITIES.map(r => { const cs = allCards.filter(c => c.stars === r.stars); return { stars: r.stars, label: r.label, hex: r.hex, total: cs.length, owned: cs.filter(c => countMap.has(c.number)).length }; }).filter(r => r.total > 0), }; }

nodes.name: serialFor
nodes.signature: function serialFor(b: ProfileBase, cardNumber: number): GridCard['serial']
nodes.body_text: function serialFor(b: ProfileBase, cardNumber: number): GridCard['serial'] { const { values, } = b.board; const entries = b.owned.filter(e => decodeEntry(e).cardNumber === cardNumber); const points = pointsFor(values, entries, b.lower).serialPoints; let best: number | undefined; for (const [e, list] of values.serials?.held.get(b.lower) ?? []) if (decodeEntry(e).cardNumber === cardNumber && list.length) best = Math.min(best ?? Infinity, list[0]); return { points, best, mult: serialMultiplier(best, values.settings) }; }

[]), { id: c.id, ...(c.uid ? { uid: c.uid } : {}), variant: c.variant, n: c.n, at: c.at, origin: ORIGIN_LABELS[c.origin], ...(minted?.get(entryOf(c)) ? { made: minted.get(entryOf(c)) } : {}), ...(c.est ? { est: true } : {}), ...(m > 1 ? { m: Math.round(m * 100) / 100 } : {}), ...(c.ev.length > 1 ? { j: c.ev.slice(1).slice(-2).map(e => histText(e, hidden, c.origin)) } : {}), ...(cv ? { p: copyPoints(cv, c.variant, c.n, settings) } : {}), }]); } const holoFor = await getHoloResolver(); const backs = new Map(await Promise.all(b.packs.map(async ({ pack }) => [pack.id, await cardBackFor(pack, b.season.name)] as const))); return b.allCards.map(c => { const v = b.board.values.cards.get(c.number); const w = effectiveWeights(c.pack, c); const wTotal = VARIANTS.reduce((s, k) => s + Math.max(0, w[k]), 0) || 1; const pullRate = v?.pullRate ?? 0; return { id: c.id, number: c.number, name: c.name, imageUrl: c.imageUrl, fullArtImageUrl: c.fullArtImageUrl, stillUrl: c.stillUrl, fullArtStillUrl: c.fullArtStillUrl, stars: c.stars, packName: c.packName, upgradable: c.pack.upgradesEnabled && c.upgradesEnabled !== false, pullRate, variantOdds: { regular: pullRate * Math.max(0, w.regular) / wTotal, reverse: pullRate * Math.max(0, w.reverse) / wTotal, full: pullRate * Math.max(0, w.full) / wTotal, shiny: pullRate * Math.max(0, w.shiny) / wTotal, }, counts: b.variantMap.get(c.number) ?? emptyCounts(), values: v?.values ?? { regular: 0, reverse: 0, full: 0, shiny: 0 }, variantCopies: v?.variantCopies ?? emptyCounts(), serial: serialFor(b, c.number), costs: c.pack.upgradeCosts, variants: allowedVariants(c.pack, c), holo: holoFor(c.pack, c.stars), back: backs.get(c.pack.id), maths: v?.maths, copies: copiesByCard.get(c.number), steps: Object.fromEntries(VARIANTS.map(x => [x, upgradeStep(c.pack, c, x)])) as GridCard['steps'], }; }); }

The old /collection/<name> address still works: it // redirects here, so links in Discord posts, the Twitch panel and old bookmarks keep working. export const PROFILE_TABS: { id: 'overview' | 'collection' | 'stats' | 'trades' | 'activity' | 'share'; label: string; icon: IconName; ownerOnly?: boolean }[] = [ { id: 'overview', label: 'Overview', icon: 'grid' }, { id: 'collection', label: 'Collection', icon: 'cards' }, { id: 'stats', label: 'Stats', icon: 'trend' }, { id: 'trades', label: 'Trades', icon: 'trade' }, { id: 'activity', label: 'Activity', icon: 'activity' }, { id: 'share', label: 'Share', icon: 'image', ownerOnly: true }, ]; /** The profile address for a username (lower-cased, URL-safe), optionally on a tab. */ /** The browser-tab title for a profile page: "Alice's profile", "Alice's collection", "Alice's stats" ... one pattern for every tab. */ /** `?tab=` to a known tab, falling back to the overview. */ /** Event types the public Activity tab may show: pulls, upgrades and completed trades only (never admin actions or declined offers). */ export const PUBLIC_ACTIVITY_TYPES = ['pull', 'upgrade', 'trade'] as const;

nodes.body_text: import { kv } from './db'; import { alejoLabel, pronounLabel, type AlejoPronoun, type AlejoUser, type Pronouns } from './pronouns'; // Server side of the pronouns: resolves what to show after a collector's name. The pr.alejo.io lookup is only made for a // collector who chose that mode, is cached in KV (answers and misses for a day, a failure for ten minutes), gives up after // two seconds and never throws, so a slow or missing answer just shows nothing. const API = 'https://api.pronouns.alejo.io/v1'; const DAY = 86_400; const FAILED_SECONDS = 600; const TIMEOUT_MS = 2000; const tableKey = 'pronouns:table'; /** Local checks point this at a fake; the override is ignored in production builds. */ /** The parsed JSON, null for a 404 (nothing set), undefined for any failure. */ /** What pr.alejo.io says this login uses ("he/him"), or null. Cached for a day, misses included. */ /** The pronouns to show for a collector, from their setting. Never throws. */

nodes.name: getJson
nodes.signature: async function getJson(path: string): Promise<unknown | null | undefined>
nodes.body_text: async function getJson(path: string): Promise<unknown | null | undefined> { const ctl = new AbortController(); const timer = setTimeout(() => ctl.abort(), TIMEOUT_MS); try { const res = await fetch(`${base()}${path}`, { signal: ctl.signal, cache: 'no-store', headers: { accept: 'application/json' } }); if (res.status === 404) return null; if (!res.ok) return undefined; return await res.json(); } catch { return undefined; } finally { clearTimeout(timer); } }

nodes.name: pronounTable
nodes.signature: async function pronounTable(): Promise<Record<string, AlejoPronoun> | null>
nodes.body_text: async function pronounTable(): Promise<Record<string, AlejoPronoun> | null> { const hit = await kv.get<Record<string, AlejoPronoun>>(tableKey).catch(() => null); if (hit) return hit; const fresh = await getJson('/pronouns'); if (!fresh || typeof fresh !== 'object') return null; await kv.set(tableKey, fresh, { ex: DAY }).catch(() => {}); return fresh as Record<string, AlejoPronoun>; }

nodes.name: alejoPronouns
nodes.signature: async function alejoPronouns(login: string): Promise<string | null>
nodes.body_text: async function alejoPronouns(login: string): Promise<string | null> { if (!/^[a-z0-9_]{1,25}$/.test(login)) return null; const cached = await kv.get<{ v: string | null }>(userKey(login)).catch(() => null); if (cached && typeof cached === 'object' && 'v' in cached) return cached.v; const [user, table] = await Promise.all([getJson(`/users/${encodeURIComponent(login)}`), pronounTable()]); if (user === undefined || !table) { await kv.set(userKey(login), { v: null }, { ex: FAILED_SECONDS }).catch(() => {}); return null; } const v = user ? alejoLabel(user as AlejoUser, table) : null; await kv.set(userKey(login), { v }, { ex: DAY }).catch(() => {}); return v; }

nodes.signature: async function pronounsFor(login: string, p: Pronouns): Promise<string | null>
nodes.body_text: async function pronounsFor(login: string, p: Pronouns): Promise<string | null> { try { if (p.mode === 'set') return pronounLabel(p.value); if (p.mode === 'alejo') return await alejoPronouns(login.toLowerCase()); } catch { /* nothing shown */ } return null; }

nodes.name: pronouns.ts
nodes.body_text: // Pronouns shown after a collector's name (pure, client-safe). A viewer picks one of three modes: nothing (the default for // everyone), a choice from a fixed list, or "from pr.alejo.io" (the pronouns they set for Twitch chat, fetched on the server by // lib/pronouns-store.ts). No free text, so nothing here needs moderating. export const DEFAULT_PRONOUNS: Pronouns = { mode: 'none' }; /** The fixed list a viewer can pick from (the set pr.alejo.io offers, as pairs, plus any / ask me / other). */ export const PRONOUN_CHOICES = [ { id: 'hehim', label: 'he/him' }, { id: 'sheher', label: 'she/her' }, { id: 'theythem', label: 'they/them' }, { id: 'hethey', label: 'he/they' }, { id: 'shethey', label: 'she/they' }, { id: 'theyhe', label: 'they/he' }, { id: 'theyshe', label: 'they/she' }, { id: 'any', label: 'any' }, { id: 'itits', label: 'it/its' }, { id: 'askme', label: 'ask me' }, { id: 'other', label: 'other' }, ] as const; export const PRONOUN_MODE_LABELS: Record<PronounMode, string> = { none: 'Do not show pronouns', set: 'Choose from a list', alejo: 'Use the ones I set on pr.alejo.io' }; /** Anything → valid pronouns: an unknown mode is 'none', and a value is kept only for 'set' and only from the list. */ /** What pr.alejo.io knows about one pronoun (the /v1/pronouns table is keyed by id). */ /** What pr.alejo.io knows about one user (/v1/users/<login>; a 404 when they have set none). */ /** "he/him", "he/they" (a second pronoun), "any" (a single-word pronoun), from pr.alejo.io's ids. Null when nothing usable. */

nodes.name: PronounMode
nodes.body_text: type PronounMode = 'none' | 'set' | 'alejo';

nodes.name: Pronouns

nodes.name: pronounLabel
nodes.body_text: pronounLabel = (id: string | undefined): string | null => PRONOUN_CHOICES.find(c => c.id === id)?.label ?? null

nodes.name: sanitizePronouns
nodes.body_text: function sanitizePronouns(input: unknown): Pronouns { const o = (input && typeof input === 'object' ? input : {}) as Record<string, unknown>; if (o.mode === 'alejo') return { mode: 'alejo' }; if (o.mode === 'set' && typeof o.value === 'string' && PRONOUN_CHOICES.some(c => c.id === o.value)) return { mode: 'set', value: o.value }; return { mode: 'none' }; }

'' : part(main.object); return second ? `${first}/${second}` : first; }

nodes.name: provenance.ts
nodes.body_text: import type { Copy, CopyEvent } from './serials-core'; import { isEscrow } from './serials-core'; // A copy's journey (pure, client-safe): its history events turned into steps with who held it when and for how long. Names here are // raw; the page masks private collectors before showing them. /** * `copy.ev` is the full history we kept (the first event plus the latest 40), so a very busy copy may be missing its middle. * `now` is a parameter so the result is repeatable. */ /** "3 days", "5 hours", "12 minutes", "under a minute". */

nodes.name: StepKind
nodes.body_text: type StepKind = 'made' | 'passed' | 'offered' | 'returned' | 'forged' | 'ended' | 'removed';

nodes.name: ProvStep
nodes.body_text: interface ProvStep { kind: StepKind; t: number; /** Who it came from / who it went to (viewer logins). */ from?: string; to?: string; /** The viewer who held the copy AFTER this step (undefined while it sits in a trade offer or is gone). */ holder?: string; /** How long that holder kept it, until the next step (or until now for the last one). */ heldMs?: number; /** The copy this one was forged into (for an upgrade). */ into?: string; }

nodes.name: Provenance
nodes.body_text: interface Provenance { steps: ProvStep[]; /** Everyone who has held it, in order, once each. */ holders: string[]; /** Completed trades (the copy changed hands). */ trades: number; /** The holder who kept it longest and for how long. */ longest: { who: string; ms: number } | null; /** Time since it was made. */ ageMs: number; state: 'held' | 'offer' | 'gone'; }

nodes.name: viewer
nodes.body_text: viewer = (n?: string) => (n && !isEscrow(n) ? n : undefined)

nodes.name: buildProvenance
nodes.signature: function buildProvenance(copy: Pick<Copy, 'ev' | 'owner' | 'at'>, now = Date.now()): Provenance
nodes.body_text: function buildProvenance(copy: Pick<Copy, 'ev' | 'owner' | 'at'>, now = Date.now()): Provenance { const steps: ProvStep[] = []; let holder: string | undefined; for (const e of copy.ev as CopyEvent[]) { if (e.type === 'minted') { holder = viewer(e.who); steps.push({ kind: 'made', t: e.t, to: holder, holder }); } else if (e.type === 'escrowed') { steps.push({ kind: 'offered', t: e.t, from: viewer(e.who) }); holder = undefined; } else if (e.type === 'returned') { holder = viewer(e.who); steps.push({ kind: 'returned', t: e.t, to: holder, holder }); } else if (e.type === 'traded') { holder = viewer(e.to); steps.push({ kind: 'passed', t: e.t, from: viewer(e.who), to: holder, holder }); } else if (e.type === 'upgraded') { steps.push({ kind: 'forged', t: e.t, from: viewer(e.who), into: e.note }); holder = undefined; } else if (e.type === 'removed') { steps.push({ kind: 'removed', t: e.t, from: viewer(e.who) }); holder = undefined; } } const gone = !copy.owner; const last = steps[steps.length - 1]; // How long each holder kept it: from the step that gave it to them until the next step. const held = new Map<string, number>(); steps.forEach((s, i) => { if (!s.holder) return; const end = steps[i + 1]?.t ?? (gone ? s.t : now); s.heldMs = Math.max(0, end - s.t); held.set(s.holder, (held.get(s.holder) ?? 0) + s.heldMs); }); const holders: string[] = []; for (const s of steps) if (s.holder && !holders.includes(s.holder)) holders.push(s.holder); const top = [...held].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])[0]; return { steps, holders, trades: steps.filter(s => s.kind === 'passed').length, longest: top ? { who: top[0], ms: top[1] } : null, ageMs: Math.max(0, (gone && last ? last.t : now) - (steps[0]?.t ?? copy.at)), state: gone ? 'gone' : isEscrow(copy.owner) ? 'offer' : 'held', }; }

nodes.name: spanText
nodes.body_text: function spanText(ms: number): string { const min = Math.floor(ms / 60_000); if (min < 1) return 'under a minute'; if (min < 60) return `${min} minute${min === 1 ? '' : 's'}`; const h = Math.floor(min / 60); if (h < 48) return `${h} hour${h === 1 ? '' : 's'}`; const d = Math.floor(h / 24); return `${d} day${d === 1 ? '' : 's'}`; }

nodes.name: public-shortcuts.ts
nodes.body_text: import { profileHref } from './profile-url'; // "g then a letter" navigation for the public site's Keyboard shortcuts experiment (pure, client-safe). export const PUBLIC_SEQUENCE_MS = 1200; export const PUBLIC_GO_KEYS: PublicGoKey[] = [ { key: 'h', label: 'Home', href: '/' }, { key: 'c', label: 'My profile', href: u => profileHref(u), needsLogin: true }, { key: 'l', label: 'Leaderboard', href: '/leaderboard' }, { key: 's', label: 'Season stats', href: '/stats' }, { key: 'd', label: 'Card Dex', href: '/cards' }, { key: 't', label: 'Trade', href: '/trade' }, { key: 'a', label: 'My stats', href: '/account', needsLogin: true }, { key: 'e', label: 'Settings', href: '/settings', needsLogin: true }, ]; export const PUBLIC_IDLE: PublicSeq = { pending: false, at: 0 };

nodes.name: PublicGoKey
nodes.body_text: interface PublicGoKey { key: string; label: string; href: string | ((username: string) => string); needsLogin?: boolean }

nodes.name: PublicSeq
nodes.body_text: interface PublicSeq { pending: boolean; at: number }

nodes.name: nextPublicKey
nodes.signature: function nextPublicKey(state: PublicSeq, key: string, now: number, username?: string): { state: PublicSeq; go?: string }
nodes.body_text: function nextPublicKey(state: PublicSeq, key: string, now: number, username?: string): { state: PublicSeq; go?: string } { const k = key.toLowerCase(); if (state.pending && now - state.at <= PUBLIC_SEQUENCE_MS) { const hit = PUBLIC_GO_KEYS.find(i => i.key === k); if (!hit || (hit.needsLogin && !username)) return { state: PUBLIC_IDLE }; return { state: PUBLIC_IDLE, go: typeof hit.href === 'function' ? hit.href(username!) : hit.href }; } return k === 'g' ? { state: { pending: true, at: now } } : { state: PUBLIC_IDLE }; }

nodes.name: pull-limit-core.ts
nodes.body_text: // Pull limits kept with each viewer (ROADMAP 12.4). The Mix It Up tab sets the DEFAULT number of paid pulls per stream; a viewer can // have their own base limit, and temporary bonuses ("buffs": +N pulls per stream until a time) on top of it. Buff cards are meant to // add rows to `buffs` later, which is why a buff records where it came from. Pure: no database. export const NO_PULL_LIMIT: UserPullLimit = { limit: null, buffs: [] }; export const MAX_LIMIT = 1000; export const MAX_BUFFS = 20; export const MAX_BUFF_HOURS = 24 * 365; /** Whatever is stored (or nothing), as a complete, safe record. */ /** * What this viewer may pull per stream: their own base (else the default), plus every buff still running. A base of 0 means no * limit, and buffs cannot change that. `limit` 0 = unlimited. */ /** Sets (or clears, with null) the viewer's own base limit. */ /** Adds a bonus. `hours` null/0 = until removed. Ended buffs are dropped. Returns null when the input is not usable or the list is full. */ /** Nothing worth storing (so the key can be deleted). */

nodes.name: PullBuff
nodes.body_text: interface PullBuff { id: string; /** Extra pulls per stream while the buff lasts. */ amount: number; /** When it ends (ms since epoch); null = until removed. */ until: number | null; /** Who or what granted it: 'admin', later e.g. 'card:<id>'. */ source: string; note?: string; }

nodes.name: UserPullLimit
nodes.body_text: interface UserPullLimit { /** This viewer's own base limit per stream; null = use the default from Settings. 0 = no limit. */ limit: number | null; buffs: PullBuff[]; }

nodes.name: int
nodes.signature: int = (v: unknown, min: number, max: number): number | null
nodes.body_text: int = (v: unknown, min: number, max: number): number | null => { const n = typeof v === 'number' ? v : typeof v === 'string' && v.trim() !== '' ? Number(v) : NaN; return Number.isFinite(n) ? Math.min(max, Math.max(min, Math.floor(n))) : null; }

nodes.name: normalizePullLimit
nodes.body_text: function normalizePullLimit(raw: unknown): UserPullLimit { const r = (raw && typeof raw === 'object' ? raw : {}) as Record<string, unknown>; const buffs: PullBuff[] = []; if (Array.isArray(r.buffs)) { for (const b of r.buffs) { if (!b || typeof b !== 'object') continue; const o = b as Record<string, unknown>; const amount = typeof o.amount === 'number' && o.amount >= 1 ? int(o.amount, 1, MAX_LIMIT) : null; if (amount === null || typeof o.id !== 'string' || !o.id) continue; buffs.push({ id: o.id.slice(0, 60), amount, until: typeof o.until === 'number' && Number.isFinite(o.until) ? o.until : null, source: typeof o.source === 'string' && o.source ? o.source.slice(0, 60) : 'admin', ...(typeof o.note === 'string' && o.note.trim() ? { note: o.note.trim().slice(0, 120) } : {}), }); if (buffs.length >= MAX_BUFFS) break; } } return { limit: r.limit === null || r.limit === undefined ? null : int(r.limit, 0, MAX_LIMIT), buffs }; }

nodes.name: isActive
nodes.body_text: isActive = (b: PullBuff, now: number) => b.until === null || b.until > now

nodes.name: effectiveLimit
nodes.signature: function effectiveLimit(defaultLimit: number, rec: UserPullLimit, now = Date.now()): { limit: number; base: number; bonus: number; custom: boolean }
nodes.body_text: function effectiveLimit(defaultLimit: number, rec: UserPullLimit, now = Date.now()): { limit: number; base: number; bonus: number; custom: boolean } { const base = rec.limit ?? defaultLimit; const bonus = rec.buffs.filter(b => isActive(b, now)).reduce((s, b) => s + b.amount, 0); return { limit: base === 0 ? 0 : base + bonus, base, bonus, custom: rec.limit !== null }; }

nodes.name: withBase
nodes.signature: function withBase(rec: UserPullLimit, value: unknown): UserPullLimit
nodes.body_text: function withBase(rec: UserPullLimit, value: unknown): UserPullLimit { return { ...rec, limit: value === null || value === '' || value === undefined ? null : int(value, 0, MAX_LIMIT) }; }

nodes.name: withBuff
nodes.signature: function withBuff(rec: UserPullLimit, o: { id: string; amount: unknown; hours?: unknown; source?: string; note?: string }, now = Date.now()): UserPullLimit | null
nodes.body_text: function withBuff(rec: UserPullLimit, o: { id: string; amount: unknown; hours?: unknown; source?: string; note?: string }, now = Date.now()): UserPullLimit | null { const wanted = typeof o.amount === 'number' ? o.amount : typeof o.amount === 'string' && o.amount.trim() !== '' ? Number(o.amount) : NaN; if (!(wanted >= 1)) return null; // 0, negative or not a number: refuse rather than quietly make it 1 const amount = int(wanted, 1, MAX_LIMIT)!; const hours = o.hours === null || o.hours === undefined || o.hours === '' ? 0 : int(o.hours, 0, MAX_BUFF_HOURS); if (hours === null) return null; const live = rec.buffs.filter(b => isActive(b, now)); if (live.length >= MAX_BUFFS) return null; const buff: PullBuff = { id: o.id, amount, until: hours > 0 ? now + hours * 3_600_000 : null, source: o.source || 'admin', ...(o.note?.trim() ? { note: o.note.trim().slice(0, 120) } : {}) }; return { ...rec, buffs: [...live, buff] }; }

nodes.name: withoutBuff
nodes.signature: function withoutBuff(rec: UserPullLimit, id: string): UserPullLimit
nodes.body_text: function withoutBuff(rec: UserPullLimit, id: string): UserPullLimit { return { ...rec, buffs: rec.buffs.filter(b => b.id !== id) }; }

nodes.name: isEmpty
nodes.body_text: isEmpty = (rec: UserPullLimit) => rec.limit === null && rec.buffs.length === 0

nodes.name: pull-limit.ts
nodes.body_text: // Per-viewer pull limits in KV (`user:<name>:pulllimit`), see pull-limit-core.ts. Buff cards and admins both go through addBuff. import { kv } from './db'; import { isEmpty, normalizePullLimit, withBase, withBuff, withoutBuff, type UserPullLimit } from './pull-limit-core'; /** This viewer's own base limit per stream (null = follow the default from Settings, 0 = no limit). */ /** A temporary bonus: +amount pulls per stream for `hours` (0 or empty = until removed). Null when the input is unusable or there are too many. */

nodes.name: key
nodes.body_text: key = (u: string) => `user:${u.toLowerCase()}:pulllimit`

nodes.name: getUserPullLimit
nodes.body_text: async function getUserPullLimit(username: string): Promise<UserPullLimit> { return normalizePullLimit(await kv.get(key(username)).catch(() => null)); }

nodes.name: save
nodes.signature: async function save(username: string, rec: UserPullLimit): Promise<UserPullLimit>
nodes.body_text: async function save(username: string, rec: UserPullLimit): Promise<UserPullLimit> { if (isEmpty(rec)) await kv.del(key(username)); else await kv.set(key(username), rec); return rec; }

nodes.name: setUserBaseLimit
nodes.signature: async function setUserBaseLimit(username: string, value: unknown): Promise<UserPullLimit>
nodes.body_text: async function setUserBaseLimit(username: string, value: unknown): Promise<UserPullLimit> { return save(username, withBase(await getUserPullLimit(username), value)); }

nodes.name: addUserPullBuff
nodes.signature: async function addUserPullBuff(username: string, o: { amount: unknown; hours?: unknown; source?: string; note?: string }): Promise<UserPullLimit | null>
nodes.body_text: async function addUserPullBuff(username: string, o: { amount: unknown; hours?: unknown; source?: string; note?: string }): Promise<UserPullLimit | null> { const next = withBuff(await getUserPullLimit(username), { ...o, id: crypto.randomUUID() }); return next ? save(username, next) : null; }

nodes.name: removeUserPullBuff
nodes.signature: async function removeUserPullBuff(username: string, id: string): Promise<UserPullLimit>
nodes.body_text: async function removeUserPullBuff(username: string, id: string): Promise<UserPullLimit> { return save(username, withoutBuff(await getUserPullLimit(username), id)); }

nodes.name: deleteUserPullLimit
nodes.body_text: async function deleteUserPullLimit(username: string): Promise<void> { await kv.del(key(username)).catch(() => {}); }

nodes.name: push-client.ts
nodes.body_text: // Browser side of Web Push (client only): is it possible here, and subscribe / unsubscribe this device. The server half is lib/push.ts. /** An iPhone / iPad only allows push inside the installed app (iOS 16.4+); a normal Safari tab cannot ask. */ /** Asks permission (must run from a tap), subscribes and tells the server. Throws a viewer-readable message ('denied' when blocked). */

nodes.name: PushSupport
nodes.body_text: type PushSupport = 'ok' | 'install-first' | 'unsupported';

nodes.name: pushSupport
nodes.body_text: function pushSupport(): PushSupport { if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 'unsupported'; const ua = navigator.userAgent; const ios = /iPhone|iPad|iPod/.test(ua) || (/Macintosh/.test(ua) && navigator.maxTouchPoints > 1); const standalone = window.matchMedia('(display-mode: standalone)').matches || (navigator as unknown as { standalone?: boolean }).standalone === true; if (ios && !standalone) return 'install-first'; return 'serviceWorker' in navigator && 'PushManager' in window && 'Notification' in window ? 'ok' : 'unsupported'; }

nodes.name: keyBytes
nodes.body_text: function keyBytes(b64: string): Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer> { const raw = atob((b64 + '='.repeat((4 - (b64.length % 4)) % 4)).replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/')); const out = new Uint8Array(new ArrayBuffer(raw.length)); for (let i = 0; i < raw.length; i++) out[i] = raw.charCodeAt(i); return out; }

nodes.name: currentSubscription
nodes.body_text: async function currentSubscription(): Promise<PushSubscription | null> { try { return await (await navigator.serviceWorker.ready).pushManager.getSubscription(); } catch { return null; } }

nodes.name: enablePush
nodes.body_text: async function enablePush(publicKey: string): Promise<void> { const perm = await Notification.requestPermission(); if (perm !== 'granted') throw new Error(perm === 'denied' ? 'denied' : 'Alerts were not allowed.'); const reg = await navigator.serviceWorker.ready; const sub = (await reg.pushManager.getSubscription()) ?? await reg.pushManager.subscribe({ userVisibleOnly: true, applicationServerKey: keyBytes(publicKey) }); const res = await fetch('/api/account/push', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ subscription: sub.toJSON() }) }); if (!res.ok) throw new Error(((await res.json().catch(() => ({}))) as { error?: string }).error || 'Could not turn alerts on.'); }

nodes.name: disablePush
nodes.body_text: async function disablePush(): Promise<void> { const sub = await currentSubscription(); if (!sub) return; await fetch('/api/account/push', { method: 'DELETE', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ endpoint: sub.endpoint }) }).catch(() => null); await sub.unsubscribe().catch(() => false); }

nodes.name: push-core.ts
nodes.body_text: // Web Push, the client-safe half: what a stored device looks like, how a subscription from the browser is validated and which // notices become alerts. The sending lives in lib/push.ts (Node only). import type { Notice } from './trade-notice-core'; export const PUSH_MAX_DEVICES = 5; export const PUSH_KINDS = ['offers', 'results', 'watch', 'admin'] as const; export const PUSH_KIND_LABELS: Record<PushKind, string> = { offers: 'Trade offers and counters', results: 'How my offers ended', watch: 'Listing alerts', admin: 'Messages from the admins' }; /** What the settings page may see of a device: never the endpoint or keys. */ /** https only (a push service), plus plain http on localhost outside production so the fake endpoint of the checks can be used. */ const B64URL = /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+={0,2}$/; /** A browser's PushSubscription.toJSON() in, a clean { endpoint, keys } out (or null). p256dh is a 65-byte P-256 point, auth 16 bytes. */ /** A short device label from the user agent, e.g. "Chrome on Android". The raw string is never kept. */ /** The pushKinds group that governs a notice (offers, results, listing alerts, admin). */ const TITLES: Record<string, string> = { offer: 'New trade offer', countered: 'Counter offer', accepted: 'Trade accepted', declined: 'Offer declined', cancelled: 'Offer cancelled', expired: 'Offer expired', watch: 'Card listed', admin: 'Message from the admins', feedback: 'An answer to your feedback', };

nodes.name: PushKind
nodes.body_text: type PushKind = (typeof PUSH_KINDS)[number];

nodes.name: PushDevice
nodes.body_text: interface PushDevice { endpoint: string; keys: { p256dh: string; auth: string }; ua: string; addedAt: number; lastOkAt: number }

nodes.name: PushDeviceInfo
nodes.body_text: interface PushDeviceInfo { id: string; ua: string; addedAt: number; lastOkAt: number }

nodes.name: PushPayload
nodes.body_text: interface PushPayload { title: string; body: string; url: string; tag: string; urgent?: boolean }

nodes.name: validEndpoint
nodes.signature: function validEndpoint(v: unknown, dev = process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production'): v is string
nodes.body_text: function validEndpoint(v: unknown, dev = process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production'): v is string { if (typeof v !== 'string' || v.length > 600) return false; try { const u = new URL(v); if (u.protocol === 'https:') return true; return dev && u.protocol === 'http:' && (u.hostname === 'localhost' || u.hostname === '127.0.0.1'); } catch { return false; } }

nodes.name: b64Len
nodes.body_text: b64Len = (s: string) => { try { return atob(s.replace(/=+$/, '').replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/')).length; } catch { return -1; } }

nodes.name: parseSubscription
nodes.signature: function parseSubscription(input: unknown): { endpoint: string; keys: { p256dh: string; auth: string } } | null
nodes.body_text: function parseSubscription(input: unknown): { endpoint: string; keys: { p256dh: string; auth: string } } | null { const o = (input && typeof input === 'object' ? input : {}) as { endpoint?: unknown; keys?: { p256dh?: unknown; auth?: unknown } }; const p = o.keys?.p256dh, a = o.keys?.auth; if (!validEndpoint(o.endpoint) || typeof p !== 'string' || typeof a !== 'string') return null; if (!B64URL.test(p) || !B64URL.test(a) || b64Len(p) !== 65 || b64Len(a) !== 16) return null; return { endpoint: o.endpoint, keys: { p256dh: p, auth: a } }; }

nodes.name: deviceLabel
nodes.body_text: function deviceLabel(ua: string): string { const os = /iPhone|iPad|iPod/.test(ua) ? 'iPhone / iPad' : /Android/i.test(ua) ? 'Android' : /Windows/.test(ua) ? 'Windows' : /Mac OS X|Macintosh/.test(ua) ? 'Mac' : /Linux|CrOS/.test(ua) ? 'Linux' : 'Unknown device'; const br = /EdgA|EdgiOS|Edg\//.test(ua) ? 'Edge' : /SamsungBrowser/i.test(ua) ? 'Samsung Internet' : /FxiOS|Firefox/i.test(ua) ? 'Firefox' : /CriOS|Chrome\//.test(ua) ? 'Chrome' : /Safari\//.test(ua) ? 'Safari' : 'Browser'; return `${br} on ${os}`; }

nodes.name: pushGroup
nodes.body_text: function pushGroup(kind: string): PushKind { if (kind === 'offer' || kind === 'countered') return 'offers'; if (kind === 'watch') return 'watch'; return kind === 'admin' || kind === 'feedback' ? 'admin' : 'results'; }

nodes.name: allowsPush
nodes.signature: function allowsPush(pushKinds: readonly string[], kind: string): boolean
nodes.body_text: function allowsPush(pushKinds: readonly string[], kind: string): boolean { return pushKinds.includes(pushGroup(kind)); }

nodes.name: payloadFor
nodes.body_text: function payloadFor(n: Pick<Notice, 'id' | 'kind' | 'text' | 'tradeId'>): PushPayload { return { title: TITLES[n.kind] ?? 'The Cheesy TCG', body: n.text.slice(0, 240), url: n.kind === 'watch' ? '/trade?tab=board' : n.kind === 'feedback' ? '/feedback' : '/trade', tag: n.tradeId ? `trade-${n.tradeId}` : `notice-${n.id}`, urgent: n.kind === 'offer' || n.kind === 'countered', }; }

nodes.name: push-prompt-core.ts
nodes.body_text: // The "turn on alerts" banner: when to show it and how a "Not now" is remembered (pure, client-safe). The component is // app/components/site/PushPrompt.tsx; the subscribe flow it runs is lib/push-client.ts. export const PROMPT_KEY = 'tcg_push_prompt'; /** "Not now" hides the banner this long. */ export const SNOOZE_DAYS = 14; /** After this many "Not now" taps the banner stops for good (Settings still has the switch). */ export const MAX_DISMISSALS = 3; /** The stored value (JSON) read defensively: anything odd means "never dismissed". */ /** One more "Not now": hide for SNOOZE_DAYS and count it. */ /** A phone, a tablet, or the installed app (a computer's browser tab does not get the banner). */ /** 'turn-on': offer the subscribe button. 'install': an iPhone in Safari cannot ask yet, so point at the install guide. null: show nothing. */

nodes.name: PromptState
nodes.body_text: interface PromptState { until: number; n: number }

nodes.name: PromptMode
nodes.body_text: type PromptMode = 'turn-on' | 'install' | null;

nodes.name: parsePromptState
nodes.body_text: function parsePromptState(raw: string | null): PromptState { try { const o = JSON.parse(raw ?? 'null') as Partial<PromptState> | null; const until = Number(o?.until), n = Number(o?.n); return { until: Number.isFinite(until) && until > 0 ? until : 0, n: Number.isInteger(n) && n > 0 ? n : 0 }; } catch { return { until: 0, n: 0 }; } }

nodes.name: dismissed
nodes.signature: function dismissed(s: PromptState, now: number): PromptState
nodes.body_text: function dismissed(s: PromptState, now: number): PromptState { return { until: now + SNOOZE_DAYS * 86_400_000, n: s.n + 1 }; }

nodes.name: isPhoneLike
nodes.signature: function isPhoneLike(ua: string, touchPoints: number, standalone: boolean): boolean
nodes.body_text: function isPhoneLike(ua: string, touchPoints: number, standalone: boolean): boolean { return standalone || /Android|iPhone|iPad|iPod|Mobile/i.test(ua) || (/Macintosh/.test(ua) && touchPoints > 1); }

nodes.name: PromptInput
nodes.body_text: interface PromptInput { /** The server has Web Push set up (VAPID keys) and the viewer is signed in. */ serverEnabled: boolean; phone: boolean; /** `pushSupport()` from lib/push-client. */ support: 'ok' | 'install-first' | 'unsupported'; permission: NotificationPermission | 'unsupported'; /** This device already has a push subscription. */ subscribed: boolean; state: PromptState; now: number; }

nodes.name: promptMode
nodes.body_text: function promptMode(i: PromptInput): PromptMode { if (!i.serverEnabled || !i.phone || i.subscribed || i.permission === 'denied') return null; if (i.state.n >= MAX_DISMISSALS || i.now < i.state.until) return null; if (i.support === 'install-first') return 'install'; if (i.support === 'ok' && i.permission === 'default') return 'turn-on'; return null; }

nodes.name: push.ts
nodes.body_text: import webpush from 'web-push'; import { after } from 'next/server'; import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'; import { kv, inSandbox } from './db'; import { getUserSettings } from './user-settings-store'; import { wantsNotice } from './user-settings'; import { PUSH_MAX_DEVICES, allowsPush, deviceLabel, parseSubscription, payloadFor, type PushDevice, type PushDeviceInfo, type PushPayload, } from './push-core'; import type { Notice } from './trade-notice-core'; // Web Push: the only file that imports `web-push` (Node runtime; never from client code or the edge middleware). Browsers bring // their own push service, we only sign the message with the VAPID keys. Without the keys everything here is a quiet no-op. // Devices live in the KV hash push:<user> (field = hash of the endpoint), at most PUSH_MAX_DEVICES per viewer. const TTL_S = 24 * 60 * 60; /** Stores (or refreshes) this device. A sixth device drops the oldest. */ /** Removes a device by endpoint (this browser) or by id (from the list). */ /** Sends one payload to every device of a viewer. A 404 / 410 from the push service removes that device; other failures are logged. */ /** The "Send me a test alert" button (nothing is sent from a sandbox or preview). */ /** * Called by notify() once the notice is written. The sandbox is decided now (it is not visible inside after()); the send runs after * the response so a slow push service never slows a trade. Outside a request (scripts, checks) it just runs. */

nodes.name: key
nodes.body_text: key = (u: string) => `push:${u.toLowerCase()}`

nodes.name: idOf
nodes.body_text: idOf = (endpoint: string) => createHash('sha256').update(endpoint).digest('hex').slice(0, 20)

nodes.name: pushPublicKey
nodes.body_text: pushPublicKey = () => (process.env.VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY ?? '').trim()

nodes.name: pushConfigured
nodes.body_text: pushConfigured = () => !!(pushPublicKey() && (process.env.VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY ?? '').trim())

nodes.name: vapid
nodes.body_text: function vapid() { return { subject: (process.env.VAPID_SUBJECT ?? '').trim() || 'mailto:admin@example.com', publicKey: pushPublicKey(), privateKey: (process.env.VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY ?? '').trim(), }; }

nodes.name: readAll
nodes.signature: async function readAll(user: string): Promise<Record<string, PushDevice>>
nodes.body_text: async function readAll(user: string): Promise<Record<string, PushDevice>> { return ((await kv.hgetall(key(user)).catch(() => null)) as Record<string, PushDevice> | null) ?? {}; }

nodes.name: listDevices
nodes.body_text: async function listDevices(user: string): Promise<PushDeviceInfo[]> { const all = await readAll(user); return Object.entries(all).map(([id, d]) => ({ id, ua: d.ua, addedAt: d.addedAt, lastOkAt: d.lastOkAt })).sort((a, b) => b.addedAt - a.addedAt); }

nodes.name: SubscribeResult
nodes.signature: type SubscribeResult = { ok: true; id: string; devices: PushDeviceInfo[] } | { ok: false; error: string };
nodes.body_text: type SubscribeResult = { ok: true; id: string; devices: PushDeviceInfo[] } | { ok: false; error: string };

nodes.name: addDevice
nodes.signature: async function addDevice(user: string, input: unknown, ua: string): Promise<SubscribeResult>
nodes.body_text: async function addDevice(user: string, input: unknown, ua: string): Promise<SubscribeResult> { if (!pushConfigured()) return { ok: false, error: 'Alerts are not set up on this site yet.' }; const sub = parseSubscription(input); if (!sub) return { ok: false, error: 'That does not look like a valid push subscription.' }; const id = idOf(sub.endpoint); const all = await readAll(user); const now = Date.now(); const device: PushDevice = { ...sub, ua: deviceLabel(ua), addedAt: all[id]?.addedAt ?? now, lastOkAt: now }; const others = Object.entries(all).filter(([k]) => k !== id).sort((a, b) => a[1].addedAt - b[1].addedAt); const drop = others.slice(0, Math.max(0, others.length + 1 - PUSH_MAX_DEVICES)).map(([k]) => k); if (drop.length) await kv.hdel(key(user), ...drop); await kv.hset(key(user), { [id]: device }); return { ok: true, id, devices: await listDevices(user) }; }

nodes.name: removeDevice
nodes.signature: async function removeDevice(user: string, ref: { endpoint?: unknown; id?: unknown }): Promise<PushDeviceInfo[]>
nodes.body_text: async function removeDevice(user: string, ref: { endpoint?: unknown; id?: unknown }): Promise<PushDeviceInfo[]> { const id = typeof ref.id === 'string' && /^[a-f0-9]{20}$/.test(ref.id) ? ref.id : typeof ref.endpoint === 'string' ? idOf(ref.endpoint) : null; if (id) await kv.hdel(key(user), id).catch(() => 0); return listDevices(user); }

nodes.name: deleteAllDevices
nodes.body_text: async function deleteAllDevices(user: string): Promise<void> { await kv.del(key(user)).catch(() => 0); }

nodes.name: PushResult
nodes.body_text: interface PushResult { sent: number; removed: number; failed: number }

nodes.name: pushToUser
nodes.signature: async function pushToUser(user: string, payload: PushPayload): Promise<PushResult>
nodes.body_text: async function pushToUser(user: string, payload: PushPayload): Promise<PushResult> { const res: PushResult = { sent: 0, removed: 0, failed: 0 }; if (!pushConfigured()) return res; const all = await readAll(user); const v = vapid(); const body = JSON.stringify({ title: payload.title, body: payload.body, url: payload.url, tag: payload.tag }); await Promise.all(Object.entries(all).map(async ([id, d]) => { try { // Signed here, delivered with fetch (web-push's own sender only speaks https, which a local fake endpoint cannot). const details = webpush.generateRequestDetails( { endpoint: d.endpoint, keys: d.keys }, body, { TTL: TTL_S, urgency: payload.urgent ? 'high' : 'normal', vapidDetails: v } as webpush.RequestOptions, ); const r = await fetch(details.endpoint, { method: details.method, headers: details.headers as Record<string, string>, body: details.body as unknown as BodyInit, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(8000) }); if (r.status === 404 || r.status === 410) { await kv.hdel(key(user), id); res.removed++; } else if (r.ok) { res.sent++; await kv.hset(key(user), { [id]: { ...d, lastOkAt: Date.now() } }).catch(() => 0); } else { res.failed++; console.warn(`push for ${user}: push service answered ${r.status}`); } } catch (e) { res.failed++; console.warn('push failed:', e instanceof Error ? e.message : e); } })); return res; }

nodes.name: sendTestPush
nodes.body_text: async function sendTestPush(user: string): Promise<PushResult> { if (await inSandbox()) return { sent: 0, removed: 0, failed: 0 }; return pushToUser(user, { title: 'Test alert', body: 'Alerts work on this device. You will get one when someone trades with you.', url: '/settings', tag: 'test' }); }

nodes.name: pushNotice
nodes.signature: async function pushNotice(user: string, notice: Notice): Promise<void>
nodes.body_text: async function pushNotice(user: string, notice: Notice): Promise<void> { try { if (!pushConfigured() || (await inSandbox())) return; const s = await getUserSettings(user); if (!wantsNotice(s, notice.kind) || !allowsPush(s.pushKinds, notice.kind)) return; const run = async () => { await pushToUser(user, payloadFor(notice)); }; try { after(run); } catch { await run(); } } catch { /* best effort */ } }

nodes.name: run
nodes.body_text: run = async () => { await pushToUser(user, payloadFor(notice)); }

nodes.name: qr.ts
nodes.body_text: import qrcode from 'qrcode-generator'; /** A QR code as a grid of dark modules (client-safe; used by the flip card's back and the share image). Null if the text cannot be encoded. */ /** The same as one SVG path (dark modules only), so it can be styled like the rest of an engraving. */

nodes.name: qrModules
nodes.signature: function qrModules(text: string): { size: number; dark: (r: number, c: number) => boolean } | null
nodes.body_text: function qrModules(text: string): { size: number; dark: (r: number, c: number) => boolean } | null { try { const q = qrcode(0, 'M'); q.addData(text); q.make(); return { size: q.getModuleCount(), dark: (r, c) => q.isDark(r, c) }; } catch { return null; } }

nodes.name: qrPath
nodes.signature: function qrPath(text: string): { d: string; size: number } | null
nodes.body_text: function qrPath(text: string): { d: string; size: number } | null { const m = qrModules(text); if (!m) return null; let d = ''; for (let r = 0; r < m.size; r++) for (let c = 0; c < m.size; c++) if (m.dark(r, c)) d += `M${c} ${r}h1v1h-1z`; return { d, size: m.size }; }

Math.round((prob / total) * 100) : 0 }; }).filter(r => includeEmpty || r.count > 0); }

nodes.body_text: import type { Copy } from './serials-core'; import { isEscrow } from './serials-core'; // The profile's "Recent pulls" widget: the person's latest pulls, whatever happened to the print since (client-safe, pure). /** What became of a print for the person who pulled it: still theirs, in an open offer, with someone else, spent in an upgrade or taken out. */ /** Prints `user` pulled from a pack or was granted (a webhook reward or an admin gift; the minted event names them), newest first, each once. Held, traded away and retired prints all count. */

nodes.name: PullFate
nodes.body_text: type PullFate = 'held' | 'offer' | 'traded' | 'forged' | 'removed';

nodes.name: pullFate
nodes.signature: function pullFate(c: Pick<Copy, 'owner' | 'ev'>, user: string): PullFate
nodes.body_text: function pullFate(c: Pick<Copy, 'owner' | 'ev'>, user: string): PullFate { if (c.owner === user) return 'held'; if (isEscrow(c.owner)) return 'offer'; if (c.owner) return 'traded'; return [...c.ev].reverse().find(e => e.type === 'upgraded' || e.type === 'removed')?.type === 'upgraded' ? 'forged' : 'removed'; }

nodes.name: pickRecentPulls
nodes.signature: function pickRecentPulls(candidates: Copy[], user: string, limit = 8): (Copy & { fate: PullFate })[]
nodes.body_text: function pickRecentPulls(candidates: Copy[], user: string, limit = 8): (Copy & { fate: PullFate })[] { const seen = new Set<string>(); return candidates .filter(c => (c.origin === 'pull' || c.origin === 'grant') && (c.ev[0]?.who ?? c.owner) === user && !seen.has(c.id) && !!seen.add(c.id)) .sort((x, y) => y.at - x.at || y.n - x.n) .slice(0, limit) .map(c => ({ ...c, fate: pullFate(c, user) })); }

nodes.name: sandbox-diff.ts
nodes.body_text: // Compares a sandbox's setup with production's (pure, client-safe). A sandbox starts as a copy of production's seasons, packs, // cards and settings, so anything different has been changed inside the sandbox (or in production since). export const SETTING_KEYS = ['scoring:settings', 'overlay:settings', 'overlay:packprops', 'overlay:presets'] as const; const SEASON_FIELDS = ['name', 'collectionName', 'status', 'active', 'maxConcurrentPacks', 'packIds', 'startsAt', 'endsAt', 'autoStart', 'endedAt', 'tradingFrozen']; const PACK_FIELDS = ['name', 'status', 'active', 'archived', 'weight', 'coverImageUrl', 'accentColor', 'holoMinStars', 'cardTime', 'cooldownTime', 'soundVolume', 'upgradesEnabled', 'variantWeights', 'upgradeCosts', 'disabledVariants']; const CARD_FIELDS = ['number', 'name', 'stars', 'probability', 'imageUrl', 'soundUrl', 'fullArtImageUrl', 'stillUrl', 'fullArtStillUrl', 'upgradesEnabled', 'disabledVariants']; /** Top-level keys that differ between two settings objects (a short, readable summary of a larger blob). */ /** Counts by change type, for the summary tiles. */ /** Reads a whole setup through a key reader (production's, or a sandbox's). */

nodes.name: Setup
nodes.body_text: interface Setup { seasons: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>>; packs: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>>; cards: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>[]>; // by pack id settings: Record<string, unknown>; // by KV key }
