nodes.body_text: interface DiffItem { area: DiffArea; id: string; label: string; change: 'added' | 'removed' | 'changed'; fields: FieldChange[] }

nodes.name: show
nodes.body_text: show = (v: unknown): string => { if (v === undefined) return '(not set)'; const t = typeof v === 'string' ? v : JSON.stringify(v); return t.length > 80 ? t.slice(0, 77) + '…' : t; }

nodes.name: same
nodes.body_text: same = (a: unknown, b: unknown) => JSON.stringify(a ?? null) === JSON.stringify(b ?? null)

nodes.name: fieldDiff
nodes.signature: function fieldDiff(prod: Record<string, unknown> | undefined, box: Record<string, unknown> | undefined, fields: string[]): FieldChange[]
nodes.body_text: function fieldDiff(prod: Record<string, unknown> | undefined, box: Record<string, unknown> | undefined, fields: string[]): FieldChange[] { const out: FieldChange[] = []; for (const f of fields) if (!same(prod?.[f], box?.[f])) out.push({ field: f, production: show(prod?.[f]), sandbox: show(box?.[f]) }); return out; }

nodes.name: settingDiff
nodes.signature: function settingDiff(prod: unknown, box: unknown): FieldChange[]
nodes.body_text: function settingDiff(prod: unknown, box: unknown): FieldChange[] { const p = (prod && typeof prod === 'object' ? prod : {}) as Record<string, unknown>; const b = (box && typeof box === 'object' ? box : {}) as Record<string, unknown>; const keys = [...new Set([...Object.keys(p), ...Object.keys(b)])].sort(); return keys.filter(k => !same(p[k], b[k])).map(k => ({ field: k, production: show(p[k]), sandbox: show(b[k]) })); }

nodes.name: diffSetup
nodes.signature: function diffSetup(prod: Setup, box: Setup): DiffItem[]
nodes.body_text: function diffSetup(prod: Setup, box: Setup): DiffItem[] { const items: DiffItem[] = []; const name = (r: Record<string, unknown> | undefined, fallback: string) => String(r?.name ?? fallback); const walk = (area: DiffArea, p: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>>, b: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>>, fields: string[]) => { for (const id of [...new Set([...Object.keys(p), ...Object.keys(b)])].sort()) { if (!(id in b)) items.push({ area, id, label: name(p[id], id), change: 'removed', fields: [] }); else if (!(id in p)) items.push({ area, id, label: name(b[id], id), change: 'added', fields: [] }); else { const f = fieldDiff(p[id], b[id], fields); if (f.length) items.push({ area, id, label: name(b[id], id), change: 'changed', fields: f }); } } }; walk('Season', prod.seasons, box.seasons, SEASON_FIELDS); walk('Pack', prod.packs, box.packs, PACK_FIELDS); for (const packId of [...new Set([...Object.keys(prod.cards), ...Object.keys(box.cards)])].sort()) { const packName = name(box.packs[packId] ?? prod.packs[packId], packId); const p = new Map((prod.cards[packId] ?? []).map(c => [String(c.id ?? c.number), c])); const b = new Map((box.cards[packId] ?? []).map(c => [String(c.id ?? c.number), c])); for (const id of [...new Set([...p.keys(), ...b.keys()])]) { const label = `${name(b.get(id) ?? p.get(id), id)} (${packName})`; if (!b.has(id)) items.push({ area: 'Card', id: `${packId}:${id}`, label, change: 'removed', fields: [] }); else if (!p.has(id)) items.push({ area: 'Card', id: `${packId}:${id}`, label, change: 'added', fields: [] }); else { const f = fieldDiff(p.get(id), b.get(id), CARD_FIELDS); if (f.length) items.push({ area: 'Card', id: `${packId}:${id}`, label, change: 'changed', fields: f }); } } } for (const key of SETTING_KEYS) { const f = settingDiff(prod.settings[key], box.settings[key]); if (f.length) items.push({ area: 'Setting', id: key, label: key, change: 'changed', fields: f }); } return items; }

nodes.name: name
nodes.signature: name = (r: Record<string, unknown> | undefined, fallback: string)
nodes.body_text: name = (r: Record<string, unknown> | undefined, fallback: string) => String(r?.name ?? fallback)

nodes.name: walk
nodes.signature: walk = (area: DiffArea, p: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>>, b: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>>, fields: string[])
nodes.body_text: walk = (area: DiffArea, p: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>>, b: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>>, fields: string[]) => { for (const id of [...new Set([...Object.keys(p), ...Object.keys(b)])].sort()) { if (!(id in b)) items.push({ area, id, label: name(p[id], id), change: 'removed', fields: [] }); else if (!(id in p)) items.push({ area, id, label: name(b[id], id), change: 'added', fields: [] }); else { const f = fieldDiff(p[id], b[id], fields); if (f.length) items.push({ area, id, label: name(b[id], id), change: 'changed', fields: f }); } } }

nodes.name: summarizeDiff
nodes.signature: function summarizeDiff(items: DiffItem[]): { added: number; removed: number; changed: number; total: number }
nodes.body_text: function summarizeDiff(items: DiffItem[]): { added: number; removed: number; changed: number; total: number } { const n = { added: 0, removed: 0, changed: 0, total: items.length }; for (const i of items) n[i.change]++; return n; }

nodes.name: readSetup
nodes.signature: async function readSetup(read: (key: string) => Promise<unknown>): Promise<Setup>
nodes.body_text: async function readSetup(read: (key: string) => Promise<unknown>): Promise<Setup> { const seasonIds = ((await read('seasons:list')) as string[] | null) ?? []; const packIds = ((await read('packs:list')) as string[] | null) ?? []; const setup: Setup = { seasons: {}, packs: {}, cards: {}, settings: {} }; await Promise.all([ ...seasonIds.map(async id => { const v = await read(`season:${id}`); if (v) setup.seasons[id] = v as Record<string, unknown>; }), ...packIds.map(async id => { const [pack, cards] = await Promise.all([read(`pack:${id}`), read(`pack:${id}:cards`)]); if (pack) setup.packs[id] = pack as Record<string, unknown>; if (Array.isArray(cards)) setup.cards[id] = cards as Record<string, unknown>[]; }), ...SETTING_KEYS.map(async k => { const v = await read(k); if (v !== null && v !== undefined) setup.settings[k] = v; }), ]); return setup; }

nodes.name: sandbox-log.ts
nodes.body_text: import { kv, runInSandbox } from './db'; import { getCollection, listSeasons, saveCollection, getUserProfile, saveUserProfile, deleteUserProfile, withCollectionLock } from './kv'; import { listOpenTrades, tradeHistory } from './trades'; import type { UserProfile } from './types'; // A short history of what an admin did inside a sandbox, plus a one-step undo for the last change to viewer data. // Both live INSIDE the sandbox's namespace (via `kv`, so a reset or delete wipes them with everything else) and never // touch production. Undo restores collections (and the profiles of the viewers an action named); it refuses when trades // have happened since, because escrowed cards would then be counted twice. const LOG_KEY = 'sandbox:log'; const UNDO_KEY = 'sandbox:undo'; export const LOG_LIMIT = 60; /** A fingerprint of the trade state; if it changed since a snapshot, restoring collections would break escrow. */ /** Writes a log line (best effort). */ /** * Runs a change to viewer data, remembering how things were so the last change can be undone, and logs it. * The snapshot is only kept if `fn` succeeds. `describe` turns the result into the log detail. */ /** Restores the state from before the last viewer-data change. Returns what was undone, or why it could not be. */

nodes.name: LogEntry
nodes.body_text: interface LogEntry { at: number; label: string; detail?: string; undoable: boolean }

nodes.name: UndoPoint
nodes.body_text: interface UndoPoint { at: number; label: string; collections: Record<string, Record<string, number[]>>; // collection name -> contents before the change profiles: Record<string, UserProfile | null>; // viewers the action named -> profile before the change tradeStamp: string; }

nodes.name: tradeStamp
nodes.body_text: async function tradeStamp(): Promise<string> { const [open, history] = await Promise.all([listOpenTrades().catch(() => []), tradeHistory().catch(() => [])]); return `${open.map(t => `${t.id}:${t.status}`).join(',')}|${history.length}`; }

nodes.name: appendLog
nodes.signature: function appendLog(list: LogEntry[], entry: LogEntry): LogEntry[]
nodes.body_text: function appendLog(list: LogEntry[], entry: LogEntry): LogEntry[] { return [entry, ...list].slice(0, LOG_LIMIT); }

nodes.name: getLog
nodes.body_text: function getLog(sandboxId: string): Promise<LogEntry[]> { return runInSandbox(sandboxId, async () => (await kv.get<LogEntry[]>(LOG_KEY)) ?? []); }

nodes.name: getUndoLabel
nodes.signature: function getUndoLabel(sandboxId: string): Promise<{ label: string; at: number } | null>
nodes.body_text: function getUndoLabel(sandboxId: string): Promise<{ label: string; at: number } | null> { return runInSandbox(sandboxId, async () => { const u = await kv.get<UndoPoint>(UNDO_KEY); return u ? { label: u.label, at: u.at } : null; }); }

nodes.name: logEvent
nodes.signature: function logEvent(sandboxId: string, label: string, detail?: string, undoable = false): Promise<void>
nodes.body_text: function logEvent(sandboxId: string, label: string, detail?: string, undoable = false): Promise<void> { return runInSandbox(sandboxId, async () => { try { await kv.set(LOG_KEY, appendLog((await kv.get<LogEntry[]>(LOG_KEY)) ?? [], { at: Date.now(), label, detail, undoable })); } catch { /* the log must never block an action */ } }); }

nodes.name: takeSnapshot
nodes.signature: async function takeSnapshot(label: string, usernames: string[]): Promise<UndoPoint>
nodes.body_text: async function takeSnapshot(label: string, usernames: string[]): Promise<UndoPoint> { const seasons = await listSeasons(); const collections: UndoPoint['collections'] = {}; for (const s of seasons) collections[s.collectionName] = await getCollection(s.collectionName); const profiles: UndoPoint['profiles'] = {}; for (const u of usernames) profiles[u] = await getUserProfile(u); return { at: Date.now(), label, collections, profiles, tradeStamp: await tradeStamp() }; }

nodes.name: withUndo
nodes.signature: async function withUndo<T>(sandboxId: string, label: string, usernames: string[], fn: () => Promise<T>, describe?: (r: T) => string): Promise<T>
nodes.body_text: async function withUndo<T>(sandboxId: string, label: string, usernames: string[], fn: () => Promise<T>, describe?: (r: T) => string): Promise<T> { const before = await runInSandbox(sandboxId, () => takeSnapshot(label, usernames)); const result = await fn(); await runInSandbox(sandboxId, async () => { try { await kv.set(UNDO_KEY, before); } catch { /* ignore */ } }); await logEvent(sandboxId, label, describe?.(result), true); return result; }

nodes.name: undoLast
nodes.signature: function undoLast(sandboxId: string): Promise<{ ok: true; label: string } | { ok: false; error: string }>
nodes.body_text: function undoLast(sandboxId: string): Promise<{ ok: true; label: string } | { ok: false; error: string }> { return runInSandbox(sandboxId, async () => { const point = await kv.get<UndoPoint>(UNDO_KEY); if (!point) return { ok: false as const, error: 'Nothing to undo.' }; if ((await tradeStamp()) !== point.tradeStamp) return { ok: false as const, error: 'Trades have happened since that change, and undoing it would count escrowed cards twice. Cancel or finish the trades, or reset the viewer data.' }; for (const [name, data] of Object.entries(point.collections)) await withCollectionLock(name, () => saveCollection(name, data)); for (const [user, profile] of Object.entries(point.profiles)) { if (profile) await saveUserProfile(profile); else await deleteUserProfile(user); } await kv.del(UNDO_KEY); await logEvent(sandboxId, `Undid: ${point.label}`); return { ok: true as const, label: point.label }; }); }

nodes.name: sandbox-scenarios.ts
nodes.body_text: import { getActiveSeasonWithPacks, saveCollection, getCollection, ensureUserProfile, withCollectionLock } from './kv'; import { runInSandbox } from './db'; import { encodeEntry } from './variants'; import { seedUsers } from './sandbox-tools'; import type { UpgradeCosts } from './types'; // One-click test setups. `planScenario` is pure (given the active season's cards and upgrade costs it says exactly who gets which // copies) so it can be checked without a database; `applyScenario` writes the plan in one locked pass. Every scenario names its // viewers (e.g. `upgrade_ready`) so you can find them in the Users tab and "Log in as" them. export const SCENARIOS: ScenarioInfo[] = [ { id: 'upgrade-ready', title: 'Ready to upgrade', description: 'upgrade_ready has exactly enough Regulars of three cards for a Reverse Holo upgrade; upgrade_one_short is one print short.', needsUpgrades: true, icon: 'sparkles' }, { id: 'nearly-complete', title: 'One card short of a full set', description: 'one_card_short owns every card in the season except one. Pull it, or grant it, to see the full set bonus appear.', needsUpgrades: false, icon: 'target' }, { id: 'complete-set', title: 'Complete collection', description: 'completionist owns one of every card, for the Complete chip, the set bonus and the end-of-season awards.', needsUpgrades: false, icon: 'cheese' }, { id: 'trade-pair', title: 'Trade-ready pair', description: 'trader_a and trader_b each have spare prints of cards the other lacks, so a one-for-one trade helps both.', needsUpgrades: false, icon: 'trade' }, { id: 'shiny-showcase', title: 'Shiny showcase', description: 'shiny_hunter owns Full Art and Shiny prints of three cards, to look at the rarest versions and their points.', needsUpgrades: true, icon: 'gem' }, { id: 'crowd', title: 'Busy leaderboard', description: '100 realistic viewers with a long tail of light collectors and a few heavy ones.', needsUpgrades: false, icon: 'users' }, ]; /** Applies a scenario inside a sandbox. Returns what was set up and who to look at. */

nodes.name: ScenarioId
nodes.body_text: type ScenarioId = 'upgrade-ready' | 'nearly-complete' | 'complete-set' | 'trade-pair' | 'shiny-showcase' | 'crowd';

nodes.name: ScenarioInfo
nodes.body_text: interface ScenarioInfo { id: ScenarioId; title: string; description: string; needsUpgrades: boolean; icon: 'sparkles' | 'target' | 'cheese' | 'trade' | 'gem' | 'users' }

nodes.body_text: interface PlanContext { cards: { number: number; stars: number }[]; costs: UpgradeCosts | null }

nodes.name: Grant
nodes.body_text: interface Grant { user: string; entries: number[] }

nodes.name: Plan
nodes.signature: type Plan = { ok: true; grants: Grant[]; note: string } | { ok: false; error: string };
nodes.body_text: type Plan = { ok: true; grants: Grant[]; note: string } | { ok: false; error: string };

nodes.name: copies
nodes.signature: copies = (n: number, count: number, variant: Parameters<typeof encodeEntry>[1] = 'regular')
nodes.body_text: copies = (n: number, count: number, variant: Parameters<typeof encodeEntry>[1] = 'regular') => Array.from({ length: Math.max(0, count) }, () => encodeEntry(n, variant))

nodes.name: planScenario
nodes.signature: function planScenario(id: Exclude<ScenarioId, 'crowd'>, ctx: PlanContext): Plan
nodes.body_text: function planScenario(id: Exclude<ScenarioId, 'crowd'>, ctx: PlanContext): Plan { const nums = [...new Set(ctx.cards.map(c => c.number))].sort((a, b) => a - b); if (nums.length === 0) return { ok: false, error: 'The active season has no cards.' }; const need = SCENARIOS.find(s => s.id === id)!.needsUpgrades; if (need && !ctx.costs) return { ok: false, error: 'No pack in the active season has upgrades switched on. Turn them on in the pack settings first.' }; switch (id) { case 'upgrade-ready': { const cost = ctx.costs!.reverse; const three = nums.slice(0, 3); return { ok: true, grants: [ { user: 'upgrade_ready', entries: three.flatMap(n => copies(n, cost)) }, { user: 'upgrade_one_short', entries: copies(three[0], cost - 1) }, ], note: `upgrade_ready has ${cost} Regulars each of ${three.map(n => `#${n}`).join(', ')} (exactly one Reverse Holo upgrade each); upgrade_one_short has ${cost - 1} of #${three[0]}.`, }; } case 'nearly-complete': { if (nums.length < 2) return { ok: false, error: 'The season needs at least two cards.' }; const missing = nums[nums.length - 1]; return { ok: true, grants: [{ user: 'one_card_short', entries: nums.filter(n => n !== missing).flatMap(n => copies(n, 1)) }], note: `one_card_short owns every card except #${missing}.` }; } case 'complete-set': return { ok: true, grants: [{ user: 'completionist', entries: nums.flatMap(n => copies(n, 1)) }], note: `completionist owns all ${nums.length} cards.` }; case 'trade-pair': { if (nums.length < 6) return { ok: false, error: 'The season needs at least six cards for a trade pair.' }; const half = Math.floor(nums.length / 2); const a = nums.slice(0, half), b = nums.slice(half); const dupes = (list: number[]) => list.slice(0, 3); return { ok: true, grants: [ { user: 'trader_a', entries: [...a.flatMap(n => copies(n, 1)), ...dupes(a).flatMap(n => copies(n, 2))] }, { user: 'trader_b', entries: [...b.flatMap(n => copies(n, 1)), ...dupes(b).flatMap(n => copies(n, 2))] }, ], note: `trader_a owns #${a[0]}–#${a[a.length - 1]} with spares of ${dupes(a).map(n => `#${n}`).join(', ')}; trader_b owns the rest with spares of ${dupes(b).map(n => `#${n}`).join(', ')}.`, }; } case 'shiny-showcase': { const three = nums.slice(0, 3); return { ok: true, grants: [{ user: 'shiny_hunter', entries: [...copies(three[0], 1), ...three.flatMap(n => [...copies(n, 1, 'full'), ...copies(n, 1, 'shiny')])] }], note: `shiny_hunter owns Full Art and Shiny ${three.map(n => `#${n}`).join(', ')}.` }; } } }

nodes.name: dupes
nodes.body_text: dupes = (list: number[]) => list.slice(0, 3)

nodes.name: applyScenario
nodes.signature: function applyScenario(sandboxId: string | null, id: ScenarioId): Promise<{ note: string; users: string[] }>
nodes.body_text: function applyScenario(sandboxId: string | null, id: ScenarioId): Promise<{ note: string; users: string[] }> { if (id === 'crowd') { return seedUsers(sandboxId, { count: 100, minPulls: 3, maxPulls: 150, shape: 'realistic' }) .then(r => ({ note: `Created ${r.users} viewers with ${r.pulls.toLocaleString()} pulls between them.`, users: [] })); } return runInSandbox(sandboxId, async () => { const active = await getActiveSeasonWithPacks(); if (!active) throw new Error('This sandbox has no active season. Activate one first.'); const cards = active.packs.flatMap(p => p.cards.map(c => ({ number: c.number, stars: c.stars }))); const costs = active.packs.find(p => p.pack.upgradesEnabled)?.pack.upgradeCosts ?? null; const plan = planScenario(id, { cards, costs }); if (!plan.ok) throw new Error(plan.error); const collection = active.season.collectionName; for (const g of plan.grants) await ensureUserProfile(g.user); await withCollectionLock(collection, async () => { const data = await getCollection(collection); for (const g of plan.grants) data[g.user] = [...(data[g.user] ?? []), ...g.entries]; await saveCollection(collection, data); }); return { note: plan.note, users: plan.grants.map(g => g.user) }; }); }

Each runs pinned to the given sandbox, wherever the admin is. /** One overlay-style draw: pack by weight, card by probability, then (where upgrades are on) the variant roll. */ /** Draws `count` pulls for a user exactly as the overlay does (pack by weight, card by probability, then the variant roll). */ /** Gives a user `count` copies of one card in one variant (the quickest way to set up an upgrade or trade scenario). */ /** Everyone with a collection in this sandbox, with their copy counts. */ /** The active season's cards (for the "grant copies" picker). */ // ── Bulk seeding ────────────────────────────────────────── const WORDS_A = ['nacho', 'gouda', 'brie', 'swiss', 'cheddar', 'feta', 'edam', 'curd', 'melty', 'crispy', 'cheesy', 'smoky', 'sharp', 'creamy', 'toasty', 'spicy', 'golden', 'holey', 'mighty', 'sleepy', 'turbo', 'lucky', 'salty', 'zesty']; const WORDS_B = ['gus', 'fox', 'owl', 'moth', 'otter', 'wizard', 'knight', 'ninja', 'goblin', 'panda', 'badger', 'crab', 'llama', 'raven', 'viking', 'robot', 'pirate', 'duck', 'yeti', 'mole', 'newt', 'bear', 'toad', 'hawk']; /** Distinct, valid, readable usernames that don't clash with anyone already in the collection. */ /** * Creates `count` test viewers who have each pulled a number of cards the way the overlay would draw them, so the leaderboard, * card values and scarcity look like a real season. 'realistic' gives a few heavy collectors and many light ones (a long tail); * 'even' spreads pulls evenly between min and max. Everything is drawn in memory and written once, so 100 users is quick. */ /** Every card in the active season with what it is worth right now and why (odds, copies out there). */ // ── Overview, user table and removal ────────────────────── /** Headline numbers for a sandbox (viewers, copies, what is active). */ /** Everyone in the sandbox with their standing in the active season (rank / score), for the Users tab. */ /** Empties these viewers' collections ('clear') or removes them entirely, profile included ('delete'). Returns how many had cards. */

nodes.name: drawOne
nodes.signature: function drawOne(packs: DrawPacks): { card: Card; pack: Pack; variant: Variant }
nodes.body_text: function drawOne(packs: DrawPacks): { card: Card; pack: Pack; variant: Variant } { let r = Math.random() * packs.reduce((s, p) => s + (p.pack.weight || 1), 0); let chosen = packs[packs.length - 1]; for (const p of packs) { r -= p.pack.weight || 1; if (r <= 0) { chosen = p; break; } } let rp = Math.random() * chosen.cards.reduce((s, c) => s + c.probability, 0); let card = chosen.cards[chosen.cards.length - 1]; for (const c of chosen.cards) { rp -= c.probability; if (rp <= 0) { card = c; break; } } const variant: Variant = upgradesAllowed(chosen.pack, card) ? rollVariant(effectiveWeights(chosen.pack, card)) : 'regular'; return { card, pack: chosen.pack, variant }; }

nodes.name: simulatePulls
nodes.signature: function simulatePulls(sandboxId: string, username: string, count: number): Promise<{ pulls: number; byVariant: VariantCounts }>
nodes.body_text: function simulatePulls(sandboxId: string, username: string, count: number): Promise<{ pulls: number; byVariant: VariantCounts }> { return runInSandbox(sandboxId, async () => { const user = cleanTestUsername(username); if (!user) throw new Error('Enter a username.'); const active = await getActiveSeasonWithPacks(); if (!active) throw new Error('This sandbox has no active season. Activate one first.'); const packs = active.packs.filter(p => p.cards.length > 0 && p.pack.active); if (packs.length === 0) throw new Error('No active pack with cards in the active season.'); const n = Math.max(1, Math.min(500, Math.floor(count) || 1)); const byVariant = emptyCounts(); await ensureUserProfile(user); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const { card, variant } = drawOne(packs); await addCollectionEntry(active.season.collectionName, user, encodeEntry(card.number, variant), 'pull'); byVariant[variant]++; } return { pulls: n, byVariant }; }); }

nodes.body_text: function grantCopies(sandboxId: string, username: string, cardNumber: number, variant: Variant, count: number): Promise<number> { return runInSandbox(sandboxId, async () => { const user = cleanTestUsername(username); if (!user) throw new Error('Enter a username.'); if (!VARIANTS.includes(variant)) throw new Error('Unknown variant.'); const active = await getActiveSeasonWithPacks(); if (!active) throw new Error('This sandbox has no active season. Activate one first.'); const exists = active.packs.some(p => p.cards.some(c => c.number === cardNumber)); if (!exists) throw new Error('That card is not in the active season.'); const n = Math.max(1, Math.min(200, Math.floor(count) || 1)); await ensureUserProfile(user); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) await addCollectionEntry(active.season.collectionName, user, encodeEntry(cardNumber, variant), 'grant'); return n; }); }

nodes.name: makeNames
nodes.signature: function makeNames(count: number, taken: Set<string>): string[]
nodes.body_text: function makeNames(count: number, taken: Set<string>): string[] { const names: string[] = []; let guard = 0; while (names.length < count && guard++ < count * 40) { const a = WORDS_A[Math.floor(Math.random() * WORDS_A.length)]; const b = WORDS_B[Math.floor(Math.random() * WORDS_B.length)]; const name = `${a}_${b}${guard > count * 4 ? Math.floor(Math.random() * 90 + 10) : ''}`; if (!taken.has(name)) { taken.add(name); names.push(name); } } for (let i = 0; names.length < count; i++) { const name = `viewer_${taken.size + i}`; if (!taken.has(name)) { taken.add(name); names.push(name); } } return names; }

Activate one first.'); const packs = active.packs.filter(p => p.cards.length > 0 && p.pack.active); if (packs.length === 0) throw new Error('No active pack with cards in the active season.'); const count = Math.max(1, Math.min(300, Math.floor(opts.count) || 1)); const min = Math.max(1, Math.min(2000, Math.floor(opts.minPulls) || 1)); const max = Math.max(min, Math.min(2000, Math.floor(opts.maxPulls) || min)); const collection = active.season.collectionName; const seeded: Record<string, number[]> = {}; const byVariant = emptyCounts(); let pulls = 0, heaviest = 0; const names = makeNames(count, new Set(Object.keys(await getCollection(collection)))); for (const name of names) { const u = Math.random(); const n = Math.round(min + (max - min) * (opts.shape === 'even' ? u : u ** 3)); const entries: number[] = []; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const { card, variant } = drawOne(packs); entries.push(encodeEntry(card.number, variant)); byVariant[variant]++; } seeded[name] = entries; pulls += n; heaviest = Math.max(heaviest, n); } // One locked read-modify-write for everyone. await withCollectionLock(collection, async () => { const data = await getCollection(collection); for (const [name, entries] of Object.entries(seeded)) data[name] = [...(data[name] ?? []), ...entries]; await saveCollection(collection, data); }); return { users: names.length, pulls, byVariant, heaviest }; }); }

nodes.name: listCardValues
nodes.signature: function listCardValues(sandboxId: string): Promise<{ number: number; name: string; stars: number; pack: string; upgrades: boolean; pullRate: number; copies: VariantCounts; values: Record<Variant, number>; }[]>

nodes.name: sandbox.ts
nodes.body_text: import { prodKv, SANDBOX_REGISTRY_KEY, RESERVED_IDS, PREVIEW_ID, forgetSandboxCache } from './db'; // Sandboxes: isolated copies of the app's data for testing (upgrades, and later trading) without touching production. // A sandbox is a key namespace (`sbx:<id>:*`, see lib/db.ts) plus an entry in the registry below. This module is the only // code that uses the raw production client: it creates a sandbox by copying the setup (seasons, packs, cards, overlay and // scoring settings, optionally viewer collections) INTO the namespace, and wipes a namespace with SCAN. It never writes // to an un-prefixed key other than the registry itself. /** Every sandbox is a full namespace of the shared database, so the number is capped. */ export const MAX_SANDBOXES = 10; export const EXPIRY_CHOICES = [0, 7, 30] as const; // days; 0 = never export const SOURCE_LABELS: Record<SandboxSource, string> = { config: 'A copy of production setup (seasons, packs, cards, settings), no viewers', collections: 'A copy of production setup plus every viewer\'s collection', empty: 'Empty (you build everything yourself)', }; /** A URL-safe id from a name, unique among existing sandboxes. */ /** Copies one production key into the sandbox. Missing keys are skipped. */ /** Settings keys copied from production into a sandbox (or the preview namespace), on top of the seasons / packs / cards. One list for both. */ export const SETUP_SETTINGS_KEYS = ['overlay:settings', 'overlay:packprops', 'overlay:presets', 'scoring:settings'] as const; /** Copies production's setup into the namespace. Never copies secrets or outside-world config (Discord, webhooks, sessions). */ /** Copies production's setup into the preview namespace (preview deployments only; `prodKv` is fenced to that namespace there). */ /** Deletes keys in a namespace matching `pattern` (default: all of them) using SCAN. Returns how many were removed. */ /** Wipes the sandbox and copies production's current setup in again. */ /** Removes only viewer data (collections, profiles, activity, logins), keeping the sandbox's setup. */ /** Records that something was done in a sandbox (best effort: a failed write must never block the action itself). */ /** Sets (days > 0) or clears (0) the automatic deletion date, counted from now. */ /** Pure: which sandboxes have passed their expiry. */ /** Deletes every sandbox past its expiry (called lazily when the Sandbox page loads; there is no background job). Returns their names. */ /** How many keys a sandbox holds (a rough size for the list). */ /** Reads one key from production (null when absent). Used only to compare a sandbox against it. */ /** Reads one key from inside a sandbox's namespace. */

nodes.name: SandboxSource
nodes.body_text: type SandboxSource = 'config' | 'collections' | 'empty';

nodes.name: Sandbox
nodes.body_text: interface Sandbox { id: string; name: string; createdAt: number; /** What it was created from; "reset" starts over from the same source. */ source: SandboxSource; /** Last time an admin action ran in it (set by touchSandbox). */ lastUsedAt?: number; /** When set, it is deleted automatically once this time has passed (see sweepExpiredSandboxes). */ expiresAt?: number; }

nodes.name: ns
nodes.body_text: ns = (id: string, key: string) => `sbx:${id}:${key}`

nodes.name: listSandboxes
nodes.body_text: async function listSandboxes(): Promise<Sandbox[]> { const list = ((await prodKv.get<Sandbox[]>(SANDBOX_REGISTRY_KEY)) ?? []).filter(s => !RESERVED_IDS.includes(s.id)); return [...list].sort((a, b) => b.createdAt - a.createdAt); }

nodes.name: getSandbox
nodes.signature: async function getSandbox(id: string): Promise<Sandbox | null>
nodes.body_text: async function getSandbox(id: string): Promise<Sandbox | null> { return (await listSandboxes()).find(s => s.id === id) ?? null; }

nodes.name: saveRegistry
nodes.body_text: async function saveRegistry(list: Sandbox[]) { await prodKv.set(SANDBOX_REGISTRY_KEY, list); forgetSandboxCache(); }

nodes.name: makeId
nodes.signature: function makeId(name: string, takenIds: string[]): string
nodes.body_text: function makeId(name: string, takenIds: string[]): string { const taken = [...takenIds, ...RESERVED_IDS]; // a reserved id (the preview namespace) can never be handed out const base = name.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '').slice(0, 20).replace(/-+$/g, '') || 'sandbox'; const padded = base.length < 3 ? `${base}-box` : base; if (!taken.includes(padded)) return padded; for (let i = 2; i < 100; i++) { const id = `${padded.slice(0, 18)}-${i}`; if (!taken.includes(id)) return id; } return `${padded.slice(0, 14)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`; }

nodes.name: copyKey
nodes.signature: async function copyKey(id: string, key: string): Promise<void>
nodes.body_text: async function copyKey(id: string, key: string): Promise<void> { const value = await prodKv.get(key); if (value !== null && value !== undefined) await prodKv.set(ns(id, key), value); }

nodes.name: cloneFromProduction
nodes.signature: async function cloneFromProduction(id: string, withCollections: boolean): Promise<void>
nodes.body_text: async function cloneFromProduction(id: string, withCollections: boolean): Promise<void> { const seasonIds = (await prodKv.get<string[]>('seasons:list')) ?? []; const packIds = (await prodKv.get<string[]>('packs:list')) ?? []; await copyKey(id, 'seasons:list'); await copyKey(id, 'packs:list'); for (const sid of seasonIds) { await copyKey(id, `season:${sid}`); if (withCollections) { const season = await prodKv.get<{ collectionName?: string }>(`season:${sid}`); if (season?.collectionName) await copyKey(id, `tcg_${season.collectionName}`); } } for (const pid of packIds) { await copyKey(id, `pack:${pid}`); await copyKey(id, `pack:${pid}:cards`); } // Presentation and scoring settings, so the sandbox looks and scores like production. for (const key of SETUP_SETTINGS_KEYS) await copyKey(id, key); }

nodes.name: seedPreviewFromProduction
nodes.body_text: async function seedPreviewFromProduction(withCollections: boolean): Promise<void> { await cloneFromProduction(PREVIEW_ID, withCollections); }

nodes.name: wipeKeys
nodes.signature: async function wipeKeys(id: string, pattern = '*'): Promise<number>
nodes.body_text: async function wipeKeys(id: string, pattern = '*'): Promise<number> { let cursor: string | number = 0; let removed = 0; do { const [next, keys] = (await prodKv.scan(cursor, { match: ns(id, pattern), count: 200 })) as [string | number, string[]]; // Belt and braces: only ever delete keys that really are inside this sandbox's namespace. const mine = keys.filter(k => k.startsWith(`sbx:${id}:`)); if (mine.length > 0) { await prodKv.del(...mine); removed += mine.length; } cursor = next; } while (String(cursor) !== '0'); return removed; }

nodes.name: createSandbox
nodes.signature: async function createSandbox(input: { name: string; source: SandboxSource; expiresInDays?: number }): Promise<Sandbox>
nodes.body_text: async function createSandbox(input: { name: string; source: SandboxSource; expiresInDays?: number }): Promise<Sandbox> { const list = await listSandboxes(); if (list.length >= MAX_SANDBOXES) throw new Error(`You already have ${MAX_SANDBOXES} sandboxes. Delete one first.`); const name = input.name.trim().slice(0, 40) || 'Sandbox'; const days = (EXPIRY_CHOICES as readonly number[]).includes(input.expiresInDays ?? 0) ? input.expiresInDays ?? 0 : 0; const now = Date.now(); const sandbox: Sandbox = { id: makeId(name, list.map(s => s.id)), name, createdAt: now, lastUsedAt: now, source: input.source, ...(days > 0 ? { expiresAt: now + days * 86_400_000 } : {}) }; await saveRegistry([...list, sandbox]); if (input.source !== 'empty') await cloneFromProduction(sandbox.id, input.source === 'collections'); return sandbox; }

nodes.name: resetSandbox
nodes.body_text: async function resetSandbox(id: string): Promise<void> { const sandbox = await getSandbox(id); if (!sandbox) throw new Error('Sandbox not found.'); await wipeKeys(id); if (sandbox.source !== 'empty') await cloneFromProduction(id, sandbox.source === 'collections'); }

nodes.name: resetTestData
nodes.body_text: async function resetTestData(id: string): Promise<number> { let n = 0; for (const pattern of ['tcg_*', 'user:*', 'activity:*', 'twitch_opaque:*', 'lock:*', 'webhooks:queue', 'overlay:clients']) n += await wipeKeys(id, pattern); return n; }

nodes.name: deleteSandbox
nodes.body_text: async function deleteSandbox(id: string): Promise<void> { await wipeKeys(id); await saveRegistry((await listSandboxes()).filter(s => s.id !== id)); }

nodes.name: touchSandbox
nodes.signature: async function touchSandbox(id: string, now = Date.now()): Promise<void>
nodes.body_text: async function touchSandbox(id: string, now = Date.now()): Promise<void> { try { const list = await listSandboxes(); if (!list.some(s => s.id === id)) return; await saveRegistry(list.map(s => (s.id === id ? { ...s, lastUsedAt: now } : s))); } catch { /* ignore */ } }

nodes.name: setSandboxExpiry
nodes.signature: async function setSandboxExpiry(id: string, days: number, now = Date.now()): Promise<void>
nodes.body_text: async function setSandboxExpiry(id: string, days: number, now = Date.now()): Promise<void> { const list = await listSandboxes(); await saveRegistry(list.map(s => { if (s.id !== id) return s; const { expiresAt: _drop, ...rest } = s; void _drop; return days > 0 ? { ...rest, expiresAt: now + days * 86_400_000 } : rest; })); }

nodes.name: expiredSandboxes
nodes.signature: function expiredSandboxes(list: Sandbox[], now = Date.now()): Sandbox[]
nodes.body_text: function expiredSandboxes(list: Sandbox[], now = Date.now()): Sandbox[] { return list.filter(s => typeof s.expiresAt === 'number' && s.expiresAt <= now); }

nodes.name: sweepExpiredSandboxes
nodes.body_text: async function sweepExpiredSandboxes(now = Date.now()): Promise<string[]> { const gone = expiredSandboxes(await listSandboxes(), now); for (const s of gone) await deleteSandbox(s.id); return gone.map(s => s.name); }

nodes.name: countKeys
nodes.body_text: async function countKeys(id: string): Promise<number> { let cursor: string | number = 0; let n = 0; do { const [next, keys] = (await prodKv.scan(cursor, { match: ns(id, '*'), count: 500 })) as [string | number, string[]]; n += keys.filter(k => k.startsWith(`sbx:${id}:`)).length; cursor = next; } while (String(cursor) !== '0'); return n; }

nodes.name: readProduction
nodes.body_text: readProduction = (key: string) => prodKv.get(key)

nodes.name: readSandboxKey
nodes.body_text: readSandboxKey = (id: string, key: string) => prodKv.get(ns(id, key))

nodes.name: score-history-core.ts
nodes.body_text: // Score samples for the My Stats history chart (pure). A sample is stored when the viewer opens My Stats, at most every 30 minutes // and only if something changed (or it has been 6 hours), so the history reads as "from when you started looking". export const SAMPLE_GAP_MS = 30 * 60_000; export const SAMPLE_REFRESH_MS = 6 * 3_600_000; export const HISTORY_CAP = 120; /** Oldest first, one point per sample. */

nodes.name: ScoreSample
nodes.body_text: interface ScoreSample { at: number; score: number; rank: number | null }

nodes.name: shouldSample
nodes.signature: function shouldSample(last: ScoreSample | undefined, next: { score: number; rank: number | null }, now: number): boolean
nodes.body_text: function shouldSample(last: ScoreSample | undefined, next: { score: number; rank: number | null }, now: number): boolean { if (!last) return true; const age = now - last.at; if (age < SAMPLE_GAP_MS) return false; return last.score !== next.score || last.rank !== next.rank || age >= SAMPLE_REFRESH_MS; }

nodes.name: chartPoints
nodes.body_text: function chartPoints(samples: ScoreSample[]): ScoreSample[] { return [...samples].sort((a, b) => a.at - b.at); }

nodes.name: score-history.ts
nodes.body_text: import { kv } from './db'; import { HISTORY_CAP, shouldSample, type ScoreSample } from './score-history-core'; /** Newest first. */ /** Stores a sample when it is worth keeping (see shouldSample). Best effort: never throws. Returns the history including it. */

nodes.name: key
nodes.body_text: key = (u: string, seasonId: string) => `user:${u.toLowerCase()}:scorehist:${seasonId}`

nodes.name: scoring-core.ts
nodes.body_text: // The scoring settings' shape, defaults, limits and sanitising: pure and client-safe (no database). The stored copy lives in ./scoring. /** * Everything that tunes how cards are valued and how the leaderboard is scored. Edited in Admin → Settings → Scoring and * stored in one KV key. The defaults reproduce the original hard-coded behaviour exactly, so an untouched install scores * the same as before. Settings apply to every season's leaderboard immediately (values are always computed live). */ export const DEFAULT_SCORING: ScoringSettings = { baseScore: 10, rarityExponent: 1, serialBonusMax: 3, serialBonusCutoff: 20, upgradeMargin: 1.2, completionBonusPct: 25, completeSetBonusPct: 50, leaderboardSize: 100, }; /** Allowed range for each setting (also used for the form inputs). */ export const SCORING_LIMITS: Record<keyof ScoringSettings, { min: number; max: number; step: number }> = { baseScore: { min: 1, max: 1000, step: 1 }, rarityExponent: { min: 0, max: 3, step: 0.1 }, serialBonusMax: { min: 1, max: 20, step: 0.1 }, serialBonusCutoff: { min: 0, max: 1000, step: 1 }, upgradeMargin: { min: 1, max: 5, step: 0.05 }, completionBonusPct: { min: 0, max: 500, step: 1 }, completeSetBonusPct: { min: 0, max: 1000, step: 1 }, leaderboardSize: { min: 5, max: 500, step: 5 }, }; /** Turns anything (stored data, a form submission) into valid settings: numbers only, clamped to range, defaults for the rest. */ /** * What a copy's serial does to its points: the first copy ever made of a card (in its version) gets `serialBonusMax`×, the * bonus fades in a straight line and is gone after serial `serialBonusCutoff`. No serial (or one past the cutoff) = 1×. */

nodes.name: ScoringSettings
nodes.body_text: interface ScoringSettings { /** Points one Regular copy of an average card (equal pull chance to every other card) is worth. */ baseScore: number; /** How strongly rarity counts: value scales with rarity^exponent. 1 = proportional, <1 flattens, >1 exaggerates. */ rarityExponent: number; /** Serial bonus: copy #1 of a card (in its version) is worth this many times a normal copy; the bonus shrinks steadily with the serial. */ serialBonusMax: number; /** How many serials get a bonus. #1 gets the full bonus, the bonus fades to nothing after this serial. 0 switches it off. */ serialBonusCutoff: number; /** An upgraded copy is guaranteed to be worth at least this many times the copies it consumes. */ upgradeMargin: number; /** Progress bonus at 100% of the set, as a percent of the set value (what one Regular of every card is worth). */ completionBonusPct: number; /** Extra bonus for owning at least one of every card, as a percent of the set value. */ completeSetBonusPct: number; /** How many collectors the leaderboard lists. */ leaderboardSize: number; }

nodes.name: sanitizeScoring
nodes.body_text: function sanitizeScoring(raw: unknown): ScoringSettings { const r = (raw && typeof raw === 'object' ? raw : {}) as Record<string, unknown>; const out = { ...DEFAULT_SCORING }; for (const key of Object.keys(DEFAULT_SCORING) as (keyof ScoringSettings)[]) { const v = typeof r[key] === 'string' && (r[key] as string).trim() !== '' ? Number(r[key]) : r[key]; if (typeof v === 'number' && Number.isFinite(v)) { const { min, max } = SCORING_LIMITS[key]; out[key] = Math.min(max, Math.max(min, v)); } } out.leaderboardSize = Math.round(out.leaderboardSize); out.serialBonusCutoff = Math.round(out.serialBonusCutoff); return out; }

nodes.name: serialMultiplier
nodes.signature: function serialMultiplier(n: number | undefined, s: Pick<ScoringSettings, 'serialBonusMax' | 'serialBonusCutoff'>): number
nodes.body_text: function serialMultiplier(n: number | undefined, s: Pick<ScoringSettings, 'serialBonusMax' | 'serialBonusCutoff'>): number { if (n === undefined || !(n >= 1) || n > s.serialBonusCutoff) return 1; return 1 + (s.serialBonusMax - 1) * (1 - (n - 1) / s.serialBonusCutoff); }

nodes.name: scoring-preview.ts
nodes.body_text: import { buildLeaderboard, collectionBonuses, computeSeasonValues, type LeaderboardRow } from './leaderboard'; import { sanitizeScoring, type ScoringSettings } from './scoring'; import type { SerialIndex } from './serials-core'; import type { Card, Pack } from './types'; // "What would these scoring numbers do?" Recomputes the active season with the saved settings and with the candidate ones // side by side, so an admin sees the effect before saving (scoring is global: saving re-scores every season at once). // Pure: pass in the season's packs and collection. const COMPARE = 20;

nodes.name: PreviewSide
nodes.body_text: interface PreviewSide { setValue: number; topScore: number; maxCardValue: number; completionAtFull: number; completeSetBonus: number; top: { username: string; score: number; rank: number }[]; }

nodes.name: ScoringPreview
nodes.body_text: interface ScoringPreview { saved: PreviewSide; candidate: PreviewSide; candidateSettings: ScoringSettings; /** The top viewers with their rank under each, for the movers list. */ movers: { username: string; savedRank: number; candidateRank: number; savedScore: number; candidateScore: number }[]; /** How many of the compared viewers change rank. */ rankChanges: number; viewers: number; }

nodes.name: side
nodes.signature: function side(rows: LeaderboardRow[], values: ReturnType<typeof computeSeasonValues>): PreviewSide
nodes.body_text: function side(rows: LeaderboardRow[], values: ReturnType<typeof computeSeasonValues>): PreviewSide { const bonus = collectionBonuses(values, values.totalCards); let max = 0; for (const v of values.cards.values()) max = Math.max(max, v.values.regular, v.values.reverse, v.values.full, v.values.shiny); return { setValue: values.setValue, topScore: rows[0]?.score ?? 0, maxCardValue: max, completionAtFull: bonus.completion, completeSetBonus: bonus.set, top: rows.slice(0, 5).map((r, i) => ({ username: r.username, score: r.score, rank: i + 1 })), }; }

nodes.name: previewScoring
nodes.signature: function previewScoring( packs: { pack: Pack; cards: Card[] }[], collection: Record<string, number[]>, saved: ScoringSettings, candidateRaw: unknown, hidden: Set<string> = new Set(), serials: SerialIndex | null = null, ): ScoringPreview
nodes.body_text: function previewScoring( packs: { pack: Pack; cards: Card[] }[], collection: Record<string, number[]>, saved: ScoringSettings, candidateRaw: unknown, hidden: Set<string> = new Set(), serials: SerialIndex | null = null, ): ScoringPreview { const candidateSettings = sanitizeScoring(candidateRaw); const sv = computeSeasonValues(packs, collection, saved, serials); const cv = computeSeasonValues(packs, collection, candidateSettings, serials); const sRows = buildLeaderboard(sv, collection).filter(r => !hidden.has(r.username)); const cRows = buildLeaderboard(cv, collection).filter(r => !hidden.has(r.username)); const cRank = new Map(cRows.map((r, i) => [r.username, { rank: i + 1, score: r.score }])); const movers = sRows.slice(0, COMPARE).map((r, i) => ({ username: r.username, savedRank: i + 1, savedScore: r.score, candidateRank: cRank.get(r.username)?.rank ?? i + 1, candidateScore: cRank.get(r.username)?.score ?? r.score, })); return { saved: side(sRows, sv), candidate: side(cRows, cv), candidateSettings, movers, rankChanges: movers.filter(m => m.savedRank !== m.candidateRank).length, viewers: sRows.length, }; }

nodes.name: season-wrap.ts
nodes.body_text: import { kv } from './db'; import { getCollection, getPacksForSeason, getPackCards, getSeason, listSeasons, saveSeason, setActiveSeason, withLock } from './kv'; import { getSeasonLeaderboard, type LeaderboardRow } from './leaderboard'; import { uniqueCount } from './collection'; import { decodeEntry } from './variants'; import type { Card, Season } from './types'; import type { IconName } from '@/app/components/Icon'; // Season lifecycle on the server: live stats for a season, the wrap-up snapshot (final standings + awards), ending / reopening a // season, activating one (which wraps up the one it replaces), and the lazy scheduler for start / end dates (no background job: // kv.getActiveSeason() runs applySeasonSchedule() the first time anything asks after a date has passed). /** Cards in the season's published packs. */ // ── Wrap-up snapshot ── const STANDINGS_CAP = 100; /** Awards from the final standings: podium places, completionists and the biggest collectors. Pure, so it is testable. */ /** Computes and stores the final standings and awards for a season (replacing an earlier snapshot). */ // ── Lifecycle ── const LOCK = 'season-lifecycle'; /** Ends a season: takes the snapshot, deactivates it, marks it ended and (by default) freezes trading for it. */ /** Undo an end: clears the ended mark and the trading freeze. It does not activate the season. */ /** Makes a season the active one. The season it replaces is wrapped up first (snapshot + ended + trading frozen). */ /** Applies due start / end dates. Safe to call often: it does nothing unless a date has passed. */ /** Awards a viewer has earned across seasons (newest season first). */ /** What activating a season will do, and what might be wrong with it, for the confirmation dialog. */

nodes.name: SeasonStats
nodes.body_text: interface SeasonStats { viewers: number; copies: number; pool: number; found: number; complete: number; avgCompletion: number; top: { username: string; unique: number } | null; /** Days between the season's start (its start date, else creation) and its end (or now). */ days: number; }

nodes.name: seasonCards
nodes.body_text: async function seasonCards(season: Season): Promise<Card[]> { const packs = (await getPacksForSeason(season)).filter(p => p.status === 'published'); return (await Promise.all(packs.map(p => getPackCards(p.id)))).flat(); }

nodes.name: getSeasonStats
nodes.body_text: async function getSeasonStats(season: Season): Promise<SeasonStats> { const [collection, cards] = await Promise.all([getCollection(season.collectionName), seasonCards(season)]); const users = Object.entries(collection); const pool = cards.length; const foundSet = new Set<number>(); let copies = 0; let complete = 0; let top: SeasonStats['top'] = null; let uniqueSum = 0; for (const [username, entries] of users) { copies += entries.length; for (const e of entries) foundSet.add(decodeEntry(e).cardNumber); const u = uniqueCount(entries); uniqueSum += u; if (pool > 0 && u >= pool) complete++; if (!top || u > top.unique) top = { username, unique: u }; } const start = season.startsAt ?? season.createdAt; const end = season.endedAt ?? Date.now(); return { viewers: users.length, copies, pool, found: foundSet.size, complete, avgCompletion: users.length > 0 && pool > 0 ? Math.round((uniqueSum / users.length / pool) * 100) : 0, top, days: Math.max(1, Math.ceil((end - start) / 86_400_000)), }; }

nodes.name: Award
nodes.body_text: interface Award { id: string; title: string; icon: IconName; username: string; detail: string }

nodes.name: SnapshotRow
nodes.body_text: interface SnapshotRow { username: string; score: number; cardPoints: number; uniqueCards: number; copies: number; complete: boolean; /** The split of the bonuses and the copies per version, kept so the final board can show the same breakdown as the live one. Snapshots taken before these existed lack them. */ completionBonus?: number; setBonus?: number; variants?: { regular: number; reverse: number; full: number; shiny: number }; }

nodes.name: SeasonSnapshot
nodes.body_text: interface SeasonSnapshot { at: number; seasonName: string; stats: Pick<SeasonStats, 'viewers' | 'copies' | 'pool' | 'found' | 'complete'>; standings: SnapshotRow[]; awards: Award[]; }

nodes.name: snapKey
nodes.body_text: snapKey = (id: string) => `season:${id}:wrap`

nodes.name: buildAwards
nodes.body_text: function buildAwards(rows: LeaderboardRow[]): Award[] { const out: Award[] = []; const podium: [string, string, IconName][] = [['champion', 'Champion', 'trophy'], ['runner-up', 'Runner-up', 'medal'], ['third', 'Third place', 'medal']]; rows.slice(0, 3).forEach((r, i) => out.push({ id: podium[i][0], title: podium[i][1], icon: podium[i][2], username: r.username, detail: `${r.score.toLocaleString()} points` })); for (const r of rows.filter(x => x.complete).slice(0, 10)) out.push({ id: 'completionist', title: 'Completionist', icon: 'cheese', username: r.username, detail: 'Owned every card' }); const best = <T,>(pick: (r: LeaderboardRow) => number, min = 1): LeaderboardRow | null => { let top: LeaderboardRow | null = null; for (const r of rows) if (pick(r) >= min && (!top || pick(r) > pick(top))) top = r; return top; }; const mostCards = best(r => r.uniqueCards); if (mostCards) out.push({ id: 'most-cards', title: 'Biggest collection', icon: 'cards', username: mostCards.username, detail: `${mostCards.uniqueCards} different cards` }); const mostPulls = best(r => r.copies); if (mostPulls) out.push({ id: 'most-pulls', title: 'Most cards pulled', icon: 'zap', username: mostPulls.username, detail: `${mostPulls.copies.toLocaleString()} prints` }); const shiny = best(r => r.variants.shiny); if (shiny) out.push({ id: 'shiny-hunter', title: 'Shiny hunter', icon: 'sparkles', username: shiny.username, detail: `${shiny.variants.shiny} Shiny` }); const full = best(r => r.variants.full); if (full) out.push({ id: 'full-art', title: 'Full Art collector', icon: 'gem', username: full.username, detail: `${full.variants.full} Full Art` }); return out; }

nodes.name: best
nodes.signature: best = <T,>(pick: (r: LeaderboardRow) => number, min = 1): LeaderboardRow | null
nodes.body_text: best = <T,>(pick: (r: LeaderboardRow) => number, min = 1): LeaderboardRow | null => { let top: LeaderboardRow | null = null; for (const r of rows) if (pick(r) >= min && (!top || pick(r) > pick(top))) top = r; return top; }

nodes.name: getSnapshot
nodes.signature: async function getSnapshot(seasonId: string): Promise<SeasonSnapshot | null>
nodes.body_text: async function getSnapshot(seasonId: string): Promise<SeasonSnapshot | null> { try { return (await kv.get<SeasonSnapshot>(snapKey(seasonId))) ?? null; } catch { return null; } }

nodes.name: takeSnapshot
nodes.body_text: async function takeSnapshot(season: Season): Promise<SeasonSnapshot> { const [board, stats] = await Promise.all([getSeasonLeaderboard(season), getSeasonStats(season)]); const snapshot: SeasonSnapshot = { at: Date.now(), seasonName: season.name, stats: { viewers: stats.viewers, copies: stats.copies, pool: stats.pool, found: stats.found, complete: stats.complete }, standings: board.rows.slice(0, STANDINGS_CAP).map(r => ({ username: r.username, score: r.score, cardPoints: r.cardPoints, uniqueCards: r.uniqueCards, copies: r.copies, complete: r.complete, completionBonus: r.completionBonus, setBonus: r.setBonus, variants: r.variants })), awards: buildAwards(board.rows), }; await kv.set(snapKey(season.id), snapshot); return snapshot; }

nodes.name: endSeason
nodes.signature: async function endSeason(id: string, opts: { freezeTrading?: boolean } = {}): Promise<{ ok: true; snapshot: SeasonSnapshot } | { ok: false; error: string }>
nodes.body_text: async function endSeason(id: string, opts: { freezeTrading?: boolean } = {}): Promise<{ ok: true; snapshot: SeasonSnapshot } | { ok: false; error: string }> { return withLock(LOCK, async () => { const season = await getSeason(id); if (!season || season.status !== 'published') return { ok: false as const, error: 'Only a published season can be ended.' }; const snapshot = await takeSnapshot(season); await saveSeason({ ...season, active: false, endedAt: Date.now(), tradingFrozen: opts.freezeTrading === false ? season.tradingFrozen : true, autoStart: undefined }); return { ok: true as const, snapshot }; }); }

nodes.name: reopenSeason
nodes.body_text: async function reopenSeason(id: string): Promise<void> { await withLock(LOCK, async () => { const season = await getSeason(id); if (!season) return; await saveSeason({ ...season, endedAt: undefined, tradingFrozen: undefined }); }); }

nodes.name: activateWithWrapUp
nodes.signature: async function activateWithWrapUp(id: string): Promise<{ ok: true; replaced?: string } | { ok: false; error: string }>
nodes.body_text: async function activateWithWrapUp(id: string): Promise<{ ok: true; replaced?: string } | { ok: false; error: string }> { return withLock(LOCK, async () => { const target = await getSeason(id); if (!target) return { ok: false as const, error: 'That season no longer exists.' }; if (target.status === 'draft') return { ok: false as const, error: 'Publish the season first.' }; const seasons = await listSeasons(); const outgoing = seasons.find(s => s.active && s.id !== id && !s.endedAt); if (outgoing) { const snapshot = await takeSnapshot(outgoing); void snapshot; await saveSeason({ ...outgoing, active: false, endedAt: Date.now(), tradingFrozen: true, autoStart: undefined }); } // Starting (or restarting) a season clears any ended mark and freeze on it. await saveSeason({ ...target, endedAt: undefined, tradingFrozen: undefined, autoStart: undefined }); await setActiveSeason(id); return { ok: true as const, replaced: outgoing?.name }; }); }

nodes.name: applySeasonSchedule
nodes.body_text: async function applySeasonSchedule(): Promise<void> { const now = Date.now(); const due = (list: Season[]) => ({ starts: list.filter(s => s.status === 'published' && !s.active && s.autoStart && !s.endedAt && s.startsAt !== undefined && s.startsAt <= now && (s.endsAt === undefined || s.endsAt > now)).sort((a, b) => (a.startsAt ?? 0) - (b.startsAt ?? 0)), ends: list.filter(s => s.status === 'published' && s.active && !s.endedAt && s.endsAt !== undefined && s.endsAt <= now), }); const first = due(await listSeasons()); if (first.starts.length === 0 && first.ends.length === 0) return; // Work from a fresh read so two requests racing here don't both act. const { starts, ends } = due(await listSeasons()); const next = starts[starts.length - 1]; // the latest start that is due wins if (next) await activateWithWrapUp(next.id); for (const s of ends) if (s.id !== next?.id) await endSeason(s.id, { freezeTrading: true }); }

nodes.name: getUserAwards
nodes.signature: async function getUserAwards(username: string): Promise<{ seasonId: string; seasonName: string; award: Award }[]>
nodes.body_text: async function getUserAwards(username: string): Promise<{ seasonId: string; seasonName: string; award: Award }[]> { const name = username.toLowerCase(); const seasons = (await listSeasons()).sort((a, b) => b.createdAt - a.createdAt); const snaps = await Promise.all(seasons.map(async s => ({ s, snap: await getSnapshot(s.id) }))); return snaps.flatMap(({ s, snap }) => (snap?.awards ?? []).filter(a => a.username.toLowerCase() === name).map(award => ({ seasonId: s.id, seasonName: s.name, award }))); }

nodes.name: ActivationPreview
nodes.body_text: interface ActivationPreview { /** The season that will be wrapped up when this one goes live. */ outgoing: { id: string; name: string; viewers: number; copies: number } | null; /** Things worth knowing before switching. */ warnings: string[]; }

nodes.name: getActivationPreview
nodes.body_text: async function getActivationPreview(season: Season): Promise<ActivationPreview> { const [seasons, packs] = await Promise.all([listSeasons(), getPacksForSeason(season)]); const warnings: string[] = []; const live = packs.filter(p => p.status === 'published' && p.active); if (packs.length === 0) warnings.push('This season has no packs, so nothing could be drawn.'); else if (live.length === 0) warnings.push('None of its packs are published and active, so nothing could be drawn.'); for (const p of live) { const cards = await getPackCards(p.id); if (cards.length === 0) warnings.push(`${p.name} has no cards.`); else { const noArt = cards.filter(c => !c.imageUrl).length; const noOdds = cards.filter(c => !(c.probability > 0)).length; if (noArt > 0) warnings.push(`${p.name}: ${noArt} card${noArt === 1 ? ' has' : 's have'} no image.`); if (noOdds > 0) warnings.push(`${p.name}: ${noOdds} card${noOdds === 1 ? ' has' : 's have'} 0 odds and can never be pulled.`); } } if (season.endsAt !== undefined && season.endsAt <= Date.now()) warnings.push('Its end date has already passed, so it would be wrapped up again straight away.'); const out = seasons.find(s => s.active && s.id !== season.id && !s.endedAt); let outgoing: ActivationPreview['outgoing'] = null; if (out) { const stats = await getSeasonStats(out); outgoing = { id: out.id, name: out.name, viewers: stats.viewers, copies: stats.copies }; } return { outgoing, warnings }; }

nodes.body_text: import { SITE_URL, CHANNEL_NAME } from './site'; // Search and sharing basics (pure): the site description, which pages belong in the sitemap, and what robots may crawl. // scripts/check-public-meta.mts verifies every public page has a title and is either listed here or deliberately excluded. export const SITE_NAME = 'The Cheesy TCG'; export const SITE_DESCRIPTION = `A cheesy collectible card game played live on the ${CHANNEL_NAME} Twitch channel. Pull cards, collect every variant, climb the leaderboard.`; /** Public pages that belong in search results. */ export const INDEXED_PATHS: { path: string; priority: number; changeFrequency: 'hourly' | 'daily' | 'weekly' | 'monthly' }[] = [ { path: '/', priority: 1, changeFrequency: 'hourly' }, { path: '/leaderboard', priority: 0.9, changeFrequency: 'hourly' }, { path: '/cards', priority: 0.8, changeFrequency: 'daily' }, { path: '/stats', priority: 0.7, changeFrequency: 'hourly' }, { path: '/collection', priority: 0.6, changeFrequency: 'weekly' }, { path: '/faq', priority: 0.7, changeFrequency: 'monthly' }, { path: '/changelog', priority: 0.4, changeFrequency: 'weekly' }, { path: '/install', priority: 0.4, changeFrequency: 'monthly' }, { path: '/privacy', priority: 0.2, changeFrequency: 'monthly' }, { path: '/terms', priority: 0.2, changeFrequency: 'monthly' }, ]; /** The public pages that stay reachable (and listed) while the site is closed to testers. */ export const OPEN_WHEN_CLOSED = ['/privacy', '/terms']; /** Pages that exist but must stay out of search (signed-in, admin, utility). Anything not here or in INDEXED_PATHS fails the check. */ export const NOINDEX_PATHS = ['/account', '/settings', '/notifications', '/feedback', '/trade', '/trade/new', '/trade/[id]', '/auth/error', '/closed', '/login', '/admin', '/mod', '/offline', '/email-status']; /** Entries for the sitemap: the fixed pages plus one leaderboard per published season. */ /** What crawlers may not visit. */ export const DISALLOWED_PATHS = ['/admin', '/mod', '/api/', '/auth/', '/login', '/account', '/trade', '/overlay.html', '/twitch-panel/']; export const siteUrl = SITE_URL;
