nodes.name: buildSitemap
nodes.signature: function buildSitemap(base: string, seasons: { id: string; status?: string; createdAt?: number }[], now = new Date(), closed = false): SitemapEntry[]
nodes.body_text: function buildSitemap(base: string, seasons: { id: string; status?: string; createdAt?: number }[], now = new Date(), closed = false): SitemapEntry[] { const root = base.replace(/\/$/, ''); // While the site is closed (alpha / beta), only the pages that stay open to everyone are listed. if (closed) return INDEXED_PATHS.filter(p => OPEN_WHEN_CLOSED.includes(p.path)).map(p => ({ url: `${root}${p.path}`, lastModified: now, changeFrequency: p.changeFrequency, priority: p.priority })); const fixed = INDEXED_PATHS.map(p => ({ url: `${root}${p.path === '/' ? '' : p.path}`, lastModified: now, changeFrequency: p.changeFrequency, priority: p.priority })); const boards = seasons .filter(s => s.status !== 'draft') .map(s => ({ url: `${root}/leaderboard/${s.id}`, lastModified: s.createdAt ? new Date(s.createdAt) : now, changeFrequency: 'daily' as const, priority: 0.5 })); return [...fixed, ...boards]; }

nodes.name: serials-core.ts
nodes.body_text: import { VARIANTS, decodeEntry, encodeEntry } from './variants'; import type { Variant } from './types'; // Card serials (client-safe, pure). Every copy of a card has an identity: the card, its version and a number that counts up per // card AND version ("Shiny Gouda Goat #3" is the third Shiny of that card ever made). The ledger that stores copies is in // lib/serials.ts; the decisions (which copy to mint, move or retire) are made here so they can be checked without a database. export const EVENT_CAP = 40; export const ESCROW_PREFIX = 'escrow:'; /** An entry's card + version as a collection entry (see lib/variants.ts). */ /** How many of each entry a collection array holds. */ /** Entries whose count differs between two arrays (the users a save really changed). */ /** The newest `k` copies (highest number first). Trades and removals take these, so a collector keeps their low numbers. */ /** What it takes to make the ledger's copies match what a collection array really holds. */ /** Appends an event, keeping the history short (the first event, "minted", always stays). */ export const ORIGIN_LABELS: Record<Origin, string> = { pull: 'Pulled live on stream', grant: 'Given as a gift', upgrade: 'Forged in an upgrade', estimated: 'Existed before editions were numbered (numbered later)', other: 'Added to the collection', }; /** "pulled by", "given to", ...: how to say who a copy first belonged to, by how it came to exist (a numbered-later copy was not necessarily pulled). */ export const ORIGIN_BY: Record<Origin, string> = { pull: 'pulled by', grant: 'given to', upgrade: 'forged by', estimated: 'first held by', other: 'added to' }; /** The one-word label for when a copy came into being, by how it did ("Pulled", not "Created": a copy is pulled, given or forged). */ export const ORIGIN_VERB: Record<Origin, string> = { pull: 'Pulled', grant: 'Given', upgrade: 'Forged', estimated: 'First recorded', other: 'Added' }; export const EVENT_LABELS: Record<CopyEventType, string> = { minted: 'Created', escrowed: 'Put up in a trade offer', returned: 'Came back from a trade offer', traded: 'Traded', upgraded: 'Spent in an upgrade', removed: 'Removed from the collection', reversed: 'Returned by staff (trade reversed)', }; /** "Shiny Full Art #3" without the card name, for chips. */ /** * The serial numbers each viewer holds right now, for scoring: owner -> entry (card + version) -> serials, lowest first. Copies in an * open trade offer (escrow) are left out, like they are everywhere in the score. `minted` is how many of each entry were ever made, * so the next copy of it will be `minted + 1`. */ /** Serials by collection entry (card + version), lowest first: what one holder or one offer's escrow has. */ /** Builds the scoring view from the ledger's id -> owner index and its minted counters. */ export { decodeEntry }; /** Unique copy numbers start here, so they are all the same length ("#1000001"). */ export const UID_BASE = 1_000_000; /** "#1023381", or '' for a copy without one. */ /** A typed query as a unique copy number ("#1023381", "1023381"), or null. Only 7-9 digit numbers qualify, so card numbers and short digits never match. */

nodes.name: Origin
nodes.body_text: type Origin = 'pull' | 'grant' | 'upgrade' | 'estimated' | 'other';

nodes.name: CopyEventType
nodes.body_text: type CopyEventType = 'minted' | 'escrowed' | 'returned' | 'traded' | 'upgraded' | 'removed' | 'reversed';

nodes.name: CopyEvent
nodes.body_text: interface CopyEvent { t: number; type: CopyEventType; who?: string; to?: string; note?: string }

nodes.name: Copy
nodes.body_text: interface Copy { /** "<card>.<variant index>.<n>", safe in URLs. */ id: string; /** The copy's unique number across every season ("#1023381"): how it is referred to, searched and linked (`/c/<uid>`). Absent on copies made before unique numbers existed until the next "Number existing copies" run. The edition number `n` below is what earns the points bonus. */ uid?: number; card: number; variant: Variant; /** Which copy of this card in this version it was (1 = the first ever made). */ n: number; owner: string; at: number; origin: Origin; /** Numbered after the fact (copies that existed before serials): the order within a version is a best guess. */ est?: boolean; /** For an upgrade: the copies that were spent to make this one. */ madeFrom?: string[]; ev: CopyEvent[]; }

nodes.name: copyId
nodes.signature: copyId = (card: number, variant: Variant, n: number)
nodes.body_text: copyId = (card: number, variant: Variant, n: number) => `${card}.${VARIANTS.indexOf(variant)}.${n}`

nodes.name: parseCopyId
nodes.signature: function parseCopyId(id: string): { card: number; variant: Variant; n: number } | null
nodes.body_text: function parseCopyId(id: string): { card: number; variant: Variant; n: number } | null { const m = /^(\d{1,6})\.([0-3])\.(\d{1,9})$/.exec(id); if (!m) return null; return { card: Number(m[1]), variant: VARIANTS[Number(m[2])], n: Number(m[3]) }; }

nodes.name: escrowOwner
nodes.body_text: escrowOwner = (tradeId: string) => `${ESCROW_PREFIX}${tradeId}`

nodes.name: isEscrow
nodes.body_text: isEscrow = (owner: string) => owner.startsWith(ESCROW_PREFIX)

nodes.name: entryOf
nodes.body_text: entryOf = (c: { card: number; variant: Variant }) => encodeEntry(c.card, c.variant)

nodes.name: countEntries
nodes.body_text: function countEntries(owned: number[]): Map<number, number> { const m = new Map<number, number>(); for (const e of owned) m.set(e, (m.get(e) ?? 0) + 1); return m; }

nodes.name: sameCollection
nodes.signature: function sameCollection(a: number[] | undefined, b: number[] | undefined): boolean
nodes.body_text: function sameCollection(a: number[] | undefined, b: number[] | undefined): boolean { const x = a ?? [], y = b ?? []; if (x.length !== y.length) return false; const cx = countEntries(x), cy = countEntries(y); for (const [k, n] of cx) if (cy.get(k) !== n) return false; return true; }

nodes.name: newestFirst
nodes.signature: function newestFirst(copies: Copy[], k: number): Copy[]
nodes.body_text: function newestFirst(copies: Copy[], k: number): Copy[] { return [...copies].sort((a, b) => b.n - a.n || b.at - a.at).slice(0, Math.max(0, k)); }

nodes.name: Reconcile
nodes.body_text: interface Reconcile { mint: Map<number, number>; retire: Map<number, number> }

nodes.name: diffCounts
nodes.signature: function diffCounts(have: Map<number, number>, want: Map<number, number>): Reconcile
nodes.body_text: function diffCounts(have: Map<number, number>, want: Map<number, number>): Reconcile { const mint = new Map<number, number>(), retire = new Map<number, number>(); for (const [e, w] of want) { const h = have.get(e) ?? 0; if (w > h) mint.set(e, w - h); } for (const [e, h] of have) { const w = want.get(e) ?? 0; if (h > w) retire.set(e, h - w); } return { mint, retire }; }

nodes.name: withEvent
nodes.signature: function withEvent(c: Copy, e: CopyEvent): Copy
nodes.body_text: function withEvent(c: Copy, e: CopyEvent): Copy { const ev = [...c.ev, e]; return { ...c, ev: ev.length > EVENT_CAP ? [ev[0], ...ev.slice(ev.length - (EVENT_CAP - 1))] : ev }; }

nodes.name: serialLabel
nodes.signature: serialLabel = (c: { variant: Variant; n: number }, labels: Record<Variant, string>)
nodes.body_text: serialLabel = (c: { variant: Variant; n: number }, labels: Record<Variant, string>) => `${c.variant === 'regular' ? '' : `${labels[c.variant]} `}#${c.n}`

nodes.name: SerialIndex
nodes.body_text: interface SerialIndex { held: Map<string, Map<number, number[]>>; /** Copies held by open trade offers: trade id -> entry -> serials. They score nothing while there, but price the offer's give side. */ escrow: Map<string, Map<number, number[]>>; minted: Map<number, number>; }

nodes.name: SerialPool
nodes.body_text: type SerialPool = Record<number, number[]>;

nodes.name: poolOf
nodes.body_text: poolOf = (m: Map<number, number[]> | undefined): SerialPool => Object.fromEntries(m ?? [])

nodes.name: buildSerialIndex
nodes.signature: function buildSerialIndex(idx: Record<string, string>, minted: Map<number, number>): SerialIndex
nodes.body_text: function buildSerialIndex(idx: Record<string, string>, minted: Map<number, number>): SerialIndex { const held = new Map<string, Map<number, number[]>>(); const escrow = new Map<string, Map<number, number[]>>(); for (const [id, owner] of Object.entries(idx)) { const inEscrow = isEscrow(owner); const p = parseCopyId(id); if (!p) continue; const [bucket, who] = inEscrow ? [escrow, owner.slice(ESCROW_PREFIX.length)] : [held, owner]; const byEntry = bucket.get(who) ?? new Map<number, number[]>(); const e = encodeEntry(p.card, p.variant); byEntry.set(e, [...(byEntry.get(e) ?? []), p.n]); bucket.set(who, byEntry); } for (const bucket of [held, escrow]) for (const byEntry of bucket.values()) for (const list of byEntry.values()) list.sort((a, b) => a - b); return { held, escrow, minted }; }

nodes.name: uidLabel
nodes.body_text: uidLabel = (uid?: number) => (uid ? `#${uid}` : '')

nodes.name: parseUid
nodes.body_text: function parseUid(raw: string): number | null { const m = /^#?\s*(\d{7,9})$/.exec(raw.trim()); if (!m) return null; const n = Number(m[1]); return n > UID_BASE ? n : null; }

nodes.name: serials-view.ts
nodes.body_text: import { isEscrow, parseUid, type Copy, type Origin } from './serials-core'; // Pure helpers for the admin Prints screen (/admin/serials): what a typed search means, which filters a view carries, and what a // "return to the list" address may be. No database here, so scripts/check-serials-view.mts can cover them. /** A typed search: a print number ("#1023381" or "1023381"), or free text (a login or a card name, decided by the page). */ export const ORIGINS: Origin[] = ['pull', 'grant', 'upgrade', 'estimated', 'other']; /** Editions of one card version, oldest first (the order chips are drawn in), narrowed by holder ("retired" and "offer" are holders too) and origin. */ /** Where an action may send the admin back to: only the Prints list itself (a query on /admin/serials), never another address. */ /** The same list address with the open print and any message changed. */

nodes.name: PrintSearch
nodes.signature: type PrintSearch = | { kind: 'none' } | { kind: 'uid'; uid: number } | { kind: 'text'; text: string };
nodes.body_text: type PrintSearch = | { kind: 'none' } | { kind: 'uid'; uid: number } | { kind: 'text'; text: string };

nodes.name: parsePrintSearch
nodes.body_text: function parsePrintSearch(raw: string | undefined): PrintSearch { const q = (raw ?? '').trim().slice(0, 60); if (!q) return { kind: 'none' }; const uid = parseUid(q); return uid ? { kind: 'uid', uid } : { kind: 'text', text: q }; }

nodes.name: parseOrigin
nodes.body_text: parseOrigin = (v: string | undefined): Origin | '' => (ORIGINS as string[]).includes(v ?? '') ? (v as Origin) : ''

nodes.name: cleanHolder
nodes.body_text: cleanHolder = (v: string | undefined) => (v ?? '').trim().replace(/^@/, '').toLowerCase().slice(0, 40)

nodes.name: filterEditions
nodes.signature: function filterEditions(copies: Copy[], f: { holder?: string; origin?: Origin | '' }): Copy[]
nodes.body_text: function filterEditions(copies: Copy[], f: { holder?: string; origin?: Origin | '' }): Copy[] { const holder = cleanHolder(f.holder); return copies .filter(c => { if (f.origin && c.origin !== f.origin) return false; if (!holder) return true; if (holder === 'retired') return !c.owner; if (holder === 'offer') return !!c.owner && isEscrow(c.owner); return c.owner === holder; }) .sort((a, b) => a.n - b.n); }

nodes.name: safeSerialsReturn
nodes.body_text: function safeSerialsReturn(raw: unknown): string | null { if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.length > 600) return null; if (!/^\/admin\/serials\?[A-Za-z0-9_=&%.+~#-]*$/.test(raw)) return null; return raw; }

nodes.name: withParams
nodes.signature: function withParams(base: string, set: Record<string, string | undefined>): string
nodes.body_text: function withParams(base: string, set: Record<string, string | undefined>): string { const [path, query = ''] = base.split('?'); const q = new URLSearchParams(query); for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(set)) { if (v) q.set(k, v); else q.delete(k); } const s = q.toString(); return s ? `${path}?${s}` : path; }

nodes.name: serials.ts
nodes.body_text: import { kv } from './db'; import { buildSerialIndex, diffCounts, copyId, parseCopyId, countEntries, entryOf, escrowOwner, isEscrow, newestFirst, sameCollection, withEvent, UID_BASE, type Copy, type CopyEvent, type Origin, type SerialIndex, type SerialPool, } from './serials-core'; import { decodeEntry, encodeEntry } from './variants'; import type { Variant } from './types'; // The copy ledger (server). Collections stay exactly as they were (an array of entries per viewer); the ledger sits beside them and // gives each copy an identity. Every write to a collection goes through saveCollection (lib/kv.ts), which calls syncAfterSave here, so // the ledger can't drift: it mints for what was added, retires what was removed, and follows copies that a trade or upgrade moves. // // KV layout, per collection name: // copies:<c>:o:<owner> hash copy id -> Copy (the owner is a viewer, or "escrow:<tradeId>" while an offer is open) // copies:<c>:idx hash copy id -> owner (find any live copy) // copies:<c>:n hash entry -> count (how many were ever made of each card + version: the next serial) // copies:<c>:ret hash copy id -> Copy (retired copies keep their history) // copies:<c>:init flag set once existing copies have been numbered; until then nothing is tracked // copies:uid:seq hash n -> how many unique numbers were handed out, game-wide (the next unique number is UID_BASE + that + 1) // copies:uid:idx hash unique number -> "<collection>|<copy id>" (find any copy from its number, live or retired) const key = { owner: (c: string, o: string) => `copies:${c}:o:${o}`, idx: (c: string) => `copies:${c}:idx`, n: (c: string) => `copies:${c}:n`, ret: (c: string) => `copies:${c}:ret`, init: (c: string) => `copies:${c}:init`, uidSeq: 'copies:uid:seq', uidIdx: 'copies:uid:idx', }; /** A move that keeps a copy's identity: `to` / `from` is a viewer or an escrow owner. */ /** One copy by id (live or retired). */ /** How many of each card + version were ever made (the serial counter), keyed by entry. */ /** The serials everyone holds, for scoring. null while the collection's copies are not numbered yet (then no serial bonus applies). */ /** The serials one owner (a viewer or an escrow) holds right now, by entry, lowest first. Empty while the collection is not tracked. */ /** * One page of the copies of a card in one version, by serial number (they are numbered 1..made with none skipped, so a page is just * a range of ids). Live and retired copies both come back; `owner` is '' for a retired one. Newest first unless `oldestFirst`. */ /** How many live copies (in collections or offers) exist of each card + version, by entry. */ /** The serial number the most recently made copy of this card + version got (null while the collection is not numbered). Read under the collection lock, it is the copy just made. */ /** The copy most recently made of this card + version (id, unique number, serial), or nulls while the collection is not numbered. Read under the collection lock, it is the copy just made. */ /** Every live copy of one card + version (all owners, escrow included), for "who holds the other numbers". */ /** Hands out `count` unique numbers (consecutive); returns the first, or 0 when the counter could not be reached (the copies are then made without one). */ /** Hands copies from one owner to another, keeping their identity. Returns how many actually moved (the ledger may hold fewer). */ /** Makes the ledger match one viewer's collection: mint what they have that it lacks, retire what it holds that they no longer have. */ /** * Called by saveCollection after it wrote `after`. Does nothing until the collection's existing copies have been numbered * (backfillSerials), because new serials would otherwise jump the queue. Never throws: a ledger problem must not fail a pull. */ /** * Numbers every copy that exists now (once per collection). The order is a best guess: viewers in the order the collection stores * them, each viewer's copies in the order they were added, so numbers within a version are estimates (marked `est`). New copies * are exact from this point on. Safe to run again: it only fills gaps. */ /** * Gives a unique number to every copy of this collection that has none (live and retired), oldest first (by when it was made, then by * card, version and edition number, which is the best order we have for copies numbered after the fact). Safe to run again. */ /** Finds a copy from its unique number, in any season: which collection it belongs to and its copy id. */ /** Quick facts for the admin panel. */ /** Deleting a collection (or a whole season's data) clears its ledger too. */ export { escrowOwner, encodeEntry }; export type { Variant }; /** The first of these copies that is not held by `owners` right now (null when all are). `holder` says where it is instead: another viewer, an offer's escrow, or '' when it no longer exists. */ /** "Print #1023381" for a copy id (the edition when the copy has no unique number yet). */ /** The unique number most recently handed out, game-wide (null before any). */ /** How many prints sit in open trade offers right now (a live print whose holder is an escrow). */

nodes.name: Move
nodes.body_text: interface Move { from: string; to: string; entry: number; count: number; /** Move exactly these copies (by id) instead of the newest `count`. Used by admin transfers. */ ids?: string[]; /** Added to each moved copy's history event (e.g. "admin transfer"). */ note?: string; /** A staff reversal of a completed trade: the copies go back and the history says so (`who` is the staff member, `note` the reason). */ reversal?: { who: string; note: string }; }

nodes.name: SyncContext
nodes.body_text: interface SyncContext { /** Where newly added copies came from (default 'other'). */ origin?: Origin; /** Copies that change hands in this save (trades, escrow, refunds). */ moves?: Move[]; /** Retire exactly these copies of `owner` (an admin removing one specific copy), in place of retiring the newest. */ retire?: { owner: string; ids: string[]; who: string; note?: string }; /** Copies spent and the one made from them. */ upgrade?: { user: string; spent: number; count: number; made: number; /** Spend exactly these prints (the newest that are not favourites) instead of the newest `count`. */ ids?: string[] }; }

nodes.name: parse
nodes.body_text: parse = (v: unknown): Copy | null => { try { return (typeof v === 'string' ? JSON.parse(v) : v) as Copy; } catch { return null; } }

nodes.name: readOwner
nodes.signature: async function readOwner(c: string, owner: string): Promise<Copy[]>
nodes.body_text: async function readOwner(c: string, owner: string): Promise<Copy[]> { const h = (await kv.hgetall(key.owner(c, owner)).catch(() => null)) as Record<string, unknown> | null; return h ? Object.values(h).map(parse).filter((x): x is Copy => !!x) : []; }

nodes.name: isTracking
nodes.body_text: async function isTracking(c: string): Promise<boolean> { try { return !!(await kv.get(key.init(c))); } catch { return false; } }

nodes.name: getOwnerCopies
nodes.body_text: getOwnerCopies = (c: string, owner: string) => readOwner(c, owner)

nodes.name: getCopy
nodes.signature: async function getCopy(c: string, id: string): Promise<Copy | null>
nodes.body_text: async function getCopy(c: string, id: string): Promise<Copy | null> { const owner = (await kv.hget<string>(key.idx(c), id).catch(() => null)) ?? null; if (owner) { const v = await kv.hget(key.owner(c, owner), id).catch(() => null); const copy = parse(v); if (copy) return copy; } return parse(await kv.hget(key.ret(c), id).catch(() => null)); }

nodes.name: mintedCounts
nodes.signature: async function mintedCounts(c: string): Promise<Map<number, number>>
nodes.body_text: async function mintedCounts(c: string): Promise<Map<number, number>> { const h = (await kv.hgetall(key.n(c)).catch(() => null)) as Record<string, unknown> | null; return new Map(Object.entries(h ?? {}).map(([e, n]) => [Number(e), Number(n)])); }

nodes.name: loadSerialIndex
nodes.signature: async function loadSerialIndex(c: string): Promise<SerialIndex | null>
nodes.body_text: async function loadSerialIndex(c: string): Promise<SerialIndex | null> { try { if (!(await isTracking(c))) return null; const [idx, minted] = await Promise.all([kv.hgetall(key.idx(c)), mintedCounts(c)]); return buildSerialIndex((idx ?? {}) as Record<string, string>, minted); } catch { return null; } }

nodes.name: serialPool
nodes.signature: async function serialPool(c: string, owner: string): Promise<SerialPool>
nodes.body_text: async function serialPool(c: string, owner: string): Promise<SerialPool> { if (!(await isTracking(c))) return {}; const pool: SerialPool = {}; for (const x of await readOwner(c, owner)) (pool[entryOf(x)] ??= []).push(x.n); for (const list of Object.values(pool)) list.sort((a, b) => a - b); return pool; }

nodes.name: CopyPage
nodes.body_text: interface CopyPage { made: number; copies: Copy[] }

nodes.name: pageCopies
nodes.signature: async function pageCopies(c: string, card: number, variant: Variant, page: number, size: number, oldestFirst = false): Promise<CopyPage>
nodes.body_text: async function pageCopies(c: string, card: number, variant: Variant, page: number, size: number, oldestFirst = false): Promise<CopyPage> { const made = (await mintedCounts(c)).get(entryOf({ card, variant })) ?? 0; const from = Math.max(0, page) * size; const ns = Array.from({ length: Math.max(0, Math.min(size, made - from)) }, (_, i) => (oldestFirst ? from + i + 1 : made - from - i)); const copies = (await Promise.all(ns.map(n => getCopy(c, copyId(card, variant, n))))).filter((x): x is Copy => !!x); return { made, copies }; }

nodes.name: liveCounts
nodes.signature: async function liveCounts(c: string): Promise<Map<number, number>>
nodes.body_text: async function liveCounts(c: string): Promise<Map<number, number>> { const idx = (await kv.hgetall(key.idx(c)).catch(() => null)) as Record<string, string> | null; const out = new Map<number, number>(); for (const id of Object.keys(idx ?? {})) { const p = parseCopyId(id); if (!p) continue; const e = encodeEntry(p.card, p.variant); out.set(e, (out.get(e) ?? 0) + 1); } return out; }

nodes.name: lastSerial
nodes.signature: async function lastSerial(c: string, entry: number): Promise<number | null>
nodes.body_text: async function lastSerial(c: string, entry: number): Promise<number | null> { try { if (!(await isTracking(c))) return null; const n = Number(await kv.hget(key.n(c), String(entry))); return Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0 ? n : null; } catch { return null; } }

nodes.name: lastCopy
nodes.signature: async function lastCopy(c: string, entry: number): Promise<{ serial: number | null; copyId: string | null; uid: number | null }>
nodes.body_text: async function lastCopy(c: string, entry: number): Promise<{ serial: number | null; copyId: string | null; uid: number | null }> { const serial = await lastSerial(c, entry); if (!serial) return { serial: null, copyId: null, uid: null }; const { cardNumber, variant } = decodeEntry(entry); const id = copyId(cardNumber, variant, serial); const copy = await getCopy(c, id).catch(() => null); return { serial, copyId: id, uid: copy?.uid ?? null }; }

nodes.name: liveCopiesOfEntry
nodes.signature: async function liveCopiesOfEntry(c: string, entry: number): Promise<{ id: string; owner: string }[]>
nodes.body_text: async function liveCopiesOfEntry(c: string, entry: number): Promise<{ id: string; owner: string }[]> { const idx = (await kv.hgetall(key.idx(c)).catch(() => null)) as Record<string, string> | null; const { cardNumber, variant } = decodeEntry(entry); const prefix = `${cardNumber}.${['regular', 'reverse', 'full', 'shiny'].indexOf(variant)}.`; return Object.entries(idx ?? {}).filter(([id]) => id.startsWith(prefix)).map(([id, owner]) => ({ id, owner })); }

nodes.name: nextUids
nodes.body_text: async function nextUids(count: number): Promise<number> { try { return UID_BASE + Number(await kv.hincrby(key.uidSeq, 'n', count)) - count + 1; } catch { return 0; } }

nodes.name: registerUids
nodes.signature: async function registerUids(c: string, copies: Copy[]): Promise<void>
nodes.body_text: async function registerUids(c: string, copies: Copy[]): Promise<void> { const entries = copies.filter(x => x.uid).map(x => [String(x.uid), `${c}|${x.id}`] as const); if (entries.length) await kv.hset(key.uidIdx, Object.fromEntries(entries)).catch(() => {}); }

nodes.name: mint
nodes.signature: async function mint(c: string, owner: string, entry: number, count: number, origin: Origin, opts: { est?: boolean; madeFrom?: string[]; who?: string; noUid?: boolean } = {}): Promise<Copy[]>
nodes.body_text: async function mint(c: string, owner: string, entry: number, count: number, origin: Origin, opts: { est?: boolean; madeFrom?: string[]; who?: string; noUid?: boolean } = {}): Promise<Copy[]> { if (count <= 0) return []; const { cardNumber, variant } = decodeEntry(entry); const top = Number(await kv.hincrby(key.n(c), String(entry), count)); const uid0 = opts.noUid ? 0 : await nextUids(count); const now = Date.now(); const made: Copy[] = []; for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) { const n = top - count + 1 + i; made.push({ id: copyId(cardNumber, variant, n), ...(uid0 ? { uid: uid0 + i } : {}), card: cardNumber, variant, n, owner, at: now, origin, ...(opts.est ? { est: true } : {}), ...(opts.madeFrom ? { madeFrom: opts.madeFrom } : {}), ev: [{ t: now, type: 'minted', who: opts.who ?? owner }], }); } await kv.hset(key.owner(c, owner), Object.fromEntries(made.map(m => [m.id, m]))); await kv.hset(key.idx(c), Object.fromEntries(made.map(m => [m.id, owner]))); await registerUids(c, made); return made; }

nodes.name: retire
nodes.signature: async function retire(c: string, owner: string, copies: Copy[], ev: Omit<CopyEvent, 't'>): Promise<void>
nodes.body_text: async function retire(c: string, owner: string, copies: Copy[], ev: Omit<CopyEvent, 't'>): Promise<void> { if (copies.length === 0) return; const now = Date.now(); await kv.hset(key.ret(c), Object.fromEntries(copies.map(x => [x.id, withEvent({ ...x, owner: '' }, { t: now, ...ev })]))); await kv.hdel(key.owner(c, owner), ...copies.map(x => x.id)); await kv.hdel(key.idx(c), ...copies.map(x => x.id)); }

nodes.name: move
nodes.signature: async function move(c: string, m: Move): Promise<number>
nodes.body_text: async function move(c: string, m: Move): Promise<number> { const mine = (await readOwner(c, m.from)).filter(x => entryOf(x) === m.entry); const picked = m.ids ? mine.filter(x => m.ids!.includes(x.id)) : newestFirst(mine, m.count); if (picked.length === 0) return 0; const now = Date.now(); const moved = picked.map(x => { if (isEscrow(m.to)) return withEvent({ ...x, owner: m.to }, { t: now, type: 'escrowed', who: m.from }); if (m.reversal) return withEvent({ ...x, owner: m.to }, { t: now, type: 'reversed', who: m.reversal.who, to: m.to, note: m.reversal.note }); // Out of escrow: back to whoever put it there is a refund, to anyone else it is a trade from them. const putBy = isEscrow(m.from) ? [...x.ev].reverse().find(e => e.type === 'escrowed')?.who : undefined; return putBy === m.to ? withEvent({ ...x, owner: m.to }, { t: now, type: 'returned', who: m.to }) : withEvent({ ...x, owner: m.to }, { t: now, type: 'traded', who: putBy ?? m.from, to: m.to, ...(m.note ? { note: m.note } : {}) }); }); await kv.hset(key.owner(c, m.to), Object.fromEntries(moved.map(x => [x.id, x]))); await kv.hset(key.idx(c), Object.fromEntries(moved.map(x => [x.id, m.to]))); await kv.hdel(key.owner(c, m.from), ...picked.map(x => x.id)); return picked.length; }

nodes.name: reconcileUser
nodes.signature: async function reconcileUser(c: string, user: string, owned: number[], origin: Origin, est = false, noUid = false): Promise<void>
nodes.body_text: async function reconcileUser(c: string, user: string, owned: number[], origin: Origin, est = false, noUid = false): Promise<void> { const have = await readOwner(c, user); const byEntry = new Map<number, Copy[]>(); for (const x of have) { const e = entryOf(x); byEntry.set(e, [...(byEntry.get(e) ?? []), x]); } const { mint: toMint, retire: toRetire } = diffCounts(new Map([...byEntry].map(([e, l]) => [e, l.length])), countEntries(owned)); for (const [e, k] of toRetire) await retire(c, user, newestFirst(byEntry.get(e) ?? [], k), { type: 'removed', who: user }); for (const [e, k] of toMint) await mint(c, user, e, k, origin, { est, noUid }); }

nodes.name: syncAfterSave
nodes.signature: async function syncAfterSave(c: string, before: Record<string, number[]>, after: Record<string, number[]>, ctx: SyncContext = {}): Promise<void>
nodes.body_text: async function syncAfterSave(c: string, before: Record<string, number[]>, after: Record<string, number[]>, ctx: SyncContext = {}): Promise<void> { try { if (!(await isTracking(c))) return; const touched = new Set<string>(); for (const u of new Set([...Object.keys(before), ...Object.keys(after)])) if (!sameCollection(before[u], after[u])) touched.add(u); for (const m of ctx.moves ?? []) { await move(c, m); for (const side of [m.from, m.to]) if (!isEscrow(side)) touched.add(side); } if (ctx.retire) { const { owner, ids, who, note } = ctx.retire; const doomed = (await readOwner(c, owner)).filter(x => ids.includes(x.id)); await retire(c, owner, doomed, { type: 'removed', who, ...(note ? { note } : {}) }); touched.add(owner); } if (ctx.upgrade) { const { user, spent, count, made, ids } = ctx.upgrade; const mine = (await readOwner(c, user)).filter(x => entryOf(x) === spent); const used = ids ? mine.filter(x => ids.includes(x.id)) : newestFirst(mine, count); const [fresh] = await mint(c, user, made, 1, 'upgrade', { madeFrom: used.map(x => x.id) }); await retire(c, user, used, { type: 'upgraded', who: user, ...(fresh ? { note: fresh.id } : {}) }); touched.add(user); } for (const u of touched) await reconcileUser(c, u, after[u] ?? [], ctx.origin ?? 'other'); } catch (e) { console.error('serial sync failed', e); } }

nodes.name: BackfillResult
nodes.body_text: interface BackfillResult { users: number; copies: number; /** Copies that were given a unique number in this run. */ numbered: number }

nodes.name: backfillSerials
nodes.signature: async function backfillSerials(c: string, data: Record<string, number[]>): Promise<BackfillResult>
nodes.body_text: async function backfillSerials(c: string, data: Record<string, number[]>): Promise<BackfillResult> { let copies = 0; for (const [user, owned] of Object.entries(data)) { const before = (await readOwner(c, user)).length; await reconcileUser(c, user, owned, 'estimated', true, true); copies += Math.max(0, owned.length - before); } await kv.set(key.init(c), Date.now()); // Unique numbers last, oldest copy first, so older copies get the lower numbers. const numbered = await assignMissingUids(c); return { users: Object.keys(data).length, copies, numbered }; }

nodes.name: assignMissingUids
nodes.body_text: async function assignMissingUids(c: string): Promise<number> { const idx = ((await kv.hgetall(key.idx(c)).catch(() => null)) ?? {}) as Record<string, string>; const owners = [...new Set(Object.values(idx))]; const live = (await Promise.all(owners.map(async o => ({ o, copies: await readOwner(c, o) })))).filter(x => x.copies.length > 0); const retHash = ((await kv.hgetall(key.ret(c)).catch(() => null)) ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>; const retired = Object.values(retHash).map(parse).filter((x): x is Copy => !!x); const missing = [...live.flatMap(x => x.copies), ...retired].filter(x => !x.uid); if (missing.length === 0) return 0; missing.sort((a, b) => a.at - b.at || a.card - b.card || ['regular', 'reverse', 'full', 'shiny'].indexOf(a.variant) - ['regular', 'reverse', 'full', 'shiny'].indexOf(b.variant) || a.n - b.n); const first = await nextUids(missing.length); if (!first) return 0; missing.forEach((x, i) => { x.uid = first + i; }); const done = new Set(missing.map(x => x.id)); for (const { o, copies } of live) { const changed = copies.filter(x => done.has(x.id)); if (changed.length) await kv.hset(key.owner(c, o), Object.fromEntries(changed.map(x => [x.id, x]))); } const changedRet = retired.filter(x => done.has(x.id)); if (changedRet.length) await kv.hset(key.ret(c), Object.fromEntries(changedRet.map(x => [x.id, x]))); await registerUids(c, missing); return missing.length; }

nodes.name: findByUid
nodes.signature: async function findByUid(uid: number): Promise<{ collection: string; copyId: string } | null>
nodes.body_text: async function findByUid(uid: number): Promise<{ collection: string; copyId: string } | null> { try { const v = await kv.hget<string>(key.uidIdx, String(uid)); if (!v) return null; const cut = v.indexOf('|'); return cut > 0 ? { collection: v.slice(0, cut), copyId: v.slice(cut + 1) } : null; } catch { return null; } }

nodes.name: serialStats
nodes.signature: async function serialStats(c: string): Promise<{ tracking: boolean; minted: number; live: number; retired: number }>
nodes.body_text: async function serialStats(c: string): Promise<{ tracking: boolean; minted: number; live: number; retired: number }> { const [tracking, n, idx, ret] = await Promise.all([isTracking(c), mintedCounts(c), kv.hlen(key.idx(c)).catch(() => 0), kv.hlen(key.ret(c)).catch(() => 0)]); return { tracking, minted: [...n.values()].reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0), live: Number(idx) || 0, retired: Number(ret) || 0 }; }

nodes.name: dropLedger
nodes.signature: async function dropLedger(c: string, users: string[]): Promise<void>
nodes.body_text: async function dropLedger(c: string, users: string[]): Promise<void> { try { await kv.del(key.idx(c), key.n(c), key.ret(c), key.init(c), ...users.map(u => key.owner(c, u))); } catch { /* best effort */ } }

nodes.name: firstNotHeld
nodes.signature: async function firstNotHeld(c: string, owners: string[], ids: string[]): Promise<{ id: string; holder: string } | null>
nodes.body_text: async function firstNotHeld(c: string, owners: string[], ids: string[]): Promise<{ id: string; holder: string } | null> { for (const id of ids) { const holder = (await kv.hget<string>(key.idx(c), id).catch(() => null)) ?? ''; if (!owners.includes(holder)) return { id, holder }; } return null; }

nodes.name: printLabel
nodes.signature: async function printLabel(c: string, id: string): Promise<string>
nodes.body_text: async function printLabel(c: string, id: string): Promise<string> { const copy = await getCopy(c, id); if (copy?.uid) return `Print #${copy.uid}`; const p = parseCopyId(id); return p ? `Edition #${p.n}` : 'that print'; }

nodes.name: lastUid
nodes.body_text: async function lastUid(): Promise<number | null> { try { const n = Number(await kv.hget(key.uidSeq, 'n')); return Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0 ? UID_BASE + n : null; } catch { return null; } }

nodes.name: inOfferCount
nodes.body_text: async function inOfferCount(c: string): Promise<number> { const idx = (await kv.hgetall(key.idx(c)).catch(() => null)) as Record<string, string> | null; return Object.values(idx ?? {}).filter(o => typeof o === 'string' && isEscrow(o)).length; }

nodes.name: session.ts
nodes.body_text: import { createHmac, timingSafeEqual } from 'crypto'; import { cookies } from 'next/headers'; import { currentSandboxId } from './db'; // Website login session: a small signed cookie, no database. The payload is signed with SESSION_SECRET (HMAC-SHA256), // so it can be read but not forged or edited. Logging out clears the cookie; otherwise it expires after 30 days. // Never put anything secret in it. It is readable by the browser's owner. export const SESSION_COOKIE = 'tcg_session'; /** Short-lived cookie holding the OAuth `state` (+ return path) between leaving for Twitch and coming back. */ export const OAUTH_COOKIE = 'tcg_oauth'; const MAX_AGE_S = 60 * 60 * 24 * 30; /** True when website login can work (a usable SESSION_SECRET plus Twitch app credentials). */ /** The logged-in viewer for this request, or null. */ /** * Cross-site request guard for state-changing endpoints: the Origin (or Referer) must be this site. SameSite=Lax * on the cookie already blocks cross-site POSTs; this is a second layer for browsers that send an Origin. */

nodes.name: Session
nodes.body_text: interface Session { /** Lowercase Twitch login. The key collections and profiles are stored under. */ username: string; twitchId: string; displayName: string; exp: number; // unix seconds /** Set for a sandbox test login: only valid while the request is in that same sandbox. */ sandbox?: string; }

nodes.name: secret
nodes.body_text: function secret(): string | null { const s = process.env.SESSION_SECRET; return s && s.length >= 16 ? s : null; }

nodes.name: loginConfigured
nodes.body_text: function loginConfigured(): boolean { return !!secret() && !!process.env.TWITCH_CLIENT_ID && !!process.env.TWITCH_CLIENT_SECRET; }

nodes.name: sign
nodes.body_text: sign = (payload: string, key: string) => createHmac('sha256', key).update(payload).digest('base64url')

nodes.name: signSession
nodes.body_text: function signSession(data: Omit<Session, 'exp'>): string | null { const key = secret(); if (!key) return null; const session: Session = { ...data, exp: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + MAX_AGE_S }; const payload = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(session)).toString('base64url'); return `${payload}.${sign(payload, key)}`; }

nodes.name: verifySession
nodes.signature: function verifySession(token: string | undefined): Session | null
nodes.body_text: function verifySession(token: string | undefined): Session | null { const key = secret(); if (!key || !token) return null; const [payload, sig, extra] = token.split('.'); if (!payload || !sig || extra !== undefined) return null; const expected = Buffer.from(sign(payload, key)); const given = Buffer.from(sig); if (expected.length !== given.length || !timingSafeEqual(expected, given)) return null; try { const s = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(payload, 'base64url').toString('utf8')) as Session; if (typeof s.username !== 'string' || !s.username || typeof s.exp !== 'number' || s.exp < Date.now() / 1000) return null; return s; } catch { return null; } }

nodes.name: getSession
nodes.body_text: async function getSession(): Promise<Session | null> { const session = verifySession((await cookies()).get(SESSION_COOKIE)?.value); // A sandbox test login is useless (and ignored) outside its sandbox, so it can't be mistaken for a real viewer on production. if (session?.sandbox && (await currentSandboxId()) !== session.sandbox) return null; return session; }

nodes.name: sessionCookieOptions
nodes.body_text: function sessionCookieOptions(maxAge = MAX_AGE_S) { return { httpOnly: true, secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production', sameSite: 'lax' as const, path: '/', maxAge, }; }

nodes.name: isSameOrigin
nodes.body_text: function isSameOrigin(req: Request): boolean { const host = req.headers.get('host'); const origin = req.headers.get('origin') ?? req.headers.get('referer'); if (!origin || !host) return false; try { return new URL(origin).host === host; } catch { return false; } }

nodes.name: layoutCards
nodes.signature: function layoutCards(n: number, area: Rect, gap = 28, colsOverride?: number): Rect[]
nodes.body_text: function layoutCards(n: number, area: Rect, gap = 28, colsOverride?: number): Rect[] { const count = Math.max(0, Math.min(9, Math.floor(n))); if (count === 0) return []; const cols = colsOverride ? Math.max(1, Math.min(3, Math.floor(colsOverride))) : count === 1 ? 1 : count === 2 ? 2 : count === 4 ? 2 : 3; const rows = Math.ceil(count / cols); // The biggest card that fits both ways. const wByWidth = (area.w - gap * (cols - 1)) / cols; const hByHeight = (area.h - gap * (rows - 1)) / rows; const w = Math.min(wByWidth, hByHeight * CARD_RATIO); const h = w / CARD_RATIO; const out: Rect[] = []; for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) { const r = Math.floor(i / cols); const inRow = r === rows - 1 ? count - r * cols : cols; // centre a short last row const c = i - r * cols; const rowW = inRow * w + (inRow - 1) * gap; out.push({ x: area.x + (area.w - rowW) / 2 + c * (w + gap), y: area.y + (area.h - (rows * h + (rows - 1) * gap)) / 2 + r * (h + gap), w, h }); } return out; }

nodes.body_text: function statsLayout(h = SHARE_H, thumbCount = 3): StatsLayout { const a = cardArea(h); const extra = h - SHARE_H; const heroH = 196 + Math.round(extra * 0.2), gap = 24; const tileH = 144 + Math.round(extra * 0.1), tileW = (a.w - gap) / 2; const hero: Rect = { x: a.x, y: a.y, w: a.w, h: heroH }; const tiles: Rect[] = []; for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) tiles.push({ x: a.x + (i % 2) * (tileW + gap), y: a.y + heroH + gap + Math.floor(i / 2) * (tileH + gap), w: tileW, h: tileH }); const stripY = tiles[5].y + tileH + 34; const strip: Rect = { x: a.x, y: stripY, w: a.w, h: a.y + a.h - stripY }; const labelH = 44; const tg = 28; // As tall as the strip allows, but never wider than the area (a story's strip is taller than three prints are wide). const tw = Math.min(Math.max(0, strip.h - labelH) * CARD_RATIO, (strip.w - tg * (thumbCount - 1)) / Math.max(1, thumbCount)), th = tw / CARD_RATIO; const total = thumbCount * tw + (thumbCount - 1) * tg; const thumbs: Rect[] = Array.from({ length: thumbCount }, (_, i) => ({ x: strip.x + (strip.w - total) / 2 + i * (tw + tg), y: strip.y + labelH, w: tw, h: th })); return { hero, tiles, strip, stripLabelY: strip.y + 28, thumbs }; }

nodes.name: binderLayout
nodes.signature: function binderLayout(b: { cols: number; rows: number; pages: unknown[] }, h = SHARE_H): BinderLayout
nodes.body_text: function binderLayout(b: { cols: number; rows: number; pages: unknown[] }, h = SHARE_H): BinderLayout { const area = cardArea(h); const n = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, b.pages.length)); const inner = { w: area.w - 2 * BINDER_LEATHER_PAD, h: area.h - 2 * BINDER_LEATHER_PAD }; const chromeW = 2 * BINDER_PAGE_PAD, chromeH = 2 * BINDER_PAGE_PAD + BINDER_HEAD_H + BINDER_HEAD_GAP; const pocketByWidth = (inner.w / n - chromeW - (b.cols - 1) * BINDER_GAP) / b.cols; const pocketByHeight = (inner.h - chromeH - (b.rows - 1) * BINDER_GAP) / (b.rows * 1.5); const pw = Math.max(8, Math.min(pocketByWidth, pocketByHeight)); const ph = pw * 1.5; const pageW = b.cols * pw + (b.cols - 1) * BINDER_GAP + chromeW; const pageH = b.rows * ph + (b.rows - 1) * BINDER_GAP + chromeH; const leather: Rect = { x: area.x + (area.w - (n * pageW + 2 * BINDER_LEATHER_PAD)) / 2, y: area.y + (area.h - (pageH + 2 * BINDER_LEATHER_PAD)) / 2, w: n * pageW + 2 * BINDER_LEATHER_PAD, h: pageH + 2 * BINDER_LEATHER_PAD, }; const pages = Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => { const rect: Rect = { x: leather.x + BINDER_LEATHER_PAD + i * pageW, y: leather.y + BINDER_LEATHER_PAD, w: pageW, h: pageH }; const head: Rect = { x: rect.x + BINDER_PAGE_PAD, y: rect.y + BINDER_PAGE_PAD, w: pageW - chromeW, h: BINDER_HEAD_H }; const gx = rect.x + BINDER_PAGE_PAD, gy = head.y + BINDER_HEAD_H + BINDER_HEAD_GAP; const pockets: Rect[] = []; for (let r = 0; r < b.rows; r++) for (let c = 0; c < b.cols; c++) pockets.push({ x: gx + c * (pw + BINDER_GAP), y: gy + r * (ph + BINDER_GAP), w: pw, h: ph }); return { rect, head, pockets }; }); return { leather, k: pw / 137, pages }; }

Null when nothing is known. */ /** Everything the stats image draws besides the header and the strip of prints. */

nodes.name: StatsCardInput
nodes.body_text: interface StatsCardInput { rank: number | null; score: number; uniqueCards: number; totalCards: number; copies: number; /** The scoring setting: the completion bonus as a percentage of the set's value, reached at 100% of the cards. */ completionBonusPct: number; /** Their prints with a ledger (empty when the season does not track prints). */ prints: { card: number; variant: Variant; n: number }[]; /** The chance of pulling that card in that version, 0 when unknown. */ chance: (card: number, variant: Variant) => number; nameOf: (card: number) => string; hexOf: (card: number) => string | undefined; tradesCompleted: number; }

nodes.name: rarestPrint
nodes.signature: function rarestPrint(i: Pick<StatsCardInput, 'prints' | 'chance'>): { card: number; variant: Variant; n: number; chance: number } | null
nodes.body_text: function rarestPrint(i: Pick<StatsCardInput, 'prints' | 'chance'>): { card: number; variant: Variant; n: number; chance: number } | null { let best: { card: number; variant: Variant; n: number; chance: number } | null = null; for (const p of i.prints) { const chance = i.chance(p.card, p.variant); if (!(chance > 0)) continue; if (!best || chance < best.chance || (chance === best.chance && (p.n < best.n || (p.n === best.n && p.card < best.card)))) best = { ...p, chance }; } return best; }

nodes.name: buildStatsCard
nodes.body_text: function buildStatsCard(i: StatsCardInput): StatsCardShare { const rarest = rarestPrint(i); const lowest = i.prints.reduce<number | null>((m, p) => (m === null || p.n < m ? p.n : m), null); const bonus = i.totalCards > 0 ? (i.completionBonusPct * i.uniqueCards) / i.totalCards : 0; return { rank: i.rank ? `#${i.rank}` : '-', score: Math.round(i.score).toLocaleString('en-US'), accent: rarest ? i.hexOf(rarest.card) : undefined, figures: [ { label: 'Different cards', value: `${i.uniqueCards}/${i.totalCards}`, progress: i.totalCards > 0 ? i.uniqueCards / i.totalCards : 0 }, { label: 'Prints', value: i.copies.toLocaleString('en-US') }, { label: 'Progress bonus', value: `+${bonus.toFixed(1)}%`, sub: 'of the set value' }, { label: 'Best edition', value: lowest === null ? '-' : `#${lowest}`, sub: lowest === null ? undefined : 'lowest held' }, { label: 'Rarest print', value: rarest ? i.nameOf(rarest.card) : '-', sub: rarest ? `${rarest.variant === 'regular' ? 'Regular' : VARIANT_LABELS[rarest.variant]} · 1 in ${Math.round(1 / rarest.chance).toLocaleString('en-US')}` : undefined }, { label: 'Trades', value: String(i.tradesCompleted), sub: 'completed' }, ], }; }

Everything is ignored while // typing in a field and when a modifier key is held (so browser and OS shortcuts keep working). export const SEQUENCE_WINDOW_MS = 1200; export const GO_SHORTCUTS: Shortcut[] = NAV_ITEMS.map(i => ({ keys: ['g', i.key], label: i.label, href: i.href, group: 'Go to' as const })); export const GLOBAL_SHORTCUTS: Shortcut[] = [ { keys: ['Ctrl/⌘', 'K'], label: 'Open the command palette', group: 'Anywhere' }, { keys: ['/'], label: 'Focus the search box on this page', group: 'Anywhere' }, { keys: ['?'], label: 'Show these shortcuts', group: 'Anywhere' }, { keys: ['Esc'], label: 'Close a dialog or the palette', group: 'Anywhere' }, ]; export const ALL_SHORTCUTS: Shortcut[] = [...GLOBAL_SHORTCUTS, ...GO_SHORTCUTS]; export const IDLE: SeqState = { pending: false, at: 0 }; /** Advances the "g then letter" sequence. Returns the new state and, when a sequence completed, where to go. */ /** True when the key press came from somewhere text is being typed. */

nodes.body_text: function stepSequence(state: SeqState, key: string, now: number): { state: SeqState; go?: string } { const k = key.toLowerCase(); if (state.pending && now - state.at <= SEQUENCE_WINDOW_MS) { const hit = NAV_ITEMS.find(i => i.key === k); return hit ? { state: IDLE, go: hit.href } : { state: IDLE }; } return k === 'g' ? { state: { pending: true, at: now } } : { state: IDLE }; }

nodes.body_text: import { kv } from './db'; import { getActiveSeasonWithPacks, getCollection } from './kv'; import { getSeasonLeaderboardCached } from './leaderboard'; import { getOwnerCopies } from './serials'; import { serialMultiplier } from './scoring-core'; import { countVariants, VARIANTS, VARIANT_LABELS } from './variants'; import { parseShowQuery, pickShowVariant, resolveCard, type ShowCard } from './showoff'; import type { Variant } from './types'; export const SHOWOFF_COOLDOWN_S = 15; /** * Works out what to put on stream for "show off my <card>". Everything is checked here, on the server: the card must exist in the * running season and the viewer must really own it (in the version asked for), so the overlay can only ever be told to show a genuine * card of theirs. One show-off per viewer every few seconds, so a chat cannot flood the screen. */

nodes.name: prepareShowOff
nodes.signature: async function prepareShowOff(username: string, text: unknown, opts: { dry?: boolean } = {}): Promise<ShowResult>
nodes.body_text: async function prepareShowOff(username: string, text: unknown, opts: { dry?: boolean } = {}): Promise<ShowResult> { const user = username.toLowerCase(); const active = await getActiveSeasonWithPacks(); if (!active) return { ok: false, error: 'no-season', message: 'There is no season running right now.' }; const { season, packs } = active; const owned = countVariants((await getCollection(season.collectionName))[user] ?? []); const cards: ShowCard[] = packs.flatMap(p => p.cards).map(c => ({ number: c.number, name: c.name, stars: c.stars })); const board = await getSeasonLeaderboardCached(season).catch(() => null); const q = parseShowQuery(text); // "My best card": the copy worth the most points right now (falls back to the rarest owned). const best = (): ShowCard | null => { let top: { card: ShowCard; value: number } | null = null; for (const c of cards) { const counts = owned.get(c.number); if (!counts) continue; const v = board?.values.cards.get(c.number); const value = VARIANTS.reduce((m, variant) => (counts[variant] > 0 ? Math.max(m, v?.values[variant] ?? 0) : m), 0) || c.stars; if (!top || value > top.value) top = { card: c, value }; } return top?.card ?? null; }; const resolved = resolveCard(q, cards, new Set(owned.keys()), best); if (!resolved.ok) return { ok: false, error: resolved.reason, message: resolved.message }; const card = resolved.card; const pick = pickShowVariant(owned.get(card.number)!, q.variant); if (!pick.ok) return { ok: false, error: 'not-owned', message: pick.message }; // The viewer's own copy with the lowest serial number, when the season's copies are numbered. let serial: number | undefined; let uid: number | undefined; try { const mine = (await getOwnerCopies(season.collectionName, user)).filter(c => c.card === card.number && c.variant === pick.variant); if (mine.length > 0) { const lowest = mine.reduce((a, c) => (c.n < a.n ? c : a)); serial = lowest.n; uid = lowest.uid; } } catch { /* no serial shown */ } const serialMult = serial && board ? serialMultiplier(serial, board.values.settings) : undefined; // Cooldown last, so a refused request (not their card, a typo) does not use up their turn. const taken = opts.dry ? 'OK' : await kv.set(`showoff:cd:${user}`, 1, { nx: true, ex: SHOWOFF_COOLDOWN_S }).catch(() => 'OK'); if (taken === null) return { ok: false, error: 'cooldown', message: `Easy there, try again in a few seconds.`, retryAfter: SHOWOFF_COOLDOWN_S }; const label = `${pick.variant === 'regular' ? '' : `${VARIANT_LABELS[pick.variant]} `}${card.name}${serial ? ` #${serial}` : ''}`; return { ok: true, plan: { username: user, cardNumber: card.number, cardName: card.name, variant: pick.variant, serial, serialMult, uid, message: `Showing off your ${label}!` } }; }

Math.max(m, v?.values[variant] ?? 0) : m), 0) || c.stars; if (!top || value > top.value) top = { card: c, value }; } return top?.card ?? null; }

nodes.name: showoff.ts
nodes.body_text: import { VARIANTS, VARIANT_LABELS, type VariantCounts } from './variants'; import type { Variant } from './types'; // Showing a card off on stream from a chat command (pure, client-safe). The bot passes whatever the viewer typed after the command, // e.g. "shiny gouda goat" or "#12"; this works out which card and version they mean and checks they really own it. const VARIANT_WORDS: Record<string, Variant> = { regular: 'regular', normal: 'regular', base: 'regular', reverse: 'reverse', rh: 'reverse', holo: 'reverse', reverseholo: 'reverse', full: 'full', fa: 'full', fullart: 'full', shiny: 'shiny', sh: 'shiny', shinyfullart: 'shiny', }; /** Splits "shiny gouda goat" / "gouda goat sh" / "#12 reverse" into a card and a version. Never throws. */ /** * Which card a viewer means, among the cards of the season. Cards they own win over ones they do not, so a short name that matches * several cards still resolves when only one of them is theirs. */ /** The version to show: the one asked for (if they own it), else the best they own. */

nodes.name: norm
nodes.body_text: norm = (s: string) => s.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '')

nodes.name: ShowQuery
nodes.body_text: interface ShowQuery { /** The card the viewer asked for: a number, a name, or empty for "my best card". */ number: number | null; name: string; variant: Variant | null; }

nodes.name: parseShowQuery
nodes.body_text: function parseShowQuery(raw: unknown): ShowQuery { const text = typeof raw === 'number' ? `#${raw}` : typeof raw === 'string' ? raw : ''; // Two-word version names first ("shiny full art", "full art", "reverse holo"). const tidy = text.trim().slice(0, 80).replace(/\bshiny\s+full\s*art\b/gi, 'shiny').replace(/\bfull\s+art\b/gi, 'full').replace(/\breverse\s+holo\b/gi, 'reverse'); const tokens = tidy.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean); let variant: Variant | null = null; const rest: string[] = []; for (const t of tokens) { const w = VARIANT_WORDS[norm(t)]; if (w && !variant && tokens.length > 1) variant = w; // a lone word is a card name, whatever it is else rest.push(t); } const joined = rest.join(' ').trim(); const num = /^#?(\d{1,6})$/.exec(joined); return { number: num ? Number(num[1]) : null, name: num ? '' : joined, variant }; }

nodes.name: ShowCard
nodes.body_text: interface ShowCard { number: number; name: string; stars: number }

nodes.name: Resolved
nodes.signature: type Resolved = | { ok: true; card: ShowCard } | { ok: false; reason: 'none' | 'not-owned' | 'ambiguous' | 'nothing-to-show'; message: string; candidates?: string[] };
nodes.body_text: type Resolved = | { ok: true; card: ShowCard } | { ok: false; reason: 'none' | 'not-owned' | 'ambiguous' | 'nothing-to-show'; message: string; candidates?: string[] };

nodes.name: resolveCard
nodes.signature: function resolveCard(q: ShowQuery, cards: ShowCard[], owned: ReadonlySet<number>, best: () => ShowCard | null): Resolved
nodes.body_text: function resolveCard(q: ShowQuery, cards: ShowCard[], owned: ReadonlySet<number>, best: () => ShowCard | null): Resolved { if (q.number === null && !q.name) { const card = best(); return card ? { ok: true, card } : { ok: false, reason: 'nothing-to-show', message: 'You have no cards to show yet.' }; } let matches: ShowCard[]; if (q.number !== null) matches = cards.filter(c => c.number === q.number); else { const n = norm(q.name); const exact = cards.filter(c => norm(c.name) === n); const starts = cards.filter(c => norm(c.name).startsWith(n)); const has = cards.filter(c => norm(c.name).includes(n)); // Prefer an exact name, then a prefix, then anywhere in the name, but only the tier that has something the viewer owns. matches = [exact, starts, has].find(tier => tier.some(c => owned.has(c.number))) ?? [exact, starts, has].find(t => t.length > 0) ?? []; } if (matches.length === 0) return { ok: false, reason: 'none', message: `I could not find a card called "${q.number !== null ? `#${q.number}` : q.name}".` }; const mine = matches.filter(c => owned.has(c.number)); if (mine.length === 0) return { ok: false, reason: 'not-owned', message: `You don't have ${matches.length === 1 ? matches[0].name : `"${q.name}"`} yet.` }; if (mine.length > 1) return { ok: false, reason: 'ambiguous', message: `Which one? ${mine.slice(0, 3).map(c => c.name).join(', ')}${mine.length > 3 ? '…' : ''}`, candidates: mine.slice(0, 3).map(c => c.name) }; return { ok: true, card: mine[0] }; }

nodes.name: pickShowVariant
nodes.signature: function pickShowVariant(counts: VariantCounts, wanted: Variant | null): { ok: true; variant: Variant } | { ok: false; message: string }
nodes.body_text: function pickShowVariant(counts: VariantCounts, wanted: Variant | null): { ok: true; variant: Variant } | { ok: false; message: string } { if (wanted) { if (counts[wanted] > 0) return { ok: true, variant: wanted }; const have = VARIANTS.filter(v => counts[v] > 0).map(v => VARIANT_LABELS[v]); return { ok: false, message: `You don't have the ${VARIANT_LABELS[wanted]} version${have.length ? ` (you have ${have.join(', ')})` : ''}.` }; } const best = [...VARIANTS].reverse().find(v => counts[v] > 0); return best ? { ok: true, variant: best } : { ok: false, message: 'You do not own that card.' }; }

nodes.name: ownersByCard
nodes.signature: function ownersByCard( collection: Record<string, number[]>, values: SeasonValues, limit = 10, hidden: Set<string> = new Set(), ): Map<number, { top: CardOwner[]; collectors: number }>
nodes.body_text: function ownersByCard( collection: Record<string, number[]>, values: SeasonValues, limit = 10, hidden: Set<string> = new Set(), ): Map<number, { top: CardOwner[]; collectors: number }> { const lists = new Map<number, CardOwner[]>(); for (const [username, entries] of Object.entries(collection)) { if (hidden.has(username.toLowerCase())) continue; // an admin hid this viewer from public lists const byCard = new Map<number, number[]>(); for (const e of entries) { const n = decodeEntry(e).cardNumber; byCard.set(n, [...(byCard.get(n) ?? []), e]); } for (const [cardNumber, counts] of countVariants(entries)) { const cv = values.cards.get(cardNumber); if (!cv) continue; // card since removed from the season const copies = VARIANTS.reduce((s, v) => s + counts[v], 0); // The points of these copies, serial bonuses included (the same maths as the leaderboard). const points = pointsFor(values, byCard.get(cardNumber) ?? [], username).points; const list = lists.get(cardNumber) ?? []; list.push({ username: username.toLowerCase(), copies, variants: counts, points }); lists.set(cardNumber, list); } } const out = new Map<number, { top: CardOwner[]; collectors: number }>(); for (const [n, list] of lists) { list.sort((a, b) => b.copies - a.copies || b.points - a.points || a.username.localeCompare(b.username)); out.set(n, { top: list.slice(0, limit), collectors: list.length }); } return out; }

nodes.name: computeStats
nodes.body_text: function computeStats(o: SeasonOverview): SeasonStats { const copiesOf = (c: Card) => o.values.cards.get(c.number)?.copies ?? 0; const variantCopies = emptyCounts(); let totalScore = 0; let uniqueSum = 0; for (const r of o.rows) { totalScore += r.score; uniqueSum += r.uniqueCards; for (const v of VARIANTS) variantCopies[v as Variant] += r.variants[v]; } const totalCards = o.cards.length; const byCopies = [...o.cards].sort((a, b) => copiesOf(b) - copiesOf(a) || a.number - b.number); return { collectors: o.rows.length, totalCopies: o.rows.reduce((s, r) => s + r.copies, 0), totalCards, cardsPulled: o.cards.filter(c => copiesOf(c) > 0).length, avgCompletionPct: o.rows.length > 0 && totalCards > 0 ? Math.round((uniqueSum / o.rows.length / totalCards) * 100) : 0, totalScore, topScore: o.rows[0]?.score ?? 0, variantCopies, rarity: RARITIES.map(r => { const tier = o.cards.filter(c => c.stars === r.stars); return { stars: r.stars, label: r.label, hex: r.hex, cards: tier.length, copies: tier.reduce((s, c) => s + copiesOf(c), 0) }; }).filter(r => r.cards > 0), mostPulled: byCopies.slice(0, 5).map(card => ({ card, copies: copiesOf(card) })), leastPulled: [...byCopies].reverse().slice(0, 5).map(card => ({ card, copies: copiesOf(card) })), upgradesOn: o.cards.some(c => c.pack.upgradesEnabled), }; }

nodes.body_text: // The alpha / beta label shown on the public site (ROADMAP 16.3): a banner strip, a pill beside the logo and a note in the admin header. // It reads the KV key `access:settings` (written by Settings -> Access, ROADMAP 16.1) and only needs `label`, `mode` and `message` from it, // so this helper stands on its own: it can be swapped for the access settings reader once both are in. import { cache } from 'react'; import { prodKv } from './db'; export const BANNER_DEFAULT: Record<SiteLabel, string> = { alpha: 'Alpha: things may change, and progress may be reset before launch.', beta: 'Beta: things may change, and progress may be reset before launch.', }; /** Reads whatever was stored (a JSON string or an object); anything unexpected means no label. Pure, for the check. */ /** The banner text: the admin's message when set, else the default for the label. */ /** The admin header's "Site: ..." text, or null when the site is open with no label. */ /** Cached per request. A database error means no label, so a blip never breaks a page. */ export const getSiteLabel = cache(async (): Promise<SiteLabelInfo> => { try { return parseSiteLabel(await prodKv.get('access:settings')); } catch { return { label: null, mode: 'open' }; } });

nodes.name: parseSiteLabel
nodes.body_text: function parseSiteLabel(raw: unknown): SiteLabelInfo { let o: unknown = raw; if (typeof raw === 'string') { try { o = JSON.parse(raw); } catch { o = null; } } const r = (o && typeof o === 'object' ? o : {}) as Record<string, unknown>; const message = typeof r.message === 'string' ? r.message.trim().slice(0, 300) : ''; return { label: r.label === 'alpha' || r.label === 'beta' ? r.label : null, mode: r.mode === 'alpha' || r.mode === 'beta' ? r.mode : 'open', ...(message ? { message } : {}), }; }

[{ id: `copy:${uid}`, kind: 'copy', label: `Print #${uid}`, href: `/c/${uid}`, hint: 'Card print' }] : []; } const box = (await currentSandboxId().catch(() => null)) ?? 'prod'; const active = await getActiveSeasonWithPacks(); if (!active) return []; const [usernames, cards, hidden] = await Promise.all([ viewerCache.get(`${box}:${active.season.id}`, async () => Object.keys(await getCollection(active.season.collectionName))), cardCache.get(`${box}:${active.season.id}`, async () => active.packs.flatMap(p => p.cards.map(c => ({ number: c.number, name: c.name, stars: c.stars, thumb: stillFor(c, c.imageUrl) })))), getHiddenUsers().catch(() => new Set<string>()), ]); return rankSearch(buildEntityItems(usernames, hidden, cards), query, limit); }

nodes.body_text: import { scoreItem } from './palette'; // The public site's search (pure, client-safe): what can be found, how queries are cleaned and how results are ranked. // Pages are searched in the browser; viewers and cards come from GET /api/search. Viewers an admin has hidden from public // boards never appear here (their own page still works if you know the address). export const PUBLIC_PAGES: SearchItem[] = [ { id: 'page:home', kind: 'page', label: 'Home', href: '/', keywords: ['start', 'main'] }, { id: 'page:leaderboard', kind: 'page', label: 'Leaderboard', href: '/leaderboard', keywords: ['ranking', 'top', 'points', 'score'] }, { id: 'page:collection', kind: 'page', label: 'Find a collector', href: '/collection', keywords: ['collections', 'collectors', 'players', 'search', 'viewer'] }, { id: 'page:cards', kind: 'page', label: 'Card dex', href: '/cards', keywords: ['cards', 'rarity', 'odds'] }, { id: 'page:stats', kind: 'page', label: 'Season stats', href: '/stats', keywords: ['numbers', 'charts'] }, { id: 'page:trade', kind: 'page', label: 'Trade', href: '/trade', keywords: ['swap', 'offers', 'board'] }, { id: 'page:faq', kind: 'page', label: 'FAQ', href: '/faq', keywords: ['help', 'how', 'points', 'upgrade', 'variants'] }, { id: 'page:changelog', kind: 'page', label: "What's new", href: '/changelog', keywords: ['changelog', 'updates', 'news', 'changes', 'release notes'] }, { id: 'page:install', kind: 'page', label: 'Get the app', href: '/install', keywords: ['install', 'home screen', 'add to home screen', 'ios', 'android', 'iphone', 'pwa', 'app'] }, { id: 'page:account', kind: 'page', label: 'My stats', href: '/account', keywords: ['account', 'profile', 'me', 'upgrade'] }, { id: 'page:privacy', kind: 'page', label: 'Privacy policy', href: '/privacy' }, { id: 'page:terms', kind: 'page', label: 'Terms of use', href: '/terms', keywords: ['eula'] }, ]; export const MAX_QUERY = 40; const LIMITS: Record<SearchKind, number> = { page: 3, player: 5, card: 4, copy: 1 }; /** What the user typed, made safe to send and match: trimmed, no control characters, no leading @, length-capped. */ /** Search items for the entities on the server: the active season's viewers (hidden ones excluded) and cards. */ /** Best matches first, with a cap per kind so one kind can't crowd the rest out. */

nodes.name: SearchKind
nodes.body_text: type SearchKind = 'page' | 'player' | 'card' | 'copy';

nodes.name: SearchItem
nodes.body_text: interface SearchItem { id: string; kind: SearchKind; label: string; href: string; hint?: string; keywords?: string[]; /** Cards: the static thumbnail, shown beside the name. */ image?: string; stars?: number; }

nodes.name: cleanQuery
nodes.body_text: function cleanQuery(raw: string): string { return raw.replace(/[\u0000-\u001f\u007f]/g, '').trim().replace(/^@+/, '').slice(0, MAX_QUERY); }

nodes.name: buildEntityItems
nodes.signature: function buildEntityItems( usernames: string[], hidden: Set<string>, cards: { number: number; name: string; stars: number; thumb?: string }[], ): SearchItem[]
nodes.body_text: function buildEntityItems( usernames: string[], hidden: Set<string>, cards: { number: number; name: string; stars: number; thumb?: string }[], ): SearchItem[] { const players = [...new Set(usernames.map(u => u.toLowerCase()))].filter(u => !hidden.has(u)).map<SearchItem>(u => ({ id: `player:${u}`, kind: 'player', label: u, href: `/u/${encodeURIComponent(u)}`, hint: 'Collector', })); const dex = cards.map<SearchItem>(c => ({ id: `card:${c.number}`, kind: 'card', label: c.name, href: `/cards?card=${c.number}`, hint: `Card #${c.number}`, image: c.thumb, stars: c.stars, })); return [...players, ...dex]; }

nodes.name: rankSearch
nodes.signature: function rankSearch(items: SearchItem[], rawQuery: string, limit = 10): SearchItem[]
nodes.body_text: function rankSearch(items: SearchItem[], rawQuery: string, limit = 10): SearchItem[] { const q = cleanQuery(rawQuery); if (!q) return []; const scored = items .map(it => ({ it, s: scoreItem(it, q) })) // Scattered-letter matching (a name that merely contains the letters in order) only produces noise ("ali" finding the card // "Goatlygidds", "alic" finding "Privacy policy"): a result must start with, contain or be keyed by what was typed. .filter(x => x.s >= 25) .sort((a, b) => b.s - a.s || a.it.label.localeCompare(b.it.label)); const taken: Record<SearchKind, number> = { page: 0, player: 0, card: 0, copy: 0 }; const out: SearchItem[] = []; for (const { it } of scored) { if (taken[it.kind] >= LIMITS[it.kind]) continue; taken[it.kind]++; out.push(it); if (out.length >= limit) break; } return out; }
