nodes.body_text: // Staff badges on public pages (Streamer / Admin / Mod). Pure helper plus the cached server read. // Never used by the Twitch panel (freeze). import { cache } from 'react'; import { staffBadgeFor, type StaffBadge } from './staff-badge-core'; import { CHANNEL_LOGIN } from './site'; import { listStaff, listSuperAdmins } from './staff'; import { getUserSettings } from './user-settings-store'; export { staffBadgeFor, STAFF_BADGE_LABELS, type StaffBadge } from './staff-badge-core'; /** Every visible badge on the site, login -> badge. Read live from the staff list, once per request. */ export const getStaffBadges = cache(async (): Promise<Record<string, StaffBadge>> => { try { const staff = await listStaff(); const supers = listSuperAdmins().map(s => s.login).filter(l => !l.startsWith('Twitch ID')); const logins = [...new Set([...staff.map(r => r.login), ...supers.map(s => s.toLowerCase()), CHANNEL_LOGIN])]; const out: Record<string, StaffBadge> = {}; await Promise.all(logins.map(async l => { const badge = staffBadgeFor(l, staff, await getUserSettings(l).catch(() => null), supers); if (badge) out[l] = badge; })); return out; } catch { return {}; } });

nodes.name: staff-core.ts
nodes.body_text: // Who may use the admin and mod panels (pure, edge-safe: no node or framework imports, because the middleware uses it). // // Three roles: // super the owner. Hard-coded below by Twitch ID, can never be removed or demoted, manages everyone. // admin the full admin panel; can add and remove mods. // mod the mod panel only (live activity, moderating viewers, moderating trades). // Staff are Twitch accounts: they sign in with "Log in with Twitch" and their role is looked up from the staff list. /** What a role may do: 'admin' = the admin panel, 'mod' = the mod panel, 'staff:mods' / 'staff:admins' = add and remove those roles. */ /** * The super admin. Matched by Twitch's numeric account ID, never by name alone: a Twitch login can be renamed and later * claimed by someone else, but the ID can't. More IDs can be added with the SUPER_ADMIN_TWITCH_IDS env var (comma separated). */ export const SUPER_ADMINS: { login: string; twitchId: string }[] = [{ login: 'joshmiles', twitchId: '36094918' }]; export const ROLE_LABELS: Record<StaffRole, string> = { super: 'Super admin', admin: 'Admin', mod: 'Mod' }; export const STAFF_ROLES = ['admin', 'mod'] as const; const CAPABILITIES: Record<StaffRole, readonly Capability[]> = { super: ['admin', 'mod', 'staff:mods', 'staff:admins'], admin: ['admin', 'mod', 'staff:mods'], mod: ['mod'], }; /** A staff member as stored. `twitchId` is filled in the first time they sign in (or from their viewer profile when they are added). */ /** Twitch logins are 3 to 25 letters, digits and underscores. Returns the lower-case login, or null if it can't be one. */ /** Is this Twitch account the super admin? The login is ignored on purpose: only the numeric ID counts. */ /** * The role a signed-in Twitch account has right now, from the staff list. The super admin comes from the code, not the list. * A record bound to a Twitch ID only matches that ID, so a renamed or re-claimed login can't inherit someone's access. */ /** May `actor` add, change or remove someone whose role is `target`? Admins manage mods; only the super admin manages admins. The super admin is untouchable. */ /** Where a role lands after signing in. */ /** A post-login destination, only if it is inside a panel this role may open. */ /** Cleans a stored record read back from KV (drops anything unexpected). */

nodes.name: StaffRole
nodes.body_text: type StaffRole = 'super' | 'admin' | 'mod';

nodes.name: Capability
nodes.body_text: type Capability = 'admin' | 'mod' | 'staff:mods' | 'staff:admins';

nodes.name: AssignableRole
nodes.body_text: type AssignableRole = (typeof STAFF_ROLES)[number];

nodes.name: roleCan
nodes.signature: roleCan = (role: StaffRole | null | undefined, cap: Capability): boolean
nodes.body_text: roleCan = (role: StaffRole | null | undefined, cap: Capability): boolean => !!role && CAPABILITIES[role].includes(cap)

nodes.name: StaffRecord
nodes.body_text: interface StaffRecord { login: string; twitchId?: string; displayName?: string; role: AssignableRole; addedBy: string; addedAt: number; lastLogin?: number; }

nodes.name: cleanLogin
nodes.body_text: function cleanLogin(input: unknown): string | null { if (typeof input !== 'string') return null; const s = input.trim().replace(/^@/, '').toLowerCase(); return /^[a-z0-9_]{3,25}$/.test(s) ? s : null; }

nodes.name: isTwitchId
nodes.body_text: isTwitchId = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && /^\d{1,20}$/.test(v)

nodes.name: superIds
nodes.signature: function superIds(env: Record<string, string | undefined> = process.env): Set<string>
nodes.body_text: function superIds(env: Record<string, string | undefined> = process.env): Set<string> { const ids = new Set(SUPER_ADMINS.map(s => s.twitchId)); for (const id of (env.SUPER_ADMIN_TWITCH_IDS ?? '').split(',')) if (isTwitchId(id.trim())) ids.add(id.trim()); return ids; }

nodes.name: isSuperAdmin
nodes.signature: function isSuperAdmin(identity: { twitchId?: string | null }, env?: Record<string, string | undefined>): boolean
nodes.body_text: function isSuperAdmin(identity: { twitchId?: string | null }, env?: Record<string, string | undefined>): boolean { return !!identity.twitchId && superIds(env).has(identity.twitchId); }

nodes.name: resolveRole
nodes.signature: function resolveRole(identity: { login: string; twitchId?: string | null }, record: StaffRecord | null | undefined, env?: Record<string, string | undefined>): StaffRole | null
nodes.body_text: function resolveRole(identity: { login: string; twitchId?: string | null }, record: StaffRecord | null | undefined, env?: Record<string, string | undefined>): StaffRole | null { if (isSuperAdmin(identity, env)) return 'super'; if (!record || record.login !== identity.login.toLowerCase()) return null; if (record.twitchId && record.twitchId !== identity.twitchId) return null; return record.role; }

nodes.name: canManage
nodes.signature: function canManage(actor: StaffRole | null | undefined, target: StaffRole): boolean
nodes.body_text: function canManage(actor: StaffRole | null | undefined, target: StaffRole): boolean { if (target === 'super') return false; return roleCan(actor, target === 'admin' ? 'staff:admins' : 'staff:mods'); }

nodes.name: homePath
nodes.body_text: homePath = (role: StaffRole): string => (roleCan(role, 'admin') ? '/admin' : '/mod')

nodes.name: staffReturnTo
nodes.signature: function staffReturnTo(raw: string | null | undefined, role: StaffRole): string
nodes.body_text: function staffReturnTo(raw: string | null | undefined, role: StaffRole): string { const ok = !!raw && raw.startsWith('/') && !raw.startsWith('//') && !raw.startsWith('/\\') && !/[\r\n]/.test(raw); if (ok && raw!.startsWith('/admin') && roleCan(role, 'admin')) return raw!; if (ok && raw!.startsWith('/mod') && roleCan(role, 'mod')) return raw!; return homePath(role); }

nodes.name: sanitizeStaffRecord
nodes.body_text: function sanitizeStaffRecord(input: unknown): StaffRecord | null { if (!input || typeof input !== 'object') return null; const o = input as Record<string, unknown>; const login = cleanLogin(o.login); if (!login || (o.role !== 'admin' && o.role !== 'mod')) return null; return { login, ...(isTwitchId(o.twitchId) ? { twitchId: o.twitchId } : {}), ...(typeof o.displayName === 'string' && o.displayName ? { displayName: o.displayName.slice(0, 40) } : {}), role: o.role, addedBy: typeof o.addedBy === 'string' ? o.addedBy.slice(0, 40) : 'unknown', addedAt: typeof o.addedAt === 'number' ? o.addedAt : 0, ...(typeof o.lastLogin === 'number' ? { lastLogin: o.lastLogin } : {}), }; }

nodes.name: staff-guard.ts
nodes.body_text: import { cache } from 'react'; import { cookies } from 'next/headers'; import { AUTH_COOKIE, isPasswordLoginEnabled, isValidAdminToken } from './admin-token'; import { getStaffRecord } from './staff'; import type { Session } from './session'; import { roleCan, resolveRole, type Capability, type StaffRole } from './staff-core'; import { STAFF_COOKIE, renewStaffToken, staffCookieOptions, verifyStaffToken } from './staff-token'; // Who is making this request, as staff. The authoritative check (server actions, API routes and the panel layouts call this); // the middleware only does the coarse, database-free version from the signed cookie. /** * The signed-in staff member for this request, or null. A Twitch staff cookie is re-checked against the live staff list on every * call (so removing someone, or changing their role, takes effect at once for anything they change). The old admin password * cookie still counts as a super admin unless ADMIN_PASSWORD_LOGIN=off. */ export const getStaff = cache(async (): Promise<StaffContext | null> => { const jar = await cookies(); const token = await verifyStaffToken(jar.get(STAFF_COOKIE)?.value); if (token) { const role = resolveRole({ login: token.u, twitchId: token.id }, await getStaffRecord(token.u)); if (role) return { login: token.u, twitchId: token.id, displayName: token.dn || token.u, role, via: 'twitch' }; } if (isPasswordLoginEnabled() && isValidAdminToken(jar.get(AUTH_COOKIE)?.value)) { return { login: 'password', displayName: 'Admin (password)', role: 'super', via: 'password' }; } return null; }); /** * The panel link for the public site's top bar: where this visitor's staff role takes them, or null for everyone else. A signed-in * viewer is looked up in the staff list (so staff see the button without having opened a panel yet; the link then signs them in * through /auth/staff), and a password-only admin is recognised from their cookie. The link is only a convenience: the panels * check access again themselves. */ export const staffPanelLink = cache(async (session: Session | null): Promise<{ href: string; label: string } | null> => { let role: StaffRole | null = null; if (session && !session.sandbox) role = resolveRole({ login: session.username, twitchId: session.twitchId }, await getStaffRecord(session.username)); if (!role) role = (await getStaff())?.role ?? null; if (!role) return null; return roleCan(role, 'admin') ? { href: '/admin', label: 'Admin panel' } : { href: '/mod', label: 'Mod panel' }; }); /** * Slide the staff cookie forward: when it has under 30 minutes left (and the session is under 12 hours old), re-issue it with the * live role, so an open activity feed keeps working. Only runs for a Twitch staff session that getStaff just re-checked, so a removed * member is never renewed. Setting a cookie is only allowed in route handlers and actions; anywhere else (a page render) it is skipped. */ /** Throws unless the caller is staff with this capability. Returns who they are, for the audit trail. */ /** True when the caller is staff with this capability (for API routes that answer 401 instead of throwing). */

nodes.name: StaffContext
nodes.body_text: interface StaffContext { /** Lower-case Twitch login (or "password" for the emergency password login). */ login: string; twitchId?: string; displayName: string; role: StaffRole; via: 'twitch' | 'password'; }

nodes.name: renewStaffCookie
nodes.body_text: async function renewStaffCookie(s: StaffContext): Promise<void> { if (s.via !== 'twitch') return; try { const jar = await cookies(); const token = await verifyStaffToken(jar.get(STAFF_COOKIE)?.value); if (!token) return; const fresh = await renewStaffToken(token, s.role); if (fresh) jar.set(STAFF_COOKIE, fresh, staffCookieOptions()); } catch { /* cookies are read-only here; the next action or poll renews it */ } }

nodes.name: requireStaff
nodes.body_text: async function requireStaff(cap: Capability = 'mod'): Promise<StaffContext> { const s = await getStaff(); if (!s || !roleCan(s.role, cap)) throw new Error('Not authorised.'); await renewStaffCookie(s); return s; }

nodes.name: hasStaffCapability
nodes.body_text: async function hasStaffCapability(cap: Capability): Promise<boolean> { const s = await getStaff(); if (!s || !roleCan(s.role, cap)) return false; await renewStaffCookie(s); return true; }

nodes.name: staff-token.ts
nodes.body_text: // The signed staff cookie (edge-safe: Web Crypto only, so the middleware can verify it without a database). // // It says "this Twitch account was a <role> when it was issued" and lasts one hour; staff guard calls slide it forward (renewStaffToken) // until 12 hours after the first issue (`iat`), after which only a real sign-in through /auth/staff gives a new one. The middleware uses it for coarse gating // (which panel); every action and API route still re-checks the live staff list (lib/staff-guard.ts), so removing someone // stops their changes at once and their page views within the hour. Signed with SESSION_SECRET (the same secret as the // viewer session), so it can be read but not forged. import type { StaffRole } from './staff-core'; export const STAFF_COOKIE = 'tcg_staff'; export const STAFF_TTL_S = 60 * 60; /** Renew when less than this is left. */ export const STAFF_RENEW_BELOW_S = 30 * 60; /** A session cannot be renewed past this long after its first issue. */ export const STAFF_MAX_SESSION_S = 12 * 60 * 60; const enc = new TextEncoder(); /** The token's contents if it is genuine and not expired, else null. */ /** True when this token should be re-issued now: under 30 minutes left and still inside the 12-hour cap (older tokens without `iat` count their first issue as exp minus one hour). */ /** A fresh cookie value for a token that is due for renewal (same first-issue time, the live role), else null. */

nodes.name: StaffToken
nodes.body_text: interface StaffToken { u: string; id: string; dn: string; role: StaffRole; exp: number; iat?: number }

nodes.name: b64url
nodes.body_text: b64url = (bytes: Uint8Array) => btoa(String.fromCharCode(...bytes)).replace(/\+/g, '-').replace(/\//g, '_').replace(/=+$/, '')

nodes.name: fromB64url
nodes.body_text: fromB64url = (s: string) => Uint8Array.from(atob(s.replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/')), c => c.charCodeAt(0))

nodes.name: secret
nodes.signature: function secret(env: Record<string, string | undefined> = process.env): string | null
nodes.body_text: function secret(env: Record<string, string | undefined> = process.env): string | null { const s = env.SESSION_SECRET; return s && s.length >= 16 ? s : null; }

nodes.name: hmac
nodes.signature: async function hmac(payload: string, key: string): Promise<Uint8Array>
nodes.body_text: async function hmac(payload: string, key: string): Promise<Uint8Array> { const k = await crypto.subtle.importKey('raw', enc.encode(key), { name: 'HMAC', hash: 'SHA-256' }, false, ['sign']); return new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.sign('HMAC', k, enc.encode(payload))); }

nodes.name: same
nodes.body_text: same = (a: Uint8Array, b: Uint8Array) => { if (a.length !== b.length) return false; let d = 0; for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) d |= a[i] ^ b[i]; return d === 0; }

nodes.name: signStaffToken
nodes.signature: async function signStaffToken(data: Omit<StaffToken, 'exp' | 'iat'> & { iat?: number }, now = Date.now(), env?: Record<string, string | undefined>): Promise<string | null>
nodes.body_text: async function signStaffToken(data: Omit<StaffToken, 'exp' | 'iat'> & { iat?: number }, now = Date.now(), env?: Record<string, string | undefined>): Promise<string | null> { const key = secret(env); if (!key) return null; const nowS = Math.floor(now / 1000); const token: StaffToken = { ...data, iat: data.iat ?? nowS, exp: nowS + STAFF_TTL_S }; const payload = b64url(enc.encode(JSON.stringify(token))); return `${payload}.${b64url(await hmac(payload, key))}`; }

nodes.name: verifyStaffToken
nodes.signature: async function verifyStaffToken(raw: string | undefined, now = Date.now(), env?: Record<string, string | undefined>): Promise<StaffToken | null>
nodes.body_text: async function verifyStaffToken(raw: string | undefined, now = Date.now(), env?: Record<string, string | undefined>): Promise<StaffToken | null> { const key = secret(env); if (!key || !raw) return null; const parts = raw.split('.'); if (parts.length !== 2 || !parts[0] || !parts[1]) return null; try { if (!same(await hmac(parts[0], key), fromB64url(parts[1]))) return null; const t = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(fromB64url(parts[0]))) as StaffToken; if (typeof t.u !== 'string' || typeof t.id !== 'string' || typeof t.exp !== 'number' || t.exp < now / 1000) return null; if (t.role !== 'super' && t.role !== 'admin' && t.role !== 'mod') return null; return t; } catch { return null; } }

nodes.name: shouldRenewStaffToken
nodes.signature: function shouldRenewStaffToken(t: StaffToken, now = Date.now()): boolean
nodes.body_text: function shouldRenewStaffToken(t: StaffToken, now = Date.now()): boolean { const nowS = now / 1000; const iat = typeof t.iat === 'number' ? t.iat : t.exp - STAFF_TTL_S; return t.exp - nowS < STAFF_RENEW_BELOW_S && nowS - iat < STAFF_MAX_SESSION_S; }

nodes.name: renewStaffToken
nodes.signature: async function renewStaffToken(t: StaffToken, role: StaffRole, now = Date.now(), env?: Record<string, string | undefined>): Promise<string | null>
nodes.body_text: async function renewStaffToken(t: StaffToken, role: StaffRole, now = Date.now(), env?: Record<string, string | undefined>): Promise<string | null> { if (!shouldRenewStaffToken(t, now)) return null; return signStaffToken({ u: t.u, id: t.id, dn: t.dn, role, iat: typeof t.iat === 'number' ? t.iat : t.exp - STAFF_TTL_S }, now, env); }

nodes.name: staffCookieOptions
nodes.body_text: function staffCookieOptions(maxAge = STAFF_TTL_S) { return { httpOnly: true, secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production', sameSite: 'lax' as const, path: '/', maxAge }; }

nodes.name: staff.ts
nodes.body_text: // The staff list (server side). Stored in KV as the hash `staff:members` (login -> record) with a capped change log `staff:log`. // // Staff are real accounts, not test data, so they live in the PRODUCTION namespace even while an admin is inside a sandbox // (`prodKv`, not the sandbox-aware `kv`). Otherwise entering a sandbox would make every staff member look like a stranger. import { notifyAdminLog } from './discord'; import { isPreview, prodKv, runInSandbox } from './db'; import { getUserProfile } from './kv'; import { SUPER_ADMINS, canManage, cleanLogin, isSuperAdmin, isTwitchId, sanitizeStaffRecord, type AssignableRole, type StaffRecord, type StaffRole, } from './staff-core'; const MEMBERS = 'staff:members'; const LOG = 'staff:log'; const LOG_CAP = 200; /** The staff list is real account data shared with production, so preview deployments (which are fenced from writing it) can't change it. */ const PREVIEW_REFUSAL: StaffResult = { ok: false, message: 'Staff cannot be changed on a preview deployment. Do it on the live site.' }; /** Everyone on the staff list (not the super admin, who comes from the code), admins first, then by name. */ /** The fixed super admins, for display (from the code, and any extra IDs in the environment). */ /** A viewer's Twitch ID from their profile, if they have played (so a new staff member is bound to the account, not just the name). */ /** Notes a sign-in: stamps the time, and binds the record to the account's Twitch ID the first time (never rebinds). */

nodes.name: StaffActor
nodes.body_text: interface StaffActor { login: string; role: StaffRole }

nodes.name: StaffResult
nodes.body_text: interface StaffResult { ok: boolean; message: string }

nodes.name: StaffLogEntry
nodes.body_text: interface StaffLogEntry { at: number; by: string; action: 'added' | 'role' | 'removed'; login: string; detail: string }

nodes.name: getStaffRecord
nodes.signature: async function getStaffRecord(login: string): Promise<StaffRecord | null>
nodes.body_text: async function getStaffRecord(login: string): Promise<StaffRecord | null> { const l = cleanLogin(login); if (!l) return null; try { return sanitizeStaffRecord(await prodKv.hget(MEMBERS, l)); } catch { return null; } }

nodes.name: listStaff
nodes.body_text: async function listStaff(): Promise<StaffRecord[]> { try { const all = (await prodKv.hgetall(MEMBERS)) ?? {}; return Object.values(all).map(sanitizeStaffRecord).filter((r): r is StaffRecord => !!r) .sort((a, b) => (a.role === b.role ? a.login.localeCompare(b.login) : a.role === 'admin' ? -1 : 1)); } catch { return []; } }

nodes.name: getStaffLog
nodes.body_text: async function getStaffLog(limit = 40): Promise<StaffLogEntry[]> { try { return (await prodKv.lrange<StaffLogEntry>(LOG, 0, limit - 1)) ?? []; } catch { return []; } }

nodes.name: log
nodes.body_text: async function log(entry: Omit<StaffLogEntry, 'at'>) { void notifyAdminLog({ action: `Staff ${entry.action}`, subject: entry.login, detail: entry.detail, by: entry.by }); try { await prodKv.lpush(LOG, { at: Date.now(), ...entry }); await prodKv.ltrim(LOG, 0, LOG_CAP - 1); } catch { /* best effort */ } }

nodes.name: listSuperAdmins
nodes.signature: function listSuperAdmins(): { login: string; twitchId: string }[]
nodes.body_text: function listSuperAdmins(): { login: string; twitchId: string }[] { const extra = (process.env.SUPER_ADMIN_TWITCH_IDS ?? '').split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(isTwitchId) .filter(id => !SUPER_ADMINS.some(s => s.twitchId === id)).map(id => ({ login: `Twitch ID ${id}`, twitchId: id })); return [...SUPER_ADMINS, ...extra]; }

nodes.name: knownTwitchId
nodes.signature: async function knownTwitchId(login: string): Promise<{ id?: string; displayName?: string }>
nodes.body_text: async function knownTwitchId(login: string): Promise<{ id?: string; displayName?: string }> { try { const p = await runInSandbox(null, () => getUserProfile(login)); return { id: isTwitchId(p?.twitchId) ? p!.twitchId : undefined, displayName: p?.displayName }; } catch { return {}; } }

nodes.name: addStaff
nodes.signature: async function addStaff(actor: StaffActor, loginInput: unknown, role: AssignableRole): Promise<StaffResult>
nodes.body_text: async function addStaff(actor: StaffActor, loginInput: unknown, role: AssignableRole): Promise<StaffResult> { if (isPreview()) return PREVIEW_REFUSAL; const login = cleanLogin(loginInput); if (!login) return { ok: false, message: 'Enter a Twitch username (3 to 25 letters, numbers or underscores).' }; if (role !== 'admin' && role !== 'mod') return { ok: false, message: 'Pick a role.' }; if (!canManage(actor.role, role)) return { ok: false, message: role === 'admin' ? 'Only the super admin can add admins.' : 'You can\'t add mods.' }; if (SUPER_ADMINS.some(s => s.login === login)) return { ok: false, message: `${login} is the super admin already.` }; if (await getStaffRecord(login)) return { ok: false, message: `${login} is already staff. Change their role instead.` }; const known = await knownTwitchId(login); if (known.id && isSuperAdmin({ twitchId: known.id })) return { ok: false, message: `${login} is the super admin already.` }; const record: StaffRecord = { login, role, addedBy: actor.login, addedAt: Date.now(), ...(known.id ? { twitchId: known.id } : {}), ...(known.displayName ? { displayName: known.displayName } : {}), }; await prodKv.hset(MEMBERS, { [login]: record }); await log({ by: actor.login, action: 'added', login, detail: `as ${role}` }); return { ok: true, message: `${known.displayName ?? login} is now ${role === 'admin' ? 'an admin' : 'a mod'}.${known.id ? '' : ' They have not played yet, so the name is matched until they first sign in.'}` }; }

nodes.name: setStaffRole
nodes.signature: async function setStaffRole(actor: StaffActor, loginInput: unknown, role: AssignableRole): Promise<StaffResult>
nodes.body_text: async function setStaffRole(actor: StaffActor, loginInput: unknown, role: AssignableRole): Promise<StaffResult> { if (isPreview()) return PREVIEW_REFUSAL; const login = cleanLogin(loginInput); const rec = login ? await getStaffRecord(login) : null; if (!login || !rec) return { ok: false, message: 'That person isn\'t on the staff list.' }; if (role !== 'admin' && role !== 'mod') return { ok: false, message: 'Pick a role.' }; // Both the role they have and the role they would get must be one the actor may manage (so an admin can't promote a mod to admin). // Checked before anything else, so a caller with no rights never gets a success message. if (!canManage(actor.role, rec.role) || !canManage(actor.role, role)) return { ok: false, message: actor.role === 'mod' ? 'You can\'t change staff.' : 'Only the super admin can change admins or make someone an admin.' }; if (rec.role === role) return { ok: true, message: `${login} is already ${role === 'admin' ? 'an admin' : 'a mod'}.` }; await prodKv.hset(MEMBERS, { [login]: { ...rec, role } }); await log({ by: actor.login, action: 'role', login, detail: `${rec.role} to ${role}` }); return { ok: true, message: `${login} is now ${role === 'admin' ? 'an admin' : 'a mod'}.` }; }

nodes.name: removeStaff
nodes.signature: async function removeStaff(actor: StaffActor, loginInput: unknown): Promise<StaffResult>
nodes.body_text: async function removeStaff(actor: StaffActor, loginInput: unknown): Promise<StaffResult> { if (isPreview()) return PREVIEW_REFUSAL; const login = cleanLogin(loginInput); const rec = login ? await getStaffRecord(login) : null; if (!login || !rec) return { ok: false, message: 'That person isn\'t on the staff list.' }; if (!canManage(actor.role, rec.role)) return { ok: false, message: 'Only the super admin can remove admins.' }; await prodKv.hdel(MEMBERS, login); await log({ by: actor.login, action: 'removed', login, detail: `was ${rec.role}` }); return { ok: true, message: `${login} is no longer staff.` }; }

nodes.name: touchStaffLogin
nodes.signature: async function touchStaffLogin(login: string, twitchId: string, displayName: string): Promise<void>
nodes.body_text: async function touchStaffLogin(login: string, twitchId: string, displayName: string): Promise<void> { if (isPreview()) return; // best effort, and a preview must not write the shared staff list try { const rec = await getStaffRecord(login); if (!rec) return; await prodKv.hset(MEMBERS, { [rec.login]: { ...rec, twitchId: rec.twitchId ?? twitchId, displayName, lastLogin: Date.now() } }); } catch { /* best effort */ } }

nodes.name: stats.ts
nodes.body_text: import { kv } from './db'; // A small time-series store behind the dashboard charts. recordActivity() calls recordStats() for every event, which bumps hourly // counters in one hash per season collection (`stats:h:<collection>`, field "<UTC hour>|<metric>") and adds the viewer to that // day's set (`stats:u:<collection>:<UTC day>`). The activity log is capped at 500 events, so it can't answer "pulls per day this // season"; these counters can. They only count from when tracking began (`stats:since:<collection>`). export const METRICS: Metric[] = ['pull', 'newCard', 'newViewer', 'upgrade', 'trade', 'grant', 'v:reverse', 'v:full', 'v:shiny']; const HOUR = 3_600_000; const DAY = 24 * HOUR; /** Counts one activity event. Never throws: statistics must not break the action they describe. */ export const RANGES: Range[] = [{ id: '24h', label: '24 hours' }, { id: '7d', label: '7 days' }, { id: 'season', label: 'Season' }]; /** Buckets for a range ending now: hourly for 24h, daily otherwise (the season range starts at `seasonStart`, at most 90 days back). */ /** The series for the given buckets (and, for a comparison, pass the previous period's buckets). */ /** Pulls per pack name since tracking began, summed over the given season collections. Powers the "share of draws" on the pack library. */ /** When each viewer was last seen doing something (pull, upgrade, trade, grant), since tracking began. */

nodes.name: Metric
nodes.body_text: type Metric = 'pull' | 'newCard' | 'newViewer' | 'upgrade' | 'trade' | 'grant' | 'v:reverse' | 'v:full' | 'v:shiny';

nodes.name: pad
nodes.body_text: pad = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, '0')

nodes.name: hourKey
nodes.body_text: hourKey = (t: number) => { const d = new Date(t); return `${d.getUTCFullYear()}${pad(d.getUTCMonth() + 1)}${pad(d.getUTCDate())}${pad(d.getUTCHours())}`; }

nodes.name: dayKey
nodes.body_text: dayKey = (t: number) => hourKey(t).slice(0, 8)

nodes.name: StatEvent
nodes.body_text: interface StatEvent { type: string; username: string; collectionName?: string; [k: string]: unknown; }

nodes.name: recordStats
nodes.signature: async function recordStats(e: StatEvent, at = Date.now()): Promise<void>
nodes.body_text: async function recordStats(e: StatEvent, at = Date.now()): Promise<void> { const coll = e.collectionName; if (!coll) return; try { const bumps: Metric[] = []; // A card granted by webhook (a Mix It Up reward) counts as a pull everywhere the numbers are shown (the weekly digest, the dashboard charts). if (e.type === 'pull' || (e.type === 'grant' && e.source === 'webhook')) { bumps.push('pull'); if (e.isNew) bumps.push('newCard'); if (e.copies === 1 && e.uniqueOwned === 1) bumps.push('newViewer'); if (typeof e.packName === 'string' && e.packName) bumps.push(`p:${e.packName}` as Metric); const v = e.variant as string | undefined; if (v === 'reverse' || v === 'full' || v === 'shiny') bumps.push(`v:${v}` as Metric); } else if (e.type === 'upgrade') bumps.push('upgrade'); else if (e.type === 'trade' && e.action === 'accepted') bumps.push('trade'); else if (e.type === 'grant') bumps.push('grant'); // an admin grant if (bumps.length === 0) return; const key = `stats:h:${coll}`; const h = hourKey(at); await Promise.all(bumps.map(m => kv.hincrby(key, `${h}|${m}`, 1))); await kv.set(`stats:since:${coll}`, at, { nx: true }); if (e.username) { await kv.sadd(`stats:u:${coll}:${dayKey(at)}`, e.username); await kv.hset('stats:last', { [e.username]: at }); // when each viewer was last seen (the Users page) } } catch { /* best effort */ } }

nodes.name: Series
nodes.body_text: interface Series { /** Bucket start times (ms), oldest first. */ starts: number[]; step: 'hour' | 'day'; /** One number per bucket, per metric. */ data: Record<Metric, number[]>; /** Distinct active viewers per day-bucket (day step only; hour step leaves it empty). */ viewers: number[]; /** When tracking began, or null if nothing has been recorded. */ since: number | null; }

nodes.name: Range
nodes.body_text: interface Range { id: '24h' | '7d' | 'season'; label: string }

nodes.name: bucketsFor
nodes.signature: function bucketsFor(range: Range['id'], seasonStart: number, now = Date.now()): { starts: number[]; step: 'hour' | 'day' }
nodes.body_text: function bucketsFor(range: Range['id'], seasonStart: number, now = Date.now()): { starts: number[]; step: 'hour' | 'day' } { if (range === '24h') { const end = Math.floor(now / HOUR) * HOUR; return { step: 'hour', starts: Array.from({ length: 24 }, (_, i) => end - (23 - i) * HOUR) }; } const endDay = Math.floor(now / DAY) * DAY; const days = range === '7d' ? 7 : Math.max(2, Math.min(90, Math.ceil((endDay - Math.floor(seasonStart / DAY) * DAY) / DAY) + 1)); return { step: 'day', starts: Array.from({ length: days }, (_, i) => endDay - (days - 1 - i) * DAY) }; }

nodes.name: getSeries
nodes.signature: async function getSeries(coll: string, starts: number[], step: 'hour' | 'day'): Promise<Series>
nodes.body_text: async function getSeries(coll: string, starts: number[], step: 'hour' | 'day'): Promise<Series> { const empty = () => Object.fromEntries(METRICS.map(m => [m, starts.map(() => 0)])) as Record<Metric, number[]>; try { const [hash, since] = await Promise.all([kv.hgetall<Record<string, number | string>>(`stats:h:${coll}`), kv.get<number>(`stats:since:${coll}`)]); const data = empty(); const span = step === 'hour' ? HOUR : DAY; const index = new Map(starts.map((s, i) => [step === 'hour' ? hourKey(s) : dayKey(s), i])); for (const [field, value] of Object.entries(hash ?? {})) { const bar = field.indexOf('|'); const h = field.slice(0, bar); const i = index.get(step === 'hour' ? h : h.slice(0, 8)); if (i === undefined) continue; const bucket = data[field.slice(bar + 1) as Metric]; if (bucket) bucket[i] += Number(value) || 0; // per-pack counters (p:<name>) aren't part of a series } const viewers = step === 'day' ? await Promise.all(starts.map(s => kv.scard(`stats:u:${coll}:${dayKey(s)}`).catch(() => 0))) : []; void span; return { starts, step, data, viewers, since: since ?? null }; } catch { return { starts, step, data: empty(), viewers: [], since: null }; } }

nodes.name: empty
nodes.body_text: empty = () => Object.fromEntries(METRICS.map(m => [m, starts.map(() => 0)])) as Record<Metric, number[]>

nodes.name: sum
nodes.body_text: sum = (xs: number[]) => xs.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0)

nodes.name: getPackPulls
nodes.signature: async function getPackPulls(collections: string[]): Promise<Record<string, number>>

nodes.body_text: import type { ActivityEvent } from './activity'; import { copyHrefFor } from './copy-link'; import { asPullEvent } from './activity-view'; import { VARIANTS } from './variants'; import type { Variant } from './types'; // The end-of-stream recap: a pure summary of the activity log between two times. Client-safe (no server imports) so the admin // dashboard widget and the Discord embed share the same shape. Posting and storing it is in lib/twitch-live.ts. // Left out on purpose: "biggest rank climb". Ranks come from the whole-season leaderboard, which the activity log cannot // replay cheaply (it would need a before and after leaderboard for the stream), so it is not part of the recap. /** * Summarises what happened between `from` and `to` (ms). `events` is the activity log in any order; `logIsFull` says the log was * at its cap, which together with an oldest event after `from` means the start of the stream has rolled out of it. */ /** A stream with no pulls gets no recap. */ /** Made-up numbers for the Discord channel card's test button when no real recap exists yet. */

nodes.name: RecapPull
nodes.body_text: interface RecapPull { username: string; cardName: string; stars: number; variant?: Variant; packName: string; /** Site path of the print, when the pull has one. */ href: string | null; serial?: number }

nodes.name: StreamRecap
nodes.body_text: interface StreamRecap { from: number; to: number; /** Packs opened (one pull is one pack). */ packs: number; /** Different cards among those pulls. */ distinctCards: number; /** Viewers who opened at least one pack. */ pullers: number; /** Viewers whose very first card came in this stream. */ newCollectors: string[]; /** Pulls that were the first print of their card ever. */ firstEver: RecapPull[]; rarest: RecapPull | null; topPuller: { username: string; packs: number } | null; tradesCompleted: number; /** True when the activity log (capped) no longer reaches back to the start of the stream, so the numbers are a floor. */ partial: boolean; }

nodes.name: variantRank
nodes.body_text: variantRank = (v?: Variant) => Math.max(0, VARIANTS.indexOf(v ?? 'regular'))

nodes.name: buildStreamRecap
nodes.signature: function buildStreamRecap(events: ActivityEvent[], from: number, to: number, opts: { seasonId?: string; logIsFull?: boolean } = {}): StreamRecap
nodes.body_text: function buildStreamRecap(events: ActivityEvent[], from: number, to: number, opts: { seasonId?: string; logIsFull?: boolean } = {}): StreamRecap { const inWindow = events.filter(e => e.at >= from && e.at <= to); // A card granted by webhook (a Mix It Up reward) is a pack opened as far as the stream is concerned. const pulls = inWindow.flatMap(e => asPullEvent(e) ?? []); const oldest = events.reduce((m, e) => Math.min(m, e.at), Infinity); const counts = new Map<string, number>(); for (const p of pulls) counts.set(p.username, (counts.get(p.username) ?? 0) + 1); let topPuller: StreamRecap['topPuller'] = null; for (const [username, packs] of counts) if (!topPuller || packs > topPuller.packs || (packs === topPuller.packs && username < topPuller.username)) topPuller = { username, packs }; const asPull = (p: ActivityEvent & { type: 'pull' }): RecapPull => ({ username: p.username, cardName: p.cardName, stars: p.stars, variant: p.variant, packName: p.packName, href: copyHrefFor(p, opts.seasonId ?? ''), ...(p.serial ? { serial: p.serial } : {}), }); let rarest: (ActivityEvent & { type: 'pull' }) | null = null; for (const p of pulls) { const better = !rarest || p.stars > rarest.stars || (p.stars === rarest.stars && (variantRank(p.variant) > variantRank(rarest.variant) || (variantRank(p.variant) === variantRank(rarest.variant) && p.at < rarest.at))); if (better) rarest = p; } return { from, to, packs: pulls.length, distinctCards: new Set(pulls.map(p => p.cardNumber)).size, pullers: counts.size, newCollectors: [...new Set(pulls.filter(p => p.isNew && p.uniqueOwned === 1).map(p => p.username))], firstEver: pulls.filter(p => p.serial === 1).map(asPull), rarest: rarest ? asPull(rarest) : null, topPuller, tradesCompleted: inWindow.filter(e => e.type === 'trade' && e.action === 'accepted').length, partial: !!opts.logIsFull && Number.isFinite(oldest) && oldest > from, }; }

nodes.name: asPull
nodes.body_text: asPull = (p: ActivityEvent & { type: 'pull' }): RecapPull => ({ username: p.username, cardName: p.cardName, stars: p.stars, variant: p.variant, packName: p.packName, href: copyHrefFor(p, opts.seasonId ?? ''), ...(p.serial ? { serial: p.serial } : {}), })

nodes.name: recapWorthPosting
nodes.body_text: recapWorthPosting = (r: StreamRecap) => r.packs > 0

nodes.name: sampleRecap
nodes.body_text: function sampleRecap(now = Date.now()): StreamRecap { return { from: now - 2 * 3_600_000 - 15 * 60_000, to: now, packs: 42, distinctCards: 27, pullers: 9, newCollectors: ['sample_viewer'], firstEver: [], tradesCompleted: 2, partial: false, topPuller: { username: 'sample_viewer', packs: 11 }, rarest: { username: 'sample_viewer', cardName: 'Sample Card', stars: 5, variant: 'shiny', packName: 'Sample Pack', href: null, serial: 1 }, }; }

nodes.body_text: import { kv } from './db'; import { notifySystem, escapeMd } from './discord'; import { formatBytes, loadDataHealth, sizeAttention, type HealthLevel } from './data-health'; import type { BackupRun } from './backup'; // The "System" Discord notices that come from the nightly job and the manual backup: the backup result and the data-health warning. // (Sandboxes and the live status post from where they happen.) Everything here swallows its own errors. /** A backup finished (a run) or failed (an error message). */ const RANK: Record<HealthLevel, number> = { ok: 0, warn: 1, high: 2 }; const KEY = 'discord:health:level'; /** Posts when a season's collection data gets bigger than it was at the last look (ok to warn, warn to high). Once per crossing, not daily. */

nodes.name: reportBackup
nodes.signature: async function reportBackup(result: BackupRun | { error: string }): Promise<void>
nodes.body_text: async function reportBackup(result: BackupRun | { error: string }): Promise<void> { try { if ('error' in result) { await notifySystem({ title: '⚠️ Backup failed', text: escapeMd(result.error).slice(0, 400), tone: 'bad' }); } else { await notifySystem({ title: '💾 Backup saved', tone: 'good', fields: [ { name: 'Size', value: formatBytes(result.bytes), inline: true }, { name: 'Keys', value: String(result.keys), inline: true }, ...(result.skipped ? [{ name: 'Skipped', value: String(result.skipped), inline: true }] : []), ], }); } } catch { /* best effort */ } }

nodes.name: reportDataHealth
nodes.body_text: async function reportDataHealth(): Promise<void> { try { const health = await loadDataHealth(); const worst = health.seasons.reduce<HealthLevel>((w, s) => (RANK[s.level] > RANK[w] ? s.level : w), 'ok'); const last = ((await kv.get<HealthLevel>(KEY)) ?? 'ok') as HealthLevel; await kv.set(KEY, worst); if (RANK[worst] <= RANK[last]) return; const lines = health.seasons.flatMap(s => { const a = sizeAttention(s.name, s.collection.bytes); return a ? [a.text] : []; }); await notifySystem({ title: worst === 'high' ? '🚨 Data health: large' : '📈 Data health: growing', text: lines.join('\n'), tone: 'bad' }); } catch { /* best effort */ } }

nodes.name: loadTradeAdminData
nodes.body_text: async function loadTradeAdminData() { await sweepTrades(); const [settings, open, history, seasons] = await Promise.all([getTradeSettings(), listOpenTrades(), tradeHistory(), listSeasons()]); const all: Trade[] = [...open, ...history]; const now = Date.now(); // Card names / points for every season that has a trade, and when each involved viewer first appeared. const cardsBySeason: Record<string, Record<number, TradeCardInfo>> = {}; const poolsBySeason: Record<string, TradePools> = {}; for (const s of seasons) if (all.some(t => t.seasonId === s.id)) { cardsBySeason[s.id] = await getTradeCards(s).catch(() => ({})); poolsBySeason[s.id] = await getTradePools(s, open).catch(() => ({ viewer: null, give: {}, mine: {} })); } const users = [...new Set(all.flatMap(t => [t.from, partnerOf(t)].filter((u): u is string => !!u)))]; const created = new Map<string, number>(); await Promise.all(users.map(async u => { const c = (await getUserProfile(u).catch(() => null))?.createdAt; if (c) created.set(u, c); })); const pts = (t: Trade, side: 'give' | 'get') => stackPoints(side === 'give' ? t.give : t.get, cardsBySeason[t.seasonId] ?? {}, side === 'give' ? poolsBySeason[t.seasonId]?.give[t.id] : undefined); const flags = flagTrades(all, { points: pts, createdAt: u => created.get(u) }); const stats = computeTradeStats(open, history, now); const seasonName = (id: string) => seasons.find(s => s.id === id)?.name ?? id; const row = (t: Trade, isOpen: boolean): TradeRow => { const cards = cardsBySeason[t.seasonId] ?? {}; const nameOf = (n: number) => cards[n]?.name; return { id: t.id, status: t.status, open: isOpen, kind: t.kind, from: t.from, to: t.to, takenBy: t.kind === 'listing' && t.status === 'accepted' ? t.resolvedBy : undefined, seasonId: t.seasonId, seasonName: seasonName(t.seasonId), giveText: describeItems(t.give, nameOf), getText: describeItems(t.get, nameOf), givePts: pts(t, 'give'), getPts: pts(t, 'get'), cardNames: [...t.give, ...t.get].map(i => nameOf(i.cardNumber) ?? `#${i.cardNumber}`).join(' '), note: t.note, reason: t.reason, resolvedBy: t.resolvedBy, staff: t.staff, counterOf: t.counterOf, createdAt: t.createdAt, resolvedAt: t.resolvedAt, expiresAt: t.expiresAt, reversedAt: t.reversedAt, reversedBy: t.reversedBy, reverseReason: t.reverseReason, flags: flags.get(t.id) ?? [], }; }; const rows = [...open.map(t => row(t, true)), ...history.map(t => row(t, false))]; const flaggedOpen = rows.filter(r => r.open && r.flags.length > 0).length; const flaggedRecent = rows.filter(r => !r.open && r.flags.length > 0 && now - (r.resolvedAt ?? r.createdAt) < 7 * 86_400_000).length; return { settings, open, history, seasons, rows, stats, cardsBySeason, flaggedOpen, flaggedRecent, now }; }

nodes.name: trade-core.ts
nodes.body_text: import type { Variant } from './types'; import { VARIANTS, VARIANT_LABELS, encodeEntry, removeEntries } from './variants'; import { parseCopyId } from './serials-core'; // The pure part of trading: types, validation of what a viewer sends, and the settlement maths. No database, so it is safe to // import in client components and easy to test (scripts/check-trades.mts). The rules that need data (limits, expiry, locks) // live in lib/trades.ts. // // ESCROW: when an offer is made, the copies the offerer gives are REMOVED from their collection and held by the trade. They go // to the other side on accept and come back to the offerer on cancel / decline / counter / expiry. So an open offer can never // be double-spent, and the offerer's side can never go stale. Copies are conserved exactly: collection + escrow is constant. /** A stack of identical copies: one card in one variant. */ /** * May this viewer see what is in the trade? A board listing is public; a direct offer only to the two people in it (the viewer is a * lowercase login, or none when signed out). Used by the trade page; staff look at offers in the admin and mod panels instead. */ export const DEFAULT_TRADE_SETTINGS: TradeSettings = { enabled: true, expiryHours: 48, maxOpenPerUser: 5, cooldownSeconds: 20, maxStacksPerSide: 8, minAccountHours: 0, }; export const TRADE_LIMITS = { expiryHours: { min: 1, max: 24 * 14 }, maxOpenPerUser: { min: 1, max: 50 }, cooldownSeconds: { min: 0, max: 3600 }, maxStacksPerSide: { min: 1, max: 30 }, minAccountHours: { min: 0, max: 24 * 30 }, copiesPerStack: 99, noteLength: 140, } as const; /** Coerces stored / posted settings into valid ones. */ /** * Cleans a list of stacks sent by a client: drops junk, merges the same card+variant, and clamps counts. Returns null if * anything is unusable (a viewer should be told, not silently trimmed) or it is empty / too long. */ /** Exact print ids for one stack: `count` distinct ids that all belong to this card + version. Null if anything is off. */ /** Does any stack name exact prints? */ /** The ledger move for one stack: exact prints when chosen, otherwise the newest `count` (the ledger's default). */ /** The stacks of a trade with the taker's own choices filled in (`chosen` by collection entry); stacks the offerer already pinned stay as they are. Null if a choice is malformed. */ /** The collection entries a list of stacks stands for, one per copy. */ /** How many copies of an exact card+variant a collection holds. */ /** The first stack the collection can't cover (null = it owns everything listed). */ /** * Settles an accepted trade. `give` is already held in escrow, so only two collections change: the taker hands over `get` to * the offerer and receives `give`. Returns both new collections, or the stack the taker lacks. Every copy that leaves one place * arrives in the other: nothing is created or destroyed. */ /** * Takes `items` out of a collection for escrow. Returns the remainder, or the stack the viewer doesn't have. */ /** "2× Regular #5, Shiny Full Art #12" for logs and messages (names are looked up by the caller where it has them). */

nodes.name: TradeItem
nodes.body_text: interface TradeItem { cardNumber: number; variant: Variant; count: number; /** * The exact prints (copy ids `<card>.<variant index>.<n>`) when the viewer chose them, `ids.length === count`, all distinct and all of * this card + version. Absent = any print: the newest move first (what trades always did). */ ids?: string[]; }

nodes.name: TradeStatus
nodes.body_text: type TradeStatus = 'open' | 'accepted' | 'declined' | 'cancelled' | 'expired' | 'countered' | 'failed';

nodes.name: Trade
nodes.body_text: interface Trade { id: string; seasonId: string; /** 'direct': offered to one viewer. 'listing': on the open board, anyone can take it. */ kind: 'direct' | 'listing'; /** The viewer who made the offer (lowercase login). */ from: string; /** Who a direct offer is for. Absent on listings. */ to?: string; /** What `from` hands over. While the trade is open these copies are held in escrow (not in anyone's collection). */ give: TradeItem[]; /** True while `give` is physically held by the trade. Refunds and settlement only happen when this is true, so they can't repeat. */ escrowed: boolean; /** What `from` wants back, i.e. what the person who accepts hands over. */ get: TradeItem[]; note?: string; status: TradeStatus; createdAt: number; expiresAt: number; resolvedAt?: number; /** Who accepted / declined / cancelled it ('admin' for an admin cancel). */ resolvedBy?: string; /** Why it ended, for failed / admin-cancelled trades. */ reason?: string; /** The staff member (Twitch login) who cancelled it, when resolvedBy is 'admin'. */ staff?: string; /** Set on a counter-offer: the trade it answers. */ counterOf?: string; /** The exact prints that changed hands when it was accepted (`give`: offerer to taker, `get`: taker to offerer). Absent on older trades and in seasons whose prints are not numbered. */ moved?: { give: string[]; get: string[] }; /** Set when staff reversed the completed trade: every print went back where it started. The status stays 'accepted'. */ reversedAt?: number; reversedBy?: string; reverseReason?: string; }

nodes.name: tradeVisibleTo
nodes.signature: function tradeVisibleTo(trade: Pick<Trade, 'kind' | 'from' | 'to'>, viewer: string | null | undefined): boolean
nodes.body_text: function tradeVisibleTo(trade: Pick<Trade, 'kind' | 'from' | 'to'>, viewer: string | null | undefined): boolean { if (trade.kind === 'listing') return true; const v = viewer?.toLowerCase(); return !!v && (v === trade.from || v === trade.to); }

nodes.name: TradeSettings
nodes.body_text: interface TradeSettings { /** Master switch: off freezes trading (existing offers stay but can't be accepted). */ enabled: boolean; /** Hours an offer stays open. */ expiryHours: number; /** Open offers one viewer can have at once (direct + listings together). */ maxOpenPerUser: number; /** Seconds a viewer must wait between creating offers. */ cooldownSeconds: number; /** Different card/variant stacks allowed on each side of an offer. */ maxStacksPerSide: number; /** Hours a viewer's profile must have existed before they can offer or accept (0 = no limit). */ minAccountHours: number; }

nodes.name: clampInt
nodes.signature: clampInt = (v: unknown, min: number, max: number, fallback: number)
nodes.body_text: clampInt = (v: unknown, min: number, max: number, fallback: number) => { const n = Math.floor(Number(v)); return Number.isFinite(n) ? Math.min(max, Math.max(min, n)) : fallback; }

nodes.name: sanitizeTradeSettings
nodes.body_text: function sanitizeTradeSettings(input: unknown): TradeSettings { const i = (input && typeof input === 'object' ? input : {}) as Record<string, unknown>; const d = DEFAULT_TRADE_SETTINGS; return { enabled: i.enabled === undefined ? d.enabled : i.enabled === true || i.enabled === 'on' || i.enabled === 'true', expiryHours: clampInt(i.expiryHours, TRADE_LIMITS.expiryHours.min, TRADE_LIMITS.expiryHours.max, d.expiryHours), maxOpenPerUser: clampInt(i.maxOpenPerUser, TRADE_LIMITS.maxOpenPerUser.min, TRADE_LIMITS.maxOpenPerUser.max, d.maxOpenPerUser), cooldownSeconds: clampInt(i.cooldownSeconds, TRADE_LIMITS.cooldownSeconds.min, TRADE_LIMITS.cooldownSeconds.max, d.cooldownSeconds), maxStacksPerSide: clampInt(i.maxStacksPerSide, TRADE_LIMITS.maxStacksPerSide.min, TRADE_LIMITS.maxStacksPerSide.max, d.maxStacksPerSide), minAccountHours: clampInt(i.minAccountHours, TRADE_LIMITS.minAccountHours.min, TRADE_LIMITS.minAccountHours.max, d.minAccountHours), }; }

nodes.name: cleanItems
nodes.signature: function cleanItems(input: unknown, maxStacks: number): TradeItem[] | null
nodes.body_text: function cleanItems(input: unknown, maxStacks: number): TradeItem[] | null { if (!Array.isArray(input) || input.length === 0) return null; const merged = new Map<string, TradeItem>(); for (const raw of input) { if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'object') return null; const r = raw as Record<string, unknown>; const cardNumber = Number(r.cardNumber); const count = Math.floor(Number(r.count)); const variant = String(r.variant) as Variant; if (!Number.isInteger(cardNumber) || cardNumber < 1 || cardNumber >= 1_000_000 || !VARIANTS.includes(variant) || !Number.isFinite(count) || count < 1) return null; let ids: string[] | undefined; if (r.ids !== undefined && r.ids !== null) { ids = cleanIds(r.ids, cardNumber, variant, count) ?? undefined; if (!ids) return null; } const key = `${cardNumber}:${variant}`; const prev = merged.get(key); const total = (prev?.count ?? 0) + count; if (total > TRADE_LIMITS.copiesPerStack) return null; // Two lines for one card + version merge; picked prints only survive when both lines picked them (and never the same one twice). if (prev && (!!prev.ids !== !!ids || (ids && prev.ids!.some(id => ids!.includes(id))))) return null; merged.set(key, { cardNumber, variant, count: total, ...(ids ? { ids: [...(prev?.ids ?? []), ...ids] } : {}) }); } const list = [...merged.values()]; return list.length > maxStacks ? null : list; }

nodes.name: cleanIds
nodes.signature: function cleanIds(input: unknown, cardNumber: number, variant: Variant, count: number): string[] | null
nodes.body_text: function cleanIds(input: unknown, cardNumber: number, variant: Variant, count: number): string[] | null { if (!Array.isArray(input) || input.length !== count) return null; const ids: string[] = []; for (const id of input) { if (typeof id !== 'string') return null; const p = parseCopyId(id); if (!p || p.card !== cardNumber || p.variant !== variant || p.n < 1 || ids.includes(id)) return null; ids.push(id); } return ids; }

nodes.name: hasPickedPrints
nodes.body_text: hasPickedPrints = (items: TradeItem[]) => items.some(i => i.ids?.length)

nodes.name: moveOf
nodes.body_text: moveOf = (i: TradeItem) => ({ entry: encodeEntry(i.cardNumber, i.variant), count: i.count, ...(i.ids ? { ids: i.ids } : {}) })

nodes.name: withChosenPrints
nodes.signature: function withChosenPrints(items: TradeItem[], chosen: Record<string, string[]> | undefined): TradeItem[] | null
nodes.body_text: function withChosenPrints(items: TradeItem[], chosen: Record<string, string[]> | undefined): TradeItem[] | null { if (!chosen) return items; const out: TradeItem[] = []; for (const i of items) { const picked = chosen[String(encodeEntry(i.cardNumber, i.variant))]; if (i.ids || picked === undefined) { out.push(i); continue; } const ids = cleanIds(picked, i.cardNumber, i.variant, i.count); if (!ids) return null; out.push({ ...i, ids }); } return out; }

nodes.name: itemEntries
nodes.body_text: function itemEntries(items: TradeItem[]): number[] { return items.flatMap(i => Array<number>(i.count).fill(encodeEntry(i.cardNumber, i.variant))); }

nodes.name: itemCopies
nodes.body_text: itemCopies = (items: TradeItem[]) => items.reduce((n, i) => n + i.count, 0)

nodes.name: ownedCopies
nodes.signature: function ownedCopies(owned: number[], cardNumber: number, variant: Variant): number
nodes.body_text: function ownedCopies(owned: number[], cardNumber: number, variant: Variant): number { const entry = encodeEntry(cardNumber, variant); let n = 0; for (const e of owned) if (e === entry) n++; return n; }

nodes.name: firstMissing
nodes.signature: function firstMissing(owned: number[], items: TradeItem[]): TradeItem | null
nodes.body_text: function firstMissing(owned: number[], items: TradeItem[]): TradeItem | null { return items.find(i => ownedCopies(owned, i.cardNumber, i.variant) < i.count) ?? null; }

nodes.name: settleTrade
nodes.signature: function settleTrade( offererOwned: number[], takerOwned: number[], give: TradeItem[], get: TradeItem[], ): { ok: true; offerer: number[]; taker: number[] } | { ok: false; missing: TradeItem }
nodes.body_text: function settleTrade( offererOwned: number[], takerOwned: number[], give: TradeItem[], get: TradeItem[], ): { ok: true; offerer: number[]; taker: number[] } | { ok: false; missing: TradeItem } { const lacking = firstMissing(takerOwned, get); if (lacking) return { ok: false, missing: lacking }; let taker: number[] | null = takerOwned; for (const item of get) taker = removeEntries(taker!, encodeEntry(item.cardNumber, item.variant), item.count); if (!taker) throw new Error('settlement invariant broken'); // unreachable: ownership was checked above return { ok: true, offerer: [...offererOwned, ...itemEntries(get)], taker: [...taker, ...itemEntries(give)] }; }

nodes.name: takeForEscrow
nodes.signature: function takeForEscrow(owned: number[], items: TradeItem[]): { ok: true; rest: number[] } | { ok: false; missing: TradeItem }
nodes.body_text: function takeForEscrow(owned: number[], items: TradeItem[]): { ok: true; rest: number[] } | { ok: false; missing: TradeItem } { const lacking = firstMissing(owned, items); if (lacking) return { ok: false, missing: lacking }; let rest: number[] | null = owned; for (const item of items) rest = removeEntries(rest!, encodeEntry(item.cardNumber, item.variant), item.count); if (!rest) throw new Error('escrow invariant broken'); // unreachable return { ok: true, rest }; }

nodes.name: describeItems
nodes.signature: function describeItems(items: TradeItem[], nameOf?: (cardNumber: number) => string | undefined): string
nodes.body_text: function describeItems(items: TradeItem[], nameOf?: (cardNumber: number) => string | undefined): string { return items .map(i => `${i.count > 1 ? `${i.count}× ` : ''}${nameOf?.(i.cardNumber) ?? `#${i.cardNumber}`} (${VARIANT_LABELS[i.variant]})`) .join(', '); }

nodes.name: trade-insights.ts
nodes.body_text: import type { Trade, TradeItem } from './trade-core'; // Client-safe analysis of the trade history for the admin Trades page: summary numbers, a daily series, who trades most, which cards // move most, and the "worth a look" flags. Everything here is computed from the trades it is given (open + the kept history, newest // first, capped at 400), so it describes recent activity, not all time. const DAY = 86_400_000; /** The counterparty who completed a trade: the recipient of a direct offer, or whoever took a listing. */ // ── flags ── export const FLAG_RULES = { /** One side is worth at least this many times the other... */ lopsidedRatio: 2, /** ...and the gap is at least this many points. */ lopsidedGap: 50, /** This many completed trades between the same two viewers within `repeatDays`. */ repeatTrades: 3, repeatDays: 7, /** This many offers from one viewer within `burstMinutes`. */ burstOffers: 5, burstMinutes: 10, /** A viewer whose profile is younger than this when the offer was made. */ newAccountHours: 24, } as const; /** Flags per trade id. Only trades with something worth a look appear in the map. */ export const FLAG_LABEL: Record<FlagKind, string> = { lopsided: 'Lopsided', repeat: 'Repeat pair', burst: 'Rapid offers', newbie: 'New account' }; /** One row of the trade log, as plain data for the client component. */

nodes.name: copies
nodes.body_text: copies = (items: TradeItem[]) => items.reduce((n, i) => n + i.count, 0)

nodes.name: TradeStats
nodes.body_text: interface TradeStats { openCount: number; escrowCards: number; ended: number; accepted: number; declined: number; cancelled: number; expired: number; countered: number; failed: number; /** accepted / (accepted + declined + cancelled + expired + failed), or null with nothing to go on. */ acceptRate: number | null; /** Median minutes from offer to acceptance, or null. */ medianAcceptMin: number | null; perDay: { day: string; offered: number; accepted: number }[]; topTraders: { username: string; trades: number; cards: number }[]; topCards: { key: string; copies: number }[]; /** The number of ended trades the numbers are based on, and when the oldest began. */ since: number | null; }

nodes.name: partnerOf
nodes.body_text: partnerOf = (t: Trade): string | undefined => t.to ?? (t.status === 'accepted' ? t.resolvedBy : undefined)

nodes.name: computeTradeStats
nodes.signature: function computeTradeStats(open: Trade[], history: Trade[], now: number, days = 14): TradeStats
nodes.body_text: function computeTradeStats(open: Trade[], history: Trade[], now: number, days = 14): TradeStats { const counts = { accepted: 0, declined: 0, cancelled: 0, expired: 0, countered: 0, failed: 0 }; for (const t of history) if (t.status in counts) counts[t.status as keyof typeof counts]++; const decided = counts.accepted + counts.declined + counts.cancelled + counts.expired + counts.failed; const waits = history.filter(t => t.status === 'accepted' && t.resolvedAt).map(t => (t.resolvedAt! - t.createdAt) / 60_000).sort((a, b) => a - b); const medianAcceptMin = waits.length ? Math.round(waits[Math.floor(waits.length / 2)]) : null; const dayKey = (ms: number) => new Date(ms).toISOString().slice(0, 10); const perDayMap = new Map<string, { offered: number; accepted: number }>(); for (let i = days - 1; i >= 0; i--) perDayMap.set(dayKey(now - i * DAY), { offered: 0, accepted: 0 }); for (const t of [...open, ...history]) { const e = perDayMap.get(dayKey(t.createdAt)); if (e) e.offered++; } for (const t of history) if (t.status === 'accepted' && t.resolvedAt) { const e = perDayMap.get(dayKey(t.resolvedAt)); if (e) e.accepted++; } const traders = new Map<string, { trades: number; cards: number }>(); const cardCopies = new Map<string, number>(); for (const t of history) { if (t.status !== 'accepted') continue; const moved = copies(t.give) + copies(t.get); for (const u of [t.from, partnerOf(t)]) { if (!u) continue; const e = traders.get(u) ?? { trades: 0, cards: 0 }; e.trades++; e.cards += moved; traders.set(u, e); } for (const i of [...t.give, ...t.get]) { const k = `${t.seasonId}:${i.cardNumber}`; cardCopies.set(k, (cardCopies.get(k) ?? 0) + i.count); } } return { openCount: open.length, escrowCards: open.filter(t => t.escrowed).reduce((n, t) => n + copies(t.give), 0), ended: history.length, ...counts, acceptRate: decided > 0 ? counts.accepted / decided : null, medianAcceptMin, perDay: [...perDayMap].map(([day, v]) => ({ day, ...v })), topTraders: [...traders].map(([username, v]) => ({ username, ...v })).sort((a, b) => b.trades - a.trades || b.cards - a.cards).slice(0, 8), topCards: [...cardCopies].map(([key, c]) => ({ key, copies: c })).sort((a, b) => b.copies - a.copies).slice(0, 8), since: history.length ? Math.min(...history.map(t => t.createdAt)) : null, }; }

nodes.name: dayKey
nodes.body_text: dayKey = (ms: number) => new Date(ms).toISOString().slice(0, 10)

nodes.name: FlagKind
nodes.body_text: type FlagKind = 'lopsided' | 'repeat' | 'burst' | 'newbie';

nodes.name: TradeFlag
nodes.body_text: interface TradeFlag { kind: FlagKind; label: string }

nodes.name: FlagContext
nodes.body_text: interface FlagContext { /** Points of one side of a trade at today's values. */ points: (t: Trade, side: 'give' | 'get') => number; /** When the viewer's profile was created (ms), if known. */ createdAt: (username: string) => number | undefined; }

nodes.name: flagTrades
nodes.signature: function flagTrades(trades: Trade[], ctx: FlagContext): Map<string, TradeFlag[]>
nodes.body_text: function flagTrades(trades: Trade[], ctx: FlagContext): Map<string, TradeFlag[]> { const out = new Map<string, TradeFlag[]>(); const add = (id: string, f: TradeFlag) => { const l = out.get(id) ?? []; if (!l.some(x => x.kind === f.kind)) l.push(f); out.set(id, l); }; for (const t of trades) { if (t.status === 'cancelled' || t.status === 'expired' || t.status === 'countered') continue; // nothing changed hands const g = ctx.points(t, 'give'), w = ctx.points(t, 'get'); const hi = Math.max(g, w), lo = Math.min(g, w); if (hi - lo >= FLAG_RULES.lopsidedGap && hi >= FLAG_RULES.lopsidedRatio * Math.max(lo, 1)) { add(t.id, { kind: 'lopsided', label: `${Math.round(g)} pts for ${Math.round(w)} pts` }); } } // Completed trades between the same pair. const pairs = new Map<string, Trade[]>(); for (const t of trades) { const b = partnerOf(t); if (t.status !== 'accepted' || !b) continue; const k = [t.from, b].sort().join('|'); pairs.set(k, [...(pairs.get(k) ?? []), t]); } for (const [k, list] of pairs) { const sorted = [...list].sort((a, b) => (a.resolvedAt ?? 0) - (b.resolvedAt ?? 0)); for (let i = 0; i < sorted.length; i++) { const window = sorted.filter(t => Math.abs((t.resolvedAt ?? 0) - (sorted[i].resolvedAt ?? 0)) <= FLAG_RULES.repeatDays * DAY); if (window.length >= FLAG_RULES.repeatTrades) for (const t of window) add(t.id, { kind: 'repeat', label: `${window.length} trades between ${k.replace('|', ' and ')} in ${FLAG_RULES.repeatDays} days` }); } } // Rapid-fire offers. const byOfferer = new Map<string, Trade[]>(); for (const t of trades) byOfferer.set(t.from, [...(byOfferer.get(t.from) ?? []), t]); for (const [user, list] of byOfferer) { const sorted = [...list].sort((a, b) => a.createdAt - b.createdAt); for (let i = 0; i < sorted.length; i++) { const window = sorted.filter(t => t.createdAt >= sorted[i].createdAt && t.createdAt - sorted[i].createdAt <= FLAG_RULES.burstMinutes * 60_000); if (window.length >= FLAG_RULES.burstOffers) for (const t of window) add(t.id, { kind: 'burst', label: `${user} made ${window.length} offers within ${FLAG_RULES.burstMinutes} minutes` }); } } // New accounts. for (const t of trades) { for (const u of [t.from, t.to].filter((x): x is string => !!x)) { const c = ctx.createdAt(u); if (c && t.createdAt - c < FLAG_RULES.newAccountHours * 3_600_000) add(t.id, { kind: 'newbie', label: `${u} had only just joined` }); } } return out; }

nodes.name: add
nodes.body_text: add = (id: string, f: TradeFlag) => { const l = out.get(id) ?? []; if (!l.some(x => x.kind === f.kind)) l.push(f); out.set(id, l); }

nodes.name: tradesToCsv
nodes.body_text: function tradesToCsv(rows: TradeRow[]): string { const esc = (v: unknown) => { const s = String(v ?? ''); return /[",\n]/.test(s) ? `"${s.replace(/"/g, '""')}"` : s; }; const head = ['id', 'status', 'kind', 'from', 'to_or_taker', 'season', 'gives', 'wants', 'give_points', 'get_points', 'created', 'resolved', 'resolved_by', 'reason', 'flags']; const lines = rows.map(r => [r.id, r.status, r.kind, r.from, r.to ?? r.takenBy ?? '', r.seasonName, r.giveText, r.getText, Math.round(r.givePts), Math.round(r.getPts), new Date(r.createdAt).toISOString(), r.resolvedAt ? new Date(r.resolvedAt).toISOString() : '', r.resolvedBy ?? '', r.reason ?? '', r.flags.map(f => f.kind).join(' ')].map(esc).join(',')); return [head.join(','), ...lines].join('\n'); }

nodes.name: trade-match.ts
nodes.body_text: import { encodeEntry } from './variants'; import { firstMissing, type Trade, type TradeItem } from './trade-core'; import { poolsFor, stackPoints, type TradeCardInfo, type TradePools } from './trade-view-core'; // Which open listings on the board suit a viewer (pure, client-safe): ones that give a card they are looking for or do not own yet, // and ones that only ask for spare copies. The server still decides whether a trade is allowed; this only ranks and explains. /** Listings worth showing as "matches": something you want or lack, or a fair trade of spares, that you can actually take. Best first. */ /** A short verdict on how even an offer is, from the points each side gives: "Even", "Generous", "Lopsided" (you give a lot more). */

nodes.name: MatchViewer
nodes.body_text: interface MatchViewer { /** Copies owned per exact card + version (a collection entry, see lib/variants.ts). */ copies: Map<number, number>; /** Cards on their Looking for list. */ wanted: Set<number>; }

nodes.name: MatchInfo
nodes.body_text: interface MatchInfo { trade: Trade; canTake: boolean; /** Cards offered that are on the viewer's Looking for list. */ offersWanted: TradeItem[]; /** Cards offered that the viewer owns no copy of (in any version). */ offersNew: TradeItem[]; /** Everything asked for is a spare: the viewer would still keep at least one copy of each. */ asksOnlySpares: boolean; /** Points the viewer would gain (negative = give up more than they get), at today's values. */ gain: number; score: number; reasons: string[]; }

nodes.name: ownsAny
nodes.body_text: ownsAny = (copies: Map<number, number>, card: number) => [0, 1, 2, 3].some(v => (copies.get(card + 1_000_000 * v) ?? 0) > 0)

nodes.name: matchTrade
nodes.signature: function matchTrade(trade: Trade, viewer: MatchViewer, cards: Record<number, TradeCardInfo>, pools?: TradePools): MatchInfo
nodes.body_text: function matchTrade(trade: Trade, viewer: MatchViewer, cards: Record<number, TradeCardInfo>, pools?: TradePools): MatchInfo { // ownedList for firstMissing: expand counts back into an entry list (small: only the asked-for stacks matter). const owned: number[] = []; for (const i of trade.get) owned.push(...Array<number>(viewer.copies.get(encodeEntry(i.cardNumber, i.variant)) ?? 0).fill(encodeEntry(i.cardNumber, i.variant))); const canTake = !firstMissing(owned, trade.get); const offersWanted = trade.give.filter(i => viewer.wanted.has(i.cardNumber)); const offersNew = trade.give.filter(i => !ownsAny(viewer.copies, i.cardNumber)); const asksOnlySpares = canTake && trade.get.every(i => (viewer.copies.get(encodeEntry(i.cardNumber, i.variant)) ?? 0) > i.count); const p = poolsFor(trade, pools); const gain = Math.round(stackPoints(trade.give, cards, p.give) - stackPoints(trade.get, cards, p.get)); const reasons: string[] = []; if (offersWanted.length > 0) reasons.push('Offers a card you are looking for'); if (offersNew.length > 0) reasons.push('Offers a card you do not have yet'); if (asksOnlySpares) reasons.push('Asks only for your spare prints'); if (gain > 0) reasons.push(`You gain about ${gain.toLocaleString()} points`); const score = offersWanted.length * 100 + offersNew.length * 30 + (asksOnlySpares ? 25 : 0) + (canTake ? 20 : -50) + Math.max(-20, Math.min(20, gain / 10)); return { trade, canTake, offersWanted, offersNew, asksOnlySpares, gain, score, reasons }; }

nodes.name: bestMatches
nodes.signature: function bestMatches(trades: Trade[], viewer: MatchViewer, cards: Record<number, TradeCardInfo>, limit = 5, pools?: TradePools): MatchInfo[]
nodes.body_text: function bestMatches(trades: Trade[], viewer: MatchViewer, cards: Record<number, TradeCardInfo>, limit = 5, pools?: TradePools): MatchInfo[] { return trades .map(t => matchTrade(t, viewer, cards, pools)) .filter(m => m.canTake && (m.offersWanted.length > 0 || m.offersNew.length > 0 || (m.asksOnlySpares && m.gain >= 0))) .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score || b.trade.createdAt - a.trade.createdAt) .slice(0, limit); }

nodes.name: fairness
nodes.signature: function fairness(givePts: number, getPts: number): { label: 'Even' | 'Slightly in their favour' | 'Slightly in your favour' | 'Lopsided against you' | 'Generous to them' | 'Empty'; warn: boolean }
nodes.body_text: function fairness(givePts: number, getPts: number): { label: 'Even' | 'Slightly in their favour' | 'Slightly in your favour' | 'Lopsided against you' | 'Generous to them' | 'Empty'; warn: boolean } { if (givePts <= 0 && getPts <= 0) return { label: 'Empty', warn: false }; const hi = Math.max(givePts, getPts), lo = Math.min(givePts, getPts); const ratio = lo > 0 ? hi / lo : Infinity; if (ratio <= 1.15) return { label: 'Even', warn: false }; if (givePts > getPts) return ratio >= 2 && hi - lo >= 50 ? { label: 'Lopsided against you', warn: true } : { label: 'Slightly in their favour', warn: false }; return ratio >= 2 && hi - lo >= 50 ? { label: 'Generous to them', warn: false } : { label: 'Slightly in your favour', warn: false }; }

nodes.name: trade-notify.ts
nodes.body_text: import { kv } from './db'; import { getUserSettings } from './user-settings-store'; import { wantsNotice } from './user-settings'; import { getSeason } from './kv'; import { recordActivity } from './activity'; import { getSeasonOverview } from './site-data'; import { getHoloResolver } from './holo'; import { VARIANT_LABELS } from './variants'; import type { Trade, TradeItem } from './trade-core'; import { stackPoints, type TradeCardInfo } from './trade-view-core'; import { parseCopyId, type SerialPool } from './serials-core'; import { getTradeCards } from './trade-view'; import type { Notice, NoticeKind, Swap, SwapCard } from './trade-notice-core'; import { watchersOf, wantedForTrades } from './watch-index'; import { matchingAlerts } from './watch-core'; import { notifyListing } from './discord'; import { encodeEntry } from './variants'; import { pushNotice } from './push'; import { emailNotice } from './email'; // Notifications and activity records for trade events. Everything here is best-effort: a failure must never undo or block // a trade, so every entry point swallows errors. (Called after the trade lock is released: see flushEvents in lib/trades.ts.) const NOTICE_CAP = 30; /** * The serial numbers of the copies on each side, read BEFORE they moved (afterwards they have changed hands), so the points quoted in * the activity feed and Discord include the serial bonuses. A side that cannot be known (what a listing asks of a stranger) is absent. */ /** Newest first, plus when the viewer last opened the bell (anything newer is unread). */ /** Bumped by every new notice and every mark-as-read, so a bell polling with its last version gets a cheap 204 when nothing changed. */ /** "2× Cheesy Cat (Shiny Full Art)" for each stack. */ /** The stack lines with the edition numbers of the copies that move ("... · #7, #3"): the newest copies leave first, like on the trade page. */ /** The cards of a swap with art and holo, for the trade animation. */ /** * Records what happened to an offer: the admin activity feed / Discord (with the cards and points on both sides) and the * notification of whoever needs to know. `by` is who did it ('admin' for an admin cancel). */ const WATCHERS_CAP = 200; /** * A new board listing: tell every viewer whose Looking for list or saved alerts include one of the cards it gives (never the lister). * Each hears about it once, in the bell. Best-effort like the rest of this file. */

nodes.signature: async function notify(username: string, notice: Omit<Notice, 'id' | 'at'>): Promise<void>
nodes.body_text: async function notify(username: string, notice: Omit<Notice, 'id' | 'at'>): Promise<void> { try { const user = username.toLowerCase(); if (!wantsNotice(await getUserSettings(user), notice.kind)) return; // the viewer switched this kind of notice off const full: Notice = { ...notice, id: Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10), at: Date.now() }; await kv.lpush(noticesKey(user), full); await kv.ltrim(noticesKey(user), 0, NOTICE_CAP - 1); await kv.incr(versionKey(user)); // the bell asks "has anything changed since version N?" await pushNotice(user, full); // and, if they turned alerts on, their phone or browser hears about it too await emailNotice(user, full); // and, if they confirmed an email address, it is queued for the next email } catch { /* best effort */ } }

nodes.name: announceTrade
nodes.signature: async function announceTrade(trade: Trade, action: TradeAction, by?: string, pools: EventPools = {}): Promise<void>
nodes.body_text: async function announceTrade(trade: Trade, action: TradeAction, by?: string, pools: EventPools = {}): Promise<void> { try { const season = await getSeason(trade.seasonId); const cards = season ? await getTradeCards(season) : {}; const give = stackLines(trade.give, cards); const get = stackLines(trade.get, cards); const sentence = `${give.join(', ')} for ${get.join(', ')}`; const partner = action === 'accepted' ? by : action === 'reversed' ? trade.resolvedBy : trade.to; await recordActivity({ type: 'trade', action: trade.counterOf && action === 'offered' ? 'countered' : action, username: trade.from, partner, by, kind: trade.kind, give, get, givePts: stackPoints(trade.give, cards, pools.give), getPts: stackPoints(trade.get, cards, pools.get), note: trade.note, cardNumber: trade.give[0]?.cardNumber, collectionName: season?.collectionName, }); const tell = (user: string | undefined, kind: NoticeKind, text: string, swap?: Swap) => user ? notify(user, { kind, text, tradeId: trade.id, ...(swap ? { swap } : {}) }) : Promise.resolve(); const adminCancel = action === 'cancelled' && by === 'admin'; switch (action) { case 'offered': if (trade.counterOf) await tell(trade.to, 'countered', `@${trade.from} countered your offer: they give ${sentence}.`); else if (trade.kind === 'direct') await tell(trade.to, 'offer', `@${trade.from} offered you a trade: they give ${sentence}.`); else { await notifyWatchers(trade, cards); const counts = (await wantedForTrades([trade]))[trade.id] ?? {}; const wanted = trade.give.filter(i => counts[i.cardNumber]).map(i => { const n = counts[i.cardNumber]; const v = i.variant === 'regular' ? '' : ` (${VARIANT_LABELS[i.variant]})`; return `${n} ${n === 1 ? 'collector is' : 'collectors are'} looking for ${cards[i.cardNumber]?.name ?? `#${i.cardNumber}`}${v}`; }); await notifyListing({ id: trade.id, from: trade.from, expiresAt: trade.expiresAt, give: withEditions(trade.give, give, pools.give), get, givePts: stackPoints(trade.give, cards, pools.give), getPts: stackPoints(trade.get, cards, pools.get), imageUrl: cards[trade.give[0]?.cardNumber]?.imageUrl, note: trade.note, wanted, }); } break; case 'accepted': { const swap = await buildSwap(trade.seasonId, trade.give, trade.get, by ?? ''); await tell(trade.from, 'accepted', `@${by} accepted your trade: you gave ${give.join(', ')} and got ${get.join(', ')}.`, swap); break; } case 'declined': await tell(trade.from, 'declined', `@${trade.to} declined your offer. Your cards are back in your collection.`); break; case 'cancelled': if (adminCancel) { await tell(trade.from, 'admin', 'An admin cancelled your offer. Your cards are back in your collection.'); await tell(trade.to, 'cancelled', `The offer from @${trade.from} was cancelled.`); } else await tell(trade.to, 'cancelled', `@${trade.from} withdrew their offer to you.`); break; case 'reversed': { const text = (other: string) => `A trade between you and @${other} was reversed by staff: ${trade.reverseReason ?? 'no reason given'}. The prints went back to where they started.`; await tell(trade.from, 'admin', text(trade.resolvedBy ?? '?')); await tell(trade.resolvedBy, 'admin', text(trade.from)); break; } case 'expired': await tell(trade.from, 'expired', 'Your offer ran out of time. Your cards are back in your collection.'); await tell(trade.to, 'expired', `The offer from @${trade.from} expired.`); break; default: break; } } catch { /* best effort */ } }
