nodes.signature: tell = (user: string | undefined, kind: NoticeKind, text: string, swap?: Swap)
nodes.body_text: tell = (user: string | undefined, kind: NoticeKind, text: string, swap?: Swap) => user ? notify(user, { kind, text, tradeId: trade.id, ...(swap ? { swap } : {}) }) : Promise.resolve()

nodes.name: text
nodes.body_text: text = (other: string) => `A trade between you and @${other} was reversed by staff: ${trade.reverseReason ?? 'no reason given'}. The prints went back to where they started.`

nodes.name: notifyWatchers
nodes.signature: async function notifyWatchers(trade: Trade, cards: Record<number, TradeCardInfo>): Promise<void>
nodes.body_text: async function notifyWatchers(trade: Trade, cards: Record<number, TradeCardInfo>): Promise<void> { try { const candidates = (await watchersOf(trade.give.map(i => i.cardNumber))).filter(u => u !== trade.from).slice(0, WATCHERS_CAP); const asking = stackLines(trade.get, cards).join(', '); for (const u of candidates) { const hits = matchingAlerts(await getUserSettings(u), trade.give); if (hits.length === 0) continue; const what = stackLines(trade.give.filter(i => hits.some(h => h.cardNumber === i.cardNumber && h.variant === i.variant)), cards).join(', '); await notify(u, { kind: 'watch', text: `@${trade.from} listed ${what} on the board, which you are watching for. They want ${asking}.`, tradeId: trade.id }); } } catch { /* best effort */ } }

nodes.name: trade-view-core.ts
nodes.body_text: import type { Variant } from './types'; import { VARIANTS } from './variants'; import type { TradeItem } from './trade-core'; import { serialMultiplier } from './scoring-core'; import { encodeEntry } from './variants'; import { parseCopyId, type SerialPool } from './serials-core'; // Client-safe helpers for the trade screens (no database access). The data loader that builds these lives in lib/trade-view.ts. /** What the trade screens need to know about a card. Plain data, so it can be passed to client components. */ /** One copy's points given its serial number (undefined = no bonus). */ /** One print a viewer holds, for the print pickers: its copy id, edition number and unique print number. */ /** A holder's prints by collection entry (card + version), lowest edition first. Empty where the season's prints are not numbered. */ /** Groups copies into a print pool. */ /** What the accept flow needs to let the taker choose prints: where to look them up and the stacks the offer asks for. */ /** The accept flow's picker data for an offer the viewer could take (undefined when signed out or the offer asks for nothing choosable). */ /** The newest `count` prints of an entry (what an unpicked trade moves), as ids. */ /** Serial numbers for pricing offers: each open offer's escrowed copies, and (for a viewer) the copies they hold. */ /** The pools to price an offer with: its escrow for what it gives, the viewer's copies for what it asks (unless it is their own offer). */ /** * Total points of a list of stacks at today's values. With a `pool` (the serials the copies would come from) each stack is priced * with its real serial bonuses: trades move the NEWEST copies first, so a stack of k takes the k highest serials in the pool. * Stacks the pool does not cover are priced without a bonus. A stack with chosen prints (`ids`) is priced from those prints, whatever the pool says. */ /** "in 31h", "in 12m", "ended" for an offer's expiry. */

nodes.name: TradeCardInfo
nodes.body_text: interface TradeCardInfo { number: number; name: string; imageUrl: string; fullArtImageUrl?: string; stars: number; packName: string; /** The variants this card can be wanted in (Regular only where the pack has upgrades off). */ variants: Variant[]; /** Points per copy, aligned with VARIANTS (before any serial bonus). */ values: number[]; /** The same before rounding, so a copy with a low serial number can be priced exactly. */ raw: number[]; /** The serial bonus rule (see ScoringSettings). */ bonus: { max: number; cutoff: number }; }

nodes.name: copyValue
nodes.signature: function copyValue(card: TradeCardInfo | undefined, variant: Variant, serial?: number): number
nodes.body_text: function copyValue(card: TradeCardInfo | undefined, variant: Variant, serial?: number): number { if (!card) return 0; const i = VARIANTS.indexOf(variant); const mult = serialMultiplier(serial, { serialBonusMax: card.bonus.max, serialBonusCutoff: card.bonus.cutoff }); return mult === 1 ? card.values[i] ?? 0 : Math.max(1, Math.round((card.raw[i] ?? 0) * mult)); }

nodes.name: PrintInfo
nodes.body_text: interface PrintInfo { id: string; n: number; uid?: number }

nodes.name: PrintPool
nodes.body_text: type PrintPool = Record<number, PrintInfo[]>;

nodes.name: printPoolOf
nodes.signature: function printPoolOf(copies: { id: string; n: number; uid?: number; card: number; variant: Variant }[]): PrintPool
nodes.body_text: function printPoolOf(copies: { id: string; n: number; uid?: number; card: number; variant: Variant }[]): PrintPool { const pool: PrintPool = {}; for (const c of copies) (pool[encodeEntry(c.card, c.variant)] ??= []).push({ id: c.id, n: c.n, ...(c.uid ? { uid: c.uid } : {}) }); for (const list of Object.values(pool)) list.sort((a, b) => a.n - b.n); return pool; }

nodes.name: PickProps
nodes.body_text: interface PickProps { seasonId: string; username: string; items: TradeItem[]; cards: Record<number, TradeCardInfo> }

nodes.name: pickPropsFor
nodes.signature: function pickPropsFor(trade: { seasonId: string; get: TradeItem[] }, viewer: string | null | undefined, cards: Record<number, TradeCardInfo>): PickProps | undefined
nodes.body_text: function pickPropsFor(trade: { seasonId: string; get: TradeItem[] }, viewer: string | null | undefined, cards: Record<number, TradeCardInfo>): PickProps | undefined { const items = trade.get.filter(i => !i.ids); if (!viewer || items.length === 0) return undefined; return { seasonId: trade.seasonId, username: viewer, items, cards: Object.fromEntries(items.flatMap(i => (cards[i.cardNumber] ? [[i.cardNumber, cards[i.cardNumber]]] : []))) }; }

nodes.name: newestIds
nodes.signature: newestIds = (prints: PrintInfo[] | undefined, count: number): string[]
nodes.body_text: newestIds = (prints: PrintInfo[] | undefined, count: number): string[] => [...(prints ?? [])].sort((a, b) => b.n - a.n).slice(0, count).map(p => p.id)

nodes.name: TradePools
nodes.body_text: interface TradePools { viewer: string | null; /** Serials in each offer's escrow (its give side), by trade id. */ give: Record<string, SerialPool>; /** What the viewer holds: the pool their side of an offer is taken from. */ mine: SerialPool; /** Unique print numbers of the exact prints named by open trades (copy id -> uid), so a picked print can be shown as "Print #1023381". */ uids?: Record<string, number>; }

nodes.name: poolsFor
nodes.signature: function poolsFor(trade: { id: string; from: string }, pools?: TradePools): { give?: SerialPool; get?: SerialPool }
nodes.body_text: function poolsFor(trade: { id: string; from: string }, pools?: TradePools): { give?: SerialPool; get?: SerialPool } { if (!pools) return {}; return { give: pools.give[trade.id], get: pools.viewer && pools.viewer !== trade.from ? pools.mine : undefined }; }

nodes.name: stackPoints
nodes.signature: function stackPoints(items: TradeItem[], cards: Record<number, TradeCardInfo>, pool?: SerialPool): number
nodes.body_text: function stackPoints(items: TradeItem[], cards: Record<number, TradeCardInfo>, pool?: SerialPool): number { return items.reduce((n, i) => { const card = cards[i.cardNumber]; const serials = i.ids ? i.ids.map(id => parseCopyId(id)?.n ?? 0).filter(n => n > 0).sort((a, b) => a - b) : (pool?.[encodeEntry(i.cardNumber, i.variant)] ?? []).slice(-i.count); let pts = 0; for (let k = 0; k < i.count; k++) pts += copyValue(card, i.variant, k < serials.length ? serials[serials.length - 1 - k] : undefined); return n + pts; }, 0); }

nodes.name: timeLeft
nodes.signature: function timeLeft(expiresAt: number, now = Date.now()): string
nodes.body_text: function timeLeft(expiresAt: number, now = Date.now()): string { const ms = expiresAt - now; if (ms <= 0) return 'ended'; const m = Math.ceil(ms / 60_000); if (m < 60) return `in ${m}m`; const h = Math.floor(m / 60); return h < 48 ? `in ${h}h` : `in ${Math.floor(h / 24)}d`; }

nodes.name: trade-view.ts
nodes.body_text: import type { Season } from './types'; import { VARIANTS, allowedVariants } from './variants'; import { getSeasonOverview } from './site-data'; import { printPoolOf, type PrintPool, type TradeCardInfo, type TradePools } from './trade-view-core'; import type { Trade } from './trade-core'; import { getCopy, getOwnerCopies, isTracking, loadSerialIndex } from './serials'; import { poolOf, type SerialPool } from './serials-core'; export * from './trade-view-core'; /** Every card in a season, keyed by number, with what each variant is worth right now. */ /** The prints one viewer holds right now, by entry, for the print pickers ({} while the season's prints are not numbered). */

nodes.name: getTradeCards
nodes.signature: async function getTradeCards(season: Season): Promise<Record<number, TradeCardInfo>>
nodes.body_text: async function getTradeCards(season: Season): Promise<Record<number, TradeCardInfo>> { const overview = await getSeasonOverview(season); const out: Record<number, TradeCardInfo> = {}; for (const c of overview.cards) { const v = overview.values.cards.get(c.number); out[c.number] = { number: c.number, name: c.name, imageUrl: c.imageUrl, fullArtImageUrl: c.fullArtImageUrl, stars: c.stars, packName: c.packName, variants: c.pack.upgradesEnabled && c.upgradesEnabled !== false ? allowedVariants(c.pack, c) : ['regular'], values: VARIANTS.map(variant => v?.values[variant] ?? 0), raw: VARIANTS.map(variant => v?.maths.raw[variant] ?? 0), bonus: { max: overview.values.settings.serialBonusMax, cutoff: overview.values.settings.serialBonusCutoff }, }; } return out; }

nodes.name: getTradePools
nodes.signature: async function getTradePools(season: Season, trades: Trade[], viewer?: string | null): Promise<TradePools>
nodes.body_text: async function getTradePools(season: Season, trades: Trade[], viewer?: string | null): Promise<TradePools> { const idx = await loadSerialIndex(season.collectionName); const give: Record<string, SerialPool> = {}; for (const t of trades) if (t.seasonId === season.id && t.escrowed) give[t.id] = poolOf(idx?.escrow.get(t.id)); // Exact prints named by the trades shown: their unique numbers, for "Print #1023381". const uids: Record<string, number> = {}; const picked = trades.filter(t => t.seasonId === season.id).flatMap(t => [...t.give, ...t.get]).flatMap(i => i.ids ?? []); await Promise.all([...new Set(picked)].slice(0, 120).map(async id => { const u = (await getCopy(season.collectionName, id).catch(() => null))?.uid; if (u) uids[id] = u; })); return { viewer: viewer ?? null, give, mine: poolOf(viewer ? idx?.held.get(viewer) : undefined), uids }; }

nodes.name: getPrintPool
nodes.signature: async function getPrintPool(season: Season, owner: string): Promise<PrintPool>
nodes.body_text: async function getPrintPool(season: Season, owner: string): Promise<PrintPool> { if (!(await isTracking(season.collectionName))) return {}; return printPoolOf(await getOwnerCopies(season.collectionName, owner)); }

nodes.name: trades.ts
nodes.body_text: import { protectFavourites } from './favourites'; import { escrowOwner, isEscrow, entryOf, newestFirst, parseCopyId } from './serials-core'; import { firstNotHeld, getCopy, getOwnerCopies, isTracking, liveCopiesOfEntry, printLabel, serialPool } from './serials'; import { getUserSettings } from './user-settings-store'; import { kv } from './db'; import { getCollection, getPackCards, getPacksForSeason, getSeason, getUserProfile, saveCollection, withCollectionLock, withLock } from './kv'; import { announceTrade, type EventPools, type TradeAction } from './trade-notify'; import { currentStaffLogin } from './staff-actor'; import { allowedVariants, encodeEntry, removeEntries } from './variants'; import { DEFAULT_TRADE_SETTINGS, TRADE_LIMITS, cleanItems, itemEntries, sanitizeTradeSettings, settleTrade, takeForEscrow, describeItems, hasPickedPrints, moveOf, withChosenPrints, type Trade, type TradeItem, type TradeSettings, type TradeStatus, } from './trade-core'; import type { Card, Pack } from './types'; // Trading engine (server). See lib/trade-core.ts for the model. Storage (all through the namespaced `kv`, so sandboxes work): // trades:open Trade[] every open offer (one blob, mutated under the 'trades' lock, like a collection) // trades:history Trade[] resolved offers, newest first, capped // trade:settings TradeSettings // trade:cd:<user> a short-lived key that enforces the cooldown between offers // ESCROW: creating an offer moves the offered copies out of the offerer's collection into the trade; every way an offer can end // either settles them to the other side (accept) or refunds them (everything else). Lock order is always 'trades' then a // collection's lock, and nothing takes them the other way round. const OPEN_KEY = 'trades:open'; const HISTORY_KEY = 'trades:history'; const SETTINGS_KEY = 'trade:settings'; const HISTORY_CAP = 400; const LOCK = 'trades'; // Notifications / activity for what happens to offers are queued while the trade lock is held and sent after it is released // (building them reads the season and its card values, which must not delay the lock). Whoever flushes first sends everything queued. const queued: { trade: Trade; action: TradeAction; by?: string; pools?: EventPools }[] = []; /** The serials on each side of an offer right now (call before the copies move): `give` from the escrow, `get` from whoever would hand it over. */ /** Runs a locked section, then sends the notifications it queued. */ /** Moderation: is this viewer barred from trading? (reads the profile directly; lib/user-admin.ts imports this module) */ /** True while the viewer's profile is younger than the "minimum account age" setting (a viewer with no profile counts as new). */ // ── settings ────────────────────────────────────────────── // ── storage helpers (call inside the 'trades' lock when they will be written back) ── /** Puts copies back into a viewer's collection (a refund). Safe to call once per escrow: callers flip `escrowed` first. */ /** Ends an offer: refunds its escrow (unless it is being settled), records why, and moves it to history. */ /** Expires (and refunds) every overdue open offer. Returns whether anything changed. Call inside the lock. */ /** * Refunds offers that have expired. There is no background job, so this runs whenever anyone touches trading (the trade pages, * the account page, a collection page): an expired offer's copies are back with their owner by the time they look. */ // ── reading ─────────────────────────────────────────────── /** All open offers (after refunding expired ones). */ /** One viewer's trades, split the way the page shows them. */ // ── making offers ───────────────────────────────────────── /** Shared by new offers and counters: validates, escrows `give` out of the offerer's collection and stores the offer. */ // ── answering offers ────────────────────────────────────── /** Accept: the taker hands over what the offerer wanted and receives the escrowed copies. */ /** The exact prints a settlement is about to move (read before they do): the escrow's for `give`, the taker's for `get`. Undefined when the season's prints are not numbered. */ /** The recipient says no: the offerer's copies are refunded. */ /** The offerer withdraws (or an admin cancels): the copies are refunded. Works even while trading is paused. */ /** * Counter-offer: the recipient of a direct offer answers with a different one. The original is closed as 'countered' (its * escrow refunded to its offerer) and the new offer, escrowing the counter-offerer's copies, goes back to the original offerer. */ /** What a trade is, in words (for the admin log). */ /** How many trades (open and finished, in the kept history) each viewer has been part of: for the admin users list. */ // ── admin bulk controls ─────────────────────────────────── /** Cancels (and refunds) every open offer that matches, in one locked pass. Returns how many ended. */ /** Pushes the expiry of open offers (all, or the given ids) back by `hours` from now-or-their-current-expiry, whichever is later. */ // ── reversing a completed trade (ROADMAP 9.2) ───────────── const REVERSE_WINDOW = { before: 10_000, after: 1_000 }; // the ledger stamps a move a moment before the trade record is closed /** * The prints an older trade moved, rebuilt from the ledger: live copies of the traded cards with a 'traded' event between the two * people at the time it settled. Returns null unless every stack is matched exactly (no more, no fewer), so a guess never moves anything. */ /** The first of these prints that is not with `holder` any more (or is in an open offer), in words; null when all are. */ /** Can this completed trade be reversed automatically? (For the staff button: the reason it can't, or null.) */ /** * Staff put every print of a completed trade back where it started. All or nothing: each print must still be with the person who * received it and not in an open offer, otherwise nothing moves and the print that has moved on is named. The trade keeps * status 'accepted' and gains reversedAt / reversedBy / reverseReason; each print gets a 'reversed' event (who = staff, note = reason). */

nodes.name: queueEvent
nodes.signature: function queueEvent(trade: Trade, action: TradeAction, by?: string, pools?: EventPools): void
nodes.body_text: function queueEvent(trade: Trade, action: TradeAction, by?: string, pools?: EventPools): void { queued.push({ trade: structuredClone(trade), action, by, pools }); }

nodes.name: snapshotPools
nodes.signature: async function snapshotPools(seasonId: string, owners: { give?: string; get?: string }): Promise<EventPools>
nodes.body_text: async function snapshotPools(seasonId: string, owners: { give?: string; get?: string }): Promise<EventPools> { try { const c = (await getSeason(seasonId))?.collectionName; if (!c) return {}; const [give, get] = await Promise.all([owners.give ? serialPool(c, owners.give) : undefined, owners.get ? serialPool(c, owners.get) : undefined]); return { give, get }; } catch { return {}; } }

nodes.name: flushEvents
nodes.body_text: async function flushEvents(): Promise<void> { const batch = queued.splice(0, queued.length); for (const e of batch) await announceTrade(e.trade, e.action, e.by, e.pools); }

nodes.name: locked
nodes.body_text: function locked<T>(fn: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> { return withLock(LOCK, fn).finally(flushEvents); }

nodes.name: blocked
nodes.body_text: async function blocked(username: string): Promise<boolean> { try { return !!(await getUserProfile(username))?.flags?.noTrading; } catch { return false; } }

nodes.name: tooNew
nodes.signature: async function tooNew(username: string, settings: TradeSettings): Promise<boolean>
nodes.body_text: async function tooNew(username: string, settings: TradeSettings): Promise<boolean> { if (settings.minAccountHours <= 0) return false; try { const created = (await getUserProfile(username))?.createdAt; return !created || Date.now() - created < settings.minAccountHours * 3_600_000; } catch { return false; } }

nodes.name: getTradeSettings
nodes.body_text: async function getTradeSettings(): Promise<TradeSettings> { return sanitizeTradeSettings(await kv.get(SETTINGS_KEY).catch(() => null) ?? DEFAULT_TRADE_SETTINGS); }

nodes.name: saveTradeSettings
nodes.body_text: async function saveTradeSettings(settings: TradeSettings): Promise<void> { await kv.set(SETTINGS_KEY, sanitizeTradeSettings(settings)); }

nodes.name: readOpen
nodes.body_text: readOpen = async (): Promise<Trade[]> => (await kv.get<Trade[]>(OPEN_KEY)) ?? []

nodes.name: readHistory
nodes.body_text: readHistory = async (): Promise<Trade[]> => (await kv.get<Trade[]>(HISTORY_KEY)) ?? []

nodes.name: seasonContext
nodes.body_text: async function seasonContext(seasonId: string) { const season = await getSeason(seasonId); if (!season || season.status === 'draft') return null; const packs = await getPacksForSeason(season); const cardMap = new Map<number, { pack: Pack; card: Card }>(); for (const pack of packs) for (const card of await getPackCards(pack.id)) cardMap.set(card.number, { pack, card }); return { season, cardMap }; }

nodes.name: returnToCollection
nodes.signature: async function returnToCollection(seasonId: string, username: string, items: TradeItem[], tradeId?: string): Promise<void>
nodes.body_text: async function returnToCollection(seasonId: string, username: string, items: TradeItem[], tradeId?: string): Promise<void> { const season = await getSeason(seasonId); if (!season) return; // the season is gone: nothing to refund into await withCollectionLock(season.collectionName, async () => { const data = await getCollection(season.collectionName); data[username] = [...(data[username] ?? []), ...itemEntries(items)]; // The copies come back out of escrow with their identity (serials) intact. await saveCollection(season.collectionName, data, tradeId ? { moves: items.map(i => ({ from: escrowOwner(tradeId), to: username, ...moveOf(i) })) } : undefined); }); }

nodes.name: closeTrade
nodes.signature: async function closeTrade(open: Trade[], history: Trade[], trade: Trade, status: TradeStatus, by: string | undefined, reason?: string, refund = true, settledPools?: EventPools): Promise<void>
nodes.body_text: async function closeTrade(open: Trade[], history: Trade[], trade: Trade, status: TradeStatus, by: string | undefined, reason?: string, refund = true, settledPools?: EventPools): Promise<void> { // A refund puts the escrowed copies back with the offerer, so price the give side from the escrow before that happens. const pools = settledPools ?? (trade.escrowed ? await snapshotPools(trade.seasonId, { give: escrowOwner(trade.id) }) : undefined); if (refund && trade.escrowed) { await returnToCollection(trade.seasonId, trade.from, trade.give, trade.id); trade.escrowed = false; } trade.status = status; trade.resolvedAt = Date.now(); if (by) trade.resolvedBy = by; if (reason) trade.reason = reason; if (by === 'admin') { const staff = await currentStaffLogin(); if (staff) trade.staff = staff; } const i = open.findIndex(t => t.id === trade.id); if (i >= 0) open.splice(i, 1); history.unshift(trade); if (history.length > HISTORY_CAP) history.length = HISTORY_CAP; // (a counter is announced by the new offer it creates) if (status === 'accepted' || status === 'declined' || status === 'cancelled' || status === 'expired') queueEvent(trade, status, by, pools); }

nodes.name: sweepInLock
nodes.signature: async function sweepInLock(open: Trade[], history: Trade[]): Promise<boolean>
nodes.body_text: async function sweepInLock(open: Trade[], history: Trade[]): Promise<boolean> { const now = Date.now(); const overdue = open.filter(t => t.expiresAt <= now); for (const t of overdue) await closeTrade(open, history, t, 'expired', undefined, 'The offer ran out of time.'); return overdue.length > 0; }

nodes.name: persist
nodes.signature: async function persist(open: Trade[], history: Trade[]): Promise<void>
nodes.body_text: async function persist(open: Trade[], history: Trade[]): Promise<void> { await kv.set(OPEN_KEY, open); await kv.set(HISTORY_KEY, history); }

nodes.name: sweepTrades
nodes.body_text: async function sweepTrades(): Promise<number> { const peek = await readOpen(); const now = Date.now(); if (!peek.some(t => t.expiresAt <= now)) return 0; // the common case costs one read and no lock return locked(async () => { const open = await readOpen(); const history = await readHistory(); const before = open.length; await sweepInLock(open, history); await persist(open, history); return before - open.length; }); }

nodes.name: listOpenTrades
nodes.body_text: async function listOpenTrades(): Promise<Trade[]> { await sweepTrades(); return readOpen(); }

nodes.name: getTrade

nodes.body_text: async function tradesForUser(username: string): Promise<{ incoming: Trade[]; outgoing: Trade[]; board: Trade[]; recent: Trade[] }> { const user = username.toLowerCase(); const open = await listOpenTrades(); const history = await readHistory(); return { incoming: open.filter(t => t.kind === 'direct' && t.to === user), outgoing: open.filter(t => t.from === user), // Other people's listings the viewer could take (their own are under "outgoing"). board: open.filter(t => t.kind === 'listing' && t.from !== user), recent: history.filter(t => t.from === user || t.to === user || t.resolvedBy === user).slice(0, 30), }; }

nodes.name: createInLock
nodes.signature: async function createInLock(input: NewTrade, settings: TradeSettings, open: Trade[], history: Trade[], counterOf?: string): Promise<TradeResult<{ trade: Trade }>>
nodes.body_text: async function createInLock(input: NewTrade, settings: TradeSettings, open: Trade[], history: Trade[], counterOf?: string): Promise<TradeResult<{ trade: Trade }>> { const from = input.from.toLowerCase(); const to = input.to?.toLowerCase(); if (input.kind === 'direct') { if (!to) return fail(400, 'Choose who the offer is for.'); if (to === from) return fail(400, 'You can\'t trade with yourself.'); } // Moderation: a restricted viewer can't make offers, and can't be offered one. if (await blocked(from)) return fail(403, 'Trading isn\'t available on your account.'); if (input.kind === 'direct' && input.to && (await blocked(String(input.to).toLowerCase()))) return fail(403, 'That viewer can\'t take part in trades.'); // A viewer can stop taking direct offers (the open board and counter-offers to their own offers still work). if (input.kind === 'direct' && input.to && !counterOf && !(await getUserSettings(String(input.to))).allowOffers) return fail(403, 'That viewer isn\'t taking trade offers right now.'); if (await tooNew(from, settings)) return fail(403, `Trading opens ${settings.minAccountHours} hours after you first play.`); const ctx = await seasonContext(input.seasonId); if (!ctx) return fail(404, 'That season isn\'t available for trading.'); const { season, cardMap } = ctx; if (season.tradingFrozen) return fail(403, 'Trading is closed for this season.'); let give = cleanItems(input.give, settings.maxStacksPerSide); const get = cleanItems(input.get, settings.maxStacksPerSide); if (!give) return fail(400, `Choose between 1 and ${settings.maxStacksPerSide} different cards to give (up to ${TRADE_LIMITS.copiesPerStack} prints of each).`); if (!get) return fail(400, `Choose between 1 and ${settings.maxStacksPerSide} different cards you want back.`); // Wanted cards must exist, and a wanted variant must be one the card can actually be in this pack. for (const item of get) { const hit = cardMap.get(item.cardNumber); if (!hit) return fail(400, `Card #${item.cardNumber} isn't in this season.`); if (item.variant !== 'regular' && (!hit.pack.upgradesEnabled || !allowedVariants(hit.pack, hit.card).includes(item.variant))) { return fail(400, `${hit.card.name} can't be a ${item.variant} in this season.`); } } // Exact prints need a numbered ledger, and only a direct offer can ask for the other person's exact prints (a listing is taken by a stranger who picks at accept). if (hasPickedPrints(give) || hasPickedPrints(get)) { if (!(await isTracking(season.collectionName))) return fail(400, 'Prints in this season are not numbered yet, so you can\'t choose which ones to trade.'); if (input.kind === 'listing' && hasPickedPrints(get)) return fail(400, 'A listing can\'t ask for exact prints: whoever takes it chooses theirs.'); } if (open.filter(t => t.from === from).length >= settings.maxOpenPerUser) { return fail(429, `You already have ${settings.maxOpenPerUser} open offers. Cancel one or wait for it to be answered.`); } if (settings.cooldownSeconds > 0 && (await kv.get(`trade:cd:${from}`))) { return fail(429, 'Slow down: wait a few seconds before making another offer.'); } if (input.kind === 'direct' && to) { const data = await getCollection(season.collectionName); if (!(to in data) && !(await getUserProfile(to))) return fail(404, `Nobody called ${to} has played yet.`); // Asked-for prints must be the recipient's right now (a counter may ask for prints still sitting in the offer it answers). for (const item of get) { if (!item.ids) continue; const gone = await firstNotHeld(season.collectionName, counterOf ? [to, escrowOwner(counterOf)] : [to], item.ids); if (gone) return fail(400, `${to} doesn't hold ${await printLabel(season.collectionName, gone.id)} any more.`); } } // Escrow: take the offered copies out of the offerer's collection, then record the offer. If recording fails, put them back. const trade: Trade = { id: crypto.randomUUID(), seasonId: season.id, kind: input.kind, from, ...(input.kind === 'direct' ? { to } : {}), give, escrowed: true, get, ...(input.note && input.note.trim() ? { note: input.note.trim().slice(0, TRADE_LIMITS.noteLength) } : {}), status: 'open', createdAt: Date.now(), expiresAt: Date.now() + settings.expiryHours * 3_600_000, ...(counterOf ? { counterOf } : {}), }; const taken = await withCollectionLock(season.collectionName, async () => { const data = await getCollection(season.collectionName); // Favourite prints never go into an offer: unpicked stacks are pinned to the newest prints that are not favourites. const safe = await protectFavourites(season.collectionName, from, give!); if (!safe.ok) return { ok: false as const, text: safe.text }; give = safe.items; trade.give = give; const res = takeForEscrow(data[from] ?? [], give); if (!res.ok) return res; // Picked prints must be this viewer's own, right now: not sold, forged or already put up in another offer. for (const item of give) { if (!item.ids) continue; const gone = await firstNotHeld(season.collectionName, [from], item.ids); if (gone) return

nodes.name: createTrade
nodes.signature: async function createTrade(input: NewTrade): Promise<TradeResult<{ trade: Trade }>>
nodes.body_text: async function createTrade(input: NewTrade): Promise<TradeResult<{ trade: Trade }>> { const settings = await getTradeSettings(); if (!settings.enabled) return fail(403, 'Trading is paused right now.'); return locked(async () => { const open = await readOpen(); const history = await readHistory(); await sweepInLock(open, history); return createInLock(input, settings, open, history); }); }

nodes.name: findOpen
nodes.signature: async function findOpen(id: string): Promise<{ open: Trade[]; history: Trade[]; trade: Trade } | { error: ReturnType<typeof fail> }>
nodes.body_text: async function findOpen(id: string): Promise<{ open: Trade[]; history: Trade[]; trade: Trade } | { error: ReturnType<typeof fail> }> { const open = await readOpen(); const history = await readHistory(); await sweepInLock(open, history); const trade = open.find(t => t.id === id); if (!trade) { await persist(open, history); return { error: fail(404, 'That offer is no longer open.') }; } return { open, history, trade }; }

nodes.name: acceptTrade
nodes.signature: async function acceptTrade(id: string, username: string, getIds?: Record<string, string[]>): Promise<TradeResult<{ trade: Trade }>>
nodes.body_text: async function acceptTrade(id: string, username: string, getIds?: Record<string, string[]>): Promise<TradeResult<{ trade: Trade }>> { const taker = username.toLowerCase(); const settings = await getTradeSettings(); if (!settings.enabled) return fail(403, 'Trading is paused right now.'); return locked(async () => { const found = await findOpen(id); if ('error' in found) return found.error; const { open, history, trade } = found; if (taker === trade.from) return fail(400, 'You can\'t accept your own offer.'); if (trade.kind === 'direct' && trade.to !== taker) return fail(403, 'That offer is for someone else.'); if ((await blocked(taker)) || (await blocked(trade.from))) return fail(403, 'Trading isn\'t available for this trade.'); if (await tooNew(taker, settings)) return fail(403, `Trading opens ${settings.minAccountHours} hours after you first play.`); const season = await getSeason(trade.seasonId); if (!season) return fail(404, 'That season no longer exists.'); if (season.tradingFrozen) return fail(403, 'Trading is closed for this season.'); // Prints the taker chose for what the offer asks (the offerer may have pinned some already). let get = withChosenPrints(trade.get, getIds); if (!get) return fail(400, 'Those prints don\'t match what the offer asks for.'); if (hasPickedPrints(get) && !(await isTracking(season.collectionName))) return fail(400, 'Prints in this season are not numbered yet, so they can\'t be chosen.'); // Read the serials on both sides before the copies change hands (picked prints are priced from their own ids). const pools = await snapshotPools(trade.seasonId, { give: escrowOwner(trade.id), get: taker }); let moved: Trade['moved']; const result = await withCollectionLock(season.collectionName, async () => { const data = await getCollection(season.collectionName); // The taker's favourite prints stay put: picked ones are refused, unpicked stacks skip them. The offer stays open. const safe = await protectFavourites(season.collectionName, taker, get!); if (!safe.ok) return { ok: false as const, text: safe.text }; get = safe.items; const settled = settleTrade(data[trade.from] ?? [], data[taker] ?? [], trade.give, get); if (!settled.ok) return settled; // Exact prints must still be the taker's: if one moved since the offer was made, the offer stays open for a counter. for (const item of get) { if (!item.ids) continue; const gone = await firstNotHeld(season.collectionName, [taker], item.ids); if (!gone) continue; const pinned = trade.get.some(t => t.cardNumber === item.cardNumber && t.variant === item.variant && t.ids); return { ok: false as const, text: `${pinned ? 'That offer asks for' : 'You chose'} ${await printLabel(season.collectionName, gone.id)}, which you no longer hold.` }; } moved = await movedPrints(season.collectionName, escrowOwner(trade.id), trade.give, taker, get!); data[trade.from] = settled.offerer; data[taker] = settled.taker; // Identity follows the cards: the offer's copies leave escrow for the taker, the asked-for copies go to the offerer. await saveCollection(season.collectionName, data, { moves: [ ...trade.give.map(i => ({ from: escrowOwner(trade.id), to: taker, ...moveOf(i) })), ...get.map(i => ({ from: taker, to: trade.from, ...moveOf(i) })), ] }); return settled; }); if (!result.ok && 'text' in result) return fail(400, result.text); if (!result.ok) { return fail(400, `You don't have ${result.missing.count}× card #${result.missing.cardNumber} (${result.missing.variant}) that this offer asks for.`); } // The escrow has been handed over, so close without refunding. The record keeps the exact prints that came back. trade.escrowed = false; trade.get = get!; if (moved) trade.moved = moved; await closeTrade(open, history, trade, 'accepted', taker, undefined, false, pools); await persist(open, history); return { ok: true, trade }; }); }

nodes.name: movedPrints
nodes.signature: async function movedPrints(c: string, escrow: string, give: TradeItem[], taker: string, get: TradeItem[]): Promise<Trade['moved']>
nodes.body_text: async function movedPrints(c: string, escrow: string, give: TradeItem[], taker: string, get: TradeItem[]): Promise<Trade['moved']> { if (!(await isTracking(c))) return undefined; const pick = async (owner: string, items: TradeItem[]) => { const have = await getOwnerCopies(c, owner); return items.flatMap(i => i.ids ?? newestFirst(have.filter(x => entryOf(x) === encodeEntry(i.cardNumber, i.variant)), i.count).map(x => x.id)); }; return { give: await pick(escrow, give), get: await pick(taker, get) }; }

nodes.name: pick
nodes.body_text: pick = async (owner: string, items: TradeItem[]) => { const have = await getOwnerCopies(c, owner); return items.flatMap(i => i.ids ?? newestFirst(have.filter(x => entryOf(x) === encodeEntry(i.cardNumber, i.variant)), i.count).map(x => x.id)); }

nodes.name: declineTrade
nodes.signature: async function declineTrade(id: string, username: string): Promise<TradeResult<{ trade: Trade }>>
nodes.body_text: async function declineTrade(id: string, username: string): Promise<TradeResult<{ trade: Trade }>> { const user = username.toLowerCase(); return locked(async () => { const found = await findOpen(id); if ('error' in found) return found.error; const { open, history, trade } = found; if (trade.kind !== 'direct' || trade.to !== user) return fail(403, 'Only the person it was offered to can decline it.'); await closeTrade(open, history, trade, 'declined', user); await persist(open, history); return { ok: true, trade }; }); }

nodes.name: cancelTrade
nodes.signature: async function cancelTrade(id: string, username: string, opts: { admin?: boolean; reason?: string } = {}): Promise<TradeResult<{ trade: Trade }>>
nodes.body_text: async function cancelTrade(id: string, username: string, opts: { admin?: boolean; reason?: string } = {}): Promise<TradeResult<{ trade: Trade }>> { const user = username.toLowerCase(); return locked(async () => { const found = await findOpen(id); if ('error' in found) return found.error; const { open, history, trade } = found; if (!opts.admin && trade.from !== user) return fail(403, 'You can only cancel your own offers.'); await closeTrade(open, history, trade, 'cancelled', opts.admin ? 'admin' : user, opts.reason); await persist(open, history); return { ok: true, trade }; }); }

nodes.name: counterTrade
nodes.signature: async function counterTrade(id: string, username: string, input: { give: unknown; get: unknown; note?: string }): Promise<TradeResult<{ trade: Trade }>>
nodes.body_text: async function counterTrade(id: string, username: string, input: { give: unknown; get: unknown; note?: string }): Promise<TradeResult<{ trade: Trade }>> { const user = username.toLowerCase(); const settings = await getTradeSettings(); if (!settings.enabled) return fail(403, 'Trading is paused right now.'); return locked(async () => { const found = await findOpen(id); if ('error' in found) return found.error; const { open, history, trade } = found; if (trade.kind !== 'direct' || trade.to !== user) return fail(403, 'You can only counter an offer made to you.'); // Make the counter first (it can fail validation); only then retire the original. const created = await createInLock({ seasonId: trade.seasonId, from: user, kind: 'direct', to: trade.from, give: input.give, get: input.get, note: input.note }, settings, open, history, trade.id); if (!created.ok) return created; await closeTrade(open, history, trade, 'countered', user); await persist(open, history); return created; }); }

nodes.name: summarizeTrade
nodes.signature: function summarizeTrade(t: Trade, nameOf?: (n: number) => string | undefined): string
nodes.body_text: function summarizeTrade(t: Trade, nameOf?: (n: number) => string | undefined): string { return `${t.from} gives ${describeItems(t.give, nameOf)} for ${describeItems(t.get, nameOf)}${t.to ? ` (to ${t.to})` : ' (open listing)'}`; }

nodes.name: tradeCountsByUser
nodes.signature: async function tradeCountsByUser(): Promise<Record<string, { total: number; open: number; completed: number }>>
nodes.body_text: async function tradeCountsByUser(): Promise<Record<string, { total: number; open: number; completed: number }>> { const [open, history] = await Promise.all([readOpen(), readHistory()]); const out: Record<string, { total: number; open: number; completed: number }> = {}; const bump = (u: string | undefined, key: 'open' | 'completed' | 'other') => { if (!u) return; const e = (out[u] ??= { total: 0, open: 0, completed: 0 }); e.total++; if (key === 'open') e.open++; if (key === 'completed') e.completed++; }; for (const t of open) { bump(t.from, 'open'); bump(t.to, 'open'); } for (const t of history) { const done = t.status === 'accepted'; bump(t.from, done ? 'completed' : 'other'); bump(t.to ?? (done ? t.resolvedBy : undefined), done ? 'completed' : 'other'); } return out; }

nodes.name: cancelOpenTrades
nodes.signature: async function cancelOpenTrades(filter: { username?: string; seasonId?: string }, reason = 'Cancelled by an admin'): Promise<number>
nodes.body_text: async function cancelOpenTrades(filter: { username?: string; seasonId?: string }, reason = 'Cancelled by an admin'): Promise<number> { const user = filter.username?.toLowerCase(); return locked(async () => { const open = await readOpen(); const history = await readHistory(); await sweepInLock(open, history); const hit = open.filter(t => (!user || t.from === user || t.to === user) && (!filter.seasonId || t.seasonId === filter.seasonId)); for (const t of hit) await closeTrade(open, history, t, 'cancelled', 'admin', reason); await persist(open, history); return hit.length; }); }

nodes.name: extendOpenTrades
nodes.signature: async function extendOpenTrades(ids: string[] | null, hours: number): Promise<number>
nodes.body_text: async function extendOpenTrades(ids: string[] | null, hours: number): Promise<number> { const add = Math.max(1, Math.min(24 * 14, Math.floor(hours) || 0)) * 3_600_000; return locked(async () => { const open = await readOpen(); const history = await readHistory(); await sweepInLock(open, history); let n = 0; for (const t of open) { if (ids && !ids.includes(t.id)) continue; t.expiresAt = Math.max(t.expiresAt, Date.now()) + add; n++; } await persist(open, history); return n; }); }

nodes.name: rebuildMoved
nodes.signature: async function rebuildMoved(c: string, trade: Trade, taker: string): Promise<Trade['moved'] | null>
nodes.body_text: async function rebuildMoved(c: string, trade: Trade, taker: string): Promise<Trade['moved'] | null> { if (!trade.resolvedAt || !(await isTracking(c))) return null; const at = trade.resolvedAt; const side = async (items: TradeItem[], by: string, to: string): Promise<string[] | null> => { const out: string[] = []; for (const i of items) { const live = await liveCopiesOfEntry(c, encodeEntry(i.cardNumber, i.variant)); if (live.length > 3000) return null; const hits: string[] = []; for (const { id } of live) { const copy = await getCopy(c, id); if (copy?.ev.some(e => e.type === 'traded' && e.who === by && e.to === to && e.t >= at - REVERSE_WINDOW.before && e.t <= at + REVERSE_WINDOW.after)) hits.push(id); } if (hits.length !== i.count) return null; out.push(...hits); } return out; }; const give = await side(trade.give, trade.from, taker); const get = give && (await side(trade.get, taker, trade.from)); return give && get ? { give, get } : null; }

nodes.name: side
nodes.signature: side = async (items: TradeItem[], by: string, to: string): Promise<string[] | null>
nodes.body_text: side = async (items: TradeItem[], by: string, to: string): Promise<string[] | null> => { const out: string[] = []; for (const i of items) { const live = await liveCopiesOfEntry(c, encodeEntry(i.cardNumber, i.variant)); if (live.length > 3000) return null; const hits: string[] = []; for (const { id } of live) { const copy = await getCopy(c, id); if (copy?.ev.some(e => e.type === 'traded' && e.who === by && e.to === to && e.t >= at - REVERSE_WINDOW.before && e.t <= at + REVERSE_WINDOW.after)) hits.push(id); } if (hits.length !== i.count) return null; out.push(...hits); } return out; }

nodes.name: stillWithReceiver
nodes.signature: async function stillWithReceiver(c: string, holder: string, ids: string[]): Promise<string | null>
nodes.body_text: async function stillWithReceiver(c: string, holder: string, ids: string[]): Promise<string | null> { const gone = await firstNotHeld(c, [holder], ids); if (!gone) return null; const label = await printLabel(c, gone.id); if (!gone.holder) return `${label} no longer exists.`; return isEscrow(gone.holder) ? `${label} is in an open offer.` : `${label} has since been traded to @${gone.holder}.`; }

nodes.name: reverseBlocker
nodes.signature: async function reverseBlocker(trade: Trade): Promise<string | null>
nodes.body_text: async function reverseBlocker(trade: Trade): Promise<string | null> { if (trade.status !== 'accepted') return 'Only a completed trade can be reversed.'; if (trade.reversedAt) return 'This trade was already reversed.'; if (trade.moved) return null; const season = await getSeason(trade.seasonId); if (!season || !trade.resolvedBy) return 'This trade is too old to reverse automatically.'; return (await rebuildMoved(season.collectionName, trade, trade.resolvedBy)) ? null : 'This trade is too old to reverse automatically.'; }

nodes.name: reverseTrade
nodes.signature: async function reverseTrade(id: string, staff: string, reason: string): Promise<TradeResult<{ trade: Trade }>>
nodes.body_text: async function reverseTrade(id: string, staff: string, reason: string): Promise<TradeResult<{ trade: Trade }>> { const why = reason.trim().slice(0, 300); if (!why) return fail(400, 'Give a reason for reversing this trade.'); return locked(async () => { const open = await readOpen(); const history = await readHistory(); const trade = history.find(t => t.id === id); if (!trade) return fail(404, "That trade isn't in the history."); if (trade.status !== 'accepted') return fail(400, 'Only a completed trade can be reversed.'); if (trade.reversedAt) return fail(400, 'This trade was already reversed.'); const taker = trade.resolvedBy; const season = await getSeason(trade.seasonId); if (!taker || !season) return fail(400, 'This trade is too old to reverse automatically.'); const c = season.collectionName; const result = await withCollectionLock(c, async () => { const moved = trade.moved ?? (await rebuildMoved(c, trade, taker)); if (!moved) return { ok: false as const, text: 'This trade is too old to reverse automatically. Use Give / Remove by hand.' }; // The offerer's give went to the taker; the taker's get went to the offerer. const blockedBy = (await stillWithReceiver(c, taker, moved.give)) ?? (await stillWithReceiver(c, trade.from, moved.get)); if (blockedBy) return { ok: false as const, text: `Can't reverse: ${blockedBy}` }; const data = await getCollection(c); const groups = (ids: string[]) => { const m = new Map<number, string[]>(); for (const pid of ids) { const p = parseCopyId(pid); if (p) { const e = encodeEntry(p.card, p.variant); m.set(e, [...(m.get(e) ?? []), pid]); } } return m; }; const reversal = { who: staff, note: why }; const moves: { from: string; to: string; entry: number; count: number; ids: string[]; reversal: typeof reversal }[] = []; let fromList = data[trade.from] ?? []; let takerList = data[taker] ?? []; const mismatch = { ok: false as const, text: "Can't reverse: the collections no longer match the trade." }; for (const [entry, ids] of groups(moved.give)) { const rest = removeEntries(takerList, entry, ids.length); if (!rest) return mismatch; takerList = rest; fromList = [...fromList, ...Array<number>(ids.length).fill(entry)]; moves.push({ from: taker, to: trade.from, entry, count: ids.length, ids, reversal }); } for (const [entry, ids] of groups(moved.get)) { const rest = removeEntries(fromList, entry, ids.length); if (!rest) return mismatch; fromList = rest; takerList = [...takerList, ...Array<number>(ids.length).fill(entry)]; moves.push({ from: trade.from, to: taker, entry, count: ids.length, ids, reversal }); } data[trade.from] = fromList; data[taker] = takerList; await saveCollection(c, data, { moves }); return { ok: true as const, moved }; }); if (!result.ok) return fail(400, result.text); trade.moved = result.moved; trade.reversedAt = Date.now(); trade.reversedBy = staff; trade.reverseReason = why; await persist(open, history); queueEvent(trade, 'reversed', 'admin'); return { ok: true, trade }; }); }

nodes.name: groups
nodes.body_text: groups = (ids: string[]) => { const m = new Map<number, string[]>(); for (const pid of ids) { const p = parseCopyId(pid); if (p) { const e = encodeEntry(p.card, p.variant); m.set(e, [...(m.get(e) ?? []), pid]); } } return m; }

nodes.name: ttl-cache.ts
nodes.body_text: // A tiny in-memory cache with a time limit, for expensive public reads (the season leaderboard) that many visitors ask for at once. // It lives in one server instance's memory, so it only softens bursts: a fresh instance starts empty, which is fine. In-flight // work is shared, so ten simultaneous visitors cause one computation, not ten. Pure (no framework imports); the clock is injectable.

nodes.name: TtlCache
nodes.body_text: interface TtlCache<T> { /** The cached value for `key`, or computes it (once, even for concurrent callers) and keeps it for the TTL. */ get(key: string, compute: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T>; clear(): void; size(): number; }

nodes.name: createTtlCache
nodes.signature: function createTtlCache<T>(ttlMs: number, now: () => number = Date.now, maxEntries = 50): TtlCache<T>
nodes.body_text: function createTtlCache<T>(ttlMs: number, now: () => number = Date.now, maxEntries = 50): TtlCache<T> { const done = new Map<string, { at: number; value: T }>(); const pending = new Map<string, Promise<T>>(); return { async get(key, compute) { const hit = done.get(key); if (hit && now() - hit.at < ttlMs) return hit.value; const running = pending.get(key); if (running) return running; const p = compute().then( value => { done.set(key, { at: now(), value }); // Keep the map small: drop the oldest when over the limit. if (done.size > maxEntries) done.delete(done.keys().next().value as string); pending.delete(key); return value; }, err => { pending.delete(key); throw err; }, // a failure is never cached ); pending.set(key, p); return p; }, clear() { done.clear(); pending.clear(); }, size() { return done.size; }, }; }

nodes.name: get
nodes.body_text: async get(key, compute) { const hit = done.get(key); if (hit && now() - hit.at < ttlMs) return hit.value; const running = pending.get(key); if (running) return running; const p = compute().then( value => { done.set(key, { at: now(), value }); // Keep the map small: drop the oldest when over the limit. if (done.size > maxEntries) done.delete(done.keys().next().value as string); pending.delete(key); return value; }, err => { pending.delete(key); throw err; }, // a failure is never cached ); pending.set(key, p); return p; }

nodes.name: clear
nodes.body_text: clear() { done.clear(); pending.clear(); }

nodes.name: twitch-helix.ts
nodes.body_text: // Twitch Helix API access via the app (client_credentials) token. // Distinct from TWITCH_EXTENSION_SECRET, which only verifies Extension JWTs. // Outside production the Twitch URLs can point at scripts/mock-twitch.cjs so this can be tested without real credentials. const dev = process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production'; export const TWITCH_ID_URL = (dev && process.env.TWITCH_ID_URL) || 'https://id.twitch.tv'; export const TWITCH_API_URL = (dev && process.env.TWITCH_API_URL) || 'https://api.twitch.tv'; let cachedToken: { access_token: string; expires_at: number } | null = null; /** * Resolve a numeric Twitch user ID to a lowercase login name. * Returns null if the user doesn't exist; throws on credential/network/API errors * (or if credentials are not configured). */ /** * Looks up profile pictures for Twitch logins (Helix allows up to 100 per request). * Returns login → profile_image_url; logins that don't exist on Twitch are simply absent. * Throws on credential/network/API errors so callers can avoid caching a failure as "no avatar". */

nodes.name: twitchCredentials
nodes.signature: function twitchCredentials(): { clientId: string; clientSecret: string } | null
nodes.body_text: function twitchCredentials(): { clientId: string; clientSecret: string } | null { const clientId = process.env.TWITCH_CLIENT_ID; const clientSecret = process.env.TWITCH_CLIENT_SECRET; return clientId && clientSecret ? { clientId, clientSecret } : null; }

nodes.name: getAppAccessToken
nodes.signature: async function getAppAccessToken(clientId: string, clientSecret: string): Promise<string>
nodes.body_text: async function getAppAccessToken(clientId: string, clientSecret: string): Promise<string> { // Module-scoped cache, survives across requests in the same serverless instance if (cachedToken && Date.now() < cachedToken.expires_at) return cachedToken.access_token; const res = await fetch(`${TWITCH_ID_URL}/oauth2/token`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }, body: new URLSearchParams({ client_id: clientId, client_secret: clientSecret, grant_type: 'client_credentials', }), }); if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Token fetch failed: ${res.status}`); const data = await res.json() as { access_token: string; expires_in: number }; cachedToken = { access_token: data.access_token, expires_at: Date.now() + (data.expires_in - 60) * 1000, }; return cachedToken.access_token; }

nodes.name: resolveTwitchLogin
nodes.signature: async function resolveTwitchLogin(numericUserId: string): Promise<string | null>
nodes.body_text: async function resolveTwitchLogin(numericUserId: string): Promise<string | null> { const creds = twitchCredentials(); if (!creds) throw new Error('Twitch credentials not configured'); const token = await getAppAccessToken(creds.clientId, creds.clientSecret); const res = await fetch(`${TWITCH_API_URL}/helix/users?id=${encodeURIComponent(numericUserId)}`, { headers: { 'Client-ID': creds.clientId, Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }, }); if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Helix error: ${res.status}`); const data = await res.json() as { data?: Array<{ login: string }> }; return data.data?.[0]?.login ?? null; }

nodes.name: fetchTwitchAvatars
nodes.signature: async function fetchTwitchAvatars(logins: string[]): Promise<Record<string, string>>
nodes.body_text: async function fetchTwitchAvatars(logins: string[]): Promise<Record<string, string>> { const creds = twitchCredentials(); if (!creds) throw new Error('Twitch credentials not configured'); const token = await getAppAccessToken(creds.clientId, creds.clientSecret); const out: Record<string, string> = {}; for (let i = 0; i < logins.length; i += 100) { const query = logins.slice(i, i + 100).map(l => `login=${encodeURIComponent(l)}`).join('&'); const res = await fetch(`${TWITCH_API_URL}/helix/users?${query}`, { headers: { 'Client-ID': creds.clientId, Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }, }); if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Helix error: ${res.status}`); const data = await res.json() as { data?: Array<{ login: string; profile_image_url: string }> }; for (const u of data.data ?? []) out[u.login.toLowerCase()] = u.profile_image_url; } return out; }

nodes.name: twitch-jwt.ts
nodes.body_text: import { createHmac, timingSafeEqual } from 'crypto'; import { currentSandboxId } from './db'; // Vercel uses Node 18+ so base64url encoding is available natively. // ── Sandbox emulation ── // The fake Twitch page (Admin → Sandbox → Fake Twitch) runs the real panel against a sandbox with a pretend Twitch helper. Its // tokens are signed with a key derived from SESSION_SECRET (never the extension secret), only an admin can mint one, and the // token names the sandbox it is for: it is refused anywhere else, so it can't be used against production data. /** * What the Extension routes call: a real Twitch token (verifyTwitchJwt), or a fake-Twitch token that is only honoured while * the request is inside the sandbox it was minted for. */ /** Pulls a Twitch Extension JWT out of an `Authorization: Bearer <jwt>` header. */ /** * The viewer's numeric Twitch user ID, or undefined if it isn't known. * - Viewers who shared their identity have `user_id` in the JWT. * - Broadcasters can't be prompted (Twitch's requestIdShare is a no-op on your own channel) and * their token carries no `user_id`, but `role: "broadcaster"` is signed by Twitch and means the * viewer owns the channel, so `channel_id` is their user ID. */

nodes.name: TwitchJwtPayload
nodes.body_text: interface TwitchJwtPayload { opaque_user_id: string; user_id?: string; channel_id: string; role: 'broadcaster' | 'moderator' | 'viewer' | 'external'; exp: number; /** Only on tokens minted by the fake Twitch page (see signMockTwitchJwt): the sandbox they are valid in and who they log in as. */ mock?: boolean; sandbox?: string; login?: string; }

nodes.name: verifyTwitchJwt
nodes.body_text: function verifyTwitchJwt(token: string): TwitchJwtPayload | null { const secret = process.env.TWITCH_EXTENSION_SECRET; if (!secret) return null; try { const secretBuf = Buffer.from(secret, 'base64'); const parts = token.split('.'); if (parts.length !== 3) return null; const [header, payload, sig] = parts; const expected = createHmac('sha256', secretBuf) .update(`${header}.${payload}`) .digest('base64url'); if (sig !== expected) return null; const decoded = JSON.parse( Buffer.from(payload, 'base64url').toString('utf8') ) as TwitchJwtPayload; if (decoded.exp < Date.now() / 1000) return null; return decoded; } catch { return null; } }

nodes.name: mockKey
nodes.body_text: mockKey = (): string | null => { const s = process.env.SESSION_SECRET; return s && s.length >= 16 ? `tcg-mock-ext:${s}` : null; }

nodes.name: mockSig
nodes.body_text: mockSig = (key: string, data: string) => createHmac('sha256', key).update(data).digest('base64url')

nodes.name: signMockTwitchJwt
nodes.signature: function signMockTwitchJwt(claims: Omit<TwitchJwtPayload, 'exp' | 'mock'> & { sandbox: string }, ttlSeconds = 4 * 3600): string | null
nodes.body_text: function signMockTwitchJwt(claims: Omit<TwitchJwtPayload, 'exp' | 'mock'> & { sandbox: string }, ttlSeconds = 4 * 3600): string | null { const key = mockKey(); if (!key) return null; const header = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({ alg: 'HS256', typ: 'JWT' })).toString('base64url'); const payload = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({ ...claims, mock: true, exp: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + ttlSeconds })).toString('base64url'); return `${header}.${payload}.${mockSig(key, `${header}.${payload}`)}`; }

nodes.name: verifyMockJwt
nodes.body_text: function verifyMockJwt(token: string): TwitchJwtPayload | null { const key = mockKey(); const parts = token.split('.'); if (!key || parts.length !== 3) return null; try { const expected = Buffer.from(mockSig(key, `${parts[0]}.${parts[1]}`)); const given = Buffer.from(parts[2]); if (expected.length !== given.length || !timingSafeEqual(expected, given)) return null; const decoded = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(parts[1], 'base64url').toString('utf8')) as TwitchJwtPayload; return decoded.mock && decoded.sandbox && decoded.exp >= Date.now() / 1000 ? decoded : null; } catch { return null; } }

nodes.name: verifyExtensionAuth
nodes.signature: async function verifyExtensionAuth(token: string): Promise<TwitchJwtPayload | null>
nodes.body_text: async function verifyExtensionAuth(token: string): Promise<TwitchJwtPayload | null> { const real = verifyTwitchJwt(token); if (real) return real; const mock = verifyMockJwt(token); if (!mock) return null; return (await currentSandboxId()) === mock.sandbox ? mock : null; }

nodes.name: getBearerToken
nodes.body_text: function getBearerToken(req: Request): string | null { const header = req.headers.get('authorization') ?? ''; return header.startsWith('Bearer ') ? header.slice(7) : null; }

nodes.name: getTwitchUserId
nodes.body_text: function getTwitchUserId(payload: TwitchJwtPayload): string | undefined { if (payload.user_id) return payload.user_id; if (payload.role === 'broadcaster' && payload.channel_id) return payload.channel_id; return undefined; }

nodes.name: twitch-live.ts
nodes.body_text: import { kv, inSandbox } from './db'; import { escapeMd, notifyRecap, notifySystem } from './discord'; import { getActivity } from './activity'; import { getActiveSeasonWithPacks } from './kv'; import { buildStreamRecap, recapWorthPosting, type StreamRecap } from './stream-recap'; import { getAppAccessToken, twitchCredentials, TWITCH_API_URL } from './twitch-helix'; import { CHANNEL_LOGIN } from './site'; const KEY = 'twitch:live'; const SINCE_KEY = 'twitch:live:since'; // when the current stream started (ms), set while it is seen live, deleted once its recap is handled const RECAP_LOCK = 'twitch:recap:lock'; export const RECAP_KEY = 'stream:recap:latest'; const ACTIVITY_CAP = 500; // the size of the activity log (lib/activity.ts) const FRESH_MS = 45_000; // how long a lookup is reused, across every serverless instance (shared via KV) /** * Whether the channel is live right now, from Twitch's `streams` endpoint with the app token. Results are cached in KV * for ~45 seconds so page views and polling never turn into Twitch API calls one-for-one. Returns null when Twitch * isn't configured or can't be reached and there's nothing cached, callers should simply show no indicator then. */ /** * Called whenever the channel is seen offline. If a stream start was recorded, the recap is built and posted exactly once: a short * KV lock stops two instances working at the same moment, and the start marker is deleted before posting so nothing can post it * again. No marker (nobody looked while it was live) or no pulls means no recap. Never throws. */ /** The most recent stream recap, for the dashboard widget and the channel card's test button. */

nodes.name: LiveStatus
nodes.body_text: interface LiveStatus { live: boolean; title?: string; game?: string; viewers?: number; startedAt?: string; /** When Twitch was last asked (ms). */ checkedAt: number; }

nodes.name: getLiveStatus
nodes.body_text: async function getLiveStatus(): Promise<LiveStatus | null> { const creds = twitchCredentials(); if (!creds) return null; let cached: LiveStatus | null = null; try { cached = await kv.get<LiveStatus>(KEY); if (cached && Date.now() - cached.checkedAt < FRESH_MS) return cached; } catch { // KV unavailable: fall through and ask Twitch directly } try { const token = await getAppAccessToken(creds.clientId, creds.clientSecret); const res = await fetch(`${TWITCH_API_URL}/helix/streams?user_login=${encodeURIComponent(CHANNEL_LOGIN)}`, { headers: { 'Client-ID': creds.clientId, Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }, cache: 'no-store', }); if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Helix streams error: ${res.status}`); const data = (await res.json()) as { data?: { type?: string; title?: string; game_name?: string; viewer_count?: number; started_at?: string }[] }; const s = data.data?.[0]; const status: LiveStatus = s && s.type === 'live' ? { live: true, title: s.title, game: s.game_name, viewers: s.viewer_count, startedAt: s.started_at, checkedAt: Date.now() } : { live: false, checkedAt: Date.now() }; await kv.set(KEY, status, { ex: 300 }).catch(() => {}); if (status.live) await kv.set(SINCE_KEY, (status.startedAt && Date.parse(status.startedAt)) || Date.now(), { ex: 172_800 }).catch(() => {}); else await finishStream(); if (cached && cached.live !== status.live) { void notifySystem({ title: status.live ? '🔴 The stream went live' : '⚫ The stream went offline', ...(status.live && status.title ? { text: escapeMd(status.title.slice(0, 200)) } : {}), tone: 'info' }); } return status; } catch (e) { console.error('[live] lookup failed:', e instanceof Error ? e.message : e); return cached; // a slightly stale answer beats none } }

nodes.name: finishStream
nodes.signature: async function finishStream(now = Date.now()): Promise<StreamRecap | null>
nodes.body_text: async function finishStream(now = Date.now()): Promise<StreamRecap | null> { try { if (await inSandbox()) return null; const since = await kv.get<number>(SINCE_KEY); if (!since) return null; // nobody saw the stream start: skip, and take no lock if (!(await kv.set(RECAP_LOCK, 1, { nx: true, ex: 60 }))) return null; await kv.del(SINCE_KEY); const [{ events }, active] = await Promise.all([getActivity({ limit: ACTIVITY_CAP }), getActiveSeasonWithPacks().catch(() => null)]); const recap = buildStreamRecap(events, since, now, { seasonId: active?.season.id, logIsFull: events.length >= ACTIVITY_CAP }); if (!recapWorthPosting(recap)) return null; await kv.set(RECAP_KEY, recap); await notifyRecap(recap); return recap; } catch (e) { console.error('[live] recap failed:', e instanceof Error ? e.message : e); return null; } }

nodes.name: getLatestRecap
nodes.body_text: async function getLatestRecap(): Promise<StreamRecap | null> { try { return (await kv.get<StreamRecap>(RECAP_KEY)) ?? null; } catch { return null; } }

nodes.name: twitch-oauth.ts
nodes.body_text: import { SITE_URL } from './site'; // Twitch "Log in with Twitch" (OAuth authorization-code flow) for the website. We ask for NO scopes: that gives a // token that can read only the user's public profile, which is all we need (user ID, login, display name, picture). // The token is used once to read that profile and then revoked. It is never stored. // // The Twitch URLs can be pointed at a local fake (scripts/mock-twitch.cjs) outside production, so the flow can be // tested without real Twitch credentials. In production they are always the real ones. const dev = process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production'; const ID_URL = (dev && process.env.TWITCH_ID_URL) || 'https://id.twitch.tv'; const API_URL = (dev && process.env.TWITCH_API_URL) || 'https://api.twitch.tv'; /** Must match a "OAuth Redirect URL" registered on the Twitch application exactly. */ export const REDIRECT_URI = `${SITE_URL}/auth/twitch/callback`; /** Swaps the one-time code for an access token. Throws on failure. */ /** Completes the login: code → profile, then discards the token. */ /** Only same-site relative paths may be used as a post-login destination (no open redirects). */

nodes.name: credentials
nodes.body_text: credentials = () => ({ clientId: process.env.TWITCH_CLIENT_ID ?? '', clientSecret: process.env.TWITCH_CLIENT_SECRET ?? '', })

nodes.name: authorizeUrl
nodes.body_text: function authorizeUrl(state: string): string { const { clientId } = credentials(); const params = new URLSearchParams({ client_id: clientId, redirect_uri: REDIRECT_URI, response_type: 'code', scope: '', state, }); return `${ID_URL}/oauth2/authorize?${params}`; }

nodes.name: TwitchProfile
nodes.body_text: interface TwitchProfile { id: string; login: string; // lowercase displayName: string; avatarUrl: string; }

nodes.name: exchangeCode
nodes.body_text: async function exchangeCode(code: string): Promise<string> { const { clientId, clientSecret } = credentials(); const res = await fetch(`${ID_URL}/oauth2/token`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }, body: new URLSearchParams({ client_id: clientId, client_secret: clientSecret, code, grant_type: 'authorization_code', redirect_uri: REDIRECT_URI, }), }); if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Twitch token exchange failed (${res.status})`); const data = (await res.json()) as { access_token?: string }; if (!data.access_token) throw new Error('Twitch returned no access token'); return data.access_token; }

nodes.name: fetchProfile
nodes.body_text: async function fetchProfile(accessToken: string): Promise<TwitchProfile> { const { clientId } = credentials(); const res = await fetch(`${API_URL}/helix/users`, { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}`, 'Client-Id': clientId }, }); if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Twitch profile lookup failed (${res.status})`); const data = (await res.json()) as { data?: { id: string; login: string; display_name: string; profile_image_url: string }[] }; const u = data.data?.[0]; if (!u) throw new Error('Twitch returned no user'); return { id: u.id, login: u.login.toLowerCase(), displayName: u.display_name || u.login, avatarUrl: u.profile_image_url }; }

nodes.name: revoke
nodes.body_text: async function revoke(accessToken: string): Promise<void> { const { clientId } = credentials(); await fetch(`${ID_URL}/oauth2/revoke`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }, body: new URLSearchParams({ client_id: clientId, token: accessToken }), }).catch(() => {}); }

nodes.name: profileFromCode
nodes.body_text: async function profileFromCode(code: string): Promise<TwitchProfile> { const token = await exchangeCode(code); try { return await fetchProfile(token); } finally { await revoke(token); } }

nodes.name: safeReturnTo
nodes.signature: function safeReturnTo(raw: string | null | undefined, fallback = '/account'): string
nodes.body_text: function safeReturnTo(raw: string | null | undefined, fallback = '/account'): string { if (!raw || !raw.startsWith('/') || raw.startsWith('//') || raw.startsWith('/\\') || raw.includes('\n') || raw.includes('\r')) return fallback; if (raw.startsWith('/auth/')) return fallback; return raw; }

nodes.name: twitch-viewer.ts
nodes.body_text: import { NextResponse } from 'next/server'; import { getTwitchOpaqueUser } from './kv'; import { getBearerToken, verifyExtensionAuth } from './twitch-jwt'; const DEV_OPAQUE_ID = 'dev_mock_opaque'; /** * The viewer behind a Twitch Extension request: signed JWT -> opaque ID -> linked username. Never read from the body or query. * (Dev mode, no extension secret configured, accepts any bearer, like the other extension routes.) */

nodes.name: extensionViewer
nodes.signature: async function extensionViewer(req: Request): Promise<{ username: string } | { response: NextResponse }>
nodes.body_text: async function extensionViewer(req: Request): Promise<{ username: string } | { response: NextResponse }> { const token = getBearerToken(req); if (!token) return { response: NextResponse.json({ error: 'Missing authorization token' }, { status: 401 }) }; const payload = await verifyExtensionAuth(token); const devMode = !payload && !process.env.TWITCH_EXTENSION_SECRET; if (!payload && !devMode) return { response: NextResponse.json({ error: 'Invalid or expired token' }, { status: 401 }) }; const username = await getTwitchOpaqueUser(payload?.opaque_user_id ?? DEV_OPAQUE_ID); if (!username) return { response: NextResponse.json({ error: 'Log in first.' }, { status: 401 }) }; return { username }; }
