nodes.name: upgradeCard
nodes.signature: async function upgradeCard(opts: { seasonId: string; username: string; cardNumber: number; from: Variant; }): Promise<UpgradeResult>
nodes.body_text: async function upgradeCard(opts: { seasonId: string; username: string; cardNumber: number; from: Variant; }): Promise<UpgradeResult> { const { seasonId, cardNumber, from } = opts; const username = opts.username.toLowerCase(); if (from === 'shiny') return { ok: false, status: 400, error: `${VARIANT_LABELS[from]} can't be upgraded any further.` }; const season = await getSeason(seasonId); if (!season) return { ok: false, status: 404, error: 'Season not found.' }; if (!season.active) return { ok: false, status: 400, error: 'Cards can only be upgraded in the active season.' }; const packs = await getPacksForSeason(season); const withCards = await Promise.all(packs.map(async pack => ({ pack, cards: await getPackCards(pack.id) }))); const found = withCards .map(({ pack, cards }) => ({ pack, card: cards.find(c => c.number === cardNumber) })) .find(x => x.card); if (!found?.card) return { ok: false, status: 404, error: 'That card is not in this season.' }; const { pack, card } = found; if (!upgradesAllowed(pack, card)) return { ok: false, status: 400, error: 'Upgrades are turned off for this card.' }; // The next variant that is switched on for this pack and card (a switched-off one is skipped at the combined cost). const step = upgradeStep(pack, card, from); if (!step) return { ok: false, status: 400, error: `${VARIANT_LABELS[from]} can't be upgraded any further for this card.` }; const { to, cost } = step; const fromEntry = encodeEntry(cardNumber, from); let made: { copyId: string | null; uid: number | null } = { copyId: null, uid: null }; const result = await withCollectionLock(season.collectionName, async (): Promise<UpgradeResult> => { const data = await getCollection(season.collectionName); const owned = data[username] ?? []; const remaining = removeEntries(owned, fromEntry, cost); if (!remaining) { const have = owned.filter(e => e === fromEntry).length; return { ok: false, status: 400, error: `You need ${cost} ${VARIANT_LABELS[from]} prints to upgrade; you have ${have}.`, }; } // Favourite prints are never spent: the cost is paid from the newest prints that are not favourites. let spend: string[] | undefined; if (await isTracking(season.collectionName)) { const r = await spendablePrints(season.collectionName, username, fromEntry, cost, undefined, await favouriteIdsOf(season.collectionName, username), 'spend'); if (!r.ok) return { ok: false, status: 400, error: r.text }; spend = r.ids ?? undefined; } const updated = [...remaining, encodeEntry(cardNumber, to)]; data[username] = updated; await saveCollection(season.collectionName, data, { upgrade: { user: username, spent: fromEntry, count: cost, made: encodeEntry(cardNumber, to), ...(spend ? { ids: spend } : {}) } }); const last = await lastCopy(season.collectionName, encodeEntry(cardNumber, to)); const serial = last.serial; made = last; const mult = serial ? serialMultiplier(serial, await getScoringSettings()) : 1; return { ok: true, owned: updated, cardName: card.name, from, to, cost, serial, serialMult: Math.round(mult * 100) / 100 }; }); if (result.ok) { await recordActivity({ type: 'upgrade', username, collectionName: season.collectionName, cardNumber, cardName: card.name, from, to, cost, ...(made.copyId ? { copyId: made.copyId } : {}), ...(made.uid ? { uid: made.uid } : {}), }); } return result; }

nodes.name: user-admin.ts
nodes.body_text: import { getSelfHidden } from './user-settings-store'; import { kv } from './db'; import { getCollection, getUserProfile, listSeasons, saveCollection, saveUserProfile, withCollectionLock, deleteUserProfile } from './kv'; import { recordAudit } from './audit'; import { currentStaffLogin } from './staff-actor'; import { listOpenTrades } from './trades'; import type { UserProfile } from './types'; // Server-side helpers for the admin Users pages: tags and moderation flags, the hidden-viewers set, restore points (snapshots taken // before a reset / delete / merge) and account merging. // ── Tags and flags ── export const MAX_TAGS = 8; export const SUGGESTED_TAGS = ['vip', 'moderator', 'test account', 'streamer friend', 'watch']; const HIDDEN_KEY = 'users:hidden'; /** Viewers hidden from public rankings. One small array, kept in step by saveFlags. */ /** Only the ones an admin hid (viewers who chose a private profile are tracked separately). */ /** True when this viewer is blocked from trading. */ // ── Restore points ── const SNAP_TTL = 14 * 24 * 3600; // seconds const SNAP_KEEP = 6; /** Saves what is about to be removed (cards in every season, and the profile) for 14 days. Returns null when there was nothing to save. */ /** Puts a restore point back: each saved collection is replaced with the saved cards (a restore point is taken of what it overwrites). */ // ── Merge ── /** * Moves every card of `from` into `into` (all seasons), unions their tags, keeps `into`'s profile and removes `from`'s. Refused while either * has open trade offers (escrowed cards belong to the trade). Restore points are taken of both first. */

nodes.name: cleanTag
nodes.body_text: function cleanTag(input: string): string { return input.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9 _-]/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 20); }

nodes.name: cleanTags
nodes.body_text: function cleanTags(list: string[]): string[] { return [...new Set(list.map(cleanTag).filter(Boolean))].slice(0, MAX_TAGS); }

nodes.name: UserFlags
nodes.body_text: interface UserFlags { /** Cannot make or accept trade offers, and cannot be offered one. */ noTrading?: boolean; /** Left out of the public leaderboard, card owner lists and recent pulls. */ hideFromBoard?: boolean; /** Why (admins only). */ reason?: string; at?: number; /** The staff member who set them (Twitch login). */ by?: string; }

nodes.name: getHiddenUsers
nodes.body_text: async function getHiddenUsers(): Promise<Set<string>> { const [admin, self] = await Promise.all([getAdminHidden(), getSelfHidden()]); for (const u of self) admin.add(u); return admin; }

nodes.name: getAdminHidden
nodes.body_text: async function getAdminHidden(): Promise<Set<string>> { try { return new Set((await kv.get<string[]>(HIDDEN_KEY)) ?? []); } catch { return new Set(); } }

nodes.name: setHidden
nodes.signature: async function setHidden(username: string, hidden: boolean): Promise<void>
nodes.body_text: async function setHidden(username: string, hidden: boolean): Promise<void> { const set = await getAdminHidden(); if (hidden) set.add(username); else set.delete(username); await kv.set(HIDDEN_KEY, [...set]); }

nodes.name: ensureProfile
nodes.body_text: async function ensureProfile(username: string): Promise<UserProfile> { return (await getUserProfile(username)) ?? { username, displayName: username, createdAt: Date.now() }; }

nodes.name: saveTags
nodes.signature: async function saveTags(username: string, tags: string[]): Promise<string[]>
nodes.body_text: async function saveTags(username: string, tags: string[]): Promise<string[]> { const name = username.toLowerCase(); const profile = await ensureProfile(name); const clean = cleanTags(tags); await saveUserProfile({ ...profile, tags: clean }); await recordAudit(name, 'Tags changed', clean.join(', ') || 'none'); return clean; }

nodes.name: saveFlags
nodes.signature: async function saveFlags(username: string, flags: UserFlags): Promise<void>
nodes.body_text: async function saveFlags(username: string, flags: UserFlags): Promise<void> { const name = username.toLowerCase(); const profile = await ensureProfile(name); const any = !!(flags.noTrading || flags.hideFromBoard); const by = any ? await currentStaffLogin() : null; const next: UserFlags | undefined = any ? { noTrading: !!flags.noTrading, hideFromBoard: !!flags.hideFromBoard, reason: (flags.reason ?? '').slice(0, 200), at: Date.now(), ...(by ? { by } : {}) } : undefined; await saveUserProfile({ ...profile, flags: next }); await setHidden(name, !!flags.hideFromBoard); await recordAudit(name, any ? 'Restrictions set' : 'Restrictions cleared', any ? [flags.noTrading && 'no trading', flags.hideFromBoard && 'hidden from public boards', flags.reason].filter(Boolean).join(' · ') : undefined); }

nodes.name: isTradeBlocked
nodes.body_text: async function isTradeBlocked(username: string): Promise<boolean> { try { return !!(await getUserProfile(username))?.flags?.noTrading; } catch { return false; } }

nodes.name: UserSnapshot
nodes.body_text: interface UserSnapshot { id: string; at: number; reason: string; profile: UserProfile | null; collections: { collectionName: string; seasonName: string; entries: number[] }[]; }

nodes.name: snapIndex
nodes.body_text: snapIndex = (u: string) => `user:${u}:snaps`

nodes.name: snapKey
nodes.body_text: snapKey = (u: string, id: string) => `user:${u}:snap:${id}`

nodes.name: takeUserSnapshot
nodes.signature: async function takeUserSnapshot(username: string, reason: string): Promise<UserSnapshot | null>
nodes.body_text: async function takeUserSnapshot(username: string, reason: string): Promise<UserSnapshot | null> { const name = username.toLowerCase(); const [seasons, profile] = await Promise.all([listSeasons(), getUserProfile(name)]); const collections: UserSnapshot['collections'] = []; for (const s of seasons) { const entries = (await getCollection(s.collectionName))[name]; if (entries && entries.length > 0) collections.push({ collectionName: s.collectionName, seasonName: s.name, entries: [...entries] }); } if (collections.length === 0 && !profile) return null; const snap: UserSnapshot = { id: Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10), at: Date.now(), reason, profile: profile ?? null, collections }; await kv.set(snapKey(name, snap.id), snap, { ex: SNAP_TTL }); const ids = ((await kv.get<string[]>(snapIndex(name))) ?? []).filter(Boolean); await kv.set(snapIndex(name), [snap.id, ...ids].slice(0, SNAP_KEEP), { ex: SNAP_TTL }); return snap; }

nodes.name: listUserSnapshots
nodes.body_text: async function listUserSnapshots(username: string): Promise<UserSnapshot[]> { const name = username.toLowerCase(); try { const ids = (await kv.get<string[]>(snapIndex(name))) ?? []; const snaps = await Promise.all(ids.map(id => kv.get<UserSnapshot>(snapKey(name, id)))); return snaps.filter((s): s is UserSnapshot => !!s); } catch { return []; } }

nodes.name: restoreUserSnapshot
nodes.signature: async function restoreUserSnapshot(username: string, id: string): Promise<{ ok: true; cards: number } | { ok: false; error: string }>
nodes.body_text: async function restoreUserSnapshot(username: string, id: string): Promise<{ ok: true; cards: number } | { ok: false; error: string }> { const name = username.toLowerCase(); const snap = await kv.get<UserSnapshot>(snapKey(name, id)); if (!snap) return { ok: false, error: 'That restore point has expired or no longer exists.' }; await takeUserSnapshot(name, 'Before restoring'); let cards = 0; for (const c of snap.collections) { await withCollectionLock(c.collectionName, async () => { const data = await getCollection(c.collectionName); data[name] = [...c.entries]; await saveCollection(c.collectionName, data); }); cards += c.entries.length; } if (snap.profile) await saveUserProfile(snap.profile); if (snap.profile?.flags?.hideFromBoard) await setHidden(name, true); await recordAudit(name, 'Restored from a restore point', `${cards} cards · ${snap.reason}`); return { ok: true, cards }; }

nodes.name: mergeUsers
nodes.signature: async function mergeUsers(fromRaw: string, intoRaw: string): Promise<{ ok: true; cards: number } | { ok: false; error: string }>
nodes.body_text: async function mergeUsers(fromRaw: string, intoRaw: string): Promise<{ ok: true; cards: number } | { ok: false; error: string }> { const from = fromRaw.toLowerCase().trim(); const into = intoRaw.toLowerCase().trim().replace(/^@/, ''); if (!from || !into || from === into) return { ok: false, error: 'Choose a different account to merge into.' }; const open = await listOpenTrades(); if (open.some(t => t.from === from || t.to === from || t.from === into || t.to === into)) return { ok: false, error: 'One of them has open trade offers. Cancel or wait for them to end first (the cards in an offer belong to the trade).' }; await takeUserSnapshot(from, `Before merging into ${into}`); await takeUserSnapshot(into, `Before merging ${from} into it`); let moved = 0; for (const s of await listSeasons()) { await withCollectionLock(s.collectionName, async () => { const data = await getCollection(s.collectionName); const mine = data[from]; if (!mine || mine.length === 0) return; data[into] = [...(data[into] ?? []), ...mine]; delete data[from]; moved += mine.length; await saveCollection(s.collectionName, data); }); } const [fromProfile, intoProfile] = await Promise.all([getUserProfile(from), getUserProfile(into)]); const base = intoProfile ?? { username: into, displayName: into, createdAt: fromProfile?.createdAt ?? Date.now() }; await saveUserProfile({ ...base, createdAt: Math.min(base.createdAt, fromProfile?.createdAt ?? base.createdAt), tags: cleanTags([...(base.tags ?? []), ...(fromProfile?.tags ?? [])]), twitchId: base.twitchId ?? fromProfile?.twitchId }); await deleteUserProfile(from); await setHidden(from, false); await recordAudit(into, 'Merged an account into this one', `${from} → ${into} · ${moved} cards`); await recordAudit(from, 'Merged into another account', `${from} → ${into} · ${moved} cards`); return { ok: true, cards: moved }; }

Never other people's data. */

nodes.body_text: async function buildExport(username: string) { const u = username.toLowerCase(); const [profile, settings, seasons, notices, trades, pushDevices, feedback, tester, email] = await Promise.all([ getUserProfile(u).catch(() => null), getUserSettings(u), listSeasons().catch(() => []), listNotices(u).catch(() => ({ notices: [], seen: 0 })), tradesForUser(u).catch(() => null), listDevices(u).catch(() => []), feedbackOf(u).catch(() => []), getTester(u).catch(() => null), getEmail(u).catch(() => null), ]); const collections = (await Promise.all(seasons.map(async s => { const owned = (await getCollection(s.collectionName).catch(() => ({} as Record<string, number[]>)))[u] ?? []; return owned.length ? { seasonId: s.id, season: s.name, entries: owned } : null; }))).filter(Boolean); return { exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(), username: u, profile: profile ? { displayName: profile.displayName, twitchId: profile.twitchId, createdAt: profile.createdAt } : null, settings, collections, notices: notices.notices, alertDevices: pushDevices, email: email ? { address: email.address, confirmedAt: email.verifiedAt ? new Date(email.verifiedAt).toISOString() : null, kinds: email.kinds, off: email.off ?? null } : null, feedback, tester: tester ? { tier: tester.tier, addedAt: tester.addedAt, note: tester.note ?? null } : null, trades: trades ? { incoming: trades.incoming, outgoing: trades.outgoing, recent: trades.recent } : null, note: 'Collection entries are card numbers; numbers of 1,000,000 and up are upgraded versions (number + 1,000,000 x version).', }; }

nodes.name: user-settings-store.ts
nodes.body_text: import { kv } from './db'; import { DEFAULT_SETTINGS, sanitizeUserSettings, sparse, type UserSettings } from './user-settings'; import { syncWatchIndex } from './watch-index'; // Server side of viewer settings: KV `user:<u>:settings` (sparse) and the set `users:hidden:self` of viewers who made their // own profile private. The admin-set hidden list (`users:hidden`) stays separate so each side can be switched off alone. export const SELF_HIDDEN_KEY = 'users:hidden:self'; /** Viewers who chose a private profile. Never throws. */

nodes.name: key
nodes.body_text: key = (u: string) => `user:${u.toLowerCase()}:settings`

nodes.name: getUserSettings
nodes.body_text: async function getUserSettings(username: string): Promise<UserSettings> { try { return sanitizeUserSettings(await kv.get(key(username))); } catch { return { ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS, experiments: [], watches: [], favourites: [] }; } }

nodes.name: getSelfHidden
nodes.body_text: async function getSelfHidden(): Promise<Set<string>> { try { return new Set((await kv.smembers(SELF_HIDDEN_KEY)) as string[]); } catch { return new Set(); } }

nodes.name: saveUserSettings
nodes.signature: async function saveUserSettings(username: string, input: unknown): Promise<UserSettings>
nodes.body_text: async function saveUserSettings(username: string, input: unknown): Promise<UserSettings> { const u = username.toLowerCase(); const next = sanitizeUserSettings(input); const prev = await getUserSettings(u); const small = sparse(next); if (Object.keys(small).length === 0) await kv.del(key(u)); else await kv.set(key(u), small); if (next.privateProfile) await kv.sadd(SELF_HIDDEN_KEY, u); else await kv.srem(SELF_HIDDEN_KEY, u); await syncWatchIndex(u, prev, next); return next; }

nodes.name: deleteUserSettings
nodes.body_text: async function deleteUserSettings(username: string): Promise<void> { const u = username.toLowerCase(); try { const prev = await getUserSettings(u); await kv.del(key(u)); await kv.srem(SELF_HIDDEN_KEY, u); await syncWatchIndex(u, prev, DEFAULT_SETTINGS); } catch { /* best effort */ } }

nodes.name: user-settings.ts
nodes.body_text: // A viewer's own settings (client-safe, pure). Stored sparsely in KV by lib/user-settings-store.ts; everything here is // validated on the way in, so a crafted request can never store an unknown key or an out-of-range value. export const BIO_MAX = 160; import { sanitizeProfileLayout, type ProfilePlacement } from './profile-widgets'; import { sanitizeBinder, type BinderConfig } from './binder-config'; import { UID_BASE } from './serials-core'; import { VARIANTS } from './variants'; import type { Variant } from './types'; import { PUSH_KINDS, type PushKind } from './push-core'; import { HEX_RE, clampAccent } from './accent'; import { DEFAULT_PRONOUNS, sanitizePronouns, type Pronouns } from './pronouns'; export const WANTED_MAX = 6; /** Saved listing alerts: tell me when someone lists this card (in this version, or any). */ export const WATCH_MAX = 10; /** Named header colours for the profile accent (a custom colour is stored as a clamped #rrggbb instead). */ export const ACCENTS = [ { id: 'cheddar', label: 'Cheddar', hex: '#facc15' }, { id: 'ember', label: 'Ember', hex: '#fb923c' }, { id: 'rose', label: 'Rose', hex: '#fb7185' }, { id: 'grape', label: 'Grape', hex: '#c084fc' }, { id: 'ocean', label: 'Ocean', hex: '#38bdf8' }, { id: 'mint', label: 'Mint', hex: '#34d399' }, { id: 'lime', label: 'Lime', hex: '#a3e635' }, { id: 'teal', label: 'Teal', hex: '#2dd4bf' }, { id: 'sky', label: 'Sky', hex: '#60a5fa' }, { id: 'indigo', label: 'Indigo', hex: '#818cf8' }, { id: 'magenta', label: 'Magenta', hex: '#e879f9' }, { id: 'slate', label: 'Slate', hex: '#94a3b8' }, ] as const; /** The colour of a stored accent: a named swatch's hex, or a custom #rrggbb (clamped again here, so a hand-edited value can't escape the limits). */ export const FAVOURITES_MAX = 50; export const DEFAULT_SETTINGS: UserSettings = { bio: '', privateProfile: false, notifyOffers: true, notifyResults: true, notifyWatch: true, notifyFeedback: true, noticeSound: false, pushKinds: [...PUSH_KINDS], allowOffers: true, hideStaffBadge: false, motion: 'system', hideUncollected: true, compactGrids: false, accent: '', pronouns: DEFAULT_PRONOUNS, collectionView: 'grid', wanted: [], watches: [], pinned: null, favourites: [], profileLayout: null, binder: null, experiments: [], }; /** Opt-in features that are still settling. The 'shortcuts' one changes only this viewer's browser; an experiment that changes how their own public profile looks would go here too. */ export const EXPERIMENTS: Experiment[] = [ { id: 'shortcuts', label: 'Keyboard shortcuts', description: 'Press g then h, c, l, s, d, t, a or e to jump to Home, My profile, Leaderboard, Season stats, Card Dex, Trade, My stats or Settings. Press ? for the list. Off while you are typing.' }, ]; const EXPERIMENT_IDS = new Set(EXPERIMENTS.map(e => e.id)); export const BOOLEAN_KEYS = ['privateProfile', 'notifyOffers', 'notifyResults', 'notifyWatch', 'notifyFeedback', 'noticeSound', 'allowOffers', 'hideStaffBadge', 'hideUncollected', 'compactGrids'] as const; /** Anything → a complete, valid settings object. Unknown keys are dropped, bad values fall back to the default. */ /** Only what differs from the defaults (what is actually stored). */ /** Which settings switch governs a notice kind (admin notices are never silenced). */ /** Should a notice of this kind reach this viewer? */

nodes.name: CollectionView

nodes.name: UserSettings
nodes.body_text: interface UserSettings { /** A short line shown under their name on their profile. */ bio: string; /** Leave them off the public leaderboard, card owner lists and recent pulls (their own page still works). */ privateProfile: boolean; /** Bell + trade-page notices for new offers and counters. */ notifyOffers: boolean; /** Bell notices for how their own offers ended (accepted, declined, expired...). */ notifyResults: boolean; /** Bell notices when someone lists a card on their Looking for list or one of their saved alerts. */ notifyWatch: boolean; /** Bell notices when staff answer a suggestion or problem report they sent. */ notifyFeedback: boolean; /** A short sound when a new notice arrives while the site is open (off unless they switch it on). */ noticeSound: boolean; /** Which kinds of notice also arrive as a push alert on their devices (the bell switches above still apply first). */ pushKinds: PushKind[]; /** Accept direct trade offers from other viewers (the open board is unaffected). */ allowOffers: boolean; /** Staff only: hide my Streamer / Admin / Mod badge (a personal account used as a normal player). */ hideStaffBadge: boolean; /** 'reduce' calms the site's animations even when the device does not ask for it. */ motion: MotionPref; /** Start collection grids with uncollected cards hidden. */ hideUncollected: boolean; /** Smaller card tiles in grids. */ compactGrids: boolean; /** Profile header colour: an ACCENTS id, or a custom '#rrggbb' (lightness-clamped on the way in). Empty = the default gold. */ accent: string; /** Card numbers they are looking for (the Looking for widget on their profile). */ wanted: number[]; /** Saved listing alerts (see Watch). A card on the Looking for list alerts too, in any version. */ watches: Watch[]; /** The unique number (Copy.uid) of the copy they pinned as their profile's Showcase copy, or null. Checked against the live owner whenever it is shown. */ pinned: number | null; /** Unique numbers (Copy.uid) of prints they marked as favourites: these can't be traded or spent in an upgrade. Checked against the live owner whenever used. */ favourites: number[]; /** Pronouns shown after their name: nothing until they choose (see lib/pronouns.ts). */ pronouns: Pronouns; /** Which view their collection tab opens in for visitors who have not picked one themselves. */ collectionView: CollectionView; /** The widgets of their profile Overview, in order (null = the default layout). */ profileLayout: ProfilePlacement[] | null; /** How their collection binder looks and (optionally) which card is in which pocket; null = the default look and automatic layout. */ binder: BinderConfig | null; /** Ids of switched-on experimental features (see EXPERIMENTS). */ experiments: string[]; }

nodes.name: Experiment
nodes.body_text: interface Experiment { id: string; label: string; description: string }

nodes.name: sanitizeUserSettings
nodes.body_text: function sanitizeUserSettings(input: unknown): UserSettings { const o = (input && typeof input === 'object' ? input : {}) as Record<string, unknown>; const out: UserSettings = { ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS, experiments: [], watches: [], favourites: [] }; if (typeof o.bio === 'string') out.bio = o.bio.replace(/[\u0000-\u001f\u007f]+/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, BIO_MAX); for (const k of BOOLEAN_KEYS) if (typeof o[k] === 'boolean') out[k] = o[k] as boolean; if (Array.isArray(o.pushKinds)) out.pushKinds = PUSH_KINDS.filter(k => (o.pushKinds as unknown[]).includes(k)); if (o.motion === 'reduce' || o.motion === 'system') out.motion = o.motion; out.pronouns = sanitizePronouns(o.pronouns); if (o.collectionView === 'grid' || o.collectionView === 'binder') out.collectionView = o.collectionView; if (typeof o.accent === 'string') out.accent = ACCENTS.some(a => a.id === o.accent) ? o.accent : HEX_RE.test(o.accent) ? clampAccent(o.accent) ?? '' : ''; if (Array.isArray(o.wanted)) out.wanted = [...new Set(o.wanted.filter((n): n is number => Number.isInteger(n) && n >= 1 && n < 1_000_000))].slice(0, WANTED_MAX); if (Array.isArray(o.watches)) { const seen = new Set<string>(); for (const w of o.watches) { const card = Number((w as { card?: unknown })?.card); const v = (w as { variant?: unknown })?.variant; const variant: Variant | null = typeof v === 'string' && (VARIANTS as readonly string[]).includes(v) ? (v as Variant) : null; if (!Number.isInteger(card) || card < 1 || card >= 1_000_000 || seen.has(`${card}|${variant}`) || out.watches.length >= WATCH_MAX) continue; seen.add(`${card}|${variant}`); out.watches.push({ card, variant }); } } if (typeof o.pinned === 'number' && Number.isInteger(o.pinned) && o.pinned > UID_BASE && o.pinned < 1_000_000_000) out.pinned = o.pinned; if (Array.isArray(o.favourites)) out.favourites = [...new Set(o.favourites.filter((n): n is number => Number.isInteger(n) && n > UID_BASE && n < 1_000_000_000))].slice(0, FAVOURITES_MAX); if (Array.isArray(o.profileLayout)) out.profileLayout = sanitizeProfileLayout(o.profileLayout); if (o.binder && typeof o.binder === 'object') out.binder = sanitizeBinder(o.binder); if (Array.isArray(o.experiments)) out.experiments = [...new Set(o.experiments.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string' && EXPERIMENT_IDS.has(x)))]; return out; }

nodes.name: sparse
nodes.body_text: function sparse(s: UserSettings): Partial<UserSettings> { const out: Record<string, unknown> = {}; for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(s)) if (JSON.stringify(v) !== JSON.stringify((DEFAULT_SETTINGS as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)[k])) out[k] = v; return out as Partial<UserSettings>; }

nodes.name: hasExperiment
nodes.body_text: hasExperiment = (s: UserSettings, id: string) => s.experiments.includes(id)

nodes.name: NoticeGroup
nodes.body_text: type NoticeGroup = 'offers' | 'results' | 'watch' | 'feedback';

nodes.name: noticeGroup
nodes.body_text: function noticeGroup(kind: string): NoticeGroup | null { if (kind === 'offer' || kind === 'countered') return 'offers'; if (kind === 'watch') return 'watch'; if (kind === 'feedback') return 'feedback'; if (kind === 'accepted' || kind === 'declined' || kind === 'cancelled' || kind === 'expired') return 'results'; return null; }

nodes.signature: function wantsNotice(s: UserSettings, kind: string): boolean

nodes.name: user-stats.ts
nodes.body_text: import type { Variant } from './types'; import { RARITIES } from './rarity'; import { serialMultiplier } from './scoring-core'; import { VARIANTS, VARIANT_LABELS, countVariants, emptyCounts, encodeEntry, upgradeStep, type VariantCounts } from './variants'; import type { SeasonCard, SeasonOverview } from './site-data'; import { projectUpgradeGain, collectionBonuses, copyPoints } from './leaderboard'; /** Everything the My Stats page shows, derived from the season overview and the viewer's entries. */ export { VARIANT_LABELS };

nodes.name: UpgradeOption
nodes.body_text: interface UpgradeOption { card: SeasonCard; from: Variant; to: Variant; have: number; cost: number; /** Projected change to the viewer's score if they did this upgrade now (the serial bonuses it spends count, so it can be negative). */ gain: number; }

nodes.name: UserStats
nodes.body_text: interface UserStats { rank: number | null; players: number; /** Total: card points + the two collection bonuses. */ score: number; /** Points of every copy, serial bonuses included. */ cardPoints: number; /** The part of `cardPoints` earned by low serial numbers. */ serialPoints: number; completionBonus: number; setBonus: number; complete: boolean; /** What the bonuses are worth at 100% / when complete, right now (to show what's still on offer). */ maxCompletionBonus: number; completeSetBonusValue: number; uniqueCards: number; totalCards: number; completionPct: number; copies: number; variants: VariantCounts; rarity: { stars: number; label: string; hex: string; owned: number; total: number }[]; /** The viewer's most valuable single copies. */ topCopies: { card: SeasonCard; variant: Variant; value: number; count: number; /** Set when this is one numbered copy that earns a serial bonus. */ serial?: number; mult?: number }[]; /** Upgrades they can afford right now, biggest gain first. */ upgradable: UpgradeOption[]; /** Cards they don't own a single copy of yet (names withheld: only a count). */ missing: number; }

nodes.name: computeUserStats
nodes.signature: function computeUserStats( o: SeasonOverview, username: string, owned: number[], /** Everyone's entries for the season; needed to project upgrade gains. */ collection: Record<string, number[]>, /** `upgrades: false` skips working out what they could upgrade (the costly part), for public views that never show it. */ opts: { upgrades?: boolean } = {}, ): UserStats
nodes.body_text: function computeUserStats( o: SeasonOverview, username: string, owned: number[], /** Everyone's entries for the season; needed to project upgrade gains. */ collection: Record<string, number[]>, /** `upgrades: false` skips working out what they could upgrade (the costly part), for public views that never show it. */ opts: { upgrades?: boolean } = {}, ): UserStats { const byCard = countVariants(owned); const idx = o.rows.findIndex(r => r.username === username); const row = idx >= 0 ? o.rows[idx] : null; const variants = emptyCounts(); for (const counts of byCard.values()) for (const v of VARIANTS) variants[v] += counts[v]; const held = o.values.serials?.held.get(username); const valueOf = (c: SeasonCard, v: Variant) => o.values.cards.get(c.number)?.values[v] ?? 0; // Cards grouped back into their packs, for re-running the value maths on a hypothetical collection. const packs = [...new Map(o.cards.map(c => [c.pack.id, c.pack])).values()] .map(pack => ({ pack, cards: o.cards.filter(c => c.pack.id === pack.id) })); const topCopies: UserStats['topCopies'] = []; const upgradable: UpgradeOption[] = []; for (const card of o.cards) { const counts = byCard.get(card.number); if (!counts) continue; for (const v of VARIANTS) { if (counts[v] > 0) { // Copies with a bonus-earning serial are listed one by one (they are worth different amounts); the rest are grouped. const cv = o.values.cards.get(card.number); const serials = (held?.get(encodeEntry(card.number, v)) ?? []).slice(0, counts[v]); let plain = counts[v]; for (const n of serials) { const mult = serialMultiplier(n, o.values.settings); if (!cv || mult === 1) continue; topCopies.push({ card, variant: v, value: copyPoints(cv, v, n, o.values.settings), count: 1, serial: n, mult }); plain--; } if (plain > 0) topCopies.push({ card, variant: v, value: valueOf(card, v), count: plain }); } if (opts.upgrades === false || !card.pack.upgradesEnabled || card.upgradesEnabled === false) continue; const step = upgradeStep(card.pack, card, v); if (!step) continue; const { to, cost } = step; if (counts[v] >= cost) { upgradable.push({ card, from: v, to, have: counts[v], cost, gain: projectUpgradeGain(o.values, owned, username, card.number, v, to, cost) ?? valueOf(card, to) - cost * valueOf(card, v), }); } } } topCopies.sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value); upgradable.sort((a, b) => b.gain - a.gain); const total = o.cards.length; const unique = byCard.size; return { rank: idx >= 0 ? idx + 1 : null, players: o.rows.length, score: row?.score ?? 0, cardPoints: row?.cardPoints ?? 0, serialPoints: row?.serialPoints ?? 0, completionBonus: row?.completionBonus ?? 0, setBonus: row?.setBonus ?? 0, complete: row?.complete ?? false, maxCompletionBonus: collectionBonuses(o.values, o.values.totalCards).completion, completeSetBonusValue: collectionBonuses(o.values, o.values.totalCards).set, uniqueCards: unique, totalCards: total, completionPct: total > 0 ? Math.round((unique / total) * 100) : 0, copies: owned.length, variants, rarity: RARITIES.map(r => { const tier = o.cards.filter(c => c.stars === r.stars); return { stars: r.stars, label: r.label, hex: r.hex, total: tier.length, owned: tier.filter(c => byCard.has(c.number)).length }; }).filter(r => r.total > 0), topCopies: topCopies.slice(0, 5), upgradable, missing: total - unique, }; }

nodes.name: variants.ts
nodes.body_text: import type { Card, OptionalVariant, Pack, UpgradeCosts, Variant, VariantWeights } from './types'; export const VARIANTS: readonly Variant[] = ['regular', 'reverse', 'full', 'shiny']; export const VARIANT_LABELS: Record<Variant, string> = { regular: 'Regular', reverse: 'Reverse Holo', full: 'Full Art', shiny: 'Shiny Full Art', }; export const DEFAULT_VARIANT_WEIGHTS: VariantWeights = { regular: 100, reverse: 25, full: 5, shiny: 1 }; export const DEFAULT_UPGRADE_COSTS: UpgradeCosts = { reverse: 5, full: 3, shiny: 3 }; /** * A collection entry is a plain number: `cardNumber + VARIANT_OFFSET * variantIndex`. * Regular entries are just the card number, so every pre-upgrade collection is already valid. * Mirrored in public/widget.js and public/twitch-panel/panel.js (no build step there), keep in sync. * Card numbers must stay below VARIANT_OFFSET. */ export const VARIANT_OFFSET = 1_000_000; /** Per-card copy counts split by variant. */ /** Whether pulls roll variants and the card can be upgraded. */ /** Keeps only real, switch-off-able variant ids (unknown values and "regular" are dropped), in ladder order, no repeats. */ /** The variants this card can be pulled as / upgraded to in this pack: Regular plus whatever neither the pack nor the card switched off. */ /** The pack's roll weights with the variants that are off for this pack / card zeroed. */ /** * Where an upgrade from `from` goes: the next variant up that is switched on. Skipping a switched-off variant does not * make it cheaper: the cost is the product of every step crossed (regular → full with Reverse off costs reverse × full * regular copies, exactly what crafting through it would take). Null when there is nothing above to upgrade to. */ /** Weighted variant roll. Weights are relative, so 100/25/5/1 means ~76.6% regular. */ /** Removes `n` copies of one entry (first occurrences). Returns null if fewer than `n` exist. */

nodes.name: encodeEntry
nodes.signature: function encodeEntry(cardNumber: number, variant: Variant = 'regular'): number
nodes.body_text: function encodeEntry(cardNumber: number, variant: Variant = 'regular'): number { return cardNumber + VARIANT_OFFSET * VARIANTS.indexOf(variant); }

nodes.name: decodeEntry
nodes.signature: function decodeEntry(entry: number): { cardNumber: number; variant: Variant }
nodes.body_text: function decodeEntry(entry: number): { cardNumber: number; variant: Variant } { const idx = Math.min(Math.floor(entry / VARIANT_OFFSET), VARIANTS.length - 1); return { cardNumber: entry - idx * VARIANT_OFFSET, variant: VARIANTS[idx] }; }

nodes.name: VariantCounts
nodes.body_text: type VariantCounts = Record<Variant, number>;

nodes.name: emptyCounts
nodes.body_text: function emptyCounts(): VariantCounts { return { regular: 0, reverse: 0, full: 0, shiny: 0 }; }

nodes.name: countVariants
nodes.body_text: function countVariants(owned: number[]): Map<number, VariantCounts> { const map = new Map<number, VariantCounts>(); for (const entry of owned) { const { cardNumber, variant } = decodeEntry(entry); const counts = map.get(cardNumber) ?? emptyCounts(); counts[variant]++; map.set(cardNumber, counts); } return map; }

nodes.name: nextVariant
nodes.body_text: function nextVariant(variant: Variant): Variant | null { return VARIANTS[VARIANTS.indexOf(variant) + 1] ?? null; }

nodes.name: upgradesAllowed
nodes.signature: function upgradesAllowed(pack: Pick<Pack, 'upgradesEnabled'>, card: Pick<Card, 'upgradesEnabled'>): boolean
nodes.body_text: function upgradesAllowed(pack: Pick<Pack, 'upgradesEnabled'>, card: Pick<Card, 'upgradesEnabled'>): boolean { return pack.upgradesEnabled && card.upgradesEnabled !== false; }

nodes.name: cleanDisabled
nodes.body_text: function cleanDisabled(input: unknown): OptionalVariant[] { const list = Array.isArray(input) ? input : []; return VARIANTS.filter((v): v is OptionalVariant => v !== 'regular' && list.includes(v)); }

nodes.name: allowedVariants
nodes.signature: function allowedVariants(pack: Pick<Pack, 'disabledVariants'>, card?: Pick<Card, 'disabledVariants'>): Variant[]
nodes.body_text: function allowedVariants(pack: Pick<Pack, 'disabledVariants'>, card?: Pick<Card, 'disabledVariants'>): Variant[] { const off = new Set<string>([...(pack.disabledVariants ?? []), ...(card?.disabledVariants ?? [])]); return VARIANTS.filter(v => v === 'regular' || !off.has(v)); }

nodes.name: effectiveWeights
nodes.signature: function effectiveWeights(pack: Pick<Pack, 'variantWeights' | 'disabledVariants'>, card?: Pick<Card, 'disabledVariants'>): VariantWeights
nodes.body_text: function effectiveWeights(pack: Pick<Pack, 'variantWeights' | 'disabledVariants'>, card?: Pick<Card, 'disabledVariants'>): VariantWeights { const allowed = allowedVariants(pack, card); const w = { ...pack.variantWeights }; for (const v of VARIANTS) if (!allowed.includes(v)) w[v] = 0; return w; }

nodes.name: upgradeStep
nodes.signature: function upgradeStep( pack: Pick<Pack, 'disabledVariants' | 'upgradeCosts'>, card: Pick<Card, 'disabledVariants'> | undefined, from: Variant, ): { to: Variant; cost: number } | null
nodes.body_text: function upgradeStep( pack: Pick<Pack, 'disabledVariants' | 'upgradeCosts'>, card: Pick<Card, 'disabledVariants'> | undefined, from: Variant, ): { to: Variant; cost: number } | null { const allowed = allowedVariants(pack, card); let cost = 1; for (let i = VARIANTS.indexOf(from) + 1; i < VARIANTS.length; i++) { const v = VARIANTS[i]; cost *= Math.max(1, pack.upgradeCosts[v as OptionalVariant] ?? 1); if (allowed.includes(v)) return { to: v, cost }; } return null; }

nodes.name: rollVariant
nodes.signature: function rollVariant(weights: VariantWeights, rand: () => number = Math.random): Variant
nodes.body_text: function rollVariant(weights: VariantWeights, rand: () => number = Math.random): Variant { const total = VARIANTS.reduce((sum, v) => sum + Math.max(0, weights[v]), 0); if (total <= 0) return 'regular'; let r = rand() * total; for (const v of VARIANTS) { r -= Math.max(0, weights[v]); if (r < 0) return v; } return 'regular'; }

nodes.name: removeEntries
nodes.signature: function removeEntries(owned: number[], entry: number, n: number): number[] | null
nodes.body_text: function removeEntries(owned: number[], entry: number, n: number): number[] | null { if (owned.filter(e => e === entry).length < n) return null; const result: number[] = []; let left = n; for (const e of owned) { if (e === entry && left > 0) left--; else result.push(e); } return result; }

nodes.name: watch-core.ts
nodes.body_text: import type { Variant } from './types'; import { VARIANT_LABELS } from './variants'; import type { UserSettings, Watch } from './user-settings'; // Listing alerts (pure, client-safe): which of a viewer's alerts a set of offered cards matches. A card on the Looking for list alerts // in every version; a saved watch can name one version ("tell me when someone lists a Shiny Gouda"). /** The offered stacks this viewer has asked to hear about. */ /** Every card number a viewer wants to hear about (the index key set). */ /** "Shiny Full Art Gouda" / "Gouda (any version)". */ /** * How many viewers want each card a listing gives: the people on that card's watch list, minus the `exclude` logins (the lister, and the * trade's own recipient if it has one). Only cards with at least one are returned. Counts only, never names. */

nodes.name: OfferedCard
nodes.body_text: interface OfferedCard { cardNumber: number; variant: Variant }

nodes.name: matchingAlerts
nodes.signature: function matchingAlerts(s: Pick<UserSettings, 'wanted' | 'watches'>, items: OfferedCard[]): OfferedCard[]
nodes.body_text: function matchingAlerts(s: Pick<UserSettings, 'wanted' | 'watches'>, items: OfferedCard[]): OfferedCard[] { return items.filter(i => s.wanted.includes(i.cardNumber) || s.watches.some(w => w.card === i.cardNumber && (w.variant === null || w.variant === i.variant))); }

nodes.name: alertCards
nodes.body_text: function alertCards(s: Pick<UserSettings, 'wanted' | 'watches'>): number[] { return [...new Set([...s.wanted, ...s.watches.map(w => w.card)])]; }

nodes.name: watchLabel
nodes.signature: function watchLabel(w: Watch, nameOf: (n: number) => string | undefined): string
nodes.body_text: function watchLabel(w: Watch, nameOf: (n: number) => string | undefined): string { const name = nameOf(w.card) ?? `#${w.card}`; return w.variant ? `${VARIANT_LABELS[w.variant]} ${name}` : `${name} (any version)`; }

nodes.name: wantedCounts
nodes.signature: function wantedCounts(given: Pick<OfferedCard, 'cardNumber'>[], watchersByCard: Record<number, string[]>, exclude: string[] = []): Record<number, number>
nodes.body_text: function wantedCounts(given: Pick<OfferedCard, 'cardNumber'>[], watchersByCard: Record<number, string[]>, exclude: string[] = []): Record<number, number> { const skip = new Set(exclude.map(u => u.toLowerCase())); const out: Record<number, number> = {}; for (const { cardNumber } of given) { const n = new Set((watchersByCard[cardNumber] ?? []).map(u => u.toLowerCase()).filter(u => !skip.has(u))).size; if (n > 0) out[cardNumber] = n; } return out; }

nodes.name: watch-index.ts
nodes.body_text: import { kv } from './db'; import { getAllCollectionUsers } from './kv'; import { getUserSettings } from './user-settings-store'; import { alertCards, wantedCounts } from './watch-core'; import type { Trade } from './trade-core'; import type { UserSettings } from './user-settings'; // Who wants to hear about which card: a KV set per card number (`watch:idx:<card>`) of the viewers whose Looking for list or saved // alerts include it, kept up to date whenever settings are saved (lib/user-settings-store.ts). Without it a new listing would have to // read every viewer's settings. The first lookup builds the index from the viewers who have played (no key scan: sandboxes can't). const READY = 'watch:idx:ready'; /** Brings the index in line with a viewer's settings after a save. `prev` null = nothing was stored before. Never throws. */ /** The viewers who asked to hear about any of these cards (a viewer appears once). Empty on any failure. */ /** How many viewers want each of these cards (set sizes only, names are not read). Cards nobody wants are left out. Empty on any failure. */ /** Who wants each of these cards, one read per distinct card. Empty on any failure. */ /** Wanted counts for open board listings, keyed by trade id; one batch of reads for all of them (not per viewer, not per listing). */

nodes.name: setKey
nodes.body_text: setKey = (card: number) => `watch:idx:${card}`

nodes.name: syncWatchIndex
nodes.signature: async function syncWatchIndex(username: string, prev: Pick<UserSettings, 'wanted' | 'watches'> | null, next: Pick<UserSettings, 'wanted' | 'watches'>): Promise<void>
nodes.body_text: async function syncWatchIndex(username: string, prev: Pick<UserSettings, 'wanted' | 'watches'> | null, next: Pick<UserSettings, 'wanted' | 'watches'>): Promise<void> { try { const u = username.toLowerCase(); const before = new Set(prev ? alertCards(prev) : []); const after = new Set(alertCards(next)); for (const c of after) if (!before.has(c)) await kv.sadd(setKey(c), u); for (const c of before) if (!after.has(c)) await kv.srem(setKey(c), u); } catch { /* the index is rebuilt from settings on demand */ } }

nodes.name: ensureIndex
nodes.body_text: async function ensureIndex(): Promise<void> { if (await kv.get(READY).catch(() => null)) return; const users = await getAllCollectionUsers().catch(() => []); for (const { username } of users) await syncWatchIndex(username, null, await getUserSettings(username)); await kv.set(READY, Date.now()); }

nodes.name: watchersOf
nodes.body_text: async function watchersOf(cards: number[]): Promise<string[]> { try { await ensureIndex(); const found = new Set<string>(); for (const c of new Set(cards)) for (const u of ((await kv.smembers(setKey(c))) as string[]) ?? []) found.add(u); return [...found]; } catch { return []; } }

nodes.name: watcherCounts
nodes.signature: async function watcherCounts(cards: number[]): Promise<Record<number, number>>
nodes.body_text: async function watcherCounts(cards: number[]): Promise<Record<number, number>> { const out: Record<number, number> = {}; try { await ensureIndex(); for (const c of new Set(cards)) { const n = Number(await kv.scard(setKey(c))) || 0; if (n > 0) out[c] = n; } } catch { /* none */ } return out; }

nodes.name: watchersByCard
nodes.signature: async function watchersByCard(cards: number[]): Promise<Record<number, string[]>>
nodes.body_text: async function watchersByCard(cards: number[]): Promise<Record<number, string[]>> { const out: Record<number, string[]> = {}; try { await ensureIndex(); for (const c of new Set(cards)) out[c] = ((await kv.smembers(setKey(c))) as string[]) ?? []; } catch { /* none */ } return out; }

nodes.name: wantedForTrades
nodes.signature: async function wantedForTrades(trades: Trade[]): Promise<Record<string, Record<number, number>>>
nodes.body_text: async function wantedForTrades(trades: Trade[]): Promise<Record<string, Record<number, number>>> { const listings = trades.filter(t => t.kind === 'listing' && t.status === 'open'); if (listings.length === 0) return {}; const by = await watchersByCard(listings.flatMap(t => t.give.map(i => i.cardNumber))); const out: Record<string, Record<number, number>> = {}; for (const t of listings) { const counts = wantedCounts(t.give, by, [t.from, ...(t.to ? [t.to] : [])]); if (Object.keys(counts).length > 0) out[t.id] = counts; } return out; }

nodes.name: webhook-clean.ts
nodes.body_text: // Cleaning what the admin types for an outgoing webhook. The server POSTs to this address whenever a card is pulled, so it must be a // plain public http(s) address (not this machine, not a private network), and the fields it sends must be well-formed. Pure (no // database), so the settings form and the sender share it and a script can test it. import type { WebhookField } from './webhooks'; const PRIVATE_V4 = [/^10\./, /^127\./, /^0\./, /^169\.254\./, /^192\.168\./, /^172\.(1[6-9]|2\d|3[01])\./, /^100\.(6[4-9]|[7-9]\d|1[01]\d|12[0-7])\./]; /** True for an address that points back at this machine or into a private network (by its literal text; DNS names are not resolved). */ /** An http(s) URL on a public host, or an error in plain words. An empty string is allowed (the webhook is simply not set up). */ /** The field list, kept only if it is well-formed: up to 20 rows of a non-empty key and a value. Anything else is dropped. */

nodes.name: isPrivateHost
nodes.body_text: function isPrivateHost(hostname: string): boolean { const h = hostname.toLowerCase().replace(/^\[|\]$/g, ''); if (!h) return true; if (h === 'localhost' || h.endsWith('.localhost') || h.endsWith('.local') || h.endsWith('.internal') || h.endsWith('.lan')) return true; if (/^\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+$/.test(h)) return PRIVATE_V4.some(r => r.test(h)); if (h.includes(':')) return h === '::1' || h === '::' || /^f[cd]/.test(h) || /^fe[89ab]/.test(h) || h.startsWith('::ffff:'); return !h.includes('.'); // a bare name like "intranet" }

nodes.name: checkWebhookUrl
nodes.signature: function checkWebhookUrl(raw: string): { ok: true; url: string } | { ok: false; error: string }
nodes.body_text: function checkWebhookUrl(raw: string): { ok: true; url: string } | { ok: false; error: string } { const text = raw.trim(); if (!text) return { ok: true, url: '' }; if (text.length > 500) return { ok: false, error: 'The address is too long.' }; let u: URL; try { u = new URL(text); } catch { return { ok: false, error: 'That is not a valid web address (it should start with https://).' }; } if (u.protocol !== 'https:' && u.protocol !== 'http:') return { ok: false, error: 'The address must start with https:// (or http://).' }; if (u.username || u.password) return { ok: false, error: 'Put the key in the address path or the fields, not as a user name and password.' }; if (isPrivateHost(u.hostname)) return { ok: false, error: 'That address points at this machine or a private network, which the server cannot reach. Use a public address.' }; return { ok: true, url: u.toString() }; }

nodes.name: cleanWebhookFields
nodes.body_text: function cleanWebhookFields(raw: unknown): WebhookField[] { if (!Array.isArray(raw)) return []; const out: WebhookField[] = []; for (const f of raw) { if (!f || typeof f !== 'object') continue; const key = typeof (f as WebhookField).key === 'string' ? (f as WebhookField).key.trim().slice(0, 60) : ''; const value = typeof (f as WebhookField).value === 'string' ? (f as WebhookField).value.slice(0, 500) : ''; if (key) out.push({ key, value }); if (out.length >= 20) break; } return out; }

The overlay plays exactly this and saves it with `id` as the ticket. */ draw?: { packId: string; cardNumber: number; variant: 'regular' | 'reverse' | 'full' | 'shiny' }; /** A paid pull (Mix It Up): the same id is the payment reservation, charged when the card is saved. */ paid?: boolean; /** For `card` (show a card off): which card and version, and the serial of the viewer's copy. Already checked against their collection. */ cardNumber?: number; variant?: 'regular' | 'reverse' | 'full' | 'shiny'; serial?: number; serialMult?: number; /** The print number of that copy. */ uid?: number; }

nodes.name: getWebhookSettings
nodes.body_text: async function getWebhookSettings(): Promise<WebhookSettings> { const stored = await kv.get<WebhookSettings>('webhooks:settings'); if (stored) return stored; // First access, auto-generate a secret const fresh: WebhookSettings = { incomingSecret: randomBytes(16).toString('hex'), outgoing: { cardPulled: { url: '', enabled: false, fields: [] }, collectionShown: { url: '', enabled: false, fields: [] }, }, }; await kv.set('webhooks:settings', fresh); return fresh; }

nodes.name: saveWebhookSettings

nodes.body_text: async function fireOutgoing( config: OutgoingWebhookConfig, vars: Record<string, string>, ): Promise<void> { if (!config.enabled || !config.url) return; if (await inSandbox()) return; // sandboxes never call outside services // Whatever was stored, only ever call a public http(s) address (the settings form checks this too). const target = checkWebhookUrl(config.url); if (!target.ok || !target.url) return; const payload = Object.fromEntries( cleanWebhookFields(config.fields).map(f => [f.key, interpolate(f.value, vars)]) ); fetch(target.url, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(payload), }).catch(() => {}); // fire-and-forget }

nodes.name: weekly-digest-store.ts
nodes.body_text: import { kv, inSandbox } from './db'; import { postDigest } from './discord'; import { getActiveSeasonWithPacks } from './kv'; import { getSeasonLeaderboard } from './leaderboard'; import { getPotw, loadFeatured } from './print-of-week-store'; import { isoWeekKey } from './print-of-week'; import { tradeHistory } from './trades'; import { VARIANT_LABELS } from './variants'; import { watcherCounts } from './watch-index'; import { buildWeeklyDigest, digestWorthPosting, snapshotRanks, type DigestPrint, type RankSnapshot, type WeeklyDigest } from './weekly-digest'; // The weekly digest, server side. KV: `digest:latest` (the last digest that was posted, for the dashboard widget), // `digest:ranks:<seasonId>` (rank + points per collector, saved by every run, next week's movers compare with it) and // `digest:week:<yyyy-Www>` (the once-a-week lock). Sandboxes get their own copies of these keys like everything else (lib/db.ts). export const DIGEST_KEY = 'digest:latest'; const WEEK_TTL_S = 21 * 24 * 3600; const HISTORY_CAP = 400; // what lib/trades.ts keeps in `trades:history` /** Collects everything the pure builder needs for the active season. Null when no season is active. */ /** The weekly cron's step: builds and posts the digest once per ISO week (a second call in the same week does nothing). */

nodes.name: ranksKey
nodes.body_text: ranksKey = (seasonId: string) => `digest:ranks:${seasonId}`

nodes.name: getLatestDigest
nodes.body_text: async function getLatestDigest(): Promise<WeeklyDigest | null> { try { return (await kv.get<WeeklyDigest>(DIGEST_KEY)) ?? null; } catch { return null; } }

nodes.name: build
nodes.signature: async function build(now: number): Promise<{ digest: WeeklyDigest; snapshot: RankSnapshot; seasonId: string } | null>
nodes.body_text: async function build(now: number): Promise<{ digest: WeeklyDigest; snapshot: RankSnapshot; seasonId: string } | null> { const active = await getActiveSeasonWithPacks(); if (!active) return null; const { season, packs } = active; const cardNames: Record<number, string> = {}; for (const p of packs) for (const c of p.cards) cardNames[c.number] = c.name; const [{ rows }, hours, prev, history, watchers, featured, pick] = await Promise.all([ getSeasonLeaderboard(season), kv.hgetall<Record<string, number | string>>(`stats:h:${season.collectionName}`).catch(() => null), kv.get<RankSnapshot>(ranksKey(season.id)).catch(() => null), tradeHistory().catch(() => []), watcherCounts(Object.keys(cardNames).map(Number)), loadFeatured().catch(() => null), getPotw(), ]); // The pick counts only when this run (or an admin) chose it recently, and it is still a live print of this season. let print: DigestPrint | null = null; if (featured && pick && featured.season.id === season.id && now - pick.chosenAt < 8 * 86_400_000) { const v = featured.copy.variant; print = { name: featured.card.name, label: v === 'regular' ? '' : VARIANT_LABELS[v], uid: featured.copy.uid ?? null, href: featured.copy.uid ? `/c/${featured.copy.uid}` : `/copy/${encodeURIComponent(season.id)}/${featured.copy.id}`, reason: pick.reason, }; } const board = rows.map(r => ({ username: r.username, score: r.score })); const digest = buildWeeklyDigest({ now, weekKey: isoWeekKey(now), seasonId: season.id, seasonName: season.name, hours: hours ?? {}, board, prevRanks: prev && typeof prev === 'object' ? prev : null, trades: history, historyCap: HISTORY_CAP, watchers, cardNames, print, }); return { digest, snapshot: snapshotRanks(board), seasonId: season.id }; }

nodes.name: DigestOutcome
nodes.signature: type DigestOutcome = | { status: 'posted'; week: string; channels: number; pulls: number; trades: number } | { status: 'skipped'; week: string; reason: string } | { status: 'already'; week: string } | { status: 'error'; error: string };
nodes.body_text: type DigestOutcome = | { status: 'posted'; week: string; channels: number; pulls: number; trades: number } | { status: 'skipped'; week: string; reason: string } | { status: 'already'; week: string } | { status: 'error'; error: string };

nodes.name: digestOncePerWeek
nodes.body_text: async function digestOncePerWeek(now = Date.now()): Promise<DigestOutcome> { if (await inSandbox()) return { status: 'skipped', week: isoWeekKey(now), reason: 'Never runs inside a sandbox.' }; const week = isoWeekKey(now); const lock = `digest:week:${week}`; if (!(await kv.set(lock, now, { nx: true, ex: WEEK_TTL_S }))) return { status: 'already', week }; try { const built = await build(now); if (!built) return { status: 'skipped', week, reason: 'No season is active.' }; // Every run keeps the ranks, even a quiet week, so the next digest has something to compare with. await kv.set(ranksKey(built.seasonId), built.snapshot); if (!digestWorthPosting(built.digest)) return { status: 'skipped', week, reason: 'No pulls and no trades this week.' }; await kv.set(DIGEST_KEY, built.digest); const channels = await postDigest(built.digest); return { status: 'posted', week, channels, pulls: built.digest.pulls, trades: built.digest.trades }; } catch (e) { await kv.del(lock).catch(() => {}); // let a retry later in the week try again return { status: 'error', error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Digest failed.' }; } }

nodes.name: weekly-digest.ts
nodes.body_text: // The weekly digest: a pure summary of the last seven days for the community Discord channel. Client-safe (no server imports) so the // admin dashboard widget and the Discord embed share one shape. Loading the inputs, posting and storing it is in // lib/weekly-digest-store.ts. Hidden and private collectors never reach `board` (the leaderboard already leaves them out), so they // can be neither in the top 3 nor in the movers. export const WEEK_MS = 7 * 24 * 3_600_000; /** The snapshot kept between runs: rank (1 is best) and points per collector. */ /** UTC hour key "yyyymmddhh" to ms. */ /** A week with no pulls and no trades (the off-season) gets no digest. */ /** The snapshot to keep for next week's movers. */ /** Made-up numbers for the Discord channel card's test button. */

nodes.name: DigestBoardRow
nodes.body_text: interface DigestBoardRow { username: string; score: number }

nodes.name: RankSnapshot
nodes.body_text: type RankSnapshot = Record<string, [number, number]>;

nodes.name: DigestTrade
nodes.body_text: interface DigestTrade { status: string; createdAt: number; resolvedAt?: number; give: { cardNumber: number; count: number }[]; get: { cardNumber: number; count: number }[] }

nodes.name: DigestPrint
nodes.body_text: interface DigestPrint { name: string; label: string; uid: number | null; href: string; reason: string }

nodes.name: DigestInput
nodes.body_text: interface DigestInput { now: number; weekKey: string; seasonId: string; seasonName: string; /** The season collection's `stats:h:` hash: field "<UTC yyyymmddhh>|<metric>". */ hours: Record<string, number | string>; /** Ranked best first, hidden and private collectors already removed. */ board: DigestBoardRow[]; prevRanks: RankSnapshot | null; /** Resolved trades, newest first, as `trades:history` keeps them (capped at `historyCap`). */ trades: DigestTrade[]; historyCap: number; /** Watcher count per card number (only cards with at least one). */ watchers: Record<number, number>; cardNames: Record<number, string>; print: DigestPrint | null; }

nodes.name: DigestMover
nodes.body_text: interface DigestMover { username: string; rank: number; climbed: number; gained: number }

nodes.name: WeeklyDigest
nodes.body_text: interface WeeklyDigest { weekKey: string; from: number; to: number; seasonId: string; seasonName: string; pulls: number; newCollectors: number; upgrades: number; trades: number; top: { username: string; rank: number; points: number }[]; /** Null on the first run (no snapshot to compare with). */ movers: DigestMover[] | null; mostTraded: { cardNumber: number; name: string; count: number }[]; /** The trade history no longer reaches back a whole week, so the counts are a floor. */ tradedAtLeast: boolean; mostWanted: { cardNumber: number; name: string; watchers: number } | null; print: DigestPrint | null; }

nodes.name: hourMs
nodes.body_text: function hourMs(h: string): number { return Date.UTC(+h.slice(0, 4), +h.slice(4, 6) - 1, +h.slice(6, 8), +h.slice(8, 10)); }

nodes.name: buildWeeklyDigest
nodes.body_text: function buildWeeklyDigest(i: DigestInput): WeeklyDigest { const from = i.now - WEEK_MS; const sums: Record<string, number> = {}; for (const [field, value] of Object.entries(i.hours)) { const bar = field.indexOf('|'); if (bar !== 10) continue; const t = hourMs(field.slice(0, bar)); if (!(t >= from && t <= i.now)) continue; const metric = field.slice(bar + 1); sums[metric] = (sums[metric] ?? 0) + (Number(value) || 0); } const top = i.board.slice(0, 3).map((r, n) => ({ username: r.username, rank: n + 1, points: r.score })); let movers: DigestMover[] | null = null; if (i.prevRanks) { const prev = i.prevRanks; movers = i.board .map((r, n) => { const was = prev[r.username]; return was ? { username: r.username, rank: n + 1, climbed: was[0] - (n + 1), gained: r.score - was[1] } : null; }) .filter((m): m is DigestMover => !!m && (m.climbed > 0 || m.gained > 0)) .sort((a, b) => b.climbed - a.climbed || b.gained - a.gained || a.username.localeCompare(b.username)) .slice(0, 3); } const counts = new Map<number, number>(); for (const t of i.trades) { if (t.status !== 'accepted' || (t.resolvedAt ?? 0) < from) continue; for (const it of [...t.give, ...t.get]) counts.set(it.cardNumber, (counts.get(it.cardNumber) ?? 0) + (it.count || 1)); } const mostTraded = [...counts].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1] || a[0] - b[0]).slice(0, 3) .map(([cardNumber, count]) => ({ cardNumber, name: i.cardNames[cardNumber] ?? `Card #${cardNumber}`, count })); const oldest = i.trades.reduce((m, t) => Math.min(m, t.resolvedAt ?? t.createdAt), Infinity); const tradedAtLeast = i.trades.length >= i.historyCap && oldest > from; let mostWanted: WeeklyDigest['mostWanted'] = null; for (const [k, n] of Object.entries(i.watchers)) { const cardNumber = Number(k); if (n > 0 && (!mostWanted || n > mostWanted.watchers || (n === mostWanted.watchers && cardNumber < mostWanted.cardNumber))) { mostWanted = { cardNumber, name: i.cardNames[cardNumber] ?? `Card #${cardNumber}`, watchers: n }; } } return { weekKey: i.weekKey, from, to: i.now, seasonId: i.seasonId, seasonName: i.seasonName, pulls: sums.pull ?? 0, newCollectors: sums.newViewer ?? 0, upgrades: sums.upgrade ?? 0, trades: sums.trade ?? 0, top, movers, mostTraded, tradedAtLeast, mostWanted, print: i.print, }; }

nodes.name: digestWorthPosting
nodes.body_text: digestWorthPosting = (d: WeeklyDigest) => d.pulls > 0 || d.trades > 0

nodes.name: snapshotRanks
nodes.body_text: function snapshotRanks(board: DigestBoardRow[], cap = 1000): RankSnapshot { const out: RankSnapshot = {}; board.slice(0, cap).forEach((r, n) => { out[r.username] = [n + 1, r.score]; }); return out; }

nodes.name: sampleDigest
nodes.body_text: function sampleDigest(now = Date.now()): WeeklyDigest { return { weekKey: 'sample', from: now - WEEK_MS, to: now, seasonId: 'sample', seasonName: 'Season 1', pulls: 312, newCollectors: 6, upgrades: 9, trades: 14, top: [{ username: 'sample_one', rank: 1, points: 4210 }, { username: 'sample_two', rank: 2, points: 3980 }, { username: 'sample_three', rank: 3, points: 3500 }], movers: [{ username: 'sample_four', rank: 5, climbed: 4, gained: 620 }, { username: 'sample_two', rank: 2, climbed: 1, gained: 410 }], mostTraded: [{ cardNumber: 1, name: 'Sample Card', count: 5 }, { cardNumber: 2, name: 'Other Sample', count: 3 }], tradedAtLeast: false, mostWanted: { cardNumber: 3, name: 'Wanted Sample', watchers: 7 }, print: { name: 'Sample Card', label: 'Shiny', uid: 1023381, href: '/c/1023381', reason: 'Held by 5 collectors, traded 4 times' }, }; }

nodes.name: middleware.ts
nodes.body_text: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server'; import { AUTH_COOKIE, isPasswordLoginEnabled, isValidAdminToken } from '@/lib/admin-token'; import { homePath, roleCan, type StaffRole } from '@/lib/staff-core'; import { STAFF_COOKIE, verifyStaffToken } from '@/lib/staff-token'; import { ACCESS_COOKIE, verifyAccessToken } from '@/lib/access-token'; import { gateDecision } from '@/lib/access-gate'; import { readAccessSettings } from '@/lib/access-edge'; import { isExemptPath } from '@/lib/access-core'; // The first gate for the admin (/admin) and mod (/mod) panels (and, for the extension's endpoints, the CORS answers below). It reads only the signed cookies (no database), so it can send // the wrong person away early and keep the panels out of reach of anyone signed out. The real check is done again, against the // live staff list, by the panel layouts, every server action and every API route (lib/staff-guard.ts). // // staff cookie valid (or the emergency admin password cookie) -> pick the panel by role: admins and the super admin may open // both, mods only /mod (an admin URL sends them to /mod) // no valid staff cookie but a viewer session exists -> /auth/staff, which checks the staff list and issues the // cookie (this is also how the hourly cookie is refreshed) // neither -> /login // The hosted Twitch extension is served from Twitch's own domain (https://<client id>.ext-twitch.tv, or the developer rig), so its // calls to our API are cross-origin. Only the extension's own endpoints answer them, and only for those origins. const EXTENSION_ORIGIN = /^https:\/\/([a-z0-9]+\.ext-twitch\.tv|localhost\.rig\.twitch\.tv(:\d+)?)$/; const DEV_ORIGIN = /^http:\/\/localhost:\d+$/; // The closed alpha / beta gate for the public site (ROADMAP Track 16). Coarse and database-free apart from one cached read of the mode: // a signed `tcg_access` cookie says the visitor is a tester or staff. /auth/access issues it; the layouts and signed-in APIs re-check the // live lists (lib/access.ts). Mode Open passes everything, and so does a failed read of the mode. The extension's API never meets it. // The staff panels, the extension's endpoints and now the whole public site. Static files (anything with a dot, so also the overlay, // the service worker and robots.txt) and the build output never reach the middleware. isExemptPath is the explicit allow list. export const config = { matcher: ['/((?!_next/|assets/|brand/|icons/|twitch-panel/|.*\\..*).*)'] };

nodes.name: extensionCors
nodes.body_text: function extensionCors(req: NextRequest): NextResponse { const origin = req.headers.get('origin') ?? ''; const allowed = EXTENSION_ORIGIN.test(origin) || (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production' && DEV_ORIGIN.test(origin)); const headers: Record<string, string> = allowed ? { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': origin, 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'GET, POST, OPTIONS', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Authorization, Content-Type', 'Access-Control-Max-Age': '86400', Vary: 'Origin' } : { Vary: 'Origin' }; if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new NextResponse(null, { status: 204, headers }); const res = NextResponse.next(); for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(headers)) res.headers.set(k, v); return res; }

nodes.name: publicGate
nodes.body_text: async function publicGate(req: NextRequest): Promise<NextResponse> { const { pathname, search } = req.nextUrl; // The layouts read this to skip their own check on the pages that stay open (FAQ, privacy, terms). const headers = new Headers(req.headers); headers.set('x-tcg-path', pathname); const pass = () => NextResponse.next({ request: { headers } }); if (isExemptPath(pathname)) return pass(); let settings = await readAccessSettings(); if (!settings || settings.mode === 'open') return pass(); const access = await verifyAccessToken(req.cookies.get(ACCESS_COOKIE)?.value); // A cookie issued after our remembered copy means the copy is out of date: look again before judging it. if (access && access.v > settings.v) settings = (await readAccessSettings(true)) ?? settings; const staffCookie = !!(await verifyStaffToken(req.cookies.get(STAFF_COOKIE)?.value)) || (isPasswordLoginEnabled() && isValidAdminToken(req.cookies.get(AUTH_COOKIE)?.value)); const outcome = gateDecision({ pathname, settings, access, staffCookie, hasSession: !!req.cookies.get('tcg_session')?.value }); if (outcome === 'pass') return pass(); if (outcome === 'forbidden') return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: 'closed' }, { status: 403, headers: { 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' } }); const here = pathname + search; const dest = outcome === 'refresh' ? `/auth/access?returnTo=${encodeURIComponent(here)}` : '/closed'; return NextResponse.redirect(new URL(dest, req.url)); }

nodes.name: pass
nodes.body_text: pass = () => NextResponse.next({ request: { headers } })

nodes.name: middleware
nodes.body_text: async function middleware(req: NextRequest) { const { pathname, search } = req.nextUrl; // The extension's endpoints keep exactly their CORS answers (Twitch panel freeze); the public gate never touches them. if (pathname === '/api/version' || pathname.startsWith('/api/twitch/')) return extensionCors(req); if (!pathname.startsWith('/admin') && !pathname.startsWith('/mod')) return publicGate(req); let role: StaffRole | null = null; const staff = await verifyStaffToken(req.cookies.get(STAFF_COOKIE)?.value); if (staff) role = staff.role; else if (isPasswordLoginEnabled() && isValidAdminToken(req.cookies.get(AUTH_COOKIE)?.value)) role = 'super'; if (!role) { const here = pathname + search; const dest = req.cookies.get('tcg_session')?.value ? new URL(`/auth/staff?returnTo=${encodeURIComponent(here)}`, req.url) : new URL(`/login?returnTo=${encodeURIComponent(here)}`, req.url); return NextResponse.redirect(dest); } if (pathname.startsWith('/admin') && !roleCan(role, 'admin')) return NextResponse.redirect(new URL(homePath(role), req.url)); if (pathname.startsWith('/mod') && !roleCan(role, 'mod')) return NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/login', req.url)); return NextResponse.next(); }

nodes.body_text: import type { NextConfig } from 'next'; import { execSync } from 'node:child_process'; import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'; // Build stamp, baked in at build time so every deployment is identifiable (see lib/version.ts). // On Vercel the commit comes from VERCEL_GIT_*; locally we ask git. const pkg = JSON.parse(readFileSync('./package.json', 'utf8')) as { version: string }; const nextConfig: NextConfig = { env: { BUILD_VERSION: pkg.version, BUILD_COMMIT: process.env.VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA ?? git('rev-parse HEAD') ?? '', BUILD_BRANCH: process.env.VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF ?? git('rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD') ?? '', BUILD_ENV: process.env.VERCEL_ENV ?? 'development', // production | preview | development BUILD_TIME: new Date().toISOString(), BUILD_REPO: process.env.VERCEL_GIT_REPO_OWNER && process.env.VERCEL_GIT_REPO_SLUG ? `${process.env.VERCEL_GIT_REPO_OWNER}/${process.env.VERCEL_GIT_REPO_SLUG}` : '', }, // Card art is big and the overlay re-requests it on every OBS refresh. Files are replaced under the // same name only rarely, so a day of caching (and a week of serve-stale-while-revalidating) is safe. }; export default nextConfig;

nodes.name: sw.js
nodes.body_text: // Tiny service worker for "Add to home screen". It caches nothing but a friendly offline page: pages and data always come from the // network, so nobody ever sees stale cards or scores. If a page can't be reached, the offline page is shown instead of a browser error. const CACHE = 'tcg-offline-v2'; const OFFLINE_URL = '/offline'; self.addEventListener('install', event => { event.waitUntil(caches.open(CACHE).then(c => c.addAll([OFFLINE_URL, '/icons/icon-192.png'])).then(() => self.skipWaiting())); }); self.addEventListener('activate', event => { event.waitUntil( caches.keys().then(keys => Promise.all(keys.filter(k => k !== CACHE).map(k => caches.delete(k)))).then(() => self.clients.claim()), ); }); self.addEventListener('fetch', event => { const req = event.request; if (req.method !== 'GET' || req.mode !== 'navigate') return; const url = new URL(req.url); if (url.origin !== self.location.origin || /^\/(admin|api|auth)(\/|$)/.test(url.pathname)) return; event.respondWith(fetch(req).catch(() => caches.match(OFFLINE_URL).then(r => r || Response.error()))); }); // Push alerts (Settings, Notifications). The payload is { title, body, url, tag }; a tag makes a newer alert for the same trade replace the older one. self.addEventListener('push', event => { let d = {}; try { d = event.data ? event.data.json() : {}; } catch (e) { d = { body: event.data ? event.data.text() : '' }; } const title = d.title || 'The Cheesy TCG'; event.waitUntil(Promise.all([ self.registration.showNotification(title, { body: d.body || '', tag: d.tag || undefined, renotify: !!d.tag, icon: '/icons/icon-192.png', badge: '/icons/icon-192.png', data: { url: d.url || '/' }, }), self.navigator && self.navigator.setAppBadge ? self.navigator.setAppBadge().catch(() => {}) : Promise.resolve(), ])); }); self.addEventListener('notificationclick', event => { event.notification.close(); const raw = (event.notification.data && event.notification.data.url) || '/'; const target = new URL(raw, self.location.origin); if (target.origin !== self.location.origin) return; event.waitUntil(self.clients.matchAll({ type: 'window', includeUncontrolled: true }).then(list => { for (const c of list) { if (new URL(c.url).origin === self.location.origin && 'focus' in c) { return c.focus().then(f => ('navigate' in f ? f.navigate(target.href) : undefined)).catch(() => self.clients.openWindow(target.href)); } } return self.clients.openWindow(target.href); })); });

nodes.body_text: // Where the site's API and card art live. An empty string means "the same origin as this page", which is right whenever the site itself // serves the panel (local testing, or Twitch's Testing Base URI pointing at the site). The hosted package built by // scripts/build-twitch-package.mjs replaces this file with the site's address, because Twitch serves hosted files from its own domain. window.TCG_SITE = '';

nodes.name: mock-twitch-ext.js
nodes.body_text: // A pretend Twitch Extension helper for the fake Twitch page (Admin -> Sandbox -> Fake Twitch). It only does anything when the // page is opened with ?mock=1 (the fake page does that); in the real extension this file is a harmless no-op. // It replaces window.Twitch.ext with just enough of the real helper for panel.js: onAuthorized, onError and // actions.requestIdShare (which shows a stand-in for Twitch's "share your identity" prompt). Tokens come from // POST /api/admin/sandbox/ext-token, so the panel's own API calls are verified exactly like real ones, but only inside the sandbox. (function () { var q = new URLSearchParams(location.search); if (!q.has('mock')) return; var state = { as: q.get('as') || '', share: q.get('share') === '1', role: q.get('role') || 'viewer' }; var authorized = []; var errored = []; var auth = null; // Stand-in for Twitch's "share your identity" prompt. var ext = { version: 'mock', environment: 'local', onAuthorized: function (cb) { authorized.push(cb); if (auth) cb(auth); }, onError: function (cb) { errored.push(cb); }, onContext: noop, onVisibilityChanged: noop, onHighlightChanged: noop, onPositionChanged: noop, listen: noop, unlisten: noop, send: noop, rig: { log: noop }, features: {}, configuration: {}, actions: { requestIdShare: promptShare, minimize: noop, followChannel: noop, onFollow: noop }, }; try { window.Twitch = window.Twitch || {}; window.Twitch.ext = ext; } catch (e) { window.Twitch = { ext: ext }; } try { Object.defineProperty(window.Twitch, 'ext', { value: ext, configurable: true }); } catch (e) { /* assigned above */ } // Authorise as soon as the page has loaded (the real helper does the same). if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', mint); else mint(); })();

nodes.name: banner
nodes.body_text: function banner(text) { var el = document.getElementById('mock-ext-banner'); if (!el) { el = document.createElement('div'); el.id = 'mock-ext-banner'; el.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:99999;background:#7f1d1d;color:#fff;font:12px/1.4 sans-serif;padding:6px 10px;'; document.body.appendChild(el); } el.textContent = text; }

nodes.name: mint
nodes.body_text: function mint() { return fetch('/api/admin/sandbox/ext-token', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(state) }) .then(function (r) { return r.json().then(function (b) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(b.error || ('token request failed (' + r.status + ')')); return b; }); }) .then(function (b) { auth = { channelId: '1', clientId: 'mock-client', token: b.token, helixToken: 'mock', userId: b.opaqueId }; authorized.slice().forEach(function (cb) { try { cb(auth); } catch (e) { console.error(e); } }); }) .catch(function (err) { console.error('[mock twitch]', err); banner('Fake Twitch: ' + err.message); errored.forEach(function (cb) { try { cb(err); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ } }); }); }
