function promptShare() { if (!state.as) { banner('Fake Twitch: this viewer is not logged in to Twitch, so there is no identity to share.'); return; } var wrap = document.createElement('div'); wrap.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:99998;background:rgba(0,0,0,.7);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:12px;font-family:sans-serif;'; wrap.innerHTML = '
' + '
The Cheesy TCG
' + '
would like to see your Twitch identity (' + state.as.replace(/[^a-z0-9_]/g, '') + '). Fake Twitch prompt
' + '' + '
'; document.body.appendChild(wrap); wrap.querySelector('#mock-share-no').onclick = function () { wrap.remove(); }; wrap.querySelector('#mock-share-ok').onclick = function () { wrap.remove(); state.share = true; try { window.parent.postMessage({ type: 'tcg-mock-share', share: true }, location.origin); } catch (e) { /* not framed */ } // Like Twitch, the helper re-fires onAuthorized with a token that now carries the viewer's ID. mint(); }; }

nodes.name: noop
nodes.body_text: noop = function () {}

nodes.name: panel.js
nodes.body_text: 'use strict'; // ── Where the site lives ───────────────────────────────── // window.TCG_SITE (config.js) is '' when this panel is served by the site itself (local testing, or Twitch's Testing Base URI pointing at it): // the API and card art are then on the same origin. In the hosted package Twitch serves these files from its own domain, so config.js // holds the site's address and every API call and card image goes there (the site allows it with CORS, see middleware.ts). const SITE = String(window.TCG_SITE || '').replace(/\/$/, ''); /** Makes the card art URLs in an API response absolute (they come back as /assets/... paths). */ // ── Rarity colours matching the admin panel ────────────── const RARITY_COLOR = { 1: '#6b7280', 2: '#22c55e', 3: '#3b82f6', 4: '#a855f7', 5: '#f59e0b' }; // Keep in sync with lib/rarity.ts const RARITY_LABEL = { 1: 'Common', 2: 'Uncommon', 3: 'Rare', 4: 'Epic', 5: 'Legendary' }; // ── Variants ────────────────────────────────────────────── // Collection entries encode the variant: cardNumber + VARIANT_OFFSET * variantIndex (regular = plain number). // Keep in sync with lib/variants.ts. const VARIANTS = ['regular', 'reverse', 'full', 'shiny']; const VARIANT_OFFSET = 1000000; const VARIANT_LABELS = { regular: 'Regular', reverse: 'Reverse Holo', full: 'Full Art', shiny: 'Shiny Full Art' }; // Art for a variant: Full Art and Shiny use the card's full-art image when it has one. // Clips the holo sheen to the art's own shape: the static thumbnail has the same rounded transparent corners. // The holographic shimmer for a card's variant: the same settings as the OBS overlay (Overlay Editor -> Variants), sent per // card by the season API as CSS variables (see lib/holo.ts). .holo-live makes it sweep on its own; otherwise it sweeps on hover. // Reads a claim from the (unverified) Extension JWT. Only used for UX decisions. The server // verifies the signature before trusting anything. // Twitch's requestIdShare() is a documented no-op on the viewer's own channel, so broadcasters // can never be prompted. The server recognises them from the signed role claim instead. // ── Card images ─────────────────────────────────────────── // Card art is a 600px animated WebP (1–4MB, ~50 frames). Decoding and animating two dozen of // them at once makes the panel crawl, so the grid shows a tiny static thumbnail and only loads // and plays the animated version for the card under the pointer. const reducedMotion = !!window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches; // Appends the thumbnail to `container` and wires up hover-to-animate. // `dimmed` mirrors the faded look used for cards owned only in a past season. // ── State ───────────────────────────────────────────────── let auth = null; // Twitch Extension auth object let season = null; // { seasonId, seasonName, collectionName, packs } let collections = []; // [{ seasonId, seasonName, active, ownedNumbers }] let currentUsername = null; let currentPackIdx = 0; let identityRequestPending = false; // true while waiting for requestIdShare() response let me = null; // /api/twitch/me: rank, score breakdown, card values, serials, waiting offers (null until loaded) let collectionFilter = 'all'; // 'all' | 'have' | 'missing' (Collection view) let lastLoadAt = 0; // when the collection was last fetched (refreshes when the panel comes back into view) // ── Serial numbers & points ─────────────────────────────── // Every copy has a number (per card and version); the first copies ever made of a card are worth extra. Mirrors serialMultiplier() // in lib/scoring-core.ts: #1 gets bonus.max, fading in a straight line to nothing after bonus.cutoff. Values come from /api/twitch/me. // The viewer's serial numbers for one card in one version, lowest first (empty until the copies are numbered). // What the viewer's copies of a card are worth, serial bonuses included (null until /api/twitch/me has loaded). // ── DOM refs ───────────────────────────────────────────── const STATES = { loading: document.getElementById('state-loading'), noSeason: document.getElementById('state-no-season'), login: document.getElementById('state-login'), collection: document.getElementById('state-collection'), }; // ── Season header renderer (shared between states) ─────── // ── Pack tabs ───────────────────────────────────────────── // ── Card grid ───────────────────────────────────────────── // How many of `card` the viewer has: pulls in the active season, plus per-season counts for any // past seasons. The collection arrays keep duplicates (one entry per pull). // Have / Missing filter above the grid, with how many cards fall in each (for the current pack). // ── Card detail view ────────────────────────────────────── // Clicking a card opens an overlay with a large version of it and how many the viewer has. // Undiscovered cards open as a locked "???" view (same secrecy as the grid), and prev/next // browse the current pack. let detailIdx = -1; // index into the current pack's cards, or -1 when closed let detailVariant = null; // variant being previewed in the detail view (null = best owned) let upgradeMsg = ''; // result of the last upgrade attempt, shown under the variant list let detailOpener = null; // element to refocus on close // The next version up that is switched on for this card, and what the step costs; skipping a switched-off version costs the // product of every step crossed. next is null at the top of the ladder. document.getElementById('detail-close').addEventListener('click', closeDetail); document.getElementById('detail-backdrop').addEventListener('click', closeDetail); document.getElementById('detail-prev').addEventListener('click', () => stepDetail(-1)); document.getElementById('detail-next').addEventListener('click', () => stepDetail(1)); document.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (detailIdx === -1) return; if (e.key === 'Escape') closeDetail(); else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') stepDetail(-1); else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') stepDetail(1); }); // Spends duplicates of `from` for one copy of the next variant. The server decides everything (cost, // whether upgrades are on, whether the viewer has enough); this just reports the outcome. // The upgrade moment (mirrors app/components/UpgradeCeremony.tsx; styles are the .ug-* rules in panel.css): the spent copies // spiral into the middle, a flash, then the new variant is revealed with its holo / glow. Tap or Esc to continue. // ── Views: collection / stats / leaderboard ─────────────── let currentView = 'collection'; let leaderboardLoadedAt = 0; // A rank badge: coloured discs for the podium, plain #N after that. // Grey placeholder rows while something loads. // A message with a Try again button. // ── Stats view ──────────────────────────────────────────── // Rank, how the score adds up, what to do next (upgrades you can afford, who is just ahead), your best serials and waiting trade // offers. Everything comes from /api/twitch/me plus the collection already in memory. // A titled section card. // Rank, score, card values and serials from /api/twitch/me. Never blocks the collection: if it fails, those extras just stay hidden. document.querySelectorAll('#view-tabs .view-tab').forEach(b => b.addEventListener('click', () => setView(b.dataset.view))); // ── Login flow ──────────────────────────────────────────── // Returns whether it worked; on a failure the cards already on screen are kept (an empty grid would look like "you own nothing"). // ── Banner, toast and refresh ───────────────────────────── let toastTimer = null; // Copies per entry in the active season (to notice new pulls after a refresh). let skipNextToast = false; // set after a trade, whose new cards are not "pulls" // Reloads the viewer's cards, rank and values. `manual` = the refresh button (always shows the result). let refreshing = false; // Coming back to the panel (e.g. after watching for a while) refreshes it, so new pulls show up without pressing anything. document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => { if (document.visibilityState === 'visible' && currentUsername && Date.now() - lastLoadAt > 45000) refreshData(false); }); // Sends the current JWT to the server, which extracts the numeric user_id from the // JWT payload (set by Twitch after requestIdShare() grant), resolves via Helix, // saves the opaque→username mapping, creates the user profile, and returns the username. // This works even when auth.userId is still showing as a non-numeric opaque ID. // Resolves to { ok: true } on success, or { ok: false, status, message } so callers can tell // "identity not shared yet" (403, expected for first-time viewers) from real failures. // Friendly text for a failed login, for the login screen. // ── Season load ─────────────────────────────────────────── // ── Logout persistence (localStorage) ──────────────────── // Survives refresh so explicit logouts aren't overridden by silent auto-login. // ── Login screen helpers ────────────────────────────────── // ── Entry point ─────────────────────────────────────────── // ── Build version ───────────────────────────────────────── // Shows which deployment this panel is running (the page, script and API ship together on Vercel). // Purely informational. Never blocks or breaks the panel. showVersion(); // ── Event wiring ────────────────────────────────────────── document.getElementById('login-btn').addEventListener('click', async () => { const btn = document.getElementById('login-btn'); btn.disabled = true; console.log('[TCG] login-btn clicked, userId:', auth?.userId, '| broadcaster:', isBroadcaster(), '| requestIdShare:', typeof window.Twitch?.ext?.actions?.requestIdShare); // Channel owner: Twitch never shows the share prompt on your own channel, so don't wait for it. if (isBroadcaster()) { btn.textContent = 'Signing in...'; const result = await loginFromJwt(); if (!result.ok) showLoginScreen(loginFailureMessage(result)); return; } if (window.Twitch?.ext?.actions?.requestIdShare) { // Keep the login screen visible, just update the button and show a hint btn.textContent = 'Waiting for Twitch...'; const statusEl = document.getElementById('login-status'); if (statusEl) { statusEl.textContent = 'Look for the Twitch prompt above the video and click Allow to continue'; statusEl.classList.remove('hidden'); } identityRequestPending = true; console.log('[TCG] calling requestIdShare()'); window.Twitch.ext.actions.requestIdShare(); setTimeout(() => { if (identityRequestPending) { console.warn('[TCG] 20s timeout, onAuthorized never re-fired after requestIdShare'); identityRequestPending = false; showLoginScreen("Twitch didn't respond. If no prompt appeared, the extension may not have identity linking enabled. Try again, or reload the page."); } }, 20000); return; } // Extension Helper unavailable console.error('[TCG] requestIdShare not available, Twitch.ext.actions:', window.Twitch?.ext?.actions); showLoginScreen('Twitch identity sharing unavailable.'); }); document.getElementById('logout-btn').addEventListener('click', () => { // Mark as explicitly logged out so refresh doesn't silently re-login setExplicitLogout(true); // Delete the server-side opaque→username mapping if (auth?.token) { fetch(api('/api/twitch/unlink'), { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + auth.token }, }).catch(() => {}); } currentUsername = null; collections = []; me = null; resetTrades(); hideBanner(); showLoginScreen(); }); document.getElementById('refresh-btn').addEventListener('click', () => refreshData(true)); // ── Twitch Extension Helper ─────────────────────────────── if (typeof window.Twitch !== 'undefined' && window.Twitch.ext) { window.Twitch.ext.onAuthorized(authObj => init(authObj)); window.Twitch.ext.onError(err => console.error('[TCG Panel]', err)); } else { // Dev mode, run without the Twitch Extension environment init({ userId: 'dev_mock_opaque', token: null, channelId: 'dev' }); }

nodes.name: api
nodes.body_text: api = path => SITE + path

nodes.name: absUrl
nodes.body_text: absUrl = u => (SITE && typeof u === 'string' && u.charAt(0) === '/' && u.charAt(1) !== '/' ? SITE + u : u)

nodes.name: absolutizeUrls
nodes.body_text: function absolutizeUrls(o) { if (!SITE || !o || typeof o !== 'object') return o; for (const k of Object.keys(o)) { const v = o[k]; if (typeof v === 'string') { if (/(image|thumb)url$/i.test(k)) o[k] = absUrl(v); } else if (v && typeof v === 'object') absolutizeUrls(v); } return o; }

nodes.name: decodeEntry
nodes.body_text: function decodeEntry(entry) { const idx = Math.min(Math.floor(entry / VARIANT_OFFSET), VARIANTS.length - 1); return { cardNumber: entry - idx * VARIANT_OFFSET, variant: VARIANTS[idx] }; }

nodes.name: variantArt
nodes.body_text: function variantArt(card, variant) { if ((variant === 'full' || variant === 'shiny') && card.fullArtImageUrl) { return { imageUrl: card.fullArtImageUrl, thumbUrl: card.fullArtThumbUrl || card.fullArtImageUrl }; } return { imageUrl: card.imageUrl, thumbUrl: card.thumbUrl }; }

nodes.name: setArtMask
nodes.body_text: function setArtMask(el, art) { const thumb = art && art.thumbUrl && art.thumbUrl !== art.imageUrl ? art.thumbUrl : null; el.style.setProperty('--art-mask', thumb ? 'url("' + thumb + '")' : 'none'); }

nodes.name: applyHolo
nodes.body_text: function applyHolo(el, card, variant, live) { const spec = card.holo && card.holo[variant]; if (!spec || !spec.on) return; el.classList.add('holo-fx'); if (live) el.classList.add('holo-live'); for (const k in spec.style) el.style.setProperty(k, spec.style[k]); }

nodes.name: jwtClaim
nodes.body_text: function jwtClaim(token, name) { try { const b64 = token.split('.')[1].replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/'); return JSON.parse(atob(b64))[name]; } catch { return undefined; } }

nodes.name: isBroadcaster
nodes.body_text: function isBroadcaster() { return jwtClaim(auth?.token, 'role') === 'broadcaster'; }

nodes.name: addCardImage
nodes.signature: function addCardImage(container, card, { alt = '', dimmed = false } = {})
nodes.body_text: function addCardImage(container, card, { alt = '', dimmed = false } = {}) { if (!card.imageUrl) return; const img = document.createElement('img'); img.src = card.thumbUrl || card.imageUrl; img.alt = alt; img.loading = 'lazy'; img.decoding = 'async'; if (dimmed) img.style.opacity = '0.55'; container.appendChild(img); const animates = card.thumbUrl && card.thumbUrl !== card.imageUrl && !reducedMotion; if (!animates) return; let overlay = null; const start = () => { if (overlay) return; overlay = document.createElement('img'); overlay.className = 'anim-overlay'; overlay.alt = ''; overlay.decoding = 'async'; // Stay invisible until loaded so the thumbnail underneath never flickers. overlay.addEventListener('load', () => { if (overlay) overlay.style.opacity = dimmed ? '0.55' : '1'; }); overlay.src = card.imageUrl; container.appendChild(overlay); }; const stop = () => { overlay?.remove(); overlay = null; }; // Touch screens emulate mouseenter on tap and mouseleave when tapping elsewhere. container.addEventListener('mouseenter', start); container.addEventListener('mouseleave', stop); }

nodes.name: start
nodes.body_text: start = () => { if (overlay) return; overlay = document.createElement('img'); overlay.className = 'anim-overlay'; overlay.alt = ''; overlay.decoding = 'async'; // Stay invisible until loaded so the thumbnail underneath never flickers. overlay.addEventListener('load', () => { if (overlay) overlay.style.opacity = dimmed ? '0.55' : '1'; }); overlay.src = card.imageUrl; container.appendChild(overlay); }

nodes.name: stop
nodes.body_text: stop = () => { overlay?.remove(); overlay = null; }

nodes.name: entryOf
nodes.body_text: entryOf = (cardNumber, variant) => cardNumber + VARIANT_OFFSET * VARIANTS.indexOf(variant)

nodes.name: fmtNum
nodes.body_text: fmtNum = n => Math.round(n).toLocaleString()

nodes.name: serialMult
nodes.body_text: function serialMult(n) { if (!me || !(n >= 1) || n > me.bonus.cutoff) return 1; return 1 + (me.bonus.max - 1) * (1 - (n - 1) / me.bonus.cutoff); }

nodes.name: copyPts
nodes.body_text: function copyPts(cardNumber, variant, serial) { const c = me && me.cards[cardNumber]; if (!c) return 0; const i = VARIANTS.indexOf(variant), m = serialMult(serial); return m === 1 ? c.values[i] : Math.max(1, Math.round(c.raw[i] * m)); }

nodes.name: heldSerials
nodes.body_text: heldSerials = (cardNumber, variant) => (me && me.serials && me.serials[entryOf(cardNumber, variant)]) || []

nodes.name: cardWorth
nodes.body_text: function cardWorth(card, variants) { if (!me || !me.cards[card.number]) return null; let total = 0; for (const v of VARIANTS) { const n = variants[v]; if (!n) continue; const serials = heldSerials(card.number, v); for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) total += copyPts(card.number, v, serials[k]); } return total; }

nodes.name: el
nodes.body_text: function el(tag, className, text) { const e = document.createElement(tag); if (className) e.className = className; if (text !== undefined) e.textContent = text; return e; }

nodes.name: showState
nodes.body_text: function showState(name) { closeDetail(); // never leave the card overlay open across login/logout/state changes Object.entries(STATES).forEach(([k, el]) => { el.classList.toggle('hidden', k !== name); }); }

nodes.name: renderSeasonHeader
nodes.body_text: function renderSeasonHeader(containerId) { const host = document.getElementById(containerId); if (!host || !season) return; const totalCards = season.packs.reduce((s, p) => s + p.cards.length, 0); const activeColl = collections.find(c => c.active); const ownedCount = activeColl ? new Set(activeColl.ownedNumbers.map(e => decodeEntry(e).cardNumber)).size : 0; const totalPulls = activeColl ? activeColl.ownedNumbers.length : 0; const pct = totalCards > 0 ? Math.round(ownedCount / totalCards * 100) : 0; host.innerHTML = ''; // Season name on the left; rank and score (once loaded) on the right. const top = el('div', 'season-top'); const titleEl = el('div', 'season-title', season.seasonName); top.appendChild(titleEl); host.appendChild(top); if (currentUsername) { const row = document.createElement('div'); row.className = 'progress-row'; const bar = document.createElement('div'); bar.className = 'progress-bar'; const fill = document.createElement('div'); fill.className = 'progress-fill'; fill.style.width = pct + '%'; bar.appendChild(fill); const label = document.createElement('div'); label.className = 'progress-label'; label.textContent = totalPulls > ownedCount ? `${ownedCount}/${totalCards} · ${pct}% · ${totalPulls} pulls` : `${ownedCount}/${totalCards} · ${pct}%`; row.appendChild(bar); row.appendChild(label); host.appendChild(row); // Rank and score once /api/twitch/me has loaded: one tap opens the Stats view. if (me && me.row && me.rank) { const chip = document.createElement('button'); chip.className = 'rank-chip'; chip.type = 'button'; chip.title = 'See how your points add up'; const rank = document.createElement('strong'); rank.textContent = '#' + me.rank; chip.append(rank, ' of ' + me.players + ' \u00b7 ' + fmtNum(me.row.score) + ' pts'); chip.addEventListener('click', () => setView('stats')); top.appendChild(chip); } } }

nodes.name: renderPackTabs
nodes.body_text: function renderPackTabs() { const tabs = document.getElementById('pack-tabs'); if (!tabs || !season) return; tabs.innerHTML = ''; tabs.classList.toggle('single', season.packs.length < 2); // one pack: its name adds nothing, so the row is dropped season.packs.forEach((pack, i) => { const btn = document.createElement('button'); btn.className = 'pack-tab' + (i === currentPackIdx ? ' active' : ''); btn.textContent = pack.packName; btn.addEventListener('click', () => { currentPackIdx = i; renderPackTabs(); renderGrid(); }); tabs.appendChild(btn); }); }

nodes.name: cardStatus
nodes.body_text: function cardStatus(card) { let activeCount = 0; const variants = { regular: 0, reverse: 0, full: 0, shiny: 0 }; // active season, per variant const past = []; // [{ seasonName, count }] for (const c of collections) { let count = 0; for (const entry of c.ownedNumbers) { const d = decodeEntry(entry); if (d.cardNumber !== card.number) continue; count++; if (c.active) variants[d.variant]++; } if (!count) continue; if (c.active) activeCount += count; else past.push({ seasonName: c.seasonName, count }); } // Highest variant owned this season (drives the art and the holo look) let best = 'regular'; for (const v of VARIANTS) if (variants[v] > 0) best = v; return { activeCount, variants, best, past, owned: activeCount > 0 || past.length > 0 }; }

nodes.name: renderGridTools
nodes.body_text: function renderGridTools() { const host = document.getElementById('grid-tools'); const pack = season && season.packs[currentPackIdx]; if (!host || !pack) return; host.innerHTML = ''; const have = pack.cards.filter(c => cardStatus(c).owned).length; const counts = { all: pack.cards.length, have, missing: pack.cards.length - have }; const group = el('div', 'seg'); group.setAttribute('role', 'group'); group.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Show'); [['all', 'All'], ['have', 'Have'], ['missing', 'Missing']].forEach(([id, label]) => { const b = el('button', 'seg-btn' + (collectionFilter === id ? ' active' : ''), label + ' ' + counts[id]); b.type = 'button'; b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', collectionFilter === id ? 'true' : 'false'); b.addEventListener('click', () => { collectionFilter = id; renderGrid(); }); group.appendChild(b); }); host.appendChild(group); }

nodes.name: renderGrid
nodes.body_text: function renderGrid() { const grid = document.getElementById('card-grid'); if (!grid || !season) return; grid.innerHTML = ''; renderGridTools(); const pack = season.packs[currentPackIdx]; if (!pack) return; let shownCount = 0; pack.cards.forEach((card, idx) => { const status = cardStatus(card); const ownedActive = status.activeCount > 0; const ownedPast = status.past; const isOwned = status.owned; if (collectionFilter === 'have' && !isOwned) return; if (collectionFilter === 'missing' && isOwned) return; shownCount++; const cell = document.createElement('div'); cell.className = 'card-cell' + (isOwned ? ' owned' : ''); // Click / Enter / Space opens the card detail view cell.setAttribute('role', 'button'); cell.tabIndex = 0; cell.setAttribute('aria-label', isOwned ? card.name : 'Undiscovered card #' + card.number); cell.addEventListener('click', () => openDetail(idx, cell)); cell.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); openDetail(idx, cell); } }); if (isOwned) { const color = RARITY_COLOR[card.stars] || '#fbbf24'; cell.style.setProperty('--rarity-color', color); // dimmed, pulled in past season only addCardImage(cell, { ...card, ...variantArt(card, status.best) }, { alt: card.name, dimmed: !ownedActive && ownedPast.length > 0 }); // Upgraded variants get a holo sheen / glow, and a marker if (ownedActive) applyHolo(cell, card, status.best, false); if (ownedActive && status.best !== 'regular') { cell.classList.add('vfx-' + status.best); setArtMask(cell, variantArt(card, status.best)); const mark = document.createElement('div'); mark.className = 'variant-mark'; mark.textContent = status.best === 'reverse' ? 'RH' : status.best === 'full' ? 'FA' : 'SH'; mark.title = VARIANT_LABELS[status.best]; cell.appendChild(mark); } // The lowest serial number held of the version shown (gold when it earns a points bonus); needs /api/twitch/me. if (ownedActive) { const held = heldSerials(card.number, status.best); if (held.length) { const n = held[0]; const sm = el('div', 'serial-mark' + (serialMult(n) > 1 ? ' bonus' : '') + (n === 1 ? ' first' : ''), '#' + n); sm.title = 'Serial #' + n + (serialMult(n) > 1 ? ' (x' + serialMult(n).toFixed(2) + ' points)' : ''); cell.appendChild(sm); } } // Season badge for past-season-only cards if (!ownedActive && ownedPast.length > 0) { const badge = document.createElement('div'); badge.className = 'season-badge'; badge.textContent = ownedPast[0].seasonName.replace(/season\s*/i, 'S'); cell.appendChild(badge); } // Rarity dot const dot = document.createElement('div'); dot.className = 'rarity-dot'; dot.style.background = color; cell.appendChild(dot); // Pull count badge (active season only) const pullCount = status.activeCount; if (ownedActive && pullCount > 1) { const countBadge = document.createElement('div'); countBadge.className = 'pull-count'; countBadge.textContent = '×' + pullCount; cell.appendChild(countBadge); } } else { const q = document.createElement('div'); q.className = 'card-question'; q.textContent = '?'; cell.appendChild(q); } // Hover tooltip const tip = document.createElement('div'); tip.className = 'card-tooltip'; tip.textContent = isOwned ? card.name + ' ' + '★'.repeat(card.stars) : '#' + card.number; cell.appendChild(tip); grid.appendChild(cell); }); if (shownCount === 0) { const msg = el('div', 'grid-empty', collectionFilter === 'missing' ? 'Nothing missing in this pack. Nice!' : 'No cards here yet. Pull some on stream!'); grid.appendChild(msg); } }

nodes.name: openDetail
nodes.body_text: function openDetail(idx, opener) { detailIdx = idx; detailVariant = null; upgradeMsg = ''; if (opener) detailOpener = opener; document.getElementById('card-detail').classList.remove('hidden'); renderDetail(); document.getElementById('detail-close').focus(); }

nodes.name: closeDetail
nodes.body_text: function closeDetail() { const el = document.getElementById('card-detail'); if (!el || detailIdx === -1) return; detailIdx = -1; detailVariant = null; upgradeMsg = ''; el.classList.add('hidden'); document.getElementById('detail-art').innerHTML = ''; if (detailOpener && document.contains(detailOpener)) detailOpener.focus(); detailOpener = null; }

nodes.name: stepDetail
nodes.body_text: function stepDetail(delta) { const cards = season?.packs[currentPackIdx]?.cards ?? []; if (detailIdx === -1 || cards.length === 0) return; detailIdx = (detailIdx + delta + cards.length) % cards.length; detailVariant = null; upgradeMsg = ''; renderDetail(); }

nodes.name: upgradeStepFor
nodes.body_text: function upgradeStepFor(pack, card, v) { const allowed = card.variants || VARIANTS; let next = null, cost = 1; for (let k = VARIANTS.indexOf(v) + 1; k < VARIANTS.length; k++) { cost *= Math.max(1, (pack.upgradeCosts && pack.upgradeCosts[VARIANTS[k]]) || 1); if (allowed.includes(VARIANTS[k])) { next = VARIANTS[k]; break; } } return next ? { next, cost } : { next: null, cost: 0 }; }

nodes.name: detailLine
nodes.body_text: function detailLine(className, text) { const el = document.createElement('div'); el.className = className; el.textContent = text; return el; }

nodes.name: renderDetail
nodes.body_text: function renderDetail() { const pack = season?.packs[currentPackIdx]; const card = pack?.cards[detailIdx]; if (!card) { closeDetail(); return; } const status = cardStatus(card); const color = RARITY_COLOR[card.stars] || '#fbbf24'; const art = document.getElementById('detail-art'); const info = document.getElementById('detail-info'); art.innerHTML = ''; info.innerHTML = ''; art.style.setProperty('--rarity-color', color); info.style.setProperty('--rarity-color', color); // Art: owned cards show the thumbnail immediately, then the animated version fades in over it. // With upgrades on, it shows the variant being previewed (default: the best one owned). const shown = detailVariant && status.variants[detailVariant] > 0 ? detailVariant : status.best; const shownArt = variantArt(card, shown); art.className = 'detail-art' + (status.owned && shown !== 'regular' ? ' vfx-' + shown : ''); setArtMask(art, shownArt); if (status.owned) applyHolo(art, card, shown, true); if (status.owned && shownArt.imageUrl) { const thumb = document.createElement('img'); thumb.src = shownArt.thumbUrl || shownArt.imageUrl; thumb.alt = card.name; art.appendChild(thumb); if (shownArt.thumbUrl && shownArt.thumbUrl !== shownArt.imageUrl && !reducedMotion) { const full = document.createElement('img'); full.className = 'anim-overlay'; full.alt = ''; full.addEventListener('load', () => { full.style.opacity = '1'; }); full.src = shownArt.imageUrl; art.appendChild(full); } } else { art.appendChild(detailLine('detail-locked', '?')); } // Text info.appendChild(detailLine('detail-name', status.owned ? card.name : '???')); info.appendChild(detailLine('detail-rarity', '★'.repeat(card.stars) + ' ' + (RARITY_LABEL[card.stars] || ''))); info.appendChild(detailLine('detail-meta', '#' + card.number + ' · ' + pack.packName + ' · ' + (detailIdx + 1) + ' of ' + pack.cards.length)); // Odds and how many exist (from /api/twitch/me); undiscovered cards keep their secrecy. const facts = me && me.cards[card.number]; if (facts && status.owned) { info.appendChild(detailLine('detail-facts', '1 in ' + Math.round(1 / facts.pullRate).toLocaleString() + ' per pack · ' + facts.copies.toLocaleString() + ' out there')); } // How many the viewer has const count = document.createElement('div'); count.className = 'detail-count' + (status.activeCount > 0 ? '' : ' empty'); const num = document.createElement('span'); num.className = 'detail-count-num'; const label = document.createElement('span'); label.className = 'detail-count-label'; if (status.activeCount > 0) { num.textContent = '×' + status.activeCount; label.textContent = status.activeCount === 1 ? 'Pulled once' : 'Pulled ' + status.activeCount + ' times'; } else if (status.owned) { num.textContent = '×0'; label.textContent = 'Not pulled this season'; } else { num.textContent = '-'; label.textContent = 'Not collected yet'; } count.append(num, label); info.appendChild(count); const worth = status.activeCount > 0 ? cardWorth(card, status.variants) : null; if (worth !== null) info.appendChild(detailLine('detail-worth', 'Worth ' + fmtNum(worth) + ' pts')); // Variants & upgrades (only for cards in packs with upgrades on) if (card.upgradesEnabled && status.activeCount > 0) { const list = document.createElement('div'); list.className = 'variant-list'; const allowed = card.variants || VARIANTS; VARIANTS.forEach(v => { const n = status.variants[v]; // A variant that is switched off for this card is hidden unless the viewer already owns one. if (n === 0 && !allowed.includes(v)) return; const { next, cost } = upgradeStepFor(pack, card, v); const row = document.createElement('div'); row.className = 'variant-row' + (n === 0 ? ' none' : '') + (v === shown ? ' active' : ''); if (n > 0) row.addEventListener('click', () => { detailVariant = v; renderDetail(); }); const name = document.createElement('span'); name.className = 'variant-name'; name.textContent = VARIANT_LABELS[v]; const cnt = document.createElement('span'); cnt.className = 'variant-count'; cnt.textContent = '\u00d7' + n; row.append(name, cnt); if (me && me.cards[card.number]) { const pts = el('span', 'variant-pts', fmtNum(me.cards[card.number].values[VARIANTS.indexOf(v)]) + ' pts'); pts.title = 'Points for one copy of this version (a low serial number is worth more)'; row.appendChild(pts); } if (next && cost) { const btn = document.createElement('button'); btn.className = 'upgrade-btn'; const can = n >= cost; btn.disabled = !can; btn.textContent = can ? 'Upgrade' : n + '/' + cost; btn.title = can ? 'Spend ' + cost + ' ' + VARIANT_LABELS[v] + ' for 1 ' + VARIANT_LABELS[next] : 'Need ' + cost + ' ' + VARIANT_LABELS[v] + ' to make 1 ' + VARIANT_LABELS[next]; btn.addEventListener('click', e => { e.stopPropagation(); upgrade(card, v, btn); }); row.appendChild(btn); } list.appendChild(row); }); info.appendChild(list); if (upgradeMsg) info.appendChild(detailLine('upgrade-msg', upgradeMsg)); } // Serial numbers of the copies the viewer holds in the version being shown; each opens that

nodes.name: playUpgradeCeremony
nodes.signature: function playUpgradeCeremony(card, from, to, cost, serial, serialMult)
nodes.body_text: function playUpgradeCeremony(card, from, to, cost, serial, serialMult) { const artFor = v => ((v === 'full' || v === 'shiny') && card.fullArtImageUrl ? { imageUrl: card.fullArtImageUrl, thumbUrl: card.fullArtThumbUrl || card.fullArtImageUrl } : { imageUrl: card.imageUrl, thumbUrl: card.thumbUrl || card.imageUrl }); const fromArt = artFor(from), toArt = artFor(to); const PILL = { reverse: 'linear-gradient(90deg,#8b5cf6,#ec4899)', full: 'linear-gradient(90deg,#0ea5e9,#6366f1)', shiny: 'linear-gradient(90deg,#f59e0b,#ef4444,#a855f7)' }; const overlay = document.createElement('div'); overlay.className = 'ug-overlay'; overlay.setAttribute('role', 'dialog'); overlay.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Upgraded ' + card.name + ' to ' + VARIANT_LABELS[to]); const stage = document.createElement('div'); stage.className = 'ug-stage'; // The stage is designed at 340x520; shrink it to fit the (small) panel. const fit = Math.min(1, window.innerWidth / 360, window.innerHeight / 540); stage.style.transform = 'scale(' + fit + ')'; const add = (cls, parent) => { const el = document.createElement('div'); el.className = cls; (parent || stage).appendChild(el); return el; }; add('ug-ring').setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true'); const n = Math.min(Math.max(cost, 2), 10); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const ing = add('ug-ingredient' + (from === 'regular' ? '' : ' vfx-' + from)); setArtMask(ing, fromArt); applyHolo(ing, card, from, true); ing.style.setProperty('--a', (360 / n) * i + 'deg'); ing.style.setProperty('--d', i * 70 + 'ms'); const img = document.createElement('img'); img.src = fromArt.thumbUrl; img.alt = ''; ing.appendChild(img); // The first few spent copies play the card's animation too (it fades in over the still once loaded). if (i < 5 && fromArt.thumbUrl !== fromArt.imageUrl && !reducedMotion) { const anim = document.createElement('img'); anim.className = 'art-anim'; anim.alt = ''; anim.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true'); anim.addEventListener('load', () => anim.classList.add('art-anim-on')); anim.src = fromArt.imageUrl; ing.appendChild(anim); } } add('ug-flash'); const frame = add('ug-card'); const art = add('ug-art' + (to === 'regular' ? '' : ' vfx-' + to), frame); setArtMask(art, toArt); applyHolo(art, card, to, true); const thumb = document.createElement('img'); thumb.src = toArt.thumbUrl; thumb.alt = card.name; art.appendChild(thumb); if (toArt.thumbUrl !== toArt.imageUrl && !reducedMotion) { const anim = document.createElement('img'); anim.className = 'ug-anim'; anim.alt = ''; anim.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true'); anim.addEventListener('load', () => anim.classList.add('ug-anim-on')); anim.src = toArt.imageUrl; art.appendChild(anim); } if (to === 'full' || to === 'shiny') { for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) { const sp = document.createElement('span'); sp.className = 'ug-spark'; sp.textContent = i % 2 ? '\u2726' : '\u2727'; sp.style.color = to === 'shiny' ? '#ffd24d' : '#7cc7ff'; sp.style.setProperty('--x', Math.round(Math.cos((i / 16) * Math.PI * 2) * (130 + (i % 3) * 40)) + 'px'); sp.style.setProperty('--y', Math.round(Math.sin((i / 16) * Math.PI * 2) * (150 + (i % 4) * 30)) + 'px'); stage.appendChild(sp); } } const text = add('ug-text'); const line = (cls, content) => { const p = document.createElement('p'); p.className = cls; p.textContent = content; text.appendChild(p); return p; }; line('ug-title', 'Upgraded!'); line('ug-card-name', card.name); const pill = line('ug-pill', VARIANT_LABELS[to]); pill.style.background = PILL[to] || PILL.reverse; if (serial) line('ug-serial' + (serialMult > 1 ? ' bonus' : '') + (serial === 1 ? ' first' : ''), '#' + serial + (serial === 1 ? ' \u00b7 the first ever' : serialMult > 1 ? ' \u00b7 \u00d7' + serialMult + ' points' : '')); line('ug-sub', cost + '\u00d7 ' + VARIANT_LABELS[from] + ' \u2192 1 ' + VARIANT_LABELS[to]); const hint = line('ug-hint', '\u00a0'); let closable = false; const close = () => { if (!closable) return; document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey); overlay.remove(); }; const onKey = e => { if (e.key === 'Escape' || e.key === 'Enter') close(); }; setTimeout(() => { closable = true; hint.textContent = 'Tap anywhere to continue'; }, 1800); setTimeout(() => { closable = true; close(); }, 9000); overlay.addEventListener('click', close); document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey); overlay.appendChild(stage); document.body.appendChild(overlay); }

nodes.name: artFor
nodes.body_text: artFor = v => ((v === 'full' || v === 'shiny') && card.fullArtImageUrl ? { imageUrl: card.fullArtImageUrl, thumbUrl: card.fullArtThumbUrl || card.fullArtImageUrl } : { imageUrl: card.imageUrl, thumbUrl: card.thumbUrl || card.imageUrl })

nodes.name: add
nodes.body_text: add = (cls, parent) => { const el = document.createElement('div'); el.className = cls; (parent || stage).appendChild(el); return el; }

nodes.name: line
nodes.body_text: line = (cls, content) => { const p = document.createElement('p'); p.className = cls; p.textContent = content; text.appendChild(p); return p; }

nodes.name: close
nodes.body_text: close = () => { if (!closable) return; document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey); overlay.remove(); }

nodes.name: onKey
nodes.body_text: onKey = e => { if (e.key === 'Escape' || e.key === 'Enter') close(); }

nodes.name: upgrade
nodes.body_text: async function upgrade(card, from, btn) { if (!auth?.token || !season) return; btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = '\u2026'; try { const res = await fetch(api('/api/twitch/upgrade'), { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + auth.token }, body: JSON.stringify({ seasonId: season.seasonId, cardNumber: card.number, from }), }); const body = await res.json().catch(() => ({})); if (res.ok) { const active = collections.find(c => c.active); if (active) active.ownedNumbers = body.owned; // The server says where the upgrade went (a switched-off variant is skipped) and what it cost. detailVariant = body.to || VARIANTS[VARIANTS.indexOf(from) + 1]; upgradeMsg = 'Upgraded to ' + VARIANT_LABELS[detailVariant] + '!'; renderSeasonHeader('collection-season-header'); renderGrid(); playUpgradeCeremony(card, from, detailVariant, body.cost || 0, body.serial || 0, body.serialMult || 1); loadMe(true); // the new copy has a serial and the score moved } else { upgradeMsg = body.error || 'Upgrade failed (' + res.status + ')'; } } catch { upgradeMsg = 'Could not reach the server'; } if (detailIdx !== -1) renderDetail(); }

nodes.name: setView
nodes.body_text: function setView(view) { currentView = view; closeDetail(); document.querySelectorAll('#view-tabs .view-tab').forEach(b => { const on = b.dataset.view === view; b.classList.toggle('active', on); b.setAttribute('aria-selected', on ? 'true' : 'false'); }); document.getElementById('pack-tabs').classList.toggle('hidden', view !== 'collection'); document.getElementById('grid-tools').classList.toggle('hidden', view !== 'collection'); document.getElementById('collection-area').classList.toggle('hidden', view !== 'collection'); document.getElementById('stats-area').classList.toggle('hidden', view !== 'stats'); document.getElementById('trades-area').classList.toggle('hidden', view !== 'trades'); document.getElementById('leaderboard-area').classList.toggle('hidden', view !== 'leaderboard'); if (view === 'stats') { renderStats(); if (!me) loadMe(); } if (view === 'trades') { renderTrades(); loadTrades(false); } if (view === 'leaderboard') loadLeaderboard(); }

nodes.name: siteUrl
nodes.body_text: siteUrl = path => new URL(path, (SITE || window.location.origin)).href

nodes.name: rankBadge
nodes.body_text: function rankBadge(rank) { const b = el('span', 'lb-rank' + (rank <= 3 ? ' medal m' + rank : ''), rank <= 3 ? String(rank) : '#' + rank); return b; }

nodes.name: boardRow
nodes.body_text: function boardRow(r, myName) { const row = document.createElement('a'); row.className = 'lb-row' + (r.username === myName ? ' me' : '') + (r.rank <= 3 ? ' top' + r.rank : ''); row.href = siteUrl('/u/' + encodeURIComponent(r.username)); row.target = '_blank'; row.rel = 'noopener noreferrer'; const who = el('span', 'lb-who'); const name = el('span', 'lb-name', r.username); if (r.username === myName) name.appendChild(el('span', 'lb-you', 'you')); const sub = el('span', 'lb-sub'); const v = r.variants; const extras = []; if (v.reverse) extras.push(v.reverse + ' RH'); if (v.full) extras.push(v.full + ' FA'); if (v.shiny) extras.push(v.shiny + ' SH'); sub.textContent = r.uniqueCards + ' cards' + (extras.length ? ' \u00b7 ' + extras.join(' \u00b7 ') : ''); who.append(name, sub); row.append(rankBadge(r.rank), who, el('span', 'lb-score', fmtNum(r.score))); return row; }

nodes.name: loadLeaderboard
nodes.body_text: async function loadLeaderboard() { const area = document.getElementById('leaderboard-area'); if (!area || !season) return; // Re-fetch at most every 30s while flipping between tabs if (Date.now() - leaderboardLoadedAt < 30000 && area.childElementCount > 0) return; area.innerHTML = ''; area.appendChild(skeletonRows(6)); try { const q = new URLSearchParams({ seasonId: season.seasonId }); if (currentUsername) q.set('username', currentUsername.toLowerCase()); const res = await fetch(api('/api/twitch/leaderboard?' + q)); if (!res.ok) throw new Error('bad status'); const data = await res.json(); leaderboardLoadedAt = Date.now(); area.innerHTML = ''; area.appendChild(detailLine('lb-note', data.seasonName + ' \u00b7 ' + data.players + ' collector' + (data.players === 1 ? '' : 's'))); if (data.rows.length === 0) { area.appendChild(detailLine('lb-note', 'No one is on the board yet.')); return; } const myName = currentUsername ? currentUsername.toLowerCase() : null; data.rows.forEach(r => area.appendChild(boardRow(r, myName))); if (data.me && data.me.rank > data.rows.length) { area.appendChild(detailLine('lb-note', '\u2026')); area.appendChild(boardRow(data.me, myName)); } const foot = el('div', 'lb-foot'); foot.append('Score = every copy you own (low serial numbers earn a bonus) plus collection bonuses. '); const more = el('a', null, 'How points work'); more.href = siteUrl('/faq#points'); more.target = '_blank'; more.rel = 'noopener noreferrer'; foot.appendChild(more); area.appendChild(foot); } catch { area.innerHTML = ''; area.appendChild(retryNote('Could not load the leaderboard.', () => { leaderboardLoadedAt = 0; loadLeaderboard(); })); } }

nodes.name: skeletonRows
nodes.body_text: function skeletonRows(n) { const wrap = el('div', 'skeleton-list'); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) wrap.appendChild(el('div', 'skeleton-row')); return wrap; }

nodes.name: retryNote
nodes.body_text: function retryNote(text, onRetry) { const box = el('div', 'retry-note'); box.appendChild(el('div', null, text)); const b = el('button', 'retry-btn', 'Try again'); b.type = 'button'; b.addEventListener('click', onRetry); box.appendChild(b); return box; }

nodes.name: cardsOfSeason
nodes.body_text: function cardsOfSeason() { const out = []; season.packs.forEach((pack, packIdx) => pack.cards.forEach((card, cardIdx) => out.push({ pack, packIdx, card, cardIdx }))); return out; }

nodes.name: statLink
nodes.body_text: function statLink(text, path, className) { const a = el('a', className || 'stat-link', text); a.href = siteUrl(path); a.target = '_blank'; a.rel = 'noopener noreferrer'; return a; }

nodes.name: statSection
nodes.body_text: function statSection(title, ...children) { const box = el('section', 'stat-box'); box.appendChild(el('h3', 'stat-title', title)); children.forEach(c => c && box.appendChild(c)); return box; }

nodes.name: openCardFromStats
nodes.body_text: function openCardFromStats(packIdx, cardIdx) { currentPackIdx = packIdx; renderPackTabs(); renderGrid(); openDetail(cardIdx, null); }

nodes.name: renderStats
nodes.body_text: function renderStats() { const area = document.getElementById('stats-area'); if (!area || !season) return; area.innerHTML = ''; if (!me) { area.appendChild(skeletonRows(4)); return; } if (!me.row) { area.appendChild(statSection('No points yet', el('p', 'stat-muted', 'Pull a card on stream and you will show up here with a rank and a score.'))); return; } const r = me.row; // Hero: score and rank const hero = el('div', 'stat-hero'); const score = el('div', 'stat-score'); score.append(el('span', 'stat-score-num', fmtNum(r.score)), el('span', 'stat-score-unit', 'points')); const rank = el('button', 'stat-rank'); rank.type = 'button'; rank.title = 'Open the leaderboard'; rank.append(el('strong', null, '#' + me.rank), ' of ' + me.players); rank.addEventListener('click', () => setView('leaderboard')); hero.append(score, rank); area.appendChild(hero); // Trade offers waiting: they are answered in the Trades tab if (me.offers > 0) { const a = el('button', 'offers-banner', me.offers + ' trade offer' + (me.offers === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' waiting for you'); a.type = 'button'; a.appendChild(el('span', 'offers-go', 'Open')); a.addEventListener('click', () => setView('trades')); area.appendChild(a); } // Who is next if (me.next && me.next.gap > 0) { area.appendChild(el('p', 'stat-next', fmtNum(me.next.gap) + ' pts behind @' + me.next.username + '. One more good pull could pass them.')); } else if (me.rank === 1) { area.appendChild(el('p', 'stat-next', 'You are in first place. Hold on to it!')); } // How the score adds up const rows = el('dl', 'stat-rows'); const addRow = (label, value, cls) => { const d = el('div', 'stat-row' + (cls ? ' ' + cls : '')); d.append(el('dt', null, label), el('dd', null, value)); rows.appendChild(d); }; addRow('Your cards', fmtNum(r.cardPoints - r.serialPoints)); addRow('Serial number bonus', (r.serialPoints > 0 ? '+' : '') + fmtNum(r.serialPoints), r.serialPoints > 0 ? 'good' : 'dim'); addRow('Completion bonus', '+' + fmtNum(r.completionBonus) + ' / ' + fmtNum(me.maxCompletion), r.completionBonus > 0 ? 'good' : 'dim'); addRow('Complete collection', r.complete ? '+' + fmtNum(r.setBonus) : fmtNum(me.setBonusValue) + ' when complete', r.complete ? 'good' : 'dim'); addRow('Total', fmtNum(r.score), 'total'); area.appendChild(statSection('Where your points come from', rows)); // Ready to upgrade const ready = []; cardsOfSeason().forEach(({ pack, packIdx, card, cardIdx }) => { if (!pack.upgradesEnabled || !card.upgradesEnabled) return; const st = cardStatus(card); VARIANTS.forEach(v => { const n = st.variants[v]; if (!n) return; const { next, cost } = upgradeStepFor(pack, card, v); if (next && n >= cost) ready.push({ pack, packIdx, card, cardIdx, from: v, to: next, cost, have: n }); }); }); if (ready.length > 0) { const list = el('div', 'ready-list'); ready.slice(0, 5).forEach(x => { const b = el('button', 'ready-row'); b.type = 'button'; const thumb = el('span', 'ready-thumb'); if (x.card.thumbUrl || x.card.imageUrl) { const img = el('img'); img.src = x.card.thumbUrl || x.card.imageUrl; img.alt = ''; thumb.appendChild(img); } const text = el('span', 'ready-text'); text.append(el('span', 'ready-name', x.card.name), el('span', 'ready-sub', x.cost + '\u00d7 ' + VARIANT_LABELS[x.from] + ' \u2192 ' + VARIANT_LABELS[x.to] + ' \u00b7 you have ' + x.have)); b.append(thumb, text, el('span', 'ready-go', 'Open')); b.addEventListener('click', () => openCardFromStats(x.packIdx, x.cardIdx)); list.appendChild(b); }); if (ready.length > 5) list.appendChild(el('p', 'stat-muted', '+' + (ready.length - 5) + ' more on the website')); a.target = '_blank'; a.rel = 'noopener noreferrer'; a.title = 'Worth ' + fmtNum(copyPts(x.card.number, x.variant, x.n)) + ' pts'; a.append('#' + x.n + ' ' + x.card.name + (x.variant === 'regular' ? '' : ' (' + (x.variant === 'reverse' ? 'RH' : x.variant === 'full' ? 'FA' : 'SH') + ')')); chips.appendChild(a); }); if (best.length > 6) chips.appendChild(el('span', 'serial-more', '+' + (best.length - 6) + ' more')); area.appendChild(statSection('Your best serial numbers', chips, el('p', 'stat-muted', 'The first copies ever made of a card are worth extra points.'))); } // Links out const links = el('div', '

nodes.name: addRow
nodes.body_text: addRow = (label, value, cls) => { const d = el('div', 'stat-row' + (cls ? ' ' + cls : '')); d.append(el('dt', null, label), el('dd', null, value)); rows.appendChild(d); }

nodes.name: loadMe
nodes.body_text: async function loadMe(fresh) { if (!auth || !auth.token || !currentUsername) return; try { const res = await fetch(api('/api/twitch/me' + (fresh ? '?fresh=1' : '')), { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + auth.token } }); if (!res.ok) return; me = await res.json(); } catch { return; } updateTradesDot(); if (!tradesData) loadTrades(false); // so listings for your Looking for list can light the dot renderSeasonHeader('collection-season-header'); renderGrid(); // the serial marks on the tiles if (currentView === 'stats') renderStats(); if (detailIdx !== -1) renderDetail(); }

nodes.name: loadUserCollection
nodes.body_text: async function loadUserCollection(username) { try { const res = await fetch(api(`/api/twitch/collection?username=${encodeURIComponent(username)}`)); if (!res.ok) return false; const data = await res.json(); collections = data.collections ?? []; lastLoadAt = Date.now(); return true; } catch { return false; } }

nodes.name: showBanner
nodes.body_text: function showBanner(text, onRetry) { const b = document.getElementById('panel-banner'); if (!b) return; b.innerHTML = ''; b.appendChild(el('span', null, text)); if (onRetry) { const btn = el('button', 'banner-btn', 'Retry'); btn.type = 'button'; btn.addEventListener('click', onRetry); b.appendChild(btn); } b.classList.remove('hidden'); }

nodes.name: hideBanner
nodes.body_text: function hideBanner() { const b = document.getElementById('panel-banner'); if (b) b.classList.add('hidden'); }

nodes.name: showToast
nodes.body_text: function showToast(text) { const t = document.getElementById('toast'); if (!t) return; t.textContent = text; t.classList.remove('hidden'); clearTimeout(toastTimer); toastTimer = setTimeout(() => t.classList.add('hidden'), 4500); }

nodes.name: activeCounts
nodes.body_text: function activeCounts() { const m = new Map(); const c = collections.find(x => x.active); if (c) for (const e of c.ownedNumbers) m.set(e, (m.get(e) || 0) + 1); return m; }

nodes.name: announceNew
nodes.body_text: function announceNew(before) { if (skipNextToast) { skipNextToast = false; return; } const names = []; const byNumber = new Map(); season.packs.forEach(pack => pack.cards.forEach(card => byNumber.set(card.number, card))); for (const [entry, n] of activeCounts()) { if (n <= (before.get(entry) || 0)) continue; const d = decodeEntry(entry); const card = byNumber.get(d.cardNumber); if (card) names.push(card.name + (d.variant === 'regular' ? '' : ' (' + VARIANT_LABELS[d.variant] + ')')); } if (names.length === 0) return; showToast('New pull: ' + names.slice(0, 2).join(', ') + (names.length > 2 ? ' +' + (names.length - 2) + ' more' : '')); }

nodes.name: refreshData
nodes.body_text: async function refreshData(manual) { if (!currentUsername || refreshing) return; refreshing = true; const btn = document.getElementById('refresh-btn'); btn.classList.add('spinning'); const before = activeCounts(); const ok = await loadUserCollection(currentUsername); if (ok) { hideBanner(); renderSeasonHeader('collection-season-header'); renderGrid(); if (before.size > 0) announceNew(before); leaderboardLoadedAt = 0; if (currentView === 'leaderboard') loadLeaderboard(); if (detailIdx !== -1) renderDetail(); loadMe(manual); } else { showBanner('Could not refresh your cards.', () => refreshData(true)); } btn.classList.remove('spinning'); refreshing = false; }

nodes.name: linkAndLogin
nodes.body_text: async function linkAndLogin(username) { // Persist the opaque ID → username mapping so next visit auto-logs in if (auth?.token) { try { await fetch(api('/api/twitch/link'), { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + auth.token, }, body: JSON.stringify({ username }), }); } catch { // Non-fatal, still show collection } } await login(username); }

nodes.name: login
nodes.body_text: async function login(username) { setExplicitLogout(false); currentUsername = username; me = null; resetTrades(); collectionFilter = 'all'; const loaded = await loadUserCollection(username); showState('collection'); leaderboardLoadedAt = 0; setView('collection'); renderSeasonHeader('collection-season-header'); renderPackTabs(); renderGrid(); if (loaded) hideBanner(); else showBanner('Could not load your cards.', () => refreshData(true)); loadMe(); // rank, card values and serial numbers: fills in when it arrives // The username links to the viewer's public collection page (opens in a new tab; Twitch's // extension sandbox allows popups). Same origin as the API calls above. const footerName = document.getElementById('footer-username'); if (footerName) { footerName.textContent = username; footerName.href = new URL('/u/' + encodeURIComponent(username.toLowerCase()), (SITE || window.location.origin)).href; } }

nodes.name: tryAutoLogin
nodes.body_text: async function tryAutoLogin() { if (!auth?.userId) return false; try { const res = await fetch(api(`/api/twitch/user?opaqueId=${encodeURIComponent(auth.userId)}`)); const { username } = await res.json(); if (username) { await login(username); return true; } } catch { // fall through } return false; }

nodes.name: loginFromJwt
nodes.body_text: async function loginFromJwt() { if (!auth?.token) return { ok: false, status: 0, message: 'No Twitch token available' }; try { const res = await fetch(api('/api/twitch/login'), { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + auth.token }, }); if (!res.ok) { const body = await res.json().catch(() => ({})); console.warn('[TCG] login failed:', res.status, body); return { ok: false, status: res.status, message: body.error || 'Login failed (' + res.status + ')' }; } const { username } = await res.json(); if (!username) return { ok: false, status: res.status, message: 'Login returned no username' }; await login(username); return { ok: true }; } catch (err) { console.error('[TCG] login error:', err); return { ok: false, status: 0, message: 'Could not reach the server' }; } }

nodes.name: loginFailureMessage
nodes.body_text: function loginFailureMessage(result) { if (result.status === 401) return 'Sign-in failed: the Twitch token was rejected (check the extension secret on the server).'; if (result.status === 500) return 'Sign-in is unavailable: ' + result.message; if (result.status === 502) return 'Sign-in failed: could not look up your Twitch account. Try again in a moment.'; return 'Could not sign you in: ' + result.message; }

nodes.name: loadSeason
nodes.body_text: async function loadSeason() { try { const res = await fetch(api('/api/twitch/season')); if (!res.ok) { showState('noSeason'); return false; } season = absolutizeUrls(await res.json()); return true; } catch { showState('noSeason'); return false; } }

nodes.name: isExplicitlyLoggedOut
nodes.body_text: function isExplicitlyLoggedOut() { try { return localStorage.getItem('tcg_panel_loggedout') === '1'; } catch { return false; } }

nodes.name: setExplicitLogout
nodes.body_text: function setExplicitLogout(val) { try { localStorage.setItem('tcg_panel_loggedout', val ? '1' : '0'); } catch {} }

nodes.name: populateLoginTeaser
nodes.body_text: function populateLoginTeaser() { const container = document.getElementById('login-teaser'); if (!container) return; container.innerHTML = ''; if (!season) return; // Gather all cards, sort rarest first so teasers show the best cards const all = season.packs.flatMap(p => p.cards) .sort((a, b) => b.stars - a.stars); const show = all.slice(0, 10); show.forEach((card, i) => { const div = document.createElement('div'); const reveal = i < 3; // top 3 rarest are revealed div.className = 'teaser-card' + (reveal ? ' revealed' : ''); if (reveal && card.imageUrl) { addCardImage(div, card); } else { const q = document.createElement('div'); q.className = 'teaser-q'; q.textContent = '?'; div.appendChild(q); } container.appendChild(div); }); }

nodes.name: renderLoginMeta
nodes.body_text: function renderLoginMeta() { const nameEl = document.getElementById('login-season-name'); const countEl = document.getElementById('login-card-count'); if (nameEl) nameEl.textContent = season?.seasonName ?? 'The Cheesy TCG'; if (countEl && season) { const total = season.packs.reduce((s, p) => s + p.cards.length, 0); countEl.textContent = total > 0 ? `${total} cards to discover` : ''; } }

nodes.name: showLoginScreen
nodes.body_text: function showLoginScreen(statusMsg) { populateLoginTeaser(); renderLoginMeta(); const btn = document.getElementById('login-btn'); btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = 'Login with Twitch'; const statusEl = document.getElementById('login-status'); if (statusEl) { statusEl.textContent = statusMsg ?? ''; statusEl.classList.toggle('hidden', !statusMsg); } showState('login'); }

nodes.name: init
nodes.body_text: async function init(twitchAuth) { auth = twitchAuth; console.log('[TCG] init(), userId:', auth.userId, '| identityRequestPending:', identityRequestPending); // Re-auth fired after user responded to the identity-share popup. // JWT now contains user_id, send it to the server to resolve username. if (identityRequestPending) { identityRequestPending = false; console.log('[TCG] identity share response, trying JWT login'); showState('loading'); const result = await loginFromJwt(); if (result.ok) return; showLoginScreen(loginFailureMessage(result)); return; } showState('loading'); const ok = await loadSeason(); if (!ok) return; // Explicit logout, respect it, show login screen if (isExplicitlyLoggedOut()) { showLoginScreen(); return; } // Returning user with saved opaque→username mapping, silent auto-login const autoLoggedIn = await tryAutoLogin(); if (autoLoggedIn) return; // JWT may already contain user_id from a previous grant. Try silent login const result = await loginFromJwt(); if (result.ok) return; // 403 just means this viewer hasn't shared their identity yet, show a plain login screen. // Anything else is a real failure; say so instead of silently looking logged out. showLoginScreen(result.status === 403 || result.status === 0 ? undefined : loginFailureMessage(result)); }

nodes.name: showVersion
nodes.body_text: async function showVersion() { const el = document.getElementById('panel-version'); if (!el) return; try { const res = await fetch(api('/api/version'), { cache: 'no-store' }); if (!res.ok) return; const v = await res.json(); el.textContent = 'v' + v.version + ' · ' + v.commit + (v.env && v.env !== 'production' ? ' · ' + v.env : ''); el.title = [ 'Version ' + v.version, 'Commit ' + v.commit, v.branch && 'Branch ' + v.branch, 'Environment ' + v.env, v.builtAt && 'Built ' + new Date(v.builtAt).toLocaleString(), ].filter(Boolean).join('\n'); } catch { // leave blank } }

nodes.name: trades.js
nodes.body_text: // Trading inside the Twitch panel: offers for you, your open offers, the open board, recent results and a small composer. // A classic script loaded after panel.js, so it shares its globals (auth, season, collections, el, cardStatus, ...). // Everything goes through /api/twitch/trades (signed Extension JWT), which uses the same engine as the website. let tradesData = null; // last GET /api/twitch/trades let tradesLoadedAt = 0; let tradesError = ''; let composer = null; // { to, note, give: {key: n}, get: {key: n}, wantVar: {number: variant}, filter, busy, msg } while composing const SHORT = { regular: '', reverse: 'RH', full: 'FA', shiny: 'SH' }; // Listings that match the viewer's Looking for list or saved alerts light the Trades dot until the tab has been opened (remembered per // device, only the newest ids). Offers waiting for them always count. const SEEN_KEY = 'tcg_panel_seen_alerts'; // ── Pieces ──────────────────────────────────────────────── // A button that needs a second tap to go ahead (a trade cannot be undone). const STATUS_TEXT = { accepted: 'Completed', declined: 'Declined', cancelled: 'Cancelled', expired: 'Expired', countered: 'Countered', failed: 'Failed' }; // ── The tab ─────────────────────────────────────────────── // ── Composer ────────────────────────────────────────────── // Answering an offer with different terms: it starts from the mirror of the offer (you give what they asked for, as far as you own it, // and want what they offered) and goes back to them as a new offer; the original is closed.

nodes.name: tkey
nodes.body_text: tkey = (number, variant) => number + '|' + variant

nodes.name: tradeCardMap
nodes.body_text: function tradeCardMap() { const m = new Map(); if (season) season.packs.forEach(pack => pack.cards.forEach(c => m.set(c.number, c))); return m; }

nodes.name: timeLeftText
nodes.body_text: timeLeftText = ms => { const left = ms - Date.now(); if (left <= 0) return 'expired'; const h = Math.floor(left / 3600000); return h >= 24 ? Math.floor(h / 24) + 'd left' : h >= 1 ? h + 'h left' : Math.max(1, Math.floor(left / 60000)) + 'm left'; }

nodes.name: resetTrades
nodes.body_text: function resetTrades() { tradesData = null; tradesLoadedAt = 0; tradesError = ''; composer = null; }

nodes.name: seenAlerts
nodes.body_text: function seenAlerts() { try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(SEEN_KEY) || '[]'); } catch { return []; } }

nodes.name: markAlertsSeen
nodes.body_text: function markAlertsSeen() { if (!tradesData) return; const ids = tradesData.board.filter(t => t.alert).map(t => t.id); try { localStorage.setItem(SEEN_KEY, JSON.stringify(ids.slice(0, 60))); } catch { /* storage unavailable */ } updateTradesDot(); }

nodes.name: updateTradesDot
nodes.body_text: function updateTradesDot() { const dot = document.getElementById('trades-dot'); if (!dot) return; const seen = seenAlerts(); const fresh = tradesData ? tradesData.board.filter(t => t.alert && seen.indexOf(t.id) === -1).length : 0; const waiting = tradesData ? tradesData.incoming.length : (me && me.offers) || 0; dot.classList.toggle('hidden', waiting + fresh === 0); dot.title = fresh > 0 && waiting === 0 ? 'A card you are looking for was listed' : 'Trade offers are waiting'; }

nodes.name: loadTrades
nodes.body_text: async function loadTrades(force) { if (!auth || !auth.token || !currentUsername) return; if (!force && tradesData && Date.now() - tradesLoadedAt < 30000) { renderTrades(); return; } try { const res = await fetch(api('/api/twitch/trades'), { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + auth.token } }); const body = await res.json().catch(() => ({})); if (!res.ok) { tradesError = body.error || 'Could not load trades (' + res.status + ')'; } else { tradesData = body; tradesError = ''; tradesLoadedAt = Date.now(); } } catch { tradesError = 'Could not reach the server'; } if (currentView === 'trades') { renderTrades(); markAlertsSeen(); } else updateTradesDot(); }

nodes.name: tradeRequest
nodes.body_text: async function tradeRequest(payload) { try { const res = await fetch(api('/api/twitch/trades'), { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + auth.token }, body: JSON.stringify(payload), }); const body = await res.json().catch(() => ({})); return res.ok ? { ok: true, body } : { ok: false, error: body.error || 'That did not work (' + res.status + ')' }; } catch { return { ok: false, error: 'Could not reach the server' }; } }

nodes.name: stackChips
nodes.body_text: function stackChips(items, cards) { const wrap = el('div', 'tr-chips'); items.forEach(i => { const card = cards.get(i.cardNumber); const chip = el('span', 'tr-chip'); const thumb = el('span', 'tr-thumb'); if (card && (card.thumbUrl || card.imageUrl)) { const img = el('img'); img.src = card.thumbUrl || card.imageUrl; img.alt = ''; thumb.appendChild(img); } chip.append(thumb, el('span', 'tr-chip-text', i.count + '× ' + (card ? card.name : '#' + i.cardNumber) + (SHORT[i.variant] ? ' (' + SHORT[i.variant] + ')' : ''))); wrap.appendChild(chip); }); return wrap; }

nodes.name: confirmButton
nodes.body_text: function confirmButton(label, className, run) { const b = el('button', className, label); b.type = 'button'; let armed = false, timer = null; b.addEventListener('click', async () => { if (!armed) { armed = true; b.textContent = 'Sure?'; b.classList.add('armed'); timer = setTimeout(() => { armed = false; b.textContent = label; b.classList.remove('armed'); }, 3000); return; } clearTimeout(timer); b.disabled = true; b.textContent = '…'; await run(); }); return b; }

nodes.name: answerTrade
nodes.body_text: async function answerTrade(action, id, doneText) { const r = await tradeRequest({ action, id }); showToast(r.ok ? doneText : r.error); await loadTrades(true); if (r.ok && action !== 'decline') { skipNextToast = action === 'accept'; refreshData(false); loadMe(true); } }

nodes.name: tradeRow
nodes.body_text: function tradeRow(t, mode, cards) { const row = el('div', 'tr-row'); const head = el('div', 'tr-head'); const title = mode === 'incoming' ? '@' + t.from + (t.counter ? ' countered' : ' offers you') : mode === 'board' ? 'Listing by @' + t.from : t.kind === 'direct' ? 'Offer to @' + t.to : 'Your listing on the board'; head.append(el('span', 'tr-who', title), el('span', 'tr-time', timeLeftText(t.expiresAt))); row.appendChild(head); if (mode === 'board' && t.alert) row.appendChild(el('span', 'tr-alert', 'On your list')); const mineOut = mode === 'outgoing'; const getItems = mineOut ? t.get : t.give; // what the viewer receives const giveItems = mineOut ? t.give : t.get; // what the viewer hands over const getPts = mineOut ? t.getPts : t.givePts, givePts = mineOut ? t.givePts : t.getPts; const side = (label, items, pts) => { const s = el('div', 'tr-side'); s.append(el('span', 'tr-label', label + ' · ' + fmtNum(pts) + ' pts'), stackChips(items, cards)); return s; }; row.append(side('You get', getItems, getPts), side('You give', giveItems, givePts)); if (t.note) row.appendChild(el('p', 'tr-note', '“' + t.note + '”')); const actions = el('div', 'tr-actions'); if (mode === 'outgoing') { actions.appendChild(confirmButton('Cancel offer', 'tr-btn ghost', () => answerTrade('cancel', t.id, 'Offer cancelled. Your cards are back.'))); } else { if (t.canTake && tradesData.enabled) { actions.appendChild(confirmButton(mode === 'board' ? 'Take trade' : 'Accept', 'tr-btn', () => answerTrade('accept', t.id, 'Trade done! Check your collection.'))); } else { actions.appendChild(el('span', 'tr-hint', !tradesData.enabled ? tradesData.closedReason : 'You do not have the cards asked for.')); } if (mode === 'incoming') { const counter = el('button', 'tr-btn ghost', 'Counter'); counter.type = 'button'; counter.disabled = !tradesData.enabled; counter.addEventListener('click', () => startCounter(t)); actions.append(counter, confirmButton('Decline', 'tr-btn ghost', () => answerTrade('decline', t.id, 'Offer declined.'))); } } row.appendChild(actions); return row; }

nodes.name: side
nodes.body_text: side = (label, items, pts) => { const s = el('div', 'tr-side'); s.append(el('span', 'tr-label', label + ' · ' + fmtNum(pts) + ' pts'), stackChips(items, cards)); return s; }

nodes.name: recentRow
nodes.body_text: function recentRow(t, cards) { const me = currentUsername; const other = t.from === me ? (t.to || t.resolvedBy || 'the board') : t.from; const row = el('div', 'tr-recent'); const gave = t.from === me ? t.give : t.get; const got = t.from === me ? t.get : t.give; const sum = items => items.map(i => i.count + '× ' + (cards.get(i.cardNumber)?.name || '#' + i.cardNumber)).join(', '); row.append(el('span', 'tr-recent-status ' + t.status, STATUS_TEXT[t.status] || t.status), el('span', 'tr-recent-text', ' @' + other + (t.status === 'accepted' ? ': got ' + sum(got) + ' for ' + sum(gave) : ''))); return row; }

nodes.name: sum
nodes.body_text: sum = items => items.map(i => i.count + '× ' + (cards.get(i.cardNumber)?.name || '#' + i.cardNumber)).join(', ')

nodes.name: renderTrades
nodes.body_text: function renderTrades() { const area = document.getElementById('trades-area'); if (!area || !season) return; if (composer) { renderComposer(area); return; } area.innerHTML = ''; if (!tradesData) { area.appendChild(tradesError ? retryNote(tradesError, () => loadTrades(true)) : skeletonRows(4)); return; } const cards = tradeCardMap(); const d = tradesData; const top = el('div', 'tr-top'); const newBtn = el('button', 'tr-btn', '+ New offer'); newBtn.type = 'button'; newBtn.disabled = !d.enabled; newBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { composer = { to: '', note: '', give: {}, get: {}, wantVar: {}, filter: '', busy: false, msg: '', counterOf: null }; renderTrades(); }); top.append(newBtn, el('span', 'tr-limits', d.outgoing.length + '/' + d.limits.maxOpen + ' open offers')); area.appendChild(top); if (!d.enabled) area.appendChild(el('p', 'tr-closed', d.closedReason)); const section = (title, count, ...children) => { const box = el('section', 'stat-box'); box.appendChild(el('h3', 'stat-title', title + (count ? ' (' + count + ')' : ''))); children.forEach(c => c && box.appendChild(c)); area.appendChild(box); }; if (d.incoming.length) section('Offers for you', d.incoming.length, ...d.incoming.map(t => tradeRow(t, 'incoming', cards))); if (d.outgoing.length) section('Your open offers', d.outgoing.length, ...d.outgoing.map(t => tradeRow(t, 'outgoing', cards))); section('The board', d.board.length, ...(d.board.length ? d.board.map(t => tradeRow(t, 'board', cards)) : [el('p', 'stat-muted', 'Nothing is listed right now. Post your own with New offer, and leave the name empty.')])); if (d.recent.length) section('Recent', 0, ...d.recent.map(t => recentRow(t, cards))); area.appendChild(el('div', 'tr-foot', 'Cards you offer are held safely until the offer is answered, cancelled or runs out (' + d.limits.expiryHours + 'h).')); }

nodes.name: section
nodes.body_text: section = (title, count, ...children) => { const box = el('section', 'stat-box'); box.appendChild(el('h3', 'stat-title', title + (count ? ' (' + count + ')' : ''))); children.forEach(c => c && box.appendChild(c)); area.appendChild(box); }

nodes.name: startCounter
nodes.body_text: function startCounter(t) { const give = {}, get = {}; const cards = tradeCardMap(); t.get.forEach(i => { const card = cards.get(i.cardNumber); const have = card ? cardStatus(card).variants[i.variant] || 0 : 0; if (have > 0) give[tkey(i.cardNumber, i.variant)] = Math.min(i.count, have); }); t.give.forEach(i => { get[tkey(i.cardNumber, i.variant)] = i.count; }); composer = { to: t.from, note: '', give, get, wantVar: {}, filter: '', busy: false, msg: '', counterOf: t.id }; renderTrades(); }

nodes.name: stepper
nodes.body_text: function stepper(value, max, onChange) { const box = el('span', 'tr-step'); const minus = el('button', 'tr-step-btn', '−'); minus.type = 'button'; minus.disabled = value <= 0; const plus = el('button', 'tr-step-btn', '+'); plus.type = 'button'; plus.disabled = value >= max; minus.setAttribute('aria-label', 'One fewer'); plus.setAttribute('aria-label', 'One more'); minus.addEventListener('click', () => onChange(value - 1)); plus.addEventListener('click', () => onChange(value + 1)); box.append(minus, el('span', 'tr-step-n', String(value)), plus); return box; }

nodes.name: stackCount
nodes.body_text: stackCount = obj => Object.keys(obj).filter(k => obj[k] > 0).length

nodes.name: setCount
nodes.body_text: setCount = (obj, key, n) => { if (n > 0) obj[key] = n; else delete obj[key]; }

nodes.name: cardRowBase
nodes.body_text: function cardRowBase(card, nameSuffix) { const row = el('div', 'tr-pick'); const thumb = el('span', 'tr-thumb'); if (card.thumbUrl || card.imageUrl) { const img = el('img'); img.src = card.thumbUrl || card.imageUrl; img.alt = ''; thumb.appendChild(img); } const name = el('span', 'tr-pick-name', card.name + (nameSuffix || '')); row.append(thumb, name); return row; }

nodes.name: renderGive
nodes.body_text: function renderGive(box) { box.innerHTML = ''; const rows = []; cardsOfSeason().forEach(({ card }) => { const st = cardStatus(card); VARIANTS.forEach(v => { if (st.variants[v] > 0) rows.push({ card, v, have: st.variants[v] }); }); }); if (rows.length === 0) { box.appendChild(el('p', 'stat-muted', 'You have no cards to offer yet.')); return; } rows.forEach(({ card, v, have }) => { const k = tkey(card.number, v); const n = composer.give[k] || 0; const row = cardRowBase(card, SHORT[v] ? ' (' + SHORT[v] + ')' : ''); row.classList.toggle('on', n > 0); row.appendChild(el('span', 'tr-have', 'have ' + have)); row.appendChild(stepper(n, have, nn => { if (nn > 0 && n === 0 && stackCount(composer.give) >= tradesData.limits.maxStacks) { composer.msg = 'You can offer up to ' + tradesData.limits.maxStacks + ' different cards.'; renderSummary(); return; } composer.msg = ''; setCount(composer.give, k, nn); renderGive(box); renderSummary(); })); box.appendChild(row); }); }

nodes.name: renderWant
nodes.body_text: function renderWant(box) { box.innerHTML = ''; const q = composer.filter.trim().toLowerCase(); let shown = 0; cardsOfSeason().forEach(({ card }) => { if (q && card.name.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) === -1 && String(card.number) !== q) return; if (!q && shown >= 12) return; shown++; const variants = (card.variants && card.variants.length) ? card.variants : ['regular']; const cur = variants.indexOf(composer.wantVar[card.number]) !== -1 ? composer.wantVar[card.number] : variants[0]; const k = tkey(card.number, cur); const n = composer.get[k] || 0; const row = cardRowBase(card); row.classList.toggle('on', n > 0); if (variants.length > 1) { const sel = el('select', 'tr-select'); variants.forEach(v => { const o = el('option', null, VARIANT_LABELS[v]); o.value = v; if (v === cur) o.selected = true; sel.appendChild(o); }); sel.addEventListener('change', () => { composer.wantVar[card.number] = sel.value; renderWant(box); }); row.appendChild(sel); } row.appendChild(stepper(n, 20, nn => { if (nn > 0 && n === 0 && stackCount(composer.get) >= tradesData.limits.maxStacks) { composer.msg = 'You can ask for up to ' + tradesData.limits.maxStacks + ' different cards.'; renderSummary(); return; } composer.msg = ''; setCount(composer.get, k, nn); renderWant(box); renderSummary(); })); box.appendChild(row); }); if (!q && cardsOfSeason().length > 12) box.appendChild(el('p', 'stat-muted', 'Type a name to find other cards.')); if (shown === 0) box.appendChild(el('p', 'stat-muted', 'No card matches that.')); }

nodes.name: itemsOf
nodes.body_text: itemsOf = obj => Object.keys(obj).filter(k => obj[k] > 0).map(k => { const [n, v] = k.split('|'); return { cardNumber: Number(n), variant: v, count: obj[k] }; })

nodes.name: renderSummary
nodes.body_text: function renderSummary() { const box = document.getElementById('tr-summary'); if (!box) return; box.innerHTML = ''; const cards = tradeCardMap(); const give = itemsOf(composer.give), get = itemsOf(composer.get); const line = (label, items) => { const s = el('div', 'tr-side'); s.append(el('span', 'tr-label', label), items.length ? stackChips(items, cards) : el('span', 'tr-hint', 'nothing chosen yet')); box.appendChild(s); }; line('You give', give); line('You want back', get); if (composer.msg) box.appendChild(el('p', 'tr-error', composer.msg)); const send = document.getElementById('tr-send'); if (send) send.disabled = composer.busy || give.length === 0 || get.length === 0; }

nodes.name: line
nodes.body_text: line = (label, items) => { const s = el('div', 'tr-side'); s.append(el('span', 'tr-label', label), items.length ? stackChips(items, cards) : el('span', 'tr-hint', 'nothing chosen yet')); box.appendChild(s); }

nodes.name: renderComposer
nodes.body_text: function renderComposer(area) { area.innerHTML = ''; const head = el('div', 'tr-top'); const back = el('button', 'tr-btn ghost', '‹ Back'); back.type = 'button'; back.addEventListener('click', () => { composer = null; renderTrades(); }); head.append(back, el('span', 'tr-limits', composer.counterOf ? 'Counter-offer' : 'New offer')); area.appendChild(head); const section = (title, hint, child) => { const box = el('section', 'stat-box'); box.appendChild(el('h3', 'stat-title', title)); if (hint) box.appendChild(el('p', 'stat-muted', hint)); box.appendChild(child); area.appendChild(box); }; const giveBox = el('div', 'tr-list'); section('1. What you give', 'Tap + on the cards to hand over. They are held safely until someone answers.', giveBox); renderGive(giveBox); const wantWrap = el('div'); const search = el('input', 'tr-input'); search.type = 'search'; search.placeholder = 'Find a card...'; search.value = composer.filter; search.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Find a card'); const wantBox = el('div', 'tr-list'); search.addEventListener('input', () => { composer.filter = search.value; renderWant(wantBox); }); wantWrap.append(search, wantBox); section('2. What you want back', null, wantWrap); renderWant(wantBox); const sendWrap = el('div'); const to = el('input', 'tr-input'); to.type = 'text'; to.placeholder = 'Twitch name (empty = post on the board)'; to.value = composer.to; to.maxLength = 40; to.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Who the offer is for'); if (composer.counterOf) { to.readOnly = true; to.title = 'A counter-offer goes back to the person who made the offer'; } to.addEventListener('input', () => { composer.to = to.value; }); const note = el('input', 'tr-input'); note.type = 'text'; note.placeholder = 'Add a note (optional)'; note.value = composer.note; note.maxLength = 140; note.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Note'); note.addEventListener('input', () => { composer.note = note.value; }); const summary = el('div'); summary.id = 'tr-summary'; const send = el('button', 'tr-btn wide', 'Send offer'); send.id = 'tr-send'; send.type = 'button'; send.addEventListener('click', async () => { composer.busy = true; composer.msg = ''; renderSummary(); const target = composer.to.replace(/^@/, '').trim(); const r = composer.counterOf ? await tradeRequest({ action: 'counter', id: composer.counterOf, give: itemsOf(composer.give), get: itemsOf(composer.get), note: composer.note }) : await tradeRequest({ action: 'create', kind: target ? 'direct' : 'listing', to: target || undefined, give: itemsOf(composer.give), get: itemsOf(composer.get), note: composer.note }); composer.busy = false; if (!r.ok) { composer.msg = r.error; renderSummary(); return; } const counterSent = !!composer.counterOf; composer = null; showToast(counterSent ? 'Counter-offer sent to @' + target + '.' : target ? 'Offer sent to @' + target + '.' : 'Listed on the board.'); await loadTrades(true); refreshData(false); loadMe(true); }); sendWrap.append(to, note, summary, send); section('3. Send it', composer.counterOf ? 'This goes back to ' + composer.to + ' as a new offer, and their original offer is closed.' : 'Name someone to offer it just to them, or leave the name empty to post it on the board for anyone.', sendWrap); renderSummary(); }
