nodes.name: widget.js
nodes.body_text: 'use strict'; // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ // STAGE LAYOUT (Settings → Overlay layout) // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ // Everything is drawn on a fixed "design stage" (default 1280x720) and scaled to fit whatever size the OBS // browser source actually is, so a differently sized source still shows the whole animation. The admin's // scale/offset are applied on top. `?preview` is the admin editor's iframe: it takes layout changes by // postMessage and never talks to the real queue, heartbeat or collection data. // Sandbox: with ?sandbox=<id> every request to this site carries the sandbox header, so the overlay reads and writes that // sandbox's data instead of production's (see lib/db.ts). A badge makes it obvious the overlay is not live data. const SANDBOX_ID = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('sandbox'); if (SANDBOX_ID) { const nativeFetch = window.fetch.bind(window); window.fetch = (input, init) => { const url = typeof input === 'string' ? input : (input && input.url) || ''; if (typeof input !== 'string' || !(url.startsWith('/') || url.startsWith(window.location.origin))) return nativeFetch(input, init); const headers = new Headers((init && init.headers) || undefined); headers.set('x-tcg-sandbox', SANDBOX_ID); return nativeFetch(input, Object.assign({}, init, { headers })); }; window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => { const badge = document.createElement('div'); badge.textContent = 'SANDBOX · ' + SANDBOX_ID; badge.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;left:10px;bottom:10px;z-index:99998;font:700 12px Poppins,sans-serif;color:#f3e8ff;background:rgba(88,28,135,.9);border:1px solid rgba(192,132,252,.6);border-radius:999px;padding:4px 12px;pointer-events:none;'; document.body.appendChild(badge); }); } // Overlay key: the OBS URL carries ?key=..., and the server only lets the overlay take queued pulls, report shown collections and // check in when that key (or a staff session) comes with the request (lib/overlay-key.ts). Sent on every request to this site. const OVERLAY_KEY = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('key'); if (OVERLAY_KEY) { const keyedFetch = window.fetch.bind(window); window.fetch = (input, init) => { const url = typeof input === 'string' ? input : (input && input.url) || ''; if (typeof input !== 'string' || !(url.startsWith('/') || url.startsWith(window.location.origin))) return keyedFetch(input, init); const headers = new Headers((init && init.headers) || undefined); headers.set('x-overlay-key', OVERLAY_KEY); return keyedFetch(input, Object.assign({}, init, { headers })); }; } const PREVIEW = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).has('preview'); // The stage is the browser source's size; scale/offset are set separately for the pack opening and the collection // view (each theater wrapper gets .is-pack or .is-collection, which picks up its own --pack-* / --col-* variables). let STAGE = { width: 1280, height: 720 }; let PLACEMENTS = { pack: { scale: 1, offsetX: 0, offsetY: 0 }, collection: { scale: 1, offsetX: 0, offsetY: 0 }, }; // ── Look & animation properties (Settings -> Overlay Properties) ── // The server sends every property's default plus the admin's values; a pack can override some of them. // Keys are dotted paths ("collection.perRow", "variant.shiny.holoSpeed"); see lib/overlay-props.ts. let PROP_DEFAULTS = {}; let PROPS_GLOBAL = {}; let PACK_OVERRIDES = {}; let PREVIEW_PROPS = null; // admin editor: unsaved values shown live (replaces the saved ones) let PREVIEW_VARIANT = ''; // admin editor: "preview as" variant // Falls back to the literal (the shipped default) if the config couldn't be fetched. window.addEventListener('resize', () => applyLayout()); applyLayout(); // ── Admin editor preview (?preview) ── // Shows a still of the pack opening / collection view while nothing is animating, so it can be positioned, and plays // the real animation on request. Messages from the editor: layout, static (which view to show), pack, collection. let previewMode = 'pack'; let previewPackId = ''; let previewCardNumber = 0; let previewShowOff = false; // the editor's "Show off" view: the still and Play use the show-off settings // The pack workspace's preview sends the UNSAVED pack and card fields; they are laid over the loaded data (this page only ever shows a preview). const DRAFT_PACK_FIELDS = ['name', 'coverImageUrl', 'accentColor', 'tearBorderColor', 'holoMinStars', 'cardTime', 'cooldownTime', 'soundVolume', 'upgradesEnabled', 'variantWeights', 'disabledVariants']; const DRAFT_CARD_FIELDS = ['name', 'stars', 'probability', 'image', 'thumb', 'soundUrl', 'fullArt', 'fullArtThumb', 'upgradesEnabled', 'disabledVariants']; if (PREVIEW) { // Clicking an element in the editor's preview asks the editor to open that element's settings. document.body.classList.add('preview-edit'); document.addEventListener('click', (e) => { const el = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('[data-edit]'); if (el && window.parent !== window) window.parent.postMessage({ type: 'select', target: el.dataset.edit }, window.location.origin); }); window.addEventListener('message', (e) => { if (e.origin !== window.location.origin || !e.data || typeof e.data !== 'object') return; if (e.data.type === 'layout') applyLayout(e.data.layout); else if (e.data.type === 'props') { PREVIEW_PROPS = e.data.props && typeof e.data.props === 'object' ? e.data.props : null; previewPackId = typeof e.data.packId === 'string' ? e.data.packId : ''; previewCardNumber = Number.isInteger(e.data.cardNumber) ? e.data.cardNumber : 0; if (activeDraws === 0) showStatic(); } else if (e.data.type === 'draft') applyDraft(e.data); else if (e.data.type === 'variant') { PREVIEW_VARIANT = ['reverse', 'full', 'shiny'].includes(e.data.variant) ? e.data.variant : ''; if (activeDraws === 0) showStatic(); } else if (e.data.type === 'static') { previewShowOff = !!e.data.showoff && e.data.mode !== 'collection'; if (activeDraws === 0) showStatic(e.data.mode); else previewMode = e.data.mode === 'collection' ? 'collection' : 'pack'; } else if (e.data.type === 'showoff') { clearStatic(); const chosen = PACKS.find(p => p.pack.id === previewPackId) || PACKS[0]; const c = chosen && (chosen.cards.find(x => x.number === previewCardNumber) || [...chosen.cards].sort((x, y) => y.stars - x.stars)[0]); if (c) queueShowCard('preview', { cardNumber: c.number, variant: PREVIEW_VARIANT || 'regular', serial: 3, serialMult: 2.8, uid: 1023381 }); } else if (e.data.type === 'pack') { clearStatic(); queueDraw('preview', { dry: true, packId: previewPackId || undefined, cardNumber: previewCardNumber || undefined, variant: PREVIEW_VARIANT || undefined, moment: MOMENT_IDS.includes(e.data.moment) ? e.data.moment : undefined }); } else if (e.data.type === 'collection') { clearStatic(); queueCollection('preview', { dry: true }); } }); } // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ // SEASON DATA (loaded from /api/seasons/active) // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ // Collection entries encode the variant: cardNumber + VARIANT_OFFSET * variantIndex (regular = plain number). // Keep in sync with lib/variants.ts. const VARIANTS = ['regular', 'reverse', 'full', 'shiny']; const VARIANT_OFFSET = 1000000; const VARIANT_LABELS = { regular: 'Regular', reverse: 'Reverse Holo', full: 'Full Art', shiny: 'Shiny Full Art' }; const DEFAULT_VARIANT_WEIGHTS = { regular: 100, reverse: 25, full: 5, shiny: 1 }; // Test-panel switches (?dev). Only the panel changes these; real draws never see them. const DEV = { dry: true, mute: false, quick: false }; // `off` lists the variants switched off for this pack / card: they are never rolled (Regular can't be switched off). let PACKS = []; // [{ pack, cards: [{number,name,image,probability,stars}] }] let ALL_CARDS = []; // flat list of all cards across all packs (for mini-list) let SEASON_CFG = { maxConcurrentPacks: 1, collectionName: '', }; // Fallback pack visual config used before season loads const PACK_DEFAULTS = { cardTime: 3, cooldownTime: 1, soundVolume: 1.0, holoMinStars: 5, packageImage: 'assets/pack-cover.png', accentColor: 'rgb(241,187,6)', tearBorderColor:'rgb(218,163,18)', }; // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ // CARD SELECTION (pick pack by weight, then card by prob) // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ /** * Picks what to draw. `opts` (test panel only) can pin any of: `packId`, `cardNumber`, `variant`. * Anything not pinned is rolled exactly as in a real draw. */ // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ // PACK SOUNDS // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ const PACK_SOUNDS = [ { src: 'https://cdn.freesound.org/previews/186/186719_105499-lq.mp3', delay: 0 }, { src: 'https://cdn.freesound.org/previews/787/787409_12262933-lq.mp3', delay: 450 }, { src: 'https://cdn.freesound.org/previews/787/787405_12262933-lq.mp3', delay: 1410 }, ]; const STAR_SVG = `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="margin-right:2px;"><path d="M9.15316 5.40838C10.4198 3.13613 11.0531 2 12 2C12.9469 2 13.5802 3.13612 14.8468 5.40837L15.1745 5.99623C15.5345 6.64193 15.7144 6.96479 15.9951 7.17781C16.2757 7.39083 16.6251 7.4699 17.3241 7.62805L17.9605 7.77203C20.4201 8.32856 21.65 8.60682 21.9426 9.54773C22.2352 10.4886 21.3968 11.4691 19.7199 13.4299L19.2861 13.9372C18.8096 14.4944 18.5713 14.773 18.4641 15.1177C18.357 15.4624 18.393 15.8341 18.465 16.5776L18.5306 17.2544C18.7841 19.8706 18.9109 21.1787 18.1449 21.7602C17.3788 22.3417 16.2273 21.8115 13.9243 20.7512L13.3285 20.4768C12.6741 20.1755 12.3469 20.0248 12 20.0248C11.6531 20.0248 11.3259 20.1755 10.6715 20.4768L10.0757 20.7512C7.77268 21.8115 6.62118 22.3417 5.85515 21.7602C5.08912 21.1787 5.21588 19.8706 5.4694 17.2544L5.53498 16.5776C5.60703 15.8341 5.64305 15.4624 5.53586 15.1177C5.42868 14.773 5.19043 14.4944 4.71392 13.9372L4.2801 13.4299C2.60325 11.4691 1.76482 10.4886 2.05742 9.54773C2.35002 8.60682 3.57986 8.32856 6.03954 7.77203L6.67589 7.62805C7.37485 7.4699 7.72433 7.39083 8.00494 7.17781C8.28555 6.96479 8.46553 6.64194 8.82547 5.99623L9.15316 5.40838Z" fill="rgb(241,187,6)"></path></svg>`; // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ // STATE // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ let cardQueue = []; let activeDraws = 0; let drawCounter = 0; let revealedCardsByUser = {}; let collectionTimeout = null; // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ // STORAGE (Vercel KV via /api/collection) // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ // Returns a promise of the server's reply ({ owned, serial, uid, serialMult } for a pull), or null. // The serial number a card was given, as a pill on the card's top-left (the label pill sits on the right). Hidden when the season's // copies are not numbered yet, or the admin turned it off (Overlay Editor -> Pack opening -> Label). // ── Special moments (Overlay Editor -> Special moments) ── // One moment plays per pull and the highest wins: first-ever print, a viewer's first pull, a new card for them. // pickMoment mirrors lib/overlay-moments.ts (scripts/check-overlay.mts runs both). const MOMENT_IDS = ['firstEver', 'firstPull', 'newCard']; const MOMENT_DEFAULT_BG = ['#ffe27a', '#f1bb06', '#fff2b0', '#f1bb06']; /** Everything one moment's banner needs, read from the effective properties. */ /** A banner over the card, optional sparkles and sound, and a longer hold. One shared by every moment. */ // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ // ALERT BAR // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ // AUDIO // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ // BUILD MINI CARD LIST // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ // ── Image warming ───────────────────────────────────────── // Card art is a 600px animated WebP (1-4MB). Showing 25 of them at once in the collection grid makes // the browser source decode and animate all of them; the grid uses tiny static thumbnails instead, // preloaded + decoded once at startup so it appears instantly. Only the one revealed card is animated. const WARM_IMAGES = new Map(); // url -> Image, kept alive so the decoded bitmap stays cached // Grid options for the card list (both the "show collection" view and the strip under a revealed card). // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ // THEATER FACTORY. Each draw gets its own DOM clone // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ // LOOK (reveal styles + per-variant effects, driven by the overlay properties) // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ // Each reveal style = which keyframes drive the pack / tear strip / card, and when (seconds at 1× speed) the card is // revealed (sound, light burst, pop), its info appears, and its label appears. Classic is the original animation. const REVEALS = { classic: { pack: ['fadeScaleIn', 4.5, 'ease'], tear: ['tearBorderIn', 4.5, 'ease'], card: ['cardBoxIn', 7.5, 'ease'], reveal: 2.8, info: 3.0, label: 3.2, sounds: true }, simple: { pack: null, tear: null, card: ['revealZoom', 0.7, 'cubic-bezier(.2,1.4,.4,1)'], reveal: 0.3, info: 0.7, label: 0.9, sounds: false }, slide: { pack: null, tear: null, card: ['revealSlide', 0.8, 'cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.15)'], reveal: 0.3, info: 0.7, label: 0.9, sounds: false }, flip: { pack: null, tear: null, card: ['revealFlip', 1.9, 'ease'], back: true, reveal: 1.3, info: 1.6, label: 1.8, sounds: false }, 'rip-shake': { pack: ['ripShakePack', 3.2, 'linear'], tear: ['ripTearFly', 3.2, 'ease'], card: ['ripCardBurst', 3.2, 'ease'], reveal: 1.9, info: 2.1, label: 2.3, sounds: true }, 'rip-peel': { pack: ['ripPeelPack', 4, 'ease'], tear: ['ripPeelTear', 4, 'ease'], card: ['ripPeelCard', 4, 'ease'], reveal: 2.8, info: 3.0, label: 3.2, sounds: true }, 'rip-slice': { pack: ['ripSlicePack', 3.6, 'ease'], tear: ['ripSliceTear', 3.6, 'ease'], card: ['ripSliceCard', 3.6, 'ease'], reveal: 2.4, info: 2.6, label: 2.8, sounds: true }, 'rip-explode': { pack: ['ripExplodePack', 3.2, 'ease'], tear: ['ripExplodeTear', 3.2, 'ease'], card: ['ripExplodeCard', 3.2, 'ease'], reveal: 1.9, info: 2.1, label: 2.3, sounds: true }, drop: { pack: null, tear: null, card: ['revealDrop', 1.2, 'ease'], reveal: 0.6, info: 1.0, label: 1.2, sounds: false }, spin: { pack: null, tear: null, card: ['revealSpin', 1.5, 'ease'], reveal: 1.0, info: 1.3, label: 1.5, sounds: false }, impact: { pack: null, tear: null, card: ['revealImpact', 1.0, 'cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)'], reveal: 0.4, info: 0.8, label: 1.0, sounds: false }, deal: { pack: null, tear: null, card: ['revealDeal', 1.1, 'ease-out'], reveal: 0.7, info: 1.0, label: 1.1, sounds: false }, }; // The light burst behind a revealed card is per variant (see the Variants editor). // Rebuilds the rays (the template ships eight) and sets their spacing and the burst's size. // Show off (Overlay Editor -> Show off): the show-off settings folded into the properties the shared drawing code already reads, // so the card, effects and print pill need no show-off branches of their own. At the defaults nothing changes. // The label pill's own wording is set by the caller; this applies its on/off, colours, size and nudge. // The card's steady-state effects as one animation list: pop on reveal, pulsing glow, gentle rock. `steady` (editor // still) skips the pop and starts the glow/rock immediately. // The 3D tilt runs on the card box (its own `rotate` property, so it doesn't fight the entrance transform). // Sets this card's per-variant look as CSS variables on the theater, plus its label. // A burst of sparkles flying out from the middle of the revealed card (per-version, experimental). // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ /

nodes.name: applyLayout
nodes.body_text: function applyLayout(layout) { if (layout) { const n = (v, d) => (typeof v === 'number' && isFinite(v) ? v : d); STAGE = { width: Math.max(1, n(layout.width, STAGE.width)), height: Math.max(1, n(layout.height, STAGE.height)), }; // Accept the old single-placement shape too (a cached config from before the split). const legacy = { scale: layout.scale, offsetX: layout.offsetX, offsetY: layout.offsetY }; for (const mode of ['pack', 'collection']) { const p = layout[mode] || legacy; PLACEMENTS[mode] = { scale: Math.max(0.05, n(p.scale, PLACEMENTS[mode].scale)), offsetX: n(p.offsetX, PLACEMENTS[mode].offsetX), offsetY: n(p.offsetY, PLACEMENTS[mode].offsetY), }; } } const fit = Math.min(window.innerWidth / STAGE.width, window.innerHeight / STAGE.height); const root = document.documentElement.style; root.setProperty('--stage-w', STAGE.width + 'px'); root.setProperty('--stage-h', STAGE.height + 'px'); root.setProperty('--stage-scale', String(fit)); // Offsets are in design pixels and applied inside the scaled stage, so they scale with the fit automatically. root.setProperty('--pack-scale', String(PLACEMENTS.pack.scale)); root.setProperty('--pack-x', PLACEMENTS.pack.offsetX + 'px'); root.setProperty('--pack-y', PLACEMENTS.pack.offsetY + 'px'); root.setProperty('--col-scale', String(PLACEMENTS.collection.scale)); root.setProperty('--col-x', PLACEMENTS.collection.offsetX + 'px'); root.setProperty('--col-y', PLACEMENTS.collection.offsetY + 'px'); }

nodes.name: n
nodes.body_text: n = (v, d) => (typeof v === 'number' && isFinite(v) ? v : d)

nodes.name: effectiveProps
nodes.body_text: function effectiveProps(packId) { const out = Object.assign({}, PROP_DEFAULTS); if (PREVIEW_PROPS) return Object.assign(out, PREVIEW_PROPS); Object.assign(out, PROPS_GLOBAL); if (packId && PACK_OVERRIDES[packId]) Object.assign(out, PACK_OVERRIDES[packId]); return out; }

nodes.name: pv
nodes.body_text: pv = (P, key, fallback) => (P[key] !== undefined ? P[key] : fallback)

nodes.name: loadLayout
nodes.body_text: async function loadLayout() { try { // ?preset=<id> in the browser source's URL picks a scene: its own layout and values (see lib/overlay-settings.ts). const scene = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('preset'); const res = await fetch('/api/overlay/config' + (scene ? '?preset=' + encodeURIComponent(scene) : ''), { cache: 'no-store' }); if (res.ok) { const cfg = await res.json(); applyLayout(cfg.layout); PROP_DEFAULTS = cfg.defaults || {}; PROPS_GLOBAL = cfg.props || {}; PACK_OVERRIDES = cfg.packOverrides || {}; } } catch { /* keep the defaults */ } }

nodes.name: applyDraft
nodes.body_text: function applyDraft(d) { const chosen = PACKS.find(p => p.pack.id === d.packId); if (!chosen) return; if (d.pack && typeof d.pack === 'object') for (const k of DRAFT_PACK_FIELDS) if (k in d.pack) chosen.pack[k] = d.pack[k]; const c = d.card && typeof d.card === 'object' ? chosen.cards.find(x => x.number === d.card.number) : null; if (c) for (const k of DRAFT_CARD_FIELDS) if (k in d.card) c[k] = d.card[k]; }

nodes.name: clearStatic
nodes.body_text: function clearStatic() { document.querySelectorAll('.static-preview').forEach(el => el.remove()); }

nodes.name: showStatic
nodes.body_text: function showStatic(mode) { if (!PREVIEW) return; if (mode) previewMode = mode; clearStatic(); if (PACKS.length === 0) return; const chosen = PACKS.find(p => p.pack.id === previewPackId) || PACKS[0]; const cfg = packConfig(chosen.pack); const P = effectiveProps(previewMode === 'pack' ? chosen.pack.id : null); const theater = createTheater(cfg); const { wrapper, packageContainer, cardBox, cardLabel, mainCard, holoOverlay, cardInfoOverlay, radialContainer, cardInfo, userText, miniList } = theater; wrapper.classList.add('static-preview'); wrapper.style.visibility = 'visible'; // Elements the editor can jump to when clicked (see the click handler below). const editable = (el, target, tip) => { if (el) { el.dataset.edit = target; el.title = tip; } }; editable(mainCard, 'card', 'Click to edit this card variant'); editable(cardLabel, 'label', 'Click to edit the label'); editable(cardInfoOverlay, 'bar', 'Click to edit the name and stars bar'); packageContainer.style.opacity = '0'; if (previewMode === 'pack') { // The settled moment of a pack opening: the revealed card, its label and the collection strip beneath it. const variant = PREVIEW_VARIANT || 'regular'; const PS = previewShowOff ? nodes.name: encodeEntry

nodes.name: decodeEntry
nodes.body_text: function decodeEntry(entry) { const idx = Math.min(Math.floor(entry / VARIANT_OFFSET), VARIANTS.length - 1); return { cardNumber: entry - idx * VARIANT_OFFSET, variant: VARIANTS[idx] }; }

nodes.name: rollVariant
nodes.body_text: function rollVariant(weights, off) { const w = Object.assign({}, DEFAULT_VARIANT_WEIGHTS, weights); const weight = v => (v !== 'regular' && off && off.indexOf(v) !== -1 ? 0 : Math.max(0, w[v])); const total = VARIANTS.reduce((s, v) => s + weight(v), 0); if (total <= 0) return 'regular'; let r = Math.random() * total; for (const v of VARIANTS) { r -= weight(v); if (r < 0) return v; } return 'regular'; }

nodes.name: packConfig

nodes.name: initSeason
nodes.body_text: async function initSeason() { try { const res = await fetch('/api/seasons/active'); if (!res.ok) return; const { season, packs } = await res.json(); SEASON_CFG = { maxConcurrentPacks: season.maxConcurrentPacks ?? 1, collectionName: season.collectionName ?? '', }; PACKS = (packs ?? []).map(({ pack, cards }) => ({ pack, cards: (cards ?? []).map(c => ({ number: c.number, name: c.name, image: c.imageUrl, // full animated art (only the revealed card uses this) thumb: c.thumbUrl || c.imageUrl, // static first frame, for the collection grid soundUrl: c.soundUrl || null, probability: c.probability, stars: c.stars, upgradesEnabled: c.upgradesEnabled !== false, disabledVariants: c.disabledVariants || [], fullArt: c.fullArtImageUrl || null, fullArtThumb: c.fullArtThumbUrl || c.fullArtImageUrl || null, })), })); // Deduplicate by card number for the mini collection list const seen = new Set(); ALL_CARDS = []; for (const { cards } of PACKS) { for (const c of cards) { if (!seen.has(c.number)) { seen.add(c.number); ALL_CARDS.push(c); } } } ALL_CARDS.sort((a, b) => a.number - b.number); preloadThumbs(); } catch { // fall back to defaults if API unreachable } }

nodes.name: pickPackAndCard
nodes.body_text: function pickPackAndCard(opts) { opts = opts || {}; if (PACKS.length === 0) return null; let chosen = null; if (opts.packId) chosen = PACKS.find(p => p.pack.id === opts.packId) || null; // A pinned card with no pinned pack: use the first pack that has it. if (!chosen && opts.cardNumber != null) chosen = PACKS.find(p => p.cards.some(c => c.number === opts.cardNumber)) || null; if (!chosen) { // Weighted pack selection const totalWeight = PACKS.reduce((s, { pack }) => s + (pack.weight || 1), 0); let rw = Math.random() * totalWeight; chosen = PACKS[PACKS.length - 1]; for (const p of PACKS) { rw -= (p.pack.weight || 1); if (rw <= 0) { chosen = p; break; } } } // Weighted card selection within the chosen pack if (chosen.cards.length === 0) return null; let card = opts.cardNumber != null ? chosen.cards.find(c => c.number === opts.cardNumber) : null; if (!card) { const totalProb = chosen.cards.reduce((s, c) => s + c.probability, 0); let rp = Math.random() * totalProb; card = chosen.cards[chosen.cards.length - 1]; for (const c of chosen.cards) { rp -= c.probability; if (rp <= 0) { card = c; break; } } } // Variant is rolled after the card, and only where the pack and card both have upgrades on. // A pinned variant (test panel) is used as-is, even where upgrades are off, so effects can be previewed. let variant = 'regular'; if (opts.variant && VARIANTS.indexOf(opts.variant) !== -1) variant = opts.variant; else if (chosen.pack.upgradesEnabled && card.upgradesEnabled) variant = rollVariant(chosen.pack.variantWeights, (chosen.pack.disabledVariants || []).concat(card.disabledVariants || [])); return { card, variant, cfg: packConfig(chosen.pack), packName: chosen.pack.name, packId: chosen.pack.id }; }

nodes.name: loadCollection
nodes.body_text: async function loadCollection() { if (!SEASON_CFG.collectionName) return; try { const res = await fetch(`/api/collection?name=${SEASON_CFG.collectionName}`); revealedCardsByUser = res.ok ? await res.json() : {}; } catch { revealedCardsByUser = {}; } }

nodes.name: saveCollection
nodes.body_text: function saveCollection(pull) { if (PREVIEW || !SEASON_CFG.collectionName) return Promise.resolve(null); const body = { data: revealedCardsByUser }; if (pull) body.pull = pull; return fetch(`/api/collection?name=${SEASON_CFG.collectionName}`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body), }) .then(res => (res.ok ? res.json() : null)) // The server appended the pull to the real collection (which may have changed since the overlay // loaded it, e.g. a viewer upgraded a card); take its copy for this user. .then(r => { if (pull && r && Array.isArray(r.owned)) revealedCardsByUser[pull.username] = r.owned; return r; }) .catch(() => null); }

nodes.name: showSerial

' bonus' : '') + (info.n === 1 ? ' first' : ''); const num = document.createElement('span'); num.className = 'serial-num'; // Edition (#7, the default), the print number (#1023381) or both (the edition pill with a small "Print #..." line under it). // Without a print number (older server, untracked ledger) the edition is shown whatever the format says. const fmt = info.uid ? nodes.body_text: function mainCardAnimation(P, variant, speed, revealAt, steady) { // Returns { anim, start }: the card's own animation list, and when (seconds) glow / rock / tilt should begin. const g = (s, d) => pv(P, 'variant.' + variant + '.' + s, d); const parts = []; let t = revealAt; if (g('pop', false) && !steady) { const sc = g('popScale', 1.12), extra = Math.max(0, sc - 1.12) * 2; const dur = 0.7 + extra; parts.push('variantPop ' + (dur / speed) + 's cubic-bezier(.2,' + (1.6 + extra).toFixed(2) + ',.4,1) ' + (revealAt / speed) + 's both'); t = revealAt + dur; } const start = steady ? 0 : t / speed; if (g('rock', false)) parts.push('variantRock ' + (g('rockSpeed', 3.6) / speed) + 's ease-in-out ' + start + 's infinite'); return { anim: parts.join(', ') || 'none', start }; }

nodes.name: showCollection
nodes.body_text: function showCollection(username, opts) { opts = opts || {}; const user = (username || 'someone').toLowerCase().trim(); if (!Array.isArray(revealedCardsByUser[user])) revealedCardsByUser[user] = []; const P = effectiveProps(null); const cfg = packConfig(PACKS[0]?.pack); const theater = createTheater(cfg); const { wrapper, packageContainer, cardBox, radialContainer, cardInfo, userText, miniList } = theater; packageContainer.style.display = 'none'; cardBox.style.display = 'none'; radialContainer.style.display = 'none'; // Fade in: commit the transparent start state, then release it so the transition runs. wrapper.classList.add('fade-in', 'fade-in-start', 'is-collection', 'appear-' + pv(P, 'collection.appear', 'fade')); wrapper.style.visibility = 'visible'; void wrapper.offsetWidth; wrapper.classList.remove('fade-in-start'); cardInfo.style.opacity = '1'; cardInfo.style.transform = 'scale(1)'; userText.textContent = headingText(P, username); if (!pv(P, 'collection.showHeading', true)) userText.style.display = 'none'; if (!PREVIEW && !opts.dry) fetch('/api/webhooks/notify', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ event: 'collectionShown', username: user }), }).catch(() => {}); const listOptions = listOpts(P, false); if (listOptions.perRow > 0) wrapper.style.maxWidth = 'none'; buildMiniList(miniList, revealedCardsByUser[user], null, cfg, listOptions); if (collectionTimeout) clearTimeout(collectionTimeout); collectionTimeout = setTimeout(() => { wrapper.classList.remove('fade-in'); // fade-out keeps the shorter default timing wrapper.classList.add('hid'); setTimeout(() => { wrapper.remove(); activeDraws--; processCardQueue(); }, 500); }, pv(P, 'collection.hold', 4) * 1000); }

' (variants)' : ''))); function fillCards() { const keep = cardSel.value; cardSel.innerHTML = ''; addOption(cardSel, '', 'Random card'); const source = packSel.value ? nodes.body_text: function warnKey() { if (Date.now() - keyWarnedAt < 60000) return; keyWarnedAt = Date.now(); showAlert('Overlay key missing or changed: copy the new URL from Settings > OBS Overlay'); }

nodes.name: pollWebhookQueue
nodes.body_text: async function pollWebhookQueue() { try { const res = await fetch('/api/webhooks/queue'); if (res.status === 401) { warnKey(); return; } if (!res.ok) return; const event = await res.json(); if (!event) return; if (event.type === 'pull') queueDraw(event.username, event.draw ? { packId: event.draw.packId, cardNumber: event.draw.cardNumber, variant: event.draw.variant, ticket: event.id } : undefined); else if (event.type === 'collection') queueCollection(event.username); else if (event.type === 'card' && event.cardNumber != null) queueShowCard(event.username, event); } catch { // ignore, overlay keeps working if server is unreachable } }

nodes.name: readObsStatus
nodes.body_text: function readObsStatus() { return new Promise(resolve => { if (!window.obsstudio || typeof window.obsstudio.getStatus !== 'function') return resolve(null); // Without the permission the callback may never fire, so don't wait forever. const timer = setTimeout(() => resolve(null), 1500); try { window.obsstudio.getStatus(status => { clearTimeout(timer); resolve(status ? { streaming: !!status.streaming, recording: !!status.recording } : null); }); } catch { clearTimeout(timer); resolve(null); } }); }

nodes.name: sendHeartbeat
nodes.body_text: async function sendHeartbeat() { const obs = await readObsStatus(); fetch('/api/overlay/heartbeat', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, keepalive: true, body: JSON.stringify({ id: OVERLAY_ID, streaming: obs ? obs.streaming : null, recording: obs ? obs.recording : null, obs: !!window.obsstudio || /OBS\//i.test(navigator.userAgent), dev: new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).has('dev'), }), }).then(r => (r.ok ? r.json() : null)).then(j => checkReload(j && j.reload)).catch(() => {}); // never let a failed ping affect the overlay }

nodes.name: checkReload
nodes.body_text: function checkReload(token) { if (typeof token !== 'number') return; if (reloadBaseline === undefined) { reloadBaseline = token; return; } if (token !== reloadBaseline && activeDraws === 0 && cardQueue.length === 0) window.location.reload(); }

nodes.name: startHeartbeat
nodes.body_text: function startHeartbeat() { sendHeartbeat(); setInterval(sendHeartbeat, 10000); // OBS fires these when the stream/recording starts or stops, report the change straight away. ['obsStreamingStarted', 'obsStreamingStopped', 'obsRecordingStarted', 'obsRecordingStopped'] .forEach(name => window.addEventListener(name, sendHeartbeat)); }

nodes.name: build-changelog.mjs
nodes.body_text: // Writes .next-changelog.json (gitignored) from the merged PRs into main, before `next build` (ROADMAP 21.1). Never fails a build: // no token, no network or an API error writes [] and prints a warning. `--ensure` only creates the empty file when it is missing // (no network), so typecheck and the checks work on a fresh clone. // Env: GITHUB_CHANGELOG_TOKEN (fine-grained, this repo, Pull requests: read), VERCEL_GIT_REPO_OWNER / VERCEL_GIT_REPO_SLUG // (falling back to the git remote), CHANGELOG_SINCE (YYYY-MM-DD, default: the day this shipped). import { existsSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'; import { execSync } from 'node:child_process'; import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'; import { buildEntries } from './changelog-parse.mjs'; const OUT = fileURLToPath(new URL('../.next-changelog.json', import.meta.url)); const SINCE_DEFAULT = '2026-10-17'; const MAX_PAGES = 10; main().catch(err => { try { write([]); } catch { /* nothing more to do */ } warn(`could not read pull requests (${err?.message ?? err}): the generated changelog is empty.`); });

nodes.name: write
nodes.body_text: write = entries => writeFileSync(OUT, JSON.stringify(entries, null, 2) + '\n')

nodes.name: warn
nodes.body_text: warn = msg => console.warn(`[changelog] ${msg}`)

nodes.name: repoFromGit
nodes.body_text: function repoFromGit() { try { const url = execSync('git remote get-url origin', { stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'ignore'] }).toString().trim(); const m = /github\.com[:/]([^/]+)\/([^/]+?)(?:\.git)?$/.exec(url); return m ? { owner: m[1], repo: m[2] } : null; } catch { return null; } }

nodes.name: main
nodes.body_text: async function main() { if (process.argv.includes('--ensure')) { if (!existsSync(OUT)) write([]); return; } const token = (process.env.GITHUB_CHANGELOG_TOKEN ?? '').trim(); if (!token) { write([]); warn('GITHUB_CHANGELOG_TOKEN is not set: the generated changelog is empty (the hand-written entries still show).'); return; } const git = repoFromGit(); const owner = process.env.VERCEL_GIT_REPO_OWNER || git?.owner; const repo = process.env.VERCEL_GIT_REPO_SLUG || git?.repo; if (!owner || !repo) { write([]); warn('Could not tell which repository to read: the generated changelog is empty.'); return; } const since = process.env.CHANGELOG_SINCE || SINCE_DEFAULT; const prs = []; for (let page = 1; page <= MAX_PAGES; page++) { const url = `https://api.github.com/repos/${owner}/${repo}/pulls?state=closed&base=main&sort=updated&direction=desc&per_page=100&page=${page}`; const res = await fetch(url, { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`, Accept: 'application/vnd.github+json', 'X-GitHub-Api-Version': '2022-11-28', 'User-Agent': 'tcg-changelog' }, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(20000), }); if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`GitHub answered ${res.status}`); const batch = await res.json(); if (!Array.isArray(batch)) throw new Error('unexpected GitHub answer'); prs.push(...batch); // Sorted by last update: once a whole page was last touched before the cutoff, nothing merged since is further down. if (batch.length < 100 || batch.every(p => String(p.updated_at ?? '').slice(0, 10) < since)) break; } const { entries, problems } = buildEntries(prs, since); for (const p of problems) warn(p); write(entries); console.log(`[changelog] ${entries.length} entr${entries.length === 1 ? 'y' : 'ies'} from ${owner}/${repo} since ${since}.`); }

nodes.name: build-twitch-package.mjs
nodes.body_text: // Builds the Twitch extension's version assets zip (the file uploaded under the version's Asset Hosting) into twitch-extension/dist/. // Usage: node scripts/build-twitch-package.mjs [--site https://cheesytcg.app] (the site address defaults to $SITE_URL, then cheesytcg.app) import { mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'; import { buildPackage, packageVersion } from './lib/twitch-package.mjs'; const site = (arg('--site') ?? process.env.SITE_URL ?? 'https://cheesytcg.app').replace(/\/$/, ''); if (!/^https:\/\/[^/]+$/.test(site)) { console.error(`The site address must be an https origin with no path, got "${site}".`); process.exit(1); } const { files, zip } = buildPackage(site); const out = `twitch-extension/dist/cheesy-tcg-panel-v${packageVersion()}.zip`; mkdirSync('twitch-extension/dist', { recursive: true }); writeFileSync(out, zip); console.log(`Wrote ${out} (${(zip.length / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB, ${files.length} files) for ${site}`); for (const f of files) console.log(' ' + f.name.padEnd(22) + (f.data.length / 1024).toFixed(1).padStart(7) + ' KB');

nodes.name: arg
nodes.body_text: arg = (name) => { const i = process.argv.indexOf(name); return i >= 0 ? process.argv[i + 1] : undefined; }

nodes.name: changelog-parse.mjs
nodes.body_text: // Turns merged pull requests into changelog entries. Pure (no network, no fs): used by scripts/build-changelog.mjs at build time and // tested by scripts/check-changelog.mts. ROADMAP 21.1. // // Only a PR's "## Changelog" section is ever read, never commit messages. The section ends at the next heading, a horizontal rule or the // first line that starts with the robot emoji or "Generated with". Anything that names the tools or authors behind a change is dropped. // Only the section's bulleted list is used (prose around it never ships), "none" on its first line skips the PR, markdown is turned into // plain text, and planning PRs (titles starting "ROADMAP") are skipped. export const MAX_ITEM_LENGTH = 500; const EM_DASH = String.fromCharCode(8212); const ROBOT = String.fromCodePoint(0x1f916); /** Lines and titles matching this never reach the changelog (the owner's rule: no tool or author credits). */ export const BANNED = /claude|anthropic|co-authored-by|generated with/i; const TAGS = ['new', 'improved', 'fixed']; /** The lines of the Changelog section of a PR body, or null when there is none. */ /** { title?, items } from a PR's Changelog section; null when it is missing, "none" or empty once cleaned. */ /** * Who a PR's changelog is for, from its "Audience:" line: players (the public What's new page, the default), staff (the admin and mod * What's new page only) or both. "public" / "everyone" and "admin" / "mod" / "mods" / "admins" are accepted too. */ /** Markdown a player would see as symbols: bold / italic markers, inline code and links (keeps the link text). */ /** Planning PRs (titles starting "ROADMAP") never reach the public changelog. */ /** The PR title without a trailing "(ROADMAP x.y)", "(Track x.y)" or "(x.y)" tag. */ /** One changelog entry from a GitHub pull request object, or null when it has none to show. */ /** Why an entry may not ship, or null when it is fine. */ /** Entries from a list of PRs: valid ones only, newest first (same day: higher PR number first). `problems` lists the dropped ones. */

nodes.name: changelogSection
nodes.body_text: function changelogSection(body) { const lines = String(body ?? '').replace(/<!--[\s\S]*?-->/g, '').split(/\r?\n/); const start = lines.findIndex(l => /^#{1,6}\s+changelog\s*$/i.test(l.trim())); if (start < 0) return null; const out = []; for (let i = start + 1; i < lines.length; i++) { const t = lines[i].trim(); if (/^#{1,6}\s/.test(t) || /^([-*_])(\s*\1){2,}$/.test(t)) break; if (t.startsWith(ROBOT) || /^generated with/i.test(t)) break; out.push(lines[i]); } return out; }

nodes.name: parseChangelogBody
nodes.body_text: function parseChangelogBody(body) { const section = changelogSection(body); if (!section) return null; const nonBlank = section.map(l => l.trimEnd()).filter(l => l.trim() !== ''); if (nonBlank.length === 0) return null; // "none", "None.", "None (staff-only change)." on the first line leaves the PR out, whatever follows it. if (/^[-*]?\s*none\b/i.test(nonBlank[0].trim())) return null; // Only the bulleted list counts: prose before it is skipped, and the first plain line after it ends the section, so a PR's own // description can never leak onto the public page. let title; let audience = 'players'; const tags = []; const items = []; let last = -1; for (const raw of nonBlank) { const line = raw.trim(); const titleMatch = /^title:\s*(.+)$/i.exec(line); if (titleMatch && items.length === 0 && title === undefined) { title = titleMatch[1].trim(); last = -1; continue; } const audienceMatch = /^audience:\s*(.+)$/i.exec(line); if (audienceMatch && items.length === 0) { audience = parseAudience(audienceMatch[1]); last = -1; continue; } const tagsMatch = /^tags?:\s*(.+)$/i.exec(line); if (tagsMatch && items.length === 0) { for (const t of tagsMatch[1].toLowerCase().split(/[\s,]+/)) if (TAGS.includes(t) && !tags.includes(t)) tags.push(t); last = -1; continue; } const bullet = /^([-*+]|\d+[.)])\s+(.*)$/.exec(line); if (bullet) { items.push(bullet[2].trim()); last = items.length - 1; continue; } if (/^\s/.test(raw) && last >= 0) { items[last] += ' ' + line; continue; } if (items.length > 0) break; } const clean = items .map(i => plainText(i).trim()) .filter(i => /[a-z0-9]/i.test(i) && !BANNED.test(i) && !/^none\.?$/i.test(i)) .map(i => (i.length > MAX_ITEM_LENGTH ? i.slice(0, MAX_ITEM_LENGTH - 3).trimEnd() + '...' : i)); if (clean.length === 0) return null; const t = title ? plainText(title).trim() : ''; return { title: t && !BANNED.test(t) ? t : undefined, tags, audience, items: clean }; }

nodes.name: parseAudience
nodes.body_text: function parseAudience(v) { const words = String(v ?? '').toLowerCase().split(/[\s,/+&]+|\band\b/).filter(Boolean); const players = words.some(w => ['players', 'player', 'public', 'viewers', 'everyone', 'both', 'all'].includes(w)); const staff = words.some(w => ['staff', 'admin', 'admins', 'mod', 'mods', 'moderators', 'both', 'all', 'everyone'].includes(w)); return players && staff ? 'both' : staff ? 'staff' : 'players'; }

nodes.name: isRoadmapPr
nodes.body_text: isRoadmapPr = (title) => /^\s*roadmap\b/i.test(String(title ?? ''))

nodes.name: cleanPrTitle
nodes.body_text: function cleanPrTitle(title) { return String(title ?? '').replace(/\s*\((?:(?:ROADMAP|Track)\b[^)]*|\d+\.\d+\w*)\)\s*$/i, '').trim(); }

nodes.name: entryFromPr
nodes.body_text: function entryFromPr(pr) { if (!pr || !pr.merged_at || isRoadmapPr(pr.title)) return null; const parsed = parseChangelogBody(pr.body); if (!parsed) return null; const fromPr = cleanPrTitle(pr.title); const title = parsed.title || (BANNED.test(fromPr) ? '' : fromPr) || 'Update'; const labels = (pr.labels ?? []).map(l => String(typeof l === 'string' ? l : l?.name ?? '').toLowerCase()); // The pills: a "Tags: new, fixed" line in the section, or the PR's labels (either works; kept in the page's order). const tags = TAGS.filter(t => labels.includes(t) || parsed.tags.includes(t)); const entry = { date: String(pr.merged_at).slice(0, 10), title, items: parsed.items }; if (tags.length) entry.tags = tags; if (parsed.audience !== 'players') entry.audience = parsed.audience; entry.pr = pr.number; return entry; }

nodes.name: entryProblem
nodes.body_text: function entryProblem(e) { const text = [e.title, ...e.items].join('\n'); if (text.includes(EM_DASH)) return 'contains an em dash'; if (BANNED.test(text)) return 'mentions a tool or author'; return null; }

nodes.name: buildEntries
nodes.body_text: function buildEntries(prs, since = '') { const entries = []; const problems = []; for (const pr of prs) { const e = entryFromPr(pr); if (!e || e.date < since) continue; const why = entryProblem(e); if (why) { problems.push(`PR #${e.pr} "${e.title}" left out: ${why}`); continue; } entries.push(e); } entries.sort((a, b) => (a.date < b.date ? 1 : a.date > b.date ? -1 : b.pr - a.pr)); return { entries, problems }; }

nodes.name: check-access.mts
nodes.body_text: // Checks the closed alpha / beta gate (ROADMAP Track 16): canEnter, the signed access cookie, the middleware matcher's allow list, // the gate decision (every exempt path passes, the Twitch extension's API is untouched), the real middleware against the mock KV, the // testers list and the tester achievement. Needs the mock KV (node scripts/mock-kv.cjs). // Run: npx tsx scripts/check-access.mts process.env.KV_REST_API_URL ||= 'http://localhost:4111'; process.env.KV_REST_API_TOKEN ||= 'dev'; process.env.KV_URL ||= 'redis://dev'; process.env.SESSION_SECRET = 'a-test-secret-that-is-long-enough-123'; const core = await import('../lib/access-core'); const tok = await import('../lib/access-token'); const gate = await import('../lib/access-gate'); const edge = await import('../lib/access-edge'); const staffTok = await import('../lib/staff-token'); // ── canEnter ── const { canEnter } = core; ok(canEnter('open', null, false), 'open: a stranger'); ok(canEnter('beta', 'beta', false) && canEnter('beta', 'alpha', false) && !canEnter('beta', null, false), 'beta: both tiers, no strangers'); ok(canEnter('alpha', 'alpha', false) && !canEnter('alpha', 'beta', false) && !canEnter('alpha', null, false), 'alpha: alpha testers only'); ok(canEnter('alpha', null, true) && canEnter('beta', null, true), 'staff always'); ok(core.canEnterTier('alpha', 'staff') && !core.canEnterTier('alpha', 'beta') && core.canEnterTier('beta', 'beta'), 'canEnterTier splits staff from tiers'); ok(core.bestTier(true, 'beta') === 'staff' && core.bestTier(false, 'alpha') === 'alpha' && core.bestTier(false, null) === null, 'bestTier'); // ── settings and tester cleaning ── ok(JSON.stringify(core.normalizeAccess(null)) === JSON.stringify({ mode: 'open', label: 'none', v: 0 }), 'default is open, no label'); ok(core.normalizeAccess({ mode: 'bogus', label: 'x', v: -3 }).mode === 'open', 'unknown mode falls back to open'); ok(core.normalizeAccess({ mode: 'beta', label: 'beta', message: ' hi ', v: 4 }).message === 'hi', 'message trimmed'); ok(core.normalizeAccess({ message: 'x'.repeat(999) }).message!.length === core.MESSAGE_MAX, 'message capped'); ok(core.normalizeAccess(JSON.stringify({ mode: 'alpha', v: 2 })).mode === 'alpha', 'a stored JSON string is read'); ok(core.sanitizeTester({ login: 'Sam_1', tier: 'beta', addedBy: 'x', addedAt: 5 })?.login === 'sam_1', 'tester login lower-cased'); ok(core.sanitizeTester({ login: 'a', tier: 'beta' }) === null && core.sanitizeTester({ login: 'sam', tier: 'gold' }) === null, 'bad testers dropped'); // ── the signed cookie ── const t0 = Date.parse('2026-10-16T12:00:00Z'); const signed = (await tok.signAccessToken({ login: 'sam', tier: 'beta', v: 3 }, t0))!; ok(!!signed, 'signed'); const read = await tok.verifyAccessToken(signed, t0 + 1000); ok(read?.login === 'sam' && read.tier === 'beta' && read.v === 3, 'verifies'); ok((await tok.verifyAccessToken(signed, t0 + 61 * 60 * 1000)) === null, 'expires after the hour'); ok((await tok.verifyAccessToken(signed + 'x', t0)) === null && (await tok.verifyAccessToken('junk', t0)) === null && (await tok.verifyAccessToken(undefined, t0)) === null, 'tampered and junk are refused'); const [payload, sig] = signed.split('.'); const forged = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({ login: 'sam', tier: 'staff', v: 3, exp: Math.floor(t0 / 1000) + 3600 })).toString('base64url'); ok((await tok.verifyAccessToken(`${forged}.${sig}`, t0)) === null, 'a changed tier does not verify'); ok(payload.length > 0, 'payload present'); ok((await tok.signAccessToken({ login: 'sam', tier: 'beta', v: 3 }, t0, { SESSION_SECRET: 'short' })) === null, 'no secret, no cookie'); // A staff cookie (same secret) is never an access cookie. const staffCookie = (await staffTok.signStaffToken({ u: 'sam', id: '1', dn: 'Sam', role: 'mod' }, t0))!; ok((await tok.verifyAccessToken(staffCookie, t0)) === null, 'a staff cookie is not an access cookie'); // ── the allow list ── const EXEMPT = [ '/closed', '/login', '/auth/twitch', '/auth/access', '/auth/staff', '/auth/logout', '/auth/error', '/admin', '/admin/settings', '/mod', '/mod/users', '/privacy', '/terms', '/api/twitch/user', '/api/twitch/leaderboard', '/api/version', '/api/webhooks/pull', '/api/webhooks/queue', '/api/cron/backup', '/api/overlay/config', '/api/overlay/heartbeat', '/api/collection', '/api/seasons/active', '/api/auth/login', '/api/admin/activity', '/api/upload', '/api/account/deletion', '/api/account/export', '/overlay.html', '/widget.js', '/widget.css', '/sw.js', '/robots.txt', '/sitemap.xml', '/manifest.webmanifest', '/assets/sounds/1.mp3', '/brand/icon.png', '/icons/x.png', '/twitch-panel/panel.js', '/_next/static/x.js', '/apple-touch-icon.png', '/icon.png' ]; const GATED = [ '/', '/leaderboard', '/leaderboard/s1', '/cards', '/cards/12', '/collection', '/collection/sam', '/u/sam', '/account', '/settings', '/trade', '/trade/new', '/trade/abc', '/notifications', '/feedback', '/stats', '/changelog', '/install', '/p/x', '/c/1', '/copy/1', '/offline-not', '/api/trades', '/api/trades/holdings', '/api/trades/abc', '/api/account/settings', '/api/account/push', '/api/account/upgrade', '/api/notifications', '/api/feedback', '/api/search', '/api/live', '/api/recent-pulls', ]; for (const p of EXEMPT.filter(p => !/\.[a-z0-9]+$/i.test(p))) ok(core.isExemptPath(p), `exempt: ${p}`); for (const p of EXEMPT.filter(p => /\.[a-z0-9]+$/i.test(p))) ok(core.isExemptPath(p), `exempt (file): ${p}`); for (const p of GATED) ok(!core.isExemptPath(p), `gated: ${p}`); ok(!core.isExemptPath('/faq-not') && !core.isExemptPath('/privacyx') && !core.isExemptPath('/admins') && !core.isExemptPath('/closedx'), 'prefixes match whole segments only'); // ── the matcher: static files never reach the middleware; everything the gate must see does ── const mw = await import('../middleware'); const matcher = new RegExp('^' + mw.config.matcher[0] + '$'); for (const p of ['/overlay.html', '/widget.js', '/sw.js', '/robots.txt', '/_next/static/chunk.js', '/assets/sounds/1.mp3', '/brand/icon.png', '/twitch-panel/panel.html', '/icons/a.png']) ok(!matcher.test(p), `matcher skips static: ${p}`); for (const p of [...GATED.filter(p => p !== '/'), '/admin', '/admin/settings', '/mod', '/api/twitch/user', '/api/twitch/collection', '/api/version', '/closed', '/faq', '/auth/access', '/api/webhooks/pull']) ok(matcher.test(p), `matcher catches: ${p}`); ok(matcher.test('/'), 'matcher catches the home page'); // ── the gate decision ── const open = { mode: 'open' as const, label: 'none' as const, v: 1 }; const beta = { mode: 'beta' as const, label: 'beta' as const, v: 5 }; const alpha = { mode: 'alpha' as const, label: 'alpha' as const, v: 5 }; ok(d('/cards', open as never) === 'pass' && d('/api/trades', open as never) === 'pass', 'open: everything passes'); ok(d('/cards', null) === 'pass', 'a database error fails open'); for (const p of EXEMPT) ok(d(p, alpha) === 'pass', `alpha mode: exempt path passes (${p})`); ok(d('/cards', beta) === 'closed' && d('/cards', beta, { hasSession: true }) === 'refresh', 'beta: strangers to /closed, signed-in to /auth/access'); ok(d('/api/trades', beta) === 'forbidden' && d('/api/trades', beta, { hasSession: true }) === 'forbidden', 'beta: gated APIs answer 403'); ok(d('/cards', beta, { access: tokenOf('beta') }) === 'pass' && d('/cards', beta, { access: tokenOf('alpha') }) === 'pass', 'beta: both tiers pass'); ok(d('/cards', alpha, { access: tokenOf('beta'), hasSession: true }) === 'refresh', 'alpha: a beta tester is sent back to be checked'); ok(d('/cards', alpha, { access: tokenOf('alpha') }) === 'pass' && d('/cards', alpha, { access: tokenOf('staff') }) === 'pass', 'alpha: alpha and staff pass'); ok(d('/cards', alpha, { access: tokenOf('alpha', 4), hasSession: true }) === 'refresh', 'an old settings version is re-checked'); ok(d('/cards', alpha, { access: tokenOf('alpha', 6) }) === 'pass', 'a newer cookie than our copy passes'); ok(d('/cards', alpha, { staffCookie: true }) === 'pass', 'a staff cookie passes'); // ── the real middleware against the mock KV ── const { NextRequest } = await import('next/server'); const kvUrl = process.env.KV_REST_API_URL!; await setSettings({ mode: 'open', label: 'none', v: 1 }); ok((await run('/cards')).status === 200, 'middleware: open passes a page'); await setSettings({ mode: 'beta', label: 'beta', v: 5 }); let r = await run('/cards'); ok(r.status === 307 && location(r).endsWith('/closed'), 'middleware: a stranger goes to /closed'); r = await run('/cards?x=1', 'tcg_session=anything'); ok(r.status === 307 && location(r).includes('/auth/access?returnTo=' + encodeURIComponent('/cards?x=1')), 'middleware: a signed-in viewer goes to /auth/access'); r = await run('/api/trades'); ok(r.status === 403 && (await r.json()).error === 'closed', 'middleware: a gated API answers 403 closed'); r = await run('/privacy'); ok(r.status === 200 && r.headers.get('x-middleware-request-x-tcg-path') === '/privacy', 'middleware: /privacy passes and carries its path for the layouts'); r = await run('/faq'); ok(r.status === 307 && location(r).endsWith('/closed'), 'middleware: the FAQ is closed to strangers too'); ok(!core.isExemptPath('/faq'), 'the FAQ is not on the allow list'); const good = await tok.signAccessToken({ login: 'sam', tier: 'beta', v: 5 }); r = await run('/cards', `tcg_access=${good}`); ok(r.status === 200, 'middleware: a valid beta cookie passes in beta mode'); await setSettings({ mode: 'alpha', label: 'alpha', v: 6 }); r = await run('/cards', `tcg_access=${good}; tcg_session=s`); ok(r.status === 307 && location(r).includes('/auth/access'), 'middleware: the beta cookie no longer passes in alpha mode'); // The extension's API keeps exactly its CORS behaviour and is never gated. r = await run('/api/twitch/user', '', { origin: 'https://abc123.ext-twitch.tv' }); ok(r.status === 200 && r.headers.get('access-control-allow-origin') === 'https://abc123.ext-twitch.tv', 'middleware: /api/twitch keeps its CORS answer in alpha mode'); r = await mw.middleware(new NextRequest('http://localhost:3112/api/twitch/user', { method: 'OPTIONS', headers: { origin: 'https://abc123.ext-twitch.tv' } })); ok(r.status === 204, 'middleware: /api/twitch preflight unchanged'); r = await run('/api/twitch/user', '', { origin: 'https://evil.example' }); ok(r.status === 200 && !r.headers.get('access-control-allow-origin'), 'middleware: other origins still get no CORS header'); r = await run('/api/webhooks/pull'); ok(r.status === 200, 'middleware: webhooks pass in alpha mode'); // A stale cache: the cookie is newer than our remembered copy, so the settings are looked up again (no redirect loop). await setSettings({ mode: 'beta', label: 'beta', v: 7 }); await run('/privacy'); // our copy is now beta v7 await rawSet({ mode: 'alpha', label: 'alpha', v: 8 }); // changed behind our back const alphaCookie = await tok.signAccessToken({ login: 'sam', tier: 'alpha', v: 8 }); r = await run('/cards', `tcg_access=${alphaCookie}`); ok(r.status === 200, 'middleware: a newer cookie makes it refresh the remembered settings'); await setSettings({ mode: 'open', label: 'none', v: 9 }); // ── the testers list and the achievement ── const acc = await import('../lib/access'); ok((await acc.getAccessSettings()).mode === 'open', 'settings read back'); let res = await acc.saveAccessSettings('josh', { mode: 'beta', label: 'beta', message: 'Welcome testers' }); const saved = await acc.getAccessSettings(); ok(res.ok && saved.mode === 'beta' && saved.v === 10 && saved.message === 'Welcome testers', 'saving raises v by one'); res = await acc.saveAccessSettings('josh', { mode: 'open', label: 'none' }); ok((await acc.getAccessSettings()).v === 11, 'every save raises v'); ok((await acc.getAccessLog()).length >= 2, 'changes are logged'); ok(!(await acc.setTester('josh', 'x', 'beta')).ok, 'short login refused'); ok(!(await acc.setTester('josh', 'sam_t', 'gold')).ok, 'bad tier refused'); ok((await acc.setTester('josh', '@Sam_T', 'beta', 'friend')).ok, 'add a beta tester'); ok((await acc.getTester('sam_t'))?.tier === 'beta' && (await acc.getTester('SAM_T'))?.note === 'friend', 'stored and read case-insensitively'); const { kv } = await import('../lib/db'); ok(!!(await kv.hget(achKey('sam_t'), 'special:beta-tester')), 'the beta achievement is written'); ok((await acc.setTester('josh', 'sam_t', 'alpha')).ok, 'move to alpha'); ok(!!(await kv.hget(achKey('sam_t'), 'special:alpha-tester')) && !!(await kv.hget(achKey('sam_t'), 'special:beta-tester')), 'both achievements kept after moving up'); ok((await acc.getTester('sam_t'))?.addedBy === 'josh', 'addedBy kept'); ok((await acc.tierFor({ username: 'sam_t', twitchId: '5' })) === 'alpha', 'tierFor: a tester'); ok((await acc.tierFor({ username: 'nobody1', twitchId: '6' })) === null, 'tierFor: a stranger'); ok((await acc.tierFor({ username: 'sam_t', twitchId: '5', sandbox: 'x' })) === null, 'tierFor: a sandbox login is nobody'); ok((await acc.tierFor({ username: 'joshmiles', twitchId: '36094918' })) === 'staff', 'tierFor: staff (the super admin)'); ok((await acc.listTesters()).length === 1, 'listed'); const { syncAchievements } = await import('../lib/achievements-store'); const view = await syncAchievements('sam_t'); ok(view.earned.length === 2 && view.earned.every(a => a.seasonId === 'special'), 'syncAchievements keeps the stored special entries'); ok(view.earned[0].seasonName === 'Special', 'listed with the Special season name'); ok((await acc.removeTester('josh', 'sam_t')).ok && !(await acc.getTester('sam_t')), 'removed'); ok(!!(await kv.hget(achKey('sam_t'), 'special:alpha-tester')), 'the achievement outlives the removal'); ok(!(await acc.removeTester('josh', 'sam_t')).ok, 'removing twice is refused'); await acc.setTester('josh', 'gone_user', 'beta'); await acc.deleteTesterRecord('gone_user'); ok(!(await acc.getTester('gone_user')), 'deleteTesterRecord (account deletion)'); // ── SEO ── const seo = await import('../lib/seo'); const closedMap = seo.buildSitemap('https://x.test', [{ id: 's1' }], new Date(0), true).map(e => e.url); ok(closedMap.length === 2 && closedMap.every(u => /\/(privacy|terms)$/.test(u)), 'closed sitemap lists only privacy and terms'); ok(seo.buildSitemap('https://x.test', [{ id: 's1' }]).length > 3, 'open sitemap unchanged'); console.log('check-access: all passed'); process.exit(0);

nodes.name: check-account-deletion.mts
nodes.body_text: // Checks the account deletion request (ROADMAP 11.3): one open request per viewer, cancelling, declining with a notice, and the // deletion itself removing every key it should (escrowed prints are returned first, a restore point is taken, open offers cancelled, // settings, notices, other feedback; the deletion record stays). Runs inside a sandbox on the mock KV; refuses anything non-local. // Run: npx tsx scripts/check-account-deletion.mts const url = process.env.KV_REST_API_URL ?? 'http://localhost:4111'; if (!/^http:\/\/(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)[:/]/.test(url)) throw new Error(`Refusing to run against non-local KV: ${url}`); process.env.KV_REST_API_URL = url; process.env.KV_REST_API_TOKEN ??= 'dev'; process.env.KV_URL ??= 'redis://dev'; const kvLib = await import('../lib/kv'); const sbx = await import('../lib/sandbox'); const trades = await import('../lib/trades'); const F = await import('../lib/feedback'); const C = await import('../lib/feedback-core'); const D = await import('../lib/account-deletion'); const admin = await import('../lib/user-admin'); const { runInSandbox, kv } = await import('../lib/db'); const { notify, listNotices } = await import('../lib/trade-notify'); const { saveUserSettings, getUserSettings } = await import('../lib/user-settings-store'); const { encodeEntry } = await import('../lib/variants'); // The words a decline sends, and a finished deletion saying nothing. ok(/could not delete/.test(C.noticeText({ kind: 'deletion', title: 'Delete my account', status: 'wontfix', reply: 'Open dispute' }, { status: true, reply: true }) ?? ''), 'a decline tells the sender and gives the reason'); eq(C.noticeText({ kind: 'deletion', title: 'Delete my account', status: 'done' }, { status: true, reply: false }), null, 'a finished deletion has no one to tell'); ok(C.DELETION_OVERDUE_DAYS === 30, 'a request is overdue after a month'); await kvLib.seedSeason1(); const box = await sbx.createSandbox({ name: 'Deletion check', source: 'config' }); await runInSandbox(box.id, async () => { const season = (await kvLib.listSeasons())[0]; const coll = season.collectionName; await kvLib.saveCollection(coll, { alice: [E(1), E(1), E(2)], bob: [E(3), E(4)] }); await trades.saveTradeSettings({ enabled: true, expiryHours: 48, maxOpenPerUser: 5, cooldownSeconds: 0, maxStacksPerSide: 8 }); await kvLib.saveUserProfile({ username: 'alice', displayName: 'Alice', createdAt: 1 }); await saveUserSettings('alice', { bio: 'hello', wanted: [3] }); await notify('alice', { kind: 'admin', text: 'hi' }); const open = await trades.createTrade({ seasonId: season.id, from: 'alice', kind: 'listing', give: [{ cardNumber: 1, variant: 'regular', count: 1 }], get: [{ cardNumber: 3, variant: 'regular', count: 1 }] }); ok(open.ok, 'alice has an open listing'); ok((await kvLib.getCollection(coll)).alice.length === 2, 'her offered print is in escrow, so she holds two'); const idea = C.parseFeedbackInput({ kind: 'idea', title: 'Hello', body: 'Some details here' }); if (!idea.ok) throw new Error('bad test input'); await F.submitFeedback('alice', idea.value, undefined); await F.submitFeedback('bob', idea.value, undefined); // The request eq(await F.deletionOf('alice'), null, 'no request yet'); const r1 = await F.requestDeletion('Alice'); ok(r1.ok && r1.item.kind === 'deletion' && r1.item.status === 'new', 'a request is made'); ok(!(await F.requestDeletion('alice')).ok, 'only one open request at a time'); ok(await F.cancelDeletion('alice'), 'the sender can cancel while it waits'); eq(await F.deletionOf('alice'), null, 'and it is gone'); const r2 = await F.requestDeletion('alice'); if (!r2.ok) throw new Error('request failed'); const dec = await F.updateFeedback(r2.item.id, { status: 'wontfix', reply: 'Open dispute' }, 'admin_amy'); ok(dec.ok && (await listNotices('alice')).notices.some(n => n.kind === 'feedback' && /could not delete/.test(n.text) && !n.text.includes('admin_amy')), 'a decline notifies the sender without naming staff'); ok(!(await F.cancelDeletion('alice')), 'a declined request cannot be cancelled'); const r3 = await F.requestDeletion('alice'); ok(r3.ok, 'after a decline they can ask again'); if (!r3.ok) throw new Error('request failed'); // The deletion const report = await D.deleteViewerAccount('alice'); ok(report.snapshot && report.tradesCancelled === 1, 'a restore point was taken and the open offer cancelled'); await F.closeDeletion(r3.item.id, 'admin_amy'); const snaps = await admin.listUserSnapshots('alice'); eq(snaps[0]?.collections[0]?.entries.length, 3, 'the restore point holds all three prints (the escrowed one was returned first)'); ok(!('alice' in (await kvLib.getCollection(coll))), 'her collection is gone'); ok((await trades.listOpenTrades()).every(t => t.from !== 'alice'), 'no open offer of hers remains'); eq(await kvLib.getUserProfile('alice'), null, 'the profile is gone'); eq((await getUserSettings('alice')).bio, '', 'her settings are gone'); eq((await listNotices('alice')).notices.length, 0, 'her notices are gone'); eq(await kv.get('user:alice:settings'), null, 'no settings key is left'); const left = await F.feedbackOf('alice'); eq(left.map(i => i.kind), ['deletion', 'deletion'], 'only the deletion records (this one and the declined one) are kept, her other feedback is deleted'); eq(left[0].status, 'done', 'and it is marked done'); ok((await F.feedbackOf('bob')).length === 1, 'someone else’s feedback is untouched'); ok(((await kvLib.getCollection(coll)).bob ?? []).length === 2, 'someone else’s collection is untouched'); }); console.log('account deletion checks passed');

nodes.name: check-achievements.mts
nodes.body_text: // Checks profile achievements: the goals, progress, and that earned goals are remembered. Needs the mock KV for the store part. // Run: node scripts/mock-kv.cjs & KV_REST_API_URL=http://localhost:4111 KV_REST_API_TOKEN=dev KV_URL=redis://dev npx tsx scripts/check-achievements.mts const a = await import('../lib/achievements'); const none = { regular: 0, reverse: 0, full: 0, shiny: 0 }; const R: ('regular' | 'reverse' | 'full' | 'shiny')[] = ['regular', 'reverse', 'full', 'shiny']; const cards = [ { number: 1, stars: 1, variants: R }, { number: 2, stars: 1, variants: R }, { number: 3, stars: 3, variants: R }, { number: 4, stars: 5, variants: ['regular' as const] }, ]; // Owns every card once in Regular, plus a Reverse of cards 1 and 2. const half = a.evaluateSeason(season([[1, { regular: 1, reverse: 1 }], [2, { regular: 2, reverse: 1 }], [3, { regular: 1 }], [4, { regular: 1 }]])); ok(by(half, 'complete').earned && by(half, 'complete').title === 'Completed Season 1', 'owning one of everything completes the season'); ok(by(half, 'tier-1').earned && by(half, 'tier-3').earned && by(half, 'tier-5').earned, 'every rarity tier is complete'); ok(!half.some(x => x.id === 's1:tier-2' || x.id === 's1:tier-4'), 'a rarity with no cards has no goal'); eq([by(half, 'all-reverse').have, by(half, 'all-reverse').need, by(half, 'all-reverse').earned], [2, 3, false], 'All Reverse Holo counts only cards that can be Reverse (card 4 cannot)'); eq(by(half, 'all-shiny').have, 0, 'no shinies yet'); eq([by(half, 'master').have, by(half, 'master').need], [6, 13], 'master set needs every card in every version it can be pulled in (4+4+4+1 = 13)'); ok(!by(half, 'master').earned, 'not a master set yet'); const partial = a.evaluateSeason(season([[1, { regular: 1 }], [3, { regular: 1 }]])); ok(!by(partial, 'complete').earned && by(partial, 'complete').have === 2 && by(partial, 'complete').need === 4, 'half way to completing'); ok(by(partial, 'tier-1').have === 1 && !by(partial, 'tier-1').earned, 'one of two Commons'); const noUpgrades = a.evaluateSeason({ seasonId: 's1', seasonName: 'Season 1', cards: cards.map(c => ({ ...c, variants: ['regular' as const] })), counts: new Map() }); ok(!noUpgrades.some(x => x.id.includes('all-') || x.id.includes('master')), 'a season without upgrades has no version goals'); const full = a.evaluateSeason(season(cards.flatMap(c => [[c.number, Object.fromEntries(c.variants.map(v => [v, 1]))] as [number, Partial<typeof none>]]))); ok(by(full, 'master').earned && by(full, 'all-shiny').earned && by(full, 'all-full').earned, 'every version of every card earns the master set'); const sorted = a.sortAchievements([{ earned: false, have: 1, need: 4 }, { earned: true, have: 2, need: 2, earnedAt: 5 }, { earned: true, have: 3, need: 3, earnedAt: 9 }, { earned: false, have: 3, need: 4 }]); eq(sorted.map(x => [x.earned, x.have]), [[true, 3], [true, 2], [false, 3], [false, 1]], 'earned first (newest first), then closest to done'); // ── serial milestones (need numbered copies) ── { const { encodeEntry } = await import('../lib/variants'); ok(!a.evaluateSeason(season([])).some(x => x.id.includes('first-') || x.id.includes('early')), 'no serial goals until the copies are numbered'); const none2 = a.evaluateSeason(withHeld([[encodeEntry(1, 'regular'), [7, 9]]])); ok(!by(none2, 'first-edition').earned && !by(none2, 'first-shiny').earned && !by(none2, 'five-firsts').earned, 'no edition #1 held: nothing earned'); ok(by(none2, 'early-bird').earned, 'edition #7 is inside the bonus cutoff of 20: Early bird'); ok(!by(a.evaluateSeason(withHeld([[encodeEntry(1, 'regular'), [21]]])), 'early-bird').earned, 'edition #21 is not'); ok(!a.evaluateSeason(withHeld([], 0)).some(x => x.id === 's1:early-bird'), 'no bonus cutoff, no Early bird goal'); const one = a.evaluateSeason(withHeld([[encodeEntry(2, 'regular'), [1, 4]]])); ok(by(one, 'first-edition').earned && !by(one, 'first-shiny').earned, 'holding edition #1 of a Regular is a first edition, not a first shiny'); eq([by(one, 'five-firsts').have, by(one, 'five-firsts').need], [1, 4], 'five firsts is capped by the number of cards (4 here) and counts different cards'); const shiny = a.evaluateSeason(withHeld([[encodeEntry(3, 'shiny'), [1]], [encodeEntry(1, 'regular'), [1]], [encodeEntry(2, 'regular'), [1]], [encodeEntry(4, 'regular'), [1]]])); ok(by(shiny, 'first-shiny').earned && by(shiny, 'five-firsts').earned && by(shiny, 'first-edition').earned, 'a #1 Shiny and four different firsts'); ok(a.evaluateSeason({ ...withHeld([[encodeEntry(1, 'regular'), [1]]]), cards: cards.map(c => ({ ...c, variants: ['regular' as const] })) }).every(x => x.id !== 's1:first-shiny'), 'no shiny goal in a season without shinies'); } // ── the store: a goal, once earned, stays ── if (!process.env.KV_REST_API_URL?.includes('localhost')) throw new Error('Refusing to run against a non-local KV'); const kvLib = await import('../lib/kv'); const store = await import('../lib/achievements-store'); await kvLib.seedSeason1(); const season1 = (await kvLib.listSeasons())[0]; const nums = (await kvLib.getPackCards((await kvLib.getPacksForSeason(season1))[0].id)).map(c => c.number); await kvLib.saveCollection(season1.collectionName, { amy: [...nums], ben: [nums[0]] }); const serials = await import('../lib/serials'); await serials.backfillSerials(season1.collectionName, await kvLib.getCollection(season1.collectionName)); const amy = await store.syncAchievements('amy', 1000); ok(amy.earned.some(x => x.id === `${season1.id}:first-edition`) || amy.earned.some(x => x.id === `${season1.id}:early-bird`), 'numbered copies earn serial milestones (first copies made are #1 / early numbers)'); ok(amy.earned.some(x => x.id === `${season1.id}:complete`), 'owning every card earns the completion achievement'); ok(amy.earned.every(x => x.earnedAt === 1000), 'the first time it is seen earned is remembered'); const ben = await store.syncAchievements('ben'); ok(!ben.earned.some(x => x.id.endsWith(':complete')) && ben.next.some(x => x.id.endsWith(':complete')), 'one card is progress, not earned'); // Amy trades most of her cards away: the achievement stays, with its original date. await kvLib.saveCollection(season1.collectionName, { amy: [nums[0]], ben: [nums[0]] }); const later = await store.syncAchievements('amy', 9000); const kept = later.earned.find(x => x.id === `${season1.id}:complete`); ok(kept && kept.earnedAt === 1000, 'a goal is never taken back, and keeps its date'); ok(later.earned.some(x => x.id.endsWith(':first-edition')), 'a first edition stays earned after the copy is traded away'); console.log('achievement checks passed'); process.exit(0);

nodes.name: check-activity-view.mts
nodes.body_text: // The Live Activity numbers (pulls per minute, last hour, viewers, rare, new cards, the sparkline) count webhook grants as pulls. // Pure (no database). Run: npx tsx scripts/check-activity-view.mts import { notableReason, pullFacts, rateStats, categoryOf } from '../lib/activity-view'; const NOW = Date.UTC(2026, 9, 16, 12, 0, 0); ok(pullFacts(pull(1)) !== null && pullFacts(grant(1)) !== null && pullFacts(adminGrant(1)) === null, 'pulls and webhook grants are pulls; admin grants are not'); ok(categoryOf(grant(1)) === 'pulls' && categoryOf(adminGrant(1)) === 'grants', 'a webhook grant is filed under Pulls, an admin grant under Grants'); const base = rateStats([pull(1), pull(2)], NOW); const withGrants = rateStats([pull(1), pull(2), grant(3), grant(4, { variant: 'shiny', isNew: false, stars: 1 }), adminGrant(1)], NOW); ok(base.lastHour === 2 && withGrants.lastHour === 4, 'the hour count includes webhook grants and leaves out admin grants'); ok(withGrants.perMinute === 4 / 5, 'pulls per minute includes them'); ok(base.viewersLastHour === 1 && withGrants.viewersLastHour === 2, 'viewers include the person who got the grant'); ok(base.rareLastHour === 0 && withGrants.rareLastHour === 2, 'rare counts a 5 star grant and a shiny grant'); ok(base.newCardsLastHour === 0 && withGrants.newCardsLastHour === 1, 'new cards counts a new grant'); ok(withGrants.spark.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) === 4, 'the sparkline includes them'); ok(rateStats([grant(90)], NOW).lastHour === 0, 'old ones age out like pulls'); ok(rateStats([grant(1, { stars: undefined, isNew: undefined })], NOW).lastHour === 1, 'an older grant without the extra facts still counts'); ok(notableReason(grant(1), 25) === '5-star pull' && notableReason(grant(1, { variant: 'shiny' }), 25) === 'Shiny pull' && notableReason(adminGrant(1), 25) === null, 'a rare webhook grant is highlighted like a pull'); console.log('activity view checks passed');

nodes.name: check-admin-shell.mts
nodes.body_text: // Checks the admin frame's shared logic: the nav list (every page exists, shortcut letters are unique), the shortcut sequence, // and the command palette's ranking. Pure (reads the app folder, no database). Run: npx tsx scripts/check-admin-shell.mts import { existsSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs'; import { join } from 'node:path'; const { NAV_ITEMS, NAV_GROUPS, isActive } = await import('../lib/admin-nav'); const sc = await import('../lib/shortcuts'); const pal = await import('../lib/palette'); // ── every nav / palette link is a real page ── for (const i of NAV_ITEMS) ok(pageExists(i.href), `nav link ${i.href} has no page`); for (const it of pal.STATIC_ITEMS) if (it.href) ok(pageExists(it.href), `palette item "${it.label}" links to a missing page ${it.href}`); // ── uniqueness ── eq(new Set(NAV_ITEMS.map(i => i.key)).size, NAV_ITEMS.length, 'shortcut letters are unique'); ok(NAV_ITEMS.every(i => /^[a-z]$/.test(i.key)), 'shortcut letters are single a-z'); eq(new Set(NAV_ITEMS.map(i => i.href)).size, NAV_ITEMS.length, 'nav hrefs are unique'); eq(new Set(pal.STATIC_ITEMS.map(i => i.id)).size, pal.STATIC_ITEMS.length, 'palette ids are unique'); const combos = sc.ALL_SHORTCUTS.map(s => s.keys.join('+')); eq(new Set(combos).size, combos.length, 'no two shortcuts share the same keys'); ok(NAV_GROUPS.every(g => g.items.length > 0), 'no empty nav group'); ok(pal.STATIC_ITEMS.filter(i => i.action).every(i => ['copy-overlay', 'open-preview', 'exit-sandbox', 'logout'].includes(i.action!)), 'palette actions are known'); // ── active item ── const dash = NAV_ITEMS.find(i => i.href === '/admin')!, packs = NAV_ITEMS.find(i => i.href === '/admin/packs')!; ok(isActive(dash, '/admin') && !isActive(dash, '/admin/packs'), 'the dashboard only matches exactly'); ok(isActive(packs, '/admin/packs/abc/cards'), 'a section matches its sub-pages'); // ── g then a letter ── let r = sc.stepSequence(sc.IDLE, 'g', 1000); ok(r.state.pending && !r.go, 'g starts a sequence'); r = sc.stepSequence(r.state, 'p', 1500); eq(r.go, '/admin/packs', 'g p goes to Packs'); ok(!r.state.pending, 'the sequence resets after a hit'); r = sc.stepSequence(sc.stepSequence(sc.IDLE, 'g', 0).state, 'p', sc.SEQUENCE_WINDOW_MS + 1); ok(!r.go, 'too slow: no navigation'); r = sc.stepSequence(sc.stepSequence(sc.IDLE, 'g', 0).state, 'z', 100); ok(!r.go && !r.state.pending, 'g then an unknown letter does nothing'); ok(!sc.stepSequence(sc.IDLE, 'p', 0).go, 'a letter alone does nothing'); eq(sc.stepSequence(sc.stepSequence(sc.IDLE, 'G', 0).state, 'D', 10).go, '/admin', 'capitals work (caps lock)'); // ── typing targets ── ok(sc.isTypingTarget({ tagName: 'INPUT' } as never) && sc.isTypingTarget({ tagName: 'TEXTAREA' } as never), 'inputs are typing targets'); ok(sc.isTypingTarget({ tagName: 'DIV', isContentEditable: true } as never), 'contenteditable is a typing target'); ok(!sc.isTypingTarget({ tagName: 'BUTTON' } as never) && !sc.isTypingTarget(null), 'buttons and nothing are not'); // ── palette ranking ── const extra: import('../lib/palette').PaletteItem[] = [ { id: 'pack:1', label: 'Cheesy Starter Pack', group: 'Packs', icon: 'cards', href: '/admin/packs/1' }, { id: 'season:1', label: 'Season 1', group: 'Seasons', icon: 'trophy', href: '/admin/seasons/1' }, { id: 'user:alice', label: 'alice', group: 'Users', icon: 'user', href: '/admin/users/alice' }, { id: 'user:bob_the_builder', label: 'bob_the_builder', group: 'Users', icon: 'user', href: '/admin/users/bob_the_builder' }, ]; const all = [...pal.STATIC_ITEMS, ...extra]; eq(top('packs'), 'Packs', 'exact page match first'); eq(top('pa'), 'Packs', 'a prefix finds the page'); eq(top('assets'), 'Assets', 'Assets'); eq(top('scoring'), 'Scoring settings', 'a settings tab by name'); eq(top('alice'), 'alice', 'a viewer by name'); eq(top('builder'), 'bob_the_builder', 'a word inside a name'); ok(pal.rankItems(all, 'obs').some(i => i.id === 'act:copy-overlay'), 'keywords match ("obs" finds the overlay URL)'); ok(pal.rankItems(all, 'sign out').some(i => i.action === 'logout'), 'keywords with a space match'); ok(pal.rankItems(all, 'chsy').some(i => i.label === 'Cheesy Starter Pack'), 'a loose subsequence still finds it'); eq(pal.rankItems(all, 'zzzzqq'), [], 'nonsense matches nothing'); const empty = pal.rankItems(all, ''); ok(empty.length > 0 && empty.every(i => i.group === 'Pages' || i.group === 'Actions'), 'with no query: pages and actions only'); eq(empty[0].label, 'Dashboard', 'and the dashboard first'); ok(pal.rankItems(all, 'e', 5).length <= 5, 'the limit is respected'); ok(pal.scoreItem({ label: 'Packs' }, 'PACKS') === 100, 'matching ignores case'); // The frame's accessibility rules: the closed drawer is inert (Tab and screen readers skip it), there is a skip link to the main area, // and the not-found screen has its own heading. const shell = readFileSync(join(process.cwd(), 'app/admin/components/AdminShell.tsx'), 'utf8'); ok(/inert={!wide && !open}/.test(shell), 'the sidebar is inert while the phone drawer is closed'); ok(shell.includes('href="#admin-main"') && shell.includes('id="admin-main"'), 'the frame has a skip link to the main area'); ok(readFileSync(join(process.cwd(), 'app/admin/not-found.tsx'), 'utf8').includes('asH1'), 'the not-found screen has an h1'); console.log('admin shell checks passed');
