nodes.name: check-assets.mts
nodes.body_text: // Checks the admin Assets tools: what counts as unused (never a referenced file or a card's thumbnail), replacing a file, // the fix guards, the insights maths and the unused-selection helpers. // Needs the mock KV running (node scripts/mock-kv.cjs); refuses anything non-local. // Run: npx tsx scripts/check-assets.mts const url = process.env.KV_REST_API_URL ?? 'http://localhost:4111'; if (!/^http:\/\/(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)[:/]/.test(url)) throw new Error(`Refusing to run against non-local KV: ${url}`); process.env.KV_REST_API_URL = url; process.env.KV_REST_API_TOKEN ??= 'dev'; process.env.KV_URL ??= 'redis://dev'; delete process.env.BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN; delete process.env.VERCEL_BLOB_RW_TOKEN; const kvLib = await import('../lib/kv'); const assets = await import('../lib/assets'); const fix = await import('../lib/asset-fix'); const ins = await import('../lib/asset-insights'); const HOST = 'https://abc123.public.blob.vercel-storage.com'; const UUID = '0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123'.slice(0, 8) + '-aaaa-bbbb-cccc-0123456789ab'; const art = `${HOST}/cards/${UUID}.webp`, thumb = `${HOST}/cards/${UUID}.thumb.webp`; const cover = `${HOST}/covers/cover.png`, orphan = `${HOST}/cards/orphan.webp`; await kvLib.seedSeason1(); const packs = await kvLib.listAllPacks(); const pack = packs[0]; const cards = await kvLib.getPackCards(pack.id); await kvLib.savePack({ ...pack, coverImageUrl: cover }); await kvLib.savePackCards(pack.id, cards.map((c, i) => (i === 0 || i === 1 ? { ...c, imageUrl: art } : i === 2 ? { ...c, imageUrl: `${HOST}/cards/legacy.gif` } : c))); // ── what is referenced / deletable ── const { referenced } = await assets.collectReferenced(); ok(referenced.has(art) && referenced.has(cover), 'card art and cover are referenced'); ok(referenced.has(thumb), "a card's companion thumbnail counts as referenced"); const inStore = new Set([art, thumb, cover, orphan, `${HOST}/cards/legacy.gif`]); eq(assets.pickDeletable([art, thumb, cover, orphan, orphan, 'https://evil.example/x.png', `${HOST}/cards/not-there.webp`], inStore, referenced), [orphan], 'only unreferenced files in our store can be deleted (and only once)'); eq(await assets.deleteUnusedBlobs([art, cover]), 0, 'no Blob token: nothing is deleted'); // ── the library: ids, sharing, flags ── const lib = await assets.loadAssetLibrary('http://localhost:1'); const ids = lib.assets.map(a => a.id); eq(new Set(ids).size, ids.length, 'every reference has a unique id'); const first = lib.assets.find(a => a.url === art)!; ok(first.sharedWith.length === 1, 'two cards pointing at one file know they share it'); ok(lib.assets.find(a => a.url.endsWith('legacy.gif'))!.issues.includes('legacy-gif'), 'a GIF is flagged'); // ── replace ── const key = assets.keyOf(first.origin, 'card-art'); ok(!(await fix.replaceAsset(key, 'https://evil.example/x.webp')).ok, 'an arbitrary URL is refused'); ok(!(await fix.replaceAsset(key, `${HOST}/sounds/a.mp3`)).ok, 'a sound cannot replace card art'); ok(!(await fix.replaceAsset({ kind: 'sound', packId: pack.id, cardId: first.origin.kind === 'pack-cover' ? undefined : first.origin.cardId }, `${HOST}/x.png`)).ok, 'an image cannot replace a sound'); const newArt = `${HOST}/cards/${UUID.replace('0123', 'ffff')}.webp`; ok((await fix.replaceAsset(key, newArt)).ok, 'a Blob image replaces card art'); const after = await kvLib.getPackCards(pack.id); eq([after[0].imageUrl, after[1].imageUrl], [newArt, art], 'only the chosen card changed (the shared file is untouched)'); ok((await fix.replaceAsset({ kind: 'pack-cover', packId: pack.id }, '/assets/pack-cover.png')).ok, 'a bundled file can be a cover'); eq((await kvLib.getPack(pack.id))?.coverImageUrl, '/assets/pack-cover.png', 'the cover changed'); ok(!(await fix.replaceAsset({ kind: 'card-art', packId: 'nope', cardId: 'x' }, art)).ok, 'an unknown card is refused'); // ── fix guards ── ok(!(await fix.fixAsset({ kind: 'sound', packId: pack.id, cardId: after[0].id }, 'http://localhost:1')).ok, 'sounds are never auto-fixed'); const noToken = await fix.fixAsset(assets.keyOf(lib.assets.find(a => a.url.endsWith('legacy.gif'))!.origin, 'card-art'), 'http://localhost:1'); ok(!noToken.ok && /not connected/i.test(noToken.message), 'fixing needs Blob storage'); // ── insights + selection helpers ── const i = ins.computeInsights([ { ...first, bytes: 100, format: 'WebP' }, { ...first, id: 'b', bytes: 900, format: 'GIF', sharedWith: [] }, { ...first, id: 'c', bytes: null, format: 'PNG', kind: 'pack-cover', sharedWith: [] }, ]); eq([i.totalBytes, i.gifs.files, i.gifs.bytes, i.unknownSize], [1000, 1, 900, 1], 'insights totals'); eq(i.gifs.estimatedSaved, Math.round(900 * ins.GIF_SAVINGS), 'GIF savings estimate'); eq(i.heaviest[0].bytes, 900, 'heaviest first'); const day = 86_400_000, now = Date.now(); const old = [{ uploadedAt: new Date(now - 40 * day).toISOString() }, { uploadedAt: new Date(now - 3 * day).toISOString() }]; eq([ins.olderThan(old, 30, now).length, ins.olderThan(old, 90, now).length, ins.olderThan(old, 1, now).length], [1, 0, 2], 'older-than filter'); console.log('assets: all checks passed');

nodes.name: check-backup.mts
nodes.body_text: // Nightly backup: key rules, retention, the encrypted file, snapshot + restore round trip, and the refusals. // Needs the mock KV (npm run check starts it); refuses anything non-local. Blob is never contacted: runBackup refuses first. // Run: npx tsx scripts/check-backup.mts const url = process.env.KV_REST_API_URL ?? 'http://localhost:4111'; if (!/^http:\/\/(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)[:/]/.test(url)) throw new Error(`Refusing to run against non-local KV: ${url}`); process.env.KV_REST_API_URL = url; process.env.KV_REST_API_TOKEN ??= 'dev'; process.env.KV_URL ??= 'redis://dev'; const core = await import('../lib/backup-core'); const backup = await import('../lib/backup'); const { prodKv } = await import('../lib/db'); const { NextRequest } = await import('next/server'); // ---- which keys are kept ---- for (const k of ['seasons:list', 'season:s1', 'season:s1:wrap', 'pack:p1:cards', 'tcg_Season2', 'user:alice:profile', 'user:alice:settings', 'user:alice:ach', 'user:alice:scorehist:s1', 'copies:Season2:o:alice', 'copies:uid:seq', 'staff:members', 'trades:open', 'notif:alice', 'discord:settings', 'webhooks:settings', 'overlay:settings', 'scoring:settings', 'twitch_opaque:U123', 'users:hidden', 'admin:dashboard', 'audit:all', 'something:nobody:thought:of']) ok(core.isBackedUp(k), `${k} is backed up`); for (const k of ['sbx:preview:tcg_x', 'sbx:demo:seasons:list', 'sandbox:registry', 'stats:h:Season2', 'stats:last', 'twitch:live', 'twitch:avatars', 'activity:log', 'activity:seq', 'lock:trades', 'captcha:pass:alice', 'showoff:cd:alice', 'trade:cd:alice', 'webhooks:queue', 'overlay:clients', 'overlay:reload', 'watch:idx:12', 'watch:idx:ready', 'user:alice:snap:abc', 'user:alice:snaps']) ok(!core.isBackedUp(k), `${k} is not backed up`); ok(core.isBackedUp('user:snapper:profile'), 'a viewer called snapper is not mistaken for a restore point'); // ---- names and retention ---- ok(core.backupName(Date.UTC(2026, 9, 15, 4)) === 'backups/2026-10-15.json.gz.enc', 'file name from the date'); const names = Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, i) => `backups/${day(i)}.json.gz.enc`); const junk = ['backups/readme.txt', 'card-art/2026-01-01.json.gz.enc', 'backups/2026-10-01.json.gz', 'backups/../x']; const doomed = core.pickBackupsToDelete([...junk, ...[...names].reverse()], 14); ok(doomed.length === 6 && doomed.every(d => names.slice(0, 6).includes(d)), 'the six oldest of twenty are picked, in any input order'); ok(core.pickBackupsToDelete(names.slice(0, 14), 14).length === 0, 'nothing is deleted at the limit'); ok(core.pickBackupsToDelete(junk, 0).length === 0, 'files that are not backups are never picked'); const NOW = Date.UTC(2026, 9, 15, 12); ok(!core.backupIsStale(NOW - 35 * 3_600_000, NOW) && core.backupIsStale(NOW - 37 * 3_600_000, NOW) && core.backupIsStale(null, NOW), 'stale after 36 hours or when there is none'); // ---- encryption ---- const KEY = 'a-long-backup-key-for-the-check'; const plain = Buffer.from('{"hello":"world"}'); const enc = core.encryptBackup(plain, KEY); ok(!enc.includes('hello'), 'ciphertext does not contain the plaintext'); ok(core.decryptBackup(enc, KEY).equals(plain), 'decrypts with the right key'); ok(!core.encryptBackup(plain, KEY).equals(enc), 'every encryption uses a fresh salt and iv'); ok(await throws(() => core.decryptBackup(enc, KEY + 'x')), 'the wrong key is refused'); const tampered = Buffer.from(enc); tampered[tampered.length - 20] ^= 1; ok(await throws(() => core.decryptBackup(tampered, KEY)), 'a damaged file is refused'); ok(await throws(() => core.decryptBackup(Buffer.from('not a backup at all, just some text'), KEY)), 'a random file is refused'); ok(await throws(() => core.encryptBackup(plain, 'short')), 'a short key is refused'); // ---- snapshot and restore round trip against the mock KV ---- await prodKv.set('seasons:list', ['s1']); await prodKv.set('season:s1', { id: 's1', name: 'Season 1', collectionName: 'S1' }); await prodKv.set('tcg_S1', { alice: [1, 1, 2], bob: [3] }); await prodKv.hset('staff:members', { alice: { login: 'alice', role: 'mod' }, bob: { login: 'bob', role: 'admin' } }); await prodKv.lpush('trades:history', { id: 'a' }); await prodKv.lpush('trades:history', { id: 'b' }); await prodKv.lpush('trades:history', { id: 'c' }); await prodKv.sadd('users:hidden', 'x', 'y'); await prodKv.set('sbx:demo:seasons:list', ['nope']); await prodKv.set('stats:last', 'skip me'); await prodKv.set('lock:trades', 'skip me'); await prodKv.lpush('activity:log', { id: 1 }); await prodKv.set('user:alice:snap:1', { big: true }); const file = await backup.collectEntries(prodKv as unknown as Parameters<typeof backup.collectEntries>[0], NOW); const byKey = new Map(file.entries.map(e => [e.key, e])); ok(byKey.size === file.entries.length, 'no key twice'); for (const k of ['seasons:list', 'season:s1', 'tcg_S1', 'staff:members', 'trades:history', 'users:hidden']) ok(byKey.has(k), `${k} was collected`); for (const k of ['sbx:demo:seasons:list', 'stats:last', 'lock:trades', 'activity:log', 'user:alice:snap:1']) ok(!byKey.has(k), `${k} was left out`); ok(byKey.get('staff:members')!.type === 'hash' && byKey.get('trades:history')!.type === 'list' && byKey.get('users:hidden')!.type === 'set' && byKey.get('tcg_S1')!.type === 'string', 'types are recorded'); ok(file.skipped.length === 0, 'nothing skipped'); // Through the real file format: gzip, encrypt, decrypt, parse. const reread = core.parseBackup(core.decryptBackup(core.encryptBackup(core.serializeBackup(file), KEY), KEY)); ok(reread.entries.length === file.entries.length && reread.createdAt === NOW, 'the file survives the encrypted round trip'); ok(core.describeBackup(reread).includes(`${file.entries.length} keys`), 'describe names the key count'); // Restore into a sandbox namespace: same values and the same list order, and the real keys are untouched. const n = await backup.restoreEntries(prodKv as unknown as Parameters<typeof backup.restoreEntries>[0], reread.entries, k => `sbx:rt:${k}`); ok(n === reread.entries.length, 'every entry was restored'); ok(JSON.stringify(await prodKv.get('sbx:rt:tcg_S1')) === JSON.stringify({ alice: [1, 1, 2], bob: [3] }), 'a string value is restored exactly'); ok(JSON.stringify(await prodKv.hgetall('sbx:rt:staff:members')) === JSON.stringify(await prodKv.hgetall('staff:members')), 'a hash is restored exactly'); ok(JSON.stringify(await prodKv.lrange('sbx:rt:trades:history', 0, -1)) === JSON.stringify(await prodKv.lrange('trades:history', 0, -1)), 'a list keeps its order'); ok(JSON.stringify(((await prodKv.smembers('sbx:rt:users:hidden')) as string[]).sort()) === JSON.stringify(['x', 'y']), 'a set is restored'); ok(JSON.stringify(await prodKv.get('tcg_S1')) === JSON.stringify({ alice: [1, 1, 2], bob: [3] }), 'the original keys were not touched'); // A restore replaces rather than merges, and --raw style (no rename) puts keys back where they were. await prodKv.set('tcg_S1', { mallory: [9] }); await prodKv.lpush('trades:history', { id: 'later' }); await backup.restoreEntries(prodKv as unknown as Parameters<typeof backup.restoreEntries>[0], reread.entries); ok(JSON.stringify(await prodKv.get('tcg_S1')) === JSON.stringify({ alice: [1, 1, 2], bob: [3] }), 'a raw restore replaces a changed string'); ok((await prodKv.lrange('trades:history', 0, -1)).length === 3, 'a raw restore replaces a list instead of appending'); // ---- refusals ---- delete process.env.VERCEL_ENV; ok(await throws(() => backup.runBackup()), 'no backup outside production'); process.env.VERCEL_ENV = 'preview'; ok(await throws(() => backup.runBackup()), 'no backup on a preview'); process.env.VERCEL_ENV = 'production'; delete process.env.BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_KEY; let msg = ''; try { await backup.runBackup(); } catch (e) { msg = String((e as Error).message); } ok(msg.includes('BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_KEY'), 'no backup without an encryption key (it would be a public plaintext file)'); delete process.env.VERCEL_ENV; delete process.env.BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN; ok(!(await backup.backupStatus(NOW)).ok && (await backup.backupStatus(NOW)).stale, 'status is red when Blob is not connected'); // The cron route: closed without the secret, and a refused run is reported as an error, never a success. const route = await import('../app/api/cron/backup/route'); delete process.env.CRON_SECRET; ok((await call('Bearer anything')).status === 401, 'route is closed when CRON_SECRET is unset'); process.env.CRON_SECRET = 'cron-secret-0123456789'; ok((await call()).status === 401, 'route refuses a call with no header'); ok((await call('Bearer wrong-secret-0123456789')).status === 401, 'route refuses a wrong secret'); ok((await call('cron-secret-0123456789')).status === 401, 'route needs the Bearer prefix'); const refused = await call('Bearer cron-secret-0123456789'); ok(refused.status === 500 && (await refused.json()).ok === false, 'a valid call outside production reports the refusal'); console.log('backup checks passed');

nodes.name: check-binder-config.mts
nodes.body_text: // Pure checks for binder customisation: config validation, grid sizes, sorts and hand-placed pages. // Run: npx tsx scripts/check-binder-config.mts const b = await import('../lib/binder'); const c = await import('../lib/binder-config'); // Defaults store nothing; junk is dropped; limits are enforced. ok(c.sanitizeBinder(null) === null && c.sanitizeBinder({}) === null && c.sanitizeBinder('x') === null, 'nothing, or an empty object, is the default (null)'); ok(c.sanitizeBinder({ ...c.DEFAULT_BINDER }) === null, 'the default config is stored as null'); const odd = c.sanitizeBinder({ title: (' Hello\u0000 world ').padEnd(80, 'x'), cover: 'nope', material: 'cloth', emblem: 'bad', cols: 99, rows: -4, pocketStyle: 'sleeve', evil: 1 })!; ok(odd.title.length === 40 && !odd.title.includes('\u0000') && odd.title.startsWith('Hello world'), 'title is cleaned and capped'); ok(odd.cover === 'saddle' && odd.emblem === 'cheese' && odd.material === 'cloth' && odd.pocketStyle === 'sleeve', 'unknown options fall back, known ones stay'); ok(odd.cols === 4 && odd.rows === 1 && !('evil' in odd), 'grid size is clamped and unknown keys dropped'); ok(c.sanitizeBinder({ mode: 'custom', cols: 3, rows: 3 }) === null, 'custom mode with no pages is just auto (and so default)'); // Pages: padded to the grid, bad slots become empty, duplicates are allowed, version pins validated. const withPages = c.sanitizeBinder({ mode: 'custom', pagesSeason: 's1', cols: 2, rows: 2, pages: [ { title: 'One', slots: [{ card: 5, variant: 'shiny' }, { card: 5, variant: 'bogus' }, { card: -1 }, 'x'] }, { title: 'Two', slots: [{ card: 7 }] }, 'junk', ] })!; ok(withPages.mode === 'custom' && withPages.pages.length === 2 && withPages.pagesSeason === 's1', 'pages kept, junk page dropped'); ok(withPages.pages.every(p => p.slots.length === 4), 'every page is padded to the grid'); ok(withPages.pages[0].slots[0]?.variant === 'shiny' && withPages.pages[0].slots[1]?.variant === null && withPages.pages[0].slots[2] === null && withPages.pages[0].slots[3] === null, 'versions validated, bad slots empty'); ok(c.sanitizeBinder({ mode: 'custom', cols: 3, rows: 3, pages: new Array(80).fill({ title: 'p', slots: [] }) })!.pages.length === c.BINDER_LIMITS.pages, 'page count is capped'); // Shrinking the grid moves overflow cards onto a new page instead of dropping them. const fat: Page[] = [{ title: 'A', slots: Array.from({ length: 9 }, (_, i) => ({ card: i + 1, variant: null })) }]; const slim = c.reflowPages(fat, 4); ok(slim.length === 3 && slim.every(p => p.slots.length === 4), '9 cards at 4 per page: three pages'); ok(slim.flatMap(p => p.slots).filter(Boolean).map(s => s!.card).join() === '1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9', 'no card is lost or reordered'); ok(slim[1].title === 'A (more)', 'overflow pages are labelled'); ok(c.reflowPages(slim, 9).length === 3, 'growing again does not merge pages (it only pads)'); // Page editing. let pg = c.addPage([], 4); ok(pg.length === 1 && pg[0].slots.length === 4 && pg[0].slots.every(s => s === null), 'a new page is empty'); pg = c.setSlot(pg, 0, 1, { card: 3, variant: 'full' }); ok(pg[0].slots[1]?.card === 3 && c.setSlot(pg, 0, 9, { card: 1, variant: null })[0].slots.length === 4, 'setSlot ignores a pocket that does not exist'); pg = c.addPage(pg, 4); pg = c.renamePage(pg, 1, ' Shinies '); ok(pg[1].title === 'Shinies', 'rename trims'); ok(c.movePage(pg, 1, 0)[0].title === 'Shinies' && c.movePage(pg, 5, 0) === pg, 'move, and a bad index changes nothing'); ok(c.nextEmpty(pg, 0, 1)?.slot === 2, 'the next empty pocket'); const nearlyFull = c.setSlot(c.setSlot(pg, 0, 2, { card: 1, variant: null }), 0, 3, { card: 2, variant: null }); // slots 1, 2, 3 taken; slot 0 empty ok(c.nextEmpty(nearlyFull, 0, 1)?.page === 1, 'onto the next page when the rest of this one is full'); ok(c.nextEmpty([{ title: '', slots: [{ card: 1, variant: null }] }], 0, 0) === null, 'a full binder has no next empty pocket'); const sw = c.swapSlots(pg, { page: 0, slot: 1 }, { page: 1, slot: 0 }); ok(sw[0].slots[1] === null && sw[1].slots[0]?.card === 3, 'swapping with an empty pocket moves the card'); ok(c.clearPage(pg, 0)[0].slots.every(s => s === null) && c.removePage(pg, 0).length === 1, 'clear and delete a page'); ok(c.addPage(new Array(c.BINDER_LIMITS.pages).fill(pg[0]), 4).length === c.BINDER_LIMITS.pages, 'cannot add past the page limit'); // Layouts: grid size, sort, grouping, hiding. const cards = [ { packName: 'A', number: 1, stars: 1, name: 'Zed', owned: false }, { packName: 'A', number: 2, stars: 5, name: 'Bob', owned: true }, { packName: 'A', number: 3, stars: 3, name: 'Amy', owned: true }, { packName: 'B', number: 4, stars: 2, name: 'Cat', owned: false }, ]; const two = b.buildBinderPages(cards, { cap: 2 }); ok(two.length === 4 && two[1].slots.length === 2 && nums(two[1]) === '1,2' && nums(two[2]) === '3' && two[3].pack === 'B', 'two pockets per page, packs apart'); ok(nums(b.buildBinderPages(cards, { cap: 4, sort: 'rarity' })[1]) === '2,3,1', 'rarest first within a pack'); ok(nums(b.buildBinderPages(cards, { cap: 4, sort: 'name' })[1]) === '3,2,1', 'by name'); ok(nums(b.buildBinderPages(cards, { cap: 4, sort: 'collected' })[1]) === '2,3,1', 'collected first'); const all = b.buildBinderPages(cards, { cap: 4, group: false }); ok(all.length === 2 && all[1].pack === 'All cards' && nums(all[1]) === '1,2,3,4', 'one run of all cards'); ok(b.buildBinderPages(cards, { cap: 4, hideUncollected: true }).flatMap(p => p.slots).filter(s => s !== null).length === 2, 'uncollected cards can be left out'); ok(b.buildBinderPages(cards, { cap: 16 })[1].slots.length === 16, 'a 4x4 page has sixteen pockets'); ok(b.buildBinderPages(cards.map(({ packName, number }) => ({ packName, number })), { cap: 9 }).length === 3, 'cards without extra info still lay out (old call shape)'); // Hand-placed pages resolve card numbers to indexes; a number that is not in the season is an empty pocket. const hand = b.buildCustomPages(cards, [{ title: 'Faves', slots: [{ card: 3, variant: 'shiny' }, { card: 999, variant: null }, null, { card: 2, variant: null }] }], 4); ok(hand.length === 2 && hand[0].kind === 'cover' && hand[1].title === 'Faves' && hand[1].cfgIndex === 0, 'a cover then the hand-made page, tagged with its saved index'); ok(hand[1].slots.join() === '2,,,1' && hand[1].pins!.join() === 'shiny,,,', 'card numbers become indexes, pins follow, unknown numbers are empty'); ok(b.buildCustomPages(cards, [], 4).length === 1, 'no custom pages: just the cover'); ok(b.buildCustomPages(cards, [{ title: 'x', slots: Array.from({ length: 6 }, () => ({ card: 1, variant: null })) }], 4).length === 3, 'a page with too many cards for the grid spills onto another'); // Filling pages from the automatic layout keeps every card once and names the pages. const filled = b.autoFillPages(cards, { cols: 2, rows: 1, sort: 'number', groupByPack: true, hideUncollected: false }); ok(filled.length === 3 && filled[0].title === 'A 1/2' && filled[2].title === 'B', 'auto-fill makes titled pages'); ok(filled.flatMap(p => p.slots).filter(Boolean).length === 4, 'every card appears once'); // The user settings carry it through (and drop it when it is the default). const us = await import('../lib/user-settings'); ok(us.sanitizeUserSettings({}).binder === null && us.sanitizeUserSettings({ binder: { cover: 'navy' } }).binder?.cover === 'navy', 'settings keep a binder'); ok(!('binder' in us.sparse(us.sanitizeUserSettings({ binder: {} }))), 'a default binder is not stored'); // The share image's binder layout: pages and pockets stay inside the leather, inside the image, for every grid size, one page or two. { const sh = await import('../lib/share-image'); ok(c.isLightColour('#efe3c3') && c.isLightColour('#f4f6fb') && !c.isLightColour('#121a3a') && !c.isLightColour('nope'), 'pale and dark page colours are told apart'); for (const H of [sh.SHARE_H, sh.STORY_H]) for (const pages of [1, 2]) for (const [cols, rows] of [[2, 1], [2, 2], [3, 3], [4, 4], [4, 1], [2, 4]]) { const L = sh.binderLayout({ cols, rows, pages: new Array(pages).fill(0) }, H); const area = sh.cardArea(H); const tag = `${cols}x${rows}, ${pages} page(s), height ${H}`; ok(L.leather.x >= area.x - 0.5 && L.leather.x + L.leather.w <= area.x + area.w + 0.5 && L.leather.y >= area.y - 0.5 && L.leather.y + L.leather.h <= area.y + area.h + 0.5, `the binder fits the card area (${tag})`); ok(L.pages.length === pages && L.pages.every(p => p.pockets.length === cols * rows), `every pocket is laid out (${tag})`); for (const p of L.pages) { ok(p.pockets.every(r => r.x >= p.rect.x && r.x + r.w <= p.rect.x + p.rect.w + 0.5 && r.y >= p.head.y + p.head.h && r.y + r.h <= p.rect.y + p.rect.h + 0.5), `pockets stay on their page (${tag})`); ok(p.pockets.every(r => Math.abs(r.h / r.w - 1.5) < 0.001), `pockets are 2:3 (${tag})`); } ok(L.pages.length < 2 || Math.abs(L.pages[0].rect.x + L.pages[0].rect.w - L.pages[1].rect.x) < 0.5, `the two pages meet at the spine (${tag})`); } // A single page is much bigger than half of a spread. ok(sh.binderLayout({ cols: 3, rows: 3, pages: [0] }).pages[0].pockets[0].w > sh.binderLayout({ cols: 3, rows: 3, pages: [0, 0] }).pages[0].pockets[0].w, 'one page gets bigger pockets than two'); } console.log('binder customisation checks passed');

Run: npx tsx scripts/check-binder.mts const b = await import('../lib/binder'); // 25 cards in one pack (stored in rarity order, not number order): 3 pages, the last with 7 pockets filled. const shuffled = mk('Starter', 1, 25).reverse(); const pages = b.buildBinderPages(shuffled); ok(pages.length === 4 && pages[0].kind === 'cover', 'a cover plus three pages'); ok(pages.slice(1).every(p => p.slots.length === 9), 'every page has nine pockets'); ok(pages[3].slots.filter(s => s !== null).length === 7 && pages[3].slots[7] === null, 'the last page has empty pockets at the end'); const first = pages[1].slots.map(s => shuffled[s!].number); ok(first.join() === '1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9', 'cards are in card-number order'); ok(pages.slice(1).flatMap(p => p.slots).filter(s => s !== null).length === 25 && new Set(pages.flatMap(p => p.slots).filter(s => s !== null)).size === 25, 'every card appears exactly once'); ok(pages[1].part === 1 && pages[1].parts === 3 && pages[3].part === 3, 'part numbers'); // Two packs: each starts on its own page, in the order they appear. const two = b.buildBinderPages([...mk('A', 1, 10), ...mk('B', 100, 3)]); ok(two.map(p => p.pack ?? 'cover').join() === 'cover,A,A,B', 'packs are kept apart and in order'); // Empty collection: just the cover. ok(b.buildBinderPages([]).length === 1, 'no cards, only a cover'); // Spreads. const d = b.buildSpreads(pages, true); ok(d.length === 3 && d[0].left === undefined && d[0].right === pages[0], 'two-page mode opens on the cover alone'); ok(d[1].left === pages[1] && d[1].right === pages[2] && d[2].left === pages[3] && d[2].right === undefined, 'then pairs, the last may stand alone'); ok(b.buildSpreads(pages, false).length === 4, 'one-page mode: one spread per page'); ok(b.spreadOfPage(0, true) === 0 && b.spreadOfPage(1, true) === 1 && b.spreadOfPage(2, true) === 1 && b.spreadOfPage(3, true) === 2 && b.spreadOfPage(3, false) === 3, 'a page finds its spread'); ok(b.clampSpread(-3, 4) === 0 && b.clampSpread(9, 4) === 3 && b.clampSpread(1.7, 4) === 1 && b.clampSpread(2, 0) === 0, 'clamping'); console.log('binder checks passed');

nodes.body_text: // Checks the leaderboard's sorting, filtering and rank movement. Pure. Run: npx tsx scripts/check-board.mts const b = await import('../lib/board-view'); const rows = [row('amy', 100, 10, 12), row('ben', 300, 8, 30, 2), row('cat', 300, 20, 25, 0, true), row('dan', 50, 10, 10, 1)]; eq(b.rankBoard(rows, 'points').map(r => [r.row.username, r.rank]), [['ben', 1], ['cat', 1], ['amy', 3], ['dan', 4]], 'points: ties share a rank, then the next rank skips'); eq(b.rankBoard(rows, 'cards').map(r => [r.row.username, r.rank]), [['cat', 1], ['amy', 2], ['dan', 2], ['ben', 4]], 'cards: different cards, ties share rank'); eq(b.rankBoard(rows, 'copies').map(r => r.row.username), ['ben', 'cat', 'amy', 'dan'], 'copies'); eq(b.rankBoard(rows, 'shiny').map(r => r.row.username), ['ben', 'dan', 'cat', 'amy'], 'shinies, ties broken by points'); const ranked = b.rankBoard(rows, 'points'); eq(b.filterBoard(ranked, { q: '@AM' }).map(r => [r.row.username, r.rank]), [['amy', 3]], 'search keeps the true rank'); eq(b.filterBoard(ranked, { completeOnly: true }).map(r => r.row.username), ['cat'], 'complete only'); eq(b.filterBoard(ranked, {}).length, 4, 'no filter keeps everyone'); const before = { amy: 1, ben: 3, cat: 1, old: 2 }; eq(b.rankMovement(before, ranked), { ben: 2, amy: -2 }, 'movement: places gained are positive, new and unchanged names are left out'); eq(b.rankSnapshot(ranked), { ben: 1, cat: 1, amy: 3, dan: 4 }, 'snapshot of ranks'); // An ended season's board comes from its saved standings. const full = b.standingsToBoardRows([ snapRow('amy', 120, 100, { completionBonus: 15, setBonus: 5, variants: { regular: 15, reverse: 3, full: 1, shiny: 1 } }), snapRow('ben', 90, 90, { completionBonus: 0, setBonus: 0, variants: { regular: 20, reverse: 0, full: 0, shiny: 0 } }), ]); ok(full.hasVariants && full.rows.length === 2 && !full.rows[0].bonusesTogether, 'a new final standing keeps the bonus split and the version counts'); eq([full.rows[0].completionBonus, full.rows[0].setBonus, full.rows[0].variants.shiny], [15, 5, 1], 'the split is passed through'); const old = b.standingsToBoardRows([snapRow('amy', 120, 100), snapRow('ben', 90, 90)]); ok(!old.hasVariants && old.rows[0].bonusesTogether === true, 'an old final standing (no split, no versions) is flagged'); eq([old.rows[0].completionBonus, old.rows[0].setBonus, old.rows[1].completionBonus], [20, 0, 0], 'the unsplit bonuses are score minus card points, in one lump'); eq(b.standingsToBoardRows([snapRow('amy', 120, 100), snapRow('ben', 90, 90)], new Set(['amy'])).rows.map(r => r.username), ['ben'], 'collectors hidden since the season ended are left out'); eq(b.standingsToBoardRows([]).rows, [], 'no standings, no rows'); const finalRanked = b.rankBoard(full.rows, 'points'); eq(finalRanked.map(r => [r.row.username, r.rank]), [['amy', 1], ['ben', 2]], 'the final board ranks like any other'); console.log('board checks passed');

nodes.name: check-captcha.mts
nodes.body_text: // Checks the Turnstile gate's decisions (pure: every dependency is faked). Run: npx tsx scripts/check-captcha.mts const { captchaKeys, checkCaptcha, verifyTurnstile, captchaBody, PASS_SECONDS } = await import('../lib/captcha'); // Keys: both or nothing. ok(captchaKeys({}) === null, 'no keys, no captcha'); ok(captchaKeys({ TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY: 'a' }) === null, 'a site key alone is not enough'); ok(captchaKeys({ TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY: 'b' }) === null, 'a secret alone is not enough'); ok(captchaKeys({ TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY: ' a ', TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY: ' b ' })?.site === 'a', 'both set (trimmed)'); const KEYS = { site: 'site-key', secret: 'secret-key' }; // Off: no keys, or a sandbox. ok((await checkCaptcha({ username: 'a' }, deps({ keys: null }).d)).ok, 'no keys: fails open'); ok((await checkCaptcha({ username: 'a' }, deps({ sandbox: true }).d)).ok, 'sandbox: fails open'); // Required, then passed, then remembered. { const { d, passes, calls } = deps(); const first = await checkCaptcha({ username: 'a' }, d); ok(!first.ok && first.reason === 'required' && first.siteKey === 'site-key', 'no token: the check is required, with the public key'); ok(calls.length === 0, 'nothing is verified without a token'); ok(!(await checkCaptcha({ username: 'a', token: 'x'.repeat(5000) }, d)).ok && calls.length === 0, 'an absurd token is not even sent to Cloudflare'); const bad = await checkCaptcha({ username: 'a', token: 'bad' }, d); ok(!bad.ok && bad.reason === 'failed' && !passes.has('a'), 'a refused token fails and grants nothing'); const good = await checkCaptcha({ username: 'a', token: 'good' }, d); ok(good.ok && good.via === 'token' && passes.has('a'), 'a good token passes and is remembered'); const again = await checkCaptcha({ username: 'a' }, d); ok(again.ok && again.via === 'pass', 'the next action needs no token'); const other = await checkCaptcha({ username: 'b' }, d); ok(!other.ok, 'the pass belongs to one viewer'); } // Cloudflare down: let them through, but do not hand out a pass. { const { d, passes } = deps(); const r = await checkCaptcha({ username: 'a', token: 'down' }, d); ok(r.ok && r.via === 'unreachable' && !passes.has('a'), 'an unreachable verifier fails open without granting a pass'); } // verifyTurnstile against a fake fetch. { ok(await verifyTurnstile('t', 's', '1.2.3.4', reply(200, { success: true })) === 'valid', 'success: valid'); ok(await verifyTurnstile('t', 's', undefined, reply(200, { success: false, 'error-codes': ['invalid-input-response'] })) === 'invalid', 'refused: invalid'); ok(await verifyTurnstile('t', 's', undefined, reply(500)) === 'unreachable', 'a server error is unreachable'); ok(await verifyTurnstile('t', 's', undefined, (async () => { throw new Error('network'); }) as unknown as typeof fetch) === 'unreachable', 'a network error is unreachable'); let sent = ''; await verifyTurnstile('tok', 'sec', '9.9.9.9', (async (_u: unknown, init?: RequestInit) => { sent = String(init?.body); return new Response(JSON.stringify({ success: true })); }) as unknown as typeof fetch); ok(sent.includes('secret=sec') && sent.includes('response=tok') && sent.includes('remoteip=9.9.9.9'), 'secret, token and IP are sent'); } // What the page sees. { const required = captchaBody({ ok: false, reason: 'required', siteKey: 'k' }); ok(required.captcha === true && required.siteKey === 'k' && /quick check/i.test(required.error), 'the required response carries the flag and key'); ok(/did not pass/i.test(captchaBody({ ok: false, reason: 'failed', siteKey: 'k' }).error), 'the failed response says so'); ok(PASS_SECONDS === 900, 'a pass lasts 15 minutes'); } console.log('captcha checks passed');

nodes.name: deps
nodes.body_text: function deps(over: Partial<Parameters<typeof checkCaptcha>[1]> = {}) { const passes = new Set<string>(); const calls: string[] = []; const d = { keys: KEYS, sandbox: false, hasPass: async (u: string) => passes.has(u), grantPass: async (u: string) => { passes.add(u); calls.push(`grant:${u}`); }, verify: async (t: string) => { calls.push(`verify:${t}`); return t === 'good' ? 'valid' as const : t === 'down' ? 'unreachable' as const : 'invalid' as const; }, ...over, }; return { d, passes, calls }; }

nodes.body_text: // The per-pack card back (ROADMAP 20.1): the sanitiser, "no key = today's look", the stored key and the share plate's look. // Needs the mock KV (npm run check starts it); refuses anything non-local. Run: npx tsx scripts/check-card-back.mts import { existsSync, readdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'; const url = process.env.KV_REST_API_URL ?? 'http://localhost:4111'; if (!/^http:\/\/(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)[:/]/.test(url)) throw new Error(`Refusing to run against non-local KV: ${url}`); process.env.KV_REST_API_URL = url; process.env.KV_REST_API_TOKEN ??= 'dev'; process.env.KV_URL ??= 'redis://dev'; const cb = await import('../lib/card-back'); const v1 = await import('../lib/card-back-v1'); const lay = await import('../lib/card-back-layout'); const store = await import('../lib/card-back-store'); const kvLib = await import('../lib/kv'); const { kv } = await import('../lib/db'); // sanitizeCardBack: unknown keys dropped, colours validated, template capped. const dirty = v1.sanitizeV1({ evil: 1, background: 'plaid', bg1: 'red', bg2: '#ABC', angle: 725, pattern: 'holes', edge: 'url(x)', text: '#112233', accent: 'javascript:1', font: 'comic', align: 'top', logo: 'url', logoUrl: 'javascript:alert(1)', logoSize: 'XL', line: 'x'.repeat(200), show: { qr: false, history: 'no', bogus: true }, size: { number: 'L', qr: 'XXL' }, }); ok(!('evil' in dirty) && !('bogus' in dirty.show), 'unknown keys dropped'); ok(dirty.background === 'steel' && dirty.bg1 === v1.DEFAULT_V1.bg1 && dirty.bg2 === '#aabbcc', 'bad background and colour fall back; short hex expands'); ok(dirty.angle === 5, 'angle wraps into 0..359'); ok(dirty.edge === 'rarity' && dirty.accent === 'auto' && dirty.text === '#112233', 'edge and accent colours validated, a good one kept'); ok(dirty.font === 'display' && dirty.align === 'top' && dirty.pattern === 'holes' && dirty.logoSize === 'M', 'choices validated'); ok(dirty.logo === 'none' && dirty.logoUrl === '', 'a bad logo address turns the logo off'); ok(dirty.line.length === v1.MAX_LINE, 'custom line capped at the maximum'); ok(dirty.show.qr === false && dirty.show.history === true && dirty.size.number === 'L' && dirty.size.qr === 'M', 'element switches and sizes validated'); ok(v1.sanitizeV1(null).line === '' && v1.sanitizeV1('x').pattern === 'lines', 'junk input gives the default'); ok(v1.sanitizeV1({ logo: 'url', logoUrl: 'https://cdn.example.com/a.png' }).logo === 'url', 'an https logo is kept'); ok(v1.sanitizeV1({ logoUrl: '/assets/x.png', logo: 'url' }).logoUrl === '/assets/x.png' && v1.sanitizeV1({ logoUrl: '//evil.com/x.png', logo: 'url' }).logo === 'none', 'site paths are kept, protocol-relative ones are not'); ok(v1.sanitizeV1({ cover: 'https://x/y.png', lineText: 'hi' }).cover === undefined, 'runtime-only fields are never stored'); // ── v2: the upgrade, the sanitiser, the layout engine ── const PRINT = { n: 7, uid: 1023381, total: 12, variantLabel: 'Shiny Full Art', name: 'Gouda Goat', date: '12 OCT 2026', origin: 'Pulled live on stream', holder: '@alice', hex: '#a855f7', history: [{ text: 'Pulled by @alice', date: '12 OCT 2026' }], href: '/copy/s1/x', qrUrl: 'https://example.com/copy/s1/x' }; const SIZE = { w: 220, h: 330 }; // DEFAULT_CARD_BACK is today's plate; no key renders it too. ok(cb.DEFAULT_CARD_BACK.v === 2 && cb.isDefaultCardBack(cb.DEFAULT_CARD_BACK) && cb.isDefaultCardBack(cb.sanitizeCardBack({})) && cb.isDefaultCardBack(cb.sanitizeCardBack(null)), 'the default design is the default, and junk input gives it'); ok(!cb.isDefaultCardBack(cb.sanitizeCardBack({ pattern: 'none' })), 'a changed design is not the default'); ok(cb.resolveCardBack(null, { packName: 'P' }) === undefined, 'no stored design gives no style (the classic plate renders)'); ok(kinds(cb.DEFAULT_CARD_BACK) === 'brand,number,edition,name,date,origin,history,qr,link', 'the classic plate: site name, number, edition, name, date, origin, history, QR, link, in that order'); ok(kinds(cb.DEFAULT_CARD_BACK, { ...PRINT, uid: undefined, total: undefined, date: undefined, origin: undefined, holder: undefined, history: undefined, href: undefined, qrUrl: undefined }) === 'brand,number,name,qr,link', 'an empty print keeps the footer row but drops what is missing'); ok(kinds(cb.DEFAULT_CARD_BACK, PRINT, { compact: true }) === 'brand,number,edition,name,date,qr,link', 'a compact back hides origin and history, and the QR code has nothing to draw (the footer row stays)'); // Every v1 design renders as it did: the plate, the per-element colours, shadows, sizes and fonts equal the v1 variables. const designs: [string, unknown][] = [ ['default', {}], ['clean', v1.PRESETS_V1[1].style], ['gold', v1.PRESETS_V1[2].style], ['art', v1.PRESETS_V1[3].style], ['text only', { text: '#112233' }], ['accent only', { accent: '#ff00ff' }], ['mono big', { font: 'mono', size: { number: 'L', edition: 'S', name: 'L', date: 'S', origin: 'L', history: 'S', qr: 'L' } }], ['hidden', { show: { number: false, date: false, history: false, qr: false }, align: 'bottom' }], ['line + url logo', { line: 'Hello {pack}', logo: 'url', logoUrl: 'https://cdn.example.com/l.png', logoSize: 'L' }], ]; const nodesByDesign: Record<string, unknown> = {}; for (const [name, raw] of designs) { const old = v1.sanitizeV1(raw); old.cover = 'https://cdn.example.com/cover.png'; const up = cb.upgradeCardBack(old); up.cover = old.cover; up.packName = 'Base'; up.seasonName = 'S1'; const ov = v1.cardBackVars(old, PRINT.hex); const pv = cb.plateVars(up, PRINT.hex); ok(pv['--edge'] === ov['--edge'] && pv['--plate-bg'] === ov['--plate-bg'] && pv['--plate-justify'] === ov['--plate-justify'], `${name}: plate edge, background and position equal the v1 design's`); const nodes = lay.layoutBack(up, PRINT, SIZE); nodesByDesign[name] = nodes; for (const n of nodes) { const gold = n.cls.includes('gold'); const isAccent = n.kind === 'brand' || n.kind === 'link'; const inkNow = isAccent ? - The binder loads faster.')); ok(badOverride && badOverride.title === 'Binder speed', 'a Title: line naming a tool falls back to the PR title'); // the 500-character cap per item const long = parseChangelogBody(`## Changelog
- ${'a'.repeat(900)}`); ok(long && long.items[0].length === MAX_ITEM_LENGTH, 'an item is capped at 500 characters'); // buildEntries: order, cutoff, em dash dropped, nothing leaks const built = buildEntries([ pr(20, 'Older', '## Changelog
- An older thing.', [], '2026-10-17T09:00:00Z'), pr(21, 'Newer', '## Changelog
- A newer thing.', [], '2026-10-19T09:00:00Z'), pr(22, 'Same day later', `## Changelog
- Another thing ${footer}`, [], '2026-10-19T12:00:00Z'), pr(23, 'Dashy', `## Changelog
- A thing ${EM} with a dash.`, [], '2026-10-19T13:00:00Z'), pr(24, 'Before ship', '## Changelog
- Too old.', [], '2026-10-01T09:00:00Z'), pr(25, 'Internal', '## Changelog
none', [], '2026-10-19T14:00:00Z'), ], '2026-10-17'); ok(built.entries.map(e => e.pr).join() === '22,21,20', 'entries are newest first, same day by PR number, and older than the cutoff are skipped'); ok(built.problems.length === 1 && /#23/.test(built.problems[0]), 'an entry with an em dash is left out and reported'); ok(built.entries.every(e => !leak(e) && ![e.title, ...e.items].join('').includes(EM)), 'no generated entry mentions a tool or contains an em dash'); // whatever the build wrote (the committed state is empty) must be clean too ok(CHANGELOG.filter(e => e.pr !== undefined).every(e => !leak(e)), 'generated entries on disk never mention Claude'); console.log('changelog checks passed');

nodes.name: check-collection-view.mts
nodes.body_text: // Checks the profile's collection filters / sort / progress / compare, the profile experiments' settings and the showcase. Pure. // Run: npx tsx scripts/check-collection-view.mts const v = await import('../lib/collection-view'); const s = await import('../lib/user-settings'); const pd = await import('../lib/profile-data'); const none = { regular: 0, reverse: 0, full: 0, shiny: 0 }; const vals = { regular: 10, reverse: 30, full: 80, shiny: 300 }; const cards = [ mk(1, 'Cheesy Cat', 1, 'A', { regular: 3 }), mk(2, 'Brie Bear', 3, 'A', {}), mk(3, 'Gouda Goat', 5, 'B', { shiny: 1 }), mk(4, 'Swiss Swan', 2, 'B', { regular: 1, reverse: 1 }), ]; eq(run({}), [1, 3, 4], 'default hides uncollected'); eq(run({}, false), [1, 2, 3, 4], 'default shows everything when not hiding'); eq(run({ show: 'missing' }), [2], 'missing'); eq(run({ show: 'dupes' }), [1, 4], 'duplicates are 2+ copies, any version'); eq(run({ show: 'versions' }), [3, 4], 'special versions'); eq(run({ stars: 5, show: 'all' }), [3], 'rarity filter'); eq(run({ pack: 'B', show: 'all' }), [3, 4], 'pack filter'); eq(run({ q: 'swan' }), [4], 'search by name'); eq(run({ q: '#3' }), [3], 'search by number'); eq(run({ sort: 'rarity' }), [3, 4, 1], 'rarity sorts high first'); eq(run({ sort: 'rarity', dir: -1 }), [1, 4, 3], 'direction reverses'); eq(run({ sort: 'value' }), [3, 4, 1], 'points sort: shiny 300 > 10+30 > 3x10'); eq(run({ sort: 'name' }), [1, 3, 4], 'name sorts a to z'); eq(run({ sort: 'copies' }), [1, 4, 3], 'copies sort, ties by number'); eq(v.packProgress(cards), [{ pack: 'A', owned: 1, total: 2, pct: 50 }, { pack: 'B', owned: 2, total: 2, pct: 100 }], 'per-pack progress'); const mine = { 2: 1, 3: 2, 9: 1 }; eq(run({ show: 'theyHave' }, true, mine), [1, 4], 'they have, I lack'); eq(run({ show: 'iHave' }, true, mine), [2], 'I have, they lack'); eq(run({ show: 'shared' }, true, mine), [3], 'both have'); eq(v.compareCollections(cards, mine), { shared: 1, theyHave: 2, iHave: 1, both: 4, total: 4 }, 'comparison counts'); // ── profile experiments ── eq(s.sanitizeUserSettings({ accent: 'nope', wanted: 'x' }).accent, '', 'unknown accent dropped'); eq(s.sanitizeUserSettings({ accent: 'grape' }).accent, 'grape', 'known accent kept'); eq(s.sanitizeUserSettings({ accent: 'teal' }).accent, 'teal', 'new named accent kept'); eq(s.ACCENTS.length, 12, 'twelve named accents'); eq(s.sanitizeUserSettings({ accent: '#1A8CFF' }).accent, '#1a8cff', 'custom accent kept, lower-cased'); eq(s.sanitizeUserSettings({ accent: '#000000' }).accent, '#595959', 'a too-dark custom colour is lightened'); eq(s.sanitizeUserSettings({ accent: '#ffffff' }).accent, '#b3b3b3', 'a too-pale custom colour is darkened'); eq(s.sanitizeUserSettings({ accent: '#fff' }).accent, '', 'short hex is not accepted'); eq(s.sanitizeUserSettings({ accent: 'javascript:1' }).accent, '', 'junk dropped'); eq([s.accentHex('grape'), s.accentHex('#1a8cff'), s.accentHex(''), s.accentHex('#000000')], ['#c084fc', '#1a8cff', undefined, '#595959'], 'accentHex for named, custom, empty and unclamped values'); eq(s.sanitizeUserSettings({ wanted: [3, 3, 0, -1, 1.5, '4', 1_000_000, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12] }).wanted, [3, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11], 'wanted: unique ints in range, capped at 6'); ok(!s.EXPERIMENTS.some(e => e.id === 'accent' || e.id === 'showcase' || e.id === 'wishlist'), 'accent, showcase and wishlist are normal settings or widgets now'); eq(s.sparse({ ...s.DEFAULT_SETTINGS, wanted: [2] }), { wanted: [2] }, 'wanted is stored sparsely'); const top = pd.topCopies([info(1), info(2), info(3), info(4)], new Map([[1, { ...none, regular: 5 }], [3, { ...none, regular: 1, shiny: 1 }], [4, { ...none, reverse: 1 }]]), new Map([[1, { values: vals }], [3, { values: vals }], [4, { values: vals }]]), 2); eq(top.map(t => [t.number, t.variant]), [[3, 'shiny'], [4, 'reverse']], 'showcase: best version per card, most valuable first, capped'); console.log('collection view checks passed'); // ── profile widgets ── const w = await import('../lib/profile-widgets'); eq(w.sanitizeProfileLayout(undefined).map(x => x.type), w.DEFAULT_PROFILE_LAYOUT.map(x => x.type), 'no layout = the default'); eq(w.sanitizeProfileLayout([]), [], 'an empty layout stays empty (an owner may clear everything)'); eq(w.sanitizeProfileLayout([{ type: 'stats', span: 99 }, { type: 'stats', span: 4 }, { type: 'nope', span: 4 }, { type: 'wishlist', span: 3 }]), [{ type: 'stats', span: 4 }, { type: 'wishlist', span: 3 }], 'unknown / duplicate widgets dropped, bad spans snap to the default'); ok(w.PROFILE_WIDGET_TYPES.every(t => w.PROFILE_WIDGETS[t].spans.includes(w.PROFILE_WIDGETS[t].defaultSpan)), 'every default span is an allowed span'); ok(w.DEFAULT_PROFILE_LAYOUT.every(p => w.PROFILE_WIDGETS[p.type].spans.includes(p.span)), 'the default layout uses allowed spans'); const withLayout = s.sanitizeUserSettings({ profileLayout: [{ type: 'rarity', span: 12 }, { type: 'bogus' }] }); eq(withLayout.profileLayout, [{ type: 'rarity', span: 12 }], 'settings keep a cleaned layout'); eq(s.sanitizeUserSettings({}).profileLayout, null, 'settings default to no custom layout'); console.log('profile widget checks passed'); // ── The card dialog's print tiles ── { const counts = { regular: 3, reverse: 0, full: 1, shiny: 0 }; const list = [cp('full', 2), cp('regular', 9), cp('regular', 1), cp('regular', 4)]; const d = v.copiesForDialog(list, counts); ok(d.tracked, 'tracked when copies exist'); eq(d.groups.map(g => g.variant), ['regular', 'full'], 'groups in version order, owned only'); eq(d.groups[0].copies.map(c => c.n), [1, 4, 9], 'edition ascending, newest last'); eq([d.total, d.shown, d.more, d.only], [4, 4, 0, null], 'totals'); const capped = v.copiesForDialog(list, counts, 2); eq(capped.groups.map(g => [g.variant, g.count, g.copies.length]), [['regular', 3, 2]], 'cap cuts across groups, counts stay whole'); eq([capped.shown, capped.more], [2, 2], 'cap reports what is left'); eq(v.copiesForDialog(list, counts, Infinity).more, 0, 'Show all lifts the cap'); eq(v.copiesForDialog([cp('shiny', 5)], { ...none, shiny: 1 }).only?.n, 5, 'one print opens straight on it'); const u = v.copiesForDialog(undefined, counts); eq([u.tracked, u.total, u.only], [false, 4, null], 'untracked season'); eq(u.groups.map(g => [g.variant, g.count, g.copies.length]), [['regular', 3, 0], ['full', 1, 0]], 'untracked: one tile per version with a count'); } console.log('copiesForDialog ok'); // ── rarestPrints / bestPrintOf ── { const list = [cp(1, 'regular', 9), cp(1, 'regular', 3), cp(2, 'shiny', 40), cp(3, 'regular', 1), cp(4, 'full', 2), cp(4, 'full', 2)]; const r = v.rarestPrints(list, chance); eq(r.map(c => c.id), ['2.shiny.40', '3.regular.1', '1.regular.3'], 'rarest first, one per card and version (lowest edition), ties to the lower edition, no-odds left out'); eq(v.rarestPrints(list, chance, 1).length, 1, 'limit'); eq(v.rarestPrints([], chance), [], 'nothing held'); eq(v.bestPrintOf(list, 1, 'regular')?.n, 3, 'best print is the lowest edition'); eq(v.bestPrintOf(list, 1, 'shiny'), undefined, 'none of that version'); } console.log('rarestPrints ok');

nodes.name: check-commands.mts
nodes.body_text: // Mix It Up chat commands (ROADMAP 19.2): matching and aliases, cleaning, each action's variables against seeded data, private // collectors masked, cooldowns, dry runs touching nothing, and the show-off action still queueing one event. // Needs the mock KV (node scripts/mock-kv.cjs); refuses anything non-local. Run: npx tsx scripts/check-commands.mts const url = process.env.KV_REST_API_URL ?? 'http://localhost:4111'; if (!/^http:\/\/(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)[:/]/.test(url)) throw new Error(`Refusing to run against non-local KV: ${url}`); process.env.KV_REST_API_URL = url; process.env.KV_REST_API_TOKEN ??= 'dev'; process.env.KV_URL ??= 'redis://dev'; const core = await import('../lib/commands-core'); const kvLib = await import('../lib/kv'); const { encodeEntry } = await import('../lib/variants'); const { kv } = await import('../lib/db'); const ser = await import('../lib/serials'); const cmds = await import('../lib/commands'); const { queueLength, clearQueue } = await import('../lib/webhooks'); // ── Pure ── const base = core.cleanCommands(core.DEFAULT_COMMANDS); ok(base.ok && base.commands.length === 2, 'the defaults are clean'); const list = base.ok ? base.commands : []; ok(core.matchCommand(list, '!ShowOff')?.name === 'showoff' && core.matchCommand(list, 'stats')?.name === 'stats', 'names match without the ! and in any case'); ok(core.matchCommand(list, '!nope') === null && core.matchCommand(list, '') === null && core.matchCommand(list, 7) === null, 'an unknown or empty command matches nothing'); const aliased = core.cleanCommands([{ ...list[0], aliases: '!Flex, brag flex' }]); ok(aliased.ok && aliased.commands[0].aliases.join() === 'flex,brag' && core.matchCommand(aliased.commands, '!brag')?.id === 'showoff', 'aliases are cleaned, unique and match'); ok(!core.cleanCommands([list[0], { ...list[1], aliases: ['showoff'] }]).ok, 'two commands cannot share a word'); ok(core.matchCommand([{ ...list[0], enabled: false }], 'showoff') === null, 'a switched-off command is unknown'); ok(!core.cleanCommands(Array.from({ length: core.MAX_COMMANDS + 1 }, (_, i) => ({ name: `c${i}`, action: 'text' }))).ok, 'at most 30 commands'); ok(core.interpolate('{a} and {nope}!', { a: 'x' }) === 'x and !', 'unknown placeholders are dropped'); const long = core.renderReply('**bold** `code` ' + 'x'.repeat(900), {}); ok(long.length <= core.REPLY_MAX && !/[*`]/.test(long), 'replies are capped and carry no Markdown'); for (const id of core.ACTION_IDS) ok(core.COMMAND_ACTIONS[id].vars.length > 0, `${id} lists its variables`); const flat = core.flatReply(true, 'hi', { cardName: 'Goat', ok: 'x' }); ok(flat.cardName === 'Goat' && flat.ok === true && flat.message === 'hi', 'variables are flattened next to ok and message'); // ── Seeded data ── await kvLib.seedSeason1(); const season = (await kvLib.listSeasons())[0]; await kvLib.setActiveSeason(season.id); const c = season.collectionName; const cards = await kvLib.getPackCards('pack1'); const [a, b] = cards; await kvLib.saveCollection(c, { ann: [encodeEntry(a.number, 'regular'), encodeEntry(a.number, 'shiny'), encodeEntry(b.number, 'regular')], bob: [encodeEntry(a.number, 'regular')], priv: [encodeEntry(a.number, 'regular'), encodeEntry(a.number, 'regular'), encodeEntry(a.number, 'regular'), encodeEntry(a.number, 'regular')], }); await ser.backfillSerials(c, await kvLib.getCollection(c)); await kv.set('users:hidden', ['priv']); const stored = await cmds.getCommands(); ok(stored.map(x => x.name).join() === 'showoff,stats', '!showoff and !stats are seeded on first read'); const unknown = await run('nothing', 'ann'); ok(!unknown.known && !unknown.ok && unknown.message === '', 'an unknown command is silent'); // card-stats let r = await run('stats', 'ann', a.name); ok(r.ok && r.vars.cardName === a.name && r.vars.number === String(a.number) && /^1 in \d/.test(r.vars.pullChance), '!stats answers with the card'); ok(r.vars.yourPrints === '2' && r.vars.printsMade === '7', `!stats counts prints (${r.vars.printsMade}) and the caller's own (${r.vars.yourPrints})`); ok(r.vars.topHolder === 'a private collector', 'a hidden top holder is not named'); ok(r.vars.collectors === '2', `collectors leave out the hidden one (${r.vars.collectors})`); ok(r.vars.firstPulledBy !== 'priv' && r.vars.url.includes(`card=${a.number}`), 'the first puller and link are filled'); ok(!JSON.stringify(r).includes('"priv"'), 'the private collector never appears by name'); ok(r.message.includes(a.name) && r.message.includes('prints made'), 'the reply is built from the template'); r = await run('stats', 'ann', `#${b.number}`); ok(r.ok && r.vars.cardName === b.name, 'a card number works too'); r = await run('stats', 'ann', 'zzzz not a card'); ok(!r.ok && /could not find/.test(r.message), 'an unknown card is a refusal'); r = await run('stats', 'ann', ''); ok(!r.ok && /Which card/.test(r.message), 'no card named asks which'); // my-stats const mine = core.cleanCommands([{ name: 'me', action: 'my-stats', reply: '#{rank} {score} {cards}/{totalCards}' }]); const withMe = mine.ok ? mine.commands : []; let m = await ms('ann'); ok(m.ok && m.vars.cards === '2' && m.vars.prints === '3' && Number(m.vars.score) > 0 && /^\d+$/.test(m.vars.rank), 'my-stats reports the caller'); m = await ms('bob', '@priv'); ok(!m.ok && /keeps their stats private/.test(m.message), "someone else's private stats are refused"); m = await ms('priv'); ok(m.ok && m.vars.prints === '4', 'a private collector can see their own stats'); m = await ms('ann', '@bob'); ok(m.ok && m.vars.prints === '1', '@someone looks at another collector'); m = await ms('ghost'); ok(!m.ok, 'a viewer with no cards gets a refusal'); // leaderboard, text, pulls-left const more = core.cleanCommands([ { name: 'top', action: 'leaderboard', reply: '{first} | {second} | {third}' }, { name: 'hi', action: 'text', reply: 'Hi {username} {args}' }, { name: 'left', action: 'pulls-left', reply: '{left} of {limit}' }, ]); const other = more.ok ? more.commands : []; let t = await o('top'); ok(t.ok && t.message.includes('ann (') && !t.message.includes('priv'), 'the leaderboard names the top collectors and leaves out hidden ones'); t = await o('hi', 'Ann', 'there'); ok(t.ok && t.message === 'Hi ann there', 'text fills {username} and {args}'); t = await o('left'); ok(!t.ok && /off/.test(t.message), 'pulls-left says so while paid pulls are off'); // ── Show-off: one real event, none in a dry run ── await clearQueue(); await kv.del('showoff:cd:ann'); r = await run('showoff', 'ann', a.name, true); ok(r.ok && (await queueLength()) === 0, 'a dry show-off queues nothing'); ok((await kv.get('showoff:cd:ann')) === null, 'and spends no cooldown'); r = await run('showoff', 'ann', a.name); ok(r.ok && r.vars.cardName === a.name && r.vars.variant === 'Shiny Full Art' && (await queueLength()) === 1, 'a real show-off queues one event'); ok(r.message.startsWith('Showing off your Shiny'), `the reply reads as before: ${r.message}`); r = await run('showoff', 'ann', a.name); ok(!r.ok && /try again/.test(r.message) && (await queueLength()) === 1, 'the show-off cooldown still holds and queues nothing'); await kv.del('showoff:cd:ann'); r = await run('showoff', 'bob', b.name); ok(!r.ok && /don't have/.test(r.message) && (await queueLength()) === 1, 'a card they do not own queues nothing'); // ── Cooldowns and error texts ── const cd = core.cleanCommands([{ name: 'cool', action: 'text', reply: 'ok', cooldownS: 30, userCooldownS: 0, errors: { cooldown: 'Slow down {username}' } }, { name: 'peruser', action: 'text', reply: 'ok', userCooldownS: 30 }]); const cdl = cd.ok ? cd.commands : []; ok((await k('cool', 'ann', true)).ok && (await k('cool', 'ann', true)).ok, 'a dry run never spends the cooldown'); ok((await k('cool', 'ann')).ok, 'the first run works'); const second = await k('cool', 'bob'); ok(!second.ok && second.message === 'Slow down bob', "the command's own cooldown text is used, with the viewer's name"); ok((await k('peruser', 'ann')).ok && !(await k('peruser', 'ann')).ok && (await k('peruser', 'bob')).ok, 'a per-viewer cooldown holds one viewer only'); // ── The log and counts ── const log = await cmds.getCommandLog(); ok(log.length > 0 && log.every(e => e.what === 'command'), 'runs are logged'); const stats = await cmds.getCommandStats(); ok((stats.showoff?.count ?? 0) >= 1 && (stats.stats?.count ?? 0) >= 1, 'runs are counted'); const before = (await cmds.getCommandLog()).length; await run('stats', 'ann', a.name, true); ok((await cmds.getCommandLog()).length === before, 'a dry run is not logged'); console.log('commands checks passed');

nodes.name: check-dashboard-layout.mts
nodes.body_text: // Checks the per-person dashboard layout: own key, fallback to the shared layout, the password login, and team layouts. // Needs the mock KV (node scripts/mock-kv.cjs) with KV_REST_API_URL / KV_REST_API_TOKEN pointing at it. // Run: npx tsx scripts/check-dashboard-layout.mts process.env.KV_REST_API_URL ||= 'http://localhost:4111'; process.env.KV_REST_API_TOKEN ||= 'dev'; process.env.KV_URL ||= 'redis://dev'; const data = await import('../lib/dashboard-data'); const dash = await import('../lib/dashboard'); const minimal = { widgets: [{ type: 'overview' as const, span: 12 }] }; const other = { widgets: [{ type: 'attention' as const, span: 12 }] }; ok(dash.loginForLayout({ login: 'sam', via: 'twitch' }) === 'sam', 'a Twitch staff member uses their own login'); ok(dash.loginForLayout({ login: 'password', via: 'password' }) === null && dash.loginForLayout(null) === null, 'the password login and nobody use the shared layout'); ok(data.layoutKeyFor('Sam') === data.layoutKeyFor('sam') && data.layoutKeyFor('sam') !== 'admin:dashboard', 'keys are per login, case-insensitive'); ok(data.layoutKeyFor('notes') !== 'admin:dashboard:notes' && data.layoutKeyFor('presets') !== 'admin:dashboard:presets', 'a login named notes or presets cannot hit those keys'); ok(data.layoutKeyFor(null) === 'admin:dashboard', 'no login is the shared key'); ok(JSON.stringify(await data.getDashboardLayout('sam')) === JSON.stringify(dash.DEFAULT_LAYOUT), 'nothing saved: the default'); await data.saveDashboardLayout(minimal, null); // the layout everyone had before ok((await data.getDashboardLayout('sam')).widgets.length === 1, 'a person with no layout of their own gets the shared one'); await data.saveDashboardLayout(other, 'sam'); ok((await data.getDashboardLayout('sam')).widgets[0].type === 'attention', 'their own layout wins'); ok((await data.getDashboardLayout('jo')).widgets[0].type === 'overview', 'saving does not touch anyone else'); ok((await data.getDashboardLayout(null)).widgets[0].type === 'overview', 'nor the shared layout'); await data.resetDashboardLayout('sam'); ok((await data.getDashboardLayout('sam')).widgets[0].type === 'overview', 'resetting returns to the shared layout'); await data.saveDashboardPreset('Stream day', minimal, 'sam'); const presets = await data.getDashboardPresets(); ok(presets[0].name === 'Stream day' && presets[0].by === 'sam', 'team layouts remember who saved them'); await data.saveDashboardPreset('Old one', minimal); ok((await data.getDashboardPresets()).find(p => p.name === 'Old one')?.by === undefined, 'older team layouts have no author'); console.log('ok');

nodes.body_text: // Checks the built-in dashboard layouts: each one is already clean (sanitizing changes nothing) and uses the widgets it should. // Run: npx tsx scripts/check-dashboard-presets.mts const d = await import('../lib/dashboard'); const names = d.BUILTIN_PRESETS.map(p => p.name); ok(names.join() === 'Stream night,Season overview,Trading desk,Minimal', 'the four built-in layouts'); ok(new Set(names).size === names.length, 'names are unique'); for (const p of d.BUILTIN_PRESETS) { ok(JSON.stringify(d.sanitizeLayout(p.layout)) === JSON.stringify(p.layout), `${p.name} sanitizes to itself (known widgets, no repeats, allowed spans)`); ok(p.layout.widgets.length > 0 && p.name.length <= 30, `${p.name} is not empty and its name fits`); } ok(types('Stream night') === want('live', 'overlay-controls', 'activity', 'pulls-chart', 'quick-actions', 'recap'), 'Stream night widgets'); ok(types('Season overview') === want('overview', 'pulls-chart', 'top-collectors', 'rarity', 'packs', 'card-ownership', 'digest'), 'Season overview widgets'); ok(types('Trading desk') === want('trades', 'attention', 'activity', 'leaderboard'), 'Trading desk widgets'); ok(types('Minimal') === want('overview', 'attention', 'quick-actions'), 'Minimal widgets'); console.log('ok');

nodes.name: check-data-health.mts
nodes.body_text: // Data health: sizes of the stored collections, the serial ledger and the capped lists, and the dashboard's size warning. // Needs the mock KV (npm run check starts it); refuses anything non-local. // Run: npx tsx scripts/check-data-health.mts const url = process.env.KV_REST_API_URL ?? 'http://localhost:4111'; if (!/^http:\/\/(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)[:/]/.test(url)) throw new Error(`Refusing to run against non-local KV: ${url}`); process.env.KV_REST_API_URL = url; process.env.KV_REST_API_TOKEN ??= 'dev'; process.env.KV_URL ??= 'redis://dev'; const dh = await import('../lib/data-health'); const kvLib = await import('../lib/kv'); const serials = await import('../lib/serials'); const { prodKv } = await import('../lib/db'); // ---- pure ---- ok(dh.formatBytes(0) === '0 B' && dh.formatBytes(1023) === '1023 B' && dh.formatBytes(2048) === '2.0 KB' && dh.formatBytes(3 * 1_048_576) === '3.00 MB', 'sizes read naturally'); ok(dh.jsonBytes(null) === 0 && dh.jsonBytes(undefined) === 0 && dh.jsonBytes({ a: [1, 2] }) === 11, 'jsonBytes counts the stored text'); ok(dh.jsonBytes({ n: 'é' }) === Buffer.byteLength('{"n":"é"}'), 'jsonBytes counts UTF-8 bytes, not characters'); ok(dh.healthLevel(dh.BLOB_WARN_BYTES - 1) === 'ok' && dh.healthLevel(dh.BLOB_WARN_BYTES) === 'warn' && dh.healthLevel(dh.BLOB_HIGH_BYTES - 1) === 'warn' && dh.healthLevel(dh.BLOB_HIGH_BYTES) === 'high', 'levels switch at 512 KB and 2 MB'); const sum = dh.summarizeCollection({ alice: [1, 1, 2], bob: [3], carol: [] }); ok(sum.viewers === 3 && sum.entries === 4 && sum.largest?.username === 'alice' && sum.largest.entries === 3, 'collection summary counts viewers, copies and the biggest holder'); ok(sum.bytes === dh.jsonBytes({ alice: [1, 1, 2], bob: [3], carol: [] }), 'collection size is the stored size'); const empty = dh.summarizeCollection({}); ok(empty.viewers === 0 && empty.entries === 0 && empty.largest === null && empty.bytes === 2, 'an empty collection is fine'); ok(dh.sizeAttention('Season 1', 1000) === null, 'no warning while small'); const warn = dh.sizeAttention('Season 1', 600 * 1024); ok(warn?.level === 'warn' && warn.text.includes('Season 1') && warn.text.includes('600.0 KB'), 'a warning names the season and the size'); ok(dh.sizeAttention('Season 1', 3 * 1_048_576)?.level === 'high', 'a very large collection is flagged high'); ok(!warn!.text.includes(String.fromCharCode(8212)), 'no em dash in the copy'); // ---- measured against the mock KV ---- await kvLib.seedSeason1(); const season = (await kvLib.listSeasons())[0]; const coll = season.collectionName; await prodKv.set(`tcg_${coll}`, { alice: [1, 1, 2, 3], bob: [4], carol: [5, 6] }); let h = await dh.loadDataHealth(season.id); const row = h.seasons.find(s => s.id === season.id)!; ok(!!row && row.active, 'the published season is listed and marked active'); ok(row.collection.viewers === 3 && row.collection.entries === 7 && row.collection.largest?.username === 'alice', 'measured viewers, entries and largest holder'); ok(row.collection.bytes === dh.jsonBytes({ alice: [1, 1, 2, 3], bob: [4], carol: [5, 6] }) && row.level === 'ok', 'measured size and level'); ok(!row.ledger.tracking && row.ledger.live === 0 && row.ledger.ownerEntries === 0 && row.ledger.largestOwner === null, 'an unnumbered season has no ledger numbers'); ok(h.trades.openCount === 0 && h.trades.historyCount === 0 && h.activityEvents === 0, 'empty trades and activity read as zero'); // Draft seasons are not measured. await kvLib.saveSeason({ ...season, id: 'draft-x', name: 'Draft', status: 'draft', collectionName: 'DraftX' }); await prodKv.set('seasons:list', [...((await prodKv.get<string[]>('seasons:list')) ?? []), 'draft-x']); h = await dh.loadDataHealth(null); ok(h.seasons.every(s => s.id !== 'draft-x'), 'draft seasons are skipped'); ok(h.seasons.every(s => !s.active), 'no season is marked active when none is given'); // Number the copies, then the ledger shows up. await serials.backfillSerials(coll, await kvLib.getCollection(coll)); h = await dh.loadDataHealth(season.id); const led = h.seasons.find(s => s.id === season.id)!.ledger; ok(led.tracking && led.live === 7 && led.retired === 0, 'a tracked season reports its live copies'); ok(led.editions >= 6 && led.ownerEntries > 0 && led.largestOwner?.username === 'alice' && !led.sampled, 'the ledger reports editions and per-viewer entries'); // Trades and activity. await prodKv.set('trades:open', [{ id: 't1' }, { id: 't2' }]); await prodKv.set('trades:history', [{ id: 'h1' }, { id: 'h2' }, { id: 'h3' }]); await prodKv.lpush('activity:log', { id: 1 }); await prodKv.lpush('activity:log', { id: 2 }); h = await dh.loadDataHealth(season.id); ok(h.trades.openCount === 2 && h.trades.historyCount === 3 && h.trades.historyBytes === dh.jsonBytes([{ id: 'h1' }, { id: 'h2' }, { id: 'h3' }]), 'trade offers and history are measured'); ok(h.activityEvents === 2, 'activity events are counted'); console.log('data health checks passed');

nodes.name: check-dex.mts
nodes.body_text: // Checks the Card Dex's filtering and sorting. Pure. Run: npx tsx scripts/check-dex.mts const d = await import('../lib/dex-view'); const cards = [ c(1, 'Cheesy Cat', 1, 'A', 0.2, 30, 10, 10, true), c(2, 'Brie Bear', 3, 'A', 0.05, 4, 3, 60, false, true), c(3, 'Gouda Goat', 5, 'B', 0.01, 0, 0, 300, false), c(4, 'Swiss Swan', 2, 'B', 0.1, 12, 6, 25, true), ]; eq(run({}), [1, 2, 3, 4], 'default: card number'); eq(run({ sort: 'rarity' }), [3, 2, 4, 1], 'rarest first = smallest pull rate first'); eq(run({ sort: 'rarity', dir: -1 }), [1, 4, 2, 3], 'reversed'); eq(run({ sort: 'value' }), [3, 2, 4, 1], 'most valuable first'); eq(run({ sort: 'copies' }), [1, 4, 2, 3], 'most pulled first'); eq(run({ sort: 'collectors' }), [1, 4, 2, 3], 'most collectors first'); eq(run({ sort: 'name' }), [2, 1, 3, 4], 'name a to z'); eq(run({ sort: 'missing' }), [2, 3, 1, 4], 'missing first, ties by number'); eq(run({ show: 'collected' }), [1, 4], 'collected'); eq(run({ show: 'missing' }), [2, 3], 'missing'); eq(run({ show: 'wanted' }), [2], 'wanted'); eq(run({ show: 'undiscovered' }), [3], 'undiscovered = nobody has pulled it'); eq(run({ stars: 3 }), [2], 'rarity'); eq(run({ pack: 'B' }), [3, 4], 'pack'); eq(run({ q: 'swan' }), [4], 'search by name'); eq(run({ q: '#2' }), [2], 'search by number'); eq(d.dexProgress(cards), { owned: 2, total: 4, pct: 50 }, 'progress'); eq(d.dexProgress([]), { owned: 0, total: 0, pct: 0 }, 'progress of nothing'); console.log('dex checks passed');

nodes.body_text: // Discord channels: the old single-webhook settings become one "Activity" channel, events fan out to every channel that wants them (each // failure isolated), the form's input is validated, and only discord.com / local stand-in URLs are ever called. Uses a local fake webhook // endpoint and the mock KV (node scripts/mock-kv.cjs). Run: npx tsx scripts/check-discord.mts import { createServer } from 'node:http'; import type { AddressInfo } from 'node:net'; const url = process.env.KV_REST_API_URL ?? 'http://localhost:4111'; if (!/^http:\/\/(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)[:/]/.test(url)) throw new Error(`Refusing to run against non-local KV: ${url}`); process.env.KV_REST_API_URL = url; process.env.KV_REST_API_TOKEN ??= 'dev'; process.env.KV_URL ??= 'redis://dev'; const hits: { path: string; body: { allowed_mentions: unknown; embeds: { title?: string; description?: string }[] } }[] = []; const server = createServer((req, res) => { let data = ''; req.on('data', d => (data += d)); req.on('end', () => { if (req.url?.includes('/999/')) { res.statusCode = 404; res.end(JSON.stringify({ message: 'Unknown Webhook' })); return; } hits.push({ path: req.url ?? '', body: JSON.parse(data) }); res.statusCode = 204; res.end(); }); }); await new Promise<void>(r => server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', r)); const port = (server.address() as AddressInfo).port; const d = await import('../lib/discord'); const kvLib = await import('../lib/kv'); const { kv } = await import('../lib/db'); await kvLib.seedSeason1(); // ── Address checks ── ok(d.isValidDiscordWebhookUrl('https://discord.com/api/webhooks/123/abc-DEF_1'), 'a real discord.com webhook is accepted'); ok(!d.isValidDiscordWebhookUrl('https://evil.example/api/webhooks/123/abc'), 'another host is refused'); ok(!d.isValidDiscordWebhookUrl('https://discord.com.evil.example/api/webhooks/123/abc'), 'a look-alike host is refused'); ok(!d.isValidDiscordWebhookUrl('http://discord.com/api/webhooks/123/abc'), 'plain http to discord.com is refused'); // ── The old single-webhook shape becomes one Activity channel ── const old = { url: hook(1), enabled: true, categories: { pulls: true, cards: false, stream: true, resets: false }, minStars: 3, newOnly: true }; const n = d.normalize(old as never); ok(n.enabled && n.channels.length === 1, 'old settings give one channel'); const c0 = n.channels[0]; ok(c0.name === 'Activity' && c0.enabled && c0.url === old.url && c0.minStars === 3 && c0.newOnly, 'the channel keeps the old url, filters and switch'); ok(c0.categories.pulls && !c0.categories.cards && c0.categories.stream && !c0.categories.resets, 'the channel keeps the old category boxes'); ok(d.normalize({ url: '', enabled: false } as never).channels.length === 0, 'an old empty webhook gives no channel'); ok(d.normalize(null).channels.length === 0 && !d.normalize(null).enabled, 'nothing stored gives no channels'); await kv.set('discord:settings', old); ok((await d.getDiscordSettings()).channels[0].name === 'Activity', 'the stored old shape is read as a channel'); // ── Validation of the form ── ok(!d.cleanDiscordInput('nope').ok, 'junk is refused'); ok(d.cleanDiscordInput({ enabled: true, channels: Array.from({ length: 25 }, (_, i) => ch({ id: 'c' + i })) }).ok, '25 channels are accepted'); ok(!d.cleanDiscordInput({ enabled: true, channels: Array.from({ length: 26 }, (_, i) => ch({ id: 'c' + i })) }).ok, 'more than 25 channels is refused'); ok(!d.cleanDiscordInput({ enabled: true, channels: [ch({ url: 'https://evil.example/x' })] }).ok, 'a bad address is refused'); ok(!d.cleanDiscordInput({ enabled: true, channels: [ch({ url: '' })] }).ok, 'an enabled channel needs an address'); const dup = d.cleanDiscordInput({ enabled: true, channels: [ch({ id: 'a' }), ch({ id: 'a', name: ' ' })] }); ok(dup.ok && dup.settings.channels[0].id !== dup.settings.channels[1].id && dup.settings.channels[1].name === 'Channel', 'ids stay unique and a blank name gets a default'); // ── Fan-out ── await d.saveDiscordSettings({ enabled: true, channels: [ { id: 'pulls', name: 'Pulls', url: hook(1), enabled: true, categories: cats({ pulls: true }), minStars: 1, newOnly: false }, { id: 'rare', name: 'Rare', url: hook(2), enabled: true, categories: cats({ pulls: true }), minStars: 5, newOnly: false }, { id: 'cards', name: 'Cards', url: hook(3), enabled: true, categories: cats({ cards: true }), minStars: 1, newOnly: false }, { id: 'off', name: 'Off', url: hook(4), enabled: false, categories: cats({ pulls: true }), minStars: 1, newOnly: false }, { id: 'gone', name: 'Gone', url: hook(999), enabled: true, categories: cats({ pulls: true }), minStars: 1, newOnly: false }, ], }); // ── Send last activity: the newest event the channel's filters allow ── { const evs = [event({ type: 'grant', seq: 3 }), event({ stars: 2, seq: 2 }), event({ stars: 4, seq: 1 })] as never[]; ok(pick({ categories: cats({ cards: true }) }) === 3, 'last activity: a Cards channel gets the newest grant'); ok(pick({ categories: cats({ pulls: true }), minStars: 1 }) === 2, 'last activity: a Pulls channel skips the grant'); ok(pick({ categories: cats({ pulls: true }), minStars: 3 }) === 1, 'last activity: the star filter skips the 2 star pull'); ok(pick({ categories: cats({ upgrades: true }) }) === undefined, 'last activity: nothing matching gives nothing'); } await d.notifyDiscord(event()); ok(hits.length === 1, `a 4 star pull reaches the Pulls channel (the deleted webhook answers 404 and affects nobody else; got ${hits.length})`); ok(hits.some(h => h.path.includes('/1/')), 'the Pulls channel got it'); ok(!hits.some(h => h.path.includes('/2/')), 'the 5 star channel did not'); ok(!hits.some(h => h.path.includes('/3/') || h.path.includes('/4/')), 'the Cards channel and the switched-off channel did not'); hits.length = 0; await d.notifyDiscord(event({ stars: 5 })); ok(hits.length === 2 && hits.some(h => h.path.includes('/2/')), 'a 5 star pull also reaches the 5 star channel'); hits.length = 1; const body0 = hits[0]; const body = body0.body; ok(JSON.stringify(body.allowed_mentions) === '{"parse":[]}', 'mentions stay empty'); ok(!/[^\\]<@everyone>/.test(body.embeds[0].title ?? '') || /\\/.test(body.embeds[0].title ?? ''), 'names are escaped'); hits.length = 0; await d.notifyDiscord(event({ type: 'grant', source: 'admin' })); ok(hits.length === 1 && hits[0].path.includes('/3/'), 'a grant reaches only the Cards channel'); hits.length = 0; await d.saveDiscordSettings({ ...(await d.getDiscordSettings()), enabled: false }); await d.notifyDiscord(event()); ok(hits.length === 0, 'the master switch silences every channel'); // ── Upgrades, trades, admin log, system (3.2) ── { const o = d.normalize({ url: hook(1), enabled: true, categories: { pulls: false, cards: true, stream: false, resets: false } } as never).channels[0]; ok(o.categories.upgrades && o.categories.trades && !o.categories.admin && !o.categories.system, 'an old channel with cards ticked gets upgrades and trades ticked'); const o2 = d.normalize({ url: hook(1), enabled: true, categories: { pulls: true, cards: false, stream: false, resets: false } } as never).channels[0]; ok(!o2.categories.upgrades && !o2.categories.trades, 'an old channel without cards stays without them'); const saved = d.normalize({ enabled: true, channels: [{ id: 'x', name: 'x', url: hook(1), enabled: true, categories: { ...cats({}), cards: true }, minStars: 1, newOnly: false }] } as never).channels[0]; ok(!saved.categories.upgrades, 'a channel saved with explicit boxes is left as it is'); } ok(d.categoryOf(event({ type: 'upgrade' })) === 'upgrades' && d.categoryOf(event({ type: 'trade' })) === 'trades' && d.categoryOf(event({ type: 'grant' })) === 'cards', 'upgrades and trades have their own categories'); await d.saveDiscordSettings({ enabled: true, channels: [ { id: 'up', name: 'Up', url: hook(11), enabled: true, categories: cats({ upgrades: true }), minStars: 1, newOnly: false }, { id: 'tr', name: 'Tr', url: hook(12), enabled: true, categories: cats({ trades: true }), minStars: 1, newOnly: false }, { id: 'ad', name: 'Ad', url: hook(13), enabled: true, categories: cats({ admin: true }), minStars: 1, newOnly: false }, { id: 'sy', name: 'Sy', url: hook(14), enabled: true, categories: cats({ system: true }), minStars: 1, newOnly: false }, { id: 'ca', name: 'Ca', url: hook(15), enabled: true, categories: cats({ cards: true }), minStars: 1, newOnly: false }, ], }); hits.length = 0; await d.notifyDiscord(event({ type: 'upgrade', cardName: 'Cat', from: 'regular', to: 'shiny', cost: 3, uid: 1023381, copyId: '1.3.1' })); ok(only(11), 'an upgrade reaches only the Upgrades channel'); ok(JSON.stringify(hits[0].body).includes('Print #1023381') && JSON.stringify(hits[0].body).includes('/c/1023381'), 'the upgrade embed names and links the print'); hits.length = 0; await d.notifyDiscord(event({ type: 'trade', action: 'accepted', partner: 'bob', kind: 'direct', give: ['a'], get: ['b'], givePts: 1, getPts: 1 })); ok(only(12), 'a completed trade reaches only the Trades channel'); hits.length = 0; await d.notifyDiscord(event({ type: 'trade', action: 'declined', partner: 'bob', kind: 'direct', give: ['a'], get: ['b'], givePts: 1, getPts: 1 })); ok(hits.length === 0, 'a declined trade is still not posted'); hits.length = 0; await d.notifyDiscord(event({ type: 'grant', source: 'admin', staff: 'melody' })); ok(hits.length === 2 && hits.some(h => h.path.includes('/13/')) && hits.some(h => h.path.includes('/15/')), 'a staff grant reaches Cards and the admin log'); const withName = hits.find(h => h.path.includes('/13/'))!, without = hits.find(h => h.path.includes('/15/'))!; ok(JSON.stringify(withName.body).includes('melody'), 'the admin log names the staff member'); ok(!JSON.stringify(without.body).includes('melody'), 'other channels never name staff'); hits.length = 0; await d.notifyAdminLog({ action: 'Tag added', subject: 'alice', detail: 'vip', by: 'melody' }); await wait(); ok(only(13) && JSON.stringify(hits[0].body).includes('melody'), 'an audit entry reaches only the admin log, with the name'); hits.length = 0; await d.notifyAdminLog({ action: 'Card removed', subject: 'alice', by: 'melody' }); await wait(); ok(hits.length === 0, 'an audit entry that has an activity event of its own is not posted twice'); hits.length = 0; await d.notifySystem({ title: 'Backup saved', tone: 'good' }); await wait(); ok(only(14), 'a system notice reaches only the System channel'); hits.length = 0; const { runInSandbox } = await import('../lib/db'); await runInSandbox('some-sandbox', async () => { await d.notifySystem({ title: 'x' }); await d.notifyAdminLog({ action: 'y' }); await d.notifyDiscord(event({ type: 'grant', source: 'admin', staff: 'a' })).catch(() => {}); }); await wait(); ok(!hits.some(h => h.path.includes('/11/') || h.path.includes('/14/')) && !hits.some(h => JSON.stringify(h.body).includes('"y"')), 'system and admin notices are silent in a sandbox'); // ── Delivery log (3.6) ── await d.saveDiscordSettings({ enabled: true, channels: [ { id: 'dead', name: 'Dead', url: hook(999), enabled: true, categories: cats({ pulls: true }), minStars: 1, newOnly: false }, { id: 'alive', name: 'Alive', url: hook(51), enabled: true, categories: cats({ pulls: true }), minStars: 1, newOnly: false }, ], }); ''), 'and says it was granted by webhook'); ok(['Pack', 'Collected', 'Edition'].every(n => emb.fields?.some(f => f.name === n)), 'with the same Pack, Collected and Edition fields'); hits.length = 0; await d.notifyDiscord(wg({ stars: 2 })); ok(hits.length === 0, 'the Pulls channel star filter applies to it'); hits.length = 0; await d.notifyDiscord(wg({ source: 'admin' })); ok(hits.length === 1 && hits[0].path.includes('/62/') && /Card granted/.test(hits[0].body.embeds[0].title ?? ''), 'an admin grant still goes to the Cards channel as before'); hits.length = 0; await d.notifyDiscord(wg({ stars: undefined, packName: undefined, cardName: undefined, uniqueOwned: undefined, isNew: undefined, copies: undefined, serial: undefined })); ok(hits.length === 1 && /Granted by webhook/.test(hits[0].body.embeds[0].description ?? ''), 'an older webhook grant without the extra facts still posts'); // ── Trade listings (3.4) ── await d.saveDiscordSettings({ enabled: true, channels: [ { id: 'li', name: 'Li', url: hook(31), enabled: true, categories: cats({ listings: true }), minStars: 1, newOnly: false }, { id: 'tr2', name: 'Tr2', url: hook(32), enabled: true, categories: cats({ trades: true }), minStars: 1, newOnly: false }, ], }); hits.length = 0; await d.notifyListing({ id: 'abc-123', from: 'al_ice', expiresAt: Date.now() + 3600_000, give: ['2× Cat (Shiny) · #7, #3'], get: ['1× Dog'], givePts: 120, getPts: 80, note: '@everyone hi' }); await wait(); ok(only(31), 'a listing reaches only the Trade listings channel'); const lj = JSON.stringify(hits[0].body); ok(lj.includes('/trade/abc-123') && lj.includes('#7, #3') && lj.includes('<t:') && lj.includes('Gives') && lj.includes('Wants'), 'the listing links to its trade page and shows both sides, editio
