nodes.name: check-seasons.mts
nodes.body_text: // Checks the season lifecycle: awards, schedule timing, activation wrapping up the old season, the lazy scheduler and the trading freeze. // Needs the mock KV running (node scripts/mock-kv.cjs); refuses anything non-local. Run: npx tsx scripts/check-seasons.mts const url = process.env.KV_REST_API_URL ?? 'http://localhost:4111'; if (!/^http:\/\/(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)[:/]/.test(url)) throw new Error(`Refusing to run against non-local KV: ${url}`); process.env.KV_REST_API_URL = url; process.env.KV_REST_API_TOKEN ??= 'dev'; process.env.KV_URL ??= 'redis://dev'; const { encodeEntry } = await import('../lib/variants'); // ── Pure: timing badges, due-schedule detection and awards ── const { seasonTiming } = await import('../app/admin/seasons/season-timing'); const kvLib = await import('../lib/kv'); const wrap = await import('../lib/season-wrap'); const now = Date.now(); const base = { id: 's', name: 'S', collectionName: 'S', active: false, status: 'published' as const, createdAt: now, maxConcurrentPacks: 1, packIds: [] }; ok(seasonTiming({ ...base, startsAt: now + 3 * 86_400_000 })?.label.startsWith('Starts in 3d'), 'a future start is shown as "Starts in 3d"'); ok(seasonTiming({ ...base, active: true, endsAt: now + 6 * 3_600_000 })?.label === 'Ends in 6h', 'an active season shows when it ends'); ok(seasonTiming({ ...base, endedAt: now - 1000, startsAt: now + 1000 }) === null, 'an ended season has no timing badge'); ok(!kvLib.scheduleDue([{ ...base, startsAt: now + 1000, autoStart: true }]), 'a start in the future is not due'); ok(kvLib.scheduleDue([{ ...base, startsAt: now - 1000, autoStart: true }]), 'a passed start with auto-start is due'); ok(!kvLib.scheduleDue([{ ...base, startsAt: now - 1000 }]), 'a passed start without auto-start is not due'); ok(kvLib.scheduleDue([{ ...base, active: true, endsAt: now - 1000 }]), 'an active season past its end is due'); ok(!kvLib.scheduleDue([{ ...base, active: true, endsAt: now - 1000, endedAt: now }]), 'an already-ended season is not due again'); const awards = wrap.buildAwards([ row('ann', 900, 10, 30, true, { regular: 20, reverse: 5, full: 3, shiny: 2 }), row('bob', 700, 12, 25, false, { regular: 25, reverse: 0, full: 0, shiny: 0 }), row('cat', 500, 5, 9), ]); ok(awards.filter(a => ['champion', 'runner-up', 'third'].includes(a.id)).map(a => a.username).join() === 'ann,bob,cat', 'the podium follows the standings'); ok(awards.some(a => a.id === 'completionist' && a.username === 'ann'), 'a complete collection earns Completionist'); ok(awards.find(a => a.id === 'most-cards')?.username === 'bob', 'Biggest collection goes to the most different cards'); ok(awards.find(a => a.id === 'shiny-hunter')?.username === 'ann', 'Shiny hunter goes to the most Shinies'); ok(!awards.some(a => a.id === 'full-art' && a.username === 'bob'), 'no award for a variant nobody has more than zero of'); // ── Engine, in an isolated sandbox namespace ── const db = await import('../lib/db'); const sbx = await import('../lib/sandbox'); const trades = await import('../lib/trades'); await kvLib.seedSeason1(); const box = await sbx.createSandbox({ name: 'Season check', source: 'config' }); await db.runInSandbox(box.id, async () => { const s1 = (await kvLib.listSeasons())[0]; const packIds = s1.packIds; await kvLib.saveCollection(s1.collectionName, { ann: [E(1), E(2), E(3, 'shiny')], bob: [E(1)] }); await kvLib.saveSeason({ id: 'next', name: 'Next', collectionName: 'NextDeck', active: false, status: 'published', createdAt: now, maxConcurrentPacks: 1, packIds }); // Activating a season wraps up the one it replaces. const res = await wrap.activateWithWrapUp('next'); ok(res.ok && res.replaced === s1.name, 'activating names the season it replaced'); const old = (await kvLib.getSeason(s1.id))!; ok(!old.active && !!old.endedAt && old.tradingFrozen === true, 'the replaced season is ended with trading frozen'); ok((await kvLib.getSeason('next'))!.active, 'the new season is active'); const snap = await wrap.getSnapshot(s1.id); ok(!!snap && snap.standings[0].username === 'ann' && snap.awards.some(a => a.id === 'champion' && a.username === 'ann'), 'the snapshot holds the final standings and awards'); ok(snap!.standings.every(r => typeof r.completionBonus === 'number' && typeof r.setBonus === 'number' && !!r.variants), 'each final standing keeps the bonus split and the version counts, so the final board shows the same breakdown'); ok((await wrap.getUserAwards('ann')).some(a => a.award.id === 'champion'), 'a viewer\'s awards are found across seasons'); ok(Object.keys(await kvLib.getCollection(s1.collectionName)).length === 2, 'the ended season keeps every collection'); // A frozen season refuses new trades. await trades.saveTradeSettings({ ...(await trades.getTradeSettings()), cooldownSeconds: 0 }); const refused = await trades.createTrade({ seasonId: s1.id, from: 'ann', kind: 'direct', to: 'bob', give: [{ cardNumber: 1, variant: 'regular', count: 1 }], get: [{ cardNumber: 2, variant: 'regular', count: 1 }] }); ok(!refused.ok && /closed/i.test(refused.error), 'trading is refused for a frozen season'); // Reopening lifts the freeze. await wrap.reopenSeason(s1.id); const reopened = (await kvLib.getSeason(s1.id))!; ok(!reopened.endedAt && !reopened.tradingFrozen, 'reopening clears the ended mark and the freeze'); // The lazy scheduler: a due start activates the season (and wraps up the active one); a due end wraps an active season up. await kvLib.saveSeason({ id: 'timed', name: 'Timed', collectionName: 'TimedDeck', active: false, status: 'published', createdAt: now, maxConcurrentPacks: 1, packIds, startsAt: now - 5000, autoStart: true }); const active = await kvLib.getActiveSeason(); // runs the schedule ok(active?.id === 'timed', 'a due scheduled start becomes the active season on the next read'); ok(!!(await kvLib.getSeason('next'))!.endedAt, 'the season it replaced was wrapped up'); ok(!(await kvLib.getSeason('timed'))!.autoStart, 'auto-start is cleared once it has fired'); await kvLib.saveSeason({ ...(await kvLib.getSeason('timed'))!, endsAt: now - 1000 }); const none = await kvLib.getActiveSeason(); ok(none === null, 'a season past its end is wrapped up on the next read'); ok(!!(await kvLib.getSeason('timed'))!.endedAt && (await kvLib.getSeason('timed'))!.tradingFrozen === true, 'the ended season has a freeze'); }); // ── The season actions validate on the server (a form can be posted without the browser's checks) ── { const { readFileSync } = await import('node:fs'); const actions = readFileSync(new URL('../app/admin/actions.ts', import.meta.url), 'utf8'); const body = actions.slice(actions.indexOf('export async function updateSeason'), actions.indexOf('export async function activateSeason')); ok(body.includes('validateSeason(') && body.includes('redirect('),'updateSeason runs validateSeason and sends the admin back with the reason'); ok(body.includes('Math.max(1, Math.floor('),'updateSeason keeps max concurrent packs a whole number of at least 1'); ok(!/export async function createSeason/.test(actions), 'there is no second, unvalidated way to create a season (the wizard is the only one)'); } await sbx.deleteSandbox(box.id); console.log('season checks passed');

nodes.body_text: // Checks the pure helpers of the admin Prints screen: what a search means, edition filters and the safe return address. // Run: npx tsx scripts/check-serials-view.mts const v = await import('../lib/serials-view'); // ── search ── ok(v.parsePrintSearch(undefined).kind === 'none' && v.parsePrintSearch(' ').kind === 'none', 'an empty search is nothing'); ok(JSON.stringify(v.parsePrintSearch('#1023381')) === '{"kind":"uid","uid":1023381}', '#1023381 is a print number'); ok(JSON.stringify(v.parsePrintSearch('1023381')) === '{"kind":"uid","uid":1023381}', '1023381 is a print number'); ok(v.parsePrintSearch('12').kind === 'text' && v.parsePrintSearch('999999').kind === 'text', 'short numbers are card numbers, not print numbers'); ok(v.parsePrintSearch('@Sam').kind === 'text', 'a login is free text'); // ── filters ── const list = [copy(3, 'sam'), copy(1, 'jo', 'grant'), copy(2, ''), copy(4, 'escrow:t1'), copy(5, 'sam', 'upgrade')]; ok(v.filterEditions(list, {}).map(c => c.n).join() === '1,2,3,4,5', 'editions are sorted oldest first'); ok(v.filterEditions(list, { holder: '@Sam' }).map(c => c.n).join() === '3,5', 'a holder filter ignores @ and case'); ok(v.filterEditions(list, { holder: 'retired' }).map(c => c.n).join() === '2', 'retired is a holder'); ok(v.filterEditions(list, { holder: 'offer' }).map(c => c.n).join() === '4', 'offer is a holder'); ok(v.filterEditions(list, { origin: 'grant' }).map(c => c.n).join() === '1', 'an origin filter'); ok(v.filterEditions(list, { holder: 'sam', origin: 'upgrade' }).map(c => c.n).join() === '5', 'both together'); ok(v.parseOrigin('upgrade') === 'upgrade' && v.parseOrigin('nope') === '' && v.parseOrigin(undefined) === '', 'origins are validated'); // ── where actions may return to ── ok(v.safeSerialsReturn('/admin/serials?season=s1&card=3&v=full&print=3.2.7') === '/admin/serials?season=s1&card=3&v=full&print=3.2.7', 'the list with filters is allowed'); for (const bad of ['https://evil.test/', '//evil.test', '/admin/users', '/admin/serials/s1/1.0.1', '/admin/serials?x=<script>', '/admin/serials?a=b c', '', 5, null, undefined, '/admin/serials?' + 'a'.repeat(700)]) { ok(v.safeSerialsReturn(bad) === null, `refused: ${String(bad).slice(0, 40)}`); } ok(v.withParams('/admin/serials?season=s1&print=1.0.1', { print: '2.0.3', done: 'Given to @jo.' }) === '/admin/serials?season=s1&print=2.0.3&done=Given+to+%40jo.', 'withParams sets and encodes'); ok(v.withParams('/admin/serials?season=s1&done=x', { done: undefined }) === '/admin/serials?season=s1', 'withParams removes'); ok(v.safeSerialsReturn(v.withParams('/admin/serials?season=s1', { print: '1.0.1' })) !== null, 'what withParams builds is still a safe address'); // ── Most valuable prints links (15.4) ── const { topPrintHref } = await import('../lib/copy-link'); ok(topPrintHref(row(3), 's1', 1023381) === '/c/1023381', 'a numbered print with a unique number opens its print page'); ok(topPrintHref(row(3), 's1', null) === '/copy/s1/7.3.3', 'a numbered print without a unique number opens the derived copy link'); ok(topPrintHref(row(undefined), 's1', 5) === '/cards?card=7', 'a grouped row opens the card dex dialog'); console.log('ok');

nodes.name: check-serials.mts
nodes.body_text: // Checks card serials: numbering per card + version, backfill, tracking switch-on, removals, trades keep identity, upgrades link back. // Needs the mock KV (node scripts/mock-kv.cjs); refuses anything non-local. Run: npx tsx scripts/check-serials.mts const url = process.env.KV_REST_API_URL ?? 'http://localhost:4111'; if (!/^http:\/\/(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)[:/]/.test(url)) throw new Error(`Refusing to run against non-local KV: ${url}`); process.env.KV_REST_API_URL = url; process.env.KV_REST_API_TOKEN ??= 'dev'; process.env.KV_URL ??= 'redis://dev'; const core = await import('../lib/serials-core'); const copyLink = await import('../lib/copy-link'); const { encodeEntry } = await import('../lib/variants'); // ── pure ── eq(core.copyId(7, 'shiny', 12), '7.3.12', 'copy id'); eq(core.parseCopyId('7.3.12'), { card: 7, variant: 'shiny', n: 12 }, 'copy id parses'); ok(core.parseCopyId('7.9.1') === null && core.parseCopyId('x') === null && core.parseCopyId('7.1.1; drop') === null, 'bad ids are refused'); ok(core.EVENT_LABELS.reversed.length > 0, 'a staff reversal has a label in the print journey'); const d = core.diffCounts(new Map([[1, 2], [2, 1]]), new Map([[1, 3], [3, 1]])); eq([[...d.mint], [...d.retire]], [[[1, 1], [3, 1]], [[2, 1]]], 'diff: what to mint and retire'); ok(core.sameCollection([1, 2, 2], [2, 1, 2]) && !core.sameCollection([1], [1, 1]), 'sameCollection ignores order only'); eq(core.newestFirst([cp(1), cp(5), cp(3)], 2).map(c => c.n), [5, 3], 'newest first'); const many = Array.from({ length: 60 }, (_, i) => ({ t: i, type: 'traded' as const })); const trimmed = many.reduce((c, e) => core.withEvent(c, e), { ...cp(1), ev: [{ t: -1, type: 'minted' as const }] }); ok(trimmed.ev.length === core.EVENT_CAP && trimmed.ev[0].type === 'minted', 'history is capped but the creation event stays'); // ── share image layout ── const sh = await import('../lib/share-image'); const area = sh.cardArea(); for (const n of [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 9, 12]) { const rs = sh.layoutCards(n, area); ok(rs.length === Math.min(n, 9), `layout gives ${Math.min(n, 9)} rects for ${n}`); ok(rs.every(r => r.x >= area.x - 0.5 && r.y >= area.y - 0.5 && r.x + r.w <= area.x + area.w + 0.5 && r.y + r.h <= area.y + area.h + 0.5), `${n} cards stay inside the area`); ok(rs.every((r, i) => rs.every((q, j) => i === j || r.x + r.w <= q.x + 0.5 || q.x + q.w <= r.x + 0.5 || r.y + r.h <= q.y + 0.5 || q.y + q.h <= r.y + 0.5)), `${n} cards do not overlap`); } // The copy image's plate sits under the card without touching it, inside the image. { const ca = sh.cardAreaWithPlate(), pr = sh.plateRect(); ok(ca.y + ca.h + sh.PLATE_GAP <= pr.y + 0.5 && pr.y + pr.h <= sh.SHARE_H - sh.FOOTER_H, 'the plate fits under the card area and above the footer'); const one = sh.layoutCards(1, ca)[0]; ok(one.y + one.h <= pr.y && one.x >= ca.x - 0.5 && one.w > 400, 'the card stays big and clear of the plate'); } // Themes, formats and the stats poster layout. { ok(new Set(sh.SHARE_THEMES.map(t => t.id)).size === sh.SHARE_THEMES.length, 'share theme ids are unique'); ok(sh.getShareTheme('nope').id === 'classic' && sh.getShareTheme(undefined).id === 'classic', 'an unknown theme falls back to Classic'); ok(sh.formatHeight('story') === sh.STORY_H && sh.formatHeight() === sh.SHARE_H, 'formats map to heights'); const h = sh.STORY_H, ca = sh.cardAreaWithPlate(h), pr = sh.plateRect(h); ok(ca.y + ca.h + sh.PLATE_GAP <= pr.y + 0.5 && pr.y + pr.h <= h - sh.FOOTER_H, 'the plate fits in a story too'); const sa = sh.cardAreaWithStats(), full = sh.cardArea(); ok(sa.y >= full.y + sh.BIG_STATS_H && sa.y + sa.h <= full.y + full.h + 0.5, 'the stat tiles leave the cards a clear area'); const six = sh.layoutCards(6, sh.cardArea(sh.STORY_H), 28, 2); ok(six.length === 6 && six.every(r => r.x >= 70 - 0.5 && r.x + r.w <= sh.SHARE_W - 70 + 0.5), 'two columns of six cards stay inside the margins'); ok(sh.PLATE_H <= 220, 'the plate stays slim'); } // ── engine, in an isolated sandbox ── const db = await import('../lib/db'); const kvLib = await import('../lib/kv'); const sbx = await import('../lib/sandbox'); const trades = await import('../lib/trades'); const ser = await import('../lib/serials'); const upgrade = await import('../lib/upgrade'); await kvLib.seedSeason1(); const pack = (await kvLib.getPack('pack1'))!; await kvLib.savePack({ ...pack, upgradesEnabled: true } as never); const box = await sbx.createSandbox({ name: 'Serial check', source: 'config' }); const prodBefore = JSON.stringify(await db.prodKv.hgetall('copies:x:idx')); await db.runInSandbox(box.id, async () => { const season = (await kvLib.listSeasons())[0]; const c = season.collectionName; await kvLib.saveCollection(c, { alice: [E(1), E(1), E(2), E(3, 'shiny')], bob: [E(1)] }); ok(!(await ser.isTracking(c)), 'nothing is tracked before the backfill'); await kvLib.addCollectionEntry(c, 'alice', E(1), 'pull'); eq(await mine('alice'), [], 'untracked: no copies minted yet'); // Backfill numbers what exists: card 1 regular x4 in total (alice 3, bob 1). const r = await ser.backfillSerials(c, await kvLib.getCollection(c)); ok(r.copies === 6 && r.users === 2, `backfill numbered 6 copies, got ${JSON.stringify(r)}`); ok(await ser.isTracking(c), 'tracking is on after the backfill'); const first = await ser.getOwnerCopies(c, 'alice'); ok(first.every(x => x.est && x.origin === 'estimated'), 'backfilled copies are marked as estimates'); eq([...(await ser.mintedCounts(c)).entries()].sort(), [[E(1), 4], [E(2), 1], [E(3, 'shiny'), 1]].sort(), 'serial counters'); ok((await mine('alice')).includes('1.0.1') && (await mine('bob')).length === 1, 'every serial has exactly one owner'); // Unique numbers: every copy has one, all different, 7 digits, found again by number. { const all = [...(await ser.getOwnerCopies(c, 'alice')), ...(await ser.getOwnerCopies(c, 'bob'))]; const uids = all.map(x => x.uid); ok(uids.every(u => typeof u === 'number' && u > 1_000_000 && u < 10_000_000), 'every copy got a 7-digit unique number'); ok(new Set(uids).size === all.length, 'unique numbers are all different'); const first = all.find(x => x.uid === Math.min(...(uids as number[])))!; const hit = await ser.findByUid(first.uid!); ok(hit?.collection === c && hit.copyId === first.id, 'a unique number finds its copy'); ok((await ser.findByUid(1)) === null, 'an unknown number finds nothing'); } const again = await ser.backfillSerials(c, await kvLib.getCollection(c)); ok(again.numbered === 0, 'running it again numbers nothing new'); ok(again.copies === 0 && await live() === 6, 'running the backfill again adds nothing'); // New pulls are exact and continue the count. await kvLib.addCollectionEntry(c, 'bob', E(1), 'pull'); const bobCopies = await ser.getOwnerCopies(c, 'bob'); const fresh = bobCopies.find(x => x.n === 5); ok(fresh && !fresh.est && fresh.origin === 'pull', 'a new pull gets the next number, exact'); await kvLib.addCollectionEntry(c, 'bob', E(1, 'shiny'), 'grant'); ok((await ser.getOwnerCopies(c, 'bob')).some(x => x.id === '1.3.1' && x.origin === 'grant'), 'numbering is per card AND version: the first Shiny is #1'); // The ledger always matches the collection. await consistent(); // Removing a copy retires the newest and keeps its history. const data = await kvLib.getCollection(c); data.alice = data.alice.slice(1); await kvLib.saveCollection(c, data); await consistent(); const retired = await ser.getCopy(c, '1.0.3'); ok(retired && retired.ev.at(-1)?.type === 'removed', 'a removed copy is retired with its history (the newest goes first)'); // Trades carry identity. await trades.saveTradeSettings({ ...(await import('../lib/trade-core')).DEFAULT_TRADE_SETTINGS, cooldownSeconds: 0, maxOpenPerUser: 5 }); const before = await mine('alice'); const give = (await ser.getOwnerCopies(c, 'alice')).filter(x => x.card === 2).map(x => x.id); const offer = await trades.createTrade({ seasonId: season.id, from: 'alice', kind: 'direct', to: 'bob', give: [stack(2)], get: [stack(1, 'shiny')] }); ok(offer.ok, 'offer created'); if (!offer.ok) return; await consistent(); eq((await db.kv.hget(`copies:${c}:idx`, give[0])), `escrow:${offer.trade.id}`, 'an offered copy sits in escrow under its own id'); const dec = await trades.declineTrade(offer.trade.id, 'bob'); ok(dec.ok, 'declined'); await consistent(); eq(await mine('alice'), before, 'a refund brings back the very same serials'); ok((await ser.getCopy(c, give[0]))!.ev.map(e => e.type).join() === 'minted,escrowed,returned', 'history: created, escrowed, returned'); const o2 = await trades.createTrade({ seasonId: season.id, from: 'alice', kind: 'direct', to: 'bob', give: [stack(2)], get: [stack(1, 'shiny')] }); if (!o2.ok) throw new Error('second offer failed'); const acc = await trades.acceptTrade(o2.trade.id, 'bob'); ok(acc.ok, 'accepted'); await consistent(); ok((await mine('bob')).includes(give[0]), 'the offered copy now belongs to bob, same id'); ok((await mine('alice')).includes('1.3.1'), 'the Shiny went to alice, same id'); const hist = (await ser.getCopy(c, give[0]))!.ev; ok(hist.at(-1)?.type === 'traded' && hist.at(-1)?.to === 'bob', 'history ends with the trade to bob'); ok(typeof (await ser.getCopy(c, give[0]))!.uid === 'number', 'a traded copy keeps its unique number'); // Upgrade: five regulars of card 1 for one reverse (pack1 costs); the new copy points back at what was spent. await kvLib.saveCollection(c, { ...(await kvLib.getCollection(c)), carol: [] }); for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) await kvLib.addCollectionEntry(c, 'carol', E(4), 'pull'); const res = await upgrade.upgradeCard({ seasonId: season.id, username: 'carol', cardNumber: 4, from: 'regular' }); ok(res.ok, `upgrade works: ${JSON.stringify(res)}`); await consistent(); const made = (await ser.getOwnerCopies(c, 'carol')).find(x => x.variant !== 'regular'); ok(made && made.origin === 'upgrade' && (made.madeFrom?.length ?? 0) >= 2, 'the upgraded copy lists the copies it was made from'); ok(typeof made!.uid === 'number' && !(await ser.getOwnerCopies(c, 'carol')).some(x => x.id !== made!.id && x.uid === made!.uid), 'the upgraded copy has a new unique number'); const spent = await ser.getCopy(c, made!.madeFrom![0]); ok(typeof spent!.uid === 'number' && (await ser.findByUid(spent!.uid!))?.copyId === spent!.id, 'a spent copy can still be found by its number'); ok(spent && spent.ev.at(-1)?.type === 'upgraded', 'a spent copy is retired as upgraded'); // Admin actions on one exact copy: give away a specific (low) copy rather than the newest, and remove a specific copy. { for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) await kvLib.addCollectionEntry(c, 'alice', E(1), 'pull'); const regs = (await ser.getOwnerCopies(c, 'alice')).filter(x => x.card === 1 && x.variant === 'regular').sort((a, b) => a.n - b.n); ok(regs.length >= 3, 'alice has several card 1 regulars to work with'); const [low, mid] = regs; const d1 = await kvLib.getCollection(c); dropOne(d1, 'alice'); d1.dave = [...(d1.dave ?? []), E(1)]; await kvLib.saveCollection(c, d1, { moves: [{ from: 'alice', to: 'dave', entry: E(1), count: 1, ids: [low.id], note: 'admin transfer' }] }); await consistent(); ok((await mine('dave')).includes(low.id) && !(await mine('alice')).includes(low.id), 'the exact copy (the lowest number) moved, not the newest'); const moved = (await ser.getCopy(c, low.id))!; ok(moved.owner === 'dave' && moved.ev.at(-1)?.type === 'traded' && moved.ev.at(-1)?.note === 'admin transfer', 'its history records the admin transfer'); const d2 = await kvLib.getCollection(c); dropOne(d2, 'alice'); await kvLib.saveCollection(c, d2, { retire: { owner: 'alice', ids: [mid.id], who: 'alice', note: 'removed by an admin' } }); await consistent(); const gone = (await ser.getCopy(c, mid.id))!; ok(!gone.owner && gone.ev.at(-1)?.type === 'removed' && gone.ev.at(-1)?.note === 'removed by an admin', 'the chosen copy is retired with its history'); ok(!(await mine('alice')).includes(mid.id), 'and is no longer held'); // Browsing: pages by serial number, newest first, live and retired together. const page = await ser.pageCopies(c, 1, 'regular', 0, 3); ok(page.copies.length === 3 && page.copies[0].n === page.made && page.copies[1].n === page.made - 1, 'the first page is the newest numbers'); const oldest = await ser.pageCopies(c, 1, 'regular', 0, 2, true); eq(oldest.copies.map(x => x.n), [1, 2], 'oldest first starts at #1'); ok((await ser.pageCopies(c, 1, 'regular', 0, 100)).copies.some(x => !x.owner), 'retired copies are listed too'); ok((await ser.pageCopies(c, 1, 'regular', 99, 3)).copies.length === 0, 'a page past the end is empty'); const lc = await ser.liveCounts(c); ok((lc.get(E(1)) ?? 0) === (await ser.liveCopiesOfEntry(c, E(1))).length, 'live counts match the ledger'); } // The scoring view of the ledger: everyone's live serials (escrow left out) and the next free number per card + version. const sidx = await ser.loadSerialIndex(c); ok(sidx !== null, 'a tracked collection has a serial index'); const heldCount = [...sidx!.held.values()].reduce((n, m) => n + [...m.values()].reduce((k, l) => k + l.length, 0), 0); ok(heldCount === (await live()) - [...Object.values((await db.kv.hgetall(`copies:${c}:idx`)) ?? {})].filter(o => String(o).startsWith('escrow:')).length, 'the index holds every live copy that is not in escrow'); for (const [entry, top] of sidx!.minted) for (const list of sidx!.held.values()) for (const n of list.get(entry) ?? []) ok(n >= 1 && n <= top, 'every held serial is within what was ever made'); // The serial a new copy got is reported back (the overlay shows it on the reveal), and an upgrade reports its new copy's serial. { const before = (await ser.mintedCounts(c)).get(E(7)) ?? 0; const got = await kvLib.addCollectionEntryWithSerial(c, 'erin', E(7), 'pull'); ok(got.serial === before + 1 && got.owned.includes(E(7)), `a pull reports its serial: ${got.serial} vs ${before + 1}`); ok((await ser.lastSerial(c, E(7))) === got.serial, 'lastSerial is the latest number made'); const again = await kvLib.addCollectionEntryWithSerial(c, 'erin', E(7), 'pull'); eq(again.serial, (got.serial ?? 0) + 1, 'the next pull of the same card and version gets the next number'); ok((await ser.lastSerial('no-such-collection', E(7))) === null, 'a collection that is not numbered has no serial'); // ... and so are the copy's id and unique number, matching the ledger. ok(got.copyId === core.copyId(7, 'regular', got.serial!), `a pull reports its copy id: ${got.copyId}`); const gotCopy = await ser.getCopy(c, got.copyId!); ok(!!gotCopy?.uid && gotCopy.uid === got.uid, 'the reported unique number matches the ledger'); ok((await ser.findByUid(got.uid!))?.copyId === got.copyId, 'the reported unique number resolves back to the copy'); ok(again.uid !== got.uid && again.copyId !== got.copyId, 'the next pull reports a different copy'); const untracked = await kvLib.addCollectionEntryWithSerial('no-such-collection', 'erin', E(7), 'pull'); ok(untracked.serial === null && untracked.copyId === null && untracked.uid === null, 'an untracked collection reports nulls'); await kvLib.deleteCollection('no-such-collection'); // copyHrefFor / adminCopyHrefFor eq(copyLink.copyHrefFor({ type: 'pull', uid: 1023381, serial: 7 }, 's1'), '/c/1023381', 'a unique number links to /c/<uid>'); eq(copyLink.copyHrefFor({ type: 'pull', serial: 12, variant: 'shiny', cardNumber: 7 }, 's1'), '/copy/s1/7.3.12', 'an older pull derives the copy id'); eq(copyLink.copyHrefFor({ type: 'pull', serial: 12, cardNumber: 7 }, 's1'), '/copy/s1/7.0.12', 'no variant means regular'); eq(copyLink.copyHrefFor({ type: 'pull', cardNumber: 7 }, 's1'), null, 'no serial and no uid: no link'); eq(copyLink.copyHrefFor({ type: 'grant', serial: 4, cardNumber: 7 }, 's1'), null, 'a grant without a uid has no link'); eq(copyLink.adminCopyHrefFor({ type: 'grant', copyId: '7.1.2' }, 's1'), '/admin/serials/s1/7.1.2', 'admin link uses the event copy id'); eq(copyLink.adminCopyHrefFor({ type: 'pull', serial: 3, variant: 'full', cardNumber: 9 }, 's1'), '/admin/serials/s1/9.2.3', 'admin link derives for older pulls'); const mintedBefo

nodes.name: check-settings.mts
nodes.body_text: // Checks the admin Settings helpers: scoring preview, scoring clamping, the environment checklist and the Twitch setup list. // Pure (no database needed). Run: npx tsx scripts/check-settings.mts const { DEFAULT_SCORING, SCORING_LIMITS, sanitizeScoring } = await import('../lib/scoring'); const { previewScoring } = await import('../lib/scoring-preview'); const { checkEnv, summarizeEnv, readEnv, ENV_SPECS } = await import('../lib/env-health'); const { extensionChecklist } = await import('../lib/twitch-setup'); const { encodeEntry } = await import('../lib/variants'); // ── scoring clamping ── const wild = sanitizeScoring({ baseScore: 99999, rarityExponent: -4, serialBonusMax: 0.2, serialBonusCutoff: 2.6, leaderboardSize: 12.6, bogus: 1, completionBonusPct: 'abc' }); ok(wild.baseScore === SCORING_LIMITS.baseScore.max, 'too-big values clamp to the maximum'); ok(wild.rarityExponent === SCORING_LIMITS.rarityExponent.min, 'negative values clamp to the minimum'); ok(wild.serialBonusMax >= 1 && Number.isInteger(wild.serialBonusCutoff), 'the serial bonus never goes below 1x and its cutoff is a whole number'); ok(Number.isInteger(wild.leaderboardSize), 'leaderboard size is a whole number'); eq(wild.completionBonusPct, DEFAULT_SCORING.completionBonusPct, 'junk falls back to the default'); eq(sanitizeScoring({ baseScore: '25' }).baseScore, 25, 'numeric strings from a form are accepted'); // ── scoring preview ── const pack = { id: 'p', name: 'P', weight: 1, active: true, status: 'published', upgradesEnabled: false } as never; const packs = [{ pack, cards: [card('a', 1, 50), card('b', 2, 30), card('c', 3, 20)] }]; const collection = { alice: [1, 1, 2, 3].map(n => encodeEntry(n, 'regular')), bob: [1, 1, 1, 1, 1].map(n => encodeEntry(n, 'regular')), carol: [3].map(n => encodeEntry(n, 'regular')) }; const same = previewScoring(packs, collection, DEFAULT_SCORING, DEFAULT_SCORING); eq(same.saved, same.candidate, 'identical numbers preview identically'); eq(same.rankChanges, 0, 'no rank changes when nothing changed'); const doubled = previewScoring(packs, collection, DEFAULT_SCORING, { ...DEFAULT_SCORING, baseScore: DEFAULT_SCORING.baseScore * 2 }); // Card values are rounded to whole points, so "double" is within a few percent (small numbers round noticeably). ok(near2(doubled.candidate.setValue, doubled.saved.setValue), 'doubling the base score doubles the set value'); ok(near2(doubled.candidate.topScore, doubled.saved.topScore), 'and the top score'); eq(doubled.rankChanges, 0, 'a pure scale does not reorder viewers'); const noBonus = previewScoring(packs, collection, DEFAULT_SCORING, { ...DEFAULT_SCORING, completionBonusPct: 0, completeSetBonusPct: 0 }); ok(noBonus.candidate.completionAtFull === 0 && noBonus.candidate.completeSetBonus === 0, 'bonuses can be switched off'); ok(noBonus.candidate.topScore < noBonus.saved.topScore, 'and the completionist loses points'); const flat = previewScoring(packs, collection, DEFAULT_SCORING, { ...DEFAULT_SCORING, rarityExponent: 0 }); ok(flat.candidate.maxCardValue < flat.saved.maxCardValue, 'flattening rarity lowers the rarest card'); const hiddenOut = previewScoring(packs, collection, DEFAULT_SCORING, DEFAULT_SCORING, new Set(['alice'])); ok(!hiddenOut.saved.top.some(t => t.username === 'alice') && hiddenOut.viewers === 2, 'hidden viewers are left out'); eq(previewScoring(packs, collection, DEFAULT_SCORING, { baseScore: 9999999 }).candidateSettings.baseScore, SCORING_LIMITS.baseScore.max, 'the candidate is clamped like a save would'); // ── environment checklist ── const none = checkEnv({}); ok(none.length === ENV_SPECS.length && none.every(c => !c.set), 'nothing set'); const s0 = summarizeEnv(none); ok(!s0.ready && s0.requiredMissing === ENV_SPECS.filter(s => s.level === 'required').length, 'required variables are counted'); const full = checkEnv(Object.fromEntries(ENV_SPECS.map(s => [s.name, 'x'.repeat(40)]))); ok(summarizeEnv(full).ready && summarizeEnv(full).recommendedMissing === 0 && summarizeEnv(full).weak === 0, 'everything set'); const weak = checkEnv({ SESSION_SECRET: 'short', ADMIN_SECRET: ' ' }); ok(weak.find(c => c.name === 'SESSION_SECRET')?.weak === true, 'a short secret is flagged weak'); ok(weak.find(c => c.name === 'ADMIN_SECRET')?.set === false, 'whitespace does not count as set'); ok(!JSON.stringify(full).includes('xxxxxxxx'), 'values never appear in the report'); eq(readEnv({ VERCEL_BLOB_RW_TOKEN: 't' } as never).BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN, 't', 'the alternate Blob token name counts'); // ── Twitch setup list ── const list = extensionChecklist('https://example.test'); ok(list.every(i => i.value.startsWith('https://example.test')), 'every value is on the site origin'); ok(list.find(i => i.id === 'redirect')?.value === 'https://example.test/auth/twitch/callback', 'OAuth redirect URL'); ok(['panel', 'mobile', 'video', 'privacy', 'terms', 'fetch', 'redirect'].every(id => list.some(i => i.id === id)), 'all setup items present'); ok(new Set(list.map(i => i.id)).size === list.length, 'ids are unique'); console.log('settings checks passed');

nodes.name: check-share-stats.mts
nodes.body_text: // Checks the figures and the layout of the "Share my stats" image (pure). Run: npx tsx scripts/check-share-stats.mts import { buildStatsCard, rarestPrint, type StatsCardInput } from '../lib/share-stats'; import { statsLayout, SHARE_H, STORY_H, cardArea } from '../lib/share-image'; const odds: Record<string, number> = { '1.regular': 0.05, '2.shiny': 0.0002, '3.regular': 0.0002, '4.full': 0 }; const base: StatsCardInput = { rank: 7, score: 18673.4, uniqueCards: 12, totalCards: 20, copies: 31, completionBonusPct: 10, prints: [{ card: 1, variant: 'regular', n: 9 }, { card: 2, variant: 'shiny', n: 40 }, { card: 3, variant: 'regular', n: 4 }, { card: 4, variant: 'full', n: 2 }], chance: (card, variant) => odds[`${card}.${variant}`] ?? 0, nameOf: n => `Card ${n}`, hexOf: n => (n === 3 ? '#ff00aa' : '#facc15'), tradesCompleted: 3, }; // the rarest print: lowest chance, ties to the lower edition, unknown odds skipped eq(rarestPrint(base), { card: 3, variant: 'regular', n: 4, chance: 0.0002 }, 'rarest print: a tie on odds goes to the lower edition'); eq(rarestPrint({ prints: [], chance: base.chance }), null, 'no prints, no rarest print'); eq(rarestPrint({ prints: [{ card: 4, variant: 'full', n: 1 }], chance: base.chance }), null, 'a print with unknown odds is skipped'); const c = buildStatsCard(base); eq([c.rank, c.score, c.accent], ['#7', '18,673', '#ff00aa'], 'rank, score and the rarest print\'s colour'); eq(c.figures.map(f => f.label), ['Different cards', 'Prints', 'Progress bonus', 'Best edition', 'Rarest print', 'Trades'], 'six figures'); eq(c.figures[0], { label: 'Different cards', value: '12/20', progress: 0.6 }, 'cards with a progress bar'); eq(c.figures[2].value, '+6.0%', 'progress bonus is the setting scaled by how much of the set they have'); eq(c.figures[3].value, '#2', 'best edition is the lowest number held'); eq([c.figures[4].value, c.figures[4].sub], ['Card 3', 'Regular · 1 in 5,000'], 'rarest print with its version and odds'); eq(c.figures[5].value, '3', 'trades completed'); // a season that does not track prints, a viewer with no rank const bare = buildStatsCard({ ...base, rank: null, prints: [], copies: 0, uniqueCards: 0 }); eq([bare.rank, bare.accent, bare.figures[3].value, bare.figures[4].value, bare.figures[2].value], ['-', undefined, '-', '-', '+0.0%'], 'untracked / empty: placeholders, no accent'); // layout: everything inside the card area, in order, for a post and a story for (const h of [SHARE_H, STORY_H]) { const a = cardArea(h), L = statsLayout(h, 3); eq(L.tiles.length, 6, 'six tiles'); ok(L.hero.y >= a.y && L.hero.y + L.hero.h < L.tiles[0].y, `hero sits above the tiles (${h})`); ok(L.tiles[1].x > L.tiles[0].x && L.tiles[2].y > L.tiles[0].y, `two columns of three (${h})`); ok(L.strip.y > L.tiles[5].y + L.tiles[5].h, `the strip is below the tiles (${h})`); ok(L.thumbs.every(t => t.h > 100 && t.y + t.h <= a.y + a.h + 0.5 && t.x >= a.x && t.x + t.w <= a.x + a.w + 0.5), `the three prints fit the area (${h})`); eq(Math.round(L.thumbs[0].w / L.thumbs[0].h * 1000), 667, `prints keep the card ratio (${h})`); } console.log('share stats ok');

nodes.body_text: // Checks the "show off a card" command on the server: ownership, version choice, serial, cooldown, queued event. // Needs the mock KV (node scripts/mock-kv.cjs); refuses anything non-local. Run: npx tsx scripts/check-showoff-server.mts const url = process.env.KV_REST_API_URL ?? 'http://localhost:4111'; if (!/^http:\/\/(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)[:/]/.test(url)) throw new Error(`Refusing to run against non-local KV: ${url}`); process.env.KV_REST_API_URL = url; process.env.KV_REST_API_TOKEN ??= 'dev'; process.env.KV_URL ??= 'redis://dev'; const kvLib = await import('../lib/kv'); const { encodeEntry } = await import('../lib/variants'); const { prepareShowOff } = await import('../lib/showoff-prepare'); const { kv } = await import('../lib/db'); const ser = await import('../lib/serials'); await kvLib.seedSeason1(); const pack = (await kvLib.getPack('pack1'))!; await kvLib.savePack({ ...pack, upgradesEnabled: true } as never); const season = (await kvLib.listSeasons())[0]; await kvLib.setActiveSeason(season.id); const c = season.collectionName; const cards = await kvLib.getPackCards('pack1'); const [a, b] = cards; await kvLib.saveCollection(c, { ann: [encodeEntry(a.number, 'regular'), encodeEntry(a.number, 'shiny')] }); await ser.backfillSerials(c, await kvLib.getCollection(c)); await clear('ann'); await clear('nobody'); let r = await prepareShowOff('Ann', a.name); ok(r.ok && r.plan.cardNumber === a.number && r.plan.variant === 'shiny', 'owned card, no version asked: the best owned version is shown'); ok(r.ok && r.plan.serial === 1, 'the lowest serial of that version is sent'); ok(r.ok && typeof r.plan.uid === 'number' && r.plan.uid === (await ser.getCopy(c, `${a.number}.3.1`))?.uid, 'the print number of that copy is sent too'); await clear('ann'); r = await prepareShowOff('ann', `regular ${a.name}`); ok(r.ok && r.plan.variant === 'regular', 'asking for regular shows the regular'); r = await prepareShowOff('ann', a.name); ok(!r.ok && r.error === 'cooldown', 'a second show-off straight away is refused'); await clear('ann'); r = await prepareShowOff('ann', b.name); ok(!r.ok && r.error === 'not-owned', 'a card they do not own is refused'); r = await prepareShowOff('ann', b.name); ok(!r.ok && r.error === 'not-owned', 'a refused request does not use up the cooldown'); r = await prepareShowOff('ann', ''); ok(r.ok, 'a bare command shows their best card'); await clear('ann'); r = await prepareShowOff('nobody', ''); ok(!r.ok, 'a viewer with no cards gets a refusal'); console.log('showoff server checks passed');

nodes.body_text: // Checks the show-off command's parsing and card matching. Pure. Run: npx tsx scripts/check-showoff.mts const s = await import('../lib/showoff'); eq(s.parseShowQuery('shiny gouda goat'), { number: null, name: 'gouda goat', variant: 'shiny' }, 'variant first'); eq(s.parseShowQuery('Gouda Goat SH'), { number: null, name: 'Gouda Goat', variant: 'shiny' }, 'variant last, any case'); eq(s.parseShowQuery('#12 reverse'), { number: 12, name: '', variant: 'reverse' }, 'number and version'); eq(s.parseShowQuery('12'), { number: 12, name: '', variant: null }, 'a bare number'); eq(s.parseShowQuery('full art brie'), { number: null, name: 'brie', variant: 'full' }, '"full art" is one version'); eq(s.parseShowQuery('Shiny Full Art Gouda Goat'), { number: null, name: 'Gouda Goat', variant: 'shiny' }, '"shiny full art" is the shiny version'); eq(s.parseShowQuery('reverse holo cat'), { number: null, name: 'cat', variant: 'reverse' }, '"reverse holo"'); eq(s.parseShowQuery('shiny'), { number: null, name: 'shiny', variant: null }, 'a lone word is a card name'); eq(s.parseShowQuery(''), { number: null, name: '', variant: null }, 'empty means my best card'); eq(s.parseShowQuery(undefined), { number: null, name: '', variant: null }, 'missing'); eq(s.parseShowQuery(7), { number: 7, name: '', variant: null }, 'a number value'); eq(s.parseShowQuery('x'.repeat(500)).name.length, 80, 'long input is cut'); const cards = [ { number: 1, name: 'Cheesy Cat', stars: 1 }, { number: 2, name: 'Cheesy Chicken', stars: 2 }, { number: 3, name: 'Gouda Goat', stars: 5 }, { number: 4, name: 'Brie Bear', stars: 3 }, ]; const owned = new Set([1, 2, 3]); eq(r('gouda goat'), { ok: true, card: cards[2] }, 'exact name'); eq(r('gouda'), { ok: true, card: cards[2] }, 'part of a name'); eq((r('cheesy') as { ok: boolean; reason?: string }).reason, 'ambiguous', 'two owned cards match'); eq(r('cheesy cat'), { ok: true, card: cards[0] }, 'a longer name settles it'); const oneOwned = s.resolveCard(s.parseShowQuery('cheesy'), cards, new Set([2]), best); eq(oneOwned, { ok: true, card: cards[1] }, 'when only one match is owned, that one wins'); eq((r('brie') as { reason?: string }).reason, 'not-owned', 'a card they do not own'); eq((r('nonsense') as { reason?: string }).reason, 'none', 'no such card'); eq(r('#3'), { ok: true, card: cards[2] }, 'by number'); eq((r('#9') as { reason?: string }).reason, 'none', 'unknown number'); eq(r(''), { ok: true, card: cards[2] }, 'no query shows their best card'); eq((s.resolveCard(s.parseShowQuery(''), cards, new Set(), () => null) as { reason?: string }).reason, 'nothing-to-show', 'no cards at all'); eq(s.pickShowVariant(counts({ regular: 2, reverse: 1 }), null), { ok: true, variant: 'reverse' }, 'no preference shows the best version owned'); eq(s.pickShowVariant(counts({ regular: 2, reverse: 1 }), 'regular'), { ok: true, variant: 'regular' }, 'an owned version is honoured'); const no = s.pickShowVariant(counts({ regular: 2 }), 'shiny') as { ok: boolean; message: string }; ok(!no.ok && no.message.includes('Shiny') && no.message.includes('Regular'), 'a version they do not own says what they do have'); console.log('showoff checks passed');

nodes.body_text: // Checks the public search and menu helpers: query cleaning, ranking and per-kind caps, hidden collectors, card deep links and the // menu's arrow-key movement. Pure. Run: npx tsx scripts/check-site-search.mts const s = await import('../lib/site-search'); const m = await import('../lib/menu-nav'); // ── cleaning ── eq(s.cleanQuery(' @Alice '), 'Alice', 'trims and drops a leading @'); eq(s.cleanQuery('a\u0000b\u001fc'), 'abc', 'control characters are removed'); eq(s.cleanQuery('x'.repeat(100)).length, s.MAX_QUERY, 'long input is capped'); eq(s.cleanQuery('@@@'), '', 'only @ signs is empty'); // ── items ── const cards = [ { number: 1, name: 'Cheesygidds', stars: 5, thumb: '/t/1.webp' }, { number: 2, name: 'Dinogidds', stars: 5 }, { number: 3, name: 'Cheesy Nacho', stars: 2 }, { number: 4, name: 'Gouda Goblin', stars: 1 }, ]; const users = ['Alice', 'alice', 'bob_the_builder', 'carol', 'cheesemaster', 'Hidden_Hank']; const items = s.buildEntityItems(users, new Set(['hidden_hank']), cards); ok(!items.some(i => i.label === 'hidden_hank'), 'hidden collectors are never searchable'); eq(items.filter(i => i.label === 'alice').length, 1, 'names are lower-cased and de-duplicated'); eq(items.find(i => i.id === 'card:1')?.href, '/cards?card=1', 'a card links to its dex entry'); eq(items.find(i => i.id === 'player:bob_the_builder')?.href, '/u/bob_the_builder', 'a collector links to their collection'); ok(items.find(i => i.id === 'player:carol')?.href === '/u/carol', 'player href'); // ── ranking ── const all = [...s.PUBLIC_PAGES, ...items]; eq(top('alice'), 'alice', 'a collector by name'); eq(top('builder'), 'bob_the_builder', 'a word inside a name'); eq(top('gouda'), 'Gouda Goblin', 'a card by name'); eq(top('leaderboard'), 'Leaderboard', 'a page by name'); ok(s.rankSearch(all, 'ranking').some(i => i.id === 'page:leaderboard'), 'page keywords match'); ok(s.rankSearch(all, 'chees').some(i => i.id === 'card:1') && s.rankSearch(all, 'chees').some(i => i.id === 'player:cheesemaster'), 'a query can match both cards and collectors'); eq(s.rankSearch(all, ''), [], 'an empty query returns nothing'); eq(s.rankSearch(all, ' @ '), [], 'a query that cleans to nothing returns nothing'); eq(s.rankSearch(all, 'zzzzqqq'), [], 'nonsense matches nothing'); const many = s.buildEntityItems(Array.from({ length: 30 }, (_, i) => `viewer${i}`), new Set(), []); eq(s.rankSearch(many, 'viewer', 20).length, 5, 'collectors are capped so they cannot crowd out the rest'); ok(s.rankSearch(all, 'e', 6).length <= 6, 'the overall limit is respected'); ok(!s.rankSearch(all, 'alic').some(i => i.kind === 'page'), 'pages are not matched by scattered letters'); ok(!s.rankSearch(all, 'x').some(i => i.kind === 'page' && i.id === 'page:privacy'), 'unrelated pages are not suggested'); // ── menu keys ── eq(m.nextMenuIndex(-1, 'ArrowDown', 3), 0, 'down from nothing goes to the first item'); eq(m.nextMenuIndex(2, 'ArrowDown', 3), 0, 'down wraps'); eq(m.nextMenuIndex(0, 'ArrowUp', 3), 2, 'up wraps'); eq(m.nextMenuIndex(-1, 'ArrowUp', 3), 2, 'up from nothing goes to the last item'); eq([m.nextMenuIndex(1, 'Home', 3), m.nextMenuIndex(1, 'End', 3)], [0, 2], 'Home and End'); eq(m.nextMenuIndex(0, 'a', 3), null, 'other keys are not handled'); eq(m.nextMenuIndex(0, 'ArrowDown', 0), null, 'an empty menu does nothing'); // Scattered letters are not a match for collectors or cards either (typing "ali" must not offer the card "Goatlygidds"). const scatter = s.buildEntityItems(['alice', 'malik'], new Set(), [{ number: 10, name: 'Goatlygidds', stars: 3 }, { number: 11, name: 'Alicorn', stars: 2 }]); eq(s.rankSearch(scatter, 'ali').map(i => i.id).sort(), ['card:11', 'player:alice', 'player:malik'].sort(), 'prefix, word-start and substring matches stay, scattered letters go'); ok(!s.rankSearch(scatter, 'ali').some(i => i.id === 'card:10'), 'a card that only contains the letters in order is not suggested'); ok(s.rankSearch(s.PUBLIC_PAGES, 'collectors').some(i => i.id === 'page:collection'), 'the Collectors page is found by that word'); console.log('site search checks passed');

nodes.name: check-staff-guards.mts
nodes.body_text: // Static audit of the access rules: every server action and admin API route must check who is calling, and only the documented // actions may let a mod in. Server actions are public POST endpoints (Next.js lets one be invoked by id from outside its page), so // a missing check is a real hole. This reads the source, so it needs no server and runs with `npm run check`. // A runtime counterpart that signs in as a mod and calls every /api/admin route and admin page: scripts/sweep-mod-access.mjs. // Run: npx tsx scripts/check-staff-guards.mts import { readdirSync, readFileSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'; import { join, relative } from 'node:path'; const root = join(import.meta.dirname, '..'); const problems: string[] = []; const files = [...walk(join(root, 'app')), ...walk(join(root, 'lib'))].filter(f => /\.(ts|tsx)$/.test(f)); // ---- helpers: cut a source file into function segments ---- /** Functions in the file that check directly or through another helper (so guarded() calling admin() calling requireAdmin() counts). */ const ADMIN_GUARD =/\b(requireAdmin|requireStaff)\(|\bisAuthenticated\(|\bhasStaffCapability\(/; const VIEWER_GUARD = /\b(getSession|requireViewer|requireSession)\(/; // ---- 1. server actions in the admin area ---- const actionFiles = files.filter(f => /^app\/admin\/.*actions\.ts$/.test(rel(f)) && /^['"]use server['"]/.test(readFileSync(f, 'utf8'))); ok(actionFiles.length >= 10, `found the admin action files (${actionFiles.length})`); const modActions: string[] = []; let checked = 0; for (const f of actionFiles) { const segs = segments(readFileSync(f, 'utf8')); const helpers = guardHelpers(segs, ADMIN_GUARD); for (const s of segs.filter(s => s.exported)) { checked++; const guarded = ADMIN_GUARD.test(s.body) || helpers.filter(h => h !== s.name).some(h => new RegExp(`\\b${h}\\(`).test(s.body)); ok(guarded, `${rel(f)}: exported action ${s.name}() never checks who is calling (call requireAdmin(), or requireStaff('mod') if mods may use it)`); if (/requireStaff\(\s*['"]mod['"]\s*\)/.test(s.body)) modActions.push(s.name); } } ok(checked >= 60, `audited a realistic number of actions (${checked})`); // Only these may let a mod in (CLAUDE.md > Staff). Adding one is a decision, so it must be added here too. const DOCUMENTED_MOD_ACTIONS = ['saveTagsAction', 'saveFlagsAction', 'cancelUserTradeAction', 'cancelOneTradeAction', 'blockViewerTradingAction', 'reverseTradeAction', 'updateFeedbackAction'].sort(); ok(JSON.stringify([...modActions].sort()) === JSON.stringify(DOCUMENTED_MOD_ACTIONS), `the actions a mod may use are exactly the documented ones (found: ${[...modActions].sort().join(', ')})`); // ---- 2. viewer actions (public site) must read the session, never trust the body ---- const viewerFiles = files.filter(f => /^app\/(\(site\)|\(entity\)|u)\/.*actions\.ts$/.test(rel(f)) && /^['"]use server['"]/.test(readFileSync(f, 'utf8'))); ok(viewerFiles.length >= 3, 'found the viewer action files (profile, cards, copy)'); for (const f of viewerFiles) { const segs = segments(readFileSync(f, 'utf8')); const helpers = guardHelpers(segs, VIEWER_GUARD); for (const s of segs.filter(s => s.exported)) { const guarded = VIEWER_GUARD.test(s.body) || helpers.filter(h => h !== s.name).some(h => new RegExp(`\\b${h}\\(`).test(s.body)); ok(guarded, `${rel(f)}: viewer action ${s.name}() never reads the signed-in session`); } } // ---- 3. admin API routes ---- const routes = files.filter(f => /^app\/api\/admin\/.*route\.ts$/.test(rel(f))); ok(routes.length >= 4, `found the admin API routes (${routes.length})`); const modRoutes: string[] = []; for (const f of routes) { const src = readFileSync(f, 'utf8'); // import-legacy checks its own secret (one-time utility); everything else uses the staff guards. const own = /import-legacy/.test(rel(f)) ? /ADMIN_SECRET|secret/.test(src) : ADMIN_GUARD.test(src); ok(own, `${rel(f)}: admin route never checks who is calling`); if (/hasStaffCapability\(\s*['"]mod['"]\s*\)/.test(src)) modRoutes.push(rel(f)); } ok(JSON.stringify(modRoutes) === JSON.stringify(['app/api/admin/activity/route.ts']), `only the activity feed lets a mod read an admin route (found: ${modRoutes.join(', ') || 'none'})`); // ---- 4. the guards fail closed ---- const guard = readFileSync(join(root, 'lib/staff-guard.ts'), 'utf8'); ok(/export async function requireStaff/.test(guard) && /export async function hasStaffCapability/.test(guard), 'staff guards exist'); const auth = readFileSync(join(root, 'lib/auth.ts'), 'utf8'); ok(/hasStaffCapability\(\s*['"]admin['"]\s*\)/.test(auth), "isAuthenticated() requires the 'admin' capability, not 'mod'"); if (problems.length) throw new Error(`FAILED: ${problems.length} problem(s):\n - ${problems.join('\n - ')}`); console.log(`staff guard audit passed (${checked} admin actions, ${viewerFiles.length} viewer action files, ${routes.length} admin routes)`);

nodes.name: ok
nodes.body_text: ok = (cond: unknown, msg: string) => { if (!cond) problems.push(msg); }

nodes.name: walk
nodes.signature: function walk(dir: string, out: string[] = []): string[]
nodes.body_text: function walk(dir: string, out: string[] = []): string[] { for (const name of readdirSync(dir)) { if (name === 'node_modules' || name === '.next') continue; const p = join(dir, name); if (statSync(p).isDirectory()) walk(p, out); else out.push(p); } return out; }

nodes.name: rel
nodes.body_text: rel = (p: string) => relative(root, p).split('\\').join('/')

nodes.name: Seg
nodes.body_text: interface Seg { name: string; exported: boolean; body: string }

nodes.name: segments
nodes.body_text: function segments(src: string): Seg[] { const re = /^(export\s+)?(?:async\s+)?function\s+(\w+)/gm; const marks = [...src.matchAll(re)].map(m => ({ name: m[2], exported: !!m[1], at: m.index! })); return marks.map((m, i) => ({ name: m.name, exported: m.exported, body: src.slice(m.at, i + 1 < marks.length ? marks[i + 1].at : src.length) })); }

nodes.name: guardHelpers
nodes.signature: function guardHelpers(segs: Seg[], guard: RegExp): string[]
nodes.body_text: function guardHelpers(segs: Seg[], guard: RegExp): string[] { const names = new Set(segs.filter(s => guard.test(s.body)).map(s => s.name)); for (let changed = true; changed;) { changed = false; for (const s of segs) { if (names.has(s.name)) continue; if ([...names].some(h => new RegExp(`\\b${h}\\(`).test(s.body))) { names.add(s.name); changed = true; } } } return [...names]; }

nodes.name: check-staff.mts
nodes.body_text: // Checks staff roles: who counts as super admin, role resolution, who may manage whom, the signed staff cookie and the staff list. // Needs the mock KV (node scripts/mock-kv.cjs) with KV_REST_API_URL / KV_REST_API_TOKEN pointing at it. // Run: npx tsx scripts/check-staff.mts process.env.KV_REST_API_URL ||= 'http://localhost:4111'; process.env.KV_REST_API_TOKEN ||= 'dev'; process.env.KV_URL ||= 'redis://dev'; process.env.SESSION_SECRET = 'a-test-secret-that-is-long-enough-123'; delete process.env.SUPER_ADMIN_TWITCH_IDS; const core = await import('../lib/staff-core'); const tok = await import('../lib/staff-token'); const adminToken = await import('../lib/admin-token'); // ── the super admin is the owner, by Twitch ID ── ok(core.SUPER_ADMINS.some(s => s.login === 'joshmiles'), 'joshmiles is a super admin'); const JOSH = core.SUPER_ADMINS.find(s => s.login === 'joshmiles')!.twitchId; ok(core.isSuperAdmin({ twitchId: JOSH }), 'the owner\'s Twitch ID is the super admin'); ok(!core.isSuperAdmin({ twitchId: '1' }) && !core.isSuperAdmin({}) && !core.isSuperAdmin({ twitchId: null }), 'other accounts are not'); ok(core.resolveRole({ login: 'joshmiles', twitchId: JOSH }, null) === 'super', 'joshmiles is super with no staff record at all'); ok(core.resolveRole({ login: 'joshmiles', twitchId: '999' }, null) === null, 'the login name alone gives nothing (someone who took the name later is not super)'); ok(core.resolveRole({ login: 'renamed', twitchId: JOSH }, null) === 'super', 'the ID still counts if the account is renamed'); ok(core.isSuperAdmin({ twitchId: '777' }, { SUPER_ADMIN_TWITCH_IDS: '555, 777' }) && !core.isSuperAdmin({ twitchId: '778' }, { SUPER_ADMIN_TWITCH_IDS: '555, 777' }), 'extra super admin IDs come from the environment'); ok(!core.isSuperAdmin({ twitchId: 'abc' }, { SUPER_ADMIN_TWITCH_IDS: 'abc' }), 'a junk ID in the environment is ignored'); // ── role resolution from the staff list ── ok(core.resolveRole({ login: 'sam', twitchId: '5' }, rec()) === 'mod', 'a listed mod (not yet bound to an ID)'); ok(core.resolveRole({ login: 'SAM', twitchId: '5' }, rec()) === 'mod', 'logins match regardless of case'); ok(core.resolveRole({ login: 'sam', twitchId: '5' }, rec({ twitchId: '5' })) === 'mod', 'bound and matching ID'); ok(core.resolveRole({ login: 'sam', twitchId: '6' }, rec({ twitchId: '5' })) === null, 'bound to another ID: a re-claimed name gets nothing'); ok(core.resolveRole({ login: 'other', twitchId: '5' }, rec()) === null, 'a record only matches its own login'); ok(core.resolveRole({ login: 'sam', twitchId: '5' }, null) === null, 'not on the list'); ok(core.resolveRole({ login: 'sam', twitchId: '5' }, rec({ role: 'admin' })) === 'admin', 'an admin'); // ── what each role may do ── ok(core.roleCan('super', 'admin') && core.roleCan('super', 'mod') && core.roleCan('super', 'staff:admins') && core.roleCan('super', 'staff:mods'), 'super can do everything'); ok(core.roleCan('admin', 'admin') && core.roleCan('admin', 'mod') && core.roleCan('admin', 'staff:mods') && !core.roleCan('admin', 'staff:admins'), 'an admin cannot manage admins'); ok(core.roleCan('mod', 'mod') && !core.roleCan('mod', 'admin') && !core.roleCan('mod', 'staff:mods') && !core.roleCan('mod', 'staff:admins'), 'a mod only reaches the mod panel'); ok(!core.roleCan(null, 'mod') && !core.roleCan(undefined, 'admin'), 'no role, no access'); ok(core.canManage('super', 'admin') && core.canManage('super', 'mod'), 'super manages admins and mods'); ok(!core.canManage('super', 'super'), 'nobody manages the super admin'); ok(core.canManage('admin', 'mod') && !core.canManage('admin', 'admin') && !core.canManage('admin', 'super'), 'an admin manages only mods'); ok(!core.canManage('mod', 'mod') && !core.canManage(null, 'mod'), 'mods and strangers manage nobody'); // ── names, destinations ── ok(core.cleanLogin(' @Sam_99 ') === 'sam_99' && core.cleanLogin('ab') === null && core.cleanLogin('has space') === null && core.cleanLogin('x'.repeat(26)) === null && core.cleanLogin(5) === null, 'Twitch logins'); ok(core.homePath('mod') === '/mod' && core.homePath('admin') === '/admin' && core.homePath('super') === '/admin', 'where each role lands'); ok(core.staffReturnTo('/admin/users', 'admin') === '/admin/users' && core.staffReturnTo('/admin/users', 'mod') === '/mod', 'a mod is never sent to an admin page'); ok(core.staffReturnTo('/mod/trades', 'mod') === '/mod/trades' && core.staffReturnTo('/mod/trades', 'admin') === '/mod/trades', 'mod pages are open to everyone on staff'); ok(core.staffReturnTo('//evil.com', 'admin') === '/admin' && core.staffReturnTo('https://evil.com', 'admin') === '/admin' && core.staffReturnTo('/account', 'admin') === '/admin' && core.staffReturnTo(null, 'mod') === '/mod' && core.staffReturnTo('/admin\nx', 'admin') === '/admin', 'only panel paths are allowed as a destination'); ok(core.sanitizeStaffRecord({ login: 'Sam', role: 'god' }) === null && core.sanitizeStaffRecord({ login: 'sam', role: 'super' }) === null && core.sanitizeStaffRecord('x') === null, 'a stored record can never be super or have an unknown role'); ok(core.sanitizeStaffRecord({ login: 'sam', role: 'mod', twitchId: 'nope', addedBy: 'a', addedAt: 3 })?.twitchId === undefined, 'a junk Twitch ID is dropped'); // ── the signed cookie ── const t = await tok.signStaffToken({ u: 'sam', id: '5', dn: 'Sam', role: 'mod' }, 1_000_000_000_000); ok(t && t.split('.').length === 2, 'a token is signed'); const back = await tok.verifyStaffToken(t!, 1_000_000_000_000 + 1000); ok(back?.u === 'sam' && back.id === '5' && back.role === 'mod', 'it verifies and carries the identity'); ok(await tok.verifyStaffToken(t!, 1_000_000_000_000 + (tok.STAFF_TTL_S + 5) * 1000) === null, 'it expires after an hour'); // sliding renewal and the 12-hour cap const T0 = 1_000_000_000_000; ok(back?.iat === Math.floor(T0 / 1000), 'a token records when it was first issued'); ok(!tok.shouldRenewStaffToken(back!, T0 + 10 * 60_000), 'not renewed with 50 minutes left'); ok(tok.shouldRenewStaffToken(back!, T0 + 31 * 60_000), 'renewed with under 30 minutes left'); const renewed = await tok.renewStaffToken(back!, 'admin', T0 + 40 * 60_000); const rb = await tok.verifyStaffToken(renewed!, T0 + 40 * 60_000); ok(rb?.role === 'admin' && rb.iat === back!.iat && rb.exp > back!.exp, 'a renewal takes the live role, keeps iat and extends exp'); ok(await tok.renewStaffToken(back!, 'mod', T0 + 5 * 60_000) === null, 'no renewal when not due'); const issuedAt = T0 + 11 * 3600_000; // first issued at T0, last renewed an hour before the cap const late = await tok.signStaffToken({ u: 'sam', id: '5', dn: 'Sam', role: 'mod', iat: Math.floor(T0 / 1000) }, issuedAt); const lateT = await tok.verifyStaffToken(late!, issuedAt); ok(lateT && tok.shouldRenewStaffToken(lateT, issuedAt + 40 * 60_000), 'still renewed just inside 12 hours'); ok(!tok.shouldRenewStaffToken(lateT!, T0 + 12 * 3600_000 + 1000), 'never renewed after 12 hours since the first issue'); const [payload, sig] = t!.split('.'); const forged = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({ u: 'sam', id: '5', dn: 'Sam', role: 'super', exp: 9_999_999_999 })).toString('base64url'); ok(await tok.verifyStaffToken(`${forged}.${sig}`, 1_000_000_000_000) === null, 'a forged role is rejected'); ok(await tok.verifyStaffToken(`${payload}.${sig.slice(0, -2)}xx`, 1_000_000_000_000) === null, 'a changed signature is rejected'); ok(await tok.verifyStaffToken(undefined) === null && await tok.verifyStaffToken('garbage') === null && await tok.verifyStaffToken('a.b.c') === null && await tok.verifyStaffToken('.') === null, 'junk is rejected'); ok(await tok.verifyStaffToken(t!, 1_000_000_000_000, { SESSION_SECRET: 'a-different-secret-that-is-long-1' }) === null, 'a different secret is rejected'); ok(await tok.signStaffToken({ u: 'sam', id: '5', dn: 'Sam', role: 'mod' }, Date.now(), { SESSION_SECRET: 'short' }) === null, 'no token is made without a proper secret'); const roleless = await tok.signStaffToken({ u: 'sam', id: '5', dn: 'Sam', role: 'root' as never }, 1_000_000_000_000); ok(await tok.verifyStaffToken(roleless!, 1_000_000_000_000) === null, 'a token with an unknown role is rejected'); // ── the emergency password switch ── ok(adminToken.isPasswordLoginEnabled({}) && adminToken.isPasswordLoginEnabled({ ADMIN_PASSWORD_LOGIN: 'on' }), 'password login is on by default'); ok(['off', 'OFF', 'false', '0', 'no', ' off '].every(v => !adminToken.isPasswordLoginEnabled({ ADMIN_PASSWORD_LOGIN: v })), 'and can be switched off'); // ── the staff list ── const staff = await import('../lib/staff'); const SUPER = { login: 'joshmiles', role: 'super' as const }; const ADMIN = { login: 'ann', role: 'admin' as const }; const MOD = { login: 'sam', role: 'mod' as const }; const unique = Date.now().toString(36); const mod1 = `mod_${unique}`, mod2 = `modb_${unique}`, adm1 = `adm_${unique}`; ok(!(await staff.addStaff(MOD, mod1, 'mod')).ok, 'a mod cannot add staff'); ok((await staff.addStaff(ADMIN, mod1, 'mod')).ok, 'an admin can add a mod'); ok(!(await staff.addStaff(ADMIN, adm1, 'admin')).ok && (await staff.getStaffRecord(adm1)) === null, 'an admin cannot add an admin'); ok((await staff.addStaff(SUPER, adm1, 'admin')).ok, 'the super admin can add an admin'); ok(!(await staff.addStaff(SUPER, mod1, 'mod')).ok, 'adding someone twice is refused'); ok(!(await staff.addStaff(SUPER, 'joshmiles', 'admin')).ok, 'the super admin cannot be added as staff'); ok(!(await staff.addStaff(SUPER, 'no', 'mod')).ok && !(await staff.addStaff(SUPER, mod2, 'root' as never)).ok, 'bad names and roles are refused'); const m1 = await staff.getStaffRecord(mod1); ok(m1?.role === 'mod' && m1.addedBy === 'ann' && !m1.twitchId, 'the record notes who added it (no ID yet: they have not played)'); // Role changes and removal obey the same rules. ok(!(await staff.setStaffRole(ADMIN, mod1, 'admin')).ok && (await staff.getStaffRecord(mod1))?.role === 'mod', 'an admin cannot promote a mod to admin'); ok(!(await staff.setStaffRole(ADMIN, adm1, 'mod')).ok && (await staff.getStaffRecord(adm1))?.role === 'admin', 'an admin cannot demote an admin'); ok(!(await staff.removeStaff(ADMIN, adm1)).ok && (await staff.getStaffRecord(adm1)) !== null, 'an admin cannot remove an admin'); ok(!(await staff.setStaffRole(MOD, mod1, 'mod')).ok && !(await staff.removeStaff(MOD, mod1)).ok, 'a mod cannot change or remove anyone'); ok((await staff.setStaffRole(SUPER, mod1, 'admin')).ok && (await staff.getStaffRecord(mod1))?.role === 'admin', 'the super admin can promote'); ok((await staff.setStaffRole(SUPER, mod1, 'mod')).ok && (await staff.getStaffRecord(mod1))?.role === 'mod', 'and demote'); ok(!(await staff.setStaffRole(SUPER, 'nobody_here', 'mod')).ok && !(await staff.removeStaff(SUPER, 'nobody_here')).ok, 'unknown people cannot be changed or removed'); // First sign-in binds the account's Twitch ID, once. await staff.touchStaffLogin(mod1, '4242', 'Mod One'); const bound = await staff.getStaffRecord(mod1); ok(bound?.twitchId === '4242' && bound.displayName === 'Mod One' && !!bound.lastLogin, 'the first sign-in binds the Twitch ID and notes the time'); await staff.touchStaffLogin(mod1, '9999', 'Impostor'); ok((await staff.getStaffRecord(mod1))?.twitchId === '4242', 'a different account signing in as that name does not rebind it'); ok(core.resolveRole({ login: mod1, twitchId: '9999' }, await staff.getStaffRecord(mod1)) === null && core.resolveRole({ login: mod1, twitchId: '4242' }, await staff.getStaffRecord(mod1)) === 'mod', 'so only the real account gets the role'); // Listing, log and removal. const list = await staff.listStaff(); ok(list.some(r => r.login === mod1) && list.some(r => r.login === adm1), 'both are listed'); ok(list.findIndex(r => r.login === adm1) < list.findIndex(r => r.login === mod1), 'admins are listed before mods'); ok((await staff.removeStaff(ADMIN, mod1)).ok && (await staff.getStaffRecord(mod1)) === null, 'an admin can remove a mod'); ok((await staff.removeStaff(SUPER, adm1)).ok && (await staff.getStaffRecord(adm1)) === null, 'the super admin can remove an admin'); const log = await staff.getStaffLog(50); ok(log.some(l => l.action === 'added' && l.login === mod1 && l.by === 'ann') && log.some(l => l.action === 'removed' && l.login === adm1 && l.by === 'joshmiles') && log.some(l => l.action === 'role' && l.login === mod1), 'every change is logged with who made it'); ok(staff.listSuperAdmins().some(s => s.login === 'joshmiles'), 'the super admin is shown'); // ── what staff did is attributed ── { const act = await import('../lib/activity'); const view = await import('../lib/activity-view'); ok(act.isStaffAction(ev({ type: 'grant', source: 'admin', username: 'a', cardNumber: 1 })), 'an admin grant is a staff action'); ok(!act.isStaffAction(ev({ type: 'grant', source: 'webhook', username: 'a', cardNumber: 1 })), 'a webhook grant is not'); ok(act.isStaffAction(ev({ type: 'remove', username: 'a', cardNumber: 1 })) && act.isStaffAction(ev({ type: 'reset', scope: 'season', username: 'a' })) && act.isStaffAction(ev({ type: 'delete', username: 'a' })), 'removals, resets and deletes are'); ok(act.isStaffAction(ev({ type: 'trigger', kind: 'pull', source: 'admin', username: 'a' })) && !act.isStaffAction(ev({ type: 'trigger', kind: 'pull', source: 'webhook', username: 'a' })), 'a gifted pack is, a webhook trigger is not'); ok(act.isStaffAction(ev({ type: 'trade', action: 'cancelled', by: 'admin', kind: 'direct', give: [], get: [], givePts: 0, getPts: 0, username: 'a' })), 'an admin cancel of an offer is'); ok(!act.isStaffAction(ev({ type: 'trade', action: 'cancelled', by: 'a', kind: 'direct', give: [], get: [], givePts: 0, getPts: 0, username: 'a' })), 'a viewer withdrawing their own offer is not'); ok(!act.isStaffAction(ev({ type: 'pull', username: 'a', cardNumber: 1, cardName: 'x', stars: 1, packName: 'p', isNew: true, copies: 1, uniqueOwned: 1 })) && !act.isStaffAction(ev({ type: 'upgrade', username: 'a', cardNumber: 1, cardName: 'x', from: 'regular', to: 'reverse', cost: 5 })), 'a viewer\'s own pull or upgrade never is, even if the viewer is staff'); const base = { seq: 1, at: 1, username: 'viewer1', type: 'remove', cardNumber: 7 }; const noStaff = view.plainText(base as never, () => 'Cheese'); const withStaff = view.plainText({ ...base, staff: 'sam' } as never, () => 'Cheese'); ok(!noStaff.includes('(by') && withStaff === `${noStaff} (by sam)`, 'the sentence names the staff member'); } // ── staff badges (17.1) ── { const b = await import('../lib/staff-badge-core'); const staff = [{ login: 'sam', role: 'mod' as const }, { login: 'Ann', role: 'admin' as const }]; ok(b.staffBadgeFor('cheesygidds', staff, {}) === 'streamer', 'the channel account shows Streamer even when not on the staff list'); ok(b.staffBadgeFor('joshmiles', staff, {}) === 'admin', 'the super admin shows Admin'); ok(b.staffBadgeFor('CheesyGidds', staff, null) === 'streamer', 'case does not matter'); ok(b.staffBadgeFor('ann', staff, {}) === 'admin' && b.staffBadgeFor('SAM', staff, undefined) === 'mod', 'admin and mod badges'); ok(b.staffBadgeFor('viewer', staff, {}) === null, 'a viewer has none'); ok(b.staffBadgeFor('sam', staff, { hideStaffBadge: true }) === null && b.staffBadgeFor('cheesygidds', staff, { hideStaffBadge: true }) === null, 'a hidden badge is not shown'); ok(b.staffBadgeFor('sam', [], {}) === null, 'a removed staff member loses the badge at once'); const us = await import('../lib/user-settings'); ok(us.sanitizeUserSettings({ hideStaffBadge: true }).hideStaffBadge === true && us.sanitizeUserSettings({ hideStaffBadge: 'x' }).hideStaffBadge === false && us.DEFAULT_SETTINGS.hideStaffBadge === false, 'the setting sanitizes and defaults to shown'); } console.log('staff checks passed');

nodes.name: check-stream-recap.mts
nodes.body_text: // The end-of-stream recap: the pure builder (counts, rarest, top puller, new collectors, first ever, trades, the window), the Recap // category (off for existing channels), and the once-only rule: two instances ending the same stream post one recap, a missed // transition or a stream with no pulls posts none. Uses a local fake webhook and the mock KV (node scripts/mock-kv.cjs). // Run: node scripts/run-checks.mjs stream-recap import { createServer } from 'node:http'; import type { AddressInfo } from 'node:net'; const url = process.env.KV_REST_API_URL ?? 'http://localhost:4111'; if (!/^http:\/\/(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)[:/]/.test(url)) throw new Error(`Refusing to run against non-local KV: ${url}`); process.env.KV_REST_API_URL = url; process.env.KV_REST_API_TOKEN ??= 'dev'; process.env.KV_URL ??= 'redis://dev'; const hits: { embeds: { title?: string; fields?: { name: string; value: string }[]; description?: string }[] }[] = []; const server = createServer((req, res) => { let data = ''; req.on('data', d => (data += d)); req.on('end', () => { hits.push(JSON.parse(data)); res.statusCode = 204; res.end(); }); }); await new Promise<void>(r => server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', r)); const hook = `http://localhost:${(server.address() as AddressInfo).port}/api/webhooks/1/token`; const { buildStreamRecap, recapWorthPosting } = await import('../lib/stream-recap'); const live = await import('../lib/twitch-live'); const d = await import('../lib/discord'); const dc = await import('../lib/discord-config'); const { kv } = await import('../lib/db'); let seq = 0; const T0 = 1_000_000_000_000, H = 3_600_000; const events: Ev[] = [ pull('early', T0 - H, { stars: 5 }), // before the stream pull('ann', T0 + 1000, { isNew: true, uniqueOwned: 1, cardNumber: 3, serial: 1, stars: 3 }), // a new collector, first ever pull('ann', T0 + 2000, { cardNumber: 4 }), pull('bob', T0 + 3000, { stars: 4, variant: 'shiny', cardName: 'Bird', cardNumber: 5, serial: 7, uid: 42 }), pull('cy', T0 + 4000, { stars: 4, variant: 'regular', cardNumber: 6 }), pull('cy', T0 + 5000, { isNew: true, uniqueOwned: 3, cardNumber: 7 }), // new card, not a new collector trade('accepted', T0 + 6000), trade('offered', T0 + 6500), pull('late', T0 + 3 * H, {}), // after the stream ]; const r = buildStreamRecap(events, T0, T0 + 2 * H); // A card granted by webhook (a reward) counts as a pack opened, a puller, a new collector, and can be the rarest. const rg = buildStreamRecap([...events, wgrant('dee', T0 + 7000, { stars: 5, cardName: 'Dragon', packName: 'Base', isNew: true, copies: 1, uniqueOwned: 1, serial: 1, variant: 'shiny' }), wgrant('ann', T0 + 8000), { type: 'grant', source: 'admin', seq: ++seq, at: T0 + 9000, username: 'zed', cardNumber: 2 } as unknown as Ev], T0, T0 + 2 * H); ok(rg.packs === 7 && rg.pullers === 4, 'webhook grants count as packs and pullers; an admin grant does not'); ok(rg.rarest?.cardName === 'Dragon' && rg.rarest.variant === 'shiny', 'a rare webhook grant can be the rarest pull'); ok(rg.newCollectors.includes('dee') && rg.firstEver.some(p => p.username === 'dee'), 'and a first-ever new collector'); ok(rg.topPuller?.username === 'ann' && rg.topPuller.packs === 3, 'and counts towards the top puller (ann: 2 pulls and a grant)'); ok(r.packs === 5 && r.pullers === 3, 'counts only the pulls inside the window'); ok(r.distinctCards === 5, 'counts different cards'); ok(JSON.stringify(r.newCollectors) === '["ann"]', 'a new collector is a first-ever card, not just a new card'); ok(r.firstEver.length === 1 && r.firstEver[0].username === 'ann', 'first-ever pulls are edition 1 pulls'); ok(r.rarest?.username === 'bob' && r.rarest.variant === 'shiny', 'the rarest pull is the best star count, then the best version'); ok(r.rarest?.href === '/c/42', 'the rarest pull links to its print'); ok(r.topPuller?.username === 'ann' && r.topPuller.packs === 2, 'the top puller has the most packs (ties go to the name that sorts first)'); ok(r.tradesCompleted === 1, 'only accepted trades count'); ok(!r.partial, 'a log that reaches back is not partial'); ok(buildStreamRecap(events, T0, T0 + 2 * H, { logIsFull: true }).partial === false, 'a full log that still has older events is complete'); ok(buildStreamRecap(events.filter(e => e.at >= T0), T0 - H / 2, T0 + 2 * H, { logIsFull: true }).partial, 'a full log that starts after the stream did is partial'); ok(!recapWorthPosting(buildStreamRecap(events, T0 + 4 * H, T0 + 5 * H)), 'no pulls means no recap'); // Category: existing channels do not start posting it. const old = d.normalize({ url: hook, enabled: true, categories: { pulls: true } } as never).channels[0]; ok(old.categories.recap === false, 'an existing channel has Recap off'); ok(dc.DISCORD_CATEGORIES.some(c => c.key === 'recap') && dc.presetChannel('recap').categories.recap, 'the Recap category and preset exist'); const msg = d.buildRecapMessage(r); const fields = Object.fromEntries((msg.embeds[0].fields ?? []).map(f => [f.name, f.value])); ok(fields['Packs opened'] === '5' && fields['Rarest pull'].includes('/c/42') && fields['Top puller'].includes('ann'), 'the embed carries the numbers, the print link and the top puller'); ok(JSON.stringify(msg.allowed_mentions) === '{"parse":[]}', 'the recap pings nobody'); // Once only. const recapChannel = { id: 'r', name: 'Recap', url: hook, enabled: true, categories: { ...dc.DEFAULT_CATEGORIES, pulls: false, cards: false, upgrades: false, trades: false, resets: false, recap: true }, minStars: 1, newOnly: false }; await kv.set('discord:settings', { enabled: true, channels: [recapChannel] }); const { recordActivity } = await import('../lib/activity'); await reset(); await kv.set('twitch:live:since', Date.now() - H); await recordActivity({ type: 'pull', username: 'ann', cardNumber: 1, cardName: 'Cat', stars: 3, packName: 'Base', isNew: true, copies: 1, uniqueOwned: 1 }); await sleep(200); ok(hits.length === 0, 'a Recap-only channel does not receive the pull itself'); const [a, b] = await Promise.all([live.finishStream(), live.finishStream()]); await sleep(300); ok(!!(a ?? b) && !(a && b), 'two instances ending the same stream: exactly one builds the recap'); ok(hits.length === 1 && hits[0].embeds[0].title?.includes('Stream recap'), 'exactly one recap reaches Discord'); ok((await live.getLatestRecap())?.packs === 1, 'the latest recap is stored for the dashboard'); await kv.del('twitch:recap:lock'); await live.finishStream(); await sleep(200); ok(hits.length === 1, 'the same stream is never recapped twice, even once the lock has expired'); await reset(); await live.finishStream(); await sleep(200); ok(hits.length === 0, 'no start marker (the transition was missed) posts nothing'); await reset(); await kv.set('twitch:live:since', Date.now() - H); await live.finishStream(); await sleep(200); ok(hits.length === 0 && !(await live.getLatestRecap()), 'a stream with no pulls posts nothing'); server.close(); console.log('stream recap ok'); process.exit(0);

nodes.name: check-trade-match.mts
nodes.body_text: // Checks listing matches and the fairness label. Pure. Run: npx tsx scripts/check-trade-match.mts const m = await import('../lib/trade-match'); const { encodeEntry } = await import('../lib/variants'); const cards = Object.fromEntries([1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(n => [n, info(n, n * 10)])); // The viewer owns 3x card 1 (regular) and 1x card 2 (regular); wants card 5. const viewer = { copies: new Map([[E(1), 3], [E(2), 1]]), wanted: new Set([5]) }; const wantsMine = m.matchTrade(T('a', [[5, 'regular', 1]], [[1, 'regular', 1]]), viewer, cards); ok(wantsMine.canTake && wantsMine.offersWanted.length === 1 && wantsMine.asksOnlySpares, 'a listing that gives a wanted card for a spare'); ok(wantsMine.reasons[0] === 'Offers a card you are looking for', 'reason: wanted card'); const cantTake = m.matchTrade(T('b', [[3, 'regular', 1]], [[2, 'regular', 2]]), viewer, cards); ok(!cantTake.canTake && cantTake.score < 0, 'cannot take what asks for more than you own'); const lastCopy = m.matchTrade(T('c', [[3, 'regular', 1]], [[2, 'regular', 1]]), viewer, cards); ok(lastCopy.canTake && !lastCopy.asksOnlySpares, 'giving your only copy is not a spare'); ok(lastCopy.offersNew.length === 1, 'card 3 is new to the viewer'); eq(m.matchTrade(T('d', [[1, 'regular', 1]], [[1, 'regular', 2]]), viewer, cards).gain, -10, 'gain is points received minus points given'); const board = [T('a', [[5, 'regular', 1]], [[1, 'regular', 1]], 3), T('b', [[3, 'regular', 1]], [[2, 'regular', 2]], 2), T('c', [[3, 'regular', 1]], [[2, 'regular', 1]], 1), T('d', [[1, 'regular', 1]], [[1, 'regular', 2]], 4)]; eq(m.bestMatches(board, viewer, cards).map(x => (x.trade as { id: string }).id), ['a', 'c'], 'best matches: only takeable, interesting ones, best first'); eq(m.bestMatches(board, viewer, cards, 1).length, 1, 'limit'); eq(m.fairness(100, 100).label, 'Even', 'even'); eq(m.fairness(300, 100), { label: 'Lopsided against you', warn: true }, 'giving three times as much warns'); eq(m.fairness(100, 300).label, 'Generous to them' === m.fairness(100, 300).label ? 'Generous to them' : 'x', 'getting three times as much is not a warning'); ok(!m.fairness(100, 300).warn, 'no warning when you gain'); eq(m.fairness(40, 10).warn, false, 'a big ratio but a tiny gap does not warn'); eq(m.fairness(120, 100).label, 'Slightly in their favour', 'small gap'); eq(m.fairness(0, 0).label, 'Empty', 'nothing chosen'); // ── Serial bonuses in trade prices ── const core = await import('../lib/trade-view-core'); const stack = [{ cardNumber: 2, variant: 'regular' as const, count: 2 }]; eq(core.stackPoints(stack, cards), 40, 'no pool: plain values'); // Trades move the NEWEST copies, so with serials #1 #5 #30 a stack of 2 takes #30 (no bonus) and #5. const bonus5 = Math.round(20 * (1 + 2 * (1 - 4 / 20))); eq(core.stackPoints(stack, cards, { [E(2)]: [1, 5, 30] }), bonus5 + 20, 'a stack of 2 takes the two newest serials'); eq(core.stackPoints(stack, cards, { [E(2)]: [1] }), Math.round(20 * 3) + 20, 'a short pool: the rest are priced plain'); eq(core.stackPoints([{ cardNumber: 2, variant: 'shiny' as const, count: 1 }], cards, { [E(2)]: [1] }), 20 * 30, 'a pool for another version does not apply'); // An offer is priced from its escrow, and what it asks from the viewer's own pool; the viewer's own offer asks nobody in particular. const pools = { viewer: 'v', give: { a: { [E(5)]: [1] } }, mine: { [E(1)]: [1, 2, 3] } }; const lp = core.poolsFor({ id: 'a', from: 'x' }, pools); ok(lp.give?.[E(5)]?.[0] === 1 && lp.get?.[E(1)]?.length === 3, "someone else's offer: escrow for what it gives, my copies for what it asks"); ok(core.poolsFor({ id: 'a', from: 'v' }, pools).get === undefined, 'my own offer has no pool for what it asks'); const withBonus = m.matchTrade(T('a', [[5, 'regular', 1]], [[1, 'regular', 1]]), viewer, cards, pools); const plainMatch = m.matchTrade(T('a', [[5, 'regular', 1]], [[1, 'regular', 1]]), viewer, cards); ok(withBonus.gain === 150 - 28 && plainMatch.gain === 40, 'the match gain uses the serial bonus: ' + withBonus.gain + ' vs ' + plainMatch.gain); console.log('trade match checks passed');
