nodes.name: check-trade-points.mts
nodes.body_text: // Checks that the points quoted for trades in the activity feed / Discord include the serial bonuses, read before the copies move. // Needs the mock KV (node scripts/mock-kv.cjs); refuses anything non-local. Run: npx tsx scripts/check-trade-points.mts const url = process.env.KV_REST_API_URL ?? 'http://localhost:4111'; if (!/^http:\/\/(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)[:/]/.test(url)) throw new Error(`Refusing to run against non-local KV: ${url}`); process.env.KV_REST_API_URL = url; process.env.KV_REST_API_TOKEN ??= 'dev'; process.env.KV_URL ??= 'redis://dev'; const { encodeEntry } = await import('../lib/variants'); const db = await import('../lib/db'); const kvLib = await import('../lib/kv'); const sbx = await import('../lib/sandbox'); const trades = await import('../lib/trades'); const ser = await import('../lib/serials'); const act = await import('../lib/activity'); const view = await import('../lib/trade-view'); await kvLib.seedSeason1(); const box = await sbx.createSandbox({ name: 'Trade points check', source: 'config' }); await db.runInSandbox(box.id, async () => { const season = (await kvLib.listSeasons())[0]; const coll = season.collectionName; await trades.saveTradeSettings({ ...(await trades.getTradeSettings()), cooldownSeconds: 0 }); await kvLib.saveCollection(coll, { alice: [E(1), E(1), E(1)], bob: [E(9), E(9)] }); await ser.backfillSerials(coll, await kvLib.getCollection(coll)); // alice: card 1 #1 #2 #3, bob: card 9 #1 #2 const cards = await view.getTradeCards(season); ok(worth(1, 3) > cards[1].values[0] && worth(9, 2) > cards[9].values[0], 'low serials are worth more than the plain value'); const o = await trades.createTrade({ seasonId: season.id, from: 'alice', kind: 'direct', to: 'bob', give: [{ cardNumber: 1, variant: 'regular', count: 1 }], get: [{ cardNumber: 9, variant: 'regular', count: 1 }] }); ok(o.ok, 'offer created'); if (!o.ok) return; let ev = await latest(); ok(ev.action === 'offered' && ev.givePts === worth(1, 3), `offer: the give side is priced from the escrowed copy (#3): ${ev.givePts} vs ${worth(1, 3)}`); ok((await trades.acceptTrade(o.trade.id, 'bob')).ok, 'accepted'); ev = await latest(); ok(ev.action === 'accepted', 'accepted event recorded'); ok(ev.givePts === worth(1, 3), `accept: the give side keeps the serial it had before it moved: ${ev.givePts}`); ok(ev.getPts === worth(9, 2), `accept: the asked-for side is priced from the taker's newest copy (#2): ${ev.getPts} vs ${worth(9, 2)}`); // A declined offer is priced from the escrow, before the refund. const d = await trades.createTrade({ seasonId: season.id, from: 'alice', kind: 'direct', to: 'bob', give: [{ cardNumber: 1, variant: 'regular', count: 1 }], get: [{ cardNumber: 9, variant: 'regular', count: 1 }] }); ok(d.ok, 'second offer'); if (!d.ok) return; await trades.declineTrade(d.trade.id, 'bob'); ev = await latest(); ok(ev.action === 'declined' && ev.givePts > 0, 'declined event carries the points'); }); await sbx.deleteSandbox(box.id); console.log('trade points checks passed'); process.exit(0);

nodes.name: check-trades.mts
nodes.body_text: // Checks the trading rules. Needs the mock KV running (node scripts/mock-kv.cjs); refuses anything non-local. // Run: npx tsx scripts/check-trades.mts const url = process.env.KV_REST_API_URL ?? 'http://localhost:4111'; if (!/^http:\/\/(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)[:/]/.test(url)) throw new Error(`Refusing to run against non-local KV: ${url}`); process.env.KV_REST_API_URL = url; process.env.KV_REST_API_TOKEN ??= 'dev'; process.env.KV_URL ??= 'redis://dev'; const core = await import('../lib/trade-core'); const { encodeEntry } = await import('../lib/variants'); // ── Pure core ── eq(core.cleanItems([{ cardNumber: 5, variant: 'regular', count: 2 }, { cardNumber: 5, variant: 'regular', count: 3 }], 8), [{ cardNumber: 5, variant: 'regular', count: 5 }], 'same stack merges'); ok(core.cleanItems([], 8) === null, 'empty is refused'); ok(core.cleanItems('x', 8) === null, 'non-array is refused'); ok(core.cleanItems([{ cardNumber: 0, variant: 'regular', count: 1 }], 8) === null, 'card 0 refused'); ok(core.cleanItems([{ cardNumber: 1_000_000, variant: 'regular', count: 1 }], 8) === null, 'card number too large refused'); ok(core.cleanItems([{ cardNumber: 1, variant: 'bogus', count: 1 }], 8) === null, 'unknown variant refused'); ok(core.cleanItems([{ cardNumber: 1, variant: 'regular', count: 0 }], 8) === null, 'zero copies refused'); ok(core.cleanItems([{ cardNumber: 1, variant: 'regular', count: -3 }], 8) === null, 'negative copies refused'); ok(core.cleanItems([{ cardNumber: 1, variant: 'regular', count: 100 }], 8) === null, 'too many copies in a stack refused'); ok(core.cleanItems([{ cardNumber: 1, variant: 'regular', count: 1 }, { cardNumber: 2, variant: 'regular', count: 1 }], 1) === null, 'too many stacks refused'); eq(core.sanitizeTradeSettings({ expiryHours: 99999, maxOpenPerUser: 0, cooldownSeconds: -5, enabled: 'false' }), { enabled: false, expiryHours: 336, maxOpenPerUser: 1, cooldownSeconds: 0, maxStacksPerSide: 8, minAccountHours: 0 }, 'settings are clamped'); const give = [{ cardNumber: 1, variant: 'regular' as const, count: 2 }]; const get = [{ cardNumber: 9, variant: 'shiny' as const, count: 1 }]; const offererNow = [E(2), E(3)]; // the escrow has already left the offerer const takerNow = [E(9, 'shiny'), E(4), E(4)]; const before = total(offererNow, takerNow, core.itemEntries(give)); const settled = core.settleTrade(offererNow, takerNow, give, get); ok(settled.ok, 'settles when the taker has the goods'); if (settled.ok) { ok(total(settled.offerer, settled.taker) === before, 'settlement conserves every copy (escrow included)'); ok(core.ownedCopies(settled.offerer, 9, 'shiny') === 1 && core.ownedCopies(settled.taker, 1, 'regular') === 2, 'each side receives what was agreed'); ok(core.ownedCopies(settled.taker, 9, 'shiny') === 0, 'the taker no longer has what they gave'); } const lacking = core.settleTrade(offererNow, [E(4)], give, get); ok(!lacking.ok && lacking.missing.cardNumber === 9, 'settlement refuses when the taker lacks the goods'); const esc = core.takeForEscrow([E(1), E(1), E(1), E(7)], give); ok(esc.ok && esc.rest.length === 2 && core.ownedCopies(esc.rest, 1, 'regular') === 1, 'escrow takes exactly the offered copies'); ok(!core.takeForEscrow([E(1)], give).ok, 'escrow refuses when the viewer owns too few'); // ── Insights (pure) ── const insights = await import('../lib/trade-insights'); const now0 = Date.now(); const fl = insights.flagTrades([T({})], { points: pointsOf, createdAt: () => undefined }); ok([...fl.values()][0]?.some(f => f.kind === 'lopsided'), 'a 10× gap is flagged lopsided'); const even = insights.flagTrades([T({})], { points: () => 100, createdAt: () => undefined }); ok(even.size === 0, 'an even trade is not flagged'); const rep = insights.flagTrades(mk(3, [1, 1]), { points: () => 100, createdAt: () => undefined }); ok([...rep.values()].every(f => f.some(x => x.kind === 'repeat')) && rep.size === 3, 'three trades between one pair are flagged as repeats'); const burst = insights.flagTrades(mk(5, [1, 1]).map(t => ({ ...t, status: 'open' as const })), { points: () => 100, createdAt: () => undefined }); ok([...burst.values()].some(f => f.some(x => x.kind === 'burst')), 'five offers in minutes is a burst'); const newb = insights.flagTrades([T({ createdAt: now0 })], { points: () => 100, createdAt: u => (u === 'a' ? now0 - 3_600_000 : undefined) }); ok([...newb.values()][0]?.some(f => f.kind === 'newbie'), 'a viewer who joined an hour before is flagged new'); const st = insights.computeTradeStats([], [T({ resolvedAt: 1_000_000 + 120_000 }), T({ status: 'declined' }), T({ status: 'expired' })], now0); ok(st.accepted === 1 && Math.abs((st.acceptRate ?? 0) - 1 / 3) < 1e-9 && st.medianAcceptMin === 2, 'stats: accept rate and median wait'); ok(insights.tradesToCsv([]).startsWith('id,status'), 'csv has a header'); // ── Engine, in an isolated sandbox namespace ── const db = await import('../lib/db'); const kvLib = await import('../lib/kv'); const sbx = await import('../lib/sandbox'); const trades = await import('../lib/trades'); const { prodKv, runInSandbox } = db; await kvLib.seedSeason1(); const pack = (await kvLib.getPack('pack1'))!; await kvLib.savePack({ ...pack, upgradesEnabled: true } as never); const box = await sbx.createSandbox({ name: 'Trade check', source: 'config' }); const prodBefore = JSON.stringify(await prodKv.get('trades:open')); await runInSandbox(box.id, async () => { const season = (await kvLib.listSeasons())[0]; const coll = season.collectionName; // The invariant after every step: collections + escrow never change in total. await trades.saveTradeSettings({ ...core.DEFAULT_TRADE_SETTINGS, cooldownSeconds: 0, maxOpenPerUser: 3 }); await put({ alice: [E(1), E(1), E(1), E(2), E(5, 'reverse')], bob: [E(9), E(9), E(3), E(4, 'full')], carol: [E(7)] }); const start = await universe(); ok(start === 10, 'starting copies'); // Creating an offer escrows the copies immediately. const a1 = await trades.createTrade({ seasonId: season.id, from: 'alice', kind: 'direct', to: 'bob', give: [stack(1, 'regular', 2)], get: [stack(9, 'regular', 1)] }); ok(a1.ok, 'direct offer is created'); if (!a1.ok) return; ok(core.ownedCopies(await owned('alice'), 1, 'regular') === 1, 'two copies left alice for escrow'); ok(await universe() === start, 'copies conserved after creating'); // Rules on creation. ok(!(await trades.createTrade({ seasonId: season.id, from: 'alice', kind: 'direct', to: 'alice', give: [stack(2)], get: [stack(9)] })).ok, 'no trading with yourself'); ok(!(await trades.createTrade({ seasonId: season.id, from: 'alice', kind: 'direct', to: 'nobody_here', give: [stack(2)], get: [stack(9)] })).ok, 'recipient must exist'); ok(!(await trades.createTrade({ seasonId: season.id, from: 'alice', kind: 'direct', to: 'bob', give: [stack(2, 'regular', 5)], get: [stack(9)] })).ok, 'cannot offer copies you do not own'); ok(!(await trades.createTrade({ seasonId: season.id, from: 'alice', kind: 'listing', give: [stack(2)], get: [stack(9999)] })).ok, 'wanted card must exist'); ok(!(await trades.createTrade({ seasonId: season.id, from: 'alice', kind: 'listing', give: [stack(2)], get: [] })).ok, 'must want something back'); ok(await universe() === start, 'failed offers change nothing'); ok(core.ownedCopies(await owned('alice'), 2, 'regular') === 1, 'a refused offer takes nothing'); // Accept by the wrong person / without the goods / correctly. ok(!(await trades.acceptTrade(a1.trade.id, 'carol')).ok, 'only the recipient can accept a direct offer'); ok(!(await trades.acceptTrade(a1.trade.id, 'alice')).ok, 'cannot accept your own offer'); const lack = await trades.createTrade({ seasonId: season.id, from: 'alice', kind: 'direct', to: 'carol', give: [stack(2)], get: [stack(9, 'regular', 1)] }); ok(lack.ok, 'offer to carol'); if (lack.ok) { const r = await trades.acceptTrade(lack.trade.id, 'carol'); ok(!r.ok, 'acceptor without the requested copies is refused'); ok((await trades.getTrade(lack.trade.id))?.status === 'open', 'a refused accept leaves the offer open'); ok(await universe() === start, 'copies conserved after a refused accept'); ok((await trades.cancelTrade(lack.trade.id, 'alice')).ok, 'alice cancels the offer to carol'); ok(core.ownedCopies(await owned('alice'), 2, 'regular') === 1, 'cancel refunds the escrow'); } const accepted = await trades.acceptTrade(a1.trade.id, 'bob'); ok(accepted.ok, 'bob accepts'); ok(core.ownedCopies(await owned('bob'), 1, 'regular') === 2 && core.ownedCopies(await owned('alice'), 9, 'regular') === 1, 'the copies changed hands'); ok(await universe() === start, 'copies conserved after accepting'); ok(!(await trades.acceptTrade(a1.trade.id, 'bob')).ok, 'an offer can only be accepted once'); ok((await trades.getTrade(a1.trade.id))?.status === 'accepted', 'it is recorded as accepted'); { // Notifications: the offerer hears about the acceptance (after the trade lock is released), the recipient heard about the offer. const notify = await import('../lib/trade-notify'); const alice = await notify.listNotices('alice'); ok(alice.notices.some(n => n.kind === 'accepted' && n.text.includes('@bob')), 'the offerer is told it was accepted'); const bob = await notify.listNotices('bob'); ok(bob.notices.some(n => n.kind === 'offer' && n.text.includes('@alice')), 'the recipient is told about the offer'); } // Decline refunds. Counter swaps the offer around. const d = await trades.createTrade({ seasonId: season.id, from: 'alice', kind: 'direct', to: 'bob', give: [stack(5, 'reverse')], get: [stack(3)] }); ok(d.ok, 'offer with a variant'); if (d.ok) { ok(core.ownedCopies(await owned('alice'), 5, 'reverse') === 0, 'variant copy is in escrow'); ok(!(await trades.declineTrade(d.trade.id, 'carol')).ok, 'only the recipient can decline'); ok((await trades.declineTrade(d.trade.id, 'bob')).ok, 'bob declines'); ok(core.ownedCopies(await owned('alice'), 5, 'reverse') === 1, 'decline refunds the offerer'); } const c0 = await trades.createTrade({ seasonId: season.id, from: 'alice', kind: 'direct', to: 'bob', give: [stack(5, 'reverse')], get: [stack(3)] }); if (c0.ok) { const c1 = await trades.counterTrade(c0.trade.id, 'bob', { give: [stack(3)], get: [stack(5, 'reverse'), stack(2)] }); ok(c1.ok, 'bob counters'); if (c1.ok) { ok(c1.trade.from === 'bob' && c1.trade.to === 'alice' && c1.trade.counterOf === c0.trade.id, 'the counter goes back to alice'); ok((await trades.getTrade(c0.trade.id))?.status === 'countered', 'the original is closed as countered'); ok(core.ownedCopies(await owned('alice'), 5, 'reverse') === 1, 'alice got her escrow back when countered'); ok(core.ownedCopies(await owned('bob'), 3, 'regular') === 0, "bob's counter is in escrow"); ok(await universe() === start, 'copies conserved through a counter'); ok((await trades.acceptTrade(c1.trade.id, 'alice')).ok, 'alice accepts the counter'); ok(core.ownedCopies(await owned('alice'), 3, 'regular') === 1 && core.ownedCopies(await owned('bob'), 5, 'reverse') === 1, 'counter settled'); ok(await universe() === start, 'copies conserved after the counter settles'); } } // Listings: anyone but the poster can take one; a wanted variant must exist. const l1 = await trades.createTrade({ seasonId: season.id, from: 'carol', kind: 'listing', give: [stack(7)], get: [stack(4, 'full')] }); ok(l1.ok, 'carol posts a listing'); // A wanted variant the pack can't produce is refused (Shiny is fine here: the pack has upgrades on). ok(!(await trades.createTrade({ seasonId: season.id, from: 'carol', kind: 'listing', give: [stack(7)], get: [stack(25)] })).ok, 'the same copy cannot be offered twice (it is in escrow)'); const sv = await trades.createTrade({ seasonId: season.id, from: 'bob', kind: 'listing', give: [stack(1)], get: [stack(4, 'shiny', 1)] }); ok(sv.ok, 'a listing can ask for a variant the card can be: ' + (sv.ok ? '' : sv.error)); const stray = (await trades.listOpenTrades()).find(t => t.from === 'bob' && t.get[0]?.variant === 'shiny'); if (stray) await trades.cancelTrade(stray.id, 'bob'); if (l1.ok) { ok(!(await trades.acceptTrade(l1.trade.id, 'carol')).ok, 'cannot take your own listing'); // Two people race for the same listing: exactly one wins and nothing is duplicated. await put({ ...(await kvLib.getCollection(coll)), dave: [E(4, 'full')], erin: [E(4, 'full')] }); const startRace = await universe(); const [r1, r2] = await Promise.all([trades.acceptTrade(l1.trade.id, 'dave'), trades.acceptTrade(l1.trade.id, 'erin')]); ok([r1.ok, r2.ok].filter(Boolean).length === 1, 'only one of two simultaneous accepts succeeds: ' + JSON.stringify([r1, r2].map(r => (r.ok ? 'ok' : r.error)))); ok(await universe() === startRace, 'copies conserved through the race'); const loser = r1.ok ? 'erin' : 'dave'; ok(core.ownedCopies(await owned(loser), 4, 'full') === 1, 'the loser keeps their copy'); } // Limits. const spam = []; for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) spam.push(await trades.createTrade({ seasonId: season.id, from: 'bob', kind: 'listing', give: [stack(1)], get: [stack(25)] })); ok(spam.filter(r => r.ok).length <= 3, 'open offers per viewer are capped'); // Expiry refunds. Make an offer overdue and let any trading call sweep it. const exp = await trades.createTrade({ seasonId: season.id, from: 'alice', kind: 'listing', give: [stack(2)], get: [stack(25)] }); if (exp.ok) { const open = await trades.listOpenTrades(); const t = open.find(x => x.id === exp.trade.id)!; t.expiresAt = Date.now() - 1000; await (await import('../lib/db')).kv.set('trades:open', open); const before = core.ownedCopies(await owned('alice'), 2, 'regular'); const swept = await trades.sweepTrades(); ok(swept >= 1, 'the sweep expires overdue offers'); ok(core.ownedCopies(await owned('alice'), 2, 'regular') === before + 1, 'expiry refunds the escrow'); ok((await trades.getTrade(exp.trade.id))?.status === 'expired', 'recorded as expired'); } // Admin: freeze and cancel. const f = await trades.createTrade({ seasonId: season.id, from: 'carol', kind: 'listing', give: [stack(7)], get: [stack(25)] }); await trades.saveTradeSettings({ ...(await trades.getTradeSettings()), enabled: false }); ok(!(await trades.createTrade({ seasonId: season.id, from: 'alice', kind: 'listing', give: [stack(2)], get: [stack(25)] })).ok, 'paused: no new offers'); if (f.ok) { ok(!(await trades.acceptTrade(f.trade.id, 'bob')).ok, 'paused: no accepts'); const c = await trades.cancelTrade(f.trade.id, 'admin', { admin: true, reason: 'test' }); ok(c.ok && (await trades.getTrade(f.trade.id))?.resolvedBy === 'admin', 'an admin can cancel while paused, and it refunds'); } await trades.saveTradeSettings({ ...(await trades.getTradeSettings()), enabled: true }); // Admin bulk controls and the minimum account age. { const data = await kvLib.getCollection(coll); const holders = Object.entries(data).filter(([, l]) => l.some(e => e < 1_000_000)).map(([u]) => u); ok(holders.length >= 2, 'two viewers hold a regular copy'); const [u1, u2] = holders; const wanted = stack(25); const before = await universe(); const o1 = await trades.createTrade({ seasonId: season.id, from: u1, kind: 'listing', give: [reg(u1)], get: [wanted] }); const o2 = await trades.createTrade({ seasonId: season.id, from: u2, kind: 'listing', give: [reg(u2)], get: [wanted] }); ok(o1.ok && o2.ok, 'two listings for the bulk checks'); const ex = o1.ok ? o1.trade.expiresAt : 0; ok(await trades.extendOpenTrades([o1.ok ? o1.trade.id : ''], 10) === 1, 'extend touches only the named offer'); ok((await trades.getTrade(o1.ok ? o1.trade.id : ''))!.expiresAt === ex + 10 * 3_600_000, 'expiry moves by the hours given'); ok(await trades.cancelOpenTrades({ username: u1 }) === 1, 'cancel by viewer ends only their offers'); ok((await trades.getTrade(o2.ok ? o2.trade.id : ''))?.status === 'open', 'the other viewer offer is untouched'); ok(await trades.cancelOpenTrades({ seasonId: 'no-such-season' }) === 0, 'cancel by an unknown season matches nothing'); ok(await trades.cancelOpenTrades({}) >= 1, 'cancel everything ends the rest'); ok(await universe() === before, 'bulk cancel refunds every copy'); await tra

nodes.name: check-twitch-assets.mts
nodes.body_text: // Checks the Twitch extension submission pack: the image files exist at the sizes Twitch asks for (and the two that must be opaque are), // and the text in twitch-extension/SUBMISSION.md fits the field limits. Run: npx tsx scripts/check-twitch-assets.mts import { existsSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs'; import { join } from 'node:path'; import sharp from 'sharp'; const dir = join(process.cwd(), 'twitch-extension'); const icon = await size('icon-100.png'); ok(icon.w === 100 && icon.h === 100 && !icon.alpha, 'the icon is 100 x 100 and opaque'); const disc = await size('discovery-300x200.png'); ok(disc.w === 300 && disc.h === 200 && !disc.alpha, 'the discovery image is 300 x 200 and not transparent'); const shots = ['01-collection', '02-card-detail', '03-stats', '04-leaderboard', '05-trades']; for (const s of shots) { const m = await size(`screenshots/${s}.png`); ok(m.w === 1024 && m.h === 768, `${s} is 1024 x 768`); } ok(shots.length >= 3, 'at least three screenshots'); // The text blocks in the submission pack. const doc = readFileSync(join(dir, 'SUBMISSION.md'), 'utf8'); const blocks = [...doc.matchAll(/```[a-z]*\n([\s\S]*?)\n```/g)].map(m => m[1]); // every fenced block, with or without a language tag const name = blocks.find(b => b === 'The Cheesy TCG'); const summary = blocks.find(b => b.startsWith('Collect trading cards')); const details = blocks.find(b => b.startsWith('The Cheesy TCG is a collectible')); ok(name && name.length <= 40 && !/extension|twitch/i.test(name), 'the name is 40 characters or fewer and has no "extension" or "twitch"'); ok(summary && summary.length <= 140, `the summary is 140 characters or fewer (${summary?.length})`); ok(details && details.length <= 1024, `the details are 1,024 characters or fewer (${details?.length})`); ok(!doc.includes(String.fromCharCode(0x2014)), 'the pack has no em dashes'); console.log('twitch asset checks passed');

nodes.name: size
nodes.body_text: async function size(file: string) { ok(existsSync(join(dir, file)), `${file} exists`); const m = await sharp(join(dir, file)).metadata(); return { w: m.width, h: m.height, alpha: !!m.hasAlpha }; }

nodes.name: check-twitch-panel.mts
nodes.body_text: // Checks the Twitch panel stays in step with the server: its serial-bonus maths (public/twitch-panel/panel.js has no build step, so it // mirrors lib/scoring-core.ts) and that the three views (panel / mobile / video component) share the same markup. // Pure. Run: npx tsx scripts/check-twitch-panel.mts import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'; const { serialMultiplier } = await import('../lib/scoring-core'); // ── serial maths: run the panel's own functions against the server's ── const js = read('panel.js'); const a = js.indexOf('// ── Serial numbers & points'); const b = js.indexOf('// The viewer\'s serial numbers for one card'); ok(a > 0 && b > a, 'found the serial maths in panel.js'); const make = new Function('me', 'VARIANTS', 'VARIANT_OFFSET', `${js.slice(a, b)}\nreturn { serialMult, copyPts, entryOf };`) as (me: unknown, v: string[], o: number) => { serialMult(n: number): number; copyPts(card: number, variant: string, serial?: number): number; entryOf(card: number, variant: string): number; }; const VARIANTS = ['regular', 'reverse', 'full', 'shiny']; for (const [max, cutoff] of [[3, 20], [5, 10], [1, 20], [3, 0], [2.5, 1]] as const) { const panel = make({ bonus: { max, cutoff }, cards: { 7: { values: [100, 600, 2000, 10000], raw: [100.4, 600.2, 2000.5, 10000.1] } } }, VARIANTS, 1_000_000); for (let n = 0; n <= 30; n++) { const want = serialMultiplier(n, { serialBonusMax: max, serialBonusCutoff: cutoff }); ok(Math.abs(panel.serialMult(n) - want) < 1e-9, `serial multiplier for #${n} (max ${max}, cutoff ${cutoff}): ${panel.serialMult(n)} vs ${want}`); } // A copy past the bonus is worth the plain value; one inside it is the unrounded value times the multiplier. ok(panel.copyPts(7, 'regular', 999) === 100, 'no bonus past the cutoff'); ok(panel.copyPts(7, 'regular', undefined) === 100, 'no serial, no bonus'); const m = serialMultiplier(1, { serialBonusMax: max, serialBonusCutoff: cutoff }); ok(panel.copyPts(7, 'shiny', 1) === (m === 1 ? 10000 : Math.max(1, Math.round(10000.1 * m))), 'bonus copy points use the unrounded value'); } ok(make({ bonus: { max: 3, cutoff: 20 }, cards: {} }, VARIANTS, 1_000_000).entryOf(5, 'full') === 2_000_005, 'entry encoding matches lib/variants.ts'); // ── the three views share one markup ── const base = body(read('panel.html')); for (const f of ['mobile.html', 'video_component.html']) ok(body(read(f)) === base, `${f} has the same markup as panel.html (keep the three in sync)`); for (const id of ['stats-area', 'trades-area', 'leaderboard-area', 'collection-area', 'grid-tools', 'pack-tabs', 'panel-banner', 'toast', 'trades-dot', 'view-tabs']) { ok(base.includes(`id="${id}"`), `panel.html has #${id}`); ok((js + read('trades.js')).includes(id), `the panel scripts use #${id}`); } console.log('twitch panel checks passed');

nodes.name: check-upgrades.mts
nodes.body_text: // Sanity checks for the variant / upgrade / value maths. Run: npx tsx scripts/check-upgrades.mts import { encodeEntry, decodeEntry, rollVariant, removeEntries, countVariants, DEFAULT_VARIANT_WEIGHTS, DEFAULT_UPGRADE_COSTS, VARIANTS } from '../lib/variants'; import { variantMultipliers, computeSeasonValues, buildLeaderboard } from '../lib/leaderboard'; import type { Pack, Card } from '../lib/types'; // Encoding: legacy numbers are Regular; large card numbers survive every variant. eq(decodeEntry(25), { cardNumber: 25, variant: 'regular' }, 'legacy entry'); for (const n of [1, 40, 5000, 999_999]) for (const v of VARIANTS) eq(decodeEntry(encodeEntry(n, v)), { cardNumber: n, variant: v }, `roundtrip ${n} ${v}`); // Variant roll hits roughly the configured odds. const N = 200_000; const hits = { regular: 0, reverse: 0, full: 0, shiny: 0 }; for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) hits[rollVariant(DEFAULT_VARIANT_WEIGHTS)]++; console.log('roll %:', Object.fromEntries(VARIANTS.map(v => [v, pct(v).toFixed(2)]))); if (Math.abs(pct('regular') - 76.6) > 1 || Math.abs(pct('reverse') - 19.1) > 1 || Math.abs(pct('shiny') - 0.8) > 0.3) throw new Error('roll odds off'); eq(rollVariant({ regular: 0, reverse: 0, full: 0, shiny: 0 }), 'regular', 'zero weights'); // Removing copies. eq(removeEntries([1, 1, 2, 1], 1, 2), [2, 1], 'remove 2'); eq(removeEntries([1, 2], 1, 2), null, 'not enough'); // Counting. const owned = [3, 3, encodeEntry(3, 'reverse'), encodeEntry(4, 'shiny')]; eq(countVariants(owned).get(3), { regular: 2, reverse: 1, full: 0, shiny: 0 }, 'countVariants'); // Values: an upgrade is always worth more than the copies it consumes, whatever the admin sets. for (const p of [pack(), pack({ upgradeCosts: { reverse: 2, full: 2, shiny: 2 } }), pack({ variantWeights: { regular: 1, reverse: 1, full: 1, shiny: 1 } }), pack({ upgradeCosts: { reverse: 10, full: 10, shiny: 10 } })]) { const m = variantMultipliers(p); const costs = [0, p.upgradeCosts.reverse, p.upgradeCosts.full, p.upgradeCosts.shiny]; for (let i = 1; i < 4; i++) if (!(m[VARIANTS[i]] > m[VARIANTS[i - 1]] * costs[i])) throw new Error(`upgrade ${VARIANTS[i]} is not a net gain: ${JSON.stringify(m)}`); } console.log('multipliers (defaults):', variantMultipliers(pack())); eq(variantMultipliers(pack({ upgradesEnabled: false })), { regular: 1, reverse: 1, full: 1, shiny: 1 }, 'upgrades off => flat'); // Leaderboard: rarer cards score higher; variants count; deleted cards are ignored. const cards: Card[] = [ { id: 'a', number: 1, name: 'Common', imageUrl: '', probability: 90, stars: 1 }, { id: 'b', number: 2, name: 'Rare', imageUrl: '', probability: 10, stars: 5 }, ]; const collection = { alice: [1, 1, 1, 1, 1, encodeEntry(2, 'regular')], bob: [encodeEntry(2, 'reverse'), 99] }; const values = computeSeasonValues([{ pack: pack(), cards }], collection); console.log('card values:', [...values.cards.values()].map(c => ({ n: c.number, regular: c.values.regular, reverse: c.values.reverse }))); if (!(values.cards.get(2)!.values.regular > values.cards.get(1)!.values.regular)) throw new Error('rare should be worth more'); const rows = buildLeaderboard(values, collection); console.log('rows:', rows.map(r => [r.username, r.score])); eq(rows.find(r => r.username === 'bob')!.copies, 1, 'deleted card #99 ignored'); console.log('all checks passed'); // Serial bonus: the first copies of a card (per version) earn a multiplier that fades to nothing after the cutoff. import { projectUpgradeGain, scoreFor, pointsFor, computeSeasonValues as csv } from '../lib/leaderboard'; import { serialMultiplier } from '../lib/scoring-core'; import { buildSerialIndex } from '../lib/serials-core'; const SB = { serialBonusMax: 3, serialBonusCutoff: 20 }; eq(serialMultiplier(1, SB), 3, 'copy #1 gets the full bonus'); eq(serialMultiplier(21, SB), 1, 'past the cutoff there is no bonus'); eq(serialMultiplier(undefined, SB), 1, 'no serial, no bonus'); eq(serialMultiplier(1, { serialBonusMax: 3, serialBonusCutoff: 0 }), 1, 'cutoff 0 switches it off'); for (let n = 1; n < 20; n++) if (!(serialMultiplier(n, SB) > serialMultiplier(n + 1, SB))) throw new Error('bonus should shrink with every serial'); if (!(serialMultiplier(20, SB) > 1 && serialMultiplier(20, SB) < 1.2)) throw new Error('last serial before the cutoff is a tiny bonus'); const packs = [{ pack: pack(), cards }]; const big: Record<string, number[]> = { a: [1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 2], b: [1, 2, 2, 2] }; // Ledger: a holds Regular #1 #2 #3 #4 #5 #30 of card 1 (30 were made), b holds #6; four card-2 Regulars each. const idx = buildSerialIndex({ '1.0.1': 'a', '1.0.2': 'a', '1.0.3': 'a', '1.0.4': 'a', '1.0.5': 'a', '1.0.30': 'a', '1.0.6': 'b', '2.0.1': 'a', '2.0.2': 'a', '2.0.3': 'a', '2.0.4': 'a', '2.0.5': 'b', '2.0.6': 'b', '2.0.7': 'b', '2.0.8': 'escrow:t1', }, new Map([[encodeEntry(1, 'regular'), 30], [encodeEntry(2, 'regular'), 8]])); if (idx.held.has('escrow:t1') || idx.held.has('t1')) throw new Error('escrowed copies are not held by anyone'); eq(idx.escrow.get('t1')?.get(2), [8], 'escrowed copies are listed under their trade'); const withSerials = csv(packs, big, DEFAULT_SCORING, idx); const without = csv(packs, big, DEFAULT_SCORING, null); const plain = pointsFor(without, big.a, 'a'); const bonus = pointsFor(withSerials, big.a, 'a'); console.log('a: plain', plain.points, 'with serial bonus', bonus.points, '(+' + bonus.serialPoints + ')'); if (!(bonus.points > plain.points) || bonus.points - plain.points !== bonus.serialPoints) throw new Error('serial bonuses should add points, and report them'); if (plain.serialPoints !== 0) throw new Error('no ledger, no bonus'); const c1 = withSerials.cards.get(1)!; eq(pointsFor(withSerials, [1], 'b').points, Math.max(1, Math.round(c1.maths.raw.regular * serialMultiplier(6, DEFAULT_SCORING))), "b's #6 is worth its serial multiple"); eq(pointsFor(withSerials, [1], 'nobody').points, c1.values.regular, 'a viewer the ledger does not know gets plain values'); // Nobody else's copies change a card's value any more. eq(withSerials.cards.get(1)!.values, csv(packs, { ...big, b: [] }, DEFAULT_SCORING, idx).cards.get(1)!.values, "another viewer's copies do not move a card's value"); // The leaderboard carries the bonus and it adds up. const lrows = buildLeaderboard(withSerials, big); const la = lrows.find(r => r.username === 'a')!; if (la.serialPoints !== bonus.serialPoints || la.score !== la.cardPoints + la.completionBonus + la.setBonus) throw new Error('row totals with a serial bonus'); // Upgrade projection: five Regular card-1 copies are spent, newest serials first (#30, #5, #4, #3, #2), so only #1 is kept and Reverse #1 arrives. const idx2 = buildSerialIndex({ ...Object.fromEntries(Object.entries({ '1.0.1': 'a', '1.0.2': 'a', '1.0.3': 'a', '1.0.4': 'a', '1.0.5': 'a', '1.0.30': 'a' })), '1.1.1': 'z' }, new Map([[encodeEntry(1, 'regular'), 30], [encodeEntry(1, 'reverse'), 1]])); const v2 = csv(packs, { a: [1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1] }, DEFAULT_SCORING, idx2); const gain = projectUpgradeGain(v2, [1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1], 'a', 1, 'regular', 'reverse', 5); const afterEntries = [1, encodeEntry(1, 'reverse')]; const manual = scoreFor({ ...v2, serials: { minted: idx2.minted, escrow: new Map(), held: new Map([['a', new Map([[1, [1]], [encodeEntry(1, 'reverse'), [2]]])]]) } }, afterEntries, 'a') - scoreFor(v2, [1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1], 'a'); console.log('projected gain', gain, 'manual', manual); eq(gain, manual, 'projection spends the newest serials and mints the next free one'); if (projectUpgradeGain(v2, [1], 'a', 1, 'regular', 'reverse', 5) !== null) throw new Error('not enough copies should return null'); console.log('serial bonus checks passed'); // ── Collection bonuses ── import { collectionBonuses, buildLeaderboard as bl } from '../lib/leaderboard'; import { DEFAULT_SCORING, sanitizeScoring } from '../lib/scoring'; const COMPLETION_BONUS_RATE = DEFAULT_SCORING.completionBonusPct / 100, COMPLETE_SET_BONUS_RATE = DEFAULT_SCORING.completeSetBonusPct / 100; const setCards: Card[] = [1, 2, 3, 4].map(n => ({ id: 's' + n, number: n, name: 'C' + n, imageUrl: '', probability: 10, stars: 1 })); const sets = { full: [1, 2, 3, 4], half: [1, 2], dupes: [1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1] }; const sv = csv([{ pack: pack({ upgradesEnabled: false }), cards: setCards }], sets); const bFull = collectionBonuses(sv, 4), bHalf = collectionBonuses(sv, 2), bNone = collectionBonuses(sv, 0), bOne = collectionBonuses(sv, 1); console.log('set value', sv.setValue, '| full', bFull, '| half', bHalf); if (!(bFull.complete && bFull.set === Math.round(sv.setValue * COMPLETE_SET_BONUS_RATE))) throw new Error('complete set bonus'); if (bFull.completion !== Math.round(sv.setValue * COMPLETION_BONUS_RATE)) throw new Error('completion bonus at 100%'); if (bHalf.set !== 0 || bHalf.complete) throw new Error('half set must not get the complete bonus'); if (bHalf.completion !== Math.round(sv.setValue * COMPLETION_BONUS_RATE * 0.5)) throw new Error('completion bonus should be proportional'); if (bNone.completion !== 0 || bNone.set !== 0) throw new Error('no cards, no bonus'); if (!(bOne.completion < bHalf.completion && bHalf.completion < bFull.completion)) throw new Error('bonus should grow with completion'); const brows = bl(sv, sets); const full = brows.find(r => r.username === 'full')!, dupes = brows.find(r => r.username === 'dupes')!; if (!full.complete || full.setBonus <= 0 || full.score !== full.cardPoints + full.completionBonus + full.setBonus) throw new Error('row totals'); if (dupes.complete || dupes.setBonus !== 0) throw new Error('duplicates of one card are not a complete collection'); console.log('rows:', brows.map(r => [r.username, r.cardPoints, r.completionBonus, r.setBonus, r.score])); console.log('collection bonus checks passed'); // ── Tunable settings: each knob must really change the numbers (and defaults must reproduce the old behaviour) ── const base = csv([{ pack: pack(), cards }], collection); const same = csv([{ pack: pack(), cards }], collection, DEFAULT_SCORING); eq([...base.cards.values()].map(c => c.values), [...same.cards.values()].map(c => c.values), 'explicit defaults == implicit defaults'); const dbl = csv([{ pack: pack(), cards }], collection, { ...DEFAULT_SCORING, baseScore: 20 }); if (dbl.cards.get(2)!.values.regular !== 2 * base.cards.get(2)!.values.regular) throw new Error('baseScore should scale values'); const flat = csv([{ pack: pack(), cards }], collection, { ...DEFAULT_SCORING, rarityExponent: 0 }); if (flat.cards.get(1)!.values.regular === base.cards.get(1)!.values.regular && flat.cards.get(2)!.values.regular === base.cards.get(2)!.values.regular) throw new Error('rarityExponent 0 should change values'); if (!(rarityGap(flat) < rarityGap(base))) throw new Error('lower rarity exponent should narrow the gap between rare and common'); const bigBonus = collectionBonuses({ ...sv, settings: { ...DEFAULT_SCORING, completionBonusPct: 100, completeSetBonusPct: 200 } }, 4); if (bigBonus.completion !== sv.setValue || bigBonus.set !== 2 * sv.setValue) throw new Error('bonus percentages should be honoured'); const noBonus = collectionBonuses({ ...sv, settings: { ...DEFAULT_SCORING, completionBonusPct: 0, completeSetBonusPct: 0 } }, 4); if (noBonus.completion !== 0 || noBonus.set !== 0) throw new Error('0% disables the bonuses'); // margin changes the variant multipliers const wide = variantMultipliers(pack({ variantWeights: { regular: 1, reverse: 1, full: 1, shiny: 1 } }), { ...DEFAULT_SCORING, upgradeMargin: 2 }); const narrow = variantMultipliers(pack({ variantWeights: { regular: 1, reverse: 1, full: 1, shiny: 1 } }), { ...DEFAULT_SCORING, upgradeMargin: 1 }); if (!(wide.shiny > narrow.shiny)) throw new Error('a bigger upgrade margin should raise upgraded values'); // sanitising: junk, out-of-range and inconsistent input are all made safe const messy = sanitizeScoring({ baseScore: '-5', rarityExponent: 'abc', serialBonusMax: 99, serialBonusCutoff: -5, completionBonusPct: 99999, leaderboardSize: 12.6, unknown: 1 }); if (messy.baseScore !== 1 || messy.rarityExponent !== DEFAULT_SCORING.rarityExponent || messy.serialBonusMax !== 20 || messy.serialBonusCutoff !== 0 || messy.completionBonusPct !== 500 || messy.leaderboardSize !== 13) throw new Error('sanitize: ' + JSON.stringify(messy)); eq(sanitizeScoring(undefined), DEFAULT_SCORING, 'no stored settings -> defaults'); console.log('scoring settings checks passed'); // ── Switched-off variants: pack / card switches, upgrade steps and odds ── import { allowedVariants, effectiveWeights, upgradeStep, cleanDisabled } from '../lib/variants'; const vp = { disabledVariants: [] as ('reverse' | 'full' | 'shiny')[], upgradeCosts: DEFAULT_UPGRADE_COSTS, variantWeights: DEFAULT_VARIANT_WEIGHTS }; eq(allowedVariants(vp), ['regular', 'reverse', 'full', 'shiny'], 'everything is on by default'); eq(allowedVariants({ ...vp, disabledVariants: ['reverse'] }, { disabledVariants: ['shiny'] }), ['regular', 'full'], 'pack and card switches combine'); eq(cleanDisabled(['shiny', 'regular', 'bogus', 'shiny', 'reverse']), ['reverse', 'shiny'], 'regular and junk are dropped, order and uniqueness are fixed'); eq(upgradeStep(vp, undefined, 'regular'), { to: 'reverse', cost: 5 }, 'plain step'); eq(upgradeStep(vp, undefined, 'shiny'), null, 'nothing above shiny'); // Skipping a switched-off variant costs the combined price (no shortcut): regular -> full with Reverse off = 5 x 3. eq(upgradeStep({ ...vp, disabledVariants: ['reverse'] }, undefined, 'regular'), { to: 'full', cost: 15 }, 'skip reverse'); eq(upgradeStep(vp, { disabledVariants: ['full'] }, 'reverse'), { to: 'shiny', cost: 9 }, 'card-level skip'); eq(upgradeStep({ ...vp, disabledVariants: ['full', 'shiny'] }, undefined, 'reverse'), null, 'top variants off -> reverse is the end of the line'); eq(effectiveWeights({ ...vp, disabledVariants: ['full'] }), { regular: 100, reverse: 25, full: 0, shiny: 1 }, 'switched-off weights are zeroed'); // Rolling never returns a switched-off variant. const offW = effectiveWeights({ ...vp, disabledVariants: ['reverse', 'shiny'] }); for (let i = 0; i < 20_000; i++) { const v = rollVariant(offW); if (v === 'reverse' || v === 'shiny') throw new Error('rolled a switched-off variant'); } // The value multipliers only credit variants that exist: with Full off, Shiny is still priced from the chain of costs. const mOff = variantMultipliers(pack({ disabledVariants: ['full'] })); if (!(mOff.shiny >= mOff.reverse)) throw new Error('shiny should never be worth less than reverse'); console.log('switched-off variant checks passed'); // ── My Stats: serial bonuses show up as their own line and as individually listed copies ── import { computeUserStats } from '../lib/user-stats'; { const c = { a: [1, 1, 2] }; const sidx = buildSerialIndex({ '1.0.1': 'a', '1.0.40': 'a', '2.0.3': 'a' }, new Map([[encodeEntry(1, 'regular'), 40], [encodeEntry(2, 'regular'), 3]])); const sv = csv(packs, c, DEFAULT_SCORING, sidx); const seasonCards = cards.map(k => ({ ...k, id: String(k.number), packName: 'p', pack: pack() })); const overview = { rows: buildLeaderboard(sv, c), values: sv, cards: seasonCards } as never; const st = computeUserStats(overview, 'a', c.a, c, { upgrades: false }); const row = buildLeaderboard(sv, c)[0]; eq(st.serialPoints, row.serialPoints, 'My Stats reports the serial points'); ok(st.serialPoints > 0 && st.cardPoints === row.cardPoints, 'card points include the bonus'); const numbered = st.topCopies.filter(t => t.serial); ok(numbered.length === 2 && numbered.some(t => t.card.number === 1 && t.serial === 1) && numbered.some(t => t.card.number === 2 && t.serial === 3), 'copies with a bonus are listed one by one'); const plain = st.topCopies.find(t => t.card.number === 1 && !t.serial); ok(plain && plain.count === 1 && plain.value === sv.cards.get(1)!.values.regular, 'the copy past the cutoff is listed at the plain value'); console.log('my stats serial checks passed'); }

nodes.name: eq
nodes.signature: function eq(a: unknown, b: unknown, msg: string)
nodes.body_text: function eq(a: unknown, b: unknown, msg: string) { if (JSON.stringify(a) !== JSON.stringify(b)) throw new Error(`${msg}: ${JSON.stringify(a)} != ${JSON.stringify(b)}`); }

nodes.name: pack

nodes.name: rarityGap
nodes.body_text: rarityGap = (v: typeof base) => v.cards.get(2)!.values.regular / v.cards.get(1)!.values.regular

nodes.name: check-user-settings.mts
nodes.body_text: // Checks viewer settings: validation, notice gating, private profiles, direct-offer opt-out, export. Needs the mock KV on :4111. // Run: node scripts/mock-kv.cjs & KV_REST_API_URL=http://localhost:4111 KV_REST_API_TOKEN=dev KV_URL=redis://dev npx tsx scripts/check-user-settings.mts const c = await import('../lib/user-settings'); // ── validation ── const d = c.sanitizeUserSettings(undefined); eq(d, c.DEFAULT_SETTINGS, 'nothing in, defaults out'); const s = c.sanitizeUserSettings({ bio: ' hi\n\tthere ' + 'x'.repeat(300), privateProfile: 'yes', notifyOffers: false, motion: 'sideways', experiments: ['shortcuts', 'bogus', 'shortcuts', 7], evil: 1 }); ok(s.bio.startsWith('hi there x') && s.bio.length === c.BIO_MAX, 'bio is cleaned and capped'); eq(s.privateProfile, false, 'a non-boolean is ignored'); eq(s.notifyOffers, false, 'a boolean is kept'); eq(s.motion, 'system', 'an unknown motion falls back'); eq(s.experiments, ['shortcuts'], 'experiments are known, unique strings'); ok(!('evil' in s), 'unknown keys are dropped'); eq(c.sparse(c.DEFAULT_SETTINGS), {}, 'defaults store nothing'); eq(c.sparse(s).notifyOffers, false, 'only changes are stored'); ok(c.wantsNotice({ ...d, notifyOffers: false }, 'offer') === false && c.wantsNotice({ ...d, notifyOffers: false }, 'accepted') === true, 'offers switch only governs offers'); ok(c.wantsNotice({ ...d, notifyOffers: false, notifyResults: false }, 'admin') === true, 'admin notices always arrive'); const sc = await import('../lib/public-shortcuts'); eq(sc.nextPublicKey(sc.PUBLIC_IDLE, 'g', 0).state.pending, true, 'g starts a sequence'); eq(sc.nextPublicKey({ pending: true, at: 0 }, 'l', 100).go, '/leaderboard', 'g l goes to the leaderboard'); eq(sc.nextPublicKey({ pending: true, at: 0 }, 'c', 100, 'Bob').go, '/u/bob', 'g c needs a login and goes to the profile'); eq(sc.nextPublicKey({ pending: true, at: 0 }, 'c', 100).go, undefined, 'g c does nothing when logged out'); eq(sc.nextPublicKey({ pending: true, at: 0 }, 'l', 5000).go, undefined, 'a stale g is ignored'); // The Settings text for the shortcuts experiment names every key and every destination, so it cannot drift from the real list. const exp = c.EXPERIMENTS.find(e => e.id === 'shortcuts')!; for (const k of sc.PUBLIC_GO_KEYS) ok(exp.description.includes(k.label) && new RegExp(`\\b${k.key}\\b`).test(exp.description.split('to jump')[0]), `the shortcuts description mentions ${k.key} and "${k.label}"`); // ── collection view for visitors ── eq(c.DEFAULT_SETTINGS.collectionView, 'grid', 'visitors start on the grid by default'); eq(c.sanitizeUserSettings({ collectionView: 'binder' }).collectionView, 'binder', 'binder accepted'); eq(c.sanitizeUserSettings({ collectionView: 'carousel' }).collectionView, 'grid', 'anything else falls back to the grid'); eq(c.sparse(c.sanitizeUserSettings({ collectionView: 'grid' })).collectionView, undefined, 'the default is not stored'); // ── pinned showcase copy ── ok(c.sanitizeUserSettings({ pinned: 1000042 }).pinned === 1000042, 'a unique copy number can be pinned'); ok(c.sanitizeUserSettings({ pinned: 'x' }).pinned === null && c.sanitizeUserSettings({ pinned: 5 }).pinned === null && c.sanitizeUserSettings({ pinned: 1.5e9 }).pinned === null && c.sanitizeUserSettings({ pinned: 1000000.5 }).pinned === null, 'anything else is dropped'); ok(c.sparse(c.DEFAULT_SETTINGS).pinned === undefined, 'nothing pinned stores nothing'); const pw = await import('../lib/profile-widgets'); ok(pw.withPinnedWidget(null)[0].type === 'pinned' && pw.withPinnedWidget(null).length === pw.DEFAULT_PROFILE_LAYOUT.length + 1, 'pinning adds the widget to the default layout'); ok(pw.withPinnedWidget([{ type: 'stats', span: 4 }]).map(w => w.type).join() === 'pinned,stats', 'and to a custom one, at the top'); ok(pw.withPinnedWidget([{ type: 'pinned', span: 6 }, { type: 'stats', span: 4 }]).map(w => w.span).join() === '6,4', 'but never twice, and it keeps the owner\'s size'); for (const p of pw.PROFILE_PRESETS) eq(pw.sanitizeProfileLayout(p.layout), p.layout, `preset ${p.id} sanitizes to itself`); eq(pw.PROFILE_PRESETS.map(p => p.id), ['collector', 'showcase', 'trader', 'minimal'], 'four presets'); eq(pw.PROFILE_PRESETS[0].layout, pw.DEFAULT_PROFILE_LAYOUT, 'Collector is the default layout'); ok(pw.PROFILE_PRESETS.every(p => p.layout.length > 0 && p.label && p.description), 'presets are named and not empty'); const cs = await import('../lib/copy-share'); const spec = cs.copyShareSpec({ copy: { id: '1.3.2', uid: 1000042, card: 1, variant: 'shiny', n: 2, owner: 'ann', at: Date.UTC(2026, 9, 12), origin: 'pull', ev: [] }, cardName: 'Gouda', seasonId: 's1', seasonName: 'Season 1', packName: 'Starter', total: 5, mult: 2.9, art: '/a.webp', privateHolder: false, siteUrl: 'https://cheesytcg.app' }); ok(spec.plate?.number === '#1000042' && spec.plate.gold && spec.plate.edition === 'Edition #2 of 5 made' && spec.footer === 'cheesytcg.app/c/1000042', 'copy share spec: number, gold, edition, short link'); ok(spec.plate?.lines?.[0] === 'Held by @ann' && spec.plate.qrUrl === 'https://cheesytcg.app/copy/s1/1.3.2' && spec.title === 'Shiny Full Art Gouda', 'holder, QR link and title'); ok(cs.copyShareSpec({ copy: { id: '1.0.1', card: 1, variant: 'regular', n: 1, owner: 'ann', at: 0, origin: 'pull', ev: [] }, cardName: 'G', seasonId: 's', seasonName: 'S', packName: 'P', total: 1, mult: 1, art: '', privateHolder: true, siteUrl: 'https://x.y' }).plate?.lines?.[0] === 'Held by a private collector', 'private holders are not named'); // ── stored behaviour ── if (!process.env.KV_REST_API_URL?.includes('localhost')) throw new Error('Refusing to run against a non-local KV'); const store = await import('../lib/user-settings-store'); const { kv } = await import('../lib/db'); await store.saveUserSettings('Ann', { privateProfile: true, bio: 'hello' }); eq((await store.getUserSettings('ann')).bio, 'hello', 'settings round-trip, lower-cased'); ok((await store.getSelfHidden()).has('ann'), 'private profile joins the self-hidden set'); const admin = await import('../lib/user-admin'); ok((await admin.getHiddenUsers()).has('ann'), 'the public hidden list includes private profiles'); await admin.saveFlags('zed', { hideFromBoard: true }); await admin.saveFlags('zed', { hideFromBoard: false }); eq(await kv.get('users:hidden'), [], 'the admin list never absorbs self-hidden viewers'); await store.saveUserSettings('ann', { privateProfile: false }); ok(!(await admin.getHiddenUsers()).has('ann'), 'turning it off brings them back'); eq(await kv.get('user:ann:settings'), null, 'all-default settings are removed, not stored'); const tn = await import('../lib/trade-notify'); await store.saveUserSettings('ann', { notifyOffers: false }); await tn.notify('ann', { kind: 'offer', text: 'x' }); await tn.notify('ann', { kind: 'accepted', text: 'y' }); await tn.notify('ann', { kind: 'admin', text: 'z' }); eq((await tn.listNotices('ann')).notices.map(n => n.kind).sort(), ['accepted', 'admin'], 'a switched-off kind is not queued'); const ex = await (await import('../lib/user-export')).buildExport('ann'); eq(ex.username, 'ann', 'export is for the viewer'); ok(ex.notices.length === 2 && 'settings' in ex, 'export carries notices and settings'); // ── the pages ── import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'; ok(readFileSync('lib/seo.ts', 'utf8').includes("'/settings'"), '/settings is listed as noindex'); ok(readFileSync('app/api/account/settings/route.ts', 'utf8').includes('isSameOrigin'), 'saving checks the origin'); ok(!/body\.(username|user)/.test(readFileSync('app/api/account/settings/route.ts', 'utf8')), 'the viewer comes from the session, never the body'); console.log('user settings checks passed'); process.exit(0);

nodes.name: check-users.mts
nodes.body_text: // Checks the admin Users tools: tags, restrictions (hidden board, trade block), restore points and merging. // Needs the mock KV running (node scripts/mock-kv.cjs); refuses anything non-local. // Run: npx tsx scripts/check-users.mts const url = process.env.KV_REST_API_URL ?? 'http://localhost:4111'; if (!/^http:\/\/(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)[:/]/.test(url)) throw new Error(`Refusing to run against non-local KV: ${url}`); process.env.KV_REST_API_URL = url; process.env.KV_REST_API_TOKEN ??= 'dev'; process.env.KV_URL ??= 'redis://dev'; const admin = await import('../lib/user-admin'); const kvLib = await import('../lib/kv'); const sbx = await import('../lib/sandbox'); const trades = await import('../lib/trades'); const audit = await import('../lib/audit'); const { prodKv, runInSandbox } = await import('../lib/db'); const { encodeEntry } = await import('../lib/variants'); // Pure eq(admin.cleanTags(['VIP', ' vip ', 'Bad!!Chars', 'x'.repeat(40), '']), ['vip', 'badchars', 'x'.repeat(20)], 'tags are normalised and de-duplicated'); ok(admin.cleanTags(Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, i) => `t${i}`)).length === admin.MAX_TAGS, 'tag count is capped'); await kvLib.seedSeason1(); const box = await sbx.createSandbox({ name: 'Users check', source: 'config' }); const prodBefore = JSON.stringify(await prodKv.get('users:hidden')); await runInSandbox(box.id, async () => { const season = (await kvLib.listSeasons())[0]; const coll = season.collectionName; await kvLib.saveCollection(coll, { alice: [E(1), E(1), E(2)], bob: [E(3), E(4)], carol: [E(9)] }); await trades.saveTradeSettings({ enabled: true, expiryHours: 48, maxOpenPerUser: 5, cooldownSeconds: 0, maxStacksPerSide: 8 }); // Tags eq(await admin.saveTags('alice', ['VIP', 'watch']), ['vip', 'watch'], 'tags saved'); eq((await kvLib.getUserProfile('alice'))?.tags, ['vip', 'watch'], 'tags persisted on the profile'); // Restrictions await admin.saveFlags('bob', { noTrading: true, hideFromBoard: true, reason: 'testing' }); ok((await admin.getHiddenUsers()).has('bob'), 'bob is in the hidden set'); ok(await admin.isTradeBlocked('bob'), 'bob is trade-blocked'); const toBob = await trades.createTrade({ seasonId: season.id, from: 'alice', kind: 'direct', to: 'bob', give: [stack(1)], get: [stack(3)] }); ok(!toBob.ok, 'nobody can offer a trade to a blocked viewer'); const fromBob = await trades.createTrade({ seasonId: season.id, from: 'bob', kind: 'listing', give: [stack(3)], get: [stack(1)] }); ok(!fromBob.ok, 'a blocked viewer cannot make offers'); ok((await kvLib.getCollection(coll)).alice.length === 3, 'a refused offer takes nothing from the offerer'); await admin.saveFlags('bob', { noTrading: false, hideFromBoard: false }); ok(!(await admin.getHiddenUsers()).has('bob'), 'clearing the restriction un-hides'); // Restore points: reset, then restore const snap = await admin.takeUserSnapshot('alice', 'Before test reset'); ok(!!snap && snap.collections[0].entries.length === 3, 'a restore point holds the cards'); await kvLib.removeUserFromCollection(coll, 'alice'); ok(!(await kvLib.getCollection(coll)).alice, 'alice was reset'); const restored = await admin.restoreUserSnapshot('alice', snap!.id); ok(restored.ok && restored.cards === 3, 'restore reports the cards'); eq((await kvLib.getCollection(coll)).alice, [E(1), E(1), E(2)], 'restore brings every copy back'); ok((await admin.listUserSnapshots('alice')).length >= 2, 'restoring itself leaves a restore point'); ok(!(await admin.restoreUserSnapshot('alice', 'nope')).ok, 'an unknown restore point is refused'); // Merge const merged = await admin.mergeUsers('carol', 'bob'); ok(merged.ok && merged.cards === 1, 'merge moves the cards'); const after = await kvLib.getCollection(coll); eq(after.bob, [E(3), E(4), E(9)], 'bob now has carol\'s cards too'); ok(!after.carol, 'carol is gone from the collection'); ok(!(await admin.mergeUsers('bob', 'bob')).ok, 'merging into yourself is refused'); // Merge refused while a trade is open const open = await trades.createTrade({ seasonId: season.id, from: 'alice', kind: 'listing', give: [stack(2)], get: [stack(4)] }); ok(open.ok, 'a listing can be made'); ok(!(await admin.mergeUsers('alice', 'bob')).ok, 'merge is refused while the viewer has an open offer'); ok((await kvLib.getCollection(coll)).alice.length === 2, 'a refused merge changes nothing'); // Audit await audit.recordAudit('alice', 'Test', 'detail'); ok((await audit.getUserAudit('alice')).some(a => a.action === 'Test'), 'audit entries are readable'); }); ok(JSON.stringify(await prodKv.get('users:hidden')) === prodBefore, 'production hidden set untouched by the sandbox'); await sbx.deleteSandbox(box.id); console.log('check-users: all checks passed');

nodes.name: check-watch.mts
nodes.body_text: // Checks listing alerts: pure matching, the per-card index, and that a new board listing notifies the right viewers once. // Needs the mock KV (node scripts/mock-kv.cjs); refuses anything non-local. Run: npx tsx scripts/check-watch.mts const url = process.env.KV_REST_API_URL ?? 'http://localhost:4111'; if (!/^http:\/\/(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)[:/]/.test(url)) throw new Error(`Refusing to run against non-local KV: ${url}`); process.env.KV_REST_API_URL = url; process.env.KV_REST_API_TOKEN ??= 'dev'; process.env.KV_URL ??= 'redis://dev'; // ── pure ── const w = await import('../lib/watch-core'); const us = await import('../lib/user-settings'); const s = us.sanitizeUserSettings({ wanted: [1], watches: [{ card: 2, variant: 'shiny' }, { card: 2, variant: 'shiny' }, { card: 3, variant: null }, { card: 4, variant: 'bogus' }, { card: 'x' }, { card: 0 }] }); ok(s.watches.length === 3 && s.watches[2].variant === null, 'watches are cleaned: duplicates, bad cards dropped, an unknown version means any'); ok(us.sanitizeUserSettings({ watches: Array.from({ length: 30 }, (_, i) => ({ card: i + 1, variant: null })) }).watches.length === us.WATCH_MAX, 'capped'); const items = [{ cardNumber: 1, variant: 'regular' as const }, { cardNumber: 2, variant: 'regular' as const }, { cardNumber: 2, variant: 'shiny' as const }, { cardNumber: 3, variant: 'full' as const }, { cardNumber: 9, variant: 'regular' as const }]; const hits = w.matchingAlerts(s, items).map(i => `${i.cardNumber}.${i.variant}`); ok(hits.join() === '1.regular,2.shiny,3.full', `Looking for = any version, a watch = its version (or any): ${hits}`); ok(w.alertCards(s).sort().join() === '1,2,3,4', 'index keys: the Looking for card plus every watched card'); ok(!us.wantsNotice({ ...s, notifyWatch: false }, 'watch') && us.wantsNotice({ ...s, notifyWatch: false }, 'offer'), 'the watch switch only governs watch notices'); ok(w.watchLabel({ card: 2, variant: 'shiny' }, () => 'Gouda') === 'Shiny Full Art Gouda' && w.watchLabel({ card: 2, variant: null }, () => 'Gouda') === 'Gouda (any version)', 'labels'); const wc = w.wantedCounts([{ cardNumber: 1 }, { cardNumber: 2 }, { cardNumber: 2 }, { cardNumber: 3 }], { 1: ['alice', 'Bob', 'carol'], 2: ['alice', 'alice'], 3: ['bob'] }, ['bob']); ok(JSON.stringify(wc) === '{"1":2,"2":1}', `wanted counts drop the excluded, count a person once, and skip zeros: ${JSON.stringify(wc)}`); ok(Object.keys(w.wantedCounts([{ cardNumber: 9 }], {}, [])).length === 0, 'no watchers, no entry'); // ── stored ── const kvLib = await import('../lib/kv'); const { kv } = await import('../lib/db'); const store = await import('../lib/user-settings-store'); const idx = await import('../lib/watch-index'); const trades = await import('../lib/trades'); const tc = await import('../lib/trade-core'); const notif = await import('../lib/trade-notify'); const { encodeEntry } = await import('../lib/variants'); await kvLib.seedSeason1(); const pack = (await kvLib.getPack('pack1'))!; await kvLib.savePack({ ...pack, upgradesEnabled: true } as never); const season = (await kvLib.listSeasons())[0]; await kvLib.setActiveSeason(season.id); const [a, b, c] = await kvLib.getPackCards('pack1'); await kv.del('watch:idx:ready'); await kvLib.saveCollection(season.collectionName, { alice: [encodeEntry(c.number, 'regular')], bob: [encodeEntry(c.number, 'regular')], carol: [encodeEntry(a.number, 'regular'), encodeEntry(b.number, 'shiny'), encodeEntry(a.number, 'regular')], dave: [encodeEntry(c.number, 'regular')] }); await store.saveUserSettings('alice', { wanted: [a.number] }); await store.saveUserSettings('bob', { watches: [{ card: b.number, variant: 'shiny' }] }); await store.saveUserSettings('dave', { wanted: [a.number], notifyWatch: false }); ok((await idx.watchersOf([a.number])).sort().join() === 'alice,dave', 'the index finds who wants a card'); await store.saveUserSettings('alice', { wanted: [] }); ok((await idx.watchersOf([a.number])).join() === 'dave', 'removing a card from the list removes the viewer from the index'); await store.saveUserSettings('alice', { wanted: [a.number] }); await trades.saveTradeSettings({ ...tc.DEFAULT_TRADE_SETTINGS, cooldownSeconds: 0 }); const lst = await trades.createTrade({ seasonId: season.id, from: 'carol', kind: 'listing', give: [{ cardNumber: a.number, variant: 'regular', count: 1 }], get: [{ cardNumber: c.number, variant: 'regular', count: 1 }] }); ok(lst.ok, 'carol lists a regular of card a'); const an = await noticesOf('alice'); ok(an.length === 1 && an[0].text.includes('@carol listed') && an[0].tradeId === (lst as { trade: { id: string } }).trade.id, 'alice (Looking for) is told about the listing'); ok((await notif.listNotices('bob')).notices.filter(x => x.kind === 'watch').length === 0, 'bob watches the Shiny only, so a regular listing does not tell him'); ok((await notif.listNotices('dave')).notices.filter(x => x.kind === 'watch').length === 0, 'dave switched watch notices off'); ok((await notif.listNotices('carol')).notices.filter(x => x.kind === 'watch').length === 0, 'the lister is never told about their own listing'); const lst2 = await trades.createTrade({ seasonId: season.id, from: 'carol', kind: 'listing', give: [{ cardNumber: b.number, variant: 'shiny', count: 1 }], get: [{ cardNumber: c.number, variant: 'regular', count: 1 }] }); ok(lst2.ok, 'carol lists the shiny'); ok((await noticesOf('bob')).length === 1, 'bob is told about the shiny listing'); ok((await notif.listNotices('alice')).notices.filter(x => x.kind === 'watch').length === 1, 'alice is not told about a listing she does not want'); console.log('watch checks passed');

nodes.name: check-webhook-clean.mts
nodes.body_text: // Outgoing webhook addresses and fields are cleaned on the server (lib/webhook-clean.ts), and the sender refuses a private address even if // one was stored earlier. Pure; also reads the source to make sure the form action and the sender use it. Run: npx tsx scripts/check-webhook-clean.mts import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'; import { checkWebhookUrl, cleanWebhookFields, isPrivateHost } from '../lib/webhook-clean'; for (const h of ['localhost', 'foo.localhost', '127.0.0.1', '10.1.2.3', '192.168.0.5', '172.16.0.1', '172.31.255.1', '169.254.169.254', '0.0.0.0', '100.64.0.1', '[::1]', 'fd00::1', 'fe80::1', 'printer.local', 'db.internal', 'intranet']) { ok(isPrivateHost(h), `${h} is a private host`); } for (const h of ['example.com', 'hooks.zapier.com', '8.8.8.8', '172.32.0.1', '100.128.0.1', '[2606:4700::1111]']) { ok(!isPrivateHost(h), `${h} is public`); } ok(checkWebhookUrl('').ok && (checkWebhookUrl(' ') as { url: string }).url === '', 'an empty address is allowed (not set up)'); ok(checkWebhookUrl('https://example.com/hook?x=1').ok, 'a public https address is fine'); ok(checkWebhookUrl('http://example.com/hook').ok, 'a public http address is fine'); for (const bad of ['not a url', 'ftp://example.com/x', 'javascript:alert(1)', 'file:///etc/passwd', 'http://localhost:3000/x', 'http://127.0.0.1/x', 'https://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data', 'https://user:pw@example.com/x', 'https://' + 'a'.repeat(600) + '.com']) { ok(!checkWebhookUrl(bad).ok, `${bad.slice(0, 40)} is refused`); } ok(JSON.stringify(cleanWebhookFields([{ key: ' user ', value: '{username}' }, { key: '', value: 'x' }, null, 5, { key: 'n', value: 7 }, { value: 'no key' }])) === JSON.stringify([{ key: 'user', value: '{username}' }, { key: 'n', value: '' }]), 'fields keep well-formed rows only'); ok(cleanWebhookFields('nope').length === 0 && cleanWebhookFields({}).length === 0, 'fields that are not a list become empty'); ok(cleanWebhookFields(Array.from({ length: 50 }, (_, i) => ({ key: 'k' + i, value: '' }))).length === 20, 'at most 20 fields'); const actions = readFileSync(new URL('../app/admin/actions.ts', import.meta.url), 'utf8'); const section = actions.slice(actions.indexOf('export async function saveOutgoingWebhook'), actions.indexOf('export async function regenerateWebhookSecret')); ok(section.includes('checkWebhookUrl(') && section.includes('cleanWebhookFields('), 'the settings form checks the address and the fields'); const lib = readFileSync(new URL('../lib/webhooks.ts', import.meta.url), 'utf8'); ok(lib.includes('checkWebhookUrl(config.url)'), 'the sender checks the address again before calling it'); ok(lib.includes('timingSafeEqual'), 'the incoming secret is compared in constant time'); console.log('webhook-clean checks passed');

nodes.name: check-weekly-digest.mts
nodes.body_text: // Checks the weekly digest (ROADMAP 6.3): the pure builder (counters, top 3, first-run movers, hidden collectors, the "at least" rule, // the skip rule), the Weekly digest category (off for existing channels) and the once-a-week cron step with a local fake webhook. // Needs the mock KV (node scripts/mock-kv.cjs); refuses anything non-local. Run: npx tsx scripts/check-weekly-digest.mts import { createServer } from 'node:http'; import type { AddressInfo } from 'node:net'; const url = process.env.KV_REST_API_URL ?? 'http://localhost:4111'; if (!/^http:\/\/(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)[:/]/.test(url)) throw new Error(`Refusing to run against non-local KV: ${url}`); process.env.KV_REST_API_URL = url; process.env.KV_REST_API_TOKEN ??= 'dev'; process.env.KV_URL ??= 'redis://dev'; const hits: { embeds: { title?: string; description?: string; fields?: { name: string; value: string }[] }[] }[] = []; const server = createServer((req, res) => { let data = ''; req.on('data', d => (data += d)); req.on('end', () => { hits.push(JSON.parse(data)); res.statusCode = 204; res.end(); }); }); await new Promise<void>(r => server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', r)); const hook = `http://localhost:${(server.address() as AddressInfo).port}/api/webhooks/1/token`; const W = await import('../lib/weekly-digest'); const dc = await import('../lib/discord-config'); const d = await import('../lib/discord'); const H = 3_600_000, DAY = 24 * H; const now = Date.UTC(2026, 9, 18, 20); // a Sunday evening // ── pure builder ── const board = [{ username: 'ann', score: 900 }, { username: 'bob', score: 800 }, { username: 'cat', score: 700 }, { username: 'dan', score: 600 }]; { const g = W.buildWeeklyDigest(input()); eq([g.pulls, g.newCollectors, g.upgrades, g.trades], [15, 2, 1, 3], 'counters cover the last 7 days only and ignore per-pack fields'); eq(g.top.map(t => [t.username, t.rank, t.points]), [['ann', 1, 900], ['bob', 2, 800], ['cat', 3, 700]], 'the top 3'); ok(g.movers === null, 'the first run has no movers'); ok(W.digestWorthPosting(g), 'a week with pulls is worth posting'); } { const prev = { ann: [1, 880], bob: [4, 300], cat: [2, 690], dan: [3, 600], gone: [5, 10] } as import('../lib/weekly-digest').RankSnapshot; const g = W.buildWeeklyDigest(input({ prevRanks: prev })); eq(g.movers?.map(m => [m.username, m.climbed, m.gained]), [['bob', 2, 500], ['ann', 0, 20], ['cat', -1, 10]], 'biggest climb first, then points gained, unchanged collectors left out'); } { const prev = { ann: [1, 900], bob: [2, 800], cat: [3, 700], dan: [4, 600] } as import('../lib/weekly-digest').RankSnapshot; eq(W.buildWeeklyDigest(input({ prevRanks: prev })).movers, [], 'nobody moved: an empty list, not "first run"'); } { // Hidden or private collectors never reach `board`, so the snapshot built from it leaves them out as well. const snap = W.snapshotRanks(board); eq(snap.bob, [2, 800], 'the snapshot keeps rank and points'); ok(!('hid' in snap), 'a collector left off the board is not in the snapshot'); } { const trades = [done(1, 2, now - DAY), done(3, 1, now - 2 * DAY), done(1, 1, now - 9 * DAY), { ...done(3, 5, now - DAY), status: 'declined' }]; const g = W.buildWeeklyDigest(input({ trades })); eq(g.mostTraded.map(c => [c.name, c.count]), [['Cat', 2], ['Dog', 2], ['Fish', 1]], 'most traded counts both sides of accepted trades from this week'); ok(!g.tradedAtLeast, 'a short history that is not at its cap is complete'); const full = Array.from({ length: 400 }, (_, i) => done(1, 1, now - 20 * 60_000 * (i + 1))); ok(W.buildWeeklyDigest(input({ trades: full })).tradedAtLeast, 'a full history that stops inside the week says "at least"'); const old = [...full.slice(0, 399), done(1, 1, now - 9 * DAY)]; ok(!W.buildWeeklyDigest(input({ trades: old })).tradedAtLeast, 'a full history that reaches back past the week is complete'); } { const g = W.buildWeeklyDigest(input({ watchers: { 1: 2, 3: 5, 2: 5 } })); eq(g.mostWanted, { cardNumber: 2, name: 'Dog', watchers: 5 }, 'most wanted: highest count, lowest number on a tie'); eq(W.buildWeeklyDigest(input()).mostWanted, null, 'nobody wants anything'); } { const quiet = W.buildWeeklyDigest(input({ hours: { [`${hk(now - 8 * DAY)}|pull`]: 4 } })); ok(!W.digestWorthPosting(quiet), 'no pulls and no trades this week: skip'); ok(W.digestWorthPosting(W.buildWeeklyDigest(input({ hours: { [`${hk(now - DAY)}|trade`]: 1 } }))), 'trades alone are enough'); } // ── the Discord message and category ── { const msg = d.buildDigestMessage(W.sampleDigest(now), { footer: 'Test digest' }); const names = msg.embeds[0].fields?.map(f => f.name) ?? []; for (const n of ['Packs opened', 'Top 3 right now', 'Movers', 'Print of the week', 'Leaderboard']) ok(names.includes(n), `the embed has ${n}`); ok(!/—/.test(JSON.stringify(msg)), 'no em dash'); const first = d.buildDigestMessage({ ...W.sampleDigest(now), movers: null }); ok(first.embeds[0].fields?.some(f => f.value === 'Movers start next week.'), 'the first run says movers start next week'); ok(dc.DEFAULT_CATEGORIES.digest === false, 'digest is off by default'); ok(dc.presetChannel('digest').categories.digest === true && dc.presetChannel('digest').categories.pulls === false, 'the Weekly digest preset ticks only digest'); } // ── the weekly step, mock KV ── const { kv } = await import('../lib/db'); const kvLib = await import('../lib/kv'); const ser = await import('../lib/serials'); const stats = await import('../lib/stats'); const store = await import('../lib/weekly-digest-store'); const sbx = await import('../lib/sandbox'); const db = await import('../lib/db'); const { encodeEntry } = await import('../lib/variants'); await kvLib.seedSeason1(); const season = (await kvLib.getActiveSeason())!; const c = season.collectionName; await kvLib.saveCollection(c, { alice: [E(1), E(2), E(3, 'shiny')], bob: [E(1)], carol: [E(4)], hid: [E(1), E(2), E(3), E(4), E(5), E(6)] }); await ser.backfillSerials(c, await kvLib.getCollection(c)); await kv.sadd('users:hidden:self', 'hid'); await kv.set('discord:settings', { enabled: true, channels: [ { id: 'dig', name: 'Digest', url: hook, enabled: true, categories: { ...dc.presetChannel('digest').categories }, minStars: 1, newOnly: false }, { id: 'old', name: 'Existing', url: hook, enabled: true, categories: { pulls: true, cards: true }, minStars: 1, newOnly: false }, ], }); eq((await d.getDiscordSettings()).channels.find(x => x.id === 'old')?.categories.digest, false, 'an existing channel has the digest off'); // A quiet week first: nothing is posted, but the ranks are kept. const start = Date.now() - 14 * DAY; { const out = await store.digestOncePerWeek(start); eq(out.status, 'skipped', 'an off-season week is skipped'); eq(hits.length, 0, 'and nothing is posted'); ok(!!(await kv.get(`digest:ranks:${season.id}`)), 'the ranks are saved even on a skipped week'); ok((await store.getLatestDigest()) === null, 'no latest digest after a skipped week'); eq((await store.digestOncePerWeek(start)).status, 'already', 'a skipped week is still locked'); } // Week two: some activity, a trade, a wanted card. const w2 = start + 7 * DAY; for (const [u, at] of [['alice', w2 - 2 * DAY], ['bob', w2 - DAY], ['bob', w2 - DAY]] as const) await stats.recordStats({ type: 'pull', username: u, collectionName: c, isNew: true, copies: 1, uniqueOwned: 1, packName: 'Base' }, at); await stats.recordStats({ type: 'trade', action: 'accepted', username: 'alice', collectionName: c }, w2 - DAY); await kv.set('trades:history', [{ id: 't1', seasonId: season.id, kind: 'direct', from: 'alice', to: 'bob', give: [{ cardNumber: 1, variant: 'regular', count: 1 }], get: [{ cardNumber: 2, variant: 'regular', count: 1 }], escrowed: false, status: 'accepted', createdAt: w2 - DAY - H, expiresAt: w2, resolvedAt: w2 - DAY }]); await kv.sadd('watch:idx:3', 'alice', 'bob'); // Make bob climb: give him a shiny. await kvLib.saveCollection(c, { ...(await kvLib.getCollection(c)), bob: [E(1), E(5, 'shiny'), E(6, 'shiny')] }); { const out = await store.digestOncePerWeek(w2); eq(out.status, 'posted', 'a week with pulls is posted'); eq(hits.length, 1, 'exactly one message reaches the channel with the digest ticked'); const f = hits[0].embeds[0].fields ?? []; eq(field('Packs opened'), '3', 'pulls from the counters'); eq(field('Trades completed'), '1', 'trades from the counters'); ok(!/hid/.test(JSON.stringify(hits[0])), 'a private collector never appears'); ok(/Movers/.test(f.map(x => x.name).join()) && field('Movers') !== 'Movers start next week.', 'week two has movers'); ok(/bob/.test(field('Movers')), `bob climbed: ${field('Movers')}`); ok(/×/.test(field('Most traded cards')), 'the traded cards are listed: ' + JSON.stringify(f)); ok(/\(at least\)/.test(f.map(x => x.name).join()) === false, 'a short history is not "at least"'); ok(field('Most wanted card') !== '', 'the most wanted card is shown'); eq((await store.getLatestDigest())?.weekKey, (await import('../lib/print-of-week')).isoWeekKey(w2), 'the latest digest is kept for the dashboard'); eq((await store.digestOncePerWeek(w2)).status, 'already', 'the second call the same week does nothing'); eq(hits.length, 1, 'and posts nothing'); } // The cron route: closed without the secret, nothing outside production, nothing in a sandbox, one digest per week. const route = await import('../app/api/cron/weekly/route'); const { NextRequest } = await import('next/server'); const SECRET = 'a-long-enough-secret-123'; process.env.CRON_SECRET = SECRET; ok((await call()).status === 401, 'no secret: refused'); { const body = await (await call(SECRET)).json(); ok(body.skipped, 'outside production it does nothing'); } process.env.VERCEL_ENV = 'production'; { const before = hits.length; await stats.recordStats({ type: 'pull', username: 'carol', collectionName: c, isNew: true, copies: 1, uniqueOwned: 1, packName: 'Base' }, Date.now() - H); const one = await (await call(SECRET)).json(); eq(one.steps.digest.status, 'posted', 'the route posts this week\'s digest'); const two = await (await call(SECRET)).json(); eq(two.steps.digest.status, 'already', 'the second call posts nothing'); eq(hits.length, before + 1, 'exactly one digest from two calls'); const box = await sbx.createSandbox({ name: 'Digest check', source: 'config' }); await db.runInSandbox(box.id, async () => { ok((await (await call(SECRET)).json()).skipped, 'inside a sandbox it does nothing'); }); eq(hits.length, before + 1, 'and nothing was sent from it'); } // Webhook grants feed the same counters as pulls (the digest's pulls and new collectors), admin grants do not. { const stats = await import('../lib/stats'); const coll = 'GrantCountCheck'; const at = Date.now(); await stats.recordStats({ type: 'grant', source: 'webhook', username: 'wg', collectionName: coll, isNew: true, copies: 1, uniqueOwned: 1, variant: 'shiny', packName: 'Base' }, at); await stats.recordStats({ type: 'grant', source: 'admin', username: 'wg2', collectionName: coll }, at); await stats.recordStats({ type: 'pull', username: 'wg3', collectionName: coll, isNew: false, copies: 2, uniqueOwned: 4, packName: 'Base' }, at); const series = await stats.getSeries(coll, [at - (at % 3_600_000)], 'hour'); eq(series.data.pull[0], 2, 'a webhook grant counts as a pull in the stats (with a real pull: 2), an admin grant does not'); eq(series.data.newViewer[0], 1, 'a first card by webhook counts as a new viewer'); eq(series.data['v:shiny'][0], 1, 'and its version is counted'); eq(series.data.grant[0], 1, 'an admin grant is still counted as a grant'); } server.close(); console.log('weekly digest checks passed');
