nodes.name: check-words.mts
nodes.body_text: // The Privacy Policy and the FAQ quote numbers (how many events or notices are kept, for how many days, how long a pass lasts...). // This reads the page source and the code constants and fails when they disagree, so a changed limit cannot leave the wording stale. // Pure (reads files, no database). Run: npx tsx scripts/check-words.mts import { readFileSync, readdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'; import { join } from 'node:path'; const root = join(import.meta.dirname, '..'); const privacy = read('app/privacy/page.tsx'); const faq = read('app/(site)/faq/page.tsx'); const terms = read('app/terms/page.tsx'); // ---- what is kept, and for how long ---- has(privacy, `latest ${fromCode('lib/activity.ts', /const LOG_CAP = (\d+)/)} events`, 'activity log size'); has(privacy, `latest ${fromCode('lib/trades.ts', /const HISTORY_CAP = (\d+)/)} finished trades`, 'trade history size'); has(privacy, `newest ${fromCode('lib/trade-notify.ts', /const NOTICE_CAP = (\d+)/)}`, 'bell notices kept'); has(privacy, `newest ${fromCode('lib/score-history-core.ts', /export const HISTORY_CAP = (\d+)/)} per season`, 'score samples kept'); ok(faq.includes('Request deletion') && privacy.includes('Request deletion') && terms.includes('Request deletion'), 'the FAQ, Privacy Policy and Terms all describe the Request deletion button'); ok(faq.includes('14 days') && privacy.includes('restore point'), 'the 14-day restore point is stated'); // The feedback wording reads its numbers from the limits themselves, so it cannot drift; check it still does. has(privacy, 'FEEDBACK_LIMITS.keepDaysAfterResolved} days after that, then deleted', 'feedback retention comes from the limit'); has(privacy, 'You can send {FEEDBACK_LIMITS.perDay} a day', 'feedback daily limit comes from the limit'); has(faq, 'FEEDBACK_LIMITS.keepDaysAfterResolved} days after', 'the FAQ feedback retention comes from the limit'); has(privacy, `kept for ${fromCode('lib/user-admin.ts', /const SNAP_TTL = (\d+) \* 24/)} days`, 'restore points'); has(privacy, `up to ${fromCode('lib/avatars.ts', /const TTL_FOUND = (\d+) \* 24/)} days`, 'cached profile pictures'); has(privacy, `up to ${fromCode('lib/session.ts', /const MAX_AGE_S = 60 \* 60 \* 24 \* (\d+)/)} days`, 'login cookie lifetime'); const passMinutes = fromCode('lib/captcha.ts', /export const PASS_SECONDS = (\d+) \* 60/); has(privacy, `about ${passMinutes} minutes`, 'Turnstile pass in the privacy policy'); has(faq, `about ${passMinutes} minutes`, 'Turnstile pass in the FAQ'); has(faq, `(up to ${fromCode('lib/user-settings.ts', /export const WATCH_MAX = (\d+)/)})`, 'saved alerts'); // ---- the channel-only rule is stated in all three places ---- ok(faq.includes('Only on <a href={CHANNEL_URL}') && /run anywhere el/.test(faq), 'the FAQ says the game runs only on the channel'); ok(terms.includes('runs only on the {CHANNEL_NAME} Twitch channel'), 'the Terms say the game runs only on the channel'); ok(privacy.includes('played only on the {CHANNEL_NAME} Twitch channel'), 'the Privacy Policy says the game is played only on the channel'); // ---- plain wording rules from CLAUDE.md ---- for (const [name, text] of [['faq', faq], ['privacy', privacy], ['terms', terms]] as const) { ok(!text.includes(String.fromCharCode(8212)), `${name}: no em dash`); } ok(!/in seasons that enable it\. Can/.test(terms), 'the Terms sentence about upgrades is one sentence'); ok(!faq.includes('>Collections</Link> or the search box'), 'the FAQ calls the page Collectors, as the nav does'); // ---- a card copy is a "print" (ROADMAP 2.6): the old names must not come back into user-facing text ---- // Narrow on purpose: code identifiers (copy, uid, Copy) and comments are fine, only phrases a viewer would read are banned. const userFacing = [...walkSrc('app', /\.tsx$/), 'public/widget.js', 'lib/discord.ts', 'lib/flip-back.ts', 'lib/share-image.ts', 'lib/changelog.ts']; const banned: [RegExp, string][] = [[/unique copy number/i, 'unique copy number'], [/unique number/i, 'unique number'], [/copy page/i, 'copy page'], [/ID #/, 'ID #']]; for (const file of userFacing) { const src = withoutComments(read(file)); for (const [re, label] of banned) ok(!re.test(src), `${file} says "${label}": a card copy is a print (ROADMAP 2.6), so use "print number", "print page" or "Print #1023381"`); } // ---- the two set bonuses are the "progress bonus" and the "full set bonus" (ROADMAP 7.8); the FAQ alone may name the old words ("it used to be called") ---- const oldBonusNames = /completion bonus|complete[- ](set|collection) bonus/i; for (const file of userFacing.filter(f => f !== 'app/(site)/faq/page.tsx')) ok(!oldBonusNames.test(withoutComments(read(file))), `${file} uses an old bonus name: say "progress bonus" or "full set bonus"`); ok(faq.includes('it used to be called the completion bonus'), 'the FAQ keeps the old progress bonus name findable'); ok(faq.includes('it used to be called the complete collection bonus'), 'the FAQ keeps the old full set bonus name findable'); ok(faq.includes('id="serials"') && faq.includes('id="prints"'), 'the FAQ keeps the #serials anchor and adds #prints'); // ---- the info tooltips (ROADMAP 7.9): every glossary link lands on a real FAQ anchor, and the wording follows the house rules ---- const glossary = read('lib/glossary.ts'); const faqAnchors = new Set([...faq.matchAll(/\bid="([^"]+)"/g)].map(m => m[1])); const entries = [...glossary.matchAll(/^ (\w+): \{\n([\s\S]*?)\n \},$/gm)]; ok(entries.length >= 15, `the glossary has its first terms (found ${entries.length})`); for (const [, term, block] of entries) { const anchor = /faq: '([^']+)'/.exec(block)?.[1]; ok(!anchor || faqAnchors.has(anchor), `glossary term ${term} links to #${anchor}, which the FAQ does not have`); ok(/title: '/.test(block) && /body: '/.test(block), `glossary term ${term} has a title and a body`); } ok(!glossary.includes(String.fromCharCode(8212)) && !/\p{Extended_Pictographic}/u.test(glossary), 'the glossary has no em dash and no emoji'); ok(!oldBonusNames.test(glossary), 'the glossary uses the new bonus names'); console.log('words checks passed');

nodes.name: read
nodes.body_text: read = (p: string) => readFileSync(join(root, p), 'utf8')

nodes.name: ok
nodes.body_text: ok = (cond: unknown, msg: string) => { if (!cond) throw new Error('FAILED: ' + msg); }

nodes.name: fromCode
nodes.body_text: fromCode = (file: string, re: RegExp): number => { const m = re.exec(read(file)); if (!m) throw new Error(`could not find ${re} in ${file}`); return Number(m[1]); }

nodes.name: has
nodes.signature: has = (text: string, phrase: string, label: string)
nodes.body_text: has = (text: string, phrase: string, label: string) => ok(text.includes(phrase), `${label}: the page says "${phrase}"`)

nodes.name: walkSrc
nodes.signature: walkSrc = (dir: string, re: RegExp, out: string[] = []): string[]
nodes.body_text: walkSrc = (dir: string, re: RegExp, out: string[] = []): string[] => { for (const f of readdirSync(join(root, dir))) { const rel = dir + '/' + f; if (statSync(join(root, rel)).isDirectory()) walkSrc(rel, re, out); else if (re.test(f)) out.push(rel); } return out; }

nodes.name: withoutComments
nodes.body_text: withoutComments = (src: string) => src .replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g, '') .split('\n') .filter(l => !/^\s*(\/\/|\*)/.test(l)) .map(l => l.replace(/\s\/\/ .*$/, '')) .join('\n')

nodes.name: brand-icon.mjs
nodes.body_text: // The app icon: the mascot with a gold cheese-wedge badge in the corner, so it reads as "The Cheesy TCG" at a glance. Shared by // the home-screen icons (scripts/make-pwa-icons.mjs) and the Twitch extension art (scripts/make-twitch-assets.mjs). import sharp from 'sharp'; export const SRC = 'public/brand/icon.png'; export const NAVY = '#0a0f1e'; /** The badge as an SVG: a gold disc with a navy ring and the site's cheese wedge glyph (the path is the `cheese` icon in app/components/Icon.tsx). */ /** * The icon as a PNG buffer, `size` px square. `ratio` is how much of the square the artwork fills (1 = edge to edge on a transparent * square; less, with `background`, leaves a margin, which maskable and iOS icons need). The badge sits in the artwork's bottom-right. */

nodes.name: badgeSvg
nodes.body_text: function badgeSvg(px) { return Buffer.from(`<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="${px}" height="${px}" viewBox="0 0 100 100"> <defs><linearGradient id="g" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#fde047"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#f59e0b"/></linearGradient></defs> <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="46" fill="url(#g)" stroke="${NAVY}" stroke-width="6"/> <g transform="translate(21 21.5) scale(2.4)" fill="none" stroke="#3a2606" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"> <path d="M3 17.5 21 9.2a1 1 0 0 0 .4-1.4l-1.5-2.4a1.5 1.5 0 0 0-1.7-.6L3 9.8V17.5Z"/> <path d="M3 17.5v1.7a1.3 1.3 0 0 0 1.3 1.3H19a2 2 0 0 0 2-2v-9.8"/> <circle cx="8.5" cy="14.2" r="1.1"/><circle cx="14.5" cy="12.4" r="1"/><circle cx="16" cy="17.2" r="1.2"/> </g> </svg>`); }

nodes.name: brandIcon
nodes.signature: async function brandIcon(size, { ratio = 1, background = null, badge = 0.4 } = {})
nodes.body_text: async function brandIcon(size, { ratio = 1, background = null, badge = 0.4 } = {}) { const art = Math.round(size * ratio); const mascot = await sharp(SRC).resize(art, art, { fit: 'contain', background: { r: 0, g: 0, b: 0, alpha: 0 }, kernel: 'lanczos3' }) .sharpen({ sigma: 0.7 }).png().toBuffer(); const b = Math.round(art * badge); const off = Math.round((size - art) / 2); const badgeX = off + art - b - Math.round(art * 0.01); const badgeY = off + art - b - Math.round(art * 0.01); const base = sharp({ create: { width: size, height: size, channels: 4, background: background ?? { r: 0, g: 0, b: 0, alpha: 0 } } }); return base.composite([ { input: mascot, left: off, top: off }, { input: await sharp(badgeSvg(b)).png().toBuffer(), left: badgeX, top: badgeY }, ]).png().toBuffer(); }

nodes.name: sweep.mjs
nodes.body_text: // Shared pieces of the review sweeps (sweep-public.mjs, sweep-admin.mjs, sweep-mod-access.mjs): finding Playwright, the base URL, // logging in the way each kind of person does locally, and the per-page measurements. import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'; export const BASE = process.env.SWEEP_BASE ?? 'http://localhost:3111'; export const TWITCH_MOCK = process.env.TWITCH_MOCK ?? 'http://localhost:4222'; export const ADMIN_PASSWORD = process.env.ADMIN_PASSWORD ?? 'pw'; /** Playwright from the project, from PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE (a path to its index.mjs), or from the Claude cloud environment. */ /** Admin through the emergency password (sets the httpOnly admin cookie on this context). */ /** Signs this context in as a fake-Twitch viewer (and so as staff when that login is on the staff list). */ /** One page: navigate, settle, measure. Returns { status, url, info, errors } (info is null when the page kept navigating). */

nodes.name: loadPlaywright
nodes.body_text: async function loadPlaywright() { const custom = process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE; const customUrl = custom && (custom.startsWith('file:') ? custom : pathToFileURL(custom).href); const tries = [() => import('playwright'), ...(customUrl ? [() => import(customUrl)] : []), () => import('/opt/node-tools/node_modules/playwright/index.mjs')]; for (const t of tries) { try { return (await t()).chromium; } catch { /* next */ } } throw new Error('Playwright not found. Install it (npm i -D playwright && npx playwright install chromium) or set PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE to its index.mjs.'); }

nodes.name: loginAdminPassword
nodes.body_text: async function loginAdminPassword(ctx) { const res = await ctx.request.post(`${BASE}/api/auth/login`, { data: { password: ADMIN_PASSWORD } }); if (!res.ok()) throw new Error(`Admin password login failed (${res.status()}). Is ADMIN_PASSWORD in .env.local '${ADMIN_PASSWORD}'?`); }

nodes.name: loginTwitch
nodes.body_text: async function loginTwitch(ctx, login, returnTo = '/settings') { await fetch(`${TWITCH_MOCK}/__as?login=${encodeURIComponent(login)}`); const p = await ctx.newPage(); await p.goto(`${BASE}/auth/twitch?returnTo=${encodeURIComponent(returnTo)}`, { timeout: 90000, waitUntil: 'load' }); await p.waitForLoadState('networkidle').catch(() => {}); const where = new URL(p.url()).pathname; await p.close(); return where; }

nodes.name: visit
nodes.body_text: async function visit(p, path, errors) { errors.length = 0; const res = await p.goto(BASE + path, { timeout: 90000, waitUntil: 'load' }).catch(() => null); await p.waitForLoadState('networkidle').catch(() => {}); await p.waitForTimeout(900); let info = null; for (let t = 0; t < 4 && !info; t++) { try { info = await p.evaluate(() => ({ overflow: document.documentElement.scrollWidth - document.documentElement.clientWidth, // Content pushed past the right edge while the page itself does not scroll (a grid column stretched by a wide child, with an // ancestor hiding the overflow): elements wider than the viewport that no scrolling ancestor contains. clipped: [...document.querySelectorAll('main *, [role="main"] *')].filter(e => { if (e.closest('svg')) return false; const r = e.getBoundingClientRect(); if (r.width === 0 || r.right <= innerWidth + 1) return false; for (let a = e.parentElement; a && a !== document.body && !a.matches('main, [role="main"]'); a = a.parentElement) { if (/(auto|scroll)/.test(getComputedStyle(a).overflowX)) return false; } return true; }).length, h1: document.querySelectorAll('h1').length, title: document.title, noAlt: [...document.querySelectorAll('img:not([alt])')].length, unnamed: [...document.querySelectorAll('button, a')].filter(e => !(e.textContent || '').trim() && !(e.labels && e.labels.length) && !e.getAttribute('aria-label') && !e.getAttribute('title') && !e.querySelector('img[alt]:not([alt=""])')).length, })); } catch { await p.waitForTimeout(1500); } } return { status: res?.status() ?? null, url: new URL(p.url()).pathname + new URL(p.url()).search, info, errors: [...errors] }; }

nodes.name: flagsFor
nodes.body_text: function flagsFor(r, { expectH1 = true } = {}) { const flags = []; const i = r.info; if (!i) return ['could not measure (kept navigating)']; if (i.overflow > 1) flags.push(`overflow ${i.overflow}px`); if (i.clipped) flags.push(`${i.clipped} elements pushed past the right edge`); if (expectH1 && i.h1 !== 1) flags.push(`h1=${i.h1}`); if (i.noAlt) flags.push(`${i.noAlt} img without alt`); if (i.unnamed) flags.push(`${i.unnamed} unnamed controls`); if (r.errors.length) flags.push('console: ' + r.errors.join(' | ')); return flags; }

nodes.name: watchConsole
nodes.body_text: function watchConsole(p) { const errors = []; p.on('console', m => { if (m.type() === 'error' && !/TUNNEL|ERR_FAILED|Failed to load resource/.test(m.text())) errors.push(m.text().slice(0, 160)); }); p.on('pageerror', e => errors.push('PAGEERROR ' + e.message.slice(0, 160))); return errors; }

nodes.name: twitch-package.mjs
nodes.body_text: // Builds and checks the Twitch extension's hosted-version package: the zip uploaded under the extension version's Asset Hosting. // // Twitch serves hosted files from its own domain (https://<client id>.ext-twitch.tv), under a Content Security Policy, so the package // differs from what the site serves at /twitch-panel/: // - the three viewer pages sit at the root of the zip, all files are referenced relatively, and nothing loads from anywhere except the // zip itself and Twitch's helper script (no site analytics script, no fake Twitch helper used for local testing) // - there are no inline scripts or inline event handlers (Twitch's CSP blocks them) // - config.js holds the site's address, because the API and the card art are on the site (cross-origin; the site answers with CORS) // - the site's own pages (Terms, Privacy) are linked absolutely import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'; import { join } from 'node:path'; import { makeZip } from './zip.mjs'; export const VIEWS = ['panel.html', 'mobile.html', 'video_component.html']; export const SCRIPTS = ['config.js', 'panel.js', 'trades.js']; export const STYLES = ['panel.css', 'views.css']; export const TWITCH_HELPER = 'https://extension-files.twitch.tv/helper/v1/twitch-ext.min.js'; const SRC = join('public', 'twitch-panel'); /** The package's files: [{ name, data }]. `site` is the site's public address (no trailing slash). */ /** Everything wrong with a package (an empty list means it is fine). Pure: give it the files from buildPackageFiles or readZip. */ /** Builds the zip (throws if the package breaks a rule). */

nodes.name: read
nodes.body_text: read = name => readFileSync(join(SRC, name), 'utf8')

nodes.name: packageVersion
nodes.body_text: function packageVersion() { return JSON.parse(readFileSync('package.json', 'utf8')).version; }

nodes.name: buildPackageFiles
nodes.body_text:
function buildPackageFiles(site) { const origin = site.replace(//$/, ''); const files = []; for (const v of VIEWS) { let html = read(v).replace(/
/g, '
'); html = html .replace(/^[ 	]*<script defer src="/_vercel/insights/script\.js"></script>
/m, '') // the site's analytics, not allowed here .replace(/^[ 	]*<script src="mock-twitch-ext\.js"></script>
/m, '') // the local fake Twitch helper .replace(/href="/(terms|privacy)"/g, `href="${origin}/$1"`); // the site's own pages files.push({ name: v, data: Buffer.from(html) }); } for (const f of [...SCRIPTS, ...STYLES]) { let text = read(f).replace(/
/g, '
'); if (f === 'config.js') text = text.replace(/window\.TCG_SITE = '[^']*';/, `window.TCG_SITE = '${origin}';`); files.push({ name: f, data: Buffer.from(text) }); } return files; }

nodes.name: validatePackage
nodes.body_text: function validatePackage(files, site) { const problems = []; const origin = site.replace(/\/$/, ''); const byName = new Map(files.map(f => [f.name, f.data.toString('utf8')])); for (const v of [...VIEWS, ...SCRIPTS, ...STYLES]) if (!byName.has(v)) problems.push(`${v} is missing from the package`); for (const f of files) if (f.name.includes('/') || f.name.startsWith('.')) problems.push(`${f.name}: every file must sit at the root of the zip`); if (byName.has('mock-twitch-ext.js')) problems.push('mock-twitch-ext.js must not be shipped'); for (const v of VIEWS) { const html = byName.get(v) ?? ''; for (const m of html.matchAll(/<script\b([^>]*)>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/gi)) { const src = /\bsrc="([^"]*)"/.exec(m[1])?.[1]; if (!src) problems.push(`${v}: an inline script (Twitch's CSP blocks it)`); else if (/^https?:\/\//.test(src)) { if (src !== TWITCH_HELPER) problems.push(`${v}: external script ${src} (only Twitch's helper is allowed)`); } else if (src.startsWith('/') || !byName.has(src)) problems.push(`${v}: script "${src}" is not a relative file in the package`); if (m[2].trim() && src) problems.push(`${v}: a script tag with both src and inline code`); } for (const m of html.matchAll(/<link\b[^>]*\bhref="([^"]*)"[^>]*>/gi)) { if (!/\brel="stylesheet"/i.test(m[0])) continue; if (/^https?:|^\//.test(m[1]) || !byName.has(m[1])) problems.push(`${v}: stylesheet "${m[1]}" is not a relative file in the package`); } if (/\son[a-z]+\s*=\s*["']/i.test(html)) problems.push(`${v}: an inline event handler (Twitch's CSP blocks it)`); if (/javascript:/i.test(html)) problems.push(`${v}: a javascript: link`); if (/<style\b/i.test(html)) problems.push(`${v}: an inline <style> block`); if (/_vercel|insights/i.test(html)) problems.push(`${v}: still references the site's analytics`); for (const m of html.matchAll(/\b(?:href|src)="(\/[^"]*)"/g)) problems.push(`${v}: site-relative path ${m[1]} (it would point at Twitch's domain)`); if (!html.includes(`href="${origin}/terms"`) || !html.includes(`href="${origin}/privacy"`)) problems.push(`${v}: the Terms and Privacy links are not absolute`); const order = [...html.matchAll(/<script\b[^>]*\bsrc="([^"]*)"/gi)].map(m => m[1]); if (!order.includes('config.js') || !order.includes('panel.js') || !order.includes('trades.js')) problems.push(`${v}: does not load config.js, panel.js and trades.js`); else if (order.indexOf('config.js') > order.indexOf('panel.js') || order.indexOf('panel.js') > order.indexOf('trades.js')) problems.push(`${v}: scripts must load in the order config.js, panel.js, trades.js`); } const cfg = byName.get('config.js') ?? ''; if (!cfg.includes(`window.TCG_SITE = '${origin}';`)) problems.push(`config.js does not point at ${origin}`); for (const js of ['panel.js', 'trades.js']) { const text = byName.get(js) ?? ''; for (const m of text.matchAll(/\bfetch\(\s*(?!api\()([^\n]{0,40})/g)) problems.push(`${js}: a fetch that does not go through api(): fetch(${m[1].trim()}`); if (/importScripts|eval\(|new Function\(/.test(text)) problems.push(`${js}: dynamic code loading`); } for (const css of STYLES) { const text = byName.get(css) ?? ''; for (const m of text.matchAll(/url\(\s*(['"]?)(?!data:)([^'")]+)\1\s*\)/g)) problems.push(`${css}: loads ${m[2]} (only data: URIs are self-contained)`); if (/@import/.test(text)) problems.push(`${css}: @import`); } return problems; }

nodes.name: buildPackage
nodes.body_text: function buildPackage(site) { const files = buildPackageFiles(site); const problems = validatePackage(files, site); if (problems.length) throw new Error('The package breaks Twitch hosting rules:\n- ' + problems.join('\n- ')); return { files, zip: makeZip(files) }; }

nodes.name: zip.mjs
nodes.body_text: // A tiny ZIP writer (deflate, no dependencies) so the Twitch package can be built with nothing but Node. Entries are written in the // order given with a fixed timestamp, so the same files always produce the same zip. import { crc32, deflateRawSync } from 'node:zlib'; const DOS_TIME = 0; // 00:00:00 const DOS_DATE = ((2026 - 1980) << 9) | (1 << 5) | 1; // 2026-01-01 /** `files`: [{ name: 'panel.html', data: Buffer }]. Names use forward slashes and no leading slash. Returns the zip as a Buffer. */ /** Reads a zip made by makeZip back into [{ name, data }] (used by the checks to prove the file is a valid zip). */ import { inflateRawSync } from 'node:zlib';

nodes.name: makeZip
nodes.body_text: function makeZip(files) { const chunks = []; const central = []; let offset = 0; for (const f of files) { const name = Buffer.from(f.name, 'utf8'); const raw = Buffer.isBuffer(f.data) ? f.data : Buffer.from(f.data); const packed = deflateRawSync(raw, { level: 9 }); const useDeflate = packed.length < raw.length; const body = useDeflate ? packed : raw; const crc = crc32(raw) >>> 0; const local = Buffer.alloc(30); local.writeUInt32LE(0x04034b50, 0); // local file header signature local.writeUInt16LE(20, 4); // version needed local.writeUInt16LE(0x0800, 6); // flags: UTF-8 names local.writeUInt16LE(useDeflate ? 8 : 0, 8); local.writeUInt16LE(DOS_TIME, 10); local.writeUInt16LE(DOS_DATE, 12); local.writeUInt32LE(crc, 14); local.writeUInt32LE(body.length, 18); local.writeUInt32LE(raw.length, 22); local.writeUInt16LE(name.length, 26); local.writeUInt16LE(0, 28); chunks.push(local, name, body); const dir = Buffer.alloc(46); dir.writeUInt32LE(0x02014b50, 0); // central directory header signature dir.writeUInt16LE(20, 4); // version made by dir.writeUInt16LE(20, 6); // version needed dir.writeUInt16LE(0x0800, 8); dir.writeUInt16LE(useDeflate ? 8 : 0, 10); dir.writeUInt16LE(DOS_TIME, 12); dir.writeUInt16LE(DOS_DATE, 14); dir.writeUInt32LE(crc, 16); dir.writeUInt32LE(body.length, 20); dir.writeUInt32LE(raw.length, 24); dir.writeUInt16LE(name.length, 28); dir.writeUInt32LE(offset, 42); // offset of the local header central.push(dir, name); offset += local.length + name.length + body.length; } const dirBuf = Buffer.concat(central); const end = Buffer.alloc(22); end.writeUInt32LE(0x06054b50, 0); // end of central directory signature end.writeUInt16LE(files.length, 8); end.writeUInt16LE(files.length, 10); end.writeUInt32LE(dirBuf.length, 12); end.writeUInt32LE(offset, 16); return Buffer.concat([...chunks, dirBuf, end]); }

nodes.name: readZip
nodes.body_text: function readZip(buf) { const eocd = buf.lastIndexOf(Buffer.from([0x50, 0x4b, 0x05, 0x06])); if (eocd < 0) throw new Error('not a zip'); const count = buf.readUInt16LE(eocd + 10); let p = buf.readUInt32LE(eocd + 16); const out = []; for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) { if (buf.readUInt32LE(p) !== 0x02014b50) throw new Error('bad central directory'); const method = buf.readUInt16LE(p + 10), crc = buf.readUInt32LE(p + 16), csize = buf.readUInt32LE(p + 20); const nlen = buf.readUInt16LE(p + 28), elen = buf.readUInt16LE(p + 30), clen = buf.readUInt16LE(p + 32), lho = buf.readUInt32LE(p + 42); const name = buf.toString('utf8', p + 46, p + 46 + nlen); const lnlen = buf.readUInt16LE(lho + 26), lelen = buf.readUInt16LE(lho + 28); const start = lho + 30 + lnlen + lelen; const body = buf.subarray(start, start + csize); const data = method === 8 ? inflate(body) : body; if ((crc32(data) >>> 0) !== crc) throw new Error(`bad checksum for ${name}`); out.push({ name, data }); p += 46 + nlen + elen + clen; } return out; }

nodes.name: inflate
nodes.body_text: inflate = b => inflateRawSync(b)

nodes.name: make-pwa-icons.mjs
nodes.body_text: // Builds the home-screen icons in public/icons (and the iOS one, app/apple-icon.png) from public/brand/icon.png: the mascot with a // cheese-wedge badge (scripts/lib/brand-icon.mjs). Run once; the output is committed. Usage: node scripts/make-pwa-icons.mjs import { writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises'; import { NAVY, brandIcon } from './lib/brand-icon.mjs'; const OUT = 'public/icons'; // "any": the artwork edge to edge on a transparent square. for (const size of [192, 512]) await writeFile(`${OUT}/icon-${size}.png`, await brandIcon(size)); // Maskable (Android crops to a circle or squircle) and iOS (which fills transparency with black): the artwork on the app's dark // background with a safe margin, badge included. for (const size of [192, 512]) await writeFile(`${OUT}/maskable-${size}.png`, await brandIcon(size, { ratio: 0.66, background: NAVY })); await writeFile('app/apple-icon.png', await brandIcon(180, { ratio: 0.86, background: NAVY })); console.log('icons written to', OUT, 'and app/apple-icon.png');

nodes.name: make-twitch-assets.mjs
nodes.body_text: // Builds the Twitch extension's icon (100x100) and discovery image (300x200, opaque) in twitch-extension/ from the app icon // (scripts/lib/brand-icon.mjs) and real card art. The screenshots (1024x768) are real captures of the panel, see // docs/twitch-extension-submission.md for how they were made. Usage: node scripts/make-twitch-assets.mjs import { mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'; import sharp from 'sharp'; import { NAVY, brandIcon } from './lib/brand-icon.mjs'; const OUT = 'twitch-extension'; mkdirSync(OUT, { recursive: true }); // ── icon: the app icon on the app's dark background, square and opaque ── writeFileSync(`${OUT}/icon-100.png`, await sharp(await brandIcon(100, { ratio: 0.9, background: NAVY })).removeAlpha().png().toBuffer()); // ── discovery image: 300x200, no transparency, little text (Twitch shows it small in the Featured section) ── const W = 300, H = 200; const bg = Buffer.from(`<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="${W}" height="${H}"> <defs> <linearGradient id="b" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#16204a"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#070b1d"/></linearGradient> <radialGradient id="g" cx="0.68" cy="0.5" r="0.5"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#facc15" stop-opacity="0.38"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#facc15" stop-opacity="0"/></radialGradient> <linearGradient id="s" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#facc15"/><stop offset="0.25" stop-color="#fb7185"/><stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#c084fc"/><stop offset="0.75" stop-color="#38bdf8"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#34d399"/></linearGradient> </defs> <rect width="${W}" height="${H}" fill="url(#b)"/><rect width="${W}" height="${H}" fill="url(#g)"/><rect width="${W}" height="6" fill="url(#s)"/> </svg>`); const CARDS = ['Goatlygidds', 'Onesiegidds', 'Cheesygidds']; // the middle one is a 5-star const cardH = 128; const fan = [ { input: await card(CARDS[0], -13), left: 128, top: 46 }, { input: await card(CARDS[2], 13), left: 208, top: 40 }, { input: await card(CARDS[1], 0), left: 168, top: 28 }, ]; const icon = await brandIcon(84, { ratio: 1 }); let img = sharp(bg).composite([...fan, { input: icon, left: 22, top: 40 }]); // the name, only if this machine can draw SVG text; the image is complete without it const label = Buffer.from(`<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="140" height="56"><text x="0" y="22" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-weight="800" font-size="20" fill="#ffffff">The Cheesy</text><text x="0" y="46" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-weight="800" font-size="20" fill="#fde047">TCG</text></svg>`); try { img = sharp(await img.png().toBuffer()).composite([{ input: label, left: 18, top: 132 }]); } catch { /* no text support: icon and cards alone */ } writeFileSync(`${OUT}/discovery-300x200.png`, await sharp(await img.flatten({ background: NAVY }).png().toBuffer()).removeAlpha().png().toBuffer()); console.log('wrote', `${OUT}/icon-100.png`, 'and', `${OUT}/discovery-300x200.png`);

nodes.name: card
nodes.body_text: async function card(name, angle) { const art = await sharp(`public/assets/cards/thumb/${name}.webp`).resize({ height: cardH }).png().toBuffer(); // a soft shadow under each card, then rotate the pair const { width } = await sharp(art).metadata(); const shadow = await sharp({ create: { width: width + 24, height: cardH + 24, channels: 4, background: { r: 0, g: 0, b: 0, alpha: 0 } } }) .composite([{ input: await sharp(art).ensureAlpha().tint('#000000').blur(5).png().toBuffer(), left: 12, top: 16 }]).png().toBuffer(); const both = await sharp(shadow).composite([{ input: art, left: 12, top: 12 }]).png().toBuffer(); return sharp(both).rotate(angle, { background: { r: 0, g: 0, b: 0, alpha: 0 } }).png().toBuffer(); }

nodes.name: mock-kv.cjs
nodes.body_text: // Dev-only fake of the Upstash REST API that @vercel/kv talks to, so the app can run locally without touching // the real database. Supports only the commands this app uses. Start: node scripts/mock-kv.cjs (port 4111, or MOCK_KV_PORT). // Point the app at it with KV_REST_API_URL=http://localhost:4111 (see CLAUDE.md → Testing locally). const http = require('http'); const PORT = Number(process.env.MOCK_KV_PORT) || 4111; const store = new Map(); const types = new Map(); // key -> 'string' | 'hash' | 'list' | 'set' (the stored value alone can't tell a list from a set) http.createServer((req, res) => { let body = ''; req.on('data', c => body += c); req.on('end', () => { const enc = req.headers['upstash-encoding'] === 'base64'; let j; try { j = JSON.parse(body || "[]"); } catch { j = []; } const out = req.url.includes('pipeline') ? j.map(c => wrap(run(c))) : wrap(run(j)); res.setHeader('content-type', 'application/json'); res.end(JSON.stringify(out)); }); }).listen(PORT, () => console.log('mock kv on ' + PORT));

nodes.name: run
nodes.body_text: function run(cmd) { if (!Array.isArray(cmd)) return null; const [op, key, ...rest] = cmd; const o = String(op).toLowerCase(); switch (o) { case 'get': return store.has(key) ? store.get(key) : null; case 'set': { // SET key value [NX] [EX seconds]: NX only sets when the key is absent (what the app's locks rely on), EX expires it. const opts = rest.slice(1).map(x => String(x).toLowerCase()); if (opts.includes('nx') && store.has(key)) return null; store.set(key, rest[0]); types.set(key, 'string'); const ex = opts.indexOf('ex'); if (ex >= 0) setTimeout(() => store.delete(key), Number(rest[1 + ex + 1]) * 1000).unref(); return 'OK'; } case 'del': { let n = 0; for (const k of [key, ...rest]) if (store.delete(k)) { types.delete(k); n++; } return n; } case 'type': return types.get(key) ?? 'none'; case 'exists': return store.has(key) ? 1 : 0; case 'scan': { // SCAN cursor MATCH pattern COUNT n: one pass over everything, cursor 0 means done. const mi = rest.findIndex(x => String(x).toLowerCase() === 'match'); const pat = mi >= 0 ? String(rest[mi + 1]) : '*'; const esc = pat.split('*').map(part => part.replace(/[.+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, c => '\\' + c)).join('.*'); const re = new RegExp('^' + esc + '$'); return ['0', [...store.keys()].filter(k => re.test(k))]; } case 'lpush': { const l = store.get(key) || []; l.unshift(rest[0]); store.set(key, l); types.set(key, 'list'); return l.length; } case 'rpush': { const l = store.get(key) || []; l.push(...rest); store.set(key, l); types.set(key, 'list'); return l.length; } case 'rpop': { const l = store.get(key) || []; return l.pop() ?? null; } case 'incr': { const n = Number(store.get(key) || 0) + 1; store.set(key, String(n)); return n; } case 'decr': { const n = Number(store.get(key) || 0) - 1; store.set(key, String(n)); return n; } case 'lrange': { const l = store.get(key) || []; const [a, b] = rest.map(Number); return l.slice(Number(key === undefined ? 0 : a), b < 0 ? l.length + b + 1 : b + 1); } case 'ltrim': return 'OK'; case 'sadd': { const s = new Set(store.get(key) || []); rest.forEach(x => s.add(x)); store.set(key, [...s]); types.set(key, 'set'); return 1; } case 'srem': { const s = new Set(store.get(key) || []); let n = 0; rest.forEach(x => { if (s.delete(x)) n++; }); store.set(key, [...s]); return n; } case 'hset': { const h = store.get(key) || {}; for (let i = 0; i < rest.length; i += 2) h[rest[i]] = rest[i+1]; store.set(key, h); types.set(key, 'hash'); return rest.length / 2; } case 'hdel': { const h = store.get(key) || {}; let n = 0; rest.forEach(f => { if (f in h) { delete h[f]; n++; } }); store.set(key, h); return n; } case 'hincrby': { const h = store.get(key) || {}; h[rest[0]] = Number(h[rest[0]] || 0) + Number(rest[1]); store.set(key, h); types.set(key, 'hash'); return h[rest[0]]; } case 'scard': return (store.get(key) || []).length; case 'llen': return (store.get(key) || []).length; case 'hget': { const h = store.get(key) || {}; return rest[0] in h ? h[rest[0]] : null; } case 'hlen': return Object.keys(store.get(key) || {}).length; case 'hgetall': { const h = store.get(key); return h ? Object.entries(h).flat() : []; } case 'smembers': return store.get(key) || []; default: return null; } }

nodes.name: b64
nodes.body_text: b64 = v => v === 'OK' ? v : typeof v === 'string' ? Buffer.from(v).toString('base64') : Array.isArray(v) ? v.map(b64) : v

nodes.name: wrap
nodes.body_text: wrap = r => ({ result: enc ? b64(r) : r })

nodes.name: mock-push.cjs
nodes.body_text: // Dev-only fake push service: records every alert the app sends so it can be inspected, like mock-twitch.cjs does for Twitch. // Start: node scripts/mock-push.cjs (port 4333; MOCK_PUSH_PORT changes it). A subscription whose endpoint is // http://localhost:4333/push/<name> is accepted (201) and recorded, // http://localhost:4333/gone/<name> answers 410 (the browser dropped it), /missing/ answers 404, /fail/ answers 500. // GET /__received lists what arrived ({ path, headers, bytes }), /__reset clears the list. The bodies are encrypted for the // browser, so only their size and the headers (TTL, Urgency, Authorization) are recorded. // The app only accepts an http endpoint on localhost outside production builds (lib/push-core.ts validEndpoint). const http = require('http'); module.exports = { start }; if (require.main === module) start().then(s => console.log(`mock push on ${s.port}`));

nodes.name: start
nodes.body_text: function start(port = Number(process.env.MOCK_PUSH_PORT) || 4333) { const received = []; const server = http.createServer((req, res) => { const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost'); if (url.pathname === '/__received') { res.setHeader('content-type', 'application/json'); return res.end(JSON.stringify(received)); } if (url.pathname === '/__reset') { received.length = 0; return res.end('ok'); } const chunks = []; req.on('data', c => chunks.push(c)); req.on('end', () => { const kind = url.pathname.split('/')[1]; received.push({ path: url.pathname, kind, headers: req.headers, bytes: Buffer.concat(chunks).length }); res.statusCode = kind === 'gone' ? 410 : kind === 'missing' ? 404 : kind === 'fail' ? 500 : 201; res.end(); }); }); return new Promise(resolve => server.listen(port, '127.0.0.1', () => resolve({ port: server.address().port, received, stop: () => server.close() }))); }

nodes.name: mock-resend.cjs
nodes.body_text: // Dev-only fake of Resend's POST /emails: records every message the app sends so it can be inspected, like mock-twitch.cjs does for Twitch. // Start: node scripts/mock-resend.cjs (port 4444; MOCK_RESEND_PORT changes it). Point the app at it with RESEND_API_URL=http://localhost:4444 // (ignored in production builds) and any RESEND_API_KEY. A message to an address at @fail.test answers 500, anything else 200 { id }. // GET /__sent lists what arrived ({ auth, body }), /__reset clears the list. const http = require('http'); module.exports = { start }; if (require.main === module) start().then(s => console.log(`mock resend on ${s.port}`));

nodes.name: start
nodes.body_text: function start(port = Number(process.env.MOCK_RESEND_PORT) || 4444) { const sent = []; const server = http.createServer((req, res) => { const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost'); res.setHeader('content-type', 'application/json'); if (url.pathname === '/__sent') return res.end(JSON.stringify(sent)); if (url.pathname === '/__reset') { sent.length = 0; return res.end('"ok"'); } const chunks = []; req.on('data', c => chunks.push(c)); req.on('end', () => { let body = null; try { body = JSON.parse(Buffer.concat(chunks).toString('utf8')); } catch { /* not JSON */ } if (req.method !== 'POST' || url.pathname !== '/emails' || !body) { res.statusCode = 404; return res.end('{}'); } sent.push({ auth: req.headers.authorization, body }); const fail = (body.to || []).some(a => String(a).endsWith('@fail.test')); res.statusCode = fail ? 500 : 200; res.end(JSON.stringify(fail ? { message: 'fail' } : { id: `mock-${sent.length}` })); }); }); return new Promise(resolve => server.listen(port, '127.0.0.1', () => resolve({ port: server.address().port, sent, stop: () => server.close() }))); }

nodes.name: mock-twitch.cjs
nodes.body_text: // Dev-only fake of the Twitch endpoints used by "Log in with Twitch" (authorize, token, revoke, helix/users), so the // website login can be exercised locally without real Twitch credentials. Start: node scripts/mock-twitch.cjs (port 4222). // Point the app at it with TWITCH_ID_URL=http://localhost:4222 and TWITCH_API_URL=http://localhost:4222 (see CLAUDE.md → // Testing locally). The app ignores those variables in production builds. // // The "user" you log in as is picked with ?as=<login> on the authorize URL (default: tester, or whoever /__as?login=name last set). Each user gets a stable fake ID. const http = require('http'); const { URL } = require('url'); const codes = new Map(); // code -> login const tokens = new Map(); // token -> login const revoked = []; let live = false; // is the fake channel live? toggle with /__live?on=1 or ?on=0 let defaultUser = 'tester'; // who the next login becomes; change with /__as?login=name http.createServer((req, res) => { const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost:4222'); let body = ''; req.on('data', c => (body += c)); req.on('end', () => { // Step 1: instantly "approve" and bounce back with a code (a real Twitch shows a consent screen). if (url.pathname === '/oauth2/authorize') { const redirect = url.searchParams.get('redirect_uri'); const state = url.searchParams.get('state'); if (url.searchParams.get('deny')) { res.writeHead(302, { location: `${redirect}?error=access_denied&state=${encodeURIComponent(state)}` }); return res.end(); } const code = 'code-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2); codes.set(code, (url.searchParams.get('as') || defaultUser).toLowerCase()); res.writeHead(302, { location: `${redirect}?code=${code}&state=${encodeURIComponent(state)}` }); return res.end(); } if (url.pathname === '/oauth2/token' && req.method === 'POST') { const p = new URLSearchParams(body); if (p.get('grant_type') === 'client_credentials') return json(200, { access_token: 'app-token', expires_in: 3600, token_type: 'bearer' }); const login = codes.get(p.get('code')); if (!login || p.get('client_secret') === null) return json(400, { status: 400, message: 'invalid code' }); codes.delete(p.get('code')); const token = 'tok-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2); tokens.set(token, login); return json(200, { access_token: token, expires_in: 3600, token_type: 'bearer' }); } if (url.pathname === '/oauth2/revoke' && req.method === 'POST') { const p = new URLSearchParams(body); revoked.push(p.get('token')); tokens.delete(p.get('token')); res.writeHead(200); return res.end(); } if (url.pathname === '/helix/users') { const token = (req.headers.authorization || '').replace(/^Bearer /, ''); const login = tokens.get(token); if (!login) return json(401, { error: 'Unauthorized' }); return json(200, { data: [profile(login)] }); } // App-token endpoint used for the live indicator. if (url.pathname === '/helix/streams') { if (!/^Bearer (app-token|tok-)/.test(req.headers.authorization || '')) return json(401, { error: 'Unauthorized' }); const login = (url.searchParams.get('user_login') || '').toLowerCase(); if (!live || !login) return json(200, { data: [] }); return json(200, { data: [{ type: 'live', user_login: login, title: 'Opening packs with chat! (mock)', game_name: 'Just Chatting', viewer_count: 128, started_at: new Date(Date.now() - 3600e3).toISOString() }] }); } if (url.pathname === '/__live') { live = url.searchParams.get('on') === '1'; return json(200, { live }); } // Test helpers: switch who logs in next, and see which tokens were revoked. if (url.pathname === '/__as') { defaultUser = (url.searchParams.get('login') || 'tester').toLowerCase(); return json(200, { defaultUser }); } if (url.pathname === '/__revoked') return json(200, { revoked, outstanding: tokens.size }); json(404, { error: 'not found' }); }); }).listen(4222, () => console.log('mock twitch on 4222'));

nodes.name: optimize-cards.mjs
nodes.body_text: // Prepares card art for the web, using the same processing as admin uploads (lib/card-image.ts). // node scripts/optimize-cards.mjs [inputDir] [outputDir] // 1. Converts animated GIFs in inputDir to animated WebP in outputDir (≈20 MB → ≈1–4 MB each). // 2. Writes a small static thumbnail (first frame) for every WebP in outputDir to outputDir/thumb/. // Grids show thumbnails and only load the animated file on hover (see CardTile). // Defaults: public/assets/GIF → public/assets/cards. Requires Node ≥ 22.18 (imports the .ts module directly). // The GIF step is skipped when inputDir doesn't exist, so this also works as "regenerate thumbnails". import { readdir, mkdir, stat, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises'; import path from 'node:path'; import { toAnimatedCard, toThumb } from '../lib/card-image.ts'; const CONCURRENCY = 3; const [inDir = 'public/assets/GIF', outDir = 'public/assets/cards'] = process.argv.slice(2); const thumbDir = path.join(outDir, 'thumb'); await mkdir(thumbDir, { recursive: true }); // 1. GIF → animated WebP const gifs = await list(inDir, '.gif'); let before = 0, after = 0; await pool(gifs, async file => { const src = path.join(inDir, file); const dest = path.join(outDir, file.replace(/\.gif$/i, '.webp')); const buf = await toAnimatedCard(src); await writeFile(dest, buf); const a = await stat(src); before += a.size; after += buf.length; console.log(`${file.padEnd(28)} ${(a.size / 1e6).toFixed(1)}MB → ${(buf.length / 1e6).toFixed(2)}MB`); }); if (gifs.length) console.log(`\n${gifs.length} GIFs: ${(before / 1e6).toFixed(0)}MB → ${(after / 1e6).toFixed(0)}MB\n`); // 2. Static thumbnails (first frame of each animated WebP) const webps = await list(outDir, '.webp'); let thumbBytes = 0; await pool(webps, async file => { const buf = await toThumb(path.join(outDir, file)); await writeFile(path.join(thumbDir, file), buf); thumbBytes += buf.length; }); console.log(`${webps.length} thumbnails in ${thumbDir}: ${(thumbBytes / 1e3).toFixed(0)}KB total`);

nodes.name: list
nodes.body_text: list = async (dir, ext) => { try { return (await readdir(dir)).filter(f => f.toLowerCase().endsWith(ext)); } catch { return []; } }

nodes.name: pool
nodes.body_text: async function pool(items, worker) { const queue = [...items]; await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: CONCURRENCY }, async () => { for (let item; (item = queue.shift()); ) await worker(item); })); }

nodes.name: restore-backup.mts
nodes.body_text: // Restores a nightly backup (lib/backup.ts) into a KV store. Safe by default: the keys go into a SANDBOX namespace // (sbx:<id>:*) and the sandbox is registered, so you can open it in Admin > Sandbox and look before anything real is touched. // // BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_KEY=... KV_REST_API_URL=... KV_REST_API_TOKEN=... \ // npx tsx scripts/restore-backup.mts <backup file> [--sandbox <id>] [--dry] // and to put the keys back where they were (overwrites live data, key by key): // npx tsx scripts/restore-backup.mts <backup file> --raw --i-mean-production // // Get the file by opening the backup's Blob URL (Settings > Environment shows the newest) and saving it. KV_* point at the // target store; for a sandbox restore into production that is the production store, and nothing outside sbx:<id>: is written. import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'; import { decryptBackup, describeBackup, parseBackup } from '../lib/backup-core'; const args = process.argv.slice(2); const file = args.find((a, i) => !a.startsWith('--') && args[i - 1] !== '--sandbox'); if (!file) throw new Error('Usage: restore-backup.mts <backup file> [--sandbox <id>] [--dry] | --raw --i-mean-production'); const secret = process.env.BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_KEY ?? ''; const backup = parseBackup(decryptBackup(readFileSync(file), secret)); console.log(`Backup from ${new Date(backup.createdAt).toISOString()}: ${describeBackup(backup)}`); const raw = flag('--raw'); if (raw && !flag('--i-mean-production')) throw new Error('--raw writes over the original keys. Add --i-mean-production if that is what you want.'); const id = (opt('--sandbox') ?? `restore-${new Date(backup.createdAt).toISOString().slice(0, 10)}`).toLowerCase(); if (!raw && !/^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,22}[a-z0-9]$/.test(id)) throw new Error(`"${id}" is not a valid sandbox id.`); if (!raw && id === 'preview') throw new Error('"preview" is reserved.'); if (flag('--dry')) { console.log(raw ? 'Dry run: would restore over the original keys.' : `Dry run: would restore into sandbox "${id}".`); process.exit(0); } if (!process.env.KV_REST_API_URL || !process.env.KV_REST_API_TOKEN) throw new Error('Set KV_REST_API_URL and KV_REST_API_TOKEN for the target store.'); const { kv } = await import('@vercel/kv'); const { restoreEntries } = await import('../lib/backup'); const target = kv as unknown as Parameters<typeof restoreEntries>[0]; const n = await restoreEntries(target, backup.entries, raw ? (k: string) => k : (k: string) => `sbx:${id}:${k}`); if (!raw) { const registry = (await kv.get<{ id: string }[]>('sandbox:registry')) ?? []; if (!registry.some(s => s.id === id)) { await kv.set('sandbox:registry', [...registry, { id, name: `Restore ${id.replace(/^restore-/, '')}`, createdAt: Date.now(), lastUsedAt: Date.now(), source: 'empty' }]); } console.log(`Restored ${n} keys into sandbox "${id}". Open Admin > Sandbox and enter it to inspect.`); } else { console.log(`Restored ${n} keys over the original keys.`); }

nodes.body_text: async function startMock() { const port = await freePort(); const child = spawn(process.execPath, [join(root, 'scripts', 'mock-kv.cjs')], { env: { ...process.env, MOCK_KV_PORT: String(port) }, stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'inherit'], }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { child.once('error', reject); child.once('exit', (c) => reject(new Error(`mock KV exited early (${c})`))); child.stdout.on('data', (d) => String(d).includes('mock kv on') && resolve()); }); child.removeAllListeners('exit'); return { port, stop: () => child.kill() }; }

nodes.name: runCheck
nodes.body_text: function runCheck(file, port) { return new Promise((resolve) => { const env = { ...process.env, KV_REST_API_URL: `http://localhost:${port}`, KV_REST_API_TOKEN: 'dev', KV_URL: 'redis://dev', }; const child = spawn(process.execPath, [join(root, 'node_modules', 'tsx', 'dist', 'cli.mjs'), join('scripts', file)], { cwd: root, env, stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'], }); let out = ''; child.stdout.on('data', (d) => (out += d)); child.stderr.on('data', (d) => (out += d)); child.on('close', (code) => resolve({ code, out })); }); }

nodes.name: seed-dev.mts
nodes.body_text: // Seeds the local mock KV (scripts/mock-kv.cjs) with Season 1: `npx tsx scripts/seed-dev.mts` // Refuses to run against anything that isn't localhost, so it can never write to the real database. const url = process.env.KV_REST_API_URL ?? 'http://localhost:4111'; if (!/^http:\/\/(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)[:/]/.test(url)) throw new Error(`Refusing to seed non-local KV: ${url}`); process.env.KV_REST_API_URL = url; process.env.KV_REST_API_TOKEN ??= 'dev'; process.env.KV_URL ??= 'redis://dev'; const { seedSeason1 } = await import('../lib/kv'); await seedSeason1(); console.log('Seeded Season 1 into', url);

nodes.name: seed-review.mts
nodes.body_text: // Seeds the local mock KV with a realistic game for the page-by-page review (ROADMAP Phase 2): two seasons (Season 1 ended with a // wrap-up snapshot, Season 2 active), three packs of the new season (variants and upgrades on / a draft / an archived one), 300 // viewers per season, numbered copies with unique numbers, open and finished trades, hidden / private / blocked viewers, // achievements, a staff admin and a staff mod, and a few hundred activity events. // // node scripts/mock-kv.cjs (port 4111) // npx tsx scripts/seed-review.mts (this script; refuses any non-local KV) // // Then run the dev server and the sweeps (see docs/review.md). Prints who to log in as. const url = process.env.KV_REST_API_URL ?? 'http://localhost:4111'; if (!/^http:\/\/(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)[:/]/.test(url)) throw new Error(`Refusing to seed non-local KV: ${url}`); process.env.KV_REST_API_URL = url; process.env.KV_REST_API_TOKEN ??= 'dev'; process.env.KV_URL ??= 'redis://dev'; const kvLib = await import('../lib/kv'); const { SEED_CARDS } = await import('../lib/seed'); const { DEFAULT_UPGRADE_COSTS, DEFAULT_VARIANT_WEIGHTS, encodeEntry } = await import('../lib/variants'); const { activateWithWrapUp } = await import('../lib/season-wrap'); const { seedUsers } = await import('../lib/sandbox-tools'); const { applyScenario } = await import('../lib/sandbox-scenarios'); const serials = await import('../lib/serials'); const trades = await import('../lib/trades'); const admin = await import('../lib/user-admin'); const settingsStore = await import('../lib/user-settings-store'); const ach = await import('../lib/achievements-store'); const staff = await import('../lib/staff'); const { SUPER_ADMINS } = await import('../lib/staff-core'); const { recordActivity } = await import('../lib/activity'); const { prodKv } = await import('../lib/db'); // Start from nothing so the seed is repeatable (mock KV only; the guard above refuses anything else). let cursor: string | number = 0; do { const [next, keys] = (await prodKv.scan(cursor, { match: '*', count: 500 })) as [string | number, string[]]; if (keys.length) await prodKv.del(...keys); cursor = next; } while (String(cursor) !== '0'); // ---- Season 1: the original single-version pack, filled with a crowd, then wrapped up ---- await kvLib.seedSeason1(); const s1 = must(await kvLib.getSeason('season1'), 'season 1'); await seedUsers(null, { count: 300, minPulls: 3, maxPulls: 150, shape: 'realistic' }); await kvLib.addCollectionEntry(s1.collectionName, 'alice', 1); for (const c of SEED_CARDS) await kvLib.addCollectionEntry(s1.collectionName, 'alice', c.number); say('Season 1: 300 viewers + alice with a full set'); // ---- Season 2: variants and upgrades, plus a draft pack and an archived pack ---- const base = { coverImageUrl: '/assets/pack-cover.png', weight: 1, accentColor: 'rgb(241,187,6)', tearBorderColor: 'rgb(218,163,18)', holoMinStars: 4, cardTime: 3, cooldownTime: 1, soundVolume: 1, createdAt: Date.now() }; const packWheel: Pack = { ...base, id: 'pack-wheel', name: 'Cheese Wheel Pack', active: true, status: 'published', upgradesEnabled: true, variantWeights: DEFAULT_VARIANT_WEIGHTS, upgradeCosts: DEFAULT_UPGRADE_COSTS }; const packDraft: Pack = { ...base, id: 'pack-draft', name: 'Work In Progress Pack', active: false, status: 'draft', upgradesEnabled: false, variantWeights: DEFAULT_VARIANT_WEIGHTS, upgradeCosts: DEFAULT_UPGRADE_COSTS }; const packOld: Pack = { ...base, id: 'pack-old', name: 'Retired Promo Pack', active: false, status: 'published', archived: true, archivedAt: Date.now(), upgradesEnabled: false, variantWeights: DEFAULT_VARIANT_WEIGHTS, upgradeCosts: DEFAULT_UPGRADE_COSTS }; const wheelCards: Card[] = SEED_CARDS.slice(0, 20).map(c => ({ ...c, id: `w${c.number}`, soundUrl: undefined, fullArtImageUrl: c.imageUrl })); const draftCards: Card[] = SEED_CARDS.slice(20, 25).map((c, i) => ({ ...c, id: `d${i + 1}`, number: 21 + i, soundUrl: undefined })); // numbers are unique across a season's packs, like the real wizards assign them const oldCards: Card[] = SEED_CARDS.slice(0, 5).map(c => ({ ...c, id: `o${c.number}`, soundUrl: undefined })); for (const [p, cards] of [[packWheel, wheelCards], [packDraft, draftCards], [packOld, oldCards]] as const) { await kvLib.savePack(p); await kvLib.savePackCards(p.id, [...cards]); } await kvLib.saveSeason({ id: 'season2', name: 'Aged Cheddar', collectionName: 'AgedCheddar', active: false, status: 'published', createdAt: Date.now(), maxConcurrentPacks: 1, packIds: [packWheel.id, packDraft.id] }); const act = await activateWithWrapUp('season2'); // wraps Season 1 up first: final standings, awards, trading frozen if (!act.ok) throw new Error('could not activate season 2: ' + act.error); const s2 = must(await kvLib.getSeason('season2'), 'season 2'); say(`Season 2 active; Season 1 wrapped up (${act.replaced ?? 'none'})`); await seedUsers(null, { count: 300, minPulls: 3, maxPulls: 150, shape: 'realistic' }); await grant('alice', wheelCards.flatMap(c => [...all(c.number, 'regular', 2), ...(c.number % 3 === 0 ? all(c.number, 'reverse') : []), ...(c.number % 7 === 0 ? [...all(c.number, 'full'), ...all(c.number, 'shiny')] : [])])); await grant('hoarder', wheelCards.flatMap(c => all(c.number, 'regular', 150))); // 3,000 copies: a heavy collector for (const s of ['upgrade-ready', 'nearly-complete', 'complete-set', 'trade-pair', 'shiny-showcase'] as const) await applyScenario(null, s); say('Season 2: 300 viewers, scenarios (upgrade_ready, one_card_short, completionist, trader_a / b, shiny_hunter), alice, hoarder'); // ---- hidden, private, blocked viewers and one very long name ---- const longName = 'a_very_long_username_25c'; await grant('hidden_hank', all(1, 'regular', 3)); await grant('private_pat', all(2, 'regular', 3)); await grant('blocked_bob', all(3, 'regular', 3)); await grant(longName, all(4, 'shiny', 2)); await admin.saveFlags('hidden_hank', { hideFromBoard: true, reason: 'review: hidden from public boards' }); await admin.saveFlags('blocked_bob', { noTrading: true, reason: 'review: blocked from trading' }); await settingsStore.saveUserSettings('private_pat', { privateProfile: true, bio: 'review: a private collector' }); await settingsStore.saveUserSettings('alice', { bio: 'review: heavy collector with every card.' }); await admin.saveTags('alice', ['VIP', 'review']); say('Hidden: hidden_hank · private: private_pat · trade-blocked: blocked_bob · long name: ' + longName); // ---- serials: number every existing copy, with unique copy numbers ---- for (const s of [s1, s2]) await serials.backfillSerials(s.collectionName, await kvLib.getCollection(s.collectionName)); say('Serials numbered for both seasons'); // ---- trades: an open listing, an open direct offer, and a finished swap ---- const a = (await kvLib.getCollection(s2.collectionName)).trader_a ?? []; const b = (await kvLib.getCollection(s2.collectionName)).trader_b ?? []; const aSpare = cardOf(a[0]); const bSpare = cardOf(b[0]); const listing = await trades.createTrade({ seasonId: s2.id, from: 'trader_a', kind: 'listing', give: item(aSpare), get: item(bSpare), note: 'review: open listing' }); const direct = await trades.createTrade({ seasonId: s2.id, from: 'alice', kind: 'direct', to: 'trader_b', give: item(wheelCards[0].number), get: item(bSpare), note: 'review: direct offer' }); const swap = await trades.createTrade({ seasonId: s2.id, from: 'trader_b', kind: 'direct', to: 'trader_a', give: item(bSpare), get: item(aSpare), note: 'review: finished swap' }); if (swap.ok) await trades.acceptTrade(swap.trade.id, 'trader_a'); say(`Trades: listing ${listing.ok ? 'ok' : 'FAILED ' + JSON.stringify(listing)}, direct ${direct.ok ? 'ok' : 'FAILED ' + JSON.stringify(direct)}, swap ${swap.ok ? 'ok' : 'FAILED'}`); // ---- achievements ---- for (const u of ['alice', 'completionist', 'shiny_hunter', 'one_card_short']) await ach.syncAchievements(u); // ---- staff ---- const actor = { login: SUPER_ADMINS[0].login, role: 'super' as const }; await kvLib.ensureUserProfile('review_admin'); await kvLib.ensureUserProfile('review_mod'); console.log((await staff.addStaff(actor, 'review_admin', 'admin')).message); console.log((await staff.addStaff(actor, 'review_mod', 'mod')).message); // ---- activity: a few hundred events ---- const board = Object.keys(await kvLib.getCollection(s2.collectionName)); for (let i = 0; i < 300; i++) { const c = pick(wheelCards); const user = pick(board); await recordActivity({ type: 'pull', username: user, collectionName: s2.collectionName, cardNumber: c.number, cardName: c.name, stars: c.stars, packName: packWheel.name, variant: pick<Variant>(['regular', 'regular', 'regular', 'reverse', 'full', 'shiny']), isNew: Math.random() < 0.3, copies: 1 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 3), uniqueOwned: 1 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 20), }); } await recordActivity({ type: 'grant', source: 'admin', username: 'alice', cardNumber: 1 }); await recordActivity({ type: 'reset', scope: 'season', username: 'blocked_bob' }); say('Activity: 300 pulls and two staff events'); say(` Review data is ready. Admin ......... emergency password login (ADMIN_PASSWORD in .env.local, 'pw' in the documented setup) Admin (Twitch) fake Twitch user "review_admin" Mod ........... fake Twitch user "review_mod" (curl "http://localhost:4222/__as?login=review_mod") Viewer ........ "alice" (full set, bio, VIP), "tester" (new viewer), "trader_a", "completionist", "hoarder" (3,000 copies) Special ....... hidden_hank (hidden), private_pat (private), blocked_bob (no trading), ${longName} (long name) Seasons ....... Cheesy Starter Deck (ended, wrap-up saved), Aged Cheddar (active) Packs ......... Cheese Wheel Pack (variants + upgrades), Work In Progress Pack (draft), Retired Promo Pack (archived)`);

nodes.name: seed-twitch-screenshots.mts
nodes.body_text: // Seeds a sandbox (needs the mock KV and a seeded Season 1, see CLAUDE.md "Testing locally") with what the Twitch panel screenshots need: // a rich viewer "cheesyfan" (150 simulated pulls plus a shiny and a full art, serial numbers on), a crowd of 45 for the leaderboard and // six board listings. Prints the sandbox id. See twitch-extension/SUBMISSION.md section 4. process.env.KV_REST_API_URL ||= 'http://localhost:4111'; process.env.KV_REST_API_TOKEN ||= 'dev'; process.env.KV_URL ||= 'redis://dev'; const { createSandbox } = await import('../lib/sandbox'); const tools = await import('../lib/sandbox-tools'); const { runInSandbox } = await import('../lib/db'); const kv = await import('../lib/kv'); const serials = await import('../lib/serials'); const trades = await import('../lib/trades'); const sb = await createSandbox({ name: 'Twitch shots', source: 'config' }); await runInSandbox(sb.id, async () => { for (const pack of await kv.listAllPacks()) await kv.savePack({ ...pack, upgradesEnabled: true }); }); await tools.seedUsers(sb.id, { count: 45, minPulls: 6, maxPulls: 260, shape: 'realistic' }); await tools.simulatePulls(sb.id, 'cheesyfan', 150); await tools.grantCopies(sb.id, 'cheesyfan', 3, 'shiny', 1); await tools.grantCopies(sb.id, 'cheesyfan', 9, 'full', 1); await runInSandbox(sb.id, async () => { const season = await kv.getActiveSeason(); const data = await kv.getCollection(season!.collectionName); await serials.backfillSerials(season!.collectionName, data); // a couple of board listings from other viewers const others = Object.keys(data).filter(u => u !== 'cheesyfan').slice(0, 6); let made = 0; for (const u of others) { const owned = [...new Set(data[u])].slice(0, 2); if (owned.length < 1) continue; const r = await trades.createTrade({ seasonId: season!.id, from: u, kind: 'listing', give: [{ cardNumber: owned[0] % 1_000_000, variant: 'regular', count: 1 }], get: [{ cardNumber: ((owned[0] + 3) % 25) + 1, variant: 'regular', count: 1 }] }).catch(() => null); if (r && 'ok' in r && r.ok) made++; } console.log('listings', made); }); console.log('SANDBOX', sb.id);

nodes.name: stitch-screenshot-tiles.cjs
nodes.body_text: // node scripts/stitch-screenshot-tiles.cjs <out.png> <a> <b> <c> <d> // Four 800x600 tiles of a 1024x768 page, captured with the page scrolled to (0,0), (224,0), (0,168) and (224,168), become one // 1024x768 PNG. Each output pixel comes from exactly one tile (split at x=512, y=384), so animated art that differs between tiles // never shows a seam through the middle of it. const sharp = require(process.cwd() + '/node_modules/sharp'); const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const [out, a, b, c, d] = process.argv.slice(2); (async () => { const parts = [ { input: await cut(a, 0, 0), left: 0, top: 0 }, // page (0..512, 0..384) from the tile scrolled to (0,0) { input: await cut(b, 288, 0), left: 512, top: 0 }, // page (512..1024, 0..384): x - 224 = 288 in the tile scrolled to (224,0) { input: await cut(c, 0, 216), left: 0, top: 384 }, // page (0..512, 384..768): y - 168 = 216 in the tile scrolled to (0,168) { input: await cut(d, 288, 216), left: 512, top: 384 }, ]; const img = await sharp({ create: { width: 1024, height: 768, channels: 4, background: '#000' } }).composite(parts).flatten({ background: '#000' }).png().toBuffer(); fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(out), { recursive: true }); fs.writeFileSync(out, img); const m = await sharp(img).metadata(); console.log('wrote', out, m.width + 'x' + m.height); })();

nodes.name: cut
nodes.body_text: cut = (file, left, top) => sharp(file).extract({ left, top, width: 512, height: 384 }).png().toBuffer()

nodes.name: sweep-admin.mjs
nodes.body_text: // Sweeps the admin panel (/admin/*) and the mod panel (/mod/*) on a running dev server, the way sweep-public.mjs does the public site: // phone, tablet and desktop width, flagging horizontal overflow, a missing or duplicate h1, images without alt, unnamed controls // and console errors. Admin pages are visited as an admin (emergency password login), mod pages as a mod (fake Twitch login // "review_mod"), and the admin pages are also visited as the mod to check they send the mod away. // // Needs: mock KV + `npx tsx scripts/seed-review.mts`, the dev server on :3111, the fake Twitch on :4222 and Playwright (see docs/review.md). // Run: node scripts/sweep-admin.mjs (every page, three widths) // node scripts/sweep-admin.mjs /admin/packs ... (only these paths, admin or mod) // node scripts/sweep-admin.mjs --width=390 (one width) import { BASE, flagsFor, loadPlaywright, loginAdminPassword, loginTwitch, visit, watchConsole } from './lib/sweep.mjs'; // Dynamic routes are filled from the seed (scripts/seed-review.mts): a real pack, card, season, viewer and copy. const PACK = 'pack-wheel', DRAFT = 'pack-draft', SEASON = 'season2', ENDED = 'season1', VIEWER = 'alice', COPY = '1.0.1'; const ADMIN_PAGES = [ '/admin', '/admin?range=24h', '/admin?range=season', `/admin?season=${ENDED}`, '/admin/activity', '/admin/seasons', '/admin/seasons/new', `/admin/seasons/${SEASON}`, `/admin/seasons/${SEASON}?tab=packs`, `/admin/seasons/${SEASON}?tab=settings`, `/admin/seasons/${SEASON}?tab=wrapup`, `/admin/seasons/${ENDED}`, `/admin/seasons/${ENDED}?tab=wrapup`, '/admin/packs', '/admin/packs/new', `/admin/packs/new?draft=${DRAFT}`, `/admin/packs/${PACK}`, `/admin/packs/${PACK}?tab=odds`, `/admin/packs/${PACK}?tab=overview`, `/admin/packs/${PACK}?tab=settings`, `/admin/packs/${PACK}/cards`, `/admin/packs/${PACK}/cards/w1`, `/admin/packs/${DRAFT}`, '/admin/users', `/admin/users/${VIEWER}`, `/admin/users/${VIEWER}?tab=collection`, `/admin/users/${VIEWER}?tab=trades`, `/admin/users/${VIEWER}?tab=grant`, `/admin/users/${VIEWER}?tab=admin`, `/admin/users/${VIEWER}?compare=trader_a`, '/admin/users/hoarder', '/admin/users/blocked_bob', '/admin/users/nobody_here', '/admin/staff', '/admin/trades', '/admin/trades?tab=log', '/admin/trades?tab=settings', '/admin/serials', `/admin/serials/${SEASON}/${COPY}`, '/admin/overlay', `/admin/overlay?scope=${PACK}`, '/admin/assets', '/admin/assets?tab=pack-cover', '/admin/assets?tab=sound', '/admin/assets?tab=unused', '/admin/assets?tab=insights', '/admin/settings', '/admin/settings?tab=scoring', '/admin/settings?tab=webhooks', '/admin/settings?tab=viewers', '/admin/settings?tab=environment', '/admin/settings?tab=about', '/admin/webhooks', '/admin/sandbox', '/admin/sandbox/does-not-exist', '/admin/does-not-exist', ]; const MOD_PAGES = ['/mod', '/mod/activity', '/mod/users', `/mod/users/${VIEWER}`, '/mod/users/nobody_here', '/mod/trades', '/mod/does-not-exist']; const WIDTHS = { 390: 844, 768: 1024, 1280: 900 }; const args = process.argv.slice(2); const asked = args.filter(a => a.startsWith('/')); const widthArg = args.find(a => a.startsWith('--width='))?.slice(8); const widths = widthArg ? [Number(widthArg)] : Object.keys(WIDTHS).map(Number); const adminPages = asked.length ? asked.filter(p => p.startsWith('/admin')) : ADMIN_PAGES; const modPages = asked.length ? asked.filter(p => p.startsWith('/mod')) : MOD_PAGES; const browser = await (await loadPlaywright()).launch(); let problems = 0; for (const w of widths) { if (adminPages.length) await sweep('admin', asAdmin, adminPages, w); if (modPages.length) await sweep('mod', asMod, modPages, w); } // What a mod sees on an admin URL: the middleware sends them to /mod (the access test, sweep-mod-access.mjs, goes deeper). if (!asked.length) await sweep('mod->admin', asMod, ['/admin', '/admin/users', '/admin/settings'], widths[widths.length - 1], { expectRedirect: '/mod' }); await browser.close(); console.log(problems ? `\n${problems} page(s) flagged` : '\nall pages clean'); process.exit(problems ? 1 : 0);

nodes.name: sweep
nodes.signature: async function sweep(label, ctxFactory, pages, width, opts = {})
nodes.body_text: async function sweep(label, ctxFactory, pages, width, opts = {}) { const ctx = await ctxFactory(width); const p = await ctx.newPage(); const errors = watchConsole(p); for (const path of pages) { const r = await visit(p, path, errors); const flags = opts.expectRedirect ? (r.url.startsWith(opts.expectRedirect) ? [] : [`expected to be sent to ${opts.expectRedirect}, ended on ${r.url}`]) : flagsFor(r, { expectH1: !/does-not-exist|nobody_here/.test(path) }); if (flags.length) problems++; console.log(`${label}@${width} ${path} [${r.status}] ${r.info ? `"${r.info.title}"` : ''} ${flags.join('; ') || 'ok'}`); } await ctx.close(); }

nodes.name: viewport
nodes.body_text: viewport = w => ({ width: w, height: WIDTHS[w] ?? 900 })

nodes.name: asAdmin
nodes.body_text: asAdmin = async w => { const c = await browser.newContext({ viewport: viewport(w) }); await loginAdminPassword(c); return c; }

nodes.name: asMod
nodes.body_text: asMod = async w => { const c = await browser.newContext({ viewport: viewport(w) }); const where = await loginTwitch(c, 'review_mod', '/mod'); if (!where.startsWith('/mod')) console.log(`warning: mod login ended on ${where}; is review_mod on the staff list (seed-review) and SESSION_SECRET / TWITCH_* set?`); return c; }

nodes.name: sweep-mod-access.mjs
nodes.body_text: // Runtime half of the mod access test (the static half is scripts/check-staff-guards.mts, part of `npm run check`): signs in as a // mod and as a stranger, then checks every /admin page and every /api/admin route refuses them, apart from what a mod may use // (the /mod pages and GET /api/admin/activity). Exits non-zero if anything gets through. // // Needs the same setup as sweep-admin.mjs (seed-review, dev server, fake Twitch). Run: node scripts/sweep-mod-access.mjs import { BASE, loadPlaywright, loginAdminPassword, loginTwitch } from './lib/sweep.mjs'; const PACK = 'pack-wheel', SEASON = 'season2'; const ADMIN_PAGES = ['/admin', '/admin/activity', '/admin/seasons', '/admin/seasons/new', `/admin/seasons/${SEASON}`, '/admin/packs', '/admin/packs/new', `/admin/packs/${PACK}`, `/admin/packs/${PACK}/cards`, `/admin/packs/${PACK}/cards/w1`, '/admin/users', '/admin/users/alice', '/admin/staff', '/admin/trades', '/admin/serials', '/admin/overlay', '/admin/assets', '/admin/settings', '/admin/settings?tab=environment', '/admin/sandbox']; // GET API routes and what they should answer a mod / a stranger. import-legacy has its own secret and is only probed without one. const ADMIN_API = [ { path: '/api/admin/overlay-status', mod: [401, 403] }, { path: '/api/admin/palette', mod: [401, 403] }, { path: '/api/admin/import-legacy', mod: [401, 403], admin: [401] }, // checks its own ?secret=, so even an admin gets 401 without it { path: '/api/admin/activity?after=0', mod: [200] }, // the one admin route mods may read ]; const POST_API = ['/api/admin/sandbox/ext-token']; const browser = await (await loadPlaywright()).launch(); let failures = 0; const stranger = await browser.newContext(); await probe('stranger', stranger, { expectPages: false }); await stranger.close(); const mod = await browser.newContext(); const where = await loginTwitch(mod, 'review_mod', '/mod'); if (!where.startsWith('/mod')) console.log(`warning: the mod login ended on ${where}; check the seed and the dev server env`); await probe('mod', mod, { expectPages: false }); // The /mod pages must work for the mod. const mp = await mod.newPage(); for (const path of ['/mod', '/mod/activity', '/mod/users', '/mod/trades']) { const res = await mp.goto(BASE + path, { waitUntil: 'load', timeout: 90000 }).catch(() => null); report(res?.status() === 200 && new URL(mp.url()).pathname === path, `mod page ${path} -> ${res?.status()}`); } await mod.close(); const admin = await browser.newContext(); await loginAdminPassword(admin); await probe('admin', admin, { expectPages: true }); await admin.close(); await browser.close(); console.log(failures ? `\n${failures} access problem(s)` : '\nnobody got anywhere they should not'); process.exit(failures ? 1 : 0);

nodes.name: report
nodes.body_text: report = (ok, line) => { if (!ok) failures++; console.log(`${ok ? 'ok ' : 'FAIL'} ${line}`); }

nodes.name: probe
nodes.body_text: async function probe(label, ctx, { expectPages }) { const p = await ctx.newPage(); for (const path of ADMIN_PAGES) { await p.goto(BASE + path, { waitUntil: 'load', timeout: 90000 }).catch(() => null); const end = new URL(p.url()).pathname; const sent = end.startsWith('/admin') ? false : true; // sent away (to /mod, /login, ...) report(expectPages ? !sent : sent, `${label} page ${path} -> ${end}`); } await p.close(); for (const r of ADMIN_API) { const res = await ctx.request.get(BASE + r.path, { maxRedirects: 0 }); const allowed = label === 'stranger' ? [401, 403, 307, 308] : label === 'admin' ? (r.admin ?? [200]) : r.mod; report(allowed.includes(res.status()), `${label} GET ${r.path} -> ${res.status()}`); } for (const path of POST_API) { const res = await ctx.request.post(BASE + path, { data: {}, maxRedirects: 0 }); report(label === 'admin' ? res.status() !== 401 && res.status() !== 403 : [401, 403, 307, 308].includes(res.status()), `${label} POST ${path} -> ${res.status()}`); } }

nodes.name: sweep-public.mjs
nodes.body_text: // Sweeps every public page on a running dev server (localhost:3111, mock KV seeded, fake Twitch login) at phone and desktop width, // signed in and signed out: flags horizontal overflow, a missing / duplicate h1, images without alt, unnamed buttons and console // errors. Needs Playwright (npm i -D playwright, or the one pre-installed in the Claude cloud environment). // Run: node scripts/sweep-public.mjs (every public page) // node scripts/sweep-public.mjs --as=alice /u/alice (signed-in passes as that fake-Twitch viewer, e.g. to see an owner's own profile) // node scripts/sweep-public.mjs /u/alice /trade (only these paths: a review batch sweeps just its own pages) // Seed realistic data first with scripts/seed-review.mts (see docs/review.md). import { loadPlaywright, loginTwitch } from './lib/sweep.mjs'; const asUser = (process.argv.find(a => a.startsWith('--as=')) ?? '--as=tester').slice(5); // who the signed-in passes are (fake Twitch login) const b = await (await loadPlaywright()).launch(); const defaultRoutes = ['/', '/faq', '/privacy', '/terms', '/collection', '/leaderboard', '/stats', '/cards', '/trade', '/trade?tab=board', '/trade?tab=history', '/trade/new', '/account', '/settings', '/notifications', '/u/alice', '/u/alice?tab=collection', '/u/alice?tab=stats', '/u/alice?tab=trades', '/u/alice?tab=activity', '/u/tester', '/copy/season1/1.0.1', '/auth/error?reason=denied', '/u/nobody_here', '/does-not-exist', '/u/hoarder', '/u/private_pat', '/u/hidden_hank', '/u/a_very_long_username_25c', '/leaderboard/season1']; const asked = process.argv.slice(2).filter(a => a.startsWith('/')); const routes = asked.length ? asked : defaultRoutes; await sweep('mobile', { width: 390, height: 844 }, true); await sweep('tablet', { width: 768, height: 1024 }, true); await sweep('desktop', { width: 1280, height: 900 }, true); await sweep('out-mobile', { width: 390, height: 844 }, false); await b.close();

nodes.name: sweep
nodes.body_text: async function sweep(label, viewport, login) { const ctx = await b.newContext({ viewport }); const p = await ctx.newPage(); const errors = []; p.on('console', m => { if (m.type() === 'error' && !/TUNNEL|ERR_FAILED|Failed to load resource/.test(m.text())) errors.push(m.text().slice(0, 160)); }); p.on('pageerror', e => errors.push('PAGEERROR ' + e.message.slice(0, 160))); if (login) { await loginTwitch(ctx, asUser, '/settings'); } for (const r of routes) { errors.length = 0; const res = await p.goto('http://localhost:3111' + r, { timeout: 90000, waitUntil: 'load' }).catch(e => null); await p.waitForLoadState('networkidle').catch(() => {}); await p.waitForTimeout(400); await p.waitForTimeout(600); let info = null; for (let t = 0; t < 4 && !info; t++) { try { info = await p.evaluate(() => ({ overflow: document.documentElement.scrollWidth - document.documentElement.clientWidth, h1: document.querySelectorAll('h1').length, title: document.title, noAlt: [...document.querySelectorAll('img:not([alt])')].length, unnamed: [...document.querySelectorAll('button, a')].filter(e => !(e.textContent || '').trim() && !e.getAttribute('aria-label') && !e.getAttribute('title') && !e.querySelector('img[alt]:not([alt=""])')).length, })); } catch { await p.waitForTimeout(1500); } } if (!info) { console.log(`${label} ${r} [${res?.status()}] could not measure (kept navigating)`); continue; } const flags = []; if (info.overflow > 1) flags.push(`overflow ${info.overflow}px`); if (info.h1 !== 1) flags.push(`h1=${info.h1}`); if (info.noAlt) flags.push(`${info.noAlt} img without alt`); if (info.unnamed) flags.push(`${info.unnamed} unnamed controls`); if (errors.length) flags.push('console: ' + errors.join(' | ')); console.log(`${label} ${r} [${res?.status()}] "${info.title}" ${flags.join('; ') || 'ok'}`); } await ctx.close(); }

nodes.name: tailwind.config.ts
nodes.body_text: import type { Config } from 'tailwindcss'; const config: Config = { content: ['./app/**/*.{js,ts,jsx,tsx,mdx}', './lib/**/*.{ts,tsx}'], theme: { extend: { colors: { // Deep navy scale, retints every existing gray-* class into the TCG theme. gray: { 50: '#f4f6ff', 100: '#e6eafb', 200: '#cdd5f3', 300: '#a9b5e0', 400: '#8190bf', 500: '#7885b5', 600: '#5f6c9c', 700: '#394472', 800: '#1f2848', 900: '#141b36', 950: '#0a0f21', }, // Electric trading-card yellow. yellow: { 50: '#fffbe0', 100: '#fff4b3', 200: '#ffec80', 300: '#ffe14d', 400: '#ffd726', 500: '#ffcb05', 600: '#e0b000', 700: '#b88a00', 800: '#8a6700', 900: '#5c4500', 950: '#332600', }, poke: { blue: '#3b4cca', 'blue-light': '#6b7cff', red: '#ee3b3b', }, }, fontFamily: { display: ['var(--font-display)', 'ui-rounded', 'system-ui', 'sans-serif'], sans: ['var(--font-body)', 'system-ui', 'sans-serif'], }, boxShadow: { card: '0 1px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.05) inset, 0 8px 24px -8px rgba(0,0,0,0.6)', glow: '0 0 0 1px rgba(255,203,5,0.35), 0 0 24px -4px rgba(255,203,5,0.35)', }, }, }, plugins: [], }; export default config;
